papers.summary: 本文介绍名为Spark-to-Paper的端到端科研论文自动生成系统，定位为可直接嵌入现有代码助手，而非独立智能体平台；核心由13个可复用技能模块覆盖从想法到完稿全流程。系统先确定实验方案再执行结果，以避免事后凑结论；内置完整性校验、自审与自反驳机制，文中给出虚假内容检测率从14%提升至92%。实验图由代码直接生成可编辑矢量图，引用有效率报告为99.5%。成本与速度方面，整套系统平均仅需3.2小时、8.1美元即可生成一篇完整论文，并会主动终止无法验证的研究方向，不靠编造结果强行“成功”。文章提供论文链接 https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.11924。对研究人员而言，最值得验证的是这些指标的定义、评估集与基线、13个技能模块的复用边界、引用有效率与虚假内容检测是否经过独立复核，以及3.2小时/8.1美元对应的硬件、模型调用次数与论文领域覆盖范围。

arxiv.title: Spark-to-Paper: End-to-End Research Paper Generation as a Composable Skill
arxiv.abstract: Turning a research idea into a complete paper requires more than text generation: the system must retrieve literature, design and execute experiments, revise claims according to evidence, produce publication-ready figures, and maintain consistency across a long generation process. We present Spark-to-Paper, an end-to-end research paper generation system implemented as thirteen composable skills inside an existing coding assistant, without requiring a separate agent platform or orchestration service. Spark-to-Paper separates model-based judgment from deterministic operations that can be directly executed and checked. It further separates experiment planning from reporting, so that required evidence is specified before results are observed and manuscript claims are revised according to measured outcomes. To improve reliability over long research trajectories, the system combines deterministic integrity checks with self-critique and bounds a failure mode we call the Self-Refutation Loop, in which repeated experiments continue to reject the original research objective. Spark-to-Paper also produces editable vector figures through programmatic plotting for experimental results and code-based reconstruction for generated method diagrams. papers.report_title: AutoTrans:68组断言,53组自动通过
papers.summary: 9 月 9 日提交 arXiv 的论文 AutoTrans，提出用大模型和 EDA 工具组成流水线，把 NS31A 参考处理器的安全断言迁移到 lowRISC Ibex，并以 QuestaSim 和 JasperGold 作硬门槛。结果：68 个 assertion groups 中自动通过 53 个，Auto TAR 78%；加入针对目标微架构的人工修复后 Final TAR 100%。100% translation coverage 只表示生成输出，Auto TAR 才表示无人干预通过形式验证和非空洞检查。PMP grounding 消融显示，无目标信号清单时模型生成 15 个不存在的信号名并因 Markdown fence 首行编译失败；加入 grounding 后 8 个信号全部有效，编译通过，PMP TAR 100%。流程先用 Python 正则提取端口、内部信号、参数、枚举和 packed struct 写入 signals.json，识别 clk_i/rst_ni，再以 byte-identical prompt assembly、temperature=0.0、seed=42 固定流程，初次翻译用 V4-Flash，失败重试升级 V4-Pro。剩余 16 组人工修复集中在时序表达、前件范围与可达性、绑定与信号对应三类。Stage 2 仍需商业 EDA license 和服务器，论文没有给出跨版本、跨处理器、跨团队的独立复现结果。

arxiv.title: AutoTrans: AI-Assisted Automatic Translation of Security Assertions for RISC-V Processors
arxiv.abstract: Reusing a set of verified security assertions across RISC-V processor targets remains one of the most expensive bottlenecks in hardware security verification. Manual translation takes hours per assertion. Raw LLM translation is fast but unreliable, introducing signal hallucination, where the model invents port names absent from the target RTL and produces outputs that may vary across model updates or even within the same model version. This paper presents AutoTrans, an automated framework that addresses the above shortcomings. First, a new lightweight Regular Expression-based System Verilog signal extractor is proposed to identify the signals for generating security assertions. This step is necessary to prevent signal hallucination. Second, a template is introduced to create prompt and pinned inference parameters that guarantee a byte-identical prompt assembly on every run, making the pipeline output resilient to model updates. Moreover, the introduced template for LLM prompting is capable of generating security assertions from English-only security descriptions of RISC-V processors, with no manual authoring. Third, a formal verification process (JasperGold FPV) is integrated, which guarantees that the generated security assertions verify the security of the RISC-V processor rather than silently entering the result set. papers.report_title: 把大模型留给难步骤,这篇论文训练 AI 自己判断求助时机
papers.summary: 这项arXiv预印本提出PyroDash，让小模型先推理，在遇到难以处理的步骤时输出专用控制标记，再由协作引擎把原问题和已生成推理打包给冻结的大模型继续完成；一次请求最多交棒一次，且不回退小模型。方法分三步训练小模型：先认识交棒标记，再用监督数据区分可独立完成与需帮助的题，最后用强化学习优化，奖励同时包含答对和成本，λ控制准确率与省钱的取舍。实验用Qwen3.5-4B作小模型、GLM-5.2-FP8作大模型，在五组数学推理基准上测试，三个普通基准单次贪心，两个AIME基准32次采样，总分等权平均。λ=0.05策略平均准确率64.04%，高于只用大模型57.68%达6.36个百分点，估算成本49.36→39.29美元，但95.34%输出词元仍来自大模型，平均每题调用0.975次。λ=0.6策略准确率54.55%，比只用大模型低3.13个百分点，却将大模型输出词元占比压到1.90%、平均每题调用0.012次、估算总成本1.78美元，较大模型基线低96.4%，并略高于RouteLLM 52.74%和GlimpRouter 54.20%。作者提醒，96.4%降幅按论文词元单价估算，并非真实账单；实验仅覆盖数学推理、EasyHard-24k构造流程和一组大小模型搭配，代码生成、工具调用、多模态、多轮对话及交棒位置是否落在真实失真点均未验证。

arxiv.title: PyroDash: Cost-Efficient Token-Level Small-Large Language Model Collaborative Inference
arxiv.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) provide strong reasoning capabilities but are expensive to serve at scale, whereas small language models (SLMs) are cheaper but less reliable on difficult problems. We introduce PyroDash, a cost-aware framework for token-level SLM-LLM collaborative inference. During generation, the SLM decides whether to request assistance by emitting a control token. A Collaborate Engine then sends the query and partial reasoning trace to a frozen LLM for completion through a single handoff. The policy is internalized in the SLM, requiring neither a separate router, LLM retraining, nor access to LLM logits. PyroDash trains the SLM in three stages: control-token embedding learning, offloading-oriented supervised fine-tuning, and cost-aware alignment with Group Relative Policy Optimization. Its reward balances answer accuracy against inference cost normalized by LLM-only inference. Across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, PyroDash supports different accuracy-cost operating points. With $λ=0.05$, it achieves 64.04 percent average accuracy, 6.36 percentage points above the LLM-only baseline, while reducing cost by 20.4 percent. With $λ=0.6$, it achieves 54.55 percent accuracy with a 1.90 percent LLM token ratio and 0.012 LLM calls per example, reducing total cost from USD 49.36 to USD 1.78. arxiv.title: Dr. Claw: An AI Scientist Workspace for Vibe Research
arxiv.abstract: Command-line coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Gemini CLI) can already read and write files and sustain long sessions, yet end-to-end research still fragments across chat tools, IDEs, terminals, and writing environments, and the decisions that make it auditable are rarely preserved. We present Dr. Claw, an open-source workspace that wraps existing coding-agent executors in a controllable and auditable human-in-the-loop workflow rather than introducing another autonomous agent. Persistent state objects, a reusable skill library, and multi-executor coordination link human decisions to AI execution, turning planning, execution, and writing into one traceable, recoverable loop. We demonstrate Dr. Claw through an interactive three-view scenario and a failure-recovery walkthrough, and evaluate it against a bare command-line agent sharing the same backend executor, so the comparison contrasts the whole orchestration layer (task graph, state objects, and skill library) with the agent it wraps. Holding the executor fixed, Dr. Claw scores higher on research completeness while persisting an auditable, recoverable process trail. Demo access: repository https://github.com/OpenLAIR/dr-claw, released under AGPL-3.0 with GPL-3.0 upstream components.

papers.title: Are LLM Evaluators Really Narcissists? Sanity Checking Self-Preference Evaluations
papers.report_title: 大模型偏爱自己的答案?  这篇ICML论文先检查:它到底会不会评
papers.summary: 本文解读 ICML 2026 论文《Are LLM Evaluators Really Narcissists? Sanity Checking Self-Preference Evaluations》，重新审视 LLM 作为 judge 比较两个回答时被广泛报告的 self-preference bias（自偏好/自恋）现象。作者指出，既有研究中“模型偏爱自己”的信号可能与 evaluator quality 混杂：模型在自己答错的问题上本就不确定、更易乱判，选择自己的错误答案未必是识别出“这是我写的”。论文提出四项创新：(1) 引入 oracle label G(x,A,B) 将自偏好拆分为合理自偏好 LSP 与不合理自偏好 ILSP，并给出偏差分解 Bias=(1−Acc)·ILSP−Acc·(1−LSP)，表明 harmful bias 主要由 ILSP 驱动；(2) 提出 Evaluator Quality Baseline，在 example-level 按 oracle outcome 匹配 proxy model 回答，用 Δs_J 度量超出评审质量噪声的额外自偏好；(3) 将检验改造为配对 t-test，零假设为 judge 并不比 proxy 更偏好自身输出；(4) 用二元香农熵分析不确定性机制，发现在 hard examples 上 judge 评价自身与评价 proxy 的熵高度相关，相关系数 ρ=0.85，支持原始自偏好很大部分来自 evaluator quality artifact。该工作对自动化评测、后训练、偏好学习、安全监督与 guardrail 构建均有直接影响。

arxiv.title: Are LLM Evaluators Really Narcissists? Sanity Checking Self-Preference Evaluations
arxiv.abstract: Recent research has shown that large language models (LLMs) favor their own outputs when acting as judges, undermining the integrity of automated post-training and evaluation workflows. However, it is difficult to disentangle which behaviors are explained by narcissism versus experimental confounds. Specifically, LLM evaluators may deliver self-preferring verdicts when comparing responses to questions they fail on; these verdicts may not depend on the identity of the author, but on evaluator quality. We correct this by directly comparing the judge's voting distribution in cases where it evaluates itself versus another model. This evaluator quality baseline reveals that only 51% of examples in previous findings retain statistical significance against this null hypothesis, covering 89.6% of total self-preference probability mass. Finally, we compare the entropy of voting distributions, suggesting uncertainty-driven overlap, and show that our procedure enables more careful documentation against the backdrop of judge-bias research.

papers.title: Large-Language Models as a Cognitive Virus
papers.report_title: 论文把大模型依赖建模为可临界锁定的认知病毒
papers.summary: 本文介绍预印本论文《大语言模型作为认知病毒》，由庞培法布拉大学复杂系统实验室里卡德·索莱、塔夫茨大学生物学家迈克尔·莱文等发布。文章用流行病学语言描述大模型如何经社会与制度传播，并可能在临界点后把人群推向持续依赖。模型将使用者分为未耦合、仍保自主的耦合、持久依赖三态，用传播率、放弃率、由常规使用滑向依赖的速率以及从依赖回到自主使用的恢复率刻画人群流动，并加入“自主认知实践会因同伴与制度而互相强化”的非线性项。当集体强化足够强时，系统可出现双稳态与迟滞：传播压力升到跨临界分岔阈值，自主态失稳、依赖态迅速占优；若要从依赖态退回，往往要把传播压力压到更低的鞍结阈值，形成技术锁定。作者用“拿掉外部支持后仍剩下的认知能力”作示意指标，说明在替代型使用假设下，平均能力可随吸引子切换而陡降。文中对照脚手架与替代：前者减轻当下负担却保留或增强事后独立完成能力，后者直接代行综合、评估与写作。所谓“认知免疫”不是禁止接触大模型，而是压低替代型耦合的自动扩散、保留无辅助任务与退出路径，并抑制由常规使用滑向持久依赖。预印本标识为2609.03344，9月3日提交；黑客新闻讨论中有人指出病毒隐喻易引发道德恐慌，但模型核心仍是阈值与可逆性。

arxiv.title: Large-Language Models as a Cognitive Virus
arxiv.abstract: Large-language models (LLMs) are rapidly becoming part of human culture, reshaping how information is produced, transmitted, and used. Here we propose that their diffusion can be understood through a viral analogy, with LLM use spreading through populations, becoming embedded in cognitive and cultural practices. We model transitions among uncoupled, coupled, and persistently dependent users, and show that the interplay between social transmission, recovery, and collective reinforcement can generate tipping points and technological lock-in. A central consequence is the possibility of runaway dynamics: once a critical threshold is crossed, small increases in adoption can trigger rapid population-level shifts toward persistent dependence, with abrupt losses in cognitive competence. The same framework, however, identifies conditions for cognitive immunization, based on reducing transmission and facilitating reversibility. Our results highlight how LLM adoption may involve nonlinear collective transitions with important consequences for cognitive autonomy.

papers.title: The Last AI Built by Humans: Toward Genuine Recursive Self-Improvement
papers.report_title: 人类造的最后一代AI!上交清华字节75页综述拆解RSI路线图
papers.summary: 本文解读上交、清华、字节、上海 AI Lab 等团队 75 页综述《The Last AI Built by Humans: Toward Genuine Recursive Self-Improvement》。该综述回顾 491 项研究，提出以自主度为中心的递归自我改进（RSI）路线图，核心分析单元是“改进循环”：系统、继承状态、经验、目标、改进器、搜索策略、验证器和后继者。论文区分结构性递归与有效性递归，仅结构上递归不等于真正变强。自主度从 B0 到 L5，B0-L1 看持久化，L1-L2 看谁选改什么，L2-L3 看谁定学什么，L3-L4 看能否部署适配，L4-L5 看改进机制本身能否被改。DGM 被反复点名，可改写代码、测试验证并保留成功版本。领域实践：科学当前最强 L2，具身 ENPIRE 逼近受限 L5，软件工程 L2 最成熟、DGM 达受限 L5，医疗 L2 为主。工业数据：Theseus 环境重构后提升 18.65–39.67 个百分点；Lark 可用性 52%→65%；Humanlaya 关键缺陷包 9.0%→3.7%；ModelBest 约 1.5–2.5 天反超基线；腾讯混元 Hyra 经验银行；ARA 问答准确率 93.7% 对传统论文 72.4%。DGM 将编程 agent 从 20% 提到 50%，但迭代中也有 14/100 次不如初始策略。

arxiv.title: The Last AI Built by Humans: Toward Genuine Recursive Self-Improvement
arxiv.abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) enables AI systems to turn experience and feedback into persistent changes that improve both their capabilities and the process of future improvement. We first use the Headroom-Closed Index (HCI) to reveal the problems of existing LLMs, then introduce the RSI concept and its development roadmap: from improvement-execution autonomy, improvement-strategy autonomy, experience-acquisition autonomy, and environment-adaptation autonomy, to recursive meta-improvement. Next we examine RSI across scenarios (e.g., scientific discovery, embodied intelligence, software engineering), highlighting their distinct requirements and development speeds. Drawing on diverse industry practices and preliminary empirical evidence, we connect RSI research with practical systems and identify key challenges to achieving genuine RSI.

papers.summary: 本文解读悉尼科技大学与UT Austin在WWW '26提出的三Agent异构图RAG，面向学术问答中的跨作者-论文-会议异构图推理。方法把RAG流水线拆成检索、重排、验证三个专职Agent：检索Agent用GPT-4-turbo做查询分类，输出题型、起始节点类型、跳数预算和遍历方案；重排Agent以充分性分数Ssuf=α·Cov+(1−α)·Rel触发受控扩图，最多2次；验证Agent用实体对齐、关系对齐和属性匹配计算一致性分，低分重生成最多2次，否则输出不确定性。实验在OpenAlex（76,569节点/105,290边）和DBLP（62,443节点/79,697边）各400题上进行，每题型100题；准确率76.68%/73.43%，F1 65.35%/64.52%，H@1 85.13/83.25，均列第一，比最强Agent基线AdaptiveRAG高4.10/3.20。对比GraphRAG 61.87/60.27、GraphCoT 64.28/68.52、KGRAG 62.49/62.35、Agent-G 73.14/69.74；GPT-o3裸考仅53.58/51.65，不如Vanilla RAG 54.36/52.14。消融显示检索Agent贡献最大，重排次之，验证稳定改善F1和H@1。论文标题为Agent-Enhanced Heterogeneous Graph RAG for Academic Question Answering，链接 https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00761。

arxiv.title: Agent-Enhanced Heterogeneous Graph RAG for Academic Question Answering
arxiv.abstract: Academic question answering requires reasoning over heterogeneous scholarly graphs, where queries range from simple attribute lookups to multi-hop inference across author--paper--venue structures. Existing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems struggle in this setting due to three limitations: (1) fixed retrieval strategies that do not adapt to varying query complexity, (2) the absence of sufficiency evaluation leading to incomplete or misaligned evidence, and (3) a lack of structured verification against graph facts. To address these issues, we propose an agentic heterogeneous graph RAG method that transforms the three core stages of the RAG pipeline into explicit agentic decision steps. A query-aware retrieval agent analyzes query type and selects an appropriate graph traversal strategy; a sufficiency-aware reranking agent assesses evidence completeness and adaptively expands the retrieved subgraph; and a graph-grounded verification agent checks entity, relation, and attribute correctness before finalizing the answer. Experiments on heterogeneous graphs constructed from OpenAlex and DBLP suggest that our method consistently outperforms strong LLM, graph-augmented RAG, and agent-based baselines.

arxiv.title: Dream-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Evolving Worlds
arxiv.abstract: Recursive self-improvement is becoming increasingly vital for autonomous AI agents, where progress hinges on discovering high-value solutions across complex domains. The driver of this process is effective exploration, however, managing and improving exploration strategies remains a major bottleneck. Current systems face a fundamental dilemma: fixed strategies fail to adapt as search spaces scale, while online policy optimization requires navigating vast meta-search spaces under delayed and expensive feedback over long-horizon rollouts. We introduce \textsc{Dream-RSI}, a framework for scalable and recursively self-improving exploration. A lightweight orchestration layer makes exploration explicit and programmable while leaving the underlying coding agent unchanged. Our key insight is that accumulated discovery history can serve as a replay simulator over the realized search space. By performing dreaming in the replay simulator constructed from historical discovery trees, \textsc{Dream-RSI} secures immediate, low-cost off-policy feedback to evaluate and refine exploration policies without invoking repetitive, expensive online evaluations. The improved policy is subsequently redeployed online to drive further discovery, continuously expanding the simulator pool in a self-improving loop. papers.title: Scaling Automatic Research Agents via World Models
papers.report_title: UIUC&亚马逊开源WMRL:世界模型替研究Agent跑实验,4B打赢48B
papers.summary: UIUC和亚马逊发布WMRL，用一个语言模型充当“世界模型”来预测实验结果，替掉研究型Agent强化学习训练里最贵的真实执行。论文标题为《Scaling Automatic Research Agents via World Models》，链接为https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.12564。方法保留约10%的组用真实执行打分作为锚定组，通过在线去偏和逆方差去噪两个修正，让训练计算降到真执行GRPO的约三成，成绩反而更高。实验显示：4B模型训练GPU小时从883降到286，9B从1174降到349，速度提升3.1到3.4倍；4B在两个基准的均分从15.2/25.7升到16.4/28.8，9B从18.8/31.2升到21.6/32.8，全部反超真执行GRPO。4B成绩超过48B开源Agent Kimi-48B-A3B，9B超过120B的Nemotron-120B-A12B。消融实验：只开去噪加0.9到1.7分，只开去偏加2.2到2.8分，两个都开加2.9到4.8分。在LIBERO-Long机械臂长程操作基准上，只用结尾成功信号提升0.9个百分点，只用预测信号提升1.8个百分点，WMRL将整体成功率从38.3%升到41.2%，训练时未见过初始状态下8次尝试全部成功的比例多出5.9个百分点。论文指出方法前提是结果可预测，否则会自动退回标准GRPO。

arxiv.title: Scaling Automatic Research Agents via World Models
arxiv.abstract: Automating empirical research is a long-standing direction of AI. Recent automatic research (AutoResearch) agents bring this goal within reach, as modern LLMs show the capability to independently implement solutions and learn from the execution outcomes. Behind these gains, post-training (especially RL) plays a central role. In this paper, we identify a fundamental tension when scaling RL for these agents: the two components of every AutoResearch trajectory (agent generation and environment execution) scale in very different manners, since all generation shares compute through batching, while each execution occupies its exclusive sandbox and real machine time. As a result, the environment execution dominates the training cost and becomes the bottleneck as trajectories grow. To resolve this tension, we propose World Model RL (WMRL), which replaces environment execution with a world model to remove this bottleneck. Additionally, the world model can be imperfect, as its rewards are corrupted by bias and noise. Therefore, we further equip WMRL with two mitigations, Online Debiasing and Inverse-Variance Denoising, which offset the bias and suppress the noise respectively. Theoretically, we prove that both mitigations of WMRL strictly improve the convergence guarantee. papers.report_title: Anthropic 论文,揭示大模型人格是一根向量,而训练一份＂错解数学题＂的数据,就能让模型往＂邪恶＂偏移
papers.summary: 文章解读Anthropic合作论文《Persona Vectors: Monitoring and Controlling Character Traits in Language Models》（arXiv:2507.21509）。核心发现：人格特质可表示为激活空间中的线性方向向量，用“善良/邪恶”扮演回答的激活均值相减即可提取evil persona vector；在Qwen2.5-7B和Llama-3.1-8B上，微调后性格变化与沿人格向量漂移的相关性达0.76至0.97，最高0.97。干预公式为hℓ←hℓ+α·vℓ，层号关键，Qwen在20层干预邪恶/谄媚、16层干预幻觉，Llama选16层；中间偏后层最有效。将prompt最后token激活投影到人格向量，可在生成前预测后续性格分数，相关性0.75至0.83。微调数据即使只是错解数学题等“无害领域错误”，也会使模型在邪恶特质上偏移；投影差可筛查数据，在LMSYS-CHAT-1M一百万条对话中，高/随机/低各500条微调后性格表达排序一致。训练时预防性steering基本不掉MMLU，事后干预会掉分。文章还从产品角度提出人格监控、品牌人格向量、用户反馈微调白盒筛查等应用。

arxiv.title: Persona Vectors: Monitoring and Controlling Character Traits in Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Large language models interact with users through a simulated 'Assistant' persona. While the Assistant is typically trained to be helpful, harmless, and honest, it sometimes deviates from these ideals. In this paper, we identify directions in the model's activation space-persona vectors-underlying several traits, such as evil, sycophancy, and propensity to hallucinate. We confirm that these vectors can be used to monitor fluctuations in the Assistant's personality at deployment time. We then apply persona vectors to predict and control personality shifts that occur during training. We find that both intended and unintended personality changes after finetuning are strongly correlated with shifts along the relevant persona vectors. These shifts can be mitigated through post-hoc intervention, or avoided in the first place with a new preventative steering method. Moreover, persona vectors can be used to flag training data that will produce undesirable personality changes, both at the dataset level and the individual sample level. Our method for extracting persona vectors is automated and can be applied to any personality trait of interest, given only a natural-language description.

papers.title: Can LLM-based Financial Investing Strategies Outperform the Market in Long Run?
papers.report_title: 一起读论文:(1)基于大语言模型的金融投资策略能否在长期跑赢市场?
papers.summary: 本文解读 KDD'26 论文《Can LLM-based Financial Investing Strategies Outperform the Market in Long Run?》，作者 Weixian Waylon Li 等。文章指出现有 LLM 时机型投资策略评估多在短时间窗口和有限股票池上进行，存在生存者偏差、前视偏差和数据窥探偏差，导致策略有效性被高估。为此提出 FINSABER 回测框架，基于 20 年、100 余只标的，整合 2000—2024 年股价、新闻与财报等结构化/非结构化数据，显式纳入退市股票并采用滚动窗口。结果显示，先前报告的 LLM 优势在更广横截面和更长评估下显著衰减；市场风格分析发现 LLM 策略在牛市中过于保守、跑输被动基准，在熊市中又过于激进、招致重大亏损。Composite 设置中，随机选五、动量、波动率、FinCon 选股分别覆盖 91、84、63、80 只不同标的。波动率选股下，买入持有实现夏普 0.703、索提诺 1.291、年化收益 7.898%；FinAgent 在动量选股下年化收益 13.950%，但夏普仅 0.104、回撤较大。配对 t 检验显示 LLM 智能体未产生统计显著 alpha，p 值均超过 0.3。文章结论是未来 LLM 策略需优先强化趋势识别与市场风格自适应风控，而非简单堆叠框架复杂度。

arxiv.title: Can LLM-based Financial Investing Strategies Outperform the Market in Long Run?
arxiv.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently been leveraged for asset pricing tasks and stock trading applications, enabling AI agents to generate investment decisions from unstructured financial data. However, most evaluations of LLM timing-based investing strategies are conducted on narrow timeframes and limited stock universes, overstating effectiveness due to survivorship and data-snooping biases. We critically assess their generalizability and robustness by proposing FINSABER, a backtesting framework evaluating timing-based strategies across longer periods and a larger universe of symbols. Systematic backtests over two decades and 100+ symbols reveal that previously reported LLM advantages deteriorate significantly under broader cross-section and over a longer-term evaluation. Our market regime analysis further demonstrates that LLM strategies are overly conservative in bull markets, underperforming passive benchmarks, and overly aggressive in bear markets, incurring heavy losses. These findings highlight the need to develop LLM strategies that are able to prioritise trend detection and regime-aware risk controls over mere scaling of framework complexity.

papers.summary: 普林斯顿大学、MIT CSAIL与EPFL团队在arXiv发布CEGAR-T论文，针对硬件信息流跟踪（IFT）安全验证开销。论文开场数字：在136K cells的Mega-BOOM上，CellIFT使插桩设计规模达原设计5.81倍，仿真减速143.72倍。CEGAR-T先用轻量逻辑跑目标属性，出现反例后判断是否由过近似造成spurious counterexample，仅对后者触发refinement；Max-SAT选择尽可能少的refinement site，refinement lattice让每个block逐级增加精度；顺序逻辑提供Unroll和Single-Frame两种策略。在Ibex、Rocket和四个BOOM变体上，论文报告instrumentation overhead从5.64倍降至1.42倍，simulation overhead从34.65倍降至1.79倍，同时保持相对CellIFT baseline的精度收益。局限在于当前工作主要处理local imprecision，correlation-based imprecision仍是未来工作；数字来自特定开源核和SISP场景，不能直接翻译为仿真快20倍或验证成本下降95%。论文题目为Efficient Hardware Information-Flow Tracking for Pre-Silicon Security Testing，arXiv:2609.06791v1。

arxiv.title: Efficient Hardware Information-Flow Tracking for Pre-Silicon Security Testing
arxiv.abstract: Register-Transfer Level (RTL) simulation is widely used to test hardware before it is fabricated. To allow testing for security related information flow properties, such as confidentiality and integrity, taint logic can be automatically added to the design to track how information flows through it. However, taint logic instrumented by the state-of-the-art, such as CellIFT, makes simulation-based testing prohibitively expensive: On our evaluation of Mega-BOOM (136K cells), it increases the instrumented design to 5.81x the original cell count and causes a 143.72x simulation slowdown. The taint logic could be simplified to improve simulation speed, but it will inevitably trade off its precision. This lightweight, imprecise taint logic will introduce false positives and may eventually result in even more overhead to check these false positives. This paper explores the research question of where precision is actually needed in the design to overcome the overhead of false positives. It presents CEGAR-T, a framework that automatically synthesizes taint logic that minimizes the taint-logic instrumentation overhead while guaranteeing no false positives (relative to the precise CellIFT baseline). papers.summary: Tacite AI联合杭州电子科技大学、上海交通大学、清华大学等高校开源了Benchmark Radar，一个持续更新、专门收录AI基准的数据库和搜索引擎。系统每天从37个公开来源跟踪新基准，将LLM Stats、OpenCompass Hub、Artificial Analysis三个基准目录与各家模型报告汇成1283条记录、12,916条分数数据，每条均保留原始出处。论文标题为《Benchmark Radar: A Living Database and Search Engine for AI Benchmarks and Evaluation》，链接为https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.11115。关键发现是：790条带分数的记录中，仅82条同时满足百分比单位、方向已知、数值0-100的最基本可比条件，约十条里才有一条能直接回答“离满分还差多少”。每日发现接入13个直连数据源和24个机构官方信息源，以48小时窗口扫描，2026年9月7日运行产生366条观测、138条推荐，相关性权重占35%。目录中Agent附加标签的基准份额从2023年约5%涨到2025年约30%，校正渠道构成后最多只挪动1.1个百分点，上涨趋势仍然成立。2024年出现179条带日期新记录，2025年279条。Humanity's Last Exam在Artificial Analysis记录中有577个分数，最高55.47，三年从约1%爬升至55%。论文强调分数可比性、日期元信息缺失等局限，并提供网页、RSS、JSON、CLI、HTTP API等多入口。

arxiv.title: Benchmark Radar: A Living Database and Search Engine for AI Benchmarks and Evaluation
arxiv.abstract: Benchmark researchers and developers of large language models (LLMs) and other AI systems need to find relevant evaluations, locate their benchmark datasets and code, and understand the settings behind reported scores. We present Benchmark Radar, a living database and search engine for retrieval and discovery of AI benchmarks, covering LLM evaluation, agentic and tool-use benchmarks, coding, reasoning, safety, and domain-specific evaluations. The system combines daily discovery of benchmark papers, repositories, datasets, and releases with a searchable benchmark catalog, mentions in model cards and technical reports, and score histories. It retains source identities and citations so readers can inspect candidate benchmarks and their evaluation evidence. Daily discovery draws on 37 sources: 13 direct connectors and 24 first-party research and engineering feeds. The catalog contains 1,283 source records drawn from 4 benchmark catalogs and 12,916 numeric observations on 790 records. We describe collection and retrieval, audit the full catalog, and examine benchmark saturation, adoption trends, and the limits of score comparisons. A worked example walks through a complete prior-art search, showing how to query the catalog and inspect benchmark evidence when designing a new evaluation. papers.report_title: Puffin-World:给AI装上重力指南针,一张图重建可交互3D世界
papers.summary: Puffin-World 是南洋理工 S-Lab 与大晓机器人等联合开源的多模态世界模型，将物理（重力/纬度）、几何（深度）与外观（RGB）作为显式状态统一建模。输入单图或“参考图+相机轨迹”，模型可同时估计 roll/pitch/FoV 与逐像素深度，并沿轨迹生成物理一致的新视角 RGB+深度，融合为 3D 点云。技术核心是 Omni-Camera 9 通道稠密相机条件与 Physics Propagation，后者把参考帧重力方向传播至每帧，消融显示第 7 帧上向量误差从 4.4° 降至 1.3°。论文称在 Stanford2D3D/MegaDepth/TartanAir/LaMAR 四个相机理解基准 12/12 中位误差第一；RealEstate10K PSNR 17.22 最优；大旋转轨迹 FoV 误差 2.96°，约为 SEVA 12.59° 的 1/4；相机可控文生图 up-vector 误差 0.96°，对比 GPT Image2 的 24.13°。还提出闭环自校准世界探索雏形。局限：仅验证静态场景，需 GPU（Base 为 Qwen2.5-7B+SD3.5），NTU S-Lab License 1.0 学术非商用，暂无第三方独立复现，且部分评测集存在泄漏风险标注。

arxiv.title: Puffin-World: Scaling a Unified Multimodal Model with Native 3D World States
arxiv.abstract: We propose Puffin-World, a unified multimodal architecture that integrates physical understanding, spatial simulation, and 3D world generation and reconstruction without relying on external offline modules. To reliably construct and interact with 3D worlds, our framework jointly models three native world states: physics (gravity field and latitude), geometry (depth), and appearance (image), together with a unified Omni-Camera representation that supports diverse tasks and flexible motions. Beyond modeling these states, we introduce a strategy for propagating physical dynamics across future frames. By grounding absolute camera properties in the real world, Puffin-World enables physically consistent and visually stable world generation. We further couple appearance and geometry within a single generative process, jointly synthesizing each future view and reconstructing its underlying geometry. This unified paradigm enables interleaved closed-loop applications requiring synergy across multiple tasks, including mimic and self-calibrated world exploration. To scale Puffin-World to complex scenarios, we construct Puffin-16M, comprising 15 million vision-language-camera triplets and 1 million trajectories featuring various and challenging motions. To foster further research in this area, we released the code, models, and datasets.

papers.title: DynHD: Hallucination Detection for Diffusion Large Language Models via Denoising Dynamics Deviation Learning
papers.report_title: EMNLP 2026 | 从去噪动态入手,DynHD锁定扩散大语言模型幻觉
papers.summary: 文章解读 EMNLP 2026 论文 DynHD，面向 Diffusion Large Language Models 的幻觉检测。作者指出 D-LLM 从大量 mask 出发多步迭代去噪，若直接平均所有 token 的 entropy，正确与幻觉回答轨迹高度重合；过滤 padding、边界等结构性 token 并聚焦高不确定 token 后，正确回答的不确定性通常持续下降，幻觉回答后期更易停滞或反弹。DynHD 先做 Semantic-aware Evidence Construction 提取每个去噪步骤的 hallucination evidence，再用 Dynamical Deviation Learning 学习正常回答的参考去噪轨迹，并与实际轨迹比较，检测 stagnation 或 rebound。实验在 LLaDA-8B-Instruct 与 Dream-7B-Instruct，使用 TriviaQA、HotpotQA、CommonsenseQA。LLaDA 上平均 AUROC 84.2%，超过 TraceDet 的 72.0%；Dream 上 84.3%；跨数据集 zero-shot 平均 AUROC 72.9%，TraceDet 66.3%。DynHD 不需多次重复采样，可直接利用一次 D-LLM 生成产生的去噪轨迹，在性能与效率间取得平衡。论文题目、arXiv 与代码均给出。

arxiv.title: DynHD: Hallucination Detection for Diffusion Large Language Models via Denoising Dynamics Deviation Learning
arxiv.abstract: Diffusion large language models (D-LLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to auto-regressive models due to their iterative refinement capabilities. However, hallucinations remain a critical issue that hinders their reliability. To detect hallucination responses from model outputs, token-level uncertainty, such as entropy, has been widely used to indicate potential factual errors. Nevertheless, unlike auto-regressive models that generate tokens sequentially, D-LLMs generate fixed-length sequences simultaneously, where only a small subset of tokens is informative for hallucination detection. Thus, aggregating uncertainty over all tokens can be suboptimal. Moreover, the evolution trend of uncertainty throughout the diffusion process can also provide valuable signals, highlighting the necessity of modeling its denoising dynamics for hallucination detection. In this paper, we propose DynHD, which bridges these gaps from both spatial (token sequence) and temporal (denoising dynamics) perspectives. To handle the information density imbalance across tokens, we propose a semantic-aware evidence construction module that extracts hallucination-indicative signals by removing task-invariant structural tokens and emphasizing the uncertainty of the remaining informative tokens. papers.summary: 阿里和浙大提出Astar，用LLM从AI系统自身历史代码提交与实验结果中学习演化方向，解决算法迭代高度依赖人类专家经验的问题。Astar通过历史版本两两配对扩增样本、AST/可达性过滤与LLM意图过滤清洗提交、三级层次提示约束搜索空间，并用奖励模型实现秒级代理验证。训练链路为中间训练、SFT、RL。关键结果：0.6B版本单次生成有效优化方向成功率S@1达54.35%，超过GPT-5.5的30.71%和人类资深专家的32.29%；8B版本达67.86%。在阿里Lazada核心广告推荐系统中，Astar无人类干预连续主导20轮全自动迭代，离线Hitrate@200提升23.6%，线上A/B测试GMV提升4.86%、广告收入提升1.82%，点击率和订单量同步增长。案例中它针对Muon优化器提出频谱降噪，基于Marchenko-Pastur定律抑制噪声。论文地址为arXiv:2608.27287。
report_titles: 算法工程师要失业了?阿里和浙大联手提出Astar,用AI指导AI系统进化

arxiv.title: Astar: Learning to Propose Evolution Directions for Self-Evolving Industrial AI Systems
arxiv.abstract: Modern AI systems advance through continuous iteration: a loop of proposing evolution directions, implementing code, training, and evaluation. While the latter three stages are increasingly automated, the starting point --- proposing effective evolution directions --- remains a critical bottleneck that still relies heavily on senior experts. In this work, we explore whether AI can take over this role. We find that general-purpose LLMs, even the advanced GPT-5.5, offer only generic and misaligned suggestions: the required expertise is accumulated through experience rather than explicitly codified, and thus hard to inject directly. To this end, we propose Astar, a training-based approach that learns a specialized evolution-guiding model from the abundant iteration histories of industrial systems. Realizing this idea, however, raises four challenges: sparse supervision, noisy data, a vast direction space, and prohibitively expensive verification. We address them along two fronts. On the data side, we design a pipeline that turns noisy historical commits into a large, clean evolutionary corpus via pairwise sample expansion and noise filtering. On the model side, we train the model through mid-training, SFT, and RL, guiding evolution direction generation with hierarchical hints and using the reward model in RL as a fast surrogate evaluator. Astar has been deployed in Alibaba's Lazad

papers.title: MaxKernel: Agentic Kernel Generation for TPUs
papers.report_title: 谷歌开源MaxKernel:Agent自动写TPU内核,平均成绩超过专家手写
papers.summary: 谷歌开源 MaxKernel，用一组各司其职的子 Agent 自动编写高性能 TPU Pallas 内核，并通过编译器报错与真实硬件实测反馈反复迭代。子 Agent 包括规划、实现、编译修复、测试、自动调参和性能分析；知识库只收框架文档、内存布局指南和性能手册，明确排除人类手写高性能 kernel 代码。系统有三种模式：人在环 HITL、全自动 Auto 和图搜索 Parallel/Beam。评测在 JaxBench 50 个任务上进行，覆盖 17 个注意力算子和 33 个 KernelBench 融合算子，跑在 TPU v6e 上，查询模型为 Gemini 3.1 Pro，延迟用 XProf 实测。零样本 Best-of-N 每任务生成 100 份，只有 10/50 编译且数值正确，几何平均加速 1.08 倍。Auto 单轨迹中位数编译 49/50、正确 48/50、加速 1.39 倍，但 5 次运行在 1.19 到 1.42 倍波动。Parallel 把编译率和正确率推到 50/50，几何平均加速 1.58 倍，fast_1 为 34/50；Beam 为 50/50、1.49 倍、fast_1 31/50。8 个生产内核上，并行几何平均 2.32 倍，束搜索 1.78 倍，专家手写 2.02 倍；论文称 7 个优于专家，但逐行核对 Flash Attention 专家 2.47 倍仍略高于并行 2.37 倍，GEMM 打平，Ragged Paged Attention 专家 4.65 倍优势最大。真实模型算子中，MLA v1 延迟降 8.68%，吞吐 116.7 提到 127.8 TFLOPS；Qwen3-Next Gated DeltaNet 训练步从 84.51 毫秒压到 17.99 毫秒，约 4.7 倍；DeepSeek-V4 稀疏注意力 prefill 7.85 倍、decode 2.36 倍。边界是仅 TPU v6e/JAX/Pallas/Gemini 3.1 Pro，未报告搜索成本。
report_titles: 谷歌开源MaxKernel:Agent自动写TPU内核,平均成绩超过专家手写

arxiv.title: MaxKernel: Agentic Kernel Generation for TPUs
arxiv.abstract: Designing and authoring high-performance custom kernels for accelerators is a complex task that requires deep hardware-level expertise. Large Language Models (LLM) can be leveraged together with real-time compiler feedback to build agentic systems for kernel generation. In this work, we present MaxKernel, a multi-agent system that implements three distinct paradigms for TPU kernel development: (1) a Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) agent for collaborative, step-by-step design; (2) an Autonomous (Auto) agent that executes a fully automated, metric/trace-driven optimization loop; and (3) a Graph-Based Autonomous Search that scales the Auto agent for global exploration of the design space. All three paradigms leverage a shared pool of specialized sub-agents to handle planning, implementation, self-debugging, testing, and hardware profiling. We evaluate MaxKernel on JaxBench, a comprehensive suite of 50 diverse kernel tasks for TPUs, alongside complex, real-world workloads from state-of-the-art open-source models. We demonstrate that MaxKernel consistently generates highly optimized implementations, matching expert hand-tuned baselines and delivering significant performance across the benchmark. Our agent is open-sourced and available https://github.com/AI-Hypercomputer/accelerator-agents/tree/main/MaxKernel.

papers.title: SolarWM: Open Data and Scalable Training for Long-Horizon Video World Models
papers.report_title: GitHub 每日一荐 039|AI 视频下一步不是生成电影,而是生成一个可以一直存在的世界
papers.summary: 这篇 GitHub 每日一荐第039期深度解读开源世界模型 SolarWM，论文题目为 Open Data and Scalable Training for Long-Horizon Video World Models，论文 9 月 2 日上线，团队 2026 年 9 月 3 日开源训练与推理代码、数据管线、完整数据和多阶段模型权重。SolarWM 最受关注的能力是：训练阶段只用约 5 秒短序列，推理时却通过因果自回归 rollout 连续滚动到分钟甚至 60 分钟。它采用相机轨迹控制，模型需在已有场景基础上生成新暴露区域。训练分三阶段：Stage 0.5 双向 Flow Matching 适配画面、文字、相机条件；Stage 1 Teacher Forcing + AnyFlow 学习看历史往后生成；Stage 2 DMD + Self-Gradient Forcing 在自身 rollout 上训练并压到少步采样。正式论文因果结果在 16 FPS、4 sampling steps、无 attention sink 下生成，展示 10 秒、分钟级直至 60 分钟端点连续 session，未重启初始图、未注入参考帧、未拼接独立短视频。数据方面公开约 1.43 million canonical clips、超过 25 TB，并对齐视觉帧、metric camera geometry、caption、质量信息、筛选决策和 provenance。框架覆盖 Wan2.2、LTX-2.5、MiniMax-H3，对应 5B 到 33B 四条路线；完整三阶段权重首放 SolarWM-Wan-5B。文章也指出，小时级实验仍是固定场景提示词和给定相机轨迹下的定性 rollout，未证明长期对象记忆、持续身份或物理规律。GitHub 约 435 Star/19 Fork，Apache-2.0。

arxiv.title: SolarWM: Open Data and Scalable Training for Long-Horizon Video World Models
arxiv.abstract: We introduce SolarWM, a fully open foundation for building interactive video world models from data preparation through long-horizon inference. Training across heterogeneous data sources and video backbones is challenging: datasets differ in temporal scale, camera geometry, visual quality, motion, and captioning styles, while video generators use distinct representations and architectures. Naive data mixing and model-specific implementations therefore produce inconsistent supervision and make results difficult to reproduce and compare. SolarWM addresses this coupling with a reconfigurable multi-source data engine and a backbone-native adaptation framework. The engine converts 1.43 million canonical clips from 10 datasets into a unified, frame-aligned contract covering visual observations, metric camera geometry, captions, quality metadata, selection decisions, and provenance, while decoupling source processing from mixture construction. Under shared camera-conditioning, training, and inference interfaces, we instantiate four 5B--33B models based on Wan2.2, LTX-2.5, and MiniMax-H3 while preserving their native representations and objectives. A unified three-stage recipe combines bidirectional adaptation, teacher-forced autoregressive initialization, and distribution matching distillation. The resulting causal models enable real-time interaction over rollouts ranging from minutes

papers.title: FABO: Agent-Guided Discovery of Joint Breakpoint Optimization for Timing-Driven Routing Trees
papers.report_title: FABO:路由树的分叉,AI 开始改算法
papers.summary: 8 月 31 日发布在 arXiv 的论文 FABO，针对时序驱动布线树中的过早分叉问题：SALT 逐个 sink 修复路径时，可能让本应共享的 root-side wire 在靠近 root 处就分支，后续 sink 只能重复铺线。FABO（Flow-Aware Breakpoint Optimization）识别共享 root-side wire 的 sink 集合，联合调整分叉位置，同时尊重每个 sink 的 stretch budget；FABO-FAST 先用轻量判别器筛掉收益小的网络。作者在 129 万条 ICCAD15 nets 上测试，报告整体峰值线长改善 0.83%，30 pin 以上网络改善 2.66%；FABO-FAST 运行时间约为 SALT 的 1.3 倍。论文还称在 SALT 的 20 个 stretch-tolerance 设置下都降低 FLUTE-normalized wirelength。其智能体框架由并行探索提出结构假设，独立检查验证推导、伪代码和实验一致性，再把结构性发现落实为算法。边界是尚未覆盖跨工艺节点、真实商业布线器或量产 sign-off，0.83% 与 2.66% 均为作者 benchmark 线长指标，不能直接等同拥塞、寄生、时序或 PPA 改善。
report_titles: FABO:路由树的分叉,AI 开始改算法

arxiv.title: FABO: Agent-Guided Discovery of Joint Breakpoint Optimization for Timing-Driven Routing Trees
arxiv.abstract: The topology of a routing tree determines how a multi-pin net branches and shares physical wire, directly affecting wirelength, congestion, capacitance, and delay. We study a central early-stage routing problem: minimizing wirelength while bounding the root-to-sink path stretch for every sink. SALT is the state-of-the-art constructive algorithm for this problem. We ask whether language-model-guided search can discover a constructive algorithm that improves on SALT. To make this search reliable, we develop an agent framework that combines parallel exploration with independent checking. Applied to SALT, the framework discovers a structural limitation: SALT repairs one sink path at a time and therefore never jointly decides where paths sharing root-side wire should split. This sink-local choice can split the paths too early and duplicate wire. This discovery leads to Flow-Aware Breakpoint Optimization (FABO), which jointly optimizes breakpoints across root-to-sink paths that share wire while preserving every sink's stretch budget. Across 1.29 million ICCAD15 nets and SALT's 20-point stretch-tolerance schedule, FABO reduces average FLUTE-normalized wirelength at every setting, with peak same reductions of 0.83% overall and 2.66% for nets with at least 30 pins. With 1.3x SALT's runtime, FABO-FAST identifies and optimizes most nets for which FABO provides a substantial wirelength red

papers.report_title: 腾讯混元开源语音基础模型 AuK:一个模型管五种活,4步生成提速4.5倍
papers.summary: 腾讯混元发布并开源语音基础模型 AuK，1.5B 参数，把语音生成、内容修改、音色与情绪调整、降噪与人声分离五类任务统一到同一套「指令+音频」接口。训练语料约 30.3 亿条成对样本、195 万小时音频。语义条件用 Qwen2.5-Omni 的 32 层隐状态逐层加权；声学条件来自联合训练 AuK-VAE，在约 300 万小时语音、通用音频、音乐上按 6:3:1 训练，24kHz 波形编码为每秒 50 帧、每帧 64 维潜向量；生成骨干为 1.5B 混合 Transformer，前 10 层双流 MMDiT、后 20 层单流 DiT，学习整流流。预训练两阶段：生成任务热身 5 万步，五任务混合 60 万步；256 张 GPU，每步约 6144 条语音、合 14 小时音频。AuK-VAE 重建在语音域 PESQ 4.143 对最强基线 MiniMax-H3-AudioVAE 3.633，音乐域 3.884 对 3.051。蒸馏版 AuK-Flash 只需 4 步、去掉 CFG，生成耗时缩短到约 1/4.5。结果：Seed-TTS-Eval 平均词错误率 2.65% 对 Qwen3-TTS 3.07%，说话人相似度 0.795 对 Seed-TTS 0.778；InstructTTSEval 中文 DSD 准确率 83.37%，比 Qwen3-TTS-VD 高 2.27 个百分点；MMAE-Speech 指令遵循率 48.23%、无关属性保持率 88.11%，比 Step-Audio-EditX 分别高 4.71 和 10.84 个百分点；SpeechEditBench 内容编辑成功率从 Ming-UniAudio 的 76.46% 提到 91.83%，韵律编辑从 26.50% 提到 71.33%。增强与分离上，DNS 去噪后词错误率 2.66% 为全场最低，Libri2Mix 词错误率 9.12% 最低。论文也指出自由格式用户指令仍不可靠，部署依赖 Prompt Enhancer。

arxiv.title: AuK Technical Report: An Open-Source Foundational Model for Speech Generation and Editing
arxiv.abstract: We introduce AuK, an open-source foundational model that unifies speech generation and editing through a common interface of natural-language instructions and audio context. To support this broad capability set, we construct approximately 3.03 billion instruction--audio instances and 1.95 million hours of effective supervision across five task families: speech generation, content editing, enhancement and separation, paralinguistic editing, and acoustic editing. AuK combines a multimodal large language model for semantic conditioning, an VAE jointly trained on speech, general audio, and music for acoustic conditioning, and a hybrid rectified-flow Transformer that performs dual-stream MMDiT blocks followed by unified single-stream DiT blocks for generation. Training begins with generation-only warm-up and proceeds to joint generation--editing pre-training. We then apply complementary post-training strategies: human-feedback preference optimization for open-ended editing and reward-based reinforcement learning for speech generation. To reduce inference cost, we further distill the model with consistency initialization and task-routed Decoupled DMD. The resulting AuK-Flash performs 4-step inference without classifier-free guidance and achieves a 4.5 wall-clock speedup over the full model under matched conditions. Experiments demonstrate leading performance on zero-shot and instruct

papers.title: GraphMemix: Query-Aware Evidence Forests for Long-Term Multimodal Agent Memory
papers.report_title: 多模态Agent的长期记忆系统,被北大&MemoraX AI开源了!
papers.summary: 北京大学王选计算机研究所联合MemoraX AI提出GraphMemix，论文题目为GraphMemix: Query-Aware Evidence Forests for Long-Term Multimodal Agent Memory。文章指出，长期多模态Agent记忆检索不应只按单条相似度Top-K召回，而应在有限上下文预算下寻找互补证据组合。GraphMemix把记忆选择建模为查询感知组合图优化：单条记忆是节点，记忆间增量支持是边，选出的互补证据链构成森林。流程包括多视图召回原图、Caption、OCR、视频帧和文本字段，选Top-L种子，再用Schema关系与Mutual-kNN有限跳扩展；节点验证器用Listwise判断单条记忆独立支撑答案程度，证据链验证器将关系分为new_fact、clarification、corroboration、redundant、conflict、irrelevant六种角色，只有正向增量边进入可信图；固定节点时用Kruskal求最大权重无环森林，节点选择用1-Swap和变基数精确提炼。四项基准ATM-Bench、Mem-Gallery、MemEye、H2HMem上，Qwen3-VL-8B Reader平均Judge Accuracy 61.55%，比最强公开基线UniversalRAG 49.80%高11.75个百分点；分项为55.27%（+6.80）、76.33%（+12.57）、53.64%（+5.66）、60.96%（+16.60）。换Gemma 4 12B Unified后平均67.42%，提升12.33个百分点。ATM-Bench完整生命周期处理11,034条记忆、回答1,044个问题，总耗时比A-MEM缩短约1.78倍，比VimRAG缩短约4.27倍，比LightMem缩短约4.74倍。案例中5次1-Swap使目标函数从1.340升到2.133。

arxiv.title: GraphMemix: Query-Aware Evidence Forests for Long-Term Multimodal Agent Memory
arxiv.abstract: Organizing long-term memory for multimodal agents remains challenging because existing methods either suffer from expensive question-agnostic offline summaries or naive embedding similarity matching that introduces incomplete and redundant context. To address these issues, we propose GraphMemix, a combinatorial-optimization graph memory framework that models memory organization as query-aware evidence-forest construction. Specifically, our method consists of three key components:(1) candidate graph construction, which expands multi-view seed memories through schema and semantic relations to acquire query-aware original context; (2) evidence utility and activation costs, which decouples direct memory support from anchor-conditioned relation verification to suppress redundant or conflicting information; and (3) forest optimization, which jointly selects a forest-format memory context under a maximum evidence budget and its reliable relational structure. By organizing memory into a query-relevant subgraph, the method avoids substantial lifecycle cost and recovers low-similarity complementary evidence. Experimental results across four long-term multimodal memory benchmarks demonstrate significant improvements with different foundation models and establish a new Pareto frontier between accuracy and lifecycle cost.

papers.title: NeoHorse-1: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement via Agentic Post-Training with Routing Harness
papers.report_title: 基元律动开源NeoHorse-1:模型路由做训练数据,探索递归自我改进,4B追平9B基座
papers.summary: 基元律动联合无问芯穹、清华、北大、阿里等开源NeoHorse-1系列Agent模型，核心是把路由系统每天记录的派单信息，包括任务难度预测、实际派发层级和最终执行结果，转化为后训练数据，形成路由harness驱动的递归自我改进尝试。系统保留完整执行轨迹，经结构校验、六维语义评估和场景标注后，按路由分数做三阶段课程；SFT只监督当前用户轮助手目标片段，OPD让学生自己生成，固定老师按top-K加其他桶做反向KL逐步纠偏。评测覆盖十个基准，4B版平均分从Qwen3.5-4B的58.94提升到64.87，VitaBench 32.0对21.5、WorkBuddy 34.4对24.6，已接近9B基座Qwen3.5-9B的65.60；9B训练版平均69.04，超过30B对照Muse-Glimmer的67.86，但IFEval微降0.37、IFBench打平。控制变量显示，同样的课程与预算下，harness轨迹在五个基准平均70.57，高于公开合成数据Toucan的64.32；受监督token从不到200万扩到1000万，平均分从69.31升至71.45未饱和。案例中9B版在依赖库不可用时改用标准库，请求、时间、token用量比4B版少70.8%、76.7%、83.6%。适合关注Agent后训练、模型路由与自我改进数据飞轮的研究者。

arxiv.title: NeoHorse-1: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement via Agentic Post-Training with Routing Harness
arxiv.abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) requires a concrete mechanism through which an AI system observes its capabilities and converts that evidence into the next round of learning. We present NeoHorse-1, a family of agent-native models developed to explore this path through agentic post-training. Our system combines a heterogeneous model pool with intelligent routing, recording the predicted capability demand, selected service tier, and subsequent interaction for each user turn. These records are converted into training examples that preserve interleaved reasoning, tool calls, and harness context, and are admitted through structural validation, six-dimensional semantic evaluation, and subscene-level labeling. Routing signals organize supervised fine-tuning into a three-stage curriculum and extend to routing-guided on-policy distillation, where a teacher supervises student-generated responses under the same progression. Capability-guided allocation then converts evaluation feedback into the next training mixture, closing an evaluation-selection-update loop in which what the system learns to do shapes what it learns from next. papers.title: Terminal-Universe: Turning Agent Trajectories into Scalable Terminal Environments
papers.report_title: 阿里Qwen发布Terminal-Universe:把Agent轨迹重建成环境
papers.summary: 阿里 Qwen 团队发布 Terminal-Universe，把终端 Coding Agent 轨迹反向重建成可反复使用的代码环境，再用这些环境批量合成带验证的新任务和多轮交互数据。核心观点是轨迹与环境是同一段过程的两种视图。流程分三阶段：确定性回放重放 read、write、edit 操作，恢复文件最早版本并剔除 Agent 新建文件；智能补全 Agent 以 Make the task solvable, but NOT solved 为契约补齐项目文件、依赖和截断内容，但不夹带答案；充分性过滤由裁判 Agent 只读检查环境是否可解。终端池充分率从 40.2% 升到 93.5%，软件工程仓库池从 20.1% 升到 77.1%；工作区平均文件数从 2.9 涨到 22.4，文本行数从 90 涨到 5761。环境统一跑在 ubuntu:24.04 容器。四种重新提问方式包括意图恢复、单工作区合成、跨工作区合成和多轮用户会话。跨工作区任务中位轮数 23 对 14，工具调用 38 对 20，轨迹长度 46.5k 对 30.4k token；teacher Qwen3.7-Max 单工作区通过率 72.3%，跨工作区降到 49.2%。多轮会话中功能扩展占 62.7%、功能修订 29.3%、功能冲突 8.0%，平均 4.51 轮，69.6% 包含先失败后修复。数据漏斗从 359593 条源轨迹得到 68263 个重建环境，去重后 40194 个，最终 37273 个充分环境；SFT 语料约 3.2 万条、14.2 亿 token。用 Qwen3.5-27B 两轮监督微调，学习率 7×10⁻⁶，全局批 256，序列长 256k。Terminal-Bench 2.1 通过率从 46.2% 提到 58.1%，提升 11.9 个百分点；2.0 从 41.6% 提到 52.8%；EvoCode-Bench v2 的 MT@4 从 6.3 分升到 20.1 分，案例得分从 67.8 升到 76.1。消融显示直接模仿原始轨迹会让 2.1 从 47.0 掉到 36.7，而重建环境重做后到 52.1。

arxiv.title: Terminal-Universe: Turning Agent Trajectories into Scalable Terminal Environments
arxiv.abstract: As terminal-based code agents become prevalent, agent trajectories have accumulated at scale, while realistic, executable environments remain scarce. However, environments are what agent post-training actually requires: each can be re-queried into many verifiable tasks and provides execution feedback, whereas a trajectory is a single frozen demonstration. Rather than generating environments from scratch, we observe that the tool-execution history in existing trajectories exposes the structure and contents of the environments in which they ran, making it possible to reconstruct those environments from the trajectories themselves. Thus, we introduce Terminal-Universe, a framework which turns each trajectory into a reusable environment and explores it for synthesizing new tasks and continued interactions. Specifically, Terminal-Universe replays the file operations recorded in a trajectory to restore each file before the agent modified it, yielding a partial workspace; a completion agent then supplies the missing files and dependencies. On this recovered workspace, we both reconstruct the original intent task and synthesize entirely new ones. Besides, we also scale the tasks along two complementary axes: breadth and depth. papers.title: VLN-AVP: Zero-Shot Vision-Language Navigation with Hybrid Long-Short-Term Memory for Autonomous Valet Parking
papers.report_title: [论文解读]VLN-AVP把大模型带进地下车库
papers.summary: 论文提出 VLN-AVP，面向地下车库自动泊车的零样本视觉语言导航，核心是把视觉语言模型负责语义方向决策与车辆轨迹规划解耦，并用短期记忆和长期拓扑记忆降低大模型调用。短期记忆容量为 6 帧，用 Grounding DINO 高频检测标志，再经目标、方向、时间三重筛选；在 20 个关键路口，无短期记忆时关键语义线索识别率 57.7%、正确决策率 60%，加入后分别提高到 84.6% 和 85%。长期记忆记录路口/地标节点与带方向向量的边，支持成功、无效和路线失效更新。仿真普通任务成功率 65.2%、SPL 43.1%、导航误差 13.2 米，优于 LaMPilot 的 49.7%、34.8%、19.5 米；挑战任务成功率 45.4%、SPL 33.2%、误差 18.4 米，对比 33.6%、24.7%、27.8 米。消融显示去掉长期记忆后普通任务降至 56.8%，再去掉短期记忆降至 42.2%；挑战任务从 45.4% 降至 38.7%，再降至 31.1%。真实两个车库 30 次测试中，完整系统成功率 63.3%，无长期记忆 53.3%，LaMPilot 36.7%。10 次导航中，长期记忆使大模型调用从 1403 次降至 317 次，平均耗时从 262.7 秒降至 161.7 秒，API 费用从约 1.06 美元降至 0.24 美元。数据集覆盖 10 个车库、1000 多个任务，用激光雷达、鱼眼相机和 3D Gaussian Splatting 重建。

arxiv.title: VLN-AVP: Zero-Shot Vision-Language Navigation with Hybrid Long-Short-Term Memory for Autonomous Valet Parking
arxiv.abstract: Existing methods in Autonomous Valet Parking (AVP) typically rely on pre-built maps, which severely restricts their scalability to unseen environments and open-vocabulary targets. Inspired by the application of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) tasks, we propose VLN-AVP, a zero-shot navigation framework for AVP tasks. By combining the precise spatial perception of a Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) model with the general intelligence of VLMs, our framework 1) eliminates the dependency on pre-built maps, 2) interprets semantic environmental contexts in parking scenarios, and 3) enables intuitive navigation following natural language instructions. Specifically, we introduce a hybrid memory system: a short-term perception memory tracks semantic visual cues to address the limitations of VLM's single-frame reasoning in existing methods, while a long-term topological memory facilitates stable policy learning from past experiences. To bridge the gap in existing benchmarks, we also present the VLN-AVP dataset and benchmark. Featuring 10 high-fidelity parking scenes and over 1,000 navigation episodes, it has the largest number of garage scenes to date and is the first VLN benchmark for underground parking. papers.title: Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models
papers.report_title: 如果只读一篇大模型论文,我推荐这篇:Scaling Laws
papers.summary: 本文推荐并解读了2020年经典论文《Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models》（作者Jared Kaplan、Sam McCandlish、Tom Henighan等）。文章指出，该论文通过大量实验发现语言模型性能与模型规模、数据规模、计算量之间存在稳定的幂律关系，使大模型训练从“赌注”变为可预测、可规划的工程行为。这一发现解释了此后AI公司疯狂采购GPU、扩大模型参数（如GPT-3的1750亿参数）和数据规模的底层逻辑。文章还回顾了2022年DeepMind的Chinchilla修正：约700亿参数模型配合大规模训练数据，在相近计算量下击败参数量远大于它的Gopher，说明模型与数据存在更优比例，并非参数越多越好。同时讨论了数据质量、Test-time Compute/Inference Scaling等新趋势，强调Scaling并未过时，而是从训练阶段扩展到推理阶段。文章建议读者重点关注模型规模增加后Loss为何持续下降、模型-数据-计算量的关系，以及该规律如何改变AI研发方式。

arxiv.title: Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models
arxiv.abstract: We study empirical scaling laws for language model performance on the cross-entropy loss. The loss scales as a power-law with model size, dataset size, and the amount of compute used for training, with some trends spanning more than seven orders of magnitude. Other architectural details such as network width or depth have minimal effects within a wide range. Simple equations govern the dependence of overfitting on model/dataset size and the dependence of training speed on model size. These relationships allow us to determine the optimal allocation of a fixed compute budget. Larger models are significantly more sample-efficient, such that optimally compute-efficient training involves training very large models on a relatively modest amount of data and stopping significantly before convergence.

papers.title: SafeEvolve: Harness-Policy Co-Evolution from Agent Experience for Safety Alignment
papers.report_title: Agent 安全也能自进化?SafeEvolve 让 Harness 与 Policy 从安全经验中共同进化
papers.summary: 上海AI Lab、上海交通大学、复旦大学、香港科技大学和浙江大学等团队提出SafeEvolve，将Agent安全从静态规则或一次性训练转向Harness与Policy协同进化。文章指出，现有路线一类更新外部Harness，如安全Prompt、规则库、Skills和运行时防护，另一类更新模型Policy，如SFT、偏好优化或强化学习；但前者可能受冻结Policy理解能力限制，后者在固定Harness中训练难以吸收部署新风险。SafeEvolve收集Agent与环境交互的完整执行轨迹，记录任务目标、环境观察、工具调用、风险类型、任务完成情况和安全验证结果，对安全失败定位原因并转化为Safety Prompt或分层SkillBank局部更新；更新前进行同任务、同环境、同Policy的配对评测，只有满足安全性、任务效用和执行质量的候选才被接受并保存版本、证据和回滚条件。Policy侧采用两阶段SFT-RL：Harness-use SFT学习识别安全经验并执行安全Skills；Harness-augmented RL用Verifier评估任务完成、危险行为和工具调用有效性，构造安全—效用奖励，形成持续闭环。实验显示，在Qwen3.5-4B上，AgentDojo攻击成功率从2.37%降至0.79%，干净任务效用从59.79%提升至61.86%；AgentHarm危害得分从56.45降至12.27，安全拒绝率从28.98%提升至83.83%；在Qwen3-4B上，AgentDojo攻击成功率从13.38%降至2.42%，任务效用从44.33%提升至60.82%，攻击条件下任务效用从35.91%提升至52.05%。

arxiv.title: SafeEvolve: Harness-Policy Co-Evolution from Agent Experience for Safety Alignment
arxiv.abstract: The performance of LLM-based agents is jointly shaped by the base model and the harness used when interacting with the environment. This exposes them to safety risks in both harmful final responses and multi-step execution trajectories. Existing safety alignment mechanisms often rely on either external harness updates or policy optimization, yet applying either paradigm in isolation fails to bridge runtime control with intrinsic safety. We propose SafeEvolve, an experience-driven self-evolving framework for agent safety alignment. SafeEvolve leverages safety experience from completed on-policy trajectories to drive a continual loop of harness-policy co-evolution. On the harness side, SafeEvolve converts trajectory-level safety evidence into bounded, component-level updates across safety prompt and hierarchical skills, yielding auditable and reversible harness artifacts. On the policy side, SafeEvolve follows a two-stage SFT-RL paradigm, where harness-use SFT bootstraps the policy to actively leverage evolved harness artifacts, and harness-augmented RL further shapes autonomous safety behaviors during multi-step exploration via verifier-decomposed rewards. Through harness-policy co-evolution, SafeEvolve converts safety experience into an evolved runtime harness and improved policy behavior. papers.title: Attention Is All You Need
papers.report_title: 一篇八年前的论文,成了今天所有大模型的底座
papers.summary: 本文深度回顾了2017年NeurIPS论文《Attention Is All You Need》的核心思想与技术突破。该论文首次提出完全基于自注意力机制的Transformer架构，摒弃了当时主流的RNN和CNN。具体数据方面，Transformer在英德翻译上达到28.4 BLEU，超过当时最佳集成模型的26.4 BLEU；英法翻译41.8 BLEU，刷新单模型记录。训练仅用8块P100 GPU、耗时三天半。文章详细拆解了RNN的三大硬伤：无法并行（最大路径长度O(n)）、信息衰减、瓶颈压缩，而Transformer的自注意力将最大路径长度降至O(1)。论文提出QKV三投影机制、缩放点积注意力（除以√d_k避免梯度消失）、多头注意力（8个头，每个d_k=64）、位置编码（正弦/余弦固定函数）、残差连接与层归一化、前馈网络（d_ff=2048）等关键设计。Base模型参数量65M，Big模型213M。在WSJ句法解析任务上Transformer以四层结构达到F1 92.7，接近专用解析器。文章强调Transformer的核心范式转变：让相关性取代时间顺序成为信息流动规则，实现动态计算图。该论文奠定了当前所有大模型（ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini等）的底层架构基础。
report_titles: 一篇八年前的论文,成了今天所有大模型的底座

arxiv.title: Attention Is All You Need
arxiv.abstract: The dominant sequence transduction models are based on complex recurrent or convolutional neural networks in an encoder-decoder configuration. The best performing models also connect the encoder and decoder through an attention mechanism. We propose a new simple network architecture, the Transformer, based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely. Experiments on two machine translation tasks show these models to be superior in quality while being more parallelizable and requiring significantly less time to train. Our model achieves 28.4 BLEU on the WMT 2014 English-to-German translation task, improving over the existing best results, including ensembles by over 2 BLEU. On the WMT 2014 English-to-French translation task, our model establishes a new single-model state-of-the-art BLEU score of 41.8 after training for 3.5 days on eight GPUs, a small fraction of the training costs of the best models from the literature. We show that the Transformer generalizes well to other tasks by applying it successfully to English constituency parsing both with large and limited training data.

papers.title: WikiSkill: Compiling Agent Experience into Persistent Knowledge for Skill Evolution
papers.report_title: 超越SkillOpt!谷歌发布 WikiSkill:技能进化配上持久知识库,9B 反超 27B模型
papers.summary: 本文对Google Research提出的WikiSkill进行深度技术解读。WikiSkill针对Agent技能进化中“经验无人管理”的问题，在原始轨迹与可执行技能之间增加一层独立维护、只增不减的Wiki知识层，包含模式目录（patterns/）、进化日志（logs.md）和技能影响追踪表（skill-impact.md），并实现“技能可回滚、Wiki永不回滚”这一关键不对称设计。文章详细拆解四角色工作流：推理智能体、Wiki维护者、技能提案者和门控机制。为保持轨迹作为技能质量的纯净信号，推理智能体在训练期间被禁止访问Wiki。实验覆盖LiveMath、SealQA、SpreadsheetBench、OfficeQA、ALFWorld五个基准，以及Gemini-3.5-Flash、Qwen-3.5-4B/9B、Qwen-3.6-27B、Gemma-4-31B五个模型，对比Trace2Skill、EvoSkill、SkillOpt三个基线。结果显示：WikiSkill在所有模型上平均分均最高，比各模型最强竞争者高3.3–12.0个百分点；Gemini-3.5-Flash在LiveMath从33.0%提升到72.6%。Qwen系列模型越大，WikiSkill带来提升越大（4B/9B/27B分别为+12.3/+17.5/+23.9），带技能的9B（47.4%）也超过不带技能的27B（39.4%）。迁移实验显示4B技能可将Gemma-4-31B在LiveMath提至73.1%，但也会因碎片化偏方拖累强模型，如Gemini-3.5-Flash在SpreadSheet从50.5%降至18.1%。消融表明持久wiki是主要收益来源，开放给提案者带来+15.0个百分点，但若同时开放给推理智能体反而降到60.9%。本文还讨论了门控过拟合小验证集、wiki缺少质检等局限。论文及链接已在正文给出。

arxiv.title: WikiSkill: Compiling Agent Experience into Persistent Knowledge for Skill Evolution
arxiv.abstract: Agent skills package specialized knowledge and workflows into reusable resources that extend AI agent capabilities. Recent work automatically discovers such skills from agent experience, which enables agents to progressively adapt through interaction. However, the insights that guide skill development typically remain scattered across optimization histories, limiting their systematic reuse across iterations. We introduce WikiSkill, a framework that co-evolves agent skills with a persistent knowledge base (wiki). At a high level, WikiSkill separates raw execution experience, accumulated knowledge, and executable skills, while continuously consolidating experience into the wiki, which subsequent skill updates can build on. Across diverse benchmarks and models, WikiSkill consistently outperforms state-of-the-art skill-evolution methods and improves over no-skill baselines in most model-benchmark settings. We find that skill evolution complements model scaling: larger models generally benefit more from evolved skills, while smaller models with skills can outperform substantially larger models without them. We also find that evolved skills transfer effectively across models and model families, and skills evolved by other models can outperform self-evolved skills. Finally, our ablation studies confirm that persistent knowledge accumulation in the wiki is critical for effective skill

papers.title: Code World Model: Coding Agent as World Brain
papers.report_title: 让代码接管世界演化,西湖大学发布Code视频世界模型
papers.summary: 西湖大学AGI Lab联合南洋理工大学提出Code World Model（论文：Code World Model: Coding Agent as World Brain，arXiv:2608.25927），将开放世界视频生成拆分为“世界如何演化”和“世界如何被看见”两个问题。Coding Agent作为世界大脑，决定实体/规则/事件如何变化，并通过代码持续、确定性更新可执行世界状态；视频模型只负责将状态合成为高保真RGB观察。为解决状态到视觉的控制，论文提出Proxy——由世界状态确定性编译的粗粒度逐帧视觉条件（实体位置、尺度、姿态、轨迹、遮挡与相机运动），文本负责身份/动作语义和风格。训练数据来自157段GTA V游戏过程，共约5.6小时，以2秒间隔采样出9420个5秒片段；RGB目标为124帧1344×768@24FPS，对齐Proxy为336×192并附加对数深度与语义ID。模型在MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA上采用rank-128 LoRA，覆盖50个Transformer block，5.96亿可训练参数，8张H800训练3个epoch。推理时使用GPT-5.6 Sol作为Coding Agent，GPT Image 2生成外观锚点。定性结果显示Proxy可精确控制角色位置、动作轨迹、布局与相机；长时生成采用124帧窗口、重叠34帧。文章认为该范式可能用于具身智能、自动驾驶和长期规划等环境的训练与评估。

arxiv.title: Code World Model: Coding Agent as World Brain
arxiv.abstract: World models aim to simulate how complex environments evolve under actions and events, yet existing video-based world models primarily learn dynamics from visual observations, which reveal outcomes rather than the underlying knowledge, rules, and mechanisms governing world evolution. This makes it difficult to maintain persistent consequences and support coherent, open-ended evolution. We introduce Code World Model, a framework that separates world evolution from visual realization by combining the reasoning and coding capabilities of language models with the generative priors of video models. A coding agent serves as the world brain, reasoning about events and their consequences and generating executable code to maintain persistent world state and perform rule-consistent evolution. To connect executable state with visual generation, we introduce a proxy representation that encodes frame-wise spatiotemporal constraints and is compiled into a proxy video, which conditions a video model to render high-fidelity visual observations. We further develop data pipelines for constructing aligned proxy-observation pairs from gameplay and real-world videos. After fine-tuning on paired gameplay data, MiniMax-H3 follows proxy-based spatiotemporal specifications from simple interactive worlds built by the coding agent while preserving rich visual details and dynamics. papers.title: VoiceMem: Streaming Dual-Brain Memory for Real-Time Interaction
papers.report_title: 长期记忆与实时语音交互正式接通!颜水成团队发布无延迟“流式双脑”记忆框架
papers.summary: 颜水成团队（南洋理工大学、新加坡国立大学、清华大学、香港中文大学与Open Interaction Lab）发布VoiceMem“流式双脑”记忆框架，将长期记忆与实时语音交互接通。论文报告链接为https://arxiv.org/pdf/2608.26005，第一作者谢之非，尾作颜水成。VoiceMem设置信息左脑（Schema/Entity组织事实）与情感右脑（人格节点与情感归因），联合检索可在用户说话期间提前定位记忆。关键指标：双脑记忆密集检索仅134ms；LoCoMo上只返回5条记忆即取得91.2分，比Mem0返回200条高29.52分；人格记忆平均74.16分，超过MemOS 1.89分。信息记忆76.39分，比Mem0高24.12。ES-MemEval冲突检测/用户建模为69.10/74.00，而Full-Context基线仅12.10/21.70；移除情感右脑后LoCoMo、ES-MemEval、ChatMem-Bench、Memora分别下降6.3、4.3、5.4、4.4分。团队自建ChatMem-Bench含316个问题、15,314轮对话与约53小时音频，覆盖14类能力，VoiceMem在11类领先；在纯声学类任务文本系统仅3.23—26.92分，VoiceMem达45.16—53.84分。架构上采用流式VAD，在400ms提前量内完成检索，接近零额外延迟。开源代码、Demo与Qwen Audio Agent接入已公布。

arxiv.title: VoiceMem: Streaming Dual-Brain Memory for Real-Time Interaction
arxiv.abstract: Conversational systems, such as duplex speech language models (SLMs), still lack a streaming, accurate, and empathetic memory system as their soul. We introduce VoiceMem, a simple memory architecture with a parallel informational left brain, an emotional right brain, and streaming memory I/O mechanisms. We further build a complete pipeline for memory-aware SLM training, long-horizon evaluation, and decoupled deployment with interchangeable memory backends. Experiments and real-world deployment show three advantages: i) Accuracy: under top-5 retrieval, the left brain outperforms classical systems such as Mem0 at top-200 by nearly 30 points; ii) Emotional & Personal: the right brain, with short- and long-horizon affective attribution and dual-node persona modeling, achieves state-of-the-art performance across three persona benchmarks and improves the aggregate score by 4.29 points over the previous best system; and iii) Real-Time & Cheap: VoiceMem completes retrieval in 134 ms, well within standard VAD latency, adding no extra conversational delay while maintaining high accuracy and low cost. These results show that VoiceMem provides a practical memory foundation for real-time, personalized, and emotionally aware speech interaction.

papers.title: Huawei's $τ$ Chip Was Supposed to Melt?
papers.report_title: 100天三次迭代,华为“韬定律”真正进入验证阶段了吗?
papers.summary: 本文围绕华为9月4日于ChinaXiv发布的预印本论文《Huawei's τ Chip Was Supposed to Melt?》，将华为5月、7月、9月三次“韬定律”更新梳理成一条从理论、工程到产品数据的证据链。论文宣称通过LogicFolding改变逻辑单元的空间组织、缩短关键路径，可把部分性能与时延收益转化为功耗收益，从而缓解3D高密度堆叠带来的热和功耗问题。披露数字包括：麒麟2026晶体管密度提升约55%；NPU功耗下降66%；GPU功耗下降58%；CPU大核功耗下降41%；麒麟2027垂直互连数量预计超过1亿根。华为还称到2031年高端芯片晶体管密度将达到相当于1.4纳米制程的同等水平。文章强调，不能把性能或密度等效直接等同于“已实现1.4纳米制造工艺”；ChinaXiv预印本未经严格同行评审，麒麟数据未获第三方拆解或量产报告复核；功耗测试的频率、电压、负载及测量口径均未披露，局部功耗下降不能直接外推为整机能效。对该方向研究者，这是观察系统级芯片设计路线能否补充先进制程的重要样本；但距离独立复现、稳定量产和行业共识仍有最后一段验证路程。

arxiv.title: Huawei's $τ$ Chip Was Supposed to Melt?
arxiv.abstract: Heat is the sharpest concern on $τ$ scaling law --- the time-scaling principle behind Huawei's folded silicon, named for the delay $τ$ (``Tao'') it sets out to shrink. Our Kirin measurements turned that objection upside down. The reason is one every commuter already knows: on a chip, as in a workday, it is the travel that burns the majority of the energy, not the work at the desk.

arxiv.title: LevelSyn: Physical-Aware Logic Synthesis via Level-Asynchronous Graph Neural Networks
arxiv.abstract: As integrated circuit technology scales into the nanometer regime, the traditional disconnect between logic synthesis and physical design has led to significant PPA (Power, Performance, and Area) degradation and prolonged design closure cycles. Traditional logic synthesis relies on non-physical Wire Load Models (WLMs), while recent spectral-based placement predictors often neglect the inherent hierarchical logic depth and signal flow of netlists, which leads to low-fidelity spatial estimations. To bridge this gap, we propose LevelSyn, a novel physical-aware logic synthesis framework that integrates hierarchical representation learning with a wirelength-driven optimization engine. At its core, LevelSyn leverages a level-asynchronous Graph Neural Network (GNN) to predict high-fidelity gate coordinates by capturing the structural and directional semantics of And-Inverter Graphs (AIGs). To handle industrial-scale designs, a level-aligned subgraph partitioning strategy is introduced to eliminate memory bottlenecks while preserving local logical dependencies. These spatial insights are seamlessly integrated into a newly developed physical-informed synthesis engine within the Berkeley ABC framework. arxiv.title: StudentSim: Training LLM-based Student Simulators
arxiv.abstract: AI tutors are most useful when they adapt to each student's strengths, weaknesses, and preferred guidance, but evidence about which guidance works for which student is sparse, slow, and costly to collect from real learners. Student simulators can provide this signal as a proxy, yet existing approaches are limited: state-tracking models fit student behavior but struggle to process explanations or corrections, while LLM role-play follows guidance fluently but does not reliably match the competence of the student being imitated. We present StudentSim, a training framework that turns sparse per-student data into individualized simulators through pooled training followed by per-student specialization. The resulting simulators both mirror a student's own responses and update them under tutor guidance. We also introduce StudentSimEval, a standardized protocol covering 60 students across chess, second-language English writing, and mathematics, using public learner datasets with de-identified records shared for research. StudentSimEval measures behavioral fidelity (F), or how well a simulator matches a student's responses, and guidance responsiveness (R), or how readily it updates under tutor guidance, with all methods fit and evaluated on the same records. arxiv.title: DreamX-Creator: Democratizing Native Audio-Video Generation at 2K Resolution
arxiv.abstract: Recent video generators often omit audio or synthesize it in a separate stage, limiting reciprocal modeling of visual dynamics and acoustic events. We present DreamX-Creator 1.0, a compact native joint audio-video generation system centered on a 7B generator. Conditioned on a first frame and a text prompt, the generator jointly denoises modality-specialized audio and video streams. The streams are processed independently in the first half of the network and coupled in the latter half through Gated Cross-Modal Attention, whose token- and head-wise output gates modulate each active cross-modal attention-head output. A unified Audio-Video Data System constructs and filters temporally coherent clips, produces structured multimodal annotations, and organizes clips into capability-oriented data pools. Progressive Joint Training comprises two audio-video pre-training stages followed by High-Quality Finetuning. Audio-Video Reinforcement Learning further post-trains the generator with Modality-Aware Multimodal Feedback that routes video-, audio-, and cross-modal feedback to the corresponding streams. For high-resolution output, our Autoregressive 1-Step 2K Refinement pipeline adapts a bidirectional multi-step teacher into an autoregressive multi-step refiner and distills it into a student requiring one denoising evaluation per temporal chunk. papers.summary: 智源等发布 DisCo，将 1000 个常用 GitHub 仓库蒸馏成 5353 条经验证的技能，形成开源 AREX-Skill 库，并用该技能库驱动 Codex/GPT-5.5 Agent 执行 AI4AI 研究。固定模型骨干与 harness 后，加技能带来显著增益：MLE-bench 拿牌率从 31.11% 提升至 72.89%（相对 +134.3%），超过专门定制的 Famou-Agent 2.0 的 64.44%，高难度子集由 13.33% 涨至 62.22%；PaperBench 平均复现得分从 29.45 提到 39.59（+34.4%），20 篇中 18 升 2 回退；FrontierCS 平均分从 70.63 到 77.14，单题 token 约 4.47M，约为 Claude Code 配置的三分之一，分数更高，且增益与额外 token 几乎不相关（Spearman 0.006～0.015）；PassNet 的 AS Score 从 1.343 到 1.5313，超过 TorchInductor 的 1.419，失败样本从 14 降到 5。技能来自自动蒸馏：先圈定能力、收集证据、构建技能图，再经动态和静态两层验证；每条技能带验证记录，不可验证不入库。任务导向蒸馏可针对具体任务按需造技能。作者指出技能绑定版本，维护成本未估算，复用率未测量；增益只在 GPT-5.5 骨干上验证，弱模型收益未知。

arxiv.title: Integrated Sensing and Communication Under DISCO Physical-Layer Jamming Attacks
arxiv.abstract: Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) systems traditionally presuppose that sensing and communication (S&C) channels remain approximately constant during their coherence time. However, a "DISCO" reconfigurable intelligent surface (DRIS), i.e., an illegitimate RIS with random, time-varying reflection properties that acts like a "disco ball," introduces a paradigm shift that enables active channel aging more rapidly during the channel coherence time. In this letter, we investigate the impact of DISCO jamming attacks launched by a DRISbased fully-passive jammer (FPJ) on an ISAC system. Specifically, an ISAC problem formulation and a corresponding waveform optimization are presented in which the ISAC waveform design considers the trade-off between the S&C performance and is formulated as a Pareto optimization problem. Moreover, a theoretical analysis is conducted to quantify the impact of DISCO jamming attacks. Numerical results are presented to evaluate the S&C performance under DISCO jamming attacks and to validate the derived theoretical analysis.

arxiv.title: LLaDA-Image: Building Strong Image Generators with Fully Open Training Recipes
arxiv.abstract: We introduce LLaDA-Image, a unified framework that pairs a 6B Diffusion Transformer (DiT) trained from scratch with a frozen vision-language understanding module built on the LLaDA2.0-Mini diffusion language model backbone. Instead of relying heavily on paired image-text data from the beginning, we first build a strong visual generative prior through image-only pre-training and mid-training. The generation pipeline comprises 220M samples, 98 of which are real images. For efficient and scalable optimization, we use parameter-free RMSNorm throughout the DiT together with the Muon optimizer. The resulting unified model produces highly photorealistic images while accurately following fine-grained editing instructions. We further distill LLaDA-Image into LLaDA-Image-Turbo, enabling fast inference in 2-4 sampling steps. On Qwen-Image-Bench, LLaDA-Image achieves overall scores of 53.53 and 53.38 on the English and Chinese tracks, respectively, setting a new state-of-the-art among open-source models on both tracks. To support further research on capable and efficient generative models, we release our model weights, training code, and detailed recipes.

arxiv.title: Industrial Practice of LLM-Based Test Case Carving and Assertion Generation (Experience Paper)
arxiv.abstract: Enterprise regression testing for microservice systems is often constrained by incomplete or outdated documentation. In practice, QA engineers frequently rely on real execution traffic to reconstruct business scenarios; however, turning raw traffic into replayable regression tests with stable validation logic remains labor-intensive and error-prone. This paper presents NL2Test, an end-to-end approach and tool that generates executable API regression tests from (i) a natural-language scenario description and (ii) a traffic capture recorded while executing the scenario. NL2Test addresses two coupled tasks: test case carving, which extracts a minimal replayable request sequence and reconstructs data dependencies so that dynamic values are bound from their responses rather than hard-coded; and assertion generation, which produces assertions aligned with business intent while avoiding non-deterministic fields and hallucinated paths. To improve reliability, NL2Test uses LLMs for semantic interpretation and constrained code synthesis, and uses deterministic algorithms for request filtering, dependency confirmation via value consistency, and assertion-path validation. We evaluate NL2Test on 51 industrial regression scenarios extracted from a large consumer-facing Internet company. papers.report_title: UniSteer用机械臂「拼豆」:让人类指导进入VLA噪声空间强化学习
papers.summary: 本文介绍微软亚洲研究院、悉尼科技大学与清华大学研究者提出的UniSteer方法，面向VLA模型真机强化学习效率问题。核心思路是将人类纠正动作通过近似反演映射为流匹配生成的初始噪声，使得监督学习和强化学习能共同更新一个轻量noise actor，预训练VLA保持冻结。论文标题为《UniSteer: Unified Noise Steering for Efficient Human-Guided VLA Adaptation》。作者在AgileX Piper上测试拿勺子、堆叠积木、插入方块、折叠毛巾四项任务，每项30条示范预热后进入在线微调。结果显示平均66分钟将成功率从20%提升到90%；不加人类指导的DSRL为55%，动作空间聚合示范的DAgger为60%。OOD初始位置下，初始策略成功率0%，UniSteer微调后三项OOD均达100%，而DSRL为0%/0%/25%，DAgger为75%/100%/25%。消融显示固定点反演在速度与成功率上优于优化式反演和直接动作监督；例如拿勺子任务固定点反演73.26秒实现8/8，优化反演208.04秒3/8。拼豆演示中仅用两条人类演示轨迹完成16颗拼豆成微软Logo。该工作展示人类纠正与RL共用噪声接口的可行性。

arxiv.title: UniSteer: Unified Noise Steering for Efficient Human-Guided VLA Adaptation
arxiv.abstract: Diffusion-based vision-language-action (VLA) models have emerged as strong priors for robotic manipulation, yet adapting them to real-world distributions remains challenging. In particular, on-robot reinforcement learning (RL) is expensive and time-consuming, so effective adaptation depends on efficient policy improvement within a limited budget of real-world interactions. Noise-space RL lowers the cost by keeping the pretrained VLA fixed as a denoising generator while updating only a lightweight actor that predicts the noise. However, its performance is still limited due to inefficient autonomous exploration. Human corrective interventions can reduce this exploration burden, but they are naturally provided in action space, whereas noise-space finetuning requires supervision over noise variables. To address these challenges, we propose UniSteer, a Unified Noise Steering framework that combines human corrective guidance with noise-space RL through approximate action-to-noise inversion. Given a human corrective action, UniSteer inverts the frozen flow-matching decoder to recover a noise target, which provides supervised guidance for the same noise actor that is simultaneously optimized via reinforcement learning. Real-world experiments on diverse manipulation tasks show that UniSteer adapts more efficiently than strong noise-space RL and action-space human-in-the-loop baselines,

papers.title: Ask Self, Ask Others: Relation Is All You Need
papers.report_title: 从Attention到Relation:深入理解Token到底应该怎么流动?
papers.summary: 本文是作者对自身工作的技术笔记，核心解读论文《Ask Self, Ask Others: Relation Is All You Need》，并附带介绍更早的MemGLU门控实验。作者从Attention的计算复杂度和角色耦合出发，提出将关系形成与信息流分配解耦：构造Relation矩阵R，对角线表示Self（自问），非对角线表示Exchange（互问）。Self采用sigmoid、Exchange采用SiLU，并通过大量消融验证不同函数会退化。为使长上下文中Self不因历史数量增加而失稳，引入随层可学的log修正项。多头扩展时，为避免relation与information的固定绑定，使用Givens交替配对旋转实现跨head信息混合。显式R矩阵导出了分解公式，揭示Token先决定Self/Exchange，再决定Exchange内部权重。基于该分解进一步设计FlashRelation，逐块扫描时只需维护Exchange的对数归一化常数与加权和，吞吐接近FlashAttention；又提出Linear Relation状态更新，采用read-before-write顺序让Self决定读写强度，与KDA的gated delta-rule相比不再需要额外控制参数。作者提到Relation2已在小参量下比MHA降低约9% PPL，并通过Givens方向获得替换FFN的接口。文章记录了从Attention成本出发到显式关系矩阵的完整推导过程。

arxiv.title: Ask Self, Ask Others: Relation Is All You Need
arxiv.abstract: Attention dominates token mixing, but it collapses relation formation and flow allocation into a single score-to-flow step. We introduce Relation, which separates them by first organizing pairwise evidence into explicit Self and Exchange relations and deriving information flow afterward. Relation first decides whether a token should rely on itself or draw from its history, and if it draws from history, where to look. This relational organization gives rise to Full Relation, FlashRelation, Linear Relation, and Hybrid Relation. Across matched decoder-only models, Full Relation achieves lower mean final-validation NLL than MHA and reaches the paired MHA final training loss with 4.5-7.3% fewer tokens. Structural diagnostics further show that Relation learns a distinct depth organization: the first layer acts as a current-token anchor and a high-rank router, while later layers shift strongly toward history. In a fixed-context reference benchmark, FlashRelation is 4.17-5.28x faster than the materialized Full Relation implementation. Across scale-matched production workloads, it reaches 89.7-92.9% of PyTorch FlashAttention throughput while executing the exact Full Relation operator. Hybrid Relation demonstrates that Full and Linear Relation layers can be composed within a single decoder. papers.title: Principled Fast and Meta Knowledge Learners for Continual Reinforcement Learning
papers.report_title: 强化学习大本营新作:如何破解「学新忘旧」困局
papers.summary: 阿尔伯塔大学强化学习团队（Richard Sutton所在rlai lab）提出持续强化学习框架FAME（Principled Fast and Meta Knowledge Learners），论文已被ICRL 2026收录（原文如此），链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.00903。该工作针对灾难性遗忘与旧知识阻碍新任务学习这一矛盾：首先用最优值函数/策略距离定义不同MDP环境间的差异，并基于过去任务的状态访问分布定义序列决策中的灾难遗忘；随后将知识整合建模为灾难遗忘最小化优化问题。FAME受海马体-皮层双系统启发，快速学习模块负责旧知识迁移与热启动，元学习模块负责将新任务整合进长期知识库。自适应热启动借助假设检验在元学习初始化、微调上一任务、随机初始化三者间选择；元学习更新在离散动作下转化为增量极大似然，在连续动作下最小化KL散度或Wasserstein距离。实验覆盖MinAtar、Atari与Meta-World，验证了DQN、PPO、SAC；相对Reset、微调、平均、PackNet、ProgressiveNet、CompoNet等基线，FAME在平均性能、前向迁移和遗忘指标上全面占优，且任务越多优势越明显。消融实验确认自适应热启动、正则化强度与记忆缓冲均贡献显著。文章还讨论持续学习与自进化、具身智能的关系，并指出FAME的局限：基于Q值的遗忘度量对奖励尺度敏感等。
papers.paper_title: FAME (Principled Fast and Meta Knowledge Learners)
papers.authors: 阿尔伯塔大学强化学习团队（Richard Sutton 所在 rlai lab）
