arxiv.title: Stealing Reasoning Traces from Proprietary LLM APIs
arxiv.abstract: Leading large language model providers now conceal their models' step-by-step reasoning, or chain-of-thought, to protect intellectual property and limit information leakage. Rather than storing these traces server-side, providers return them to the client as blocks of encrypted text, which the client passes back with each subsequent request. Building on prior research, we identify an architectural vulnerability: these encrypted blocks are fully compatible and interchangeable across different sessions, users, and models within a provider's ecosystem. We exploit this compatibility to develop a scalable decryption jailbreak. By injecting an encrypted reasoning trace from a given model into a weaker, and less safeguarded model from the same provider, we force it to decode and output the trace verbatim in plaintext, without ever jailbreaking the more capable model directly. This vulnerability enables four distinct attack vectors. First, it circumvents anti-distillation mechanisms, allowing adversaries to extract a proprietary model's reasoning, as we demonstrate across Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google. Second, it allows for large-scale private data extraction. Developers frequently share session logs publicly, unaware of contents of the encrypted blocks. papers.summary: 本文重新解读GPT-3原论文《Language Models are Few-Shot Learners》（NeurIPS 2020）。关键信息：GPT-3为1750亿参数自回归Transformer，与GPT-2架构基本一致，仅注意力模式调整；OpenAI训练了8种规模（1.25亿到1750亿参数），所有模型训练3000亿token，最大模型计算量3.14×10^23 FLOPs（3640 petaflop/s-day）。论文提出微调、少样本、单样本、零样本四种任务适应方式，后三种不更新参数，仅通过上下文示例实现In-context Learning，被视为大模型范式创世纪。关键实验：少样本下两位数加法100%、两位数减法98.9%、三位数加法80.2%、三位数减法94.2%、两位数乘法29.2%；2000道三位数加/减法中训练语料仅直接匹配17/2道，排除纯粹记忆。新闻续写图灵测试中人类识别机器新闻正确率约52%。失败案例：WiC少样本49.4%接近随机，ANLI小模型约33%；论文自曝数据污染和偏见问题。作者强调GPT-3真正遗产是重新定义语言模型使用方式：用自然语言和少量示例在推理现场定义任务。

arxiv.title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners
arxiv.abstract: Recent work has demonstrated substantial gains on many NLP tasks and benchmarks by pre-training on a large corpus of text followed by fine-tuning on a specific task. While typically task-agnostic in architecture, this method still requires task-specific fine-tuning datasets of thousands or tens of thousands of examples. By contrast, humans can generally perform a new language task from only a few examples or from simple instructions - something which current NLP systems still largely struggle to do. Here we show that scaling up language models greatly improves task-agnostic, few-shot performance, sometimes even reaching competitiveness with prior state-of-the-art fine-tuning approaches. Specifically, we train GPT-3, an autoregressive language model with 175 billion parameters, 10x more than any previous non-sparse language model, and test its performance in the few-shot setting. For all tasks, GPT-3 is applied without any gradient updates or fine-tuning, with tasks and few-shot demonstrations specified purely via text interaction with the model. GPT-3 achieves strong performance on many NLP datasets, including translation, question-answering, and cloze tasks, as well as several tasks that require on-the-fly reasoning or domain adaptation, such as unscrambling words, using a novel word in a sentence, or performing 3-digit arithmetic. papers.report_title: 论文与时间 | arXiv 用大模型自动完成社会科学研究
papers.summary: 本文推送Benjamin Manning、Kehang Zhu和John Horton的arXiv论文《Automated Social Science: Language Models as Scientist and Subjects》。文章提出将社会科学研究全流程自动化：把假说写成结构因果模型，连接研究问题、实验设计与估计方案；系统自动提出可检验关系、生成代理人、运行模拟实验、回收数据并估计结果。论文展示四个场景：讨价还价、保释听证、求职面试、艺术品拍卖，前两个几乎无需人工干预，后两个加入少量人工设定。实验发现：系统能提出若干可证伪关系并找到支持或不支持证据；模型直接预测因果方向较准确，但效应大小估计偏差大——四组实验中路径系数预测平均明显高于真实估计，拍卖场景中直接给出的价格预测偏离较大，只有把拟合好的结构因果模型提供给模型后点预测才明显改善。作者认为LLM内部包含人类行为潜在信息，但直接提问难以稳定提取，结构因果模型能将这些信息转化为可检验、可重复的社会科学命题。

arxiv.title: Automated Social Science: Language Models as Scientist and Subjects
arxiv.abstract: We present an approach for automatically generating and testing, in silico, social scientific hypotheses. This automation is made possible by recent advances in large language models (LLM), but the key feature of the approach is the use of structural causal models. Structural causal models provide a language to state hypotheses, a blueprint for constructing LLM-based agents, an experimental design, and a plan for data analysis. The fitted structural causal model becomes an object available for prediction or the planning of follow-on experiments. We demonstrate the approach with several scenarios: a negotiation, a bail hearing, a job interview, and an auction. In each case, causal relationships are both proposed and tested by the system, finding evidence for some and not others. We provide evidence that the insights from these simulations of social interactions are not available to the LLM purely through direct elicitation. When given its proposed structural causal model for each scenario, the LLM is good at predicting the signs of estimated effects, but it cannot reliably predict the magnitudes of those estimates. In the auction experiment, the in silico simulation results closely match the predictions of auction theory, but elicited predictions of the clearing prices from the LLM are inaccurate. papers.report_title: Kimi K3、Qwen3.8-Max 官方评测都在用!伯克利硬核测试揭穿 AI 自进化假象
papers.summary: 本文深度解读伯克利MLS-Bench基准，用于检验AI自进化系统是否真正具备科学方法发现能力。MLS-Bench覆盖12个机器学习方向、140个真实研究任务，每任务包含至少3种复现的强人类基线和至少3个跨条件迁移测试；完整评测单候选约需700个H100小时，30题Lite版约90个H100小时。主实验中五个前沿模型经多轮迭代分数提升，但整体均未超过Human SOTA；消融与专家分析显示提升主要来自已有组件的调优与重组，新机制少见。参数规模控制实验表明，移除检查后模型可借扩大参数量超过人类基线，容量增长易被误归因为算法创新。预训练预算自由分配实验中模型未表现出稳定优势，更多算力选项常导致更差结果。Kimi K3、Qwen3.8-Max已将MLS-Bench-Lite纳入官方评测。结论：当前模型是高效工程执行者，尚未成为能独立提出、验证并推广新方法的研究者。
report_titles: Kimi K3、Qwen3.8-Max 官方评测都在用!伯克利硬核测试揭穿 AI 自进化假象

arxiv.title: MLS-Bench: A Holistic and Rigorous Assessment of AI Systems on Building Better AI
arxiv.abstract: Modern AI progress has been driven by ML methods that are generalizable across settings and scalable to larger regimes. As large language models demonstrate advanced capabilities in reasoning, coding, and engineering tasks, it is increasingly important to understand whether they can discover such methods rather than only apply existing ones. We introduce MLS-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating whether AI systems can invent generalizable and scalable ML methods. MLS-Bench contains 140 tasks across 12 domains, each requiring an agent to improve one targeted component of an ML system or algorithm and demonstrate that the improvement generalizes across controlled settings and scales. We find that current agents remain far from reliably surpassing human-designed methods, and that engineering-style tuning is easier for them than genuine method invention. We further study the effects of test-time scaling, adaptive compute allocation, and context provision on agents' discovery performance, together with case studies of their behavior. Our analyses suggest that the bottleneck is not only in proposing new methods, but also in the scientific insight needed to plan, validate, and scale claims about them. More search, compute, or context alone does not remove this bottleneck. We build and maintain a community platform for cumulative and comparable iteration, and release the data and code at h

papers.report_title: Faraday深度解读:27B「AI科学家」如何指挥GPT-5.5击败Claude Opus 4.8
papers.summary: Faraday以27B参数小模型通过CAT范式（Coding Agent as Tool）调度约5T的Codex执行编程，形成“小模型做科研决策、大模型做工程实现”的Agent架构，训练数据来自Replica流水线：从100篇ML/AI4Science经典论文中涂黑结果图，在1/7张H200、60分钟预算下要求忠实复现。训练核心是Rubric-based Judge，以视觉保真度、论点复现、实现保真度、实验努力、科学诚信五维评分，并加入任务专属Rubric、3次采样平均和回合级信用分配；移除回合级信用分配后训练在约570步崩溃。结果ML训练集Faraday得分0.856，高于Claude Opus 4.8的0.828和Codex的0.796；AI4Science测试集0.791 vs 0.748 vs 0.729；任务级胜率ML达73%、AI4S达60%。即便用Claude Opus 4.8对Codex提示词优化24轮（0.796→0.802）仍无法追赶，说明优势来自RL训练出的科研直觉而非提示工程。文章还比较了OpenRSI和Harness评测的局限。该工作展示了可扩展AI4Science路径，也提示长程非可验证RL训练需稳定架构。
report_titles: Faraday深度解读:27B「AI科学家」如何指挥GPT-5.5击败Claude Opus 4.8

arxiv.title: My, and others', spiking memristors are true memristors: a response to R.S. Williams' question at the New Memory Paradigms: Memristive Phenomena and Neuromorphic Applications Faraday Discussion
arxiv.abstract: At the Faraday Discussion, in the paper titled `Neuromorphic computation with spiking memristors: habituation, experimental instantiation of logic gates and a novel sequence-sensitive perceptron model' it was demonstrated that a large amount of computation could be done in a sequential way using memristor current spikes (d.c. response). As these spikes are found in many memristors (possibly all), this novel approach could be highly useful for fast and reproducible memristor circuits. However, questions were raised as to whether these spikes were actually due to memristance or merely capacitance in the circuit. In this longer version of the Faraday Discussion response, as much information as is available from both published and unpublished data from my lab is marshalled together. We find that the devices are likely imperfect memristors with some capacitance, and that the spikes are related to the frequency effect seen in memristor hysteresis curves, thus are an integral part of memristance.

papers.title: Perceptual Flow Matching for Few-Step Generative Modeling
papers.report_title: 免蒸馏,只改一个Loss!5行代码实现扩散模型4步生成
papers.summary: 文章介绍京东探索研究院等的论文《Perceptual Flow Matching for Few-Step Generative Modeling》，核心发现是将传统Flow Matching训练的MSE Loss替换为Perceptual Loss，即可让扩散模型从35-50步降到4-8步生成，无需Teacher模型、分布蒸馏、轨迹蒸馏或额外训练目标，仅需约5行代码改动。作者在文生图、图像编辑和视频生成任务上验证效果，并分析原因：高噪声区域后验分布不确定性大，MSE监督倾向于预测多个解的平均值（均值效应），少步推理时逐步累积导致偏离真实数据流形；感知空间对off-manifold预测惩罚更大，使预测保持在数据流形附近。文章提出空间分布距离R衡量特征空间对off-manifold样本的惩罚能力，在Spiral与FFHQ上验证R与少步生成性能相关；实验显示DINO特征空间中对1000张FFHQ人脸求均值仍保留清晰结构，而Pixel/VAE Latent空间均值模糊。消融实验表明Huber Loss、Pixel空间监督或随机初始化的ViT特征不能带来少步生成能力，只有DINO/SigLIP等富含高层语义的感知空间有效，证明监督空间的选择才是少步生成的关键。

arxiv.title: Perceptual Flow Matching for Few-Step Generative Modeling
arxiv.abstract: We propose Perceptual Flow Matching (PFM), a simple yet effective framework for few-step generation in flow-matching models. Rather than performing velocity regression in the conventional VAE latent space, PFM supervises flow matching in a perceptual feature space using pretrained perceptual models. This simple change substantially improves the few-step generation capability of flow-matching models, reducing the number of sampling steps from 35-50 to 4-8 while preserving generation quality. Unlike existing acceleration and distillation approaches, PFM requires neither teacher models nor auxiliary score networks and can be integrated into standard flow-matching training pipelines with minimal modifications. Extensive experiments on image generation, video generation, and image editing tasks demonstrate that PFM consistently produces high-quality results while producing fewer artifacts than existing distillation-based methods. We further show that perceptual supervision shifts the regression minimizer from mean-seeking to mode-seeking, biasing predictions toward on-manifold modes that remain accurate under coarse few-step integration. Our results reveal that standard flow-matching training can naturally yield high-quality few-step generators when supervised in an appropriate representation space. papers.report_title: NUS&牛津开源 OmniScientist:全模态 AI 科学家直接感知原始数据,36 案例跑通
papers.summary: 本文解读新加坡国立大学与牛津大学发布的 OmniScientist（arXiv:2608.13558），一个直接读取原始多模态科学数据的全模态 AI 科学家系统。与先翻译成文本或摘要的方案不同，它用感知层贯穿研究全程，由构思、实验、写作三个 Agent 在代码强制检查下完成“原始数据→成稿论文”。36 个真实数据集全部跑通，覆盖 5 大学科、12 种模态、4 类证据家族，其中 28 个为感知类案例。骨干模型评测中，Claude Sonnet 5 平均总分 6.3/10，GLM-5.2 与 Kimi K2.7 在各自子集上为 6.5/6.2，Qwen3.5-9B 仅 4.0；事实准确性最高（Sonnet 5 为 7.7），多模态接地最低（3.8–6.6）。感知消融在 5 个配对案例中，完整版头对头胜率 85%，7 个评审维度 6 升 1 平，多模态接地 +2.8、重要性 +1.8。案例方面：STEAD 地震审计发现 21.7%（163/750）的“噪声”记录含相干瞬态脉冲，去掉跨通道一致性后检出率从 21.7% 降至 2.0%；儿童肺炎胸片“斑驳”空间指标在留出集 AUC 0.851，显著高于原始像素基线 0.634。运行成本 0.03–4.34 美元；36 次主运行中预注册假设支持 16 次、部分支持 17 次、反驳 2 次、1 次无结论。

arxiv.title: OmniScientist: An Omni-Modal Omni-Discipline AI Scientist
arxiv.abstract: Recent advances in foundation models have enabled AI scientists to automate increasingly complete research workflows, from hypothesis generation and code execution to manuscript preparation. Yet workflow coverage alone does not provide access to the full evidence on which scientific discovery depends. Existing systems typically reason over text, code, labels, or precomputed summaries, leaving scientifically decisive spatial, temporal, cross-channel, and procedural relations unavailable to the agent. We introduce OmniScientist, an end-to-end, omni-modal AI scientist that conducts multidisciplinary research directly from heterogeneous raw evidence. A perception layer and 3 autonomous agents for ideation, experiment, and writeup operate within a deterministic pipeline, allowing observations to shape research questions, experimental decisions, and final claims throughout the research lifecycle. By running idea, rigour, and claim checks in code, the system enforces novelty screening, statistical validity, execution provenance, and numerical traceability. We evaluate OmniScientist on 36 real-data cases spanning 5 discipline families, 4 families of scientific evidence, and modalities including images, signals, audio, video, 3-D structures, trajectories, tables, formulae, and graphs. papers.title: ChatGLM: A Family of Large Language Models from GLM-130B to GLM-4 All Tools
papers.report_title: 大模型论文 · GLM篇(5):GLM-4
papers.summary: GLM-4是智谱AI于2024年1月发布的基座大模型，技术报告发表于arXiv:2406.12793。核心数据：预训练语料10T tokens（中英为主，24种语言），上下文长度128K，对标GPT-4 Turbo。后训练采用SFT+RLHF，All Tools支持浏览器、Python解释器、文生图及自定义函数，实现从工具执行到自主决策的质变。技术报告称GLM-4在MMLU、GSM8K、MATH、BBH、GPQA、HumanEval等通用基准上接近或部分超越GPT-4；中文对齐AlignBench优于GPT-4；All Tools在访问在线信息和使用Python解释器解决数学问题等任务上超越GPT-4 All Tools。开源版本GLM-4-9B支持128K/1M上下文，评测成绩：MMLU 74.7、C-Eval 77.1、GSM8K 34.3、MATH 84.0、BBH 30.4。2023年ChatGLM系列Hugging Face下载量超1000万次。GLM-4标志着智谱从'追赶'到'并跑'，并推出GLMs个性化智能体平台和开源基金。
report_titles: 大模型论文 · GLM篇(5):GLM-4

arxiv.title: ChatGLM: A Family of Large Language Models from GLM-130B to GLM-4 All Tools
arxiv.abstract: We introduce ChatGLM, an evolving family of large language models that we have been developing over time. This report primarily focuses on the GLM-4 language series, which includes GLM-4, GLM-4-Air, and GLM-4-9B. They represent our most capable models that are trained with all the insights and lessons gained from the preceding three generations of ChatGLM. To date, the GLM-4 models are pre-trained on ten trillions of tokens mostly in Chinese and English, along with a small set of corpus from 24 languages, and aligned primarily for Chinese and English usage. The high-quality alignment is achieved via a multi-stage post-training process, which involves supervised fine-tuning and learning from human feedback. Evaluations show that GLM-4 1) closely rivals or outperforms GPT-4 in terms of general metrics such as MMLU, GSM8K, MATH, BBH, GPQA, and HumanEval, 2) gets close to GPT-4-Turbo in instruction following as measured by IFEval, 3) matches GPT-4 Turbo (128K) and Claude 3 for long context tasks, and 4) outperforms GPT-4 in Chinese alignments as measured by AlignBench. The GLM-4 All Tools model is further aligned to understand user intent and autonomously decide when and which tool(s) touse -- including web browser, Python interpreter, text-to-image model, and user-defined functions -- to effectively complete complex tasks. papers.title: GLM-4.5: Agentic, Reasoning, and Coding (ARC) Foundation Models
papers.report_title: 大模型论文 · GLM篇(6):GLM-4.5
papers.summary: GLM-4.5是智谱AI与清华KEG于2025年7月发布的旗舰MoE模型，技术报告arXiv:2508.06471。总参数355B，激活参数32B（激活比约9.0%），预训练数据23T tokens（15T通用+7T定向+1T中期），上下文128K。首次在单一模型中原生融合Agentic、Reasoning、Coding（ARC）三大能力。架构采用'瘦高'MoE设计：减少宽度增加深度，注意力头提升至2.5倍（96头），引入无损平衡路由、sigmoid门控、QK-Norm。训练流程为通用预训练→定向预训练→中期训练，其中中期训练包含代码仓库级数据、合成推理数据和长上下文数据。后训练采用SFT+三路RL，自研Slime框架。混合推理支持Thinking和Direct Response。12项基准综合63.2分，全球第3，开源/国产第1；TAU-Bench 70.1%（Agent全球第2），AIME 24 91.0%，SWE-bench Verified 64.2%。轻量版GLM-4.5-Air总参106B/激活12B，综合59.8分。连续7天登顶Hugging Face趋势榜。
report_titles: 大模型论文 · GLM篇(6):GLM-4.5

arxiv.title: GLM-4.5: Agentic, Reasoning, and Coding (ARC) Foundation Models
arxiv.abstract: We present GLM-4.5, an open-source Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) large language model with 355B total parameters and 32B activated parameters, featuring a hybrid reasoning method that supports both thinking and direct response modes. Through multi-stage training on 23T tokens and comprehensive post-training with expert model iteration and reinforcement learning, GLM-4.5 achieves strong performance across agentic, reasoning, and coding (ARC) tasks, scoring 70.1% on TAU-Bench, 91.0% on AIME 24, and 64.2% on SWE-bench Verified. With much fewer parameters than several competitors, GLM-4.5 ranks 3rd overall among all evaluated models and 2nd on agentic benchmarks. We release both GLM-4.5 (355B parameters) and a compact version, GLM-4.5-Air (106B parameters), to advance research in reasoning and agentic AI systems. Code, models, and more information are available at https://github.com/zai-org/GLM-4.5.

papers.title: GLM-5: from Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering
papers.report_title: 大模型论文 · GLM篇(7):GLM-5
papers.summary: GLM-5是智谱AI于2026年2月发布的旗舰MoE模型，技术报告arXiv:2602.15763。总参744B，激活40B，256个专家，网络层80层，预训练数据28.5T tokens，原生上下文200K。发布前以代号Pony Alpha在OpenRouter匿名盲测，25%用户推测为Claude Sonnet 5。引入DSA稀疏注意力，200K上下文下注意力计算成本降低1.5-2倍；异步强化学习基础设施将轨迹生成与参数更新解耦，并提出异步Agent RL算法。Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.0达到50分，成为首个达到50分的开放权重模型；在8个Agent/推理/编程基准上平均提升约20%，与Claude Opus 4.5和GPT-5.2(xhigh)相当；LMArena文本和代码竞技场开放模型第一。训练全程基于华为昇腾芯片，发布即适配七大国产芯片平台。MIT协议全栈开源（权重、训练代码、RL框架、benchmarking suite）。后续版本GLM-5.1支持8小时持续工作，GLM-5.2上下文1M、IndexShare使1M下FLOPs降2.9倍、AAI 51分。
report_titles: 大模型论文 · GLM篇(7):GLM-5

arxiv.title: GLM-5: from Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering
arxiv.abstract: We present GLM-5, a next-generation foundation model designed to transition the paradigm of vibe coding to agentic engineering. Building upon the agentic, reasoning, and coding (ARC) capabilities of its predecessor, GLM-5 adopts DSA to significantly reduce training and inference costs while maintaining long-context fidelity. To advance model alignment and autonomy, we implement a new asynchronous reinforcement learning infrastructure that drastically improves post-training efficiency by decoupling generation from training. Furthermore, we propose novel asynchronous agent RL algorithms that further improve RL quality, enabling the model to learn from complex, long-horizon interactions more effectively. Through these innovations, GLM-5 achieves state-of-the-art performance on major open benchmarks. Most critically, GLM-5 demonstrates unprecedented capability in real-world coding tasks, surpassing previous baselines in handling end-to-end software engineering challenges. Code, models, and more information are available at https://github.com/zai-org/GLM-5.

papers.title: FlashMemory-DeepSeek-V4: Lightning Index Ultra-Long Context via Lookahead Sparse Attention
papers.report_title: DeepSeek-V4技术报告解读:万亿参数百万Token,KV Cache压到V3的1/10
papers.summary: 本文解读DeepSeek-V4预览版技术报告。V4推出Pro和Flash双版本：Pro总参数1.6T、激活49B（激活比约3.1%），Flash总参数284B、激活13B；预训练数据分别33T/32T tokens，原生支持1M上下文。相比V3.2，KV缓存占用降至10%（Flash 7%），单Token推理FLOPs降至27%（Flash 10%）。技术亮点包括CSA+HCA混合注意力、mHC流形约束超连接、Muon优化器替代AdamW、Engram条件记忆模块、TileLang算子语言+MXFP4低精度推理，以及On-Policy Distillation后训练。评测数据：MMLU-Pro 87.5/86.2，LiveCodeBench 93.5（领先Gemini-3.1-Pro-High 91.7和Claude Opus-4.6 Max 88.8），SWE Verified 80.6，GPQA 90.1，SimpleQA-Verified 57.9，CSimpleQA 84.4（开源第一），Codeforces Rating 3206（人类前23）。服务成本较V3.2下降超10倍，内存占用约1/10。后续DSpark推理加速使V4-Flash单用户生成速度提升60%-85%、高并发吞吐翻4倍；V4-Flash正式版Agent基准Terminal Bench 2.1达82.7，Agents' Last Exam 25.2接近Opus-4.8的25.7，API价格为Claude的1/90。文章强调V4是面向算力主权的全栈自研里程碑。

arxiv.title: FlashMemory-DeepSeek-V4: Lightning Index Ultra-Long Context via Lookahead Sparse Attention
arxiv.abstract: Conventional LLMs keep the full KV cache loaded during decoding, causing a severe GPU memory bottleneck for ultra-long context serving. In this report, we propose \textbf{Lookahead Sparse Attention (LSA)}, a novel inference paradigm powered by a Neural Memory Indexer built upon the DeepSeek-V4 architecture. Rather than passively attending to all historical tokens, LSA proactively predicts future context demands and preserves only the query-critical KV chunks in the GPU memory. Crucially, we instantiate this architecture via a \textbf{backbone-free decoupled training} strategy. By formulating the indexer as a standard dual-encoder architecture, we train it independently using standard retrieval training frameworks without ever loading the massive backbone model into GPU memory. We demonstrate that this ``less is more'' paradigm significantly maximizes serving efficiency while acting as an effective attention denoiser in tasks that rely on long-term global memory. Across primary long-context evaluation suites (e.g., LongBench-v2, LongMemEval, and RULER), \texttt{FM-DS-V4} compresses the average physical KV cache footprint down to merely 13.5\% of the full-context baseline, while consistently preserving or slightly elevating downstream accuracy (+0.6\% absolute margin on average). At 1M context, per-decode-token compute drops to 0.30$\times$ of the baseline and GPU KV cache shrink

papers.title: GLM-RAG: Graph Language Models for Graph-Based Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.report_title: GraphRAG退场,GLM-RAG换秘籍了
papers.summary: 本文解读海德堡大学与Aleph Alpha提出的GLM-RAG论文，用图语言模型替代GNN做知识图谱RAG检索器。核心创新：GLM将预训练LM转为graph transformer，保留语言理解；抽取seed实体局部子图后转成文本三元组序列，实体token跨三元组共享，并通过修改自注意力用相对位置编码编码图结构，使query与子图在第一注意力层就完成融合，语义判断先于结构传播。在受控对比中沿用GFM-RAG的KG/QA构建与排序生成机制，仅替换检索组件。实验关键数据：MultihopRAG上GLM-RAG Recall@2达60.0，超过GFM-RAG+的39.0和G-Reasoner约20点；G-Bench Medical 76.9、CS 76.6为SOTA；域内多跳MuSiQue Recall@2 76.9，HotPotQA EM 55.7最佳；7个单跳OOD数据集上vanilla RAG全面超过图RAG方法；GLM-RAG性能随模型规模提升，而GFM-RAG*无提升。作者点评指出多跳RAG的关键在语义理解而非单纯增加图覆盖，单跳问题用vanilla RAG即可。论文标题：GLM-RAG: Graph Language Models for Graph-Based Retrieval-Augmented Generation，链接 https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28397
report_titles: GraphRAG退场,GLM-RAG换秘籍了

arxiv.title: GLM-RAG: Graph Language Models for Graph-Based Retrieval-Augmented Generation
arxiv.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over knowledge graphs requires retrievers that can effectively capture both graph structure and semantic information. Recent approaches have explored graph neural network (GNN)-based retrievers to model graph topology in multi-hop reasoning tasks. In parallel, graph language models (GLMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm that integrates graph reasoning and the semantic capabilities of language models. In this work, we introduce a GLM-based retriever and investigate the comparative strengths of GLM-based, GNN-based, and traditional vector-search-based retrievers in single- and multi-hop RAG settings, and with a particular focus on transferability to unseen domains. Our findings suggest that finetuned GLM retrievers generalize better out of domain, achieving SOTA on two multi-hop benchmarks. On in-domain multi-hop QA datasets they remain comparable to prior work, with promising scaling as parameters and subgraph coverage increase. GNN-based retrievers achieve higher graph coverage with an efficient training setup, whereas the vector-search baseline excels at single-hop datasets.

papers.title: DAPD: Dependency-Aware Parallel Decoding via Attention for Diffusion LLMs
papers.report_title: 上海交大&上海AI Lab开源DAPD:用双锚定对齐信息路径,缓解特权幻觉,六任务均分相对OPSD+2.00
papers.summary: 文章介绍了上海交大与上海AI实验室开源的DAPD（Dual-Anchored Policy Distillation）方法，用于缓解on-policy自蒸馏（OPSD）中的特权幻觉问题。OPSD让教师使用参考答案（特权信息）训练学生，但学生在推理时看不到参考答案，导致模型学会'假装记得答案'，错误断言从每万次生成约13升至约37，同时AIME24/25/HMMT25的Avg@12从59.56降至53.24。DAPD通过双路径锚定（信息匹配条件下对齐）和双来源锚定（参考答案与自采样互相指导）解决了这一问题。在Qwen3-4B上，DAPD六任务平均57.34分，相对OPSD提升2.00分，其中AIME25达72.22（+4.44），HMMT25为46.39（+3.06）；规模曲线显示OPSD在8B-32B规模增益几乎消失（≤+0.28），而DAPD保持+2.41/+2.13/+3.06的增益。额外实验表明，替换学生条件分布为Self可将后期错误断言压低约45%，Avg@12提升6.22分；训练后期DAPD相对OPSD错误断言再降约73%。仅用推理数据训练时LCB v5达54.14。作者还提供了消融和权重分析，指出无参考双采样变体在4B/8B各+2.41。边界是训练算力更高和权重需按规模重标定。
report_titles: 上海交大&上海AI Lab开源DAPD:用双锚定对齐信息路径,缓解特权幻觉,六任务均分相对OPSD+2.00

arxiv.title: DAPD: Dependency-Aware Parallel Decoding via Attention for Diffusion LLMs
arxiv.abstract: Parallel decoding for Diffusion LLMs (dLLMs) is difficult because each denoising step provides only token-wise marginal distributions, while unmasking multiple tokens simultaneously requires accounting for inter-token dependencies. We propose Dependency-Aware Parallel Decoding (DAPD), a simple, training-free decoding method that uses self-attention to induce a conditional dependency graph over masked tokens. At each iteration, edges in this graph capture strong token interactions, while non-edges indicate weak dependence. Parallel decoding is then reduced to selecting an independent set on the graph and unmasking the selected tokens in parallel. This avoids co-updating strongly coupled tokens without auxiliary models or retraining. Experiments on LLaDA and Dream show that DAPD improves the accuracy-steps trade-off over existing methods and enables more globally distributed parallel updates that better exploit the any-order generation capability of dLLMs. The project is available at https://ai-isl.github.io/dapd

papers.title: OneDayAgent: Towards a Long-Horizon Harness for Autonomous Agents
papers.report_title: 浙大&蚂蚁开源 OneDayAgent:给长程任务加交付质检,同一流程换五模型也能跑
papers.summary: OneDayAgent 是面向长时程自主智能体任务的 harness 框架，核心思路是在模型外加一层“拆单、记账、交付校验”机制：将长任务分解为子任务，执行后合成候选成品，再按原始需求和附件抽出的必交文件名、必改项进行全局校验，缺文件或漏改则定向修复，避免模型“嘴上说完、磁盘上没有”。评测基于 AgentIF-OneDay 的 104 道办公向长任务和 767 条检查项，默认后端 GLM-5.2 总分为 0.821，其中 OWE/LII/IR 分别为 0.818/0.821/0.829，满分配置平均耗时约 3216.8 秒（约 54 分钟）。同一 harness 换五个后端均能跑完：Qwen3.6-27B 0.613、Qwen3.5-9B 0.624、Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 0.708、Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview 0.743、GLM-5.2 0.821。消融显示只开校验或只开分解均约 0.804，全开 0.821；按 Score/Lat. 计算，全开约 1.53，只留校验约 2.71，只留分解约 2.11，两者都关约 2.80。校验侧 95/104 首次通过，9 题进入修复，6 题救回、3 题仍失败。上下文压缩触发 35/104 题，压缩次数与分数相关系数约 -0.034。花语 PPT 案例中，校验成功识别 language_of_flowers.pptx 缺失并触发局部补交付物。论文指出数字仅来自 AgentIF-OneDay，工作区隔离等安全问题需另行处理。
report_titles: 浙大&蚂蚁开源 OneDayAgent:给长程任务加交付质检,同一流程换五模型也能跑

arxiv.title: OneDayAgent: Towards a Long-Horizon Harness for Autonomous Agents
arxiv.abstract: LLM agents are increasingly applied to open-ended everyday requests that span work, study, and life. These tasks are long-horizon, cross-environment, and multimodal, forcing the agent to preserve goals and constraints across many steps while navigating heterogeneous tools and attachments. While prior work has addressed individual failure modes such as goals drift, states loss, and context overflow, whether a single harness can manage them jointly and remain effective across backends has received less study. We present OneDayAgent, a long-horizon harness for autonomous agents. OneDayAgent turns an open-ended request into a managed execution process that decomposes tasks into bounded subtasks, maintains execution memory under context pressure, and verifies and repairs the final deliverable. We evaluate OneDayAgent on AgentIF-OneDay across 104 tasks. With the GLM-5.2 backend, OneDayAgent sets a new state of the art with an overall score of 0.821. The same harness runs across five backend LLMs from three model families, indicating the harness generalizes across backends without tuning, even as different models induce distinct execution styles under the same workflow.

papers.title: MerchantBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Long-Term Coherence in E-Commerce Operations
papers.report_title: 阿里开源 MerchantBench:让 Agent 开一年网店,最强配置净资产仅达人类 27.3%
papers.summary: 阿里联合浙大、北大、复旦开源 MerchantBench，用 365 天模拟网店评测 LLM Agent 的长期连贯性。环境基于 1688 真实数据：98,843 个商品、36,576 个供应商、10 个一级类目，每个商品带逐日需求曲线和对应市场日报；订单级模拟含采购扣款、结算回款和六种异常（如退货退款罚 8 元、差评罚 5 元、延迟发货罚 3 元），供应商事件快反馈与订单异常慢反馈形成混合延迟。评测覆盖 8 个模型（GPT-5.6 Sol、Claude Opus 4.8、Qwen3.7-Max/Plus、GLM-5.2、DeepSeek-V4-Pro/Flash、Kimi K2.6）在两套框架（ReAct/Hermes）下各 3 局，共 48 局全年模拟，对照 3 名无经验人类。关键结果：人类平均期末净资产 217.61 千元、GMV 608.06 千元、9,442 单；最强 LLM 配置 Qwen3.7-Max+Hermes 为 59.46 千元，仅达人类的 27.3%，是规则基线 24.48 千元的约 2.4 倍。Hermes 框架平均比 ReAct 净资产高 53.3%、GMV 高 71.5%、订单多 71.2%，7/8 模型受益，Kimi K2.6 例外（-4.1%）。稳定性方面最强配置变异系数 55.1%，GPT-5.6 Sol+ReAct 为 3.3%。失败模式包括运营连贯性崩溃（SWR 下降、活动衰减、提前放弃）和战略连贯性崩溃（被动救火、定价不调整、错记经营终点）。
papers.authors: 阿里巴巴、浙江大学、北京大学、复旦大学
report_titles: 阿里开源 MerchantBench:让 Agent 开一年网店,最强配置净资产仅达人类 27.3%

arxiv.title: MerchantBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Long-Term Coherence in E-Commerce Operations
arxiv.abstract: Large language model agents are increasingly evaluated as autonomous tool users, yet most benchmarks focus on bounded tasks with immediate success criteria. Real-world deployments often require Long-Term Coherence, the capacity to preserve purposeful behavior across extended horizons while adapting decisions to accumulated evidence. Evaluating this capacity requires a persistent environment in which actions constrain future choices, feedback arrives at heterogeneous delays, and incoherent behavior produces measurable cumulative effects. Seller-side e-commerce provides a suitable setting for this evaluation through recurrent and interdependent decisions over Product Sourcing, Listing and Pricing Control, Cash-Flow Management, and Mixed-Latency Feedback Adaptation. We introduce MerchantBench, a 365-day order-level simulation grounded in 98,843 real e-commerce product records and equipped with 26 tools for agent interaction. MerchantBench couples promptly observable Upstream Supplier Events with delayed Downstream Order Outcomes, requiring agents to follow individual order lifecycles and revisit earlier decisions. We evaluate eight LLMs under two agent frameworks in 48 runs, each spanning 365 simulated days. Our results reveal a substantial gap between even the latest LLMs and human participants, with the best LLM configuration attaining only 27.3\% of the mean final net assets ac

papers.title: Sonar-TS: Search-Then-Verify Natural Language Querying for Time Series Databases
papers.report_title: ICML 2026 | 免训练跑赢14B模型,Sonar-TS补上时序问答规模空白
papers.summary: 本文解读 Griffith 大学金明课题组 ICML 2026 工作 Sonar-TS。作者首先定义新问题 NLQ4TSDB：对数据库规模时间序列做自然语言形态查询，例如找出“先快速上升、随后进入平台期”的片段。现有 Text-to-SQL、时序问答模型、时序相似性搜索均无法同时满足形态理解（MP）、数据库规模（MS）和语言落地（NLG）。配套基准 NLQTSBench 是首个该方向基准：单题平均搜索空间约 1.2 万个点，而以往基准通常仅几百点；包含 9 类子任务、1153 项查询，用参数化模板+信号注入+人工目检保证标注可审计。Sonar-TS 是免训练神经符号框架：离线把多尺度切窗后的统计原语与 SAX 符号建成 SQL 可检索特征表，在线用 LLM 生成 SQL 粗搜候选、生成 Python 用 DTW/PELT/Theil-Sen 精验，执行失败则回灌自纠错。长历史设定下总分 0.6144，约为 MAC-SQL（0.16）的 3.8 倍；Lite 设定下 0.30，领先 ChatTS-14B（0.18）。消融显示符号粗搜与代码精验缺一不可；但形态硬任务得分仍偏低，说明问题远未解决。贡献为三个“第一”：新问题、可审计基准、免训练框架。
report_titles: ICML 2026 | 免训练跑赢14B模型,Sonar-TS补上时序问答规模空白

arxiv.title: Sonar-TS: Search-Then-Verify Natural Language Querying for Time Series Databases
arxiv.abstract: Natural Language Querying for Time Series Databases (NLQ4TSDB) aims to assist non-expert users retrieve meaningful events, intervals, and summaries from massive temporal records. However, existing Text-to-SQL methods are not designed for continuous morphological intents such as shapes or anomalies, while time series models struggle to handle ultra-long histories. To address these challenges, we propose Sonar-TS, a neuro-symbolic framework that tackles NLQ4TSDB via a Search-Then-Verify pipeline. Analogous to active sonar, it utilizes a feature index to ping candidate windows via SQL, followed by generated Python programs to lock on and verify candidates against raw signals. To enable effective evaluation, we introduce NLQTSBench, the first large-scale benchmark designed for NLQ over TSDB-scale histories. Our experiments highlight the unique challenges within this domain and demonstrate that Sonar-TS effectively navigates complex temporal queries where traditional methods fail. This work presents the first systematic study of NLQ4TSDB, offering a general framework and evaluation standard to facilitate future research.

papers.title: VeriTrace: Human-Like Temporal Exploration Completes Agentic Action Space
papers.report_title: 100% Pass@1 背后,VeriTrace 把调试方向盘交给 Agent
papers.summary: VeriTrace提出Agentic Temporal Exploration，让验证Agent自主选择波形信号、时间窗和迭代深度，在VerilogEval-V2上达到100% Pass@1（Claude Sonnet 4.5设置），为该基准首个满分系统。固定模型对比中，Claude Sonnet 4.0下VeriTrace为97.4%，作者复现的MAGE为92.3%，高5.1个百分点。消融显示，移除Inspector后为98.29% Pass@1，平均消耗26.7k token；加入后为100%，平均21.9k token，总token约下降18%，LLM调用次数从6.4次升至6.7次。论文单独分析的7道持续触发调试循环的难题中，组合逻辑和非FSM时序题两种设置均达100%，三道FSM题无Inspector时仅0%~33%，加入后均为100%；Prob155平均总token从619.5k降至110.3k。系统采用固定多Agent流程：Testbench Agent、RTL Agent、Simulation Judge、Inspector、RTL Debugger，patch仅在mismatch数下降时保留，否则回滚。文章也指出限制：仅在带golden testbench的单模块benchmark上评估，代码尚未公开，工业规模、存储开销和独立复现仍是空白。该工作将Agent能力从模型参数转向动作空间设计，是验证自动化领域值得关注的重要进展。
report_titles: 100% Pass@1 背后,VeriTrace 把调试方向盘交给 Agent

arxiv.title: VeriTrace: Human-Like Temporal Exploration Completes Agentic Action Space
arxiv.abstract: Large language models have shown promise for automated Verilog RTL generation, yet state-of-the-art multi-agent systems plateau at ~95% accuracy on standard benchmarks. We trace this ceiling to an incomplete debugging action space: existing systems restrict which signals the agent can inspect, which time windows it can query, or both, reducing debugging to pattern matching on a narrow, predetermined view of circuit behavior rather than hypothesis-driven root-cause analysis. We present VeriTrace, a multi-agent system whose Inspector agent operates over a complete debugging action space, with independent control over signal selection, time-window bounds, and iteration depth. This capability, which we term Agentic Temporal Exploration, enables the agent to form hypotheses about failure causes, query the waveform for evidence, and refine its understanding iteratively, mirroring the exploratory process of human verification engineers. VeriTrace achieves 100\% Pass@1 on VerilogEval-V2, the first system to attain perfect functional correctness on this benchmark. On a shared Claude Sonnet 4.0 backbone, VeriTrace outperforms the strongest reproduced baseline by +5.1%, demonstrating that debugging agency closes the final accuracy gap.

papers.title: LLM.int8(): 8-bit Matrix Multiplication for Transformers at Scale
papers.report_title: LLM.int8() 论文解读:为什么大模型的少数异常维度必须保留为 FP16?
papers.summary: 本文是对LLM.int8()论文的深度解读，原题为“8-bit Matrix Multiplication for Transformers at Scale”，由华盛顿大学与Facebook AI Research提出，发表于NeurIPS 2022。核心发现是Transformer扩展到约6.7B参数后，隐藏状态会出现系统化的大幅值异常特征：幅值可达普通特征数十倍、仅占约0.1%维度、集中在少数固定Hidden Dimension，普通Absmax或Vector-wise量化会因一个异常值拉宽缩放范围而失效；将异常维度置零会显著破坏Attention Top-1概率和困惑度。方法采用混合精度分解：超过99.9%的普通值走Vector-wise INT8主路径，异常维度（实验中通常不超过7个Hidden Dimension）拆出用FP16矩阵乘法，最后合并结果。论文在125M到175B模型上验证，LLM.int8()维持接近FP16的困惑度与Zero-shot精度；BLOOM-176B模型内存压缩约1.96倍。官方实现为bitsandbytes的Linear8bitLt。文章还对比SmoothQuant/GPTQ/AWQ，指出LLM.int8()并非纯INT8，小矩阵或小Batch下速度收益可能不稳定。
papers.paper_title: 8-bit Matrix Multiplication for Transformers at Scale
papers.authors: 华盛顿大学与Facebook AI Research
report_titles: LLM.int8() 论文解读:为什么大模型的少数异常维度必须保留为 FP16?

arxiv.title: LLM.int8(): 8-bit Matrix Multiplication for Transformers at Scale
arxiv.abstract: Large language models have been widely adopted but require significant GPU memory for inference. We develop a procedure for Int8 matrix multiplication for feed-forward and attention projection layers in transformers, which cut the memory needed for inference by half while retaining full precision performance. With our method, a 175B parameter 16/32-bit checkpoint can be loaded, converted to Int8, and used immediately without performance degradation. This is made possible by understanding and working around properties of highly systematic emergent features in transformer language models that dominate attention and transformer predictive performance. To cope with these features, we develop a two-part quantization procedure, LLM.int8(). We first use vector-wise quantization with separate normalization constants for each inner product in the matrix multiplication, to quantize most of the features. However, for the emergent outliers, we also include a new mixed-precision decomposition scheme, which isolates the outlier feature dimensions into a 16-bit matrix multiplication while still more than 99.9% of values are multiplied in 8-bit. Using LLM.int8(), we show empirically it is possible to perform inference in LLMs with up to 175B parameters without any performance degradation. This result makes such models much more accessible, for example making it possible to use OPT-175B/BLOOM o

papers.title: DeepSeek-V2: A Strong, Economical, and Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Language Model
papers.report_title: 大模型论文 · DeepSeek篇(2):DeepSeek-V2
papers.summary: 文章对DeepSeek-V2技术报告进行深度解读，聚焦其在MoE架构和推理成本上的突破。核心数据：总参数236B，激活参数21B，激活比例约8.9%；上下文长度128K；60层，隐藏维度5120，128个注意力头，KV压缩维度512；MoE层配置为2个共享专家+160个路由专家，每Token激活6个路由专家；预训练Token数8.1T。与V1相比，训练成本节省42.5%，KV Cache减少93.3%，最大生成吞吐量提升至5.76倍，KV缓存降至传统MHA的1/4至1/8。性能方面，基座模型MMLU 78.5（LLaMA3 70B为78.9），BBH 78.9持平，C-Eval 81.7（LLaMA3为67.5），CMMLU 84.0（LLaMA3为69.3），MATH 43.6（Mixtral 8x22B为42.5）；Chat RL版HumanEval达81.1。核心创新包括MLA低秩键值联合压缩与DeepSeekMoE细粒度专家分割、设备受限路由、辅助损失负载均衡。训练采用16路零气泡流水线并行、8路专家并行和ZeRO-1，不需张量并行。API定价输入1元、输出2元每百万Token，约为GPT-4价格的1%。文章认为MLA是开源模型中显著减小KV Cache的最佳方法之一，DeepSeek-V2从架构层面系统性解决了推理显存瓶颈。
report_titles: 大模型论文 · DeepSeek篇(2):DeepSeek-V2

arxiv.title: DeepSeek-V2: A Strong, Economical, and Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Language Model
arxiv.abstract: We present DeepSeek-V2, a strong Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model characterized by economical training and efficient inference. It comprises 236B total parameters, of which 21B are activated for each token, and supports a context length of 128K tokens. DeepSeek-V2 adopts innovative architectures including Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) and DeepSeekMoE. MLA guarantees efficient inference through significantly compressing the Key-Value (KV) cache into a latent vector, while DeepSeekMoE enables training strong models at an economical cost through sparse computation. Compared with DeepSeek 67B, DeepSeek-V2 achieves significantly stronger performance, and meanwhile saves 42.5% of training costs, reduces the KV cache by 93.3%, and boosts the maximum generation throughput to 5.76 times. We pretrain DeepSeek-V2 on a high-quality and multi-source corpus consisting of 8.1T tokens, and further perform Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL) to fully unlock its potential. Evaluation results show that, even with only 21B activated parameters, DeepSeek-V2 and its chat versions still achieve top-tier performance among open-source models.

papers.title: Multimodal Physical Fitness Monitoring (PFM) Framework Based on TimeMAE-PFM in Wearable Scenarios
papers.report_title: 免蒸馏,只改一个Loss!5行代码实现扩散模型4步生成
papers.summary: PFM主张扩散模型少步生成的关键不是蒸馏或模型结构，而是监督空间的选择。将Flow Matching训练中的MSE Loss替换为Perceptual Loss后，推理步数从35–50步降至4–8步，无需Teacher模型、分布蒸馏、轨迹蒸馏或额外训练目标，在文生图、图像编辑和视频生成上得到验证。论文提出空间分布距离R，衡量特征空间对off-manifold样本的惩罚能力；R越高，少步生成效果越好。FFHQ实验显示，DINO特征空间对1000张人脸求均值后仍能保留清晰结构和语义，而Pixel与VAE Latent空间均值退化为人脸模糊。消融实验表明，Huber Loss、Pixel空间监督、随机初始化ViT特征均因缺少高层语义信息而产生明显模糊；只有DINO、SigLIP等具有丰富语义信息的感知特征空间能稳定获得高质量少步生成。二维Spiral实验显示MSE监督下轨迹趋于数据分布中心，PFM能更快回到真实数据流形。
report_titles: 免蒸馏,只改一个Loss!5行代码实现扩散模型4步生成

arxiv.title: Multimodal Physical Fitness Monitoring (PFM) Framework Based on TimeMAE-PFM in Wearable Scenarios
arxiv.abstract: Physical function monitoring (PFM) plays a crucial role in healthcare especially for the elderly. Traditional assessment methods such as the Short Physical Performance Battery (SPPB) have failed to capture the full dynamic characteristics of physical function. Wearable sensors such as smart wristbands offer a promising solution to this issue. However, challenges exist, such as the computational complexity of machine learning methods and inadequate information capture. This paper proposes a multi-modal PFM framework based on an improved TimeMAE, which compresses time-series data into a low-dimensional latent space and integrates a self-enhanced attention module. This framework achieves effective monitoring of physical health, providing a solution for real-time and personalized assessment. The method is validated using the NHATS dataset, and the results demonstrate an accuracy of 70.6% and an AUC of 82.20%, surpassing other state-of-the-art time-series classification models.

papers.title: SKILL-KD: Contrastive Skill Distillation for LLM Agents
papers.report_title: 一个实用SKILL方案,阿里发布SKILL-KD
papers.summary: 阿里联合浙大提出一种名为SKILL-KD的实用知识蒸馏方案，核心思路是让小型模型通过“技能补丁”直接复用教师模型的操作经验，而无需修改学生模型本身。系统会对比教师与学生的操作记录，将差异转化为可执行的技能补丁；补丁必须先通过实操测试才会被加入外部技能库，测试失败则继续修改或丢弃。此外，系统会记录历史错误并用于防止补丁之间的冲突、累积冗余或覆盖旧策略。实验方面，在五个标准测试集上引入外挂技能库后，小模型平均分提升16至23分，且无论教师与学生是否属于同一模型家族，该方法均能生效。该方案提示，教师不需要逐步示范，而是可以通过定位“差距”实现高效技能迁移。原文未公开具体测试集名称、模型规模及补丁库的增长与合并细节，这些信息对于复现和评估其实际效果至关重要。
report_titles: 一个实用SKILL方案,阿里发布SKILL-KD

arxiv.title: SKILL-KD: Contrastive Skill Distillation for LLM Agents
arxiv.abstract: Skill-based prompting has become a practical mechanism for improving large language model (LLM) agents, yet existing skill acquisition methods often treat skills as experience summaries, memory entries, or direct summaries of successful demonstrations. This creates a mismatch for weaker student agents: when a student fails because it lacks task knowledge or operational strategy, its failed trajectory may not contain enough evidence to infer the missing behavior, while the teacher trajectory may be too implicit to be internalized as reusable guidance. We propose SKILL-KD, a contrastive skill distillation framework that treats skills as an explicit distillation medium between agents of different capabilities. Given a student failure and the teacher trajectory on the same task, SKILL-KD distills their actionable discrepancy into a textual skill patch, evaluates the patch by re-running the student, and iteratively refines the patch when the student still fails. To prevent repeated local updates from causing skill drift, SKILL-KD further maintains trace-linked edit histories and performs Drift-Aware Skill Consolidation, deciding whether each patch should add a new rule, delete or modify an existing rule, or be skipped. Across five agent benchmarks and two student settings, SKILL-KD consistently improves frozen student agents over fixed-model adaptation baselines.

papers.title: S$^{3}$G: Stock State Space Graph for Enhanced Stock Trend Prediction
papers.report_title: Paper Reading | S3G: 用于增强股票趋势预测的状态空间图
papers.summary: 本文解读S3G（State Space Graph，状态空间图）论文，用于增强股票趋势预测，链接为 https://arxiv.org/pdf/2603.24236。背景是传统GNN依赖静态行业图或逐时间步相似度图，忽略股票关系动态演化。S3G包含三部分：小波去噪网络（WDN）将金融序列分解为低频/高频，用可学习阈值软阈值抑制噪声；在每个时间patch用高斯核相似度构建依赖数据的图；再用状态空间模型刻画图的演化动态，最后经GNN聚合生成关系因子并预测下一日收益。训练采用MSE损失+排序损失双目标，缩放系数eta=5.0。实验基于沪深500（原文“历史沪深500”）日线数据，训练集2015-01-01至2020-12-31、验证集2021-01-01至2022-12-31、测试集2023-01-01至2024-12-31，使用Topk-Drop策略（选前10%股票，换手率3%，交易成本0.1%）。结果显示S3G在年化回报率和夏普比率上优于基线，但在AVol和MDD未取最佳，体现风险收益权衡；消融实验显示去掉WDN或SSGL模块性能显著下降。原文未给出具体年化回报率/夏普数值。
report_titles: Paper Reading | S3G: 用于增强股票趋势预测的状态空间图

arxiv.title: S$^{3}$G: Stock State Space Graph for Enhanced Stock Trend Prediction
arxiv.abstract: Stock trend prediction has attracted considerable attention for its potential to generate tangible investment returns. With the advent of deep learning in quantitative finance, researchers have increasingly recognized the importance of synergies between stocks, such as sector membership or upstream-downstream relationships, in accurately capturing market dynamics. However, previous work often relies on static industry graphs or constructs graphs at each time step via similarity measures, overlooking the fluid evolution of stock relationships. We observe that as companies interact competitively and cooperatively, their interdependencies change in a fine-grained, time-varying manner that cannot be fully captured by coarse, static connections or simple similarity-based snapshots. To address these challenges, we introduce the Stock State Space Graph (S$^{3}$G) framework for enhanced stock trend prediction. First, we apply wavelet transforms to denoise the inherently low signal-to-noise financial series and extract salient patterns. After that, we construct data-dependent graphs at each time point and employ state space models to characterize the evolutionary dynamics of these graphs. Finally, we perform a graph aggregation operation to obtain the predicted return. papers.title: DriveDNA: A Large-Scale Multimodal Naturalistic Driving Dataset and Benchmark for Driving Style Identification
papers.report_title: 南佛罗里达大学发布 DriveDNA:465 名司机 975 小时自然驾驶数据,把驾驶风格从「认车认路」中剥离出来
papers.summary: DriveDNA 是一个大规模多模态自然驾驶数据集与基准，包含 465 名司机、115 种车型、975 小时人工驾驶数据，来源为 2023 年 3 月至 2026 年 7 月通过 openpilot 挡风玻璃记录设备采集的真实日常驾驶，共 4,121 次成功解码驾驶、12,440 段纯人工驾驶片段。基准设计三个核心任务：少样本司机再识别、个性化行为预测、条件匹配比较，并用泄漏探针检查模型是否在“认车、认路”。主结果显示：学习型时序 Transformer 在未见司机再识别上 AUROC 0.935±0.005，自监督掩码重建 0.907、JEPA 0.878，经典描述符仅 0.707，零样本基础模型最低（0.596–0.636）。但在固定车型、场景、速度区间的条件匹配中，经典描述符从 0.707 跌至 0.550，视频探针从 0.937 跌至 0.675，学习表示仅从 0.935 微降到 0.811，说明前者大量依赖车/路信息。泄漏探针显示视频特征预测路线为随机水平 347 倍、预测车型 64 倍。跨车验证 AUROC 0.750（样本仅 7 名司机）。个性化预测中，FiLM 条件化在 5 秒跨度似然提升 +0.8±0.5%，CVAE +6.9±4.3 nats，但 RMSE 基本不变。评估协议还发现测试窗口随随机种子漂移会把个性化收益虚高到 +1.16 nats，固定窗口后仅 +0.068 nats。
report_titles: 南佛罗里达大学发布 DriveDNA:465 名司机 975 小时自然驾驶数据,把驾驶风格从「认车认路」中剥离出来

arxiv.title: DriveDNA: A Large-Scale Multimodal Naturalistic Driving Dataset and Benchmark for Driving Style Identification
arxiv.abstract: Driving style captures stable, driver-specific patterns in how a vehicle is driven. In naturalistic data, however, this signal is hard to isolate because drivers are observed in different vehicles, on different roads, and under different conditions, so models may mistake vehicle- or situation-specific regularities for driver-specific style. We introduce DriveDNA, a large-scale naturalistic dataset and benchmark for personalized driving-style modeling, comprising 4,121 drives from 465 drivers across 115 vehicle models and totaling 975 hours of human-controlled driving at 10 Hz with forward video, collected from community drivers in everyday use. DriveDNA defines driving style as a consistent, driver-specific behavioral pattern in how a vehicle moves under similar conditions. The benchmark evaluates this signal through three core tasks: few-shot driver re-identification, personalized behavior prediction, and condition-matched comparison, and provides behavioral annotations plus 276,248 rule-generated maneuver events across six classes with large-scale human auditing. We evaluate baselines spanning classical descriptors, supervised and self-supervised time-series encoders, multimodal fusion, probabilistic prediction, and zero-shot foundation models under a fixed multi-seed protocol. papers.title: Is Oracle Pruning the True Oracle?
papers.report_title: LLM 没有设计电路:ORACLE 的 104.4 倍怎么来的
papers.summary: ORACLE 将多目标强化学习与 LLM 动作屏蔽相结合，用于模拟电路参数自动优化。在两级运放和非传统三级 OTA 各 1,000 个目标规格问题上，报告满足 99.9% 目标规格，运行时间相对对比方法缩短 20.4～104.4 倍。学习阶段保留奖励向量，网络为每个动作预测向量 Q 值，偏好向量控制权衡；LLM（本地 Llama 3.2）只根据规格差距生成二值 action mask，屏蔽不利动作，不输出设计参数。两级运放上三个 ORACLE 版本按最佳方案口径通过率均 100%，归一化权重版本运行 2.4 分钟，余弦对齐+LLM 为 3.2 分钟，纯余弦对齐 6.5 分钟，对比方法 59.9～180 分钟。三级 OTA 上余弦对齐+LLM 通过率最高 98.4%，但其平均 FoM 7.15 低于纯余弦对齐的 8.13 和归一化权重版本的 13.30，运行时间 11.58 分钟也略长于纯余弦对齐的 10.54 分钟，说明 LLM mask 并非全胜。实验基于 45nm BSIM 仿真，无硅后结果；FoM 为作者定义，部分时间不能由仓内 CSV 直接推导。文章建议从搜索策略、设计质量、工程证据三层评估此类系统。
report_titles: LLM 没有设计电路:ORACLE 的 104.4 倍怎么来的

arxiv.title: Is Oracle Pruning the True Oracle?
arxiv.abstract: Oracle pruning, which selects unimportant weights by minimizing the pruned train loss, has served as the foundation for most neural network pruning methods for over thirty-five years, while few (if any) have thought about how much the foundation really holds. This paper, for the first time, attempts to systematically examine its validity on deep neural networks through empirical correlation analyses and provides meta-framework reflections on the field of neural network pruning. Specifically, this paper focuses on the pruning algorithms with three stages: training, pruning, and retraining. We analyze the correlation in model performance before and after the retraining stage. Extensive experiments (37K models are trained) across a wide spectrum of models (LeNet5, VGG, ResNets, ViT, MLLM) and datasets (MNIST, CIFAR10/CIFAR100, ImageNet-1K, MLLM data) are conducted. For large-scale experiments, we adopt approximate oracle pruning due to the prohibitive cost of exact oracle pruning. The results point to a counterintuitive conclusion: for deep learning models of nontrivial size (already at the scale of ResNet56 on CIFAR-10), pre-retraining performance is negligibly correlated with post-retraining performance. papers.title: VideoRAE: Taming Video Foundation Models for Generative Modeling via Representation Autoencoders
papers.report_title: 港中深团队发布 VideoRAE:把冻结的视频大模型变成生成编码器,UCF-101 生成指标 SOTA、收敛快约 5 倍
papers.summary: 香港中文大学（深圳）团队发布 VideoRAE，将冻结的视频基础模型（V-JEPA 2 / VideoMAEv2）直接用作视频生成编码器，通过轻量1D自注意力投影器压缩，再分别输出连续潜空间（给扩散Transformer）和离散token（给自回归模型），并用 REPA 表示对齐损失替代传统KL约束。重建方面，离散路线上 V-JEPA 2 版本在 UCF-101 的 rFVD 为13，明显好于 LARP 的35和 SweetTok 的20；连续路线用512×32紧凑瓶颈 rFVD 13-14，优于 LTX-VAE 的35，放大到1024×64后 VideoMAEv2 版 rFVD 可达5，接近 WAN2.1-VAE 的4。生成方面，自回归路线 gFVD 达40（V-JEPA 2）和45（VideoMAEv2），超过 SweetTok 1.9B 生成器+1280 token 的65；扩散路线512×32配置下 gFVD 为93/99，低于 LTX-VAE 的161、LeanVAE 的164和 WAN2.1-VAE 的126。收敛效率约5倍：LARP 潜空间训练2000 epoch 后 gFVD 才降到136，VideoRAE 只用400 epoch 就到139并继续下降。2B 规模文生视频实验中，VideoRAE 的 VBench 总分71.26、质量分76.09、语义分51.92，均高于 LTX-VAE 的69.35/74.03/50.67；主体一致性91.27对84.14，人类动作60.80对54.50。消融验证了多码本SimVQ、REPA和多尺度特征的必要性；论文注明训练数据仅 UCF-101/Kinetics-600，模型和代码尚未放出。
papers.authors: 香港中文大学（深圳）团队
report_titles: 港中深团队发布 VideoRAE:把冻结的视频大模型变成生成编码器,UCF-101 生成指标 SOTA、收敛快约 5 倍

arxiv.title: VideoRAE: Taming Video Foundation Models for Generative Modeling via Representation Autoencoders
arxiv.abstract: Video generation models typically rely on 3D-VAEs trained for pixel-level reconstruction, whose latent spaces may underrepresent semantic structure. We introduce VideoRAE, a representation autoencoder that converts features from a frozen video foundation model into compact, reconstruction-capable latents for video generation. A lightweight 1D self-attention projector compresses multi-scale hierarchical features, producing continuous latents for Diffusion Transformers and discrete tokens for autoregressive models through multi-codebook high-dimensional quantization. During decoding, a local-global representation alignment objective transfers semantic structure from the frozen encoder and removes the need for KL regularization. Comprehensive experiments show that VideoRAE achieves strong reconstruction in both continuous and discrete regimes. On UCF-101, autoregressive and diffusion generators built on VideoRAE achieve class-conditional gFVD scores of 40 and 93, respectively, while converging approximately five times faster than autoencoder baselines. In controlled 2B-parameter text-to-video experiments, replacing LTX-VAE with VideoRAE accelerates convergence and consistently improves VBench performance. These results establish frozen video foundation representations as compact, versatile, and generation-friendly video latents. Code and models are available at https://zhxie0117.g

papers.title: The Entropy Mechanism of Reinforcement Learning for Reasoning Language Models
papers.report_title: entropy论文最近好火心 大模型都学会磨洋工
papers.summary: 该文简介推理语言模型RL训练中的策略熵崩溃问题，论文题目为“The Entropy Mechanism of Reinforcement Learning for Reasoning Language Models”。作者建立熵H与下游性能R的变换方程R=-a·e^H+b，指出性能瓶颈源于熵耗尽；理论上推导出熵变化由动作概率与logits变化的协方差驱动，且在策略梯度类算法中该协方差与优势成正比；实证验证协方差项与熵差精确匹配，且训练过程中始终为正，从而解释了熵单调递减的机制。基于此提出Clip-Cov（裁剪高协方差token更新）与KL-Cov（对高协方差token施加KL惩罚）两种熵控制技术，鼓励探索、帮助策略逃离熵崩溃并提升下游性能。适合关注RL训练稳定性、推理模型探索机制和策略熵调控的研究人员。
papers.paper_title: The Entropy Mechanism of Reinforcement Learning for Reasoning Language Models

arxiv.title: The Entropy Mechanism of Reinforcement Learning for Reasoning Language Models
arxiv.abstract: This paper aims to overcome a major obstacle in scaling RL for reasoning with LLMs, namely the collapse of policy entropy. Such phenomenon is consistently observed across vast RL runs without entropy intervention, where the policy entropy dropped sharply at the early training stage, this diminished exploratory ability is always accompanied with the saturation of policy performance. In practice, we establish a transformation equation R=-a*e^H+b between entropy H and downstream performance R. This empirical law strongly indicates that, the policy performance is traded from policy entropy, thus bottlenecked by its exhaustion, and the ceiling is fully predictable H=0, R=-a+b. Our finding necessitates entropy management for continuous exploration toward scaling compute for RL. To this end, we investigate entropy dynamics both theoretically and empirically. Our derivation highlights that, the change in policy entropy is driven by the covariance between action probability and the change in logits, which is proportional to its advantage when using Policy Gradient-like algorithms. Empirical study shows that, the values of covariance term and entropy differences matched exactly, supporting the theoretical conclusion. papers.title: DeepSeek LLM: Scaling Open-Source Language Models with Longtermism
papers.report_title: 大模型论文 · DeepSeek篇(1):DeepSeek LLM(V1)
papers.summary: 文章对DeepSeek LLM（V1）技术报告进行深度拆解，这是DeepSeek系列的第一代模型。核心数据：模型发布7B与67B两个版本，均为Decoder-only架构，预训练使用2万亿Token中英双语数据；67B版95层、维度8192、64注意力头，使用8个GQA KV头，KV Cache较标准MHA压缩8倍；7B版30层、维度4096、32头，仍为MHA。上下文长度4096，词表102,400。训练流程包含约150万条中文指令SFT，并使用DPO替代传统RLHF。性能上，67B版本在代码、数学推理等维度全面超越LLaMA-2 70B，中文CLUE得分82.3，单卡A100上达到120 tokens/s（输入长度2048）。文章还给出推测训练成本约120万美元，并指出其低于同等规模模型的常规开销。技术要点包括Pre-RMSNorm、SwiGLU、RoPE、GQA和BBPE分词；其中GQA仅用于67B以平衡表达能力和KV Cache开销，是值得关注的工程决策。文章最后评价该模型验证了“低成本Scaling”路线，并为DeepSeek后续V2/V3/R1在Scaling Laws、数据配方和成本控制方面奠定基础。
report_titles: 大模型论文 · DeepSeek篇(1):DeepSeek LLM(V1)

arxiv.title: DeepSeek LLM: Scaling Open-Source Language Models with Longtermism
arxiv.abstract: The rapid development of open-source large language models (LLMs) has been truly remarkable. However, the scaling law described in previous literature presents varying conclusions, which casts a dark cloud over scaling LLMs. We delve into the study of scaling laws and present our distinctive findings that facilitate scaling of large scale models in two commonly used open-source configurations, 7B and 67B. Guided by the scaling laws, we introduce DeepSeek LLM, a project dedicated to advancing open-source language models with a long-term perspective. To support the pre-training phase, we have developed a dataset that currently consists of 2 trillion tokens and is continuously expanding. We further conduct supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) on DeepSeek LLM Base models, resulting in the creation of DeepSeek Chat models. Our evaluation results demonstrate that DeepSeek LLM 67B surpasses LLaMA-2 70B on various benchmarks, particularly in the domains of code, mathematics, and reasoning. Furthermore, open-ended evaluations reveal that DeepSeek LLM 67B Chat exhibits superior performance compared to GPT-3.5.

papers.title: DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report
papers.report_title: 大模型论文 · DeepSeek篇(3):DeepSeek-V3
papers.summary: 本文是DeepSeek-V3技术报告的深度解读。核心数据：总参数671B、激活参数37B（激活比例约5.5%），预训练数据14.8T tokens，仅用2048块H800训练约55天，合计2.788M H800 GPU小时，训练成本557.6万美元，全程无不可恢复损失激增或回滚。技术亮点包括：MLA将KV缓存压至每token约70KB（传统方法的1/7到1/4）；DeepSeekMoE无辅助损失负载均衡；MTP多Token预测使生成速度提升1.8倍；FP8混合精度训练将成本降低50%，精度损失控制在0.25%以下；DualPipe双向流水线并行配合多层胖树网络实现近线性扩展。性能方面，编程任务通过率82%，每千次请求成本$0.21，对比Claude Sonnet的87%和$9.00，成本仅为1/43；复杂证明完成率83%；LeetCode中等难度算法题首次通过率82%，较上一代提升17个百分点。文章还指出557.6万美元仅为正式训练成本，不包括前期研究、数据清洗、消融实验等隐性成本，并强调训练稳定性、无辅助损失负载均衡及系统性工程创新的价值。适合关注低成本大模型训练和MoE架构的研究人员阅读。
report_titles: 大模型论文 · DeepSeek篇(3):DeepSeek-V3

arxiv.title: DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report
arxiv.abstract: We present DeepSeek-V3, a strong Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model with 671B total parameters with 37B activated for each token. To achieve efficient inference and cost-effective training, DeepSeek-V3 adopts Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) and DeepSeekMoE architectures, which were thoroughly validated in DeepSeek-V2. Furthermore, DeepSeek-V3 pioneers an auxiliary-loss-free strategy for load balancing and sets a multi-token prediction training objective for stronger performance. We pre-train DeepSeek-V3 on 14.8 trillion diverse and high-quality tokens, followed by Supervised Fine-Tuning and Reinforcement Learning stages to fully harness its capabilities. Comprehensive evaluations reveal that DeepSeek-V3 outperforms other open-source models and achieves performance comparable to leading closed-source models. Despite its excellent performance, DeepSeek-V3 requires only 2.788M H800 GPU hours for its full training. In addition, its training process is remarkably stable. Throughout the entire training process, we did not experience any irrecoverable loss spikes or perform any rollbacks. The model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3.

papers.title: DeepSeek-R1 Thoughtology: Let's think about LLM Reasoning
papers.report_title: 大模型论文 · DeepSeek篇(4):DeepSeek-R1
papers.summary: 本文深度解读DeepSeek-R1及其Nature封面论文。R1基于DeepSeek-V3-Base（671B MoE），仅用512张H800训练约80小时，成本约29.4万美元，验证纯强化学习可激发推理能力。核心创新：R1-Zero完全跳过SFT，采用GRPO和基于答案正确性的规则奖励，自发涌现自我反思、验证、替代方案探索等行为，并出现Aha Moment，反思性词汇出现次数较初期增长约5-7倍；R1则引入冷启动SFT、推理导向RL、拒绝采样再微调、对齐RL四步训练，解决可读性和语言混用问题。性能：AIME数学竞赛86.7%，Codeforces 96.3百分位，MMLU/MMLU-Pro/GPQA Diamond整体超越V3，SWE Verified与o1-1217相当；ChatbotArena风格控制维度与o1、Gemini-Exp-1206并列第一。论文经历22页预印本→Nature封面→86页完整版，新增训练管线拆解、20+基准数据、10页安全性报告（10.6万条提示数据集），并披露GRPO超参数和蒸馏Qwen/Llama小模型细节。文章强调R1证明推理能力可通过RL自举获取，成本较GPT-4低数个数数量级，是开源推理模型的重要里程碑。
report_titles: 大模型论文 · DeepSeek篇(4):DeepSeek-R1

arxiv.title: DeepSeek-R1 Thoughtology: Let's think about LLM Reasoning
arxiv.abstract: Large Reasoning Models like DeepSeek-R1 mark a fundamental shift in how LLMs approach complex problems. Instead of directly producing an answer for a given input, DeepSeek-R1 creates detailed multi-step reasoning chains, seemingly "thinking" about a problem before providing an answer. This reasoning process is publicly available to the user, creating endless opportunities for studying the reasoning behaviour of the model and opening up the field of Thoughtology. Starting from a taxonomy of DeepSeek-R1's basic building blocks of reasoning, our analyses on DeepSeek-R1 investigate the impact and controllability of thought length, management of long or confusing contexts, cultural and safety concerns, and the status of DeepSeek-R1 vis-à-vis cognitive phenomena, such as human-like language processing and world modelling. Our findings paint a nuanced picture. Notably, we show DeepSeek-R1 has a 'sweet spot' of reasoning, where extra inference time can impair model performance. Furthermore, we find a tendency for DeepSeek-R1 to persistently ruminate on previously explored problem formulations, obstructing further exploration. We also note strong safety vulnerabilities of DeepSeek-R1 compared to its non-reasoning counterpart, which can also compromise safety-aligned LLMs.

papers.title: Talking like Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs)
papers.report_title: 论文解读|让大模型帮你“看懂”P&ID
papers.summary: 该文解读代尔夫特理工大学研究团队发表于ESCAPE35的论文“Talking like Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs)”。文章针对流程工业P&ID图纸人工查阅效率低、易遗漏的问题，提出将DEXPI格式智能P&ID通过pyDEXPI工具解析为知识图谱，再挂载到大语言模型上构建可对话的RAG系统。关键优化在于生成“高维知识图谱”：原始样例包含212个节点、405个关系，直接输入LLM消耗约67,000 Token；经剪枝、压缩、去冗后节点降至53个、关系减至57条，Token消耗降至约9,000，效率提升近7倍。实验使用GPT-4o、Claude 3.5等不同规模模型进行三类测试：流程描述准确率平均比完整图谱提升20%；Claude Sonnet 3.5能精准找出全部11个阀门并跨节点推理出执行机构故障安全动作；在工艺安全建议测试中，模型能指出安全阀设定压力并建议增加脉动阻尼器、热膨胀保护等。文章同时指出AI仍存在漏看设备、建议不够精确等问题，未来将优化检索策略、精细化图谱模式并建立严格评估标准。该研究展示了LLM在图谱约束下进行专业问答的潜力，是AI辅助HAZOP分析、智能图纸纠错的基础。

arxiv.title: Talking like Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs)
arxiv.abstract: We propose a methodology that allows communication with Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs) using natural language. In particular, we represent P&IDs through the DEXPI data model as labeled property graphs and integrate them with Large Language Models (LLMs). The approach consists of three main parts: 1) P&IDs are cast into a graph representation from the DEXPI format using our pyDEXPI Python package. 2) A tool for generating P&ID knowledge graphs from pyDEXPI. 3) Integration of the P&ID knowledge graph to LLMs using graph-based retrieval augmented generation (graph-RAG). This approach allows users to communicate with P&IDs using natural language. It extends LLM's ability to retrieve contextual data from P&IDs and mitigate hallucinations. Leveraging the LLM's large corpus, the model is also able to interpret process information in PIDs, which could help engineers in their daily tasks. In the future, this work will also open up opportunities in the context of other generative Artificial Intelligence (genAI) solutions on P&IDs, and AI-assisted HAZOP studies.

papers.title: AISPA: User-Centric System Prompt Auditing for Large Language Model Applications
papers.report_title: 斯坦福团队发布 AISPA:审计88款AI产品系统提示词,近四成含损害用户利益的指令
papers.summary: AISPA（AI System Prompt Assurance）是面向大模型应用系统提示词的第三方审计框架，提出八个用户利益维度：身份透明、信息真实性、隐私、工具与动作安全、用户自主与防操控、不安全请求处理、伤害预防、公平中立。语料来自六个公开/泄露系统提示词仓库，共审计 88 款商业 AI 产品，切出 1,818 条值得审计的指令片段，得到 2,420 条维度打分记录，其中 +1 保护性记录 2,346 条、-1 有问题记录 74 条，另有 29 个灰色片段。关键发现：98.9% 的产品（87/88）至少含一条保护性指令，但只有 23.9%（21/88）在八个维度上均有保护性覆盖；38.6%（34/88）的产品至少含一条有问题指令。维度覆盖不均衡：信息真实性、用户自主出现在 90% 以上产品，而不安全请求处理和隐私仅约 60%；有问题指令最高发维度是用户自主（18.2%）和信息真实性（14.8%）。时间趋势显示平均提示词长度从约 9K 字符升至 30K+，平均保护性指令从 15.0 升至 38.4；有问题产品占比在 2025 年 Q1 达 67%、Q3 降至 19%、Q4 回到 29%。前沿聊天产品线中，Claude 3.5 Sonnet 到 Claude Opus 4.6 保护性条目从 26 涨到 81，GPT-4o 到 GPT-5.2 Thinking 从 25 涨到 83，Grok-1 到 Grok-4.2 从 5 涨到 21。标注协议中试标一致率 0.933，判“有问题”须三位专家一致同意。
report_titles: 斯坦福团队发布 AISPA:审计88款AI产品系统提示词,近四成含损害用户利益的指令

arxiv.title: AISPA: User-Centric System Prompt Auditing for Large Language Model Applications
arxiv.abstract: System prompts are instructions configured by developers to govern the behaviors of foundation models in AI applications. They are used throughout commercial AI products, but are rarely disclosed to the public or regulators, creating a serious trust and accountability gap in the wide deployment of AI systems. In this paper, we introduce Artificial Intelligence System Prompt Assurance (AISPA), a user-centric framework for systematically auditing system prompts in AI systems. AISPA examines specific parts of a system prompt and evaluates them along eight dimensions that matter to users. We then use this framework to review 3,249 instructions from system prompts in 88 commercial AI products, classifying each instruction as either protective (of users) or problematic. Our audit surfaces four core findings. First, system prompt design varies substantially across products and developers, with some organizations averaging over 60 protective instructions per product while others average fewer than 5. Second, protective instructions are widely adopted but shallow in scope: 98.9% of products contain at least one, yet only 24% cover all eight dimensions of the AISPA taxonomy. Third, system prompts have grown steadily longer and more protective of users, suggesting that user protection is becoming a more visible concern in commercial prompt design. papers.title: SkillJack: Persistent Skill Backdoors in Self-Evolving Agents
papers.report_title: 腾讯朱雀实验室发布 SkillJack:经验投毒学成技能后骗过安全检测,自进化Agent需要新的安全策略
papers.summary: 腾讯朱雀实验室提出 SkillJack，研究自进化 Agent 将投毒经验自动提炼为可复用 skill 后形成的持久后门。攻击者不直接改 skill 库或抽取代码，只污染经验层；系统抽取过程把恶意轨迹编译成独立 skill，导致检测器被“洗白”、影响从临时记录跨层升级到 skill 库、删除源记录后攻击仍可触发。评测基于 SkillX 与 Anything2Skill（A2S）两条实现，使用 150 条轨迹（65 条功能化包装、65 条直接恶意、20 条干净），统一用 DeepSeek-v4-flash 抽取/检索/判定。关键数字：SkillX 功能化包装原始轨迹 LLM 检出率 98.5%，抽成 skill 后仅 11.4%；模式匹配从 44.6% 降至 11.0%。A2S DOC 模式对直接恶意抽取率为 0，对功能化包装抽取率为 41.5%，抽出后检出率从 100% 降至 44.4%。持久性实验中，直接上下文触发率 68.0%，skill 路径 40.0%；删除源轨迹后仍有 32.0% 触发，即 skill 路径触发中约 80% 存活。下游检索中 SkillX 攻击向触发 56.2%、干净任务误触发 20.0%；A2S DOC 攻击向 89.2%、干净任务检索到恶意 skill 达 95.0%。防御实验中，单纯审查 D1 或运行时拦截 D2 有效，但 D1+D2 叠加反而变差（SkillX 触发率 6.7%/0.0%/13.3%），提示层叠防御需联合设计。作者强调实验为受控合成数据，触发率不等于实网攻破率。
report_titles: 腾讯朱雀实验室发布 SkillJack:经验投毒学成技能后骗过安全检测,自进化Agent需要新的安全策略

arxiv.title: SkillJack: Persistent Skill Backdoors in Self-Evolving Agents
arxiv.abstract: Self-evolving agents increasingly convert interaction histories into reusable skills that persist beyond individual tasks. While prior work studies memory and retrieval poisoning, such attacks only affect agents when poisoned records are retrieved as context. We uncover a new and more fundamental risk: poisoned experiences can be transformed by the agent itself into durable behavioral artifacts. We present \textbf{SkillJack}, the first attack that exploits the experience-to-skill pipeline of self-evolving agents. Instead of directly manipulating runtime context, SkillJack hijacks the agent's own learning process to implant malicious behaviors into its reusable skill repertoire. We identify three key properties of this transformation: \emph{sanitization whitewashing}, where malicious intent is obscured during skill extraction; \emph{cross-layer promotion}, where transient experiences become persistent capabilities; and \emph{persistence isolation}, where the attack survives removal of its original source records. We evaluate SkillJack on two representative systems, SkillX and Anything2Skill, using a shared dataset of 150 trajectories across four policy-risk categories. papers.title: LongHorizon-Harness: Advancing Long-Horizon Agents for Real-World Tasks
papers.report_title: 阿里DreamX发布 LongHorizon-Harness:同模型下长任务完成率提升约56%
papers.summary: 阿里 DreamX 发布 LongHorizon-Harness，核心是不换模型，将长任务智能体从“单条越跑越长的对话”重构为“管理-执行-审计（MEA）”循环：Manager 只看目标/状态/审计摘要，Executor 在每个全新上下文中执行当前子任务，Auditor 只读检查环境完成证据并更新结构化任务状态；跨轮只传已核验状态，避免错误累积、上下文腐蚀、进度丢失和“看起来完成但未完成”。主评估用同一模型和后端对比：WeaveBench 上 Claude Code 基线 PassRate 51.8%，加 LongHorizon-Harness 后 80.7%，相对提升约 56%；OSWorld 2.0 的 Qwen 3.7-Plus Binary 从 2.8% 提到 8.3%（约 3 倍），Partial 从 21.5 提到 35.2；Terminal-Bench 2.1 成功率从 69.7% 提到 77.2%，说明纯命令行长流程也能受益。成本方面，OSWorld 平均输出 token 从 28.9K 增至 104K，增量主要来自 Auditor 独立核验；Terminal-Bench 2.1 上成功率提升同时总 token 反而下降。论文明确边界：审计能发现单步能力（视觉定位、数学、算法）不足，但不能替代模型能力；若任务判定依赖隐藏阈值或外部规则，流程再规范也可能“严谨地做错”。对 Agent 团队的启发是任务状态外置、完成判定与执行解耦、跨轮只传已验证事实。
report_titles: 阿里DreamX发布 LongHorizon-Harness:同模型下长任务完成率提升约56%

arxiv.title: LongHorizon-Harness: Advancing Long-Horizon Agents for Real-World Tasks
arxiv.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly undertake long-horizon tasks that require sustained reasoning, tool use, and revision across many interdependent steps. However, existing agent harnesses maintain task execution, task state, and completion assessment within a growing context, making the state difficult to track and allowing incorrect self-assessments to propagate into later decisions. We reformulate long-horizon execution as a task-state management problem and propose LongHorizon-Harness, which maintains the task state explicitly outside execution and updates it only with facts independently verified from the environment. Its Manage-Execute-Audit(MEA) loop uses a manager to maintain the task state and determine the next subtask, a fresh-context executor to perform it, and a read-only auditor to verify the resulting environment state before the next round. A lightweight AgentAdapter supports interchangeable model and harness backends without modifying their native agent loops. LongHorizon-Harness improves Qwen~3.7-Plus from 51.8% to 80.7% on WeaveBench, from 69.7% to 77.2% on Terminal-Bench~2.1, and from 2.8% to 8.3% on OSWorld~2.0. It also raises Claude Opus~4.7 from 20.0% to 34.3% on an OSWorld2.0 subset, demonstrating consistent gains across models, harnesses, and interaction domains.

papers.title: OpenScholar: Synthesizing Scientific Literature with Retrieval-augmented LMs
papers.report_title: Nature新作:别再让大模型凭空编论文,OpenScholar把综述写到可追溯
papers.summary: 本文介绍OpenScholar系统，针对科研文献综合中引用不可靠、覆盖不足的问题，将科学文献综合拆解为可检查的证据链。系统基于4500万篇开放获取论文构建数据仓库，结合专用检索、重排、带引用生成和自反馈推理循环。在ScholarQABench基准（2967个专家问题、208个长答案，覆盖CS/物理/神经科学/生物医学）上，OpenScholar-8B在多论文综合任务正确性比GPT-4o高6.1%、比PaperQA2高5.5%；OpenScholar-GPT-4o使GPT-4o正确性提高12%。引用幻觉方面，GPT-4o在CS问题幻觉引用约78.7%，生物医学约94.8%，Llama 3.1部分设置接近98%。博士级专家评估显示OpenScholar-GPT-4o和8B在覆盖度、组织性上更受偏好。文章也讨论了局限：依赖开放语料、引用准确不等于推理正确、专家评估范围有限。作者认为RAG下一阶段竞争点在证据管理，为高信任场景AI提供可审计证据链方向。论文发表于Nature Vol.650, 26 February 2026。
report_titles: Nature新作:别再让大模型凭空编论文,OpenScholar把综述写到可追溯

arxiv.title: OpenScholar: Synthesizing Scientific Literature with Retrieval-augmented LMs
arxiv.abstract: Scientific progress depends on researchers' ability to synthesize the growing body of literature. Can large language models (LMs) assist scientists in this task? We introduce OpenScholar, a specialized retrieval-augmented LM that answers scientific queries by identifying relevant passages from 45 million open-access papers and synthesizing citation-backed responses. To evaluate OpenScholar, we develop ScholarQABench, the first large-scale multi-domain benchmark for literature search, comprising 2,967 expert-written queries and 208 long-form answers across computer science, physics, neuroscience, and biomedicine. On ScholarQABench, OpenScholar-8B outperforms GPT-4o by 5% and PaperQA2 by 7% in correctness, despite being a smaller, open model. While GPT4o hallucinates citations 78 to 90% of the time, OpenScholar achieves citation accuracy on par with human experts. OpenScholar's datastore, retriever, and self-feedback inference loop also improves off-the-shelf LMs: for instance, OpenScholar-GPT4o improves GPT-4o's correctness by 12%. In human evaluations, experts preferred OpenScholar-8B and OpenScholar-GPT4o responses over expert-written ones 51% and 70% of the time, respectively, compared to GPT4o's 32%. We open-source all of our code, models, datastore, data and a public demo.

papers.title: AgentOPSD: Recursive Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.report_title: 美团LongCat发布 AgentOPSD:成功率较 GRPO 提升8%,任务越长优势越大
papers.summary: 清华、浙大与美团联合提出 AgentOPSD，针对长程多轮智能体强化学习中稀疏/延迟奖励导致逐 token 均匀广播失真的问题，通过训练时注入 skill 的 teacher 视角形成逐 token 自蒸馏信号，再聚合成轮次级证据，用递归信念更新将证据转化为逐轮信用，最后有界重塑 GRPO 轨迹级优势；推理时不依赖 skill，也不训练 critic。在 ALFWorld/WebShop/Search-QA 三类环境（Qwen2.5-3B/7B，8×H800）上，AgentOPSD 多数指标最优或次优：ALFWorld 7B 成功率 89.1%，比 GRPO 的 81.2% 高约 8 个百分点，也超过最强自蒸馏基线 SDAR 的 85.9%；3B 为 84.4% vs 75.0%。WebShop 3B Score 从 79.8 提至 90.4，7B 为 90.2 vs 80.9；Search-QA 3B 平均准确率 46.7% vs 36.4%，7B 49.2% vs 42.0%。跨两种规模 8 组对比中，AgentOPSD 全面超过多数自蒸馏基线，6/8 超过 SDAR。任务长度敏感性上，每多一轮成功率损失仅 0.54 个百分点，约为 GRPO（2.91）的 1/5、RLSD（3.59）的 1/7。消融显示逐 token 累积（85.9）、去掉信念修正（82.8）、丢掉符号（80.5）、去掉先验（78.9）均低于完整方法 89.1%。
papers.authors: 清华大学、浙江大学、美团
report_titles: 美团LongCat发布 AgentOPSD:成功率较 GRPO 提升8%,任务越长优势越大

arxiv.title: AgentOPSD: Recursive Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
arxiv.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) with verifiable rewards constructs trajectory-level advantage estimates, yet it often fails to credit the few pivotal decisions that determine outcomes in long-horizon, multi-turn agentic tasks. Recent work introduces privileged self-distillation for credit assignment, providing denser supervision, but it remains unclear how such local signals should represent sequential credit. We propose AgentOPSD, a critic-free, recursive method for turn-level credit assignment in agentic reinforcement learning. AgentOPSD aggregates token-level teacher-student log-probability gaps into turn-level evidence and recursively updates a Bayesian belief state in log-odds space. This yields a principled reweighting scheme that converts sparse outcome supervision into turn-level credit signals and identifies pivotal turns through the marginal belief revision between consecutive states. The method is fully compatible with standard policy optimization and requires neither an additional critic nor extra rollouts. We evaluate AgentOPSD on ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-QA using Qwen2.5 models at two scales (3B and 7B). AgentOPSD outperforms GRPO and strong self-distillation baselines, achieving 89.1% success on ALFWorld with Qwen2.5-7B. Ablation studies attribute the gains to turn-level aggregation and history-dependent recursive belief updates.

papers.title: Psyche-R1: Towards Reliable Psychological LLMs through Unified Empathy, Expertise, and Reasoning
papers.report_title: 论文速递丨ACL 2026:心理大模型不能只会安慰:Psyche-R1让AI更懂心理、更会推理
papers.summary: 本文为ACL 2026论文速递，介绍Psyche-R1，首个融合共情、领域知识与推理能力的中文心理大模型。针对心理场景仅会共情不够的问题，作者构建了高质量数据合成管道：整合约21万条心理学问答，经MinHash LSH去重、LLM质量筛选和人工半自动校验后保留约9万条，再通过思维链提示和迭代式提示-推理优化生成7.5万条带详细推理过程的心理推理数据；同时优化7.3万条真实心理对话，注入共情表达与具体指导。训练采用两阶段策略：第一阶段用非挑战性问答和共情对话对Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct进行SFT，提升共情与知识能力；第二阶段用多模型选择策略筛出的1.9万个挑战性样本进行GRPO强化学习，提升复杂场景推理能力。在PCEB国家心理咨询师考试基准及另一基准上，7B参数的Psyche-R1显著优于同规模模型，并在多项指标上与671B DeepSeek-R1相当。消融实验证明SFT与GRPO结合至关重要，单一数据来源提升有限，两者结合效果更佳。错误分析显示模型在挑战性题目上提升更显著。论文与模型已开源（GitHub/HuggingFace）。该工作为心理大模型从“会安慰”走向“懂心理、会推理”提供了可复现的技术方案。
report_titles: 论文速递丨ACL 2026:心理大模型不能只会安慰:Psyche-R1让AI更懂心理、更会推理

arxiv.title: Psyche-R1: Towards Reliable Psychological LLMs through Unified Empathy, Expertise, and Reasoning
arxiv.abstract: Amidst a shortage of qualified mental health professionals, the integration of large language models (LLMs) into psychological applications offers a promising way to alleviate the growing burden of mental health disorders. Recent reasoning-augmented LLMs have achieved remarkable performance in mathematics and programming, while research in the psychological domain has predominantly emphasized emotional support and empathetic dialogue, with limited attention to reasoning mechanisms that are beneficial to generating accurate responses. Therefore, in this paper, we propose \logopsyche\textit{Psyche-R1}, the first Chinese psychological LLM that jointly integrates empathy, psychological expertise, and reasoning, built upon a novel data curation pipeline. Specifically, we design a comprehensive data synthesis pipeline that produces over 75k high-quality psychological questions paired with detailed rationales, generated through an iterative prompt-rationale optimization procedure, along with 73k empathetic dialogues. Subsequently, we employ a hybrid training strategy wherein challenging samples are identified through a multi-LLM cross-selection strategy for group relative policy optimization (GRPO) to improve reasoning ability, while the remaining data are used for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to enhance empathetic response generation and psychological domain knowledge. arxiv.title: Self-Play Meets Skill Evolution: Self-Evolving Search Agents that Pose, Solve, and Remember
arxiv.abstract: Self-play agents can generate training problems without questions from target benchmarks, but their curricula lack persistent state: failures affect gradients yet do not explicitly shape future practice. External skill memories preserve procedural experience but are typically learned from fixed task distributions. We introduce \textbf{SESA} (Self-Evolving Skill-Augmented Agent), which makes procedural memory an evolving state of tool-augmented search self-play. A challenger poses problems, while a separately parameterized solver alone retrieves skills. Informative failures are distilled into reusable skills and written back to memory. The updated memory changes solver behavior and success, which changes the challenger's reward and the distribution of future problems; the resulting frontier produces new failures that rewrite memory. This bidirectional loop makes task generation and skill memory co-evolve. Because retrieved skills shape on-policy training trajectories, their benefits can enter the model parameters as well as remain in the external bank, enabling memory-free deployment and optional inference-time retrieval. Across seven open-domain and multi-hop question-answering benchmarks, SESA improves average accuracy over SSP by 1.2--3.2 points across multiple backbones and surpasses the skill-augmented SkillRL baseline by 0.9 points under a unified evaluation protocol. papers.report_title: 一个RAG突破方案,清华DocTrace爆发
papers.summary: 本文介绍百度联合清华提出的DocTrace，将长文档视觉问答（LongDocVQA）重构为显式证据图推理问题。方法上分三阶段：先低分辨率下采样做证据页定位，再用PaddleOCR-VL-1.5做结构化文档解析，最后基于结构化证据池构建证据图G=(V,E)，先建图再生成答案，实现节点级证据溯源。训练数据由Gemini 3.1 Pro自动生成grounded证据页与证据图，GPT-5.5独立验证充分性与逻辑一致性，并用任务特定GRPO对齐，设置定位奖励（距离感知软Fβ）、图忠实度奖励（四维：grounding/完整性/结构/拓扑）和答案正确性奖励。实验数据显示：在MMLongBench-Doc上达到52.9，较Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct提升14.4，且超GPT-4.1（45.6）7.3；LongDocURL为56.4（+11.3）；SlideVQA为85.1（+11.7）。证据图质量上，证据grounding达99.5%、图完整性99.6%；反事实评估表明mask被引证据后答案翻转82.8%，未被引仅9.6%，说明图捕获了真正支持预测的证据。鲁棒性方面，检索覆盖率从70.6降至50.2时条件accuracy基本不变；消融显示图推理主要贡献跨页多跳，去图推理单页从47.1降至44.6。论文链接已提供，值得关注其可追溯推理与长文档扩展性设计。

arxiv.title: DocTrace: Towards Traceable Long Document VQA via Hierarchical Evidence Graph Reasoning
arxiv.abstract: Long Document Visual Question Answering (LongDocVQA) requires Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to locate, integrate, and reason over heterogeneous document elements distributed across multiple pages. Existing approaches, including end-to-end MLLMs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, and document agents, often lack explicit mechanisms to represent and verify how grounded evidence is progressively composed during reasoning, limiting both answer accuracy and traceability. In this paper, we cast LongDocVQA as an explicit evidence graph reasoning problem rather than implicit answer prediction. To this end, we propose DocTrace, a hierarchical framework that progressively performs evidence localization, structured document parsing, and evidence graph reasoning to enable explicit evidence provenance. To effectively learn these capabilities, we develop a two-stage training framework: joint Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) first initializes evidence localization and graph reasoning abilities, followed by task-specific Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with dedicated rewards to further optimize these capabilities. papers.report_title: 上海交大&上海AI Lab开源DAPD:用双锚定对齐信息路径,缓解特权幻觉,六任务均分相对OPSD+2.00
papers.summary: 论文提出 DAPD（Dual-Anchored Policy Distillation），针对 on-policy 自蒸馏中教师模型见过参考答案、学生模型部署时看不到参考答案所导致的“特权幻觉”问题，用双路径锚定与双来源锚定缓解。核心思路是在“有/无参考答案”两种信息条件下分别对齐行为，并让参考答案与模型自采样互相指导。实验基于 LoRA 微调 Qwen3 系列，覆盖 AIME24/AIME25/HMMT25、LCB v5、BFCL v3、IFBench 六项任务：Qwen3-4B 平均 57.34，相对 OPSD +2.00；AIME25 达 72.22（+4.44），HMMT25 为 46.39（+3.06），推理侧增益最大。规模曲线显示 OPSD 相对 Base 的增益从 1.7B 的约 +5.19 降至 8B–32B 的约 +0.28，而 DAPD 在 8B/14B/32B 仍有 +2.41/+2.13/+3.06。训练动态上，OPSD 的错误断言从每万次约 13 升至约 37，AIME/HMMT Avg@12 从 59.56 跌至 53.24；加入特权锚后后期错误断言降低约 45%，Avg@12 提升 6.22；完整 DAPD 在训练后期相对 OPSD 将错误断言再压低约 73%。消融显示参考单路 63.89、采样单路 65.09、两者结合 65.28；无参考双采样变体在 4B/8B 各 +2.41，再加校验后最高到 66.11/67.59。作者也指出训练算力开销更高、权重需按规模重标定等限制。
