arxiv.title: DAPD: Dual-Anchored Policy Distillation
arxiv.abstract: On-policy (self) distillation (OPSD) is increasingly adopted for language-model post-training. It strengthens the teacher with privileged information but can induce a privilege illusion: the student learns privilege-dependent behavior it cannot reproduce from its inference-time context, yet behaves as if the training-time privileged information remained available, ultimately degrading performance. In this paper, we identify information asymmetry between the privileged teacher and the student at inference as the root cause of this failure in OPSD. To resolve this asymmetry, we propose Dual-Anchored Policy Distillation (DAPD), a unified framework with two levels of anchoring. Dual-Path Anchoring (DPA) introduces a self-conditioned bridge and aligns reference and rollout behavior along two matched-information paths, preventing privilege-dependent behavior from being transferred to the inference-time student. Dual-Source Anchoring (DSA) applies these paths in both reference-to-rollout and rollout-to-reference directions, reducing reliance on privileged reference guidance while preserving correctness supervision. Extensive experiments show that DAPD significantly alleviates privilege illusion, outperforming OPSD on Qwen3-4B by +2.00 points on average across tasks. Notably, its gains persist across scales, reaching +2.69 at 4B and +2.78 at 32B.

papers.title: What Evidence Do Language Models Find Convincing?
papers.report_title: GEO论文解读:真正说服大模型的是“贴题”
papers.summary: 本文解读论文《What Evidence Do Language Models Find Convincing?》。研究构建ConflictingQA，让模型在两段冲突网页证据中选边，并以真实回答时的段落胜率衡量“说服力”。实验比较五类模型，发现相关性重写、直接结论句和问题前缀带来最大的平均胜率提升；而添加引用式线索、补充与问题无关的信息、或改成更技术/客观的语气，未形成同等增幅。单独让模型自评可信度，也不能预测其在冲突证据中的真实选择。对GEO/品牌内容运营的启示是：内容应拆成三个问题——是否直接回应查询、结论能否被准确抽取、证据是否真实可核验。“贴题”可能提高被采用概率，但不能替代可信度。文章偏应用解读，未给出全部模型名单与具体胜率数值，适合关注LLM可信度与搜索/内容优化交叉领域的读者。

arxiv.title: What Evidence Do Language Models Find Convincing?
arxiv.abstract: Retrieval-augmented language models are being increasingly tasked with subjective, contentious, and conflicting queries such as "is aspartame linked to cancer". To resolve these ambiguous queries, one must search through a large range of websites and consider "which, if any, of this evidence do I find convincing?". In this work, we study how LLMs answer this question. In particular, we construct ConflictingQA, a dataset that pairs controversial queries with a series of real-world evidence documents that contain different facts (e.g., quantitative results), argument styles (e.g., appeals to authority), and answers (Yes or No). We use this dataset to perform sensitivity and counterfactual analyses to explore which text features most affect LLM predictions. Overall, we find that current models rely heavily on the relevance of a website to the query, while largely ignoring stylistic features that humans find important such as whether a text contains scientific references or is written with a neutral tone. Taken together, these results highlight the importance of RAG corpus quality (e.g., the need to filter misinformation), and possibly even a shift in how LLMs are trained to better align with human judgements.

papers.title: ROG: Retrieval-Augmented LLM Reasoning for Complex First-Order Queries over Knowledge Graphs
papers.report_title: 论文日报 | 基于大语言模型增强与个性化知识图谱的医疗预测框架
papers.summary: 本文解读了 ICLR 2024 论文（原文标题为 GRAPHCARE...，正文核心为 RoG 框架），针对大语言模型在知识密集型任务中的知识过时与幻觉问题，提出“规划-检索-推理”范式：先由 LLM 生成以知识图谱关系路径构成的忠实计划，再通过约束广度优先搜索检索具体推理路径，最后引导 LLM 基于路径生成可解释答案。核心创新包括利用指令微调将 KG 结构知识蒸馏进 LLM，以及将规划与检索-推理两个任务联合优化。在 WebQSP 和 Complex WebQuestions 两个知识图谱问答数据集上与 21 个基线模型对比，RoG 均达到最佳性能。实验表明生成的关系路径忠实于 KG 结构，推理过程透明可追溯；规划模块还可无缝集成到其他 LLM 中提升推理性能。该方法有效缓解了幻觉问题，为知识增强生成提供了新的研究思路。
report_titles: 论文日报 | 基于大语言模型增强与个性化知识图谱的医疗预测框架

arxiv.title: ROG: Retrieval-Augmented LLM Reasoning for Complex First-Order Queries over Knowledge Graphs
arxiv.abstract: Answering first-order logic (FOL) queries over incomplete knowledge graphs (KGs) is difficult, especially for complex query structures that compose projection, intersection, union, and negation. We propose ROG, a retrieval-augmented framework that combines query-aware neighborhood retrieval with large language model (LLM) chain-of-thought reasoning. ROG decomposes a multi-operator query into a sequence of single-operator sub-queries and grounds each step in compact, query-relevant neighborhood evidence. Intermediate answer sets are cached and reused across steps, improving consistency on deep reasoning chains. This design reduces compounding errors and yields more robust inference on complex and negation-heavy queries. Overall, ROG provides a practical alternative to embedding-based logical reasoning by replacing learned operators with retrieval-grounded, step-wise inference. Experiments on standard KG reasoning benchmarks show consistent gains over strong embedding-based baselines, with the largest improvements on high-complexity and negation-heavy query types.

papers.report_title: Agent进化了,北大skill炸了
papers.summary: 本文解读北大等机构提出的SESA（Self-Play Meets Skill Evolution），将在线技能演化引入工具增强搜索自博弈，使任务生成与技能记忆协同进化。方法上，非参数技能记忆B以(u,c,a,z,m)存储，初始包含157个技能；挑战者出题、解题器检索技能解题，失败轨迹蒸馏写回记忆，且技能仅对解题器暴露，防止策略泄漏。优化采用GRPO与可验证奖励，并用钟形端点惩罚奖励塑造前沿难度问题，避免无解或平凡问题破坏自博弈稳定。跨7个骨干模型，SESA较SSP提升2.3/2.7/3.2/1.2/2.1/1.5/3.6点，较基线最高提升10.9/11.8/7.0/10.8，较SkillRL提升0.9点。双路径消融显示，SESA-Off较SSP提升1.8/2.2，评估时无检索仍有参数化遗留，重新启用记忆库仅增加0.5/1.0，说明大部分增益内化进策略参数而非外部记忆库。记忆维护细节包括E5-base-v2余弦相似度≤0.93去重、技能超800条淘汰低分项等。值得关注的是，该工作验证了技能条件化自博弈是一种训练机制而非提示技巧，搜索Agent可在内生任务前沿上持续积累可复用经验。

arxiv.title: SESA: Supervised Explicit Semantic Analysis
arxiv.abstract: In recent years supervised representation learning has provided state of the art or close to the state of the art results in semantic analysis tasks including ranking and information retrieval. The core idea is to learn how to embed items into a latent space such that they optimize a supervised objective in that latent space. The dimensions of the latent space have no clear semantics, and this reduces the interpretability of the system. For example, in personalization models, it is hard to explain why a particular item is ranked high for a given user profile. We propose a novel model of representation learning called Supervised Explicit Semantic Analysis (SESA) that is trained in a supervised fashion to embed items to a set of dimensions with explicit semantics. The model learns to compare two objects by representing them in this explicit space, where each dimension corresponds to a concept from a knowledge base. This work extends Explicit Semantic Analysis (ESA) with a supervised model for ranking problems. We apply this model to the task of Job-Profile relevance in LinkedIn in which a set of skills defines our explicit dimensions of the space. Every profile and job are encoded to this set of skills their similarity is calculated in this space. We use RNNs to embed text input into this space. papers.report_title: MMGraphRAG输了,ACM 2026北航DualG-MRAG新作牛了
papers.summary: 本文解读北航提出的ACM MM 2026论文DualG-MRAG，面向多模态RAG的细粒度视觉与检索噪声困境。架构上，用Macro Reasoning Graph承载全局实体与关系、Micro Matching Graph承载文档内细粒度视觉事实；视觉细节放入关系r并用源文档指针d链回原图，避免污染全局结构，并通过Cross-Tier Alignment（精确匹配+ColBERT软链接）映射双层图。检索采用基于NBFNet的query-driven GNN，只从query相关锚点动态初始化消息传递，并以动态规划从前向传递轨迹解码推理路径。实验结果显示，MMQA EM达44.20%，比最强基线ViDoRAG（37.20%）绝对提升7%，也比MMGraphRAG（35.50%）更高；查询延迟约0.44s，比MMGraphRAG约40.5s快100倍。消融显示，去掉Macro图后MMQA R@5从61.9%降至21.8%，去掉Micro图后WebQA R@5下降18.2%，证明双层解耦缺一不可。该工作对多模态RAG的工程价值在于亚秒级延迟下实现跨模态多跳推理，并为粒度选择提供了可借鉴的系统设计范式。

arxiv.title: DualG-MRAG: Decoupling Macro-Reasoning and Micro-Matching for Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation
arxiv.abstract: While Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (MM-RAG) has shown promising results, it still struggles with complex multi-hop reasoning tasks. Existing methods primarily focus on independent instance-level matching, which often fails to capture explicit relationships across modalities and documents. Although Graph-enhanced methods introduce structural modeling, they face a fundamental challenge in multimodal scenarios: incorporating fine-grained visual features leads to rapid graph expansion and retrieval noise, whereas coarse-grained representations cause the discarding of critical local evidence. To address this dilemma, we propose DualG-MRAG, a Dual-tier framework that introduces a decoupled architecture comprising Macro-reasoning and Micro-matching Graphs for Multimodal RAG. Specifically, to suppress retrieval noise by isolating global structural reasoning from fine-grained evidence matching, we construct a Macro Graph for global topological routing and a Micro Graph for precise local verification. Subsequently, to enable dynamic relevance propagation across heterogeneous evidence sources, we formulate retrieval as a query-driven message passing process via a GNN Retriever. papers.report_title: Frontis.AI&清华开源 Frontis-MA1:35B模型奖牌率71.21%,超过GPT-5.5+Codex
papers.summary: Frontis.AI与清华开源OpenMLE及Frontis-MA1，论文题为《Frontis-MA1: Training an AI4AI Model towards Recursive Self-Improvement in Machine Learning Engineering》。核心是在机器学习工程任务中把任务沙盒、模型训练与长时间搜索串成同一流水线，用可执行反馈训练起草、改进、调试、交叉组合四类代码修改动作。在主实验MLE-Bench Lite的22项任务上，35B模型奖牌率达到71.21%，超过GPT-5.5+Codex的68.18%，接近GPT-5.6 Sol与Kimi K3的72.73%。受控拆解显示，相同OpenMLE-Evo下，训练使Qwen3.6-35B-A3B奖牌率从39.39%提升到60.61%，Human Rank从0.5828升至0.7647；再开启Evo-Max后达到71.21%。训练数据来自5,758项Kaggle相关任务，受许可限制完整发布1,415项，共26,259条监督样本。相比原AIRA-Evo，结构化经验与按动作取用记忆将总token减少41.7%，每百万token新验证集最优次数从1.77升至3.27，提高84.3%。在NatureBench Lite上，达到论文结果的任务从5/10增至7/10，但与Claude Opus 4.7等仍有明显差距。论文也指出RSI仍是远期目标，当前系统尚未让模型改进搜索规则本身。

arxiv.title: Frontis-MA1: Training an AI4AI Model towards Recursive Self-Improvement in Machine Learning Engineering
arxiv.abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) requires AI systems that improve the process of building AI (i.e., AI4AI); machine learning engineering (MLE) offers a concrete, executable testbed for studying this capability. We introduce OpenMLE, an open full-stack system for RSI research in MLE, spanning verifiable task environments with execution feedback (OpenMLE-Gym), operator learning (OpenMLE-RL), and long-horizon search (OpenMLE-Evo). On this stack we post-train Frontis-MA1 (35B) as a meta-evolution agent for MLE, aligning post-training and inference around four atomic program-evolution operators (Draft, Improve, Debug, Crossover): the same operators are trained via execution-grounded SFT and RL on data deduplicated against all evaluation benchmarks, then composed into long-horizon search, coupling learning and evolution in a single loop. papers.report_title: [论文解读]让大模型懂人情,让控制器守底线:SRN 的正确分工
papers.summary: 文章围绕VLM社交导航系统SRN的分工设计展开，提出视觉语言模型进入机器人导航系统时不应直接控制电机，而应采取三层分工架构。大模型负责理解场景、判断社会规则并输出高层决策，例如识别前方正在交谈的人群、判断应从右侧绕行或生成语义航点；中间桥接模块将这些抽象语义转化为规划器可用的代价权重、绕行航点、硬性边界和行人运动上下文；底层控制器则以10Hz以上的高频循环实时求解满足碰撞距离、转弯半径、制动能力等物理约束的安全轨迹。文章强调异步运行机制：VLM以低频更新社会情境判断，控制器在等待期间继续使用最近一组有效参数并结合实时传感器数据反复规划，避免机器人因大模型推理延迟而停顿。同时采用滚动时域控制，只执行规划轨迹的第一步，再根据最新观察修正后续动作。文章指出，物理安全不能依赖大模型，即使VLM判断失误，底层规划器也能通过约束和紧急制动守住安全边界。整体上，这是一篇架构性技术解读，未给出具体实验数据或比较指标，但清晰划分了语义决策与实时控制的边界，对VLM与机器人控制结合的落地路径具有参考价值。
report_titles: [论文解读]让大模型懂人情,让控制器守底线:SRN 的正确分工

arxiv.title: SDF-SRN: Learning Signed Distance 3D Object Reconstruction from Static Images
arxiv.abstract: Dense 3D object reconstruction from a single image has recently witnessed remarkable advances, but supervising neural networks with ground-truth 3D shapes is impractical due to the laborious process of creating paired image-shape datasets. Recent efforts have turned to learning 3D reconstruction without 3D supervision from RGB images with annotated 2D silhouettes, dramatically reducing the cost and effort of annotation. These techniques, however, remain impractical as they still require multi-view annotations of the same object instance during training. As a result, most experimental efforts to date have been limited to synthetic datasets. In this paper, we address this issue and propose SDF-SRN, an approach that requires only a single view of objects at training time, offering greater utility for real-world scenarios. SDF-SRN learns implicit 3D shape representations to handle arbitrary shape topologies that may exist in the datasets. To this end, we derive a novel differentiable rendering formulation for learning signed distance functions (SDF) from 2D silhouettes. Our method outperforms the state of the art under challenging single-view supervision settings on both synthetic and real-world datasets.

papers.title: DeepSeek-Coder-V2: Breaking the Barrier of Closed-Source Models in Code Intelligence
papers.report_title: 大模型编年史之DeepSeek系列第六篇:DeepSeek-Coder-V2
papers.summary: 该文是《大模型编年史》系列对DeepSeek-Coder-V2论文的深度解读。论文于2024年6月发布，标题为《DeepSeek-Coder-V2: Breaking the Barrier of Closed-Source Models in Code Intelligence》，arXiv编号2406.11931。模型基于DeepSeek-V2继续预训练6万亿token，总参数236B，激活参数仅21B（Lite版为16B总参、2.4B激活）。支持338种编程语言和128K上下文，在代码与数学基准上超越GPT-4-Turbo、Claude 3 Opus、Gemini 1.5 Pro，成为首个突破闭源模型壁垒的开源代码模型。预训练语料配比为60%源代码、10%数学、30%通用自然语言，经清洗得到1170B代码token。训练采用NTP+FIM（16B版）与MoE架构，通过YARN将上下文从16K扩至128K。指令微调数据300M tokens，GRPO强化学习引入基于编译器运行结果的奖励模型。评测方面：HumanEval+MBPP平均75.3%（仅次GPT-4o的76.4%）；LiveCodeBench+USACO通过率43.4%，持平GPT-4o；代码补全在单行填空准确率86.4%；Defects4J修复21.0%，SWE-Bench 12.7%，Aider 73.7%。文章还指出Lite版适合轻量补全，通用对话能力不如V2-Chat。总体展示出开源模型在代码智能领域首次追平闭源旗舰的完整技术路径。

arxiv.title: DeepSeek-Coder-V2: Breaking the Barrier of Closed-Source Models in Code Intelligence
arxiv.abstract: We present DeepSeek-Coder-V2, an open-source Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) code language model that achieves performance comparable to GPT4-Turbo in code-specific tasks. Specifically, DeepSeek-Coder-V2 is further pre-trained from an intermediate checkpoint of DeepSeek-V2 with additional 6 trillion tokens. Through this continued pre-training, DeepSeek-Coder-V2 substantially enhances the coding and mathematical reasoning capabilities of DeepSeek-V2, while maintaining comparable performance in general language tasks. Compared to DeepSeek-Coder-33B, DeepSeek-Coder-V2 demonstrates significant advancements in various aspects of code-related tasks, as well as reasoning and general capabilities. Additionally, DeepSeek-Coder-V2 expands its support for programming languages from 86 to 338, while extending the context length from 16K to 128K. In standard benchmark evaluations, DeepSeek-Coder-V2 achieves superior performance compared to closed-source models such as GPT4-Turbo, Claude 3 Opus, and Gemini 1.5 Pro in coding and math benchmarks.

papers.report_title: 论文日报 | 基于大语言模型增强与个性化知识图谱的医疗预测框架
papers.summary: 该论文日报给出的论文标题为《GRAPHCARE: ENHANCING HEALTHCARE PREDICTIONS WITH PERSONALIZED KNOWLEDGE GRAPHS》（arXiv:2305.12788），正文核心解读的是RoG（Reasoning on Graphs）框架。RoG旨在解决大语言模型在知识密集型任务中的知识过时/缺失与推理幻觉问题，提出“规划-检索-推理”范式：先用指令微调将知识图谱结构信息蒸馏进LLM，生成由KG关系路径构成的“忠实计划”；再通过约束广度优先搜索检索具体推理路径；最后让LLM基于路径生成可解释答案。在WebQSP和CWQ两个KGQA数据集上，RoG与21个基线模型对比均取得最佳性能（SOTA）。文章还强调，规划模块可无缝集成到其他LLM中，显著提升其推理性能。该框架为可解释、忠实的大模型推理提供了可借鉴的技术路径。

arxiv.title: GraphCare: Enhancing Healthcare Predictions with Personalized Knowledge Graphs
arxiv.abstract: Clinical predictive models often rely on patients' electronic health records (EHR), but integrating medical knowledge to enhance predictions and decision-making is challenging. This is because personalized predictions require personalized knowledge graphs (KGs), which are difficult to generate from patient EHR data. To address this, we propose \textsc{GraphCare}, an open-world framework that uses external KGs to improve EHR-based predictions. Our method extracts knowledge from large language models (LLMs) and external biomedical KGs to build patient-specific KGs, which are then used to train our proposed Bi-attention AugmenTed (BAT) graph neural network (GNN) for healthcare predictions. On two public datasets, MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV, \textsc{GraphCare} surpasses baselines in four vital healthcare prediction tasks: mortality, readmission, length of stay (LOS), and drug recommendation. On MIMIC-III, it boosts AUROC by 17.6\% and 6.6\% for mortality and readmission, and F1-score by 7.9\% and 10.8\% for LOS and drug recommendation, respectively. Notably, \textsc{GraphCare} demonstrates a substantial edge in scenarios with limited data availability. Our findings highlight the potential of using external KGs in healthcare prediction tasks and demonstrate the promise of \textsc{GraphCare} in generating personalized KGs for promoting personalized medicine.

papers.title: Bridging Online and Offline Handwriting via Differentiable Physical Rendering
papers.report_title: CMU等四校联手:可微分物理笔刷,让AI生成手写还能操控机器人直接写出来
papers.summary: 本文解读一篇来自GIST、CMU、Yonsei University、KENTECH的研究论文《Bridging Online and Offline Handwriting via Differentiable Physical Rendering》。该工作提出一个统一在线轨迹与离线图像的手写生成框架，核心是六参数可微分物理笔刷模型：基础笔宽、压力扩散敏感度、墨量密度、边缘锐度、压力下限/上限。通过可微分渲染器，梯度可从像素外观回传到笔迹轨迹，实现端到端联合训练。为解决配对数据缺失，作者用渲染器将IAM-OnDB和CASIA-OLHWDB在线数据集合成为155,840个单词级配对样本（303位书写者训练、78位测试）。框架包含笔画生成器、笔刷参数观测器（基于DINOv3）、可微分渲染器和零样本扩散增强器。实验显示：在线轨迹估计在单词/单字级较SDT的DTW显著降低；离线图像生成在IAM/CVL上FID、BFID、KID等指标达最优或次优；用户研究偏好领先；Lite 6机械臂可直接执行预测轨迹，用铅笔、滚珠笔、马克笔、毛笔等在纸上写出结构一致的字。论文首次实现在线与离线手写统一的物理建模，但复杂书法效果仍待精细模拟。

arxiv.title: Bridging Online and Offline Handwriting via Differentiable Physical Rendering
arxiv.abstract: Realistic handwritten text generation plays an important role in numerous applications, such as font design, biometric authentication, and robotic calligraphy. Existing methods are typically divided into two independent paradigms: online approaches that estimate handwriting trajectories and offline approaches that synthesize realistic handwriting images. While online models capture structural and temporal dynamics, they often lack fine-grained textures, whereas offline models reproduce realistic appearance but discard stroke order. However, unifying online and offline models remains challenging due to (1) the lack of an explicit physical model linking stroke kinematics to pixel-level appearance and (2) the absence of paired trajectory-image datasets. Moreover, enabling end-to-end learning requires a differentiable rendering process across motion and appearance domains. To address these challenges, we propose a compact physical brush model that bridges stroke dynamics and visual appearance, together with a differentiable rendering module that converts stroke trajectories into stylized images. papers.summary: 腾讯与中科院信工所开源RARG，对应论文《A New Role for Relevance: Guiding Corpus Interaction in Agentic Search》，核心是让相关性分数不只决定返回哪些文档，还决定搜索智能体先扫哪些文件、先显示哪些匹配。RARG在Direct Corpus Interaction基础上增加embed_recall，用嵌入模型生成最多10000条路径的候选清单，再以rg -j1按序扫描，避免并行输出打乱排名；RARG+补充400-1000字符的起始段落并用嵌入模型选Top 10；RARG++对最多500条匹配做局部重排并展示Top 30。主实验采用BrowseComp-Plus 100题、10万文档：GPT-5.4-mini下RARG++准确率84%，高于RISE和DCI的78%，工具调用23.9次，约为DCI 99.1次的四分之一，回合数17.6 vs 48.8；GPT-5.4下RARG++达91%（RISE 82%），工具调用25.43；扩至100万文档后准确率79%，仍领先RISE-BM25的69%。BRIGHT排序任务RARG+ nDCG@10为53.36，略高于NeMo Agent的52.89，但RARG++降至50.55，说明局部重排适合证据链快速收敛，不适合广泛召回。

arxiv.title: A New Role for Relevance: Guiding Corpus Interaction in Agentic Search
arxiv.abstract: Relevance is a query-dependent estimate of whether a document or excerpt contains useful evidence. Existing retrieval agents use relevance to select top-$k$ content, but document relevance alone cannot localize, compose, or verify the evidence required by complex questions. Direct Corpus Interaction (DCI) enables such fine-grained operations through grep-style exploration, but its relevance-agnostic search can expose useful clues late and delay convergence. Recent advances use relevance to narrow the corpus into a working space for interaction. Once interaction begins, however, relevance still does not directly guide which documents grep searches first or distinguish informative excerpts from a broad set of matches to let LLMs see them first. We introduce the Relevance-Aware RipGrep Search Agent (RARG), which turns relevance into an execution prior for corpus interaction. RARG provides coarse-to-fine relevance guidance: it orders documents for sequential 'ripgrep' traversal to expose globally relevant clues earlier, initializes promising entry points with query-relevant paragraphs, and reranks grep matches to surface informative excerpts that document-level ranking may otherwise obscure. papers.title: IDEAgent: Agentic Quality-Diversity Search for Research Idea Generation
papers.report_title: 南洋理工开源 IDEAgent:兼顾idea的质量和多样性,超最强基线 3.89 倍
papers.summary: 本文介绍IDEAgent，一个用于科研想法生成的质量-多样性（QD）搜索系统，由南洋理工大学DeCLaRe Lab开源。该系统在固定生成预算（32个计算机科学主题，每个主题预算10条）下，通过谱系管理、修复与精炼机制，在Yield指标上超过最强基线3.89倍。IDEAgent将每条想法写为结构化提案（问题、因果诊断、干预、机制、假设、预期效果、评估策略），并经过多维评估：非显然性、机制清晰度、可行性（0-100分），严谨性（5次独立采样0-9分，至少一次≤2记为严重异议），多样性（语义比对）。系统维护活跃档案、修复队列、历史档案和拒绝模式库。修复仅1次机会，精炼最多2次。主结果：严门槛（NB≥7、D≥7、C≥6）下IDEAgent平均Yield 1.094，NOVA 0.281，Sequential-Memory 0.188，相对最强基线约3.89倍。至少产出1条合格想法的主题：IDEAgent 27/32，最佳基线8/32；至少2条：8/32 vs 1/32；至少3条（NB≥6）：15/32 vs 1/32。单项质量上，非显然性6.430、严谨性6.720、机制清晰度6.341均为最高。成对多样性NOVA最高（6.757），IDEAgent 6.641。修复/精炼效果：修复28/30条最终合格，精炼82%新版替换旧版；内部评分中严谨性受益最大（修复+23.2），外部Claude裁判显示清晰度提升最明显（修复+1.63）。实验使用GPT-5.6-sol生成，Gemini-3.1-pro裁判，Gemini Flash系列辅助。论文明确：评测主路径为LLM裁判，3.89倍指通过质量和差异性门槛的想法组合数量，不表示真实可发表课题数量。代码已开源。

arxiv.title: IDEAgent: Agentic Quality-Diversity Search for Research Idea Generation
arxiv.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have significantly automated the process of scientific discovery over the past few years. However, existing systems share one core limitation: they generate and optimize ideas independently for either Quality or Diversity. This often leads to the generation of ideas in close proximity to one another or to a large set of trivial, unsound, or unclear concepts. In this work, we instead argue that research ideation should be treated as a conjunction of both objectives and framed as a Quality-Diversity (QD) search. In line with this perspective, we introduce IDEAgent, a multi-agent framework that manages the evolution of ideas through lineages. We jointly drive Quality using multi-objective feedback for dedicated repair and refinement, while Diversity is achieved through lightweight sequential memory and explicit comparison against completed ideas, their historical ancestors, and rejected proposals. To systematically evaluate this QD conjunction, we develop Yield, a joint metric that computes the largest set of mutually diverse ideas that satisfy a predetermined quality threshold. Finally, through evaluations across 32 topics spanning 8 domains of Computer Science, we show that IDEAgent outperforms the best baseline by 3.89x on Yield, while achieving non-zero Yield on 8x more topics. papers.title: GNM Head: A Generative aNthropometric Model of the human head
papers.report_title: 谷歌开源 GNM Head:优于FLAME的高精度人体头部生成式参数模型
papers.summary: 谷歌开源 GNM Head 参数化头模，将面部皮肤、颈部、眼球、牙齿和舌头统一到一个统计空间中，补齐 FLAME 等公开 3DMM 缺少口腔内部结构、难以单独控制牙舌眼的短板。网格约 17821 个顶点和 4 个可动关节，身份合计 253 维、表情合计 382 维，并对牙弓、眼周/下脸/舌/瞳孔分区建模，使口型驱动可主要拧下半脸。采集规模约 5000 人、15 万个静态表情样本，配准结合 22 台相机、14 盏灯的多视角系统与约 200 个艺术家雕刻完整头辅助。在 1.5 万张留出高分辨率扫描上，GNM 平均贴合误差 0.748mm，优于两种 FLAME 变体的约 0.97mm；合成单视角图像重建误差 GNM 均值 1.683mm、中位数 1.589mm，FLAME 为 2.172/2.086mm。眼球巩膜半径固定约 14.6mm，瞳孔缩放参数覆盖约 1-4mm 范围。作者强调毫米级对比仅覆盖共有外脸区域，口腔/齿舌收益主要体现在定性重建与独立可控性；语义采样的性别/族群标签粒度不代表完整人类多样性。许可证为 Apache-2.0，可用于学术和商业。

arxiv.title: GNM Head: A Generative aNthropometric Model of the human head
arxiv.abstract: Parametric models of the human head are essential tools traditionally used in computer vision and graphics for animation, rendering, and reconstruction. More recently, they serve as crucial conditioning signals within generative large vision models, allowing for tight spatial control of generated imagery. However, existing publicly available models are typically limited in anatomical scope, modeling only outer geometry while ignoring intra-oral and ocular structures, and frequently suffer from reduced geometric quality stemming from low-fidelity input datasets. In this report we introduce a new parametric model dubbed Generative aNthropometric Model (GNM), named as a homophone of the human genome. GNM encompasses the head, face, neck, eyeballs, teeth, and tongue, and it is built on an extensive database of high-resolution 3D scans combined with high-quality anatomy specific artist-made samples. This report details the data provenance, the model architecture including the specialized sub-models for the ocular and intra-oral structures, and shows its SotA performance on fitting target 3D face scans. To foster community innovation, the complete GNM framework is made publicly available.

papers.title: Skill Self-Play: Pushing the Frontier of LLM Capability with Co-Evolving Skills
papers.report_title: 阿里Qwen开源 Skill-SP:自博弈实现模型和Skill协同进化新范式,模型能力大幅跃升
papers.summary: 阿里 Qwen 大模型应用团队开源 Skill Self-Play（Skill-SP），通过可进化的 skill 库同时管理题目生成与自动验证，解决自博弈中“可验证但覆盖窄”与“开放但假题多”的矛盾。系统由 proposer、solver、controller 三个角色构成，训练池按预期成功率接近 0.5 筛选，并额外要求探针一致性。工具调用评测在 API-Bank 与 BFCL 上报告 avg@8：Qwen3-4B-Instruct 总均分从 60.2 升至 66.7（+6.5），Qwen3-8B +2.8，Granite-4.1-3B +5.3；弱模型 Ministral-3-8B 从 20.7 抬到 63.6（+42.9），Ministral-3-14B 从 22.2 到 64.5（+42.3），而无引导对照几乎不动。ZebraLogic 逻辑推理中 Qwen3-4B-Instruct 网格正确率从 72.1 到 73.5（+1.4），Qwen3-8B 从 23.6 到 32.4（+8.8），Ministral-3-14B 从 5.4 到 17.4（+12.0），Small 盘从 14.9 跳到 50.2（+35.3）。消融显示无引导 -2.6、均匀路由 -1.9、冻结 skill 库 -2.3；冻结出题器 -2.1、冻结难度打分 feedback solver -3.0、两者均冻结 -3.2。过程诊断显示 skill 流接受样本平均成功率约 0.57，五轮后活跃 skill 约 86，按使用熵估算有效 skill 约 46。边界：主实验停在 5 轮、3B-14B、两族可验证任务，更复杂或契约不可写的任务未覆盖。

arxiv.title: Skill Self-Play: Pushing the Frontier of LLM Capability with Co-Evolving Skills
arxiv.abstract: LLM training is shifting from manual design and annotation to interaction-driven self-evolution. However, existing self-evolutionary methods face a fundamental dilemma between task diversity and verification reliability: environment-bound methods obtain precise feedback but confine learning to narrow domains, while open-ended self-generation broadens the task space but lacks reliable verification, allowing misleading rewards to pollute the training loop. We identify agent skills as a powerful middle ground to reconcile this tension: each skill ensures deep, verifiable execution in a specific scenario, while dynamic routing across skills maintains open-ended task variety. Leveraging this insight, we introduce Skill Self-Play (Skill-SP), a co-evolutionary framework comprising a proposer, a solver, and a dynamic skill controller. Orchestrated via a reinforcement learning loop, these components co-evolve in a continuous self-play loop: the proposer generates challenging tasks conditioned on dynamically sampled skills; the solver explores candidate solutions to push its capability boundaries; and the skill controller collects execution feedback to update and expand the skill library. This interactive co-evolution effectively bridges the gap between structured verification and open-ended exploration. papers.report_title: 一个神级RAG工具,ICDE上新北航XRAG
papers.summary: 本文介绍北航与中关村实验室提出的RAG基准框架XRAG，该框架将RAG流程拆分为4阶段组件（Pre-retrieval、Retriever、Post-processor、Generator）×5种编排器（Sequential、Conditional、Iterative、Parallel、Hybrid），在HotpotQA、DropQA、NaturalQA、FinanceBench四个数据集上，通过ConR/ConG/CogL三类评测视角共40项指标进行公平对比。最关键的发现是Rerank性价比极高：BGE-RRK在FinanceBench上相较BGE-Large使Hit@1提升73.9%，而延迟仅增加11.8%，token开销仅增加1.2%；Iterative编排器SIM-RAG在HotpotQA上ChrF达62.30，远超BGE-Large sequential（26.06）和Self-RAG（17.26）；Conditional编排器表现最差，Self-RAG因启发式分类器迁移性差而垫底。研究还发现，小模型喂golden context不如喂检索结果，DeepSeek R1系列因幻觉率高在RAG场景表现差，增加检索context数量对性能提升有限，关键在于检索精度。XRAG是首个同时满足模块化设计、公平比较、统一数据、模块化评估四项要求的库，并已开源。论文为XRAG: eXamining the Core - Benchmarking Foundational Components in Advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation。
papers.paper_title: XRAG: eXamining the Core - Benchmarking Foundational Components in Advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation

arxiv.title: XRAG: eXamining the Core -- Benchmarking Foundational Components in Advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation
arxiv.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) synergizes the retrieval of pertinent data with the generative capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs), ensuring that the generated output is not only contextually relevant but also accurate and current. We introduce XRAG, an open-source, modular codebase that facilitates exhaustive evaluation of the performance of foundational components of advanced RAG modules. These components are systematically categorized into four core phases: pre-retrieval, retrieval, post-retrieval, and generation. We systematically analyse them across reconfigured datasets, providing a comprehensive benchmark for their effectiveness. As the complexity of RAG systems continues to escalate, we underscore the critical need to identify potential failure points in RAG systems. We formulate a suite of experimental methodologies and diagnostic testing protocols to dissect the failure points inherent in RAG engineering. Subsequently, we proffer bespoke solutions aimed at bolstering the overall performance of these modules. Our work thoroughly evaluates the performance of advanced core components in RAG systems, providing insights into optimizations for prevalent failure points.

papers.title: Molt: A Scalable PyTorch-Native Training Framework for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.report_title: 【Daily Paper|每日论文】多病共存与抑郁症状的相互作用:日常生活活动功能依赖的中介效应(IF=5.4)
papers.summary: 本文深度解读论文《Molt: A Scalable PyTorch-Native Training Framework for Agentic Reinforcement Learning》。Molt主动缩窄技术栈，仅支持AutoModel训练backend与vLLM serving engine，将框架代码压缩至约8.6K LOC（对比verl约62K、slime约25K、OpenRLHF约7.2K）。其核心设计包括：以生成时保存的token-exact轨迹作为数据事实标准，避免文本重新tokenization带来的偏置；通过Ray异步队列连接agent pool、vLLM rollout engines与基于NeMo AutoModel+FSDP2的单一policy actor，实现持续生成与训练的异步循环。在Qwen3-30B-A3B、bf16、DAPO-Math prompts、global batch 128、16张H100（8 training+8 rollout）的head-to-head对比中，Molt稳态optimizer step为119.4±2.3秒，slime为109.5±10.3秒，对应Tok/GPU/s分别为461和502，两者在统计上可比较，未出现数量级吞吐损失。启用MTP head后per-step generation time从329秒降至64秒（约5倍加速）；optimizer CPU offload将actor峰值显存从64.7GB降至46.4GB，但训练时间增加18%。该方法已在700B MoE、expert parallelism 256的配置上完成端到端部署，但未给出收敛结果。Molt的价值在于让agent、generator、trainer与estimator/loss模块重新对应到研究者实际修改的算法对象，使算法迭代更局部化，但代价是生态选择更窄（仅支持PyTorch原生组件）。

arxiv.title: Molt: A Scalable PyTorch-Native Training Framework for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
arxiv.abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning research is constant algorithm modification, new estimators, new pipeline stages, new rollout schemes, and in mainstream frameworks each change threads through layers of trainer, distributed backend, and rollout glue: the cost lands on the researcher at every iteration. Molt is a PyTorch-native training framework built to keep that cost small: a codebase compact and clean enough for a researcher to hold in their head, and for an AI coding assistant to read and reason about in its entirety, so the algorithm flow can be traced and changed end to end. The agent is an ordinary program, and one asynchronous loop trains multimodal and mixture-of-experts policies while never training on a token it did not generate, consistent in tokens, policy versions, and model semantics. Leanness does not cost performance: under a matched, fully asynchronous protocol, Molt is statistically comparable to a state-of-the-art Megatron-based stack. Molt is open source and provides recipes and containers at https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/labs-molt.

papers.title: Learning Safety Constraints for Large Language Models
papers.report_title: 论文阅读|[ICML'25] 大语言模型安全约束学习
papers.summary: 该文解读了ETH Zurich团队发表于ICML'25的论文。论文提出SaP（Safety Polytope）框架，将LLM安全表示为表示空间中的几何约束学习问题：用多胞体（polytope）的多个面刻画安全/不安全区域，既能检测不安全输出，也能通过几何引导修正生成过程，且无需模型微调。作者将文本生成视为词元级约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP），从带标签的安全演示中学习约束多面体；引入概念编码器（CE）降低特征多义性。实验在HarmBench上采用9种攻击方法（GCG、GBDA、AutoPrompt、PEZ、UAT、AutoDAN、Human Jailbreak、Direct Request）评估，并用成功率最高的3种攻击的80%字符串训练、20%测试，比较基线包括Self Reminder、Response Check、SmoothLLM、Rejection Sampling、MLP等。结果显示SaP在保持MMLU准确率的同时，平均攻击成功率（ASR）显著低于多数基线；CE在Llama2和Ministral上显著提升防御，在Qwen2上提升不明显（归因于特征维度较少）。面数影响方面，约30个面后性能趋于稳定/下降，Llama-2在20个面即达到高防御效果。互信息与KL散度分析表明CE增强了安全概念的可解释性。论文链接：https://arxiv.org/pdf/2505.24445。
report_titles: 论文阅读|[ICML'25] 大语言模型安全约束学习

arxiv.title: Learning Safety Constraints for Large Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as powerful tools but pose significant safety risks through harmful outputs and vulnerability to adversarial attacks. We propose SaP, short for Safety Polytope, a geometric approach to LLM safety that learns and enforces multiple safety constraints directly in the model's representation space. We develop a framework that identifies safe and unsafe regions via the polytope's facets, enabling both detection and correction of unsafe outputs through geometric steering. Unlike existing approaches that modify model weights, SaP operates post-hoc in the representation space, preserving model capabilities while enforcing safety constraints. Experiments across multiple LLMs demonstrate that our method can effectively detect unethical inputs, reduce adversarial attack success rates while maintaining performance on standard tasks, thus highlighting the importance of having an explicit geometric model for safety. Analysis of the learned polytope facets reveals emergence of specialization in detecting different semantic notions of safety, providing interpretable insights into how safety is captured in LLMs' representation space.

papers.title: xHC: Expanded Hyper-Connections
papers.report_title: 超越 DeepSeek 的 mHC,上交&小红书开源xHC:残差流扩展到十六路,性能提升算力不炸
papers.summary: 本文是上海交通大学AI博士生对xHC（Expanded Hyper-Connections）研究过程的详细复盘。xHC首次将语言模型残差流高效扩展到16流，在18B和28B MoE预训练实验中，相比DeepSeek mHC，收益提升近一倍。核心贡献包括：(1) Temporal Feature Augmentation (TFA)：利用causal depthwise convolution（kernel size 4/8/12）从相邻token提取多粒度局部特征，增加write-back component多样性，解决N增大后信息供应瓶颈。消融实验显示，TFA在N=16时收益最明显（N越大收益越显著），支持了信息多样性假设。(2) 非对称结构：Dense Read + Sparse Write，每层只更新4条streams（2条固定+2条动态），将投影计算量从O(C²N²)降至可控。使用Gram-Schmidt正交化处理components相关性，在18B规模上若不使用会导致训练不稳定。(3) 成本控制：从4流到16流，mHC开销激增，xHC通过稀疏写回使额外FLOPs与收益匹配。论文中关键数据：在18B MoE上，mHC相比Vanilla Baseline平均分从40.6提升至44.8（MMLU +5.8, ARC-C +10.6, GSM8K +6.8, C3 +5.6）；xHC在此基础上进一步提升近一倍。论文链接：https://arxiv.org/pdf/2607.14530。文章还分享了未在论文中呈现的失败探索（如非线性写入、average pooling等），为后续研究者提供了宝贵经验。
papers.authors: 上海交通大学 & 小红书

arxiv.title: xHC: Expanded Hyper-Connections
arxiv.abstract: Hyper-Connections (HC) expand the residual stream of Transformers into $N$ parallel streams, providing a form of memory scaling beyond model width and depth. Manifold-Constrained HC (mHC) stabilizes this formulation at scale. The large gains from $N{=}1$ to $N{=}4$ suggest residual-stream expansion as a promising scaling axis. However, existing HC-family methods typically stop at $N{=}4$. Our experiments reveal why: scaling mHC beyond this point yields diminishing performance gains and rapidly increasing training cost. We attribute this limitation to two bottlenecks: insufficient write-back information for an expanding number of streams and residual-mixing generation whose cost scales cubically with $N$. To address both bottlenecks, we propose xHC (Expanded Hyper-Connections), the first HC-family method to achieve meaningful expansion beyond $N{=}4$. xHC combines temporal feature augmentation for richer write-back with a sparse residual-stream architecture that updates only $k=4$ of the $N=16$ streams while retaining dense access to the full residual state. Across 18B and 28B MoE models, xHC delivers strong and consistent downstream improvements. On an 18B MoE model, xHC improves the average downstream score by 4.0 points over mHC, while adding only modest training FLOPs over the vanilla baseline. papers.title: ABot-World-0: Infinite Interactive World Rollout on a Single Desktop GPU
papers.report_title: 高德地图开源ABot-World-0:一张显卡实时推演可交互世界
papers.summary: 高德地图AMAP CV Lab开源的ABot-World-0，可在单张RTX 5090上实现约720P、最高16 FPS的实时交互世界推演，按键到首帧延迟约1.2秒，峰值显存约19 GiB。核心方法：多源动作视频（3A游戏、仿真引擎、互联网视频）训练；三阶段蒸馏——双向教师→Teacher Forcing因果学生→少步ODE蒸馏→LongForcing分布匹配蒸馏，专门解决长时间生成画面漂移。动作空间为8维离散键盘（WASD移动+IJKL旋转），每帧一个8位0/1向量。模型骨干基于Wan2.2的DiT，约5B参数。推理优化包括LightVAE轻量解码器、FP8/MXFP6低精度、Fast-RoPE、局部注意力窗口和滚动KV缓存等。在WorldRoamBench基准上，多项指标居第二，但独特优势在于单卡实时+键鼠交互+长时间稳定性。小时级长程交互抽检显示场景结构和运动响应保持良好。训练数据包含基于高德自有街景重建的ABot-3DGS场景。开源权重可从HuggingFace和ModelScope获取（Apache-2.0）。论文公开了消融实验：免LightVAE时OOM；仅注意力加速不够，需全套优化才达15.8 FPS。该工作为交互世界模型的本地部署提供了一个完整的开源基线。
report_titles: 高德地图开源ABot-World-0:一张显卡实时推演可交互世界

arxiv.title: ABot-World-0: Infinite Interactive World Rollout on a Single Desktop GPU
arxiv.abstract: We present ABot-World-0, an action-conditioned video world model for real-time, long-horizon closed-loop interaction, supported by a multi-source data infrastructure spanning AAA games, simulation engines, and internet videos to learn controllable world dynamics. WorldExplorer performs agent-driven collection guided by training feedback, while a unified pipeline applies 14 deterministic quality checks, VLM-based assessment, and synchronized action and text annotation. We progressively distill a bidirectional action-conditioned teacher into a causal student through teacher forcing and ODE distillation, and introduce LongForcing to align long student self-rollouts with an extended-horizon teacher, mitigating accumulated distribution shift and autoregressive drift. Raw keyboard actions provide a unified control interface for scene roaming and third-person character interaction, while reference-character memory provides persistent appearance cues for identity consistency during third-person rollouts. For deployment, we co-design a streaming inference stack with a lightweight VAE decoder, efficient attention, memory-aware scheduling, and low-bit DiT inference. Across optimized low-bit configurations, ABot-World-0 streams 720P video at up to 16 FPS on a single NVIDIA RTX 5090 desktop GPU, with 1.2s action-to-first-frame latency and approximately 19GiB peak VRAM. papers.title: K12-KGraph: A Curriculum-Aligned Knowledge Graph for Benchmarking and Training Educational LLMs
papers.report_title: 北大等开源 K12-KGraph:从小学到高中的教材全部整合成知识图谱,既做bench又能训练
papers.summary: 本文介绍北大团队从人教版小学到高中数理化生教材中构建的课程结构知识图谱K12-KGraph，以及由此派生的评测集K12-Bench（23,640道多选题）和训练数据K12-Train（7,335条监督微调样本）。该图谱包含9类节点（概念6,579个、技能1,364个、实验652个、习题1,171个等）和14类关系（先修边3,705条、分类边、实验验证边等），多模态侧另有插图节点7,388个、视觉元素10,203个。构建流程使用MinerU解析PDF，GPT-5.2按结构约束抽取节点与边，经人工复核（Fleiss' κ=0.84）。K12-Bench包含五类任务族：考点锚定、先修推理、相关概念、实验验证、章节定位，评测时模型看不到图谱。主结果：闭源最佳Gemini-3-Flash总EM 57.1%，开源最强Gemma-4-31B-IT为46.4%，先修题EM仅34.8%（Gemini-3-Flash），相关概念题仅33.4%。小模型Meta-LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct总EM 7.2%（随机基线6.7%）。训练数据方面，使用约2,300条文本SFT（K12-Train-Text），在GaokaoBench上Qwen3-4B-Base总分1009.96（超最强基线DataFlow 985.91 +24.1），Llama3.1-8B-Base总分625.49（超最强基线WizardLM 593.08 +32.4）。多模态实验使用Qwen3.5-2B-Base，K12-Train-Full在Gaokao-MM上总体39.9%（相对基座+7.5个百分点），在K12Vista上79.95（基座79.72，多数通用微调反而掉点）。论文强调该资源锚定中国人教版，评测为闭卷结构理解，增益主要在小参数视觉-语言模型上验证。
report_titles: 北大等开源 K12-KGraph:从小学到高中的教材全部整合成知识图谱,既做bench又能训练

arxiv.title: K12-KGraph: A Curriculum-Aligned Knowledge Graph for Benchmarking and Training Educational LLMs
arxiv.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used in K-12 education, but existing benchmarks mainly test exam question answering rather than understanding how curriculum knowledge is structured and visually presented. We call this capability curriculum cognition. It covers prerequisite chains, concept taxonomies, experiment-concept links, pedagogical sequencing, and visual grounding. We introduce K12-KGraph, a curriculum-aligned knowledge graph extracted from official People's Education Press textbooks in mathematics, physics, chemistry, and biology across primary, middle, and high school. It contains nine node types and fourteen relation types covering curriculum structure and visual grounding. From this graph, we derive K12-Bench, a 23,640-question multi-select benchmark with five task families: Ground, Prereq, Neighbor, Evidence, and Locate. We also build K12-Train, a graph-guided supervised fine-tuning corpus of 7,335 samples, including 2,267 text-only QA pairs and 5,068 multimodal VQA pairs. On K12-Bench, Gemini-3-Flash achieves only 57 percent exact match and Gemma-4-31B-IT reaches 46 percent, with Prereq and Neighbor being the hardest tasks. Our training experiments show that domain-specific supervision can reduce this gap. Under a matched 2,300-sample budget, K12-Train-Text consistently outperforms equally sized subsets of eight mainstream instruction-tuning corpora on Gaokao

papers.title: HyGRL: Adaptive Hybrid Graph Reasoning for Multi-Entity Questions
papers.report_title: GraphRAG又一新作,HyGRL可太强了
papers.summary: 本文详细解读北京理工大学提出的HyGRL框架，专注于多实体问答场景（如“问哪个导演拍的电影既拿了奥斯卡又演过Christopher Nolan的电影”）。核心创新点包括：1）异构图构造：不抽取三元组，直接将原始text chunk作为relay node加入知识图谱，避免LLM抽取三元组的token爆炸；2）RL推理：将推理建模为MDP，训轻量MLP policy进行adaptive beam search，推理时zero-token路由；3）两阶段训练：先用imitation learning蒸馏4个启发式专家（context-aware语义匹配、PPR、Adamic-Adar、Jaccard系数）初始化MLP，再用LLM偏好做pairwise reward精调。关键性能指标：在三个数据集上平均EM/F1达到56.24/63.87，超越HippoRAG2-hybrid（54.30/61.23）；推理时间仅1.82s（对比LLM 1.15s、HippoRAG2-hybrid 2.91s）；构建token比Microsoft GraphRAG节省90%（GraphRAG超20亿token）；在50%噪声下F1仅下降4.09，表现鲁棒。消融实验显示，移除KG Completion后EM降至45.07，移除Text Nodes后降至51.90，替换RL为BFS后仍有60.12，证明图构造是基础，RL提供额外增益。论文表明“不抽三元组+冻结LLM”的方向可行。
report_titles: GraphRAG又一新作,HyGRL可太强了

arxiv.title: HyGRL: Adaptive Hybrid Graph Reasoning for Multi-Entity Questions
arxiv.abstract: Multi-entity compositional questions pose significant challenges to existing retrieval-augmented language models. Conventional methods fall into a dilemma: standard RAG lacks dynamic reasoning, traditional Graph-RAG is limited by structural sparsity, and LLM-constructed Graph-RAG incurs prohibitive costs. We propose \textbf{\fwa}, a unified framework that embeds unstructured text into structured knowledge graphs, creating a heterogeneous network for flexible evidence retrieval. Reasoning is formulated as adaptive structure induction, learned via a robust two-stage process: (1) imitation learning distills heuristic expert signals, and (2) reinforcement learning refines the policy using LLM-driven preference rewards. Experiments demonstrate that {\fwa} effectively merges textual richness with structural knowledge, outperforming SOTA baselines in answer accuracy and reasoning fidelity while maintaining extremely low token costs and near real-time inference((code available at https://github.com/wjywjy123/HyGRL) .

papers.title: How Should World Models Be Evaluated for Embodied Decision-Making? A Decision-Making-Centric Position
papers.report_title: 南大团队一篇论文,撕开世界模型最大谎言:视频再逼真,也可能是废物!
papers.summary: 南京大学俞扬团队在arXiv:2606.15032中发表立场论文，尖锐批判当前世界模型评测体系的结构性错位：主流论文使用“看起来真不真”的证据（L0-L3：FID、FVD、MSE、SSIM、CLIPScore、物理QA等）来支撑“能辅助决策”的主张，是一种claim/evidence mismatch。论文提出L0-L7八级评测阶梯作为证据地图：L0视觉合理性、L1已记录未来预测、L2语义对齐、L3物理合理性（以上为“面子”层，仅具诊断价值）；L4动作可控性与干预保真（分水岭，必须检测动作改变后预测是否正确变化）、L5奖励与结果保真、L6策略评估与排序、L7规划与优化效用（“里子”层，直接衡量对真实决策的帮助）。论文指出L7揭示优化器会主动搜索模型“高估区域”，导致模型内策略评分高但实机性能塌方——这是有模型强化学习二十年来反复遇到的objective mismatch在视频世界模型上的再现。同期WorldArena基准（清华、上交、港大、普林斯顿等）已独立将“感知质量”与“功能效用”拆榜，发现通用视频大模型在感知质量上领先，但在具身功能上常被小模型反超，验证了论文核心观点。论文最后给出“决策中心评测协议”，要求研究者先声明决策契约，再逐层报告证据：L0-L3可报但只算诊断，L4以上才是决策主张的入场券。该工作为全球具身决策社区提供了一套从“好看”到“好用”的成熟度检查清单。

arxiv.title: How Should World Models Be Evaluated for Embodied Decision-Making? A Decision-Making-Centric Position
arxiv.abstract: World models have become a central abstraction in modern AI. The term now refers to several different objects: action-conditioned environment models, latent imagination models, future-video predictors, interactive neural simulators, latent predictive representations, and synthetic-data engines. Evaluation has broadened along with the term. Recent papers measure video realism, perceptual similarity, instruction following, physical plausibility, policy ranking, executability, planning success, and downstream policy improvement. This produces both metric diversity and a recurring problem of claim/evidence mismatch: papers sometimes make a stronger claim about what their model is useful for than their evaluation can establish. We organize the survey using an L0--L7 ladder spanning visual plausibility to policy optimization utility, noting that the levels cut across several orthogonal axes and so form an evidential hierarchy rather than a single scalar. arxiv.title: Context-CoT: Enhancing Context Learning via High-Quality Reasoning Synthesis
arxiv.abstract: While LLMs excel at reasoning over prompts using static pretrained knowledge, they struggle significantly with context learning-the ability to dynamically extract, internalize, and apply new knowledge from complex, task-specific contexts. Recent evaluations on the CL-Bench reveal a critical capability gap: frontier models solve only 17.2% of context-dependent tasks on average.

arxiv.title: TerraLogic: A Benchmark for Hierarchical Geospatial Reasoning in Earth Observation
arxiv.abstract: Beyond perception, reasoning is essential in remote sensing for advanced interpretation, inference, and decision-making. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled tool-augmented agents that leverage external tools to perform complex analytical tasks. However, existing studies in remote sensing primarily focus on perception-oriented tasks, leaving cognitive geospatial reasoning largely underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce TerraLogic, a benchmark for geospatial reasoning. TerraLogic comprises 545 scenario-driven, hierarchy-aware tasks, such as hazard vulnerability assessment, urban heat island analysis, and forest fragmentation dynamics, spanning optical, Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR), and infrared (IR) imagery. It advances evaluation beyond recognition and monitoring toward cognitive-level geospatial analysis. To facilitate evaluation on TerraLogic, we further propose HieraPlan, a tool-augmented agent that organizes toolkits into functional hierarchies and performs fault-tolerant reasoning. HieraPlan enables structured abstraction, robust recovery from tool failures, and stable long-horizon planning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that current approaches struggle with hierarchical geospatial reasoning, while HieraPlan provides a strong baseline with improved reasoning, cross-modal generalization, and error handling. papers.title: SimpleStrat: Diversifying Language Model Generation with Stratification
papers.report_title: AI+NLP博士论文 | UC Berkeley 2026 | 减轻训练后效应对语言模型生成多样性的影响 135页
papers.summary: 本博士论文系统研究了大型语言模型（LLM）在生成多样性方面的固有局限，并提出了三种创新方法以缓解训练后效应对多样性的负面影响。核心贡献包括：① SimpleStrat——一种轻量级采样策略，利用模型自身对解空间自动分层，通过分层采样（stratified sampling）在不损失生成质量的前提下显著提升输出多样性与覆盖率（原文未提供具体数值，但强调在对抗测试、搜索和合成数据生成等场景中效果突出）；② CoverageQA——用于量化重采样多样性的评估框架，为多样性度量提供标准化基准；③ Stylus——将多样性思想扩展至图像生成领域，通过适配器合并（adapter merging）技术，随机化适配器子集以在生成图像的质量与多样性之间取得平衡。论文还前瞻性地讨论了从多样性走向创造力的挑战，探索如何利用LLM发现新颖创意作品。该研究对需要多样化输出的应用（如数据增强、创意写作、对话系统）具有重要参考价值，尤其值得关注的是SimpleStrat无需额外训练或外部知识库，可直接应用于现有模型。论文末尾指出，评估多样性的方法学突破对未来实现真正的机器创造力至关重要。

arxiv.title: SimpleStrat: Diversifying Language Model Generation with Stratification
arxiv.abstract: Generating diverse responses from large language models (LLMs) is crucial for applications such as planning/search and synthetic data generation, where diversity provides distinct answers across generations. Prior approaches rely on increasing temperature to increase diversity. However, contrary to popular belief, we show not only does this approach produce lower quality individual generations as temperature increases, but it depends on model's next-token probabilities being similar to the true distribution of answers. We propose SimpleStrat, an alternative approach that uses the language model itself to partition the space into strata. At inference, a random stratum is selected and a sample drawn from within the strata. To measure diversity, we introduce CoverageQA, a dataset of underspecified questions with multiple equally plausible answers, and assess diversity by measuring KL Divergence between the output distribution and uniform distribution over valid ground truth answers. As computing probability per response/solution for proprietary models is infeasible, we measure recall on ground truth solutions. Our evaluation show using SimpleStrat achieves higher recall by 0.05 compared to GPT-4o and 0.36 average reduction in KL Divergence compared to Llama 3.

papers.title: Do Cognitively Interpretable Reasoning Traces Improve LLM Performance?
papers.report_title: DeepSeek R1这段“深度思考”越乱越有用,100人实测看完更累,反而更能提分
papers.summary: 亚利桑那州立大学Subbarao Kambhampati团队的实验揭示了LLM推理轨迹的认知悖论。研究以论文《Do Cognitively Interpretable Reasoning Traces Improve LLM Performance?》为载体，采用100人、4类推理轨迹、5道时间关系问答任务，训练1.7B~8B的Llama和Qwen小模型。核心发现：原始R1轨迹（长、跳跃、重复、混用语言）在多组小模型上效果最好，尤其1B模型提升显著；而最工整、人类最易理解的“算法正确轨迹”成绩经常垫底。人工评测（可预测性、可理解性、可解释性、忠实度+NASA-TLX认知负担）显示，R1原始轨迹可理解性最低、脑力负担最高；算法轨迹则最易读。统计检验确认差异显著。结论：对模型有效的中间token（提供更密训练信号）不一定对人类有语义价值。Kambhampati团队将系列工作命名为“Thinking Trace Trilogy”，主张将模型内部计算与用户解释分离。该结果直接挑战了行业用R1推理轨迹蒸馏小模型的默认假设，建议把机器的计算语言与人类可读的解释分开处理。

arxiv.title: Do Cognitively Interpretable Reasoning Traces Improve LLM Performance?
arxiv.abstract: Recent progress in reasoning-oriented Large Language Models (LLMs) has been driven by introducing Chain-of-Thought (CoT) traces, where models generate intermediate reasoning traces before producing an answer. These traces, as in DeepSeek R1, are not only used to guide inference but also serve as supervision signals for distillation into smaller models. A common but often implicit assumption is that CoT traces should be semantically meaningful and interpretable to the end user. While recent research questions the need for semantic nature of these traces, in this paper, we ask: ``\textit{Must CoT reasoning traces be interpretable to enhance LLM task performance?}" We investigate this question in the Open Book Question-Answering domain by supervised fine-tuning LLaMA and Qwen models on four types of reasoning traces: (1) DeepSeek R1 traces, (2) LLM-generated summaries of R1 traces, (3) LLM-generated post-hoc explanations of R1 traces, and (4) algorithmically generated verifiably correct traces. To quantify the trade-off between interpretability and performance, we further conduct a human-subject study with 100 participants rating the interpretability of each trace type. Our results reveal a striking mismatch: while fine-tuning on R1 traces yields the strongest performance, participants judged these traces to be the least interpretable. papers.title: Aurora: Unified Video Editing with a Tool-Using Agent
papers.report_title: AURORA论文解读:当全同态加密遇上3D堆叠存算一体,如何让“密文计算”真正跑起来?
papers.summary: 本文解读AURORA架构，该架构面向全同态加密（CKKS方案）提出3D堆叠PIM协同设计方案。核心创新包括：系数切分数据布局（将并行维度从L维转移至N维，解决传统limb切分的Bank利用率波动问题）、双层PIM任务卸载（Bank-PIM负责带宽密集型操作，Logic-PIM负责计算密集型操作）、计算与通信重叠的细粒度流水，以及层次化可重构阵列HRPA。在Ramulator2模拟器上，AURORA相比Bank-PIM+GPU架构Anaheim平均加速16.66×，相比Logic-PIM+GPU架构HMC-FHE加速20.55×，相比Bank-PIM-only架构FHENDI加速2.79×。与先进ASIC相比，加速比从1.14×（Falcon）到19.66×（BTS）不等。消融实验表明，系数切分相比limb切分在Bootstrapping上加速3.73×，在ResNet-20上加速7.92×。微架构优化组合带来约1.62×综合提升。硬件代价：每个DRAM die增加26.61%面积（32.19 mm²），逻辑die增加27.40%面积（33.16 mm²）。论文在12nm/7nm工艺下评估，但结果基于模拟，实际量产成本和安全分析有待深化。
report_titles: AURORA论文解读:当全同态加密遇上3D堆叠存算一体,如何让“密文计算”真正跑起来?

arxiv.title: Aurora: Unified Video Editing with a Tool-Using Agent
arxiv.abstract: Recent video editing models have converged on a unified conditioning design: a single diffusion transformer jointly consumes text, source video, and reference images, and one set of weights covers replacement, removal, style transfer, and reference-driven insertion. The design is flexible, but it assumes that the user already provides model-ready text, reference images, and spatial grounding for local edits, which real requests often omit. We present Aurora, an agentic video editing framework that pairs a tool-augmented vision-language model (VLM) agent with a unified video diffusion transformer. The VLM agent maps a raw user request to a structured edit plan aligned with the transformer's conditioning channels, thereby resolving textual and visual underspecification before generation. We train the VLM agent with supervised data for complete edit planning and reference-image selection, together with preference pairs for robust tool use and instruction refinement. We introduce AgentEdit-Bench to evaluate agent-enhanced video editing under textual and visual underspecification. Experiments on AgentEdit-Bench and two existing video editing benchmarks show that Aurora improves over instruction-only baselines and that the VLM agent transfers to compatible frozen video editing models. Project page: https://yeates.github.io/Aurora-Page

papers.title: ThAME: 3D Memory-Enabled Heterogeneous Accelerator for LLM Mixture of Experts
papers.report_title: ThAME论文解读:把MoE大模型的“注意力”和“专家”分别放进最合适的3D内存
papers.summary: 本文解读ThAME架构，针对MoE大模型推理提出异构3D内存加速方案：Attention放入3D DRAM-PNM（高读写耐久性支持频繁KV Cache更新），专家权重放入3D FeFET-NAND PNM（大容量静态存储），Host Chiplet执行Prefill和Router。系统通过硅中介层和UCIe互连。为解决MoE动态Token路由导致的通信瓶颈，提出层次化NoC（局部Crossbar+上层树网络），并通过多目标优化选择BFT(2,4,2)拓扑，相比Ring平均通信延迟降低4.1倍。运行时采用Min-Max调度为专家动态分配核心，约8-10 ns即可完成。在Qwen1.5、Batch=32时，ThAME的TBT约2.17-2.22 ms，每Token能耗6.7-6.9 mJ；对比TPU v6e（18.12 ms, 141 mJ）和A100（22.93 ms, 214 mJ），性能与能效分别提升数倍。消融实验表明，将层次化NoC替换为Mesh导致延迟恶化1.8倍，同时FeFET-NAND相比DRAM-PNM在延迟和能耗上优势明显。论文结果基于SCALE-Sim、NeuroSim、BookSim2等模拟，采用16位定点精度，未考虑在线学习和动态专家更新场景。
report_titles: ThAME论文解读:把MoE大模型的“注意力”和“专家”分别放进最合适的3D内存

arxiv.title: ThAME: 3D Memory-Enabled Heterogeneous Accelerator for LLM Mixture of Experts
arxiv.abstract: Mixture of Experts (MoE) architectures have emerged as a dominant paradigm for scaling Large Language Models (LLMs). However, MoE inference on conventional hardware is constrained by three fundamental bottlenecks. These encompass the massive memory bandwidth required to fetch non-contiguous expert weights, the non-deterministic scatter-gather traffic generated by input-dependent token routing, and the tail-latency dependency imposed by synchronous expert output aggregation. To address these challenges, we propose ThAME, a three-dimensional (3D) heterogeneous multi-chiplet architecture for MoE inference. ThAME employs Ferroelectric Field-Effect Transistor (FeFET)-based non-volatile and DRAM-based volatile memory chiplets with a co-designed compute mapping strategy that aligns the distinct computational profiles of attention mechanisms and expert routing. Furthermore, we design a specialized Network-on-Chip communication backbone optimized to mitigate the bottlenecks associated with non-deterministic token routing traffic across the combinatorial space of input-dependent MoE traffic patterns. Experimental results demonstrate that ThAME outperforms state-of-the-art counterparts by up to 15.7x in terms of speedup and improves energy efficiency by up to 9.8x.

papers.title: AgentCgroup: Understanding and Controlling OS Resources of AI Agents
papers.report_title: Agentic AI,真的需要一颗超高核心数的 CPU 吗?[Y26W31][解读]
papers.summary: 本文基于论文《AgentCgroup: Understanding and Controlling OS Resources of AI Agents》对144个软件工程任务的实测数据，系统分析了Agentic AI负载下CPU核心数与内存容量的配比关系。关键数据显示：Agent端到端任务中容器初始化、Agent初始化和工具执行占56%-74%的时间；两种LLM后端的平均CPU利用率仅分别为单核归一化的13.2%和7.6%；单个Agent峰值内存可达2-4GB，Tool Call内存峰均比最高达15.4×。作者指出，高核心数CPU（128核/256核）在SMT和CPU超配下可调度大量Agent（如256核+4倍超配理论支持2048个Agent），但内存容量需求随之激增至5.12TB（按2.5GB/Agent估算），实际DIMM配置（如12×256GB=3.072TB）远不足以支撑。更关键的是，内存带宽、缓存、I/O和NUMA访问将构成后续瓶颈，每核可获得的带宽下降会导致Agent执行延迟上升。文章提出“六边形CPU”概念，强调需要平衡核心数、内存容量、每核带宽、数据移动、压缩能力和CPU本地AI计算（如AMX），并建议以Agents per Socket、GB per Core等新指标衡量Agent密度而非Core Density。

arxiv.title: AgentCgroup: Understanding and Controlling OS Resources of AI Agents
arxiv.abstract: AI agents are increasingly deployed in multi-tenant cloud environments, where they execute diverse tool calls within sandboxed containers, each call with distinct resource demands and rapid fluctuations. We present a systematic characterization of OS-level resource dynamics in sandboxed AI coding agents, analyzing 144 software engineering tasks from the SWE-rebench benchmark across two LLM models. Our measurements reveal that (1) OS-level execution (tool calls, container and agent initialization) accounts for 55-60% of end-to-end task latency; (2) memory, not CPU, is the concurrency bottleneck; (3) memory spikes are tool-call-driven with a up to 15.4x peak-to-average ratio; and (4) resource demands are highly unpredictable across tasks, runs, and models. Comparing these characteristics against serverless, microservice, and batch workloads, we identify three mismatches in existing resource controls: a granularity mismatch (container-level policies vs. tool-call-level dynamics), a responsiveness mismatch (user-space reaction vs. sub-second unpredictable bursts), and an adaptability mismatch (history-based prediction vs. non-deterministic stateful execution). papers.title: A-MEM: Agentic Memory for LLM Agents
papers.report_title: 2025 NIPS | 罗格斯大学A-Mem:LLM自主织网+记忆演化
papers.summary: 本文深度解读了罗格斯大学提出的A-Mem（arXiv:2502.12110）记忆增强系统。该系统受到卢曼卡片盒笔记法启发，核心思想是让LLM自主管理记忆的组织与演化，无需预定义schema。技术亮点包括：1）记忆构建时通过LLM生成关键词、分类标签和上下文描述，并与原始交互内容拼接编码为稠密向量，显著提升检索命中率；2）新记忆进入后自动与已有记忆建立关联（先粗筛余弦相似度top-k，再由LLM精判因果/概念关联）；3）记忆演化机制：新记忆会触发对近邻记忆的改写（更新其上下文、关键词等），模拟人类学习过程。在LoCoMo基准（平均9000 token、最多35轮会话）上，小模型底座（Qwen/Llama）全面超越基线，多跳任务F1性能翻倍；DialSim数据集上F1达3.45，比MemGPT高192%。每次记忆操作约1200 token，成本不到0.0003美元，GPT-4o-mini平均响应5.4秒，本地1B模型仅1.1秒。但文章也尖锐指出其架构级缺陷：1）检索路径仅使用稀疏向量top-k，精心构建的记忆网络在查询时未被利用；2）写路径LLM调用次数多（MemoryOS实测每响应13次vs MemoryOS的4.9次），且演化过程无版本管理，幻觉积累导致语义漂移；3）记忆库只增不删，无遗忘机制；4）缺失用户建模，不区分上下文、历史与用户画像；5）时间维度完全失语（时间型任务F1仅12.14，远低于MemoryOS的20.02）。文章认为A-Mem最值得借鉴的是写时LLM语义增强（文档侧扩展）和演化动机，但需结合隔离存储、版本管理和检索路径使用。

arxiv.title: A-MEM: Agentic Memory for LLM Agents
arxiv.abstract: While large language model (LLM) agents can effectively use external tools for complex real-world tasks, they require memory systems to leverage historical experiences. Current memory systems enable basic storage and retrieval but lack sophisticated memory organization, despite recent attempts to incorporate graph databases. Moreover, these systems' fixed operations and structures limit their adaptability across diverse tasks. To address this limitation, this paper proposes a novel agentic memory system for LLM agents that can dynamically organize memories in an agentic way. Following the basic principles of the Zettelkasten method, we designed our memory system to create interconnected knowledge networks through dynamic indexing and linking. When a new memory is added, we generate a comprehensive note containing multiple structured attributes, including contextual descriptions, keywords, and tags. The system then analyzes historical memories to identify relevant connections, establishing links where meaningful similarities exist. Additionally, this process enables memory evolution - as new memories are integrated, they can trigger updates to the contextual representations and attributes of existing historical memories, allowing the memory network to continuously refine its understanding. papers.title: Memory OS of AI Agent
papers.report_title: 给AI装上「记忆操作系统」!北邮*腾讯AI Lab:MemoryOS
papers.summary: 本文解读了北邮和腾讯AI Lab提出的MemoryOS（arXiv:2506.06326），一个受操作系统内存管理启发的LLM记忆增强框架。核心架构是三级存储：短期记忆（STM）采用对话页与对话链机制，自动感知话题边界；中期记忆（MTM）直接移植段页式架构，通过语义向量+Jaccard关键词双通道相似度进行段准入，保证主题内聚；长期个性化记忆（LPM）双向建模用户和智能体的人设，含90维兴趣偏好。记忆更新流水线：STM满时通过FIFO置换至MTM（从时间序转为主题序）；MTM中的段基于访问频次、交互深度、时间衰减的热度分（阈值τ=5）决定是否升格至LPM，淘汰冷段；段迁移后页数重置防冗余。检索采用两阶段（先选段再选页）模拟人类回忆机制，并反哺热度。在LoCoMo基准（平均300轮/9K token）上，F1平均提升49.11%，BLEU-1提升46.18%；Qwen2.5-3B小模型下单跳F1提升125.61%。效率方面，每次回复平均LLM调用4.9次（A-Mem需13次），token消耗3874（MemGPT需16977）。消融实验表明组件贡献排序为MTM > LPM > 对话链，检索甜点k=10。案例展示了同时调动历史细节（公园跑步看松鼠）与用户健身目标（想变瘦）的主动关心。文章也指出架构级盲区：时间仅作为元数据存储，未作为维度索引，导致时间型任务F1仅20.02（虽相对提升118.80%但绝对分数低）；建议在检索层叠加时间感知（时间指代识别、时序重排等），无需动存储层。文章认为MemoryOS的“操作系统化”思维方式（分层、置换、检索分级、调度闭环）极具借鉴价值。
report_titles: 给AI装上「记忆操作系统」!北邮*腾讯AI Lab:MemoryOS

arxiv.title: Memory OS of AI Agent
arxiv.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) face a crucial challenge from fixed context windows and inadequate memory management, leading to a severe shortage of long-term memory capabilities and limited personalization in the interactive experience with AI agents. To overcome this challenge, we innovatively propose a Memory Operating System, i.e., MemoryOS, to achieve comprehensive and efficient memory management for AI agents. Inspired by the memory management principles in operating systems, MemoryOS designs a hierarchical storage architecture and consists of four key modules: Memory Storage, Updating, Retrieval, and Generation. Specifically, the architecture comprises three levels of storage units: short-term memory, mid-term memory, and long-term personal memory. Key operations within MemoryOS include dynamic updates between storage units: short-term to mid-term updates follow a dialogue-chain-based FIFO principle, while mid-term to long-term updates use a segmented page organization strategy. Our pioneering MemoryOS enables hierarchical memory integration and dynamic updating. Extensive experiments on the LoCoMo benchmark show an average improvement of 49.11% on F1 and 46.18% on BLEU-1 over the baselines on GPT-4o-mini, showing contextual coherence and personalized memory retention in long conversations. The implementation code is open-sourced at https://github.com/BAI-LAB/MemoryOS.

papers.title: JarvisHub: An Open Harness for Canvas-Native Multimodal Creative Agents
papers.report_title: JarvisX开源JarvisHub:把可编辑画布做成多模态创作Agent的共享项目状态
papers.summary: 本文介绍JarvisHub，一个面向多模态创作Agent的开源框架，将可编辑画布作为人和Agent共享的项目状态空间。该框架的核心创新在于将创作过程中的中间制品（参考图、候选版本、依赖关系、用户反馈等）以卡片和连线的形式保存在画布上，使得长程多模态创作可以按节点规划、生成和局部修改。JarvisHub定义了五类项目记录：项目材料关系图（节点、有向边）、节点内容、来源与运行状态、用户选择与反馈、空间布局。框架采用三层结构：画布状态层、协议桥（权限与校验）、Agent运行时。实验在同一环境下运行，主Agent后端为GPT-5.5，图像用GPT Image 2，视频用Seedance 2.0，多模态评估用Gemini 3.1 Pro。论文在叙事媒体、交互网页、演示文稿三类长程任务上进行了定性演示，展示了画布轨迹和最终交付物。关键发现：该框架能将中间状态（参考、版本、修改记录）完整保留，为局部修改提供明确入口。论文明确表示这是定性演示，尚未做成完整榜单，也没有给出与替代方案的定量对比。JarvisHub按Apache-2.0开源，支持./run.sh或Docker Compose部署。对研究人员而言，该工作提供了研究长程创作Agent上下文表示、失败后局部修复、人机协同反馈记录的可运行基础实现，下一步需验证状态记录能否减少返工时间或提高跨轮修改成功率。
report_titles: JarvisX开源JarvisHub:把可编辑画布做成多模态创作Agent的共享项目状态

arxiv.title: JarvisHub: An Open Harness for Canvas-Native Multimodal Creative Agents
arxiv.abstract: Creative AI is moving from single-step asset generation toward long-horizon multimodal production. Although recent generative models can synthesize high-quality images, videos, audio clips, UI elements, storyboards, slides, and other creative assets, real-world creative work requires more than isolated prompt-output interactions. It involves references, drafts, alternatives, edits, failed attempts, version relations, tool actions, evaluation signals, and human feedback, which together form an evolving project state. Existing prompt-based, chat-based, and node-based generation systems only partially support this state, as they often discard intermediate context, rely on linear conversations, or require manually specified workflows. Recent commercial systems indicate a shift toward agent-assisted creative production, but their closed architectures make it difficult to study how agents represent context, choose tools, revise artifacts, recover from failures, and maintain consistency over time. To address this gap, we introduce JarvisHub, a canvas-native creative agent harness for long-horizon multimodal creation. JarvisHub treats an editable canvas as the user workspace, the agent's external memory, action space, and shared project state, representing multimodal artifacts, dependencies, versions, and feedback as typed canvas nodes and links. papers.title: Silent Alarm: A J-Space Protocol for Comparing Danger Recognition Across Models and Quantization Levels
papers.report_title: Anthropic 在 Claude 脑子里发现了＂意识＂的结构,却偏不敢说它有意识
papers.summary: 本文深度解读Anthropic 2026年7月6日发表的关于J-space的论文，核心发现是模型内部存在一个可读、可改、并且可实验的中间状态空间。研究者开发了J-lens工具（基于雅可比矩阵），能够将模型内部的高维状态映射到输出词表，从而读取和操控未说出口的“想法”。关键实验包括：将Claude内部代表“Soccer”的方向替换为“Rugby”，输出立即改变，证明因果中介；在“抄写句子+心算3²-2”任务中，模型内部依次出现arithmetic、nine、seven，最终才转向输出词，表明J-space能存储完整的多步推理过程。消融实验量化了J-space的重要性：削弱后，多跳推理能力降至0.21（原为1.0），翻译降至0.02，十四行诗归零；而简单分类任务（MMLU 0.95、情感分类0.96）几乎不受影响。J-space仅占激活方差的3.2%-8.6%，却是复杂推理的核心。这些结果标志着模型可解释性从观察阶段进入因果干预阶段，为AI安全审计提供了新工具。论文还展示了J-space的多任务共享能力：将“France”方向改为“China”，四个下游问题（首都、语言、大洲、货币）答案同步改变。研究成果对理解大模型内部机制、建立可审计性有重大意义。
report_titles: Anthropic 在 Claude 脑子里发现了＂意识＂的结构,却偏不敢说它有意识
大模型在开口前,心里都想了什么?读懂Anthropic J-space,别再被“AI觉醒意识”带节奏了

arxiv.title: Silent Alarm: A J-Space Protocol for Comparing Danger Recognition Across Models and Quantization Levels
arxiv.abstract: Jailbreak-robustness research typically evaluates safety through generated responses using an LLM-as-judge approach. Such evaluations, however, are sensitive to the benchmark's grading procedure and capture only observed behavior on a given set of attacks, without directly revealing the hidden fragility of the underlying safety mechanisms. This work proposes JADR (Jacobian Assessment of Danger Recognition), a protocol that measures a model's internal representation through Jacobian space (J-space, a recently proposed workspace of verbalizable concepts) before the first response token is generated. For every prompt and layer we record the top-k J-space tokens; these are grouped into six behavioral scenario axes and compared between a danger sample based on StrongREJECT and a safe control drawn from XSTest and OKTest. The method does not call on an external judge model: the computation runs entirely locally, on the activations of the model under evaluation, which lets us compare both different models against each other and modifications of a single model - quantization and fine-tuning in particular - on the same terms. The final comparison rests on the proposed SafetyAUC metric, complemented with bootstrap confidence intervals. papers.title: SWE-Pruner Pro: The Coder LLM Already Knows What to Prune
papers.report_title: 上交字节提出 SWE-Pruner Pro:Coding Agent 的模型内部已经知道该裁剪哪些内容
papers.summary: 本文提出SWE-Pruner Pro，一种无需外挂独立剪枝模型的Coding Agent上下文剪枝方法。核心发现：骨干模型在处理工具输出时，其内部表示已编码了行级保留/删除信号，线性探针AUC达0.83，F1=0.63（正例率约30%）。方法在预填充阶段挂载一个小头（长度感知嵌入+逐token前馈分类器），直接读取隐藏状态，按行剪枝。在SWE-QA-Pro上，Qwen3-Coder-Next骨干节省39.4% token且评分从7.60升至7.84；MiMo-V2-Flash在Oolong上token降30.1%，准确率从92.4升至94.6（+2.2pp）。在SWE-Bench Verified上，MiMo-V2-Flash解决率从326/500提至345/500（+3.8%），token增幅仅7.4%（低于SWE-Pruner的+14.9%）。消融显示逐样本平衡焦点损失比BCE的Judge分高1.13分，长度嵌入将Judge从6.86提至7.08。总生成时间仅增加15.0%（中位数14.7%）。该方法依赖开源骨干隐藏状态，闭源API不适配，但为Coding Agent效率优化提供了显著更轻量的路径。
papers.authors: 上海交通大学、字节跳动

arxiv.title: SWE-Pruner Pro: The Coder LLM Already Knows What to Prune
arxiv.abstract: Pruning long context for coding agents has been a vital technology for efficient context management. While existing context pruning methods such as SWE-Pruner realize this by attaching a separate code classifier, we find the agent itself encodes internal representations indicating the relevance of code context when reading tool output. Based on this finding, we propose SWE-Pruner Pro, which prunes tool outputs directly inside the agent. Concretely, a small head turns the agent's own internal representations into a keep-or-prune label for each line, with a length-aware embedding keyed to each tool output's line count. Across two open-weight backbones and four multi-turn benchmarks, SWE-Pruner Pro saves up to 39% of prompt and completion tokens while preserving task quality, with bounded inference overhead. Notably, on MiMo-V2-Flash SWE-Pruner Pro additionally raises the SWE-Bench Verified resolve rate by +3.8% and the long-context Oolong accuracy by +2.2 points.

papers.title: TimeLens2: Generalist Video Temporal Grounding with Multimodal LLMs
papers.report_title: 南大&上海AI Lab开源TimeLens2:4B 模型在七项时序定位基准上超过 397B
papers.summary: 本文提出TimeLens2，一种通用视频时序定位框架，将证据定位视为一组时间段的标注和训练。构建TimeLens2-93K数据集（23,793条视频，93,232条样本，含12,091条多段证据，平均时长约10.2分钟）。训练分为长上下文SFT和GRPO强化学习，引入时间Wasserstein奖励解决零重叠梯度问题。4B模型在七项基准平均mIoU达47.7，相对Qwen3-VL底座提升13.0点；8B达48.0，提升18.1点。TimeLens2-4B平均超过Qwen3.5-397B-A17B约7.5点，且在所有七项上均更高。增益最大场景：VUE-TR +19.6、VUE-TR-V2 +27.8、MomentSeeker +12.6、Ego4D-NLQ +7.2。消融显示前5%数据即从34.7提到42.8 mIoU，标签精炼各阶段持续提升（42.0→43.4→44.1→45.8）。该方法聚焦可核验的时间轴输出，对长视频检索、监控取证等产品有直接价值。
report_titles: 南大&上海AI Lab开源TimeLens2:4B 模型在七项时序定位基准上超过 397B

arxiv.title: TimeLens2: Generalist Video Temporal Grounding with Multimodal LLMs
arxiv.abstract: Video multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can describe what happens in a video, but rarely identify when the supporting evidence occurs. We study generalist video temporal grounding, in which one model predicts a variable-cardinality set of evidence intervals across video lengths, domains, query forms, and viewpoints. Existing training strategies are misaligned with this set-valued task: long-video labels often rely on brittle one-pass annotation, while reinforcement-learning rewards either fail to distinguish non-overlapping predictions or require fragile segment matching. TimeLens2 treats temporal evidence as an interval set throughout supervision and optimization. TimeLens2-93K constructs reliable multi-span supervision through caption-derived proposals, independent localization, cross-agent consensus, semantic verification, and boundary refinement. Our temporal Wasserstein reward computes exact one-dimensional \(W_1\) between uniform distributions over merged interval supports, providing dense, matching-free feedback under unequal cardinalities and equivalent fragmentation; temporal IoU complements it with precise-overlap feedback. Across seven benchmarks, TimeLens2-2B outperforms all size-matched baselines on every benchmark, while the 4B and 8B variants achieve state-of-the-art performance, surpassing open-source models with up to 397B parameters. papers.title: Tencent WorkBuddy Bench: A Multi-Domain Coding-Agent Benchmark with Contamination-Resistant Task Construction
papers.report_title: 腾讯开源 WorkBuddy Bench,Coding,Web,Office,Security四大领域评测,还能防止作弊刷分
papers.summary: 腾讯优图实验室、科恩实验室等联合发布了WorkBuddy Bench，一个面向Coding Agent的多领域评测基准，包含260个口语化任务，覆盖Code（80题）、Web（70题）、Office（50题）、Security（60题）四大领域。核心亮点在于抗污染设计：所有任务描述均从真实提交、历史CVE或业务场景反推重写，避免直接搜索原始issue/PR获得答案。评测使用两套agent harness（CodeBuddy Code和Claude Code），在同一隔离沙箱中运行，确保可复现。Code子集中，bug修复仅占10/80，其余为功能接口、算法工程等；Web子集关注前端交互交付物，使用规则+多模态裁判+agent裁判三层校验；Office子集考察多文件工作区一致性，按规则分与语义裁判加权打分；Security子集覆盖白盒审计、二进制利用等，全用确定性程序打分。主榜单显示，Claude Opus 4.8拿下5列第一，GLM-5.2在Security上以76.32（cbc）/80.86（cc）领跑，证明开源权重在安全任务上可胜闭源模型。GPT-5.5在Office@cc获86.05。论文强调分轨、分harness读取结果，反对合成总分。所有任务开源，允许第三方审计和复现。该基准旨在更真实地反映agent在跨领域工作流中的实际能力，并持续通过版本更新应对数据污染。
papers.authors: 腾讯优图实验室、科恩实验室
report_titles: 腾讯开源 WorkBuddy Bench,Coding,Web,Office,Security四大领域评测,还能防止作弊刷分

arxiv.title: Tencent WorkBuddy Bench: A Multi-Domain Coding-Agent Benchmark with Contamination-Resistant Task Construction
arxiv.abstract: We introduce Tencent WorkBuddy Bench, a multi-domain evaluation suite for coding agents; this report documents its construction methodology, scoring protocol, and a cross-model leaderboard. At its core is a unified evaluation framework for constructing and running distribution-informed coding-agent tasks across four work domains - Code, Web, Office, and Security. Rather than adapting public issue text, every task is reverse-engineered from a real commit, pull request, or business scenario and rewritten as a short, colloquial, role-played request, so that a task's prompt is not recoverable by web-searching the underlying issue, pull request, or commit thread. Because the dataset is released openly - task directories, environment images, evaluation harness, tests, and reference solutions - contamination resistance rests on this construction together with dataset versioning rather than on secrecy. The four subsets - repository-level engineering, front-end development, office and business workflows, and red-/blue-team security - probe complementary facets of real work, each with its own verification style.
