papers.title: RynnBrain 1.1: Towards More Capable and Generalizable Embodied Foundation Model
papers.report_title: 阿里达摩院开源发布 RynnBrain 1.1家族,新一代更强能力的具身基座模型
papers.summary: 阿里达摩院与湖畔实验室发布RynnBrain 1.1，基于Qwen3.5构建，提供2B、9B、122B-A10B（MoE）三个规模。相比1.0版本，新增抓取接触点预测（以中心点+朝向替代矩形框）和原生三维定位（直接预测3D框中心、尺寸、姿态，量化后以token形式输出）。三维定位在SUN RGB-D上AP@15达34.28（2B）和41.12（9B），超过Seed1.5-VL和Gemini 2.0 Pro；WildDet3D-Bench上AP3D达23.44（9B），超越专用检测器。具身认知基准VSI-Bench（75.0）、MMSI（52.0）、RefSpatial-Bench（79.1）领先开源和闭源对照。真机实验使用统一81维动作空间（含手臂关节、末端位姿、夹爪、手、躯干、头部），按本体掩码激活，部署在Unitree G1、Astribot-S1、天机悟己上。与同配方Qwen-Based-VLA对比，RynnBrain-VLA平均过程分91.28%、成功率86.67%（Qwen-Based为68.33%、60.00%）。联合多本体训练（Generalist）进一步提升到94.14%和91.67%。缩放分析揭示：推理密集型任务上，RynnBrain随规模提升38.6%，而通用Qwen3.5反而下降39.2%，说明具身空间监督对缩放方向至关重要。该模型开源，权重可在HuggingFace和ModelScope获取。
papers.authors: 阿里达摩院、湖畔实验室
report_titles: 阿里达摩院开源发布 RynnBrain 1.1家族,新一代更强能力的具身基座模型

arxiv.title: RynnBrain 1.1: Towards More Capable and Generalizable Embodied Foundation Model
arxiv.abstract: We present RynnBrain 1.1, a family of embodied foundation models spanning 2B, 9B, and 122B-A10B scales. Trained with a unified spatio-temporal and physically grounded framework, RynnBrain 1.1 supports embodied perception, spatial reasoning, localization, and planning. Compared with RynnBrain 1.0, it further introduces contact-point prediction across the model family and native 3D grounding for the 2B and 9B models, yielding representations and outputs that are more directly aligned with robot manipulation. We also develop RynnBrain-VLA with a unified cross-embodiment action space and embodiment-specific masking, and deploy it on Unitree G1, Astribot-S1, and Tianji-Wuji. RynnBrain 1.1 achieves strong results on embodied cognition, localization, and 3D grounding, with the 122B-A10B model outperforming all evaluated proprietary and open-source models on VSI-Bench, MMSI, and RefSpatial-Bench. Real-robot experiments show that RynnBrain-initialized policies outperform Qwen-based and representative generalist VLAs, while joint multi-task and multi-embodiment training improves process scores and success rates over per-task training.

papers.title: MonkeyOCRv2: A Visual-Text Foundation Model for Document AI
papers.report_title: 从视觉压缩,到视觉记忆:MonkeyOCRv2以重建保留文档页面证据
papers.summary: MonkeyOCRv2提出“重建即文档视觉记忆”的可操作定义，并通过严格受控实验证明了视觉编码器对文档AI能力的决定性作用。在冻结语言模型（Qwen3-1.7B）、训练数据和解码流程的对比中，仅更换视觉编码器，MonkeyOCRv2-B在8个文档理解基准上取得57.2分，领先最强对照OpenVision-B达13.2分。进一步打乱文本语言上下文的实验中，像素级重建将使低分辨率（长边448）下的识别准确率从55.4%提升至72.1%，正常文本与打乱文本的准确率差距从29.3个百分点缩小至15.3个百分点。CHAOS-Bench（页面字符与语言常识冲突）测试中，MonkeyOCRv2-B-Parsing页面平均召回率17.9，高于HunyuanOCR-1.5的14.2、DeepSeek-OCR 2的6.3等。跨任务迁移上，仅1.1亿参数的MonkeyOCRv2-S超过3.25亿参数的UniMERNet-B；在CRNN、PARSeq、文字检测、文档篡改检测、重叠文字分割等7类任务上均获得稳定提升（如CRNN平均+2.3个百分点，文档篡改+7.5个百分点）。基于0.7B模型（0.1B编码器+0.6B语言模型）的MonkeyOCRv2-B-Parsing在MDPBench（17语种）上达83.3分，拍照文档81.7，非拉丁文字82.1，为官方排行榜开源模型第一。此外，团队开源了1.13亿张文档图像数据集MonkeyDoc v2（17种语言、800万页面级、1.05亿元素），为社区提供公共预训练实验场。
report_titles: 从视觉压缩,到视觉记忆:MonkeyOCRv2以重建保留文档页面证据

arxiv.title: MonkeyOCRv2: A Visual-Text Foundation Model for Document AI
arxiv.abstract: Mainstream visual encoders are pretrained on natural images and cannot be effectively applied to document images without document-oriented adaptation, as dense text and fine-grained character strokes demand character-level visual perception. We present MonkeyOCRv2, a visual-text pretrained model for document AI. First, we construct MonkeyDoc v2, to our knowledge the largest document-image pretraining corpus, comprising 113 million images spanning 17 languages. Second, we propose a pretraining strategy that jointly learns image-to-text generation and pixel-level document reconstruction: the former aligns visual representations with textual content, while the latter preserves character strokes and layout details. Extensive experiments are conducted on five representative document analysis tasks, including text recognition, formula recognition, text detection, document tampering detection, and overlapping text segmentation. Replacing the original encoders with MonkeyOCRv2 consistently improves performance across all five tasks. Finally, we validate its effectiveness as the vision encoder of multimodal large language models on the more challenging tasks of document parsing and document understanding. Kept frozen and paired with a lightweight language model, it yields a 0.7B document parsing model that sets a new open-source state-of-the-art on MDPBench, a recent benchmark spanning

papers.title: TVIR: Building Deep Research Agents Towards Text-Visual Interleaved Report Generation
papers.report_title: 南大*阿里提出TVIR:深度研究Agent迈入图文交错时代
papers.summary: TVIR提出了首个面向图文交错报告生成（Text-Visual Interleaved Report Generation）的统一基准与智能体框架。核心组件包括：TVIR-Bench，包含100个专家策划任务（50中文+50英文），覆盖10个领域和3个复杂度级别，每个任务配有评估核查清单；TVIR-Agent，一个四阶段分层多智能体框架（Planner→Image Searcher/Chart Generator→Writer→Polisher），显式在规划和写作全程建模视觉证据；双路径评估框架（文本评估TA+视觉评估VA）。在9个深度研究系统（含6个商业系统）的横评中，TVIR-Agent（Claude-4.5-Sonnet）取得最佳整体分数；TVIR-Agent（GLM-4.7）在文本评估（TA）上得分最高，引用支持指标达68.64分，比最佳商业系统Claude-4.5-Sonnet w/Search（47.53）高出21.11分；TVIR-Agent（Claude-4.5-Sonnet）在视觉评估（VA）上以明显优势领先，图表完成率高达94.61%。结构性错误分析显示，TVIR-Agent变体产生的可追溯性错误、一致性错误和完整性错误显著少于商业系统。工具使用分析表明，最佳策略需要在检索深度与图表生成之间取得平衡：GLM-4.7虽然平均有效引用数最高（102.41），但图表完成率仅38.45%，而Claude-4.5-Sonnet在保持高引用数（86.14）的同时实现了94.61%的图表完成率。该工作揭示了现有深度研究系统在文本综合远强于视觉整合的关键局限。
report_titles: 南大*阿里提出TVIR:深度研究Agent迈入图文交错时代

arxiv.title: TVIR: Building Deep Research Agents Towards Text-Visual Interleaved Report Generation
arxiv.abstract: Deep Research Agents have shown strong capability in multi-step information retrieval, reasoning, and long-form report generation, but existing benchmarks and systems remain predominantly text-centric, with limited evaluation of whether visual elements are factually reliable and well aligned with the surrounding analysis. To address this gap, we introduce TVIR (Text-Visual Interleaved Report Generation), which includes TVIR-Bench, a benchmark of 100 expert-curated multimodal deep research tasks that require visual elements to serve specific analytical sub-goals, and TVIR-Agent, a hierarchical multi-agent framework that serves as a strong baseline for constructing outlines, retrieving images, generating charts with traceable sources, and composing reports through context-aware sequential writing. We further develop a dual-path evaluation framework that combines Textual Assessment and Visual Assessment. Experiments across nine deep research systems show that TVIR-Agent achieves strong overall performance, underscoring the importance of explicit multimodal design and evaluation for evidence-driven report generation.

papers.title: Recover from Horcrux: A Spectrogram Augmentation Method for Cardiac Feature Monitoring from Radar Signal Components
papers.report_title: 一颗芯片如何同时守住五条后量子防线?——HORCRUX统一PQC RISC-V扩展架构解读
papers.summary: 本文深度解读HORCRUX架构，一套在32位RISC-V上覆盖ML-KEM、ML-DSA、SLH-DSA、HQC和Falcon五种后量子密码算法的统一指令扩展与协处理器设计。核心思路是提取算法间共享热点：Keccak哈希、模运算、NTT蝶形、无进位乘法、采样等，通过56条自定义指令和高度复用的硬件单元（统一乘法树、1600位状态寄存器、专用采样单元）实现多算法支持。在65nm ASIC、160MHz综合下，端到端加速效果显著：ML-KEM最高6.06倍，HQC最高27.1倍（因向量乘法占95%），ML-DSA最高9.17倍，SLH-DSA最高128.7倍（但不同阶段差异大），Falcon仅1.26-2.28倍（受32位接口与64位浮点不匹配限制）。FPGA资源开销约20,196 LUT、4,429 FF、11 DSP，相比各算法独立实现节省约51%面积。能耗方面，Keccak单元每操作从28.1 nJ降至2.6 nJ，降幅约90%。论文以较小面积代价实现了密码敏捷性，但统一乘法树的长组合路径导致最高频率仅42 MHz，这是灵活性与性能之间的折中。
report_titles: 一颗芯片如何同时守住五条后量子防线?——HORCRUX统一PQC RISC-V扩展架构解读

arxiv.title: Recover from Horcrux: A Spectrogram Augmentation Method for Cardiac Feature Monitoring from Radar Signal Components
arxiv.abstract: Radar-based wellness monitoring is becoming an effective measurement to provide accurate vital signs in a contactless manner, but data scarcity retards the related research on deep-learning-based methods. Data augmentation is commonly used to enrich the dataset by modifying the existing data, but most augmentation techniques can only couple with classification tasks. To enable the augmentation for regression tasks, this research proposes a spectrogram augmentation method, Horcrux, for radar-based cardiac feature monitoring (e.g., heartbeat detection, electrocardiogram reconstruction) with both classification and regression tasks involved. The proposed method is designed to increase the diversity of input samples while the augmented spectrogram is still faithful to the original ground truth vital sign. In addition, Horcrux proposes to inject zero values in specific areas to enhance the awareness of the deep learning model on subtle cardiac features, improving the performance for the limited dataset. Experimental result shows that Horcrux achieves an overall improvement of 16.20% in cardiac monitoring and has the potential to be extended to other spectrogram-based tasks. The code will be released upon publication.

papers.title: BigMac: Breaking the Pareto Frontier of Compute and Memory in Multimodal LLM Training
papers.report_title: 多模态大模型训练的显存与吞吐困局,被小红书开源的BigMac打破了
papers.summary: BigMac是一种创新的多模态大模型流水并行训练范式，旨在打破计算效率与显存占用之间的帕累托前沿。其核心思想是“依赖安全的嵌套流水线”：保留成熟的LLM pipeline schedule（如1F1B）作为稳定主干，只在依赖已满足且不打断LLM执行顺序的位置嵌入编码器（encoder）和生成器（generator）计算，从而在不增加LLM pipeline空泡、保持激活显存有界的同时高效实现多模态流水训练。实验在两个代表性负载上进行：MLLM-Understanding（Qwen3-30B-A3B LLM + 1.3B ViT）上，BigMac相比计算高效baseline Optimus加速1.08×-1.1×，相比显存高效baseline Megatron-DistTrain加速1.6×-1.9×，且显存占用随per-GPU batch size增加保持稳定（Optimus则快速增长直至OOM）。在MLLM-Generation（增加20B MMDiT生成器）上，Optimus在所有测试batch size下均OOM，而BigMac相比Megatron-DistTrain加速1.5×-1.9×且显存稳定。BigMac还提供了三大系统能力：全局调度可视化（Scheduler+Executor）、对算法工程师无感的流水并行接口（PP-transparent）、以及schedule-aware的profiler/simulator工具链，支持快速定位pipeline bubble和并行策略迭代。该框架已在dots多模态模型训练中投入生产使用。
report_titles: 多模态大模型训练的显存与吞吐困局,被小红书开源的BigMac打破了

arxiv.title: BigMac: Breaking the Pareto Frontier of Compute and Memory in Multimodal LLM Training
arxiv.abstract: Training multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is challenged by both model and data heterogeneity. Existing systems redesign the training pipeline to address these challenges, but remain bound by a Pareto frontier between compute and memory efficiency, improving one only at the expense of the other. We present BigMac, a new training pipeline for multimodal LLMs. The core idea of BigMac is to elegantly nest the encoder and generator computation into the original LLM pipeline, forming a dependency-safe nested pipeline structure. With this design, BigMac reduces the activation memory complexity of the encoder and generator to O(1) while keeping the activation memory complexity of the LLM unchanged. At the same time, it achieves the same computational efficiency as the idealized setting with unlimited memory. As a result, BigMac breaks the Pareto frontier between computational efficiency and memory usage, enabling simultaneous optimization of both computation and memory in MLLM training. We evaluate BigMac on multiple MLLMs and training workloads. Experimental results show that BigMac achieves a 1.08$\times$-1.9$\times$ training speedup over baseline systems while maintaining stable memory usage as batch size increases.

papers.title: Prompt-to-Paper: Agentic AI System for Bioinformatics
papers.report_title: Prompt-to-Paper:生物信息学中的智能体AI系统
papers.summary: 本文介绍Kamran等人提出的多智能体框架Prompt-to-Paper，旨在解决AI生成科学论文的质量和可验证性挑战。系统核心组件包括：1）基于60-100篇经过验证的真实论文的确定性RAG检索；2）自主编码代理，可执行真实实验并将验证过的数值结果注入稿件各部分；3）八维自动质量评分系统，包含幻觉惩罚机制（结合DeepSeek-v4-Pro的G-Eval评估（55%权重）、语料库实体网络指标（25%权重）及多种启发式特征（20%权重））；4）富含语境的迭代优化循环。文章引用两个典型案例说明问题：2024年2月一篇关于精原干细胞的研究论文因AI生成内容问题被撤回；Sakana AI的自动化写作系统通过研讨会初评但被指出存在虚构引用、实验错误等。Prompt-to-Paper系统通过确定性RAG检索和真实实验验证机制，力求在生成过程中注入事实性约束和可重复性保障。该工作发表于arXiv（2607.05456），相关代码已开源。对于研究人员而言，该系统提供了一种评估AI生成论文质量的可操作框架，尤其是在生物信息学领域，其自动质量评分和幻觉惩罚模块的设计思路值得进一步验证。
report_titles: Prompt-to-Paper:生物信息学中的智能体AI系统

arxiv.title: Prompt-to-Paper: Agentic AI System for Bioinformatics
arxiv.abstract: While recent advances in large language models have enabled end-to-end automated manuscript generation, existing systems suffer from three critical deficiencies: (i) generated claims are not deterministically grounded in verifiable literature, (ii) experimental results are frequently fabricated rather than executed, and (iii) there exists no standardized, multi-dimensional framework to assess whether AI-generated manuscripts meet the quality and rigor required for real-world publication. We present Prompt-to-Paper, a multi-agent framework that directly addresses this evaluation gap through three integrated innovations. First, a deterministic retrieval-augmented generation pipeline with section-aware relevance scoring and snowball citation expansion grounds every claim in a verifiable corpus of 60--100 papers. Second, an autonomous coding agent executes real computational biology experiments replacing synthetic outputs with genuine numerical results. Third, an eight-dimensional automated quality scorer, benchmarked with approximate reference statistics from published papers and augmented with explicit hallucination penalties, provides standardized, reproducible quality assessments. The quality-driven improvement loop uses a context-rich reviser that routes each iteration to one of three researcher actions and fires a deep research cycle every ten iterations to re-run experiments

papers.title: TAP-RAG: Task-Aware Policy Control for Long-Document Multimodal Question Answering
papers.report_title: 又一神级方案,清华TAP-RAG爆了
papers.summary: 本文解读清华提出的TAP-RAG（Task-Aware Policy Control for Long-Document Multimodal Question Answering）方案。核心创新在于通过10字段可执行策略向量（policy）实现面向查询的任务感知检索策略控制，解决了传统RAG对所有查询使用同一检索策略导致的局部/全局/表格三类证据获取失配问题。TAPC（Task-Aware Policy Controller）将查询路由到7类任务（metadata lookup、evidence localization、document aggregation等），通过validity-weighted voting得到任务先验和置信度，再通过bounded query control做有界调整。TA-QFD图扩散机制按policy条件化节点相关性和边权重，跨文档惩罚因子防止扩散漂移。TAVE视觉增强在文本不充分且满足四条件（视觉grounding、support、质量超过文本、fusion允许revise）时才允许视觉覆盖文本。实验采用Qwen3-VL-Plus作为backbone，在DocBench上达到70.2（vs RAG-Anything 61.1，提升+9.1），在MMLongBench-Doc上达到46.7（vs 42.2，+4.5）。消融实验显示TAPC alone即贡献绝大部分增益（+8.5/+4.4），TA-QFD和TAVE单独使用时在某些domain反而掉点（如DocBench Fin. 63.9→63.2），证明执行器需在TAPC协调下才有效。论文未报告task-type-level accuracy，仍为domain-level评测。该工作为多模态长文档QA提供了“策略先行、检索随动”的新范式。
papers.paper_title: TAP-RAG: Task-Aware Policy Control for Long-Document Multimodal Question Answering
report_titles: 又一神级方案,清华TAP-RAG爆了

arxiv.title: TAP-RAG: Task-Aware Policy Control for Long-Document Multimodal Question Answering
arxiv.abstract: Long-document multimodal question answering requires more than retrieving relevant chunks from a large document. Different queries require different evidence behavior. Existing multimodal RAG systems improve evidence access through text chunks, page images, graph links, or heterogeneous document elements, but they often apply a largely query-agnostic evidence-use strategy. We present TAP-RAG, a task-aware policy-controlled RAG framework for long-document multimodal QA. TAP-RAG contains a main controller, the Task-Aware Policy Controller (TAPC), and two policy-guided evidence executors: Task-Aware Query-Guided Flow Diffusion (TA-QFD) and Task-Aware Visual Enhancement (TAVE). For each query, TAPC predicts the task prior, estimates visual/local/global evidence signals, and produces an executable policy. TA-QFD then expands textual and structural evidence over the multimodal document graph, while TAVE selectively inspects page images when visual or layout evidence is needed. A guarded synthesis stage fuses text, visual, and structural evidence and abstains when support is insufficient. On DocBench and MMLongBench-Doc, TAP-RAG achieves the best overall accuracy among the compared systems, improving over a matched multimodal-RAG baseline by +9.1 points (61.1 to 70.2) and +4.5 points (42.2 to 46.7), respectively.

papers.title: LLM-CAS: Dynamic Neuron Perturbation for Real-Time Hallucination Correction
papers.report_title: 论文推送 | 用大语言模型(LLM)重构元胞自动机:探索LLM在地理模拟中的能力边界
papers.summary: 该文详细解读《Applied Geography》论文（doi:10.1016/j.apgeog.2026.104094），提出LLM-CA框架，将微调LLM与元胞自动机结合用于土地利用/覆被变化模拟。核心方法：将历史土地利用数据、邻域空间关系和驱动因子（地形、交通、人口等）编码为结构化提示词，利用LoRA微调LLM（LLaMA、Qwen等）学习时空演化规律。实验以武汉中心城区为研究区，LLaMA-3.2-3B表现最优（OA=85.80%，FoM=26.20%），优于PLUS、CNN-CA、Transformer-CA等模型。空间误差分布显示LLM-CA更接近真实格局。多情景预测（生态保护、城市扩张、耕地保护）通过语义约束成功引导不同演化方向。幻觉分析揭示：大邻域（7×7）下DeepSeek-R1-1.5B和LLaMA-3.1-8B分别产生428和1439个无效像元，但Qwen-2.5-3B与LLaMA-3.2-3B零幻觉，表明稳定性与参数规模非正相关，空间异质性是主要诱因。该工作验证了LLM在空间过程模拟中的潜力，也指出了可解释性和计算成本的挑战。
report_titles: 论文推送 | 用大语言模型(LLM)重构元胞自动机:探索LLM在地理模拟中的能力边界

arxiv.title: LLM-CAS: Dynamic Neuron Perturbation for Real-Time Hallucination Correction
arxiv.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often generate hallucinated content that lacks factual or contextual grounding, limiting their reliability in critical applications. Existing approaches such as supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning from human feedback are data intensive and computationally expensive, while static parameter editing methods struggle with context dependent errors and catastrophic forgetting. We propose LLM-CAS, a framework that formulates real-time hallucination correction as a hierarchical reinforcement learning problem. LLM-CAS trains an agent to learn a policy that dynamically selects temporary neuron perturbations during inference based on the current context. Unlike prior dynamic approaches that rely on heuristic or predefined adjustments, this policy driven mechanism enables adaptive and fine grained correction without permanent parameter modification. Experiments across multiple language models demonstrate that LLM-CAS consistently improves factual accuracy, achieving gains of 10.98 percentage points on StoryCloze, 2.71 points on TriviaQA, and 2.06 points on the MC1 score of TruthfulQA. These results outperform both static editing methods such as ITI and CAA and the dynamic SADI framework. Overall, LLM-CAS provides an efficient and context aware solution for improving the reliability of LLMs, with promising potential for future multimodal extensions

papers.title: Towards Reliable AI-Assisted Analog Design: Template-Constrained LLM Agents for SAR ADC Generation
papers.report_title: LLM 终于进模拟设计了?
papers.summary: MIT团队在arXiv:2607.14165上提出ATLAS框架，利用template-constrained LLM agents生成SAR ADC并通过Spectre仿真验证。文章揭示了直接prompting LLM生成模拟电路netlist的典型失败模式：输入晶体管栅极短接、差分输入接漏极、偏置接地等拓扑错误，证明自由生成不可靠。ATLAS将流程拆解为专家知识grounding、netlist生成、sizing优化三段，LLM承担planner、selector、integrator等角色，而非单一设计师。核心创新在于template-constrained generation，预置StrongArm latch、Miyahara comparator等模板，由Selector LLM按规格选择并局部修改，配合规则检查引擎和Spectre仿真形成闭环。主实验在GPDK-45nm下设计8-bit SAR ADC，目标ENOB 7.5/SINAD 45dB/SFDR 50dB/THD -50dB/Power 8μW，ATLAS达到ENOB 7.59、SINAD 47.5dB、SFDR 55.6dB、THD -51.5dB、Power 6μW，全部满足或优于指标。但论文明确承认边界：仅验证schematic-level，未覆盖layout与后仿；testbench指标需人工校正；向10-bit外推时仅达到约9 ENOB，未达标。ATLAS证明LLM进入模拟设计必须被约束、验证、模板化，未来竞争点在模板库、知识库、工具链与验证闭环的组织能力。
report_titles: LLM 终于进模拟设计了?

arxiv.title: Towards Reliable AI-Assisted Analog Design: Template-Constrained LLM Agents for SAR ADC Generation
arxiv.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated significant capability in software code generation, their application to analog Electronic Design Automation (EDA) is bottlenecked. Owing to limited circuit topology understanding and data, directly prompting LLMs and multimodal models leads to hallucinations and failure to produce schematics capable of passing rigorous SPICE simulations, as we show in our work. Instead, we propose an end-to-end, multi-step LLM agentic framework ATLAS, capable of generating a functional Successive Approximation Register (SAR) Analog-to-Digital Converter (ADC) that successfully passes simulation validation. To adhere to the rigid constraints of analog design, we utilize expert knowledge to ground the LLM in its planning, selection, parameterization, and iterative modification. As part of ATLAS, we introduce Template-Constrained Generation - which unlike other template-based works - builds towards a more generalized SAR ADC generation flow. We demonstrate a strong proof-of-concept of our framework by developing SAR ADCs across technology nodes and input specs. Overall, our expert-knowledge grounded multi-step agentic ATLAS establishes a pragmatic foundation for integrating LLMs into reliable analog design methodologies.

papers.title: SearchOS-V1: Towards Robust Open-Domain Information-Seeking Agent Collaboration
papers.report_title: 人大高瓴&蚂蚁发布 SearchOS:把长程搜索进度做成可调度的系统状态
papers.summary: SearchOS将开放式网上调研转化为多张带引用的关系表补全任务，核心贡献是搜索导向的上下文管理（SOCM）——包含待填任务队列、证据图、完成度看板和失败记忆四块共享状态，使多智能体协作不再依赖长上下文记忆。调度采用流水线并行，任务完成即回填空位，避免整批等待。中间层（搜索工具中间层）将护栏移出Prompt，强制证据抽取和进度检测。评测使用WideSearch（200道人工题）和GISA（373道题），骨干模型GLM-5+Qwen3.5-35B-A3B，Max@3。WideSearch Item F1 80.3（比最强多智能体基线A-MapReduce 76.0高4.3），Row F1 56.5（+2.0）；GISA Set F1 76.5（比最强基线63.1高13.4）。效率方面，带技能组比无技能组时间减少36.6%，搜索调用减少39.1%，页面调用减少42.7%。消融实验表明动态表结构优于固定表（Oracle固定表仍低8.2 Item F1），连续调度比批次调度端到端时间减少24.3%。本文的工程原则是：将目标写成结构化表格、将缺口/证据/失败纳入共享状态、用系统层处理停滞和预算。

arxiv.title: SearchOS-V1: Towards Robust Open-Domain Information-Seeking Agent Collaboration
arxiv.abstract: Recent advances in Tool-Integrated Large Language Models have made web search a core capability of information-seeking agents. However, as interaction histories grow, agents increasingly struggle to track task progress. When search attempts fail to yield useful evidence, current single- and multi-agent systems can become trapped in repetitive loops, wasting search budgets and ultimately compromising the quality and completeness of the final output. We introduce SearchOS, a system-level multi-agent framework that turns fragile, implicit search progress into explicit, persistent, and shared state. First, we formulate open-domain information seeking as relational schema completion with grounded citations, where agents discover entities, populate attributes across linked tables, and anchor each value to source evidence. Then we design Search-Oriented Context Management (SOCM), which externalizes the evolving state into Frontier Task, an Evidence Graph, a Coverage Map, and Failure Memory. Built on SOCM, SearchOS applies a pipeline-parallel scheduling mechanism that overlaps the execution of sub-agents and continuously refills freed slots with tasks targeting unresolved coverage gaps to improve utilization and throughput. papers.report_title: COSM:让手机CPU与PIM“错峰并行”,大模型推理吞吐提升2.8倍
papers.summary: 本文解读论文《COSM: A Cooperative Scheduling Framework for Concurrent PIM and CPU Execution on Mobile Devices》。针对移动设备上PIM与CPU并发访问DRAM时的资源冲突问题，COSM提出可抢占PIM命令（PIM_Exec/PIM_Pause）、带宽解耦传输（将CPU-PIM数据传输拆为外部总线+Bank内部两步）以及空闲窗口估计器IWE。核心结果：在模拟LPDDR5-6400、8核CPU、6.4 TFLOPS PIM的平台上，COSM相比Chopim将大模型推理吞吐提升最高2.8倍，相比All-Bank基线提升约6倍，同时CPU性能平均仅下降约2%。PIM任务单位Token能耗相比AsyncDIMM-Bank和Chopim分别降低1.34倍和1.61倍。论文详细分析了三类冲突（Bank冲突、命令总线冲突、CPU介导传输干扰），并对比All-Bank、CPU-first、Row-hit-aware等调度方案。COSM的关键机制包括：最长128周期的可抢占命令（将CPU干扰控制在3.2%内，PIM性能提升2.02倍）、带宽解耦使CPU性能再提高11.5%、Tiling流水线重叠数据传输与计算。评估覆盖BLOOM-1B1、DeepSeek-R1-1.5B、Qwen2-0.5B以及腾讯会议、YouTube等移动应用。该工作为移动端存内处理与CPU协同调度提供了系统级的工程参考。

arxiv.title: COSM: A Cooperative Scheduling Framework for Concurrent PIM and CPU Execution on Mobile Devices
arxiv.abstract: The development of on-device large language models (LLMs) is driven by the need for privacy and fast response times. Energy-intensive data transfer on mobile devices makes Processing-in-Memory (PIM) an effective solution. Due to stringent DRAM cost constraints, limited physical footprint on circuit boards, and the interaction between applications and LLMs, it is imperative for the CPU and PIM to operate concurrently within a shared memory space. However, challenges such as bank conflicts and bus congestion can arise, potentially diminishing the performance and energy benefits of PIM. To address this challenge, we introduce COSM, a cooperative scheduling framework designed to facilitate the concurrent operation of PIM and CPU tasks on mobile platforms. Our key innovations include: 1) a low-interference PIM control interface that generates the maximum number of PIM commands without disrupting CPU memory accesses; 2) an idleness-aware scheduling method that integrates PIM commands into available idle time windows within the CPU's access sequence. COSM not only hides PIM execution latency from the CPU, but also overlaps PIM execution with data transfer. papers.title: Custom Algorithm-based Fault Tolerance for Attention Layers in Transformers
papers.report_title: 只做一次校验,就守住整个注意力层:Flash-ABFT如何为Transformer加速器加上低成本“保险”
papers.summary: 本文解读论文《Custom Algorithm-based Fault Tolerance for Attention Layers in Transformers》。Flash-ABFT提出一种面向Transformer注意力层的算法级融合容错方案，核心创新是构造一个贯穿Softmax和QK^T·V的在线校验和，将传统逐算子校验（QK^T校验 + Softmax后校验 + 矩阵乘校验）合并为一次整体检测。数学上，通过将Value向量的元素和作为附加分量嵌入FlashAttention-2的输出递推，用一条标量通道预测整个注意力输出的校验和。硬件开销：在28nm工艺、500MHz下，面积开销仅5.3%，功耗开销低于1.9%。故障注入实验针对隐藏维度64/128/256/512、序列长度256的模型，单故障检测率最高达98.87%。论文详细给出算法伪代码、硬件架构（图3）以及FlashAttention-2块并行结构的改造方法。值得注意的局限：当前方案仅实现错误检测而非恢复，输入存储器假设由ECC保护，故障模型限于单比特翻转，且未量化检测到的算术错误对下游任务准确率的影响。该工作为Transformer加速器的低成本可靠性设计提供了新的数学框架和硬件参考。

arxiv.title: Custom Algorithm-based Fault Tolerance for Attention Layers in Transformers
arxiv.abstract: Transformers and large language models (LLMs), powered by the attention mechanism, have transformed numerous AI applications, driving the need for specialized hardware accelerators. A major challenge in these accelerators is efficiently detecting errors caused by random hardware faults. Traditional algorithm-based fault tolerance (ABFT) techniques verify individual matrix multiplications but fall short in handling the full attention mechanism, particularly due to intermediate softmax normalization. This work proposes Flash-ABFT, a novel method that computes an online checksum across the entire three-matrix product of query, key and value matrices, of an attention layer, including the softmax operation, with a single check. This approach significantly reduces overhead by eliminating redundant checks while maintaining high fault-detection accuracy. Experimental results demonstrate that Flash-ABFT incurs only 5.3% hardware area overhead and less than 1.9% energy overhead, making it a cost-effective and robust solution for error detection in attention accelerators.

papers.title: RESOURCE2SKILL: Distilling Executable Agent Skills from Human-Created Multimodal Resources
papers.report_title: 刷到好视频好文章,想抽成 skill 复用?微软开源了自动干这件事的框架
papers.summary: 微软研究院提出Resource2Skill，将教程视频、代码仓库、文章等人类创建的多模态资源蒸馏为可执行的Agent技能条目（每条含文字、截图、代码），按类别组织成可导航的技能Wiki。Agent通过分层浏览+BM25筛选+语言模型挑选组合使用。在七个创作域（幻灯片、CAD、网页、Excel、Blender、UE5、Reaper）上评测，使用GPT-5.5/5.4/Mini/Nano四档模型，每域80条不重叠任务。有技能比无技能平均提升11.9个百分点（56.8% vs 45.0%），且在所有28个模型-域格子中全部领先。与Claude Code、Codex等Agent框架对比，Resource2Skill仍全面胜出。关键发现：技能库大小约200条即可获得大部分收益（超过后边际递减）；视频来源贡献最大（去掉视频后平均性能从68.9%降至59.4%，仅视频库仍高于无视频的三源组合7.4个百分点）；截图和代码各带来约2个百分点额外增益。在线补技能在标准任务上收益小（+0.7pp），仅在离线库明确缺能力时有效（缺口任务+21.6pp）。消融实验显示“层次分类+语言模型”选取策略（平均68.9%）优于BM25（66.0%）和稠密检索（60.0%）。人盲测A/B中，w Skills在85.5%的配对中获胜。论文提供完整构建流水线：资源搜集→蒸馏器→领域验收→技能组织。对工程团队，建议优先把高频操作习惯沉淀为技能，而非盲目扩库。

arxiv.title: RESOURCE2SKILL: Distilling Executable Agent Skills from Human-Created Multimodal Resources
arxiv.abstract: Skills are a useful abstraction for software agents, turning human and agent experience into reusable procedural knowledge. Yet existing skill libraries are mostly hand-written, text-centric, or derived from agent traces, leaving tutorial videos and other multimodal human resources largely underused. We present RESOURCE2SKILL, a framework that distills multimodal resources, including tutorial videos, repositories, articles, and reference artifacts, into executable skills for software agents. RESOURCE2SKILL organizes these skills as a hierarchical multimodal Skill Wiki, where each entry combines structured text, code, visual examples, metadata, and provenance. This design preserves complementary signals from different resources: videos capture temporal operations and visual effects, code captures executable tool patterns, and articles or artifacts provide conceptual and stylistic grounding. At inference time, agents retrieve and compose relevant skills from the wiki; when coverage is insufficient, the same construction operator can acquire new skills online. Across seven practical authoring domains, RESOURCE2SKILL improves average overall score by +11.9 percentage points over no-skill agents and outperforms strong harness baselines in 26 of 28 main-aggregate model-domain cells. papers.title: LongStraw: Long-Context RL Beyond 2M Tokens under a Fixed GPU Budget
papers.report_title: MindLab&复旦开源 LongStraw:GPU资源不变,强化学习训练突破两百万上下文
papers.summary: 本文提出LongStraw方法，在GPU数量固定时将强化学习（GRPO）训练上下文从常规约256K token突破至超过200万token。核心思想是：共享提示词段只做前向计算并冻结梯度，多条短回复按顺序独立构建计算图、反向传播并累加梯度，从而将激活量从O(提示词+回复×组大小)压缩至接近单条回复尺度。实验使用Qwen3.6-27B（8×H20）和GLM-5.2（32×H20）验证：Qwen在209万token（提示词208.9万+回复8192）下，组大小从2增至8，峰值显存仅从97.503GB升至97.711GB（+0.21GB）；GLM在209万token下完整跑完两组旧分、78层策略反传及优化器调用。论文还进行了425万token压力测试。但需注意：多卡梯度归约尚未完整闭合，GLM的稀疏注意力为分片本地实现，工作负载为确定性执行探针而非在线采样。LongStraw的工程价值在于将长上下文GRPO训练从“必须加卡”转变为“固定预算下可执行”，代价是短回复串行计算、按架构定制状态约定及未完整的分布式梯度同步。对希望利用固定资源训练长轨迹Agent的团队具有指导意义。
report_titles: MindLab&复旦开源 LongStraw:GPU资源不变,强化学习训练突破两百万上下文

arxiv.title: LongStraw: Long-Context RL Beyond 2M Tokens under a Fixed GPU Budget
arxiv.abstract: Long-context RL post-training is constrained by the lifetime of state and gradients, not attention cost alone. In GRPO, one multi-million-token prompt must serve old-policy and reference scoring plus multiple policy responses, while conventional autograd keeps the prompt graph and all response graphs live alongside model weights, caches, and distributed communication buffers. We present LongStraw, an objective-aware, architecture-aware system for resident-state virtualization, response replay, and distributed-gradient execution. Its transaction captures the shared prompt without autograd, retains only the architecture-required state on explicitly owned pages, restores that state for each group member, scores old/reference branches without a graph, replays one policy response at a time with autograd, and accumulates the resulting gradients before one distributed finalization and optimizer step. This schedule bounds the live training graph by the response suffix while reusing the expensive prompt computation across the complete GRPO group. We instantiate this design for two incompatible model structures. Qwen3.6-27B combines 48 recurrent GDN layers with 16 full-attention layers; LongStraw keeps the compact recurrent state and physically CP8-sharded KV pages, composes global attention through cross-rank LSE/output merging, and performs blockwise response replay. papers.title: VideoChat3: Fully Open Video MLLM for Efficient and Generalist Video Understanding
papers.report_title: 南大等开源VideoChat3:4B 视频理解模型通吃短视频、长视频和直播流
papers.summary: VideoChat3是一个4B参数的完全开源视频多模态大模型，通过I3D-ViT在视觉端实现约16倍时空压缩（T=4时间池化+2×2空间合并），将送进语言模型的视觉token减少至常规方法的约1/16。支持离线、长视频和流式在线三种场景。流式模式采用三态切换（Silence/Standby/Response）控制每帧像素上限（224→448），自适应分辨率。训练数据包含约300万高质量指令样本（Academic2M、LV116K、OL617K），分四阶段训练。离线评测中，19个指标对比Qwen3-VL-4B赢下18个，时间定位差距尤大：TimeLens +9.7/+6.4/+8.3，VUE-TR +15.0/+20.6，MomentSeeker +12.1。在线流式基准中，ODVBench Overall 72.3、StreamingBench Real-Time 83.0、OVO-Timing F1 35.5（超过带2B额外模块的Em-Garde 31.0）。推理效率方面，2048帧输入时总延迟从44.449秒降至20.412秒，显存同步下降。模型、代码、训练策略和全部数据均开源。本文证明：视觉端先压缩冗余比单纯堆语言模型参数量更有效，特别在需要时间对齐的任务上优势显著。
report_titles: 南大等开源VideoChat3:4B 视频理解模型通吃短视频、长视频和直播流

arxiv.title: VideoChat3: Fully Open Video MLLM for Efficient and Generalist Video Understanding
arxiv.abstract: Recent advances in video understanding have spanned motion, long video, and streaming interaction, driving this field toward real-world applications. Despite this progress, current open-source models remain limited in several ways. They often struggle to generalize across diverse video types, making them effective only in specific domains. High computational demands further restrict their efficiency and scalability. Moreover, most models are only partially open, with key components such as training code, strategy, or datasets unavailable, which hinders reproducibility and slows community-driven development. To address these issues, we introduce VideoChat3, a fully open, efficient, and generalist video-centric MLLM. VideoChat3 advances video understanding through two complementary designs. For efficiency, we introduce Inflated 3D Vision Transformer (I3D-ViT) and Adaptive Frame Resolution for Streaming Video Perception, which enables efficient spatiotemporal representation and reduces the cost of processing video inputs during training and inference. For effectiveness, we develop a scalable video data synthesis pipeline that curates three diverse, high-quality training datasets: VideoChat3-Academic2M, VideoChat3-LV116K, and VideoChat3-OL617K, covering general, long-form, and streaming video scenarios, improving the model's generalization across domains. papers.title: MemoHarness: Agent Harnesses That Learn from Experience
papers.report_title: 圣母大学提出 MemoHarness:同一模型只改 harness,终端任务成功率提升 8.4 个百分点
papers.summary: MemoHarness将Agent harness拆分为六个可编辑维度（输入拼装、工具与检索、解码、编排、跨轮记忆、输出校验），通过训练期在搜索集上结构化搜索最优配置并写入经验库，测试期针对每道新题检索相似案例改编全局harness。主评测Terminal-Bench（长程shell智能体）使用GPT-5.3-Codex为基座，成功率从固定harness Codex的0.722提升至0.806（+8.4%），LiveCodeBench从0.900升至0.967（+6.7%），FinanceAgent从0.600升至0.767（+16.7%）。跨模型迁移时，Terminal-Bench上所有基座均获益，平均+0.098，GLM-5从0.500升至0.733（+0.233）。成本方面，MemoHarness总费用$6.89，低于Codex的$10.28（因大量输入进入缓存）。六维拆分使失败能定位到具体维度，经验库记录诊断信息而非仅分数。本文的工程启示：对于长程、多失败模式的Agent任务，应优先收集逐题失败主因并结构化记录，而非仅优化单套全局Prompt。
report_titles: 圣母大学提出 MemoHarness:同一模型只改 harness,终端任务成功率提升 8.4 个百分点

arxiv.title: MemoHarness: Agent Harnesses That Learn from Experience
arxiv.abstract: An agent harness is the external control layer that turns a base LLM into an executable agent by managing context, tools, orchestration, memory, decoding, and output handling. While harness design strongly affects agent behavior, most automatic improvement methods optimize narrower artifacts such as prompts, pipelines, or workflows, and deployed agents usually reuse a single global harness for all cases. We introduce MemoHarness, an adaptive harness optimization framework that learns from its own executions. MemoHarness decomposes the harness into six editable control dimensions, stores per-case diagnoses and distilled global patterns in a dual-layer experience bank, and adapts the learned harness to each test case using retrieved experience without test-time labels, feedback, or additional search. In our evaluation across shell-agent, code-generation, and analytical-reasoning benchmarks, MemoHarness improves over the fixed harnesses we compare against and shows selective transfer to unseen suites and base models. Its additional context can also remain cost-competitive when much of the retrieved experience is cacheable. papers.title: Xiaomi-Robotics-U0: Unified Embodied Synthesis with World Foundation Model
papers.report_title: 小米发布Xiaomi-Robotics-U0:把世界模型变成机器人数据引擎
papers.summary: 小米Robotics发布380亿参数的世界基础模型Xiaomi-Robotics-U0，可在训练前将真实机器人操作记录的场景（桌布、灯光、背景等）进行多样化迁移，同时保持关节动作和相机视角不变，从而低成本增强训练数据。模型同时支持文生图、场景编辑、多视角生成和视频预测，使用深度图约束保证几何一致性。真机实验（收纳耳机、叠毛巾、装箱）中，在未见过桌布和灯光干扰组，原始训练数据策略平均完成进度36.9%，加入U0增广数据后提升至63.2%（+26.3%），不同场景间的性能下降幅度从44.1%缩小至18.9%。客观指标：场景迁移深度误差从0.3444降至0.1435，分割重合度从0.4098升至0.7436。FlashAR+推理加速使单张图像生成时间从450.77秒降至5.44秒（约82.9倍）。在World Arena榜单中匿名提交总分73.64排名第一，指令跟随93.86、透视正确性98.84。本文明确U0是数据增强工具，不参与运行时决策，合成视频尚不能替代真实演示。为机器人视觉泛化提供了实用的数据扩充方案。

arxiv.title: Xiaomi-Robotics-U0: Unified Embodied Synthesis with World Foundation Model
arxiv.abstract: Recent foundation image and video generation models offer strong generalization and controllability, but their direct application to embodied scenarios is limited by requirements for multi-view consistency, geometric coherence, and robot embodiment constraints. Existing methods typically adapt foundation models with limited robot data, often sacrificing visual knowledge acquired during large-scale pre-training. We present Xiaomi-Robotics-U0, a 38-billion-parameter multimodal autoregressive model for unified embodied synthesis. It treats embodied generation as an extension of foundation image and video generation and jointly optimizes text-to-image generation, image editing, embodied scene generation, embodied transfer, and embodied video generation. This unified framework preserves the generalization of the pre-trained world foundation model while adapting it to embodied settings. Xiaomi-Robotics-U0 is the first model to support high-quality multi-view scene generation across multiple robot embodiments and to introduce structured, controllable embodied transfer for fine-grained editing while preserving multi-view consistency and interaction dynamics. papers.title: Xiaomi-Robotics-1: Scaling Vision-Language-Action Models with over 100K Hours of Real-World Trajectories
papers.report_title: 小米发布新一代VLA基座模型 Xiaomi-Robotics-1 :超10万小时真实数据训练,多项基准SOTA
papers.summary: 小米机器人团队提出Xiaomi-Robotics-1，一种视觉-语言-动作基础模型。两阶段训练：预训练使用超过10万小时UMI（Universal Manipulation Interface）真实操作轨迹，覆盖家庭、办公、工业、户外等场景；后训练使用约1万小时跨本体数据（含7200小时自采机器人数据和1000小时指令标注UMI数据）。模型采用Mixture-of-Transformers（MoT）结构，VLM（Qwen3-VL）理解图像和语言，DiT通过流匹配生成动作块。提供2B/5B/10B三个规模，总参数量分别约2.6B、5.1B、10.5B。关键性能：在RoboCasa365基准上平均成功率57.4%，超过此前最佳ABot-M0.6（46.6%）；最难Comp.-Unseen子集从7.9%提升至32.1%。RoboDojo五项能力平均得分20.07（前SOTA 13.07），Long-Horizon得分38.39（第二名25.74）。真机开箱评测（收鞋入柜等）平均成功率从无动作预训练的26%提升至75%（5B全量预训练），接触丰富的收鞋任务从0%提升至75%。微调新任务仅需平均不到10小时数据即达75%成功率，高数据设定下接近100%。论文显示预训练阶段数据量比模型规模更关键：在数十亿参数档位，数据多样性仍是主要瓶颈；从50%数据翻倍到100%还能再涨6个百分点。对复制scaling曲线的团队，建议优先搭建可扩数据源和自动标注流水线（论文用Qwen3.5-27B自动生成状态转移描述，约两周跑完10万小时）。论文代码和模型权重计划开源。
report_titles: 小米发布新一代VLA基座模型 Xiaomi-Robotics-1 :超10万小时真实数据训练,多项基准SOTA

arxiv.title: Xiaomi-Robotics-1: Scaling Vision-Language-Action Models with over 100K Hours of Real-World Trajectories
arxiv.abstract: We present Xiaomi-Robotics-1, a foundational vision-language-action (VLA) model capable of (1) following diverse language instructions to perform a wide range of mobile manipulation tasks in unseen environments out-of-the-box, and (2) efficiently adapting to novel downstream tasks with minimal fine-tuning data. We propose a two-stage training recipe consisting of pre-training and post-training. During pre-training, we imbue the model with broad and generalizable action-generation capabilities by training on over 100k hours of real-world manipulation trajectories collected via UMI devices. Crucially, we develop a scalable auto-labeling pipeline that annotates trajectory clips with natural languages describing scene state transitions, providing rich and precise conditioning for action learning. During post-training, we aim to align these capabilities with robot embodiments and imperative instructions that humans naturally use to prompt robots. Extensive experiments demonstrate strong scaling behavior. Xiaomi-Robotics-1 consistently improves with increased data scales and model sizes during pre-training. This scaling behavior directly transfers to post-training, where a stronger pre-training model yields better out-of-the-box real-robot performance in unseen environments. papers.title: Seed-Coder: Let the Code Model Curate Data for Itself
papers.report_title: 清华浙大等开源发布SEED:自进化OPD的长程Agent强化学习训练方法
papers.summary: SEED提出自进化在线策略蒸馏方法，解决长程Agent强化学习中最终奖励稀疏导致的信用分配问题。核心思想：训练时让Agent复盘自己刚完成的轨迹，生成事后复盘规则（hindsight skill），并将规则对动作的影响蒸馏回模型参数中（不增加推理负担）。方法分两阶段：第一阶段用外部分析器从离线轨迹生成技能，微调模型使其具备复盘能力；第二阶段在在线RL中，用当前策略同时采样轨迹并生成复盘规则，通过对比普通上下文和规则增强上下文下动作token的概率差，生成细粒度训练信号。在ALFWorld、WebShop、Search-based QA三类长程任务上，使用Qwen2.5-3B/7B和Qwen3-1.7B底座。关键结果：Qwen2.5-3B上ALFWorld平均成功率91.8%（GRPO 75.0%），WebShop成功率78.9%（GRPO 63.3%），Search-based QA准确率45.7%（GRPO 36.4%）。小模型增益更明显（Qwen3-1.7B ALFWorld从46.1%升至92.0%，WebShop成功率从38.3%升至77.3%）。样本效率：用60%数据达到超过GRPO全量数据的性能（80.7 vs 75.0）。在未见环境泛化上平均成功率从70.9%升至86.2%（Heat任务提升35.0个百分点）。消融表明：来自当前模型自身的在线技能（而非离线库）最关键，去掉后从91.8%降至84.4%。视觉任务（Sokoban、EZPoints）上平均成功率从77.0%升至91.0%。论文还分析了训练曲线：SEED在较早阶段就拉开差距，平均交互步数下降更快。边界：复盘可能继承模型盲点；训练成本上升（每条轨迹需额外生成规则和双通道打分）。但对依赖最终成败奖励的长程Agent任务，该方法有效缓解信用分配问题，推理时无额外开销。
report_titles: 清华浙大等开源发布SEED:自进化OPD的长程Agent强化学习训练方法

arxiv.title: Seed-Coder: Let the Code Model Curate Data for Itself
arxiv.abstract: Code data in large language model (LLM) pretraining is recognized crucial not only for code-related tasks but also for enhancing general intelligence of LLMs. Current open-source LLMs often heavily rely on human effort to produce their code pretraining data, such as employing hand-crafted filtering rules tailored to individual programming languages, or using human-annotated data to train quality filters. However, these approaches are inherently limited in scalability, prone to subjective biases, and costly to extend and maintain across diverse programming languages. To address these challenges, we introduce Seed-Coder, a series of open-source LLMs comprising base, instruct and reasoning models of 8B size, minimizing human involvement in data construction. Our code pretraining data is produced by a model-centric data pipeline, which predominantly leverages LLMs for scoring and filtering code data. The instruct model is further trained via supervised fine-tuning and preference optimization, and the reasoning model leverages Long-Chain-of-Thought (LongCoT) reinforcement learning to improve multi-step code reasoning. Seed-Coder achieves state-of-the-art results among open-source models of similar size and even surpasses some much larger models, demonstrating superior performance in code generation, code completion, code editing, code reasoning, and software engineering tasks.

papers.title: Harness Handbook: Making Evolving Agent Harnesses Readable,Navigable, and Editable
papers.report_title: 腾讯混元提出Harness Handbook:给 Agent harness 做一张可导航,可编辑,可读的行为地图
papers.summary: 腾讯混元HY LLM Frontier提出Harness Handbook，为Agent harness（提示拼接、工具调用、状态管理等运行时软件层）构建可导航、可校验、可随代码更新的行为地图。核心诉求：自然语言修改请求（如“删文件前询问用户”）需准确定位到代码中多个可能位置。手册分三层：系统总览（架构、执行模型、阶段）、阶段组件（初始化、规划、工具调用等）、源码锚点单元（带行为逻辑和源码定位器，包含状态索引）。自动构建流程：静态分析→模型行为标签（函数级或文件级）→合成打包。修改流程：BGPD定位→规划器写编辑计划→执行器改代码→同步手册。在Codex和Terminus-2两个开源harness上评测，每30条行为修改请求。规划器使用DeepSeek-V4-Pro，由三个评委独立评估计划质量（定位、范围、推理）。手册辅助规划胜率：Codex从28.3%升至38.3%，Terminus-2从26.7%升至45.6%，三个评委方向一致。同时规划token减少（Codex从10.2万降至8.9万，Terminus-2从5.8万降至5.3万）。定位指标全面改善：文件级和符号级召回、精确率、F1全部提升，Wrong比例最大下降25.9个百分点（Codex符号级从44.4%降到18.5%）。按请求类型拆分，Search-Hostile（不适合关键词搜索）和Cross-file请求受益最明显，提升达两位数百分点。消融显示：定位维度提升最直接，范围控制和推理也多数为正。论文强调手册必须随代码同步更新（非空diff后重校验），源码锚点失效则冻结。但只解决改前定位和规划，不保证改后正确性。适合行为跨阶段、跨状态、跨模块的修改场景。
papers.authors: 腾讯混元 HY LLM Frontier

arxiv.title: Harness Handbook: Making Evolving Agent Harnesses Readable,Navigable, and Editable
arxiv.abstract: The capability of a modern AI agent depends not only on its foundation model but also on its harness, which constructs prompts, manages state, invokes tools, and coordinates execution. As models, APIs, environments, and requirements evolve, the harness must be continually modified. Before such a change can be made, a developer or coding agent must identify all code locations that implement the target behavior. This is difficult because production harnesses are large, tightly coupled, and behaviorally distributed, while modification requests describe what the system should do and repositories are organized by files and modules. Code search, repository indexing, and long-context processing ease inspection, but still leave this behavior-to-code mapping to be recovered by hand. Behavior localization is therefore a central bottleneck in harness evolution. We introduce the Harness Handbook, a behavior-centric representation synthesized automatically from a harness codebase via static analysis and LLM-assisted structuring, linking each behavior to its corresponding source. We also introduce Behavior-Guided Progressive Disclosure (BGPD), which guides agents from high-level behaviors to relevant implementation details and verifies candidate locations against the current source. On diverse modification requests from two open-source harnesses, Handbook-Assisted planning improves behavior

papers.title: Beyond Prediction: Tail-Aware Scheduling for LLM Inference
papers.report_title: 大模型推理顶会论文分享---Beyond Prediction(ICML 2026)
papers.summary: 本文解读ICML 2026论文《Beyond Prediction: Tail-Aware Scheduling for LLM Inference》。该研究指出传统LLM调度器（如SJF/SRPT）依赖不可靠的输出长度预测，且多数工作仅优化平均延迟而忽视尾延迟。作者借鉴排队论中γBoost尾最优调度算法，提出UNIBOOST调度策略：通过参数α控制boost函数，动态在FCFS（保证等待时间）与LAS（优先短任务）之间切换，避免长请求饥饿。调度流程包括：基于MEMGUARD量化工作量、从prefill/decode队列优先级构建Batch、KV Cache空间不足时换出低优先级请求。实验在8×NVIDIA A100-80GB上使用Qwen-72B模型，对比Sarathi（DistBoost）、LAS、LTR和理想化SRPT（TRAIL+）。在高负载（ρ=0.99）下，UNIBOOST在TTFT、TTLT、TBT三个指标的尾部延迟上均优于所有基线。值得注意的是，该工作未开源代码且未指明推理框架，但其“不依赖输出预测”和“显式优化尾延迟”的思路对LLM推理系统设计具有重要参考价值。论文链接：https://icml.cc/virtual/2026/poster/63644

arxiv.title: Beyond Prediction: Tail-Aware Scheduling for LLM Inference
arxiv.abstract: LLM serving exhibits extreme length variability, making size-based scheduling difficult in practice. Recent LLM schedulers approximate SJF/SRPT using predicted decode lengths or ranks and primarily report mean-centric metrics such as TTFT and TBT. We show that these prediction-driven policies can be fragile under distribution shifts, bursty arrivals, and GPU memory pressure, while offering limited control over the tail latency (P90-P99) that dominates user experience, even with perfect decode-length knowledge. We introduce a distribution-aware, prediction-free scheduling framework that replaces explicit length prediction with soft priority boosting driven by lightweight statistical signals. Our design co-optimizes scheduling and cache-aware preemption to account for memory-coupled decode dynamics across workload mixes. Evaluated on production and open-source traces, our method reduces P99 TTLT by up to 35-50% relative to SRPT with perfect length knowledge and reduces TTFT by 34-47% across workloads, including reasoning-heavy and chat-heavy tasks. These results demonstrate a robust alternative for optimizing tail latency in online LLM serving.
arxiv.journal_ref: Forty-Third International Conference on Machine Learning (2026)

papers.title: PASCAL: A Phase-Aware Scheduling Algorithm for Serving Reasoning-based Large Language Models
papers.report_title: 大模型推理顶会论文分享---PASCAL(HPCA 2026)
papers.summary: 本文解读HPCA 2026论文《PASCAL: A Phase-Aware Scheduling Algorithm for Serving Reasoning-based Large Language Model》。文章针对DeepSeek-R1等reasoning-based LLM，指出其推理过程分为prefill、reasoning、answering三阶段，其中reasoning tokens对用户不可见但其生成延迟直接影响TTFT。现有调度器忽略这一差异，导致尾TTFT恶化。PASCAL调度器采用两层级设计：Instance-level调度决定请求分配到哪个GPU，优先选择KV Cache占用小或reasoning请求少的GPU；Intra-instance调度将reasoning请求置高优先级队列，answering请求置低优先级队列。当请求阶段切换时，调度器评估迁移代价并决定是否换GPU以平衡负载。实验使用DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B模型在8×H100 GPU上运行，利用AlpacaEval2.0和Arena-Hard数据集，对比FCFS和Round-Robin策略。结果显示PASCAL能有效降低reasoning-based LLM的tail TTFT，但若reasoning阶段输出过长，其效果退化至接近FCFS。论文链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.11530。代码未开源。该工作为推理加速领域开辟了“阶段感知调度”新方向，对优化长链推理模型的用户体验具有直接指导意义。

arxiv.title: PASCAL: A Phase-Aware Scheduling Algorithm for Serving Reasoning-based Large Language Models
arxiv.abstract: The emergence of reasoning-based LLMs leveraging Chain-of-Thought (CoT) inference introduces new serving challenges, as their extended reasoning phases delay user-visible output and inflate Time-To-First-Token (TTFT). Existing LLM serving frameworks fail to distinguish between reasoning and answering phases, leading to performance degradation under GPU memory constraints. We present PASCAL, a phase-aware scheduling algorithm that prioritizes reasoning to reduce TTFT while using controlled preemption and token pacing during answering to preserve Quality-of-Experience (QoE). Our hierarchical scheduler combines instance-level placement with intra-instance execution and enables dynamic migration at phase boundaries to balance load and reduce interference. Across benchmarks using DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B, PASCAL reduces tail TTFT by up to 72% while maintaining answering phase SLO attainment, demonstrating the importance of phase-aware scheduling for reasoning-based LLM deployment.

papers.title: Yuvion LLM: An Adversarially-Aware Large Language Model for Content And AI Safety
papers.report_title: 阿里安全AGI一次发布3款LLM,安全域8B多维度领先GPT-5.4
papers.summary: 阿里巴巴安全AGI实验室伏渊御风大模型团队发布三款Yuvion LLM，基于Qwen3系列训练。模型包括：Yuvion-8B（80亿参数，轻量版超越多数SOTA）、Yuvion-32B（320亿参数，旗舰版安全评测全面领先）、Yuvion-32B Agent（增加Agent RL阶段，业务能力进一步增强）。训练采用三阶段渐进式范式：知识增强继续预训练、基于GRPO的策略优化后训练、安全感知的Agentic RL训练。评测使用自建YLRE四级体系（93个评测集）：Level 1通用能力评测中，Yuvion-32B平均得分79.88%，相比未经安全特化的Qwen3-32B（80.99%）仅下降约1个百分点；Level 2开源内容安全评测中，Yuvion-32B平均Macro F1达78.2%，领先第二名4.3个百分点，中文安全场景ChineseHarm F1达97.9%，领先12.6个百分点，误报率仅0.18%（通用模型2.91%），降低16倍；Level 3静态对抗评测四类均最高分，动态对抗有效攻破率20.6%，比业界最低模型低1.7-3.8个百分点；Level 4内部业务评测综合得分86.34，领先GPT-5.4（80.40）近6个百分点，领先Qwen3-Max（81.41）4.37个百分点。论文链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.27632。模型权重已开源。

arxiv.title: Yuvion LLM: An Adversarially-Aware Large Language Model for Content And AI Safety
arxiv.abstract: As large language models are increasingly deployed in real-world systems, safety failures can still lead to harmful outputs and dangerous misuse. We argue that the essence of safety is adversarial: many failures arise not from natural inputs alone, but from strategic attempts to evade model policies and safeguards. However, existing general-purpose model development largely overlook this adversarial nature, and often remain insufficient for realistic safety scenarios involving planning, tool use, and multi-step reasoning, causing measured safety performance to overestimate real deployment robustness. To address this gap, we present Yuvion LLM, a large language model built for adversarially robust content safety and broader AI safety. Yuvion LLM treats adversarial robustness and agentic capability as first-class objectives. Its pipeline combines adversarially aware data construction, knowledge-enhanced continued pretraining, and policy-grounded multi-task safety post-training, including risk-aware supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning-based policy optimization, together with safety-aware agentic reinforcement learning for tool use and multi-step reasoning in complex safety scenarios. papers.title: FAIR GraphRAG: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation Approach for Semantic Data Analysis
papers.report_title: Call for paper (IF 5.8):截止2026年12月31日
papers.summary: 本文介绍了一项将FAIR Digital Object（FDO）嵌入GraphRAG的创新工作，旨在解决现有GraphRAG节点匿名、不可追溯、缺乏元数据标准化的问题。作者提出了FAIR GraphRAG框架，核心是为每个图节点赋予持久唯一标识符（PID）、元数据和本体链接，形成四层标准化对象（Bit sequence、Metadata、Operations、PID）。构建流水线包含五步：Schema定义（LLM few-shot生成JSON schema）、数据抽取（结构化数据规则映射，非结构化文本LLM one-shot填充）、转FDO（分配PID、抽取元数据、通过BioPortal API映射到1200+生物医学本体）、建关系（基于元数据或核心数据相似度，分为inner-dataset和cross-dataset）、入图（Neo4j）。检索环节采用查询式检索（Cypher/SPARQL），LLM生成查询语句直接访问图数据库，返回结果附带原始查询、命中FDO节点及完整元数据，实现完全可追溯。实验使用GEO RNA-seq数据集（GSE280797，8名pCCA患者，前80行），构建了1038节点KG。对比Non-FAIR GraphRAG，FAIR KG在总体准确率（92.86% vs 42.86%）、覆盖率（92.86% vs 42.86%）、可解释性（100% vs 受限）上显著领先，元数据问题准确率和本体问题准确率均达正常，而Non-FAIR为0%。Llama-3.3-70B效果差于gpt-4o-mini。FAIR合规性方面除R1.1外全部达标。该框架不局限于医疗，可推广至教育、商业等领域。

arxiv.title: FAIR GraphRAG: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation Approach for Semantic Data Analysis
arxiv.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) addresses the limitations of Large Language Models (LLMs) when providing responses to domain-specific questions. Graph-based RAG approaches, such as GraphRAG, enhance retrieval by capturing semantic relationships within knowledge graphs (KGs). While the FAIR principles (Findability, Accessibility, Interoperability, and Reusability) are becoming prevalent for scientific data management, especially in complex domains such as medicine, existing RAG approaches lack a structured FAIRification of the underlying knowledge resources. This lack limits their potential for FAIR information retrieval in these domains. To address this gap, we introduce FAIR GraphRAG, a novel framework that integrates FAIR Digital Objects (FDOs) as the fundamental units of a graph-based retrieval system. Each graph node represents an FDO that incorporates core data, metadata, persistent identifiers, and semantic links. We leverage LLMs to support schema construction and automated extraction of content and metadata from data sources. The framework was co-designed by physicians and computer scientists to ensure technical and clinical relevance. We apply FAIR GraphRAG to a biomedical dataset in gastroenterology, demonstrating its applicability to RNA-sequencing data. papers.title: Know More, Know Clearer: A Meta-Cognitive Framework for Knowledge Augmentation in Large Language Models
papers.report_title: 三分钟论文速递 | 如何确定大模型知道什么与不知道什么?
papers.summary: 本文解读ICML 2026论文《Know More, Know Clearer: A Meta-Cognitive Framework for Knowledge Augmentation in Large Language Models》。研究团队发现“结构衰减律”——模型预测正确率与不确定性之间呈稳定指数衰减关系，为元认知提供理论基础。基于此提出两阶段框架：第一阶段CGKE（认知引导知识扩展）将知识空间划分为掌握区、困惑区、缺失区，实施差异化数据增强（知识实例化、结构消歧、边界扩展）；第二阶段CDKC（认知驱动知识校准）通过认知一致性对齐机制，对正确路径强化置信度，对错误路径推动分布均匀化，理论证明可修复GRPO“保守陷阱”。在11个QA基准上，CDKC相比GRPO在Qwen2.5-7B上平均提升1.06%，在Llama-3.1-8B上提升1.73%；两轮迭代后Qwen额外提升3.32%，Llama提升4.06%。自我知识评估中，认知平衡得分达73.43%，远超次优方法的40.61%；期望校准误差降低超59%，模型内部不确定性成为真实性能的高保真代理。开源代码：https://github.com/AI9Stars/Know-More-Know-Clearer

arxiv.title: Know More, Know Clearer: A Meta-Cognitive Framework for Knowledge Augmentation in Large Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Knowledge augmentation has significantly enhanced the performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) in knowledge-intensive tasks. However, existing methods typically operate on the simplistic premise that model performance equates with internal knowledge, overlooking the knowledge-confidence gaps that lead to overconfident errors or uncertain truths. To bridge this gap, we propose a novel meta-cognitive framework for reliable knowledge augmentation via differentiated intervention and alignment. Our approach leverages internal cognitive signals to partition the knowledge space into mastered, confused, and missing regions, guiding targeted knowledge expansion. Furthermore, we introduce a cognitive consistency mechanism to synchronize subjective certainty with objective accuracy, ensuring calibrated knowledge boundaries. Extensive experiments demonstrate the our framework consistently outperforms strong baselines, validating its rationality in not only enhancing knowledge capabilities but also fostering cognitive behaviors that better distinguish knowns from unknowns. All codes are available at https://github.com/AI9Stars/Know-More-Know-Clearer.

papers.title: RLM-Cascade: Response-Level Speculative Decoding for Cost-Efficient LLM API Serving
papers.report_title: MIT团队把泛化写进Harness:短任务训练,解锁32倍长度外推
papers.summary: MIT CSAIL研究从同一30B底座出发，分别训练递归语言模型（RLM）与Transformer基线，仅在64K任务上训练，评测长度却达到训练时的8-32倍（最大约200万token）。RLM在长任务上的评测增幅约为Transformer基线的10倍，在MRCRv2上从64K扩展到约200万token，GraphWalks从不足128K延伸到100万token以上。RLM通过上下文卸载和程序化子agent调用实现“局部分布内”（LID），将长任务转化为局部调用，使每次模型调用尽量接近训练分布。实验显示，RLM在六项任务中均表现出更明显的长度外推，在MRCRv2、GraphWalks等任务上接近或超过GPT-5.5参考结果。跨域迁移测试中，RLM学到的策略更容易迁移到共享分解结构的新任务。训练耗时约为Transformer基线的1.5-3倍。研究揭示了harness作为组合泛化变量的新视角，为突破Transformer长度外推瓶颈提供了系统级方案。

arxiv.title: RLM-Cascade: Response-Level Speculative Decoding for Cost-Efficient LLM API Serving
arxiv.abstract: We present RLM-Cascade, a proxy-layer system that applies speculative decoding at the response level to reduce LLM API costs without requiring model architecture access or a shared vocabulary. A fast, inexpensive draft model generates a candidate response; a capable verify model accepts, enhances, or is bypassed entirely depending on a lightweight complexity router. On a real-world agentic coding workload (Claude Code), RLM-Cascade achieves a draft-use rate of 88.8% across 125 production requests, reducing API cost by 45.8% relative to a direct Opus baseline. Counter-intuitively, the proxy also reduces end-to-end latency: median response time is 2,026 ms versus 3,698 ms for Native Opus -- a 1.83X speedup at p50 -- because the SKIPPED path (DeepSeek only, no Opus call) dominates the workload distribution. Quality matches or exceeds the Opus baseline: 100% pass rate on a 20-task Code/Math/Instruct benchmark versus 95% for Native Opus. We further describe a rule-based complexity router that selects the SKIPPED path for simple agentic turns and a hybrid tool-call strategy that bypasses the speculative pipeline for schema-critical tool-selection turns. RLM-Cascade is deployed in production as an enterprise AI infrastructure component and published as open source with a live metrics dashboard and Prometheus endpoint.

papers.title: HORCRUX: A Complete PQC RISC-V eXtension Architecture
papers.report_title: 一颗芯片如何同时守住五条后量子防线?——HORCRUX统一PQC RISC-V扩展架构解读
papers.summary: 本文解读arXiv预印本论文《HORCRUX: A Complete PQC RISC-V eXtension Architecture》。HORCRUX是一套面向32位RISC-V处理器的后量子密码（PQC）指令扩展，通过56条自定义指令和统一协处理器同时加速ML-KEM、ML-DSA、SLH-DSA、HQC和Falcon五种NIST标准/候选算法。核心设计：共享Keccak单元、双模式32×32乘法器（普通整数+carry-less）、查表替代浮点乘法、1600位内部状态寄存器实现状态跨指令持久化。关键性能数据（周期加速倍数）：ML-KEM-1024最高6.06×，HQC-5最高27.1×，ML-DSA-87最高9.17×，SLH-DSA-128-fr密钥生成达到128.7×，但Falcon-512仅1.26-2.28×（受32位接口限制）。FPGA资源：在Zynq UltraScale+上增加20,196 LUT、4,429寄存器、11 DSP，最高频率42 MHz（因统一乘法树长组合路径）。ASIC评估（65nm, 160MHz）：SHA3-256能耗从28.1 nJ降至2.6 nJ。相比各算法独立实现，统一设计节省约51%面积。论文通过周期级剖析（表II）揭示各算法热点（如ML-KEM中Keccak占61.6%，HQC中vec_mul占95%），并给出完整的指令集映射和硬件架构图。该工作验证了在有限面积约束下实现多算法密码敏捷性的可行性。

arxiv.title: HORCRUX: A Complete PQC RISC-V eXtension Architecture
arxiv.abstract: This work presents a compact RISC-V extension for Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) called HORCRUX, which provides a unified Instruction-Set Extension (ISE) supporting all NIST-approved PQC algorithms. HORCRUX addresses the difficult trade-off between crypto-agility, high performance, and low resource consumption in constrained environments, a balance typically missing in hardware extensions that focus on limited PQC subsets. By targeting shared kernels across ML-KEM, MLDSA, SLH-DSA, HQC, and Falcon, the extension introduces new RISC-V instructions executed by a resource-efficient, tightly coupled coprocessor. This architecture is specifically optimized for embedded systems with strict energy budgets and limited area. Experimental evaluation on a Zynq UltraScale+ FPGA demonstrates speedups of up to 129x for hash-based, 9x for lattice-based, and 27x for code-based schemes, while adding fewer than 21k LUTs and 4.4k FFs. ASIC results from postsynthesis characterization in 65 nm CMOS are also reported, alongside a rigorous power characterization to validate the architecture's energy efficiency. The extension's modular structure maintains backward compatibility with standard RISC-V cores, offering a scalable solution for deploying PQC on constrained embedded systems.

papers.title: CrypFormBench: Benchmarking Formal Analysis Capability of Large Language Models for Cryptographic Schemes
papers.report_title: 【FSE'26 论文|大模型能不能看懂密码学协议】让大模型证明一个加密协议是安全的,现在的技术水平到哪一步了?
papers.summary: 本文解读中国科学院信息工程研究所等机构发表于FSE'26的论文CrypFormBench。该基准覆盖700个测试实例、677个密码学方案、7种主流形式化验证工具语言（包括Scyther、Tamarin、CryptoVerif、EasyCrypt等）和160种安全属性，评测了9个主流大模型在密码学形式化分析方面的五项核心能力：解释、生成、补全、转换、纠错。数据构建从4549个候选项目中筛选出700个高质量实例，涵盖经典身份认证、MPC、零知识证明、后量子密码等领域。结果显示，表现最好的Claude-3.5在满分100综合评分中仅获48.7分，其余模型分数普遍更低。模型在“理解已有内容”任务（解释、补全）上表现相对较好，在“主动构造正确内容”任务（生成、转换、纠错）上明显吃力。论文指出当前大模型距离独立完成密码学协议安全性证明还有显著差距，该基准为后续针对性微调或提示策略提供了细粒度诊断工具。论文链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.25561

arxiv.title: CrypFormBench: Benchmarking Formal Analysis Capability of Large Language Models for Cryptographic Schemes
arxiv.abstract: Manual formal analysis of cryptographic schemes is labor-intensive and requires substantial expertise. While model-checking tools (e.g., Scyther and Tamarin) and computational-security tools (e.g., CryptoVerif and EasyCrypt) improve the automation of security proofs, they still rely on experts to abstract schemes and write tool-specific formal descriptions. Large language models (LLMs) are a promising alternative, but their effectiveness in this domain remains unexplored due to the absence of standardized evaluation methodologies. To fill this gap, we introduce CrypFormBench (C.F.B for short), a comprehensive benchmark jointly covering symbolic and computational security to evaluate five core LLM capabilities: interpretation, generation, completion, transformation, and correction. It comprises 700 instances spanning 677 schemes, 7 mainstream formal verifier languages, and 160 security properties. The evaluation of 9 state-of-the-art LLMs reveals that most of them perform well on interpretation and completion, given their code-awareness advantages, but struggle with generation, transformation, and correction. Overall, their performance remains limited, with Claude-3.5 achieving the highest score at 48.7 out of 100. papers.title: AgenticNav: Zero-Shot Vision-and-Language Navigation as a Tool-Calling Harness
papers.report_title: [论文解读]大模型不必精通几何:AgenticNav用三个API重写零样本导航
papers.summary: 本文深度解读AgenticNav论文，提出一种仅用三个确定性API（query_depth、move_to、recall）的零样本视觉语言导航框架，将动作选择权完全交给VLM，同时由几何程序保证执行安全。关键性能数据：在R2R-CE val-unseen上使用GPT-5.5时，成功率55%，SPL 48.41%，分别比SmartWay高11和13.37个百分点；消融实验显示移除query_depth后成功率骤降至42%，移除recall后降至51%，证明按需深度查询是最大贡献因素。真实机器人测试（四视角）成功率达46.7%，是SmartWay（23.3%）的两倍。失败分析表明88.9%（仿真）和71.4%（真实）的失败源于VLM决策错误，而非工具接口。文章强调该方法不是端到端，而是通过工具调用分离语义理解与精确计算，让大模型专注于高层规划，底层约束由传统程序兜底。对从事具身智能和VLM导航的研究人员，AgenticNav提供了可复现的接口设计范式和明确的性能基线。

arxiv.title: AgenticNav: Zero-Shot Vision-and-Language Navigation as a Tool-Calling Harness
arxiv.abstract: Zero-shot vision-and-language navigation in continuous environments (VLN-CE) has recently become feasible with large vision-language models (VLMs). However, existing methods typically rely on learned waypoint predictors to propose navigable actions. This severely limits the model's action space and fails to leverage depth inputs effectively. Moreover, memory is commonly handled by accumulating long textual or visual histories with substantial irrelevant context, or by retrieving cross-episode experiences, which weakens the zero-shot setting. In this paper, we rethink zero-shot VLN-CE as an agentic interface between the VLM and the environment, and present AgenticNav, a lightweight navigation harness that exposes action, depth, and memory as callable tools. Instead of choosing from predicted waypoints, the action tool allows the VLM to directly select a target pixel in RGB observations, converting it into executable motion. Depth is exposed through an on-demand pixel-depth tool, enabling the VLM to request precise metric distances only where they matter. For memory, AgenticNav provides a compact map image summarizing the historical trajectory, paired with a recall tool that allows the VLM to selectively revisit past visual observations without overwhelming the prompt context. papers.title: GenCeption: Evaluate Vision LLMs with Unlabeled Unimodal Data
papers.report_title: 谷歌提出 GenCeption:视频生成也能训出通用视觉基座
papers.summary: Google DeepMind 在 ECCV 2026 上提出 GenCeption，探索将大规模文生视频扩散模型作为通用视觉预训练骨干的方法。核心思路是将视频生成模型（基于WAN 2.1）改造为单次前馈感知模型，通过文本指令切换任务，如深度估计、法线估计、相机位姿、前景分割、指代表达分割、3D人体关键点等。关键设计包括：1）单步前馈：固定扩散时间步为t=1（对应Rectified Flow终点），只执行一次前向传播，避免迭代采样；2）稠密任务统一映射到RGB三通道进行监督；3）稀疏任务通过可学习token加MLP解耦。实验结果显示：在Sintel数据集上，14B多任务模型的法线mAE达29.3，超越Lotus-2（30.3）和NormalCrafter（30.7）；深度AbsRel为0.130，优于DepthAnything 3的0.201、D4RT的0.148、VGGT-Ω的0.145；相机位姿ATE达0.050，优于VGGT-Ω的0.057。在3D人体关键点（EMDB）上MPJPE为71.8，优于Genmo（73.0）和GVHMR（72.6）。最值得注意的是数据效率：GenCeption仅用约1.23M帧合成数据微调，相较专有模型（如DepthAnything 3）的训练数据量少7×到500×倍。消融实验证明，视频生成骨干（WAN 2.1）显著优于V-JEPA和VideoMAE V2。此外，模型展示了涌现能力：仅在合成人体视频上训练，却能零样本泛化到真实猫、机器人等未见类别，且输出细节优于训练标签。本文还讨论了联合训练与单任务训练的权衡，以及稀疏关键点任务在联合训练中的退化问题。整体而言，GenCeption为视觉通用感知提供了一条以视频生成预训练为核心的数据高效路径，与LLM将万物统一为token的思路类似。
report_titles: 谷歌提出 GenCeption:视频生成也能训出通用视觉基座

arxiv.title: GenCeption: Evaluate Vision LLMs with Unlabeled Unimodal Data
arxiv.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are typically assessed using expensive annotated multimodal benchmarks, which often lag behind the rapidly evolving demands of MLLM evaluation. This paper outlines and validates GenCeption, a novel, annotation-free evaluation method that requires only unimodal data to measure inter-modality semantic coherence and inversely assesses MLLMs' tendency to hallucinate. This approach eliminates the need for costly data annotation, minimizes the risk of training data contamination, is expected to result in slower benchmark saturation, and avoids the illusion of emerging abilities. Inspired by the DrawCeption game, GenCeption begins with a non-textual sample and proceeds through iterative description and generation steps. The semantic drift across iterations is quantified using the GC@T metric. While GenCeption is principally applicable to MLLMs across various modalities, this paper focuses on its implementation and validation for Vision LLMs (VLLMs). Based on the GenCeption method, we establish the MMECeption benchmark for evaluating VLLMs, and compare the performance of several popular VLLMs and human annotators. Our empirical results validate GenCeption's effectiveness, demonstrating strong correlations with established VLLM benchmarks. VLLMs still significantly lag behind human performance and struggle especially with text-intensive tasks.

papers.title: EvoGraph-R1: Self-Evolving Multimodal Knowledge Hypergraphs for Agentic Retrieval
papers.report_title: GraphRAG活了,港大CVPR自演化新作杀疯了
papers.summary: 本文深度解读了港大提出的EvoGraph-R1框架，将多模态知识图谱建模为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），通过强化学习让智能体在推理过程中动态编辑图结构，突破了传统GraphRAG离线建图后推理时静态固定的瓶颈。核心贡献包括：① 设计多模态超图构建流程，融合文本与视觉子图；② 定义四个动作——GraphRetrieve、WebSearch、GraphEdit（Insert/Update/Delete）、Answer，让智能体边检索边改图；③ 采用GRPO优化策略，奖励整合正确性、结构完整性和效率。实验在文本和多模态任务上取得双SOTA：文本任务上，对比最强基线Graph-R1，2WikiMultiHopQA F1提升3.5%达68.5%，HotpotQA提升2.7%达65.4%，Natural Questions提升6.9%达56.8%；多模态任务上，E-VQA达43.6%（比MMSearch-R1高6.7%），OK-VQA达68.6%（比GPT-4o-mini高2.7%）。消融实验显示INSERT操作最关键（去掉后2Wiki降8.4%/E-VQA降6.8%且多0.8轮检索），低资源场景（仅1%语料）下超基线13.2-18.9个百分点。该工作揭示动态改图在知识稀缺时的最大价值，方向清晰：GraphRAG不应是一次性查图，图谱需随推理共同演化。
report_titles: GraphRAG活了,港大CVPR自演化新作杀疯了

arxiv.title: EvoGraph-R1: Self-Evolving Multimodal Knowledge Hypergraphs for Agentic Retrieval
arxiv.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has emerged as a critical paradigm for grounding Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) in external knowledge. Recent GraphRAG methods introduce structured entity-relation graphs to improve retrieval and reasoning. However, they remain limited by treating knowledge graphs as static data structures built offline and queried in a single pass. This static paradigm misaligns with the interactive, iterative nature of knowledge-intensive reasoning, creating three bottlenecks: (i) text-centric fragmentation that impedes cross-modal reasoning, (ii) frozen structures unable to incorporate new evidence or correct errors, and (iii) rigid single-pass retrieval without adaptive refinement. To overcome these limitations, we introduce EvoGraph-R1, a self-evolving GraphRAG framework that reconceptualizes knowledge graphs as dynamic environments shaped through agent interactions. We formulate retrieval as a Markov Decision Process (MDP) where the agent observes the graph state and executes actions to query (GraphRetrieve), expand (WebSearch), refine (GraphEdit), or terminate (Answer) the reasoning. These actions reshape the hypergraph structure and generate feedback signals that guide subsequent evolution. Through this closed loop, the hypergraph evolves by integrating new evidence, correcting errors, and refining structure to support multi-hop reasoning.

papers.title: ScaleCUA: Scaling Open-Source Computer Use Agents with Cross-Platform Data
papers.report_title: 清华&智谱开源发布ScaleCUA:可扩展的任务合成和在线强化学习 GUI Agent框架,9B模型刷新开源SOTA
papers.summary: 本文介绍了清华与智谱联合开源的ScaleCUA框架，用于训练计算机使用智能体（CUA），涵盖可验证任务合成（VeriGen）、前沿采样（Frontier Sampling）和视觉上下文切分（Visual Context Segmentation）。核心数据：基于Qwen3.5-9B的模型在OSWorld上达到68.7%（超越闭源Claude Sonnet 4.5的62.9%以及开源Kimi K2.5的63.3%），在ScienceBoard上达到54.0%（略高于Claude Opus 4.6的52.7%）。VeriGen产出了24K+可验证候选任务，最终约3K条进入高质量RL池，裁判可执行率达到94.5%。消融实验：去掉VeriGen后OSWorld成绩从68.7%降至43.9%；去掉前沿采样降至63.7%；去掉视觉上下文切分降至62.2%。视觉上下文切分相对逐步分解实现约2.83倍加速（单步总时间从750s降至265s），且不损伤正确率。轨迹引导合成使OSWorld从64.6%提升至68.7%。论文还展示了47步跨应用任务（安装GNOME主题）的端到端完成。
report_titles: 清华&智谱开源发布ScaleCUA:可扩展的任务合成和在线强化学习 GUI Agent框架,9B模型刷新开源SOTA

arxiv.title: ScaleCUA: Scaling Open-Source Computer Use Agents with Cross-Platform Data
arxiv.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have enabled computer use agents (CUAs) that operate GUIs autonomously, showing great potential, yet progress is limited by the lack of large-scale, open-source computer use data and foundation models. In this work, we introduce ScaleCUA, a step toward scaling open-source CUAs. It offers a large-scale dataset spanning 6 operating systems and 3 task domains, built via a closed-loop pipeline uniting automated agents with human experts. Trained on this scaled-up data, ScaleCUA can operate seamlessly across platforms. Specifically, it delivers strong gains over baselines (+26.6 on WebArena-Lite-v2, +10.7 on ScreenSpot-Pro) and sets new state-of-the-art results (94.4% on MMBench-GUI L1-Hard, 60.6% on OSWorld-G, 47.4% on WebArena-Lite-v2). These findings underscore the power of data-driven scaling for general-purpose computer use agents. We will release data, models, and code to advance future research: https://github.com/OpenGVLab/ScaleCUA.

papers.title: LegalWorld: A Life-Cycle Interactive Environment for Legal Agents
papers.report_title: LegalWorld司法角色扮演·智能体训练|打造法律智能体的全生命周期模拟世界
papers.summary: 论文构建LegalWorld，一个基于LLM多智能体驱动的中国民事诉讼全生命周期模拟环境。核心数据：基于75,309对真实一审-二审民事判决，覆盖500+案由。环境沿五个阶段、七个子场景推进：法律咨询→一审文书→一审庭审→上诉文书→二审庭审。内置客户、律师、法官三类异构Agent（客户采用Legal Client Persona Framework从法律素养等四维度塑造），通过双层记忆机制（场景内局部记忆+跨阶段全局记忆）保证长程一致性，配备6类法律Skill与17类Tool（法条检索、文书导出等）。构建LongJud-Bench评估基准，将律师能力拆为8个维度。环境可靠性验证：邀请217位法律背景评审，收集18,992条评分，阶段真实性8.96/10、角色一致性8.98/10。实验显示不同LLM（如Claude-Sonnet-4.6、GPT等）在咨询、文书、庭审等子能力上各有优劣，庭审环节仍是共同难点。探索性实验Reflective Legal Skill：利用完整诉讼轨迹生成反思技能，在离婚后财产、民间借贷、劳动争议三类案由上总分从61.56提升至65.29（+3.73分），且可迁移至held-out案件。提供在线交互和MCP Server接口。
report_titles: LegalWorld司法角色扮演·智能体训练|打造法律智能体的全生命周期模拟世界

arxiv.title: LegalWorld: A Life-Cycle Interactive Environment for Legal Agents
arxiv.abstract: Civil litigation is inherently a life-cycle process: what a lawyer drafts on day one constrains what unfolds at trial months later. Yet existing legal benchmarks evaluate isolated subtasks, and prior legal-agent simulators reinitialize each scenario from shared ground truth, leaving cross-stage causal dependencies unmodeled. We present LegalWorld, a life-cycle interactive environment that models Chinese civil litigation as a causally connected state chain of five stages (seven sub-scenarios), grounded in 75,309 paired Chinese civil judgments. We pair it with reusable infrastructure (local memory, global case memory, a Skill/Tool library) that keeps each dispute consistent across its full life cycle. Building on this environment, we construct LongJud-Bench to evaluate agent capability across all five connected stages. 18,992 ratings from 217 legal-background evaluators confirm that LegalWorld trajectories are procedurally faithful and role-consistent; and a capability-level cross-model evaluation reveals sharp divergences that aggregate scores cannot expose, with no single backbone leading across consultation, drafting, and courtroom advocacy. Detailed resources will be released publicly.

papers.title: Verbalized Sampling: How to Mitigate Mode Collapse and Unlock LLM Diversity
papers.report_title: 提示词工程论文登上ICML2026,网友吵翻了天
papers.summary: 一篇仅修改提示词的论文被ICML 2026接收引发争议。论文提出Verbalized Sampling（VS）方法，通过提示模型输出完整概率分布（如“生成5个笑话并分配概率值”），有效缓解LLM的模式坍缩问题。核心发现：问题根源在于训练偏好数据中的“典型性偏差”（人类标注者偏爱熟悉文本），而非传统归因的算法缺陷。在五个偏好数据集和不同基座模型上验证，创意写作任务中VS输出多样性是普通提示的1.6~2.1倍，且不降低事实准确性和安全性。模型能力越强效果越明显。支持者认为研究提供了完整问题溯源、新理论归因、数学推导和多维实验，贡献不亚于CoT（最初也是简单Prompt）。反对者质疑创新薄弱、方法并非独创、实验规模有限。论文由美国东北大学Weiyan Shi团队联合斯坦福Manning实验室等完成，第一作者包括Jiayi Zhang、Simon Yu、Derek Chong。此事件凸显机器学习领域对“推理阶段技术”价值的认知分歧，以及学科规范问题。
papers.authors: 东北大学、斯坦福Manning实验室等

arxiv.title: Verbalized Sampling: How to Mitigate Mode Collapse and Unlock LLM Diversity
arxiv.abstract: Post-training alignment often reduces LLM diversity, leading to a phenomenon known as mode collapse. Unlike prior work that attributes this effect to algorithmic limitations, we identify a fundamental, pervasive data-level driver: typicality bias in preference data, whereby annotators systematically favor familiar text as a result of well-established findings in cognitive psychology. We formalize this bias theoretically, verify it on preference datasets empirically, and show that it plays a central role in mode collapse. Motivated by this analysis, we introduce Verbalized Sampling, a simple, training-free prompting strategy to circumvent mode collapse. VS prompts the model to verbalize a probability distribution over a set of responses (e.g., "Generate 5 jokes about coffee and their corresponding probabilities"). Comprehensive experiments show that VS significantly improves performance across creative writing (poems, stories, jokes), dialogue simulation, open-ended QA, and synthetic data generation, without sacrificing factual accuracy and safety. For instance, in creative writing, VS increases diversity by 1.6-2.1x over direct prompting. We further observe an emergent trend that more capable models benefit more from VS. In sum, our work provides a new data-centric perspective on mode collapse and a practical inference-time remedy that helps unlock pre-trained generative divers

papers.title: MAD-OPD: Breaking the Ceiling in On-Policy Distillation via Multi-Agent Debate
papers.report_title: 突破OPD教师天花板!淘天*华科大提出MAD-OPD:让小模型学会＂老师们争出来的答案＂
papers.summary: 本文提出MAD-OPD，一种打破单教师知识蒸馏天花板的多教师辩论蒸馏框架。核心问题在于传统On-Policy Distillation (OPD)中，学生模型仅从单一教师获取监督信号，当教师存在盲点（如工具调用算错日期、代码生成选择不一致路径）时，错误会直接写入训练目标。MAD-OPD引入多教师辩论机制：多个教师围绕学生当前状态进行多轮辩论（每步n个教师k轮），互相纠错后形成共识，再经置信度加权得到聚合监督信号。训练目标采用JSD散度（Agentic任务）或反向KL（代码生成任务）以避免长轨迹梯度爆炸。实验在Qwen3 14B+8B → 4B蒸馏设定下验证：在Agentic基准（BFCL-v4、τ²-Bench、VitaBench）上，MAD-OPD Agentic Avg达25.69，对比单教师OPD的23.26；代码生成（LiveCodeBench v6、MBPP+）Code Avg达48.12，对比单教师OPD的44.41。最值得关注的是在LiveCodeBench v6上，4B学生pass@1达到29.83，反超14B教师（25.57）4.26个百分点；BoN@16下4B学生达43.43 vs 教师33.14。消融实验显示：辩论轮次以2轮为最优，置信度加权带来+1.52提升。MAD-OPD本质是将教师池中分散的局部正确性组织成更强的训练信号，使教师从答案提供者转变为彼此的错误检测器。代码已开源。

arxiv.title: MAD-OPD: Breaking the Ceiling in On-Policy Distillation via Multi-Agent Debate
arxiv.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own trajectories under token-level teacher supervision, but existing methods are capped by a single-teacher capability ceiling: when the teacher errs, the student inherits the error. OPD also remains largely unexplored in agentic tasks, where per-step errors compound across long trajectories and destabilize training. We propose MAD-OPD (Multi-Agent Debate-driven On-Policy Distillation), which breaks this ceiling by recasting the distillation teacher as a deliberative collective of teachers that debate over the student's on-policy state; the debate produces an emergent collective intelligence that supplies token-level supervision, with each teacher's contribution weighted by its post-debate confidence. To extend OPD to agentic tasks, we also introduce On-Policy Agentic Distillation (OPAD), which adds step-level sampling to stabilize training under multi-step error compounding. We additionally derive a task-adaptive divergence principle, selecting JSD (Jensen-Shannon divergence) for agentic stability and reverse KL (Kullback-Leibler) divergence for code generation, and verify it both theoretically and empirically. papers.title: Stratum: System-Hardware Co-Design with Tiered Monolithic 3D-Stackable DRAM for Efficient MoE Serving
papers.report_title: 把“热门专家”放进更快的内存层:Stratum如何用单片3D DRAM重构MoE推理系统?
papers.summary: 本文深度解读发表于MICRO 2025的论文《Stratum: System-Hardware Co-Design with Tiered Monolithic 3D-Stackable DRAM for Efficient MoE Serving》，提出一种面向MoE推理的系统-硬件协同设计。核心亮点是利用单片3D堆叠DRAM（Mono3D DRAM）的垂直分层延迟差异，将8个逻辑Tier暴露给系统软件，通过主题感知调度将热门专家权重放入快速层，冷门专家放入慢速层，实现内存内部数据迁移（开销<1%）。实验数据显示：与GPU基线相比，Stratum在OLMoE-1B-7B、Mixtral 8×7B、Qwen2.5-32B、LLaMA-4 Scout上分别获得8.29倍、5.39倍、6.13倍、4.48倍的解码吞吐率提升，以及7.66倍、2.74倍、3.51倍、4.87倍的能效提升；相比已有Duplex方案吞吐率提升2.2~3.0倍。硬件参数上，1024层Mono3D DRAM单芯片容量32 GB，内部带宽约19~30 TB/s，存储密度2.156 Gb/mm²（约DDR5的5.2倍），逻辑裸片集成6.4万个FP16 MAC单元，峰值算力128 TFLOPS，功耗仅42.67 W，有效面积76.63 mm²。论文还验证了主题分类器（6700万参数DistilBERT）在MMLU上94.5%准确率，聚合热门专家命中率最高达68.9%。该工作从请求语义到物理存储布局建立了完整跨层优化链路，值得关注Mono3D DRAM工艺成熟度及1024层堆叠的前瞻性。

arxiv.title: Stratum: System-Hardware Co-Design with Tiered Monolithic 3D-Stackable DRAM for Efficient MoE Serving
arxiv.abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) continue to evolve, Mixture of Experts (MoE) architecture has emerged as a prevailing design for achieving state-of-the-art performance across a wide range of tasks. MoE models use sparse gating to activate only a handful of expert sub-networks per input, achieving billion-parameter capacity with inference costs akin to much smaller models. However, such models often pose challenges for hardware deployment due to the massive data volume introduced by the MoE layers. To address the challenges of serving MoE models, we propose Stratum, a system-hardware co-design approach that combines the novel memory technology Monolithic 3D-Stackable DRAM (Mono3D DRAM), near-memory processing (NMP), and GPU acceleration. The logic and Mono3D DRAM dies are connected through hybrid bonding, whereas the Mono3D DRAM stack and GPU are interconnected via silicon interposer. Mono3D DRAM offers higher internal bandwidth than HBM thanks to the dense vertical interconnect pitch enabled by its monolithic structure, which supports implementations of higher-performance near-memory processing. papers.title: Beyond Prediction -- Structuring Epistemic Integrity in Artificial Reasoning Systems
papers.report_title: 大模型推理顶会论文分享---Beyond Prediction(ICML 2026)
papers.summary: 该论文提出UNIBOOST调度算法，针对LLM推理的尾延迟优化问题。借鉴γBoost理论，通过参数τ在FCFS（公平等待）和LAS（短任务优先）之间动态调整调度行为，避免依赖不可靠的输出长度预测。调度流程包括MEMGUARD工作量量化、boost优先级计算、KV Cache换出管理。实验使用8张NVIDIA A100 80GB GPU，部署Qwen-72B模型，在系统利用率ρ=0.99的高负载场景下，UNIBOOST在TTFT、TTLT、TBT三个指标的尾延迟上均优于Sarathi（DistBoost）、LAS、LTF（基于长度预测的SJF）及理想化TRAIL+（SRPT）。论文指出当前大部分工作只优化平均延迟而忽视尾延迟，该工作填补了该空白。对于进行LLM推理系统设计与调度的研究者，该调度策略具有直接的参考和复现价值。
report_titles: 大模型推理顶会论文分享---Beyond Prediction(ICML 2026)

arxiv.title: Beyond Prediction -- Structuring Epistemic Integrity in Artificial Reasoning Systems
arxiv.abstract: This paper develops a comprehensive framework for artificial intelligence systems that operate under strict epistemic constraints, moving beyond stochastic language prediction to support structured reasoning, propositional commitment, and contradiction detection. It formalises belief representation, metacognitive processes, and normative verification, integrating symbolic inference, knowledge graphs, and blockchain-based justification to ensure truth-preserving, auditably rational epistemic agents.

papers.title: Past-Future Scheduler for LLM Serving under SLA Guarantees
papers.report_title: 大模型推理顶会论文分享--- Past-Future Scheduler(ASPLOS 2025)
papers.summary: 该文详细解读了ASPLOS 2025上发表的Past-Future Scheduler架构，核心目标是解决LLM服务中SLA约束下的调度优化问题。当前主流调度器面临两难：保守调度按最大输出长度预留KV cache，导致batch size偏小、吞吐降低；激进调度按较短长度估计，虽提高吞吐但易触发eviction进而违反SLA。作者指出根本原因在于（1）计算运行中请求未来内存需求困难，（2）低开销预测请求输出长度困难。文章提出了基于历史请求输出长度分布预测未来KV cache峰值的调度策略：利用滑动窗口内请求长度分布的余弦相似性（实验验证多个数据集均有高相似性），动态更新预测；并模拟新请求加入后峰值内存是否超标。基于该策略实现了LightLLM框架，调度器使用GPU并行执行，开销仅占模型推理的1%。实验使用Llama2系列模型，对比对象包括Text-Generation-Inference（保守调度）、vLLM（激进调度）、DeepSpeed-MII/FastGen。结果显示Past-Future Scheduler在多数负载下取得了更高的goodput（满足SLA的有效吞吐），同时避免了激进调度中的eviction和SLA violation。该工作为LLM服务调度提供了可预测、低开销的内存管理新范式，值得关注其在更大模型（如70B）和复杂工作负载下的扩展性。
