arxiv.title: Past-Future Scheduler for LLM Serving under SLA Guarantees
arxiv.abstract: The exploration and application of Large Language Models (LLMs) is thriving. To reduce deployment costs, continuous batching has become an essential feature in current service frameworks. The effectiveness of continuous batching relies on an accurate estimate of the memory requirements of requests. However, due to the diversity in request output lengths, existing frameworks tend to adopt aggressive or conservative schedulers, which often result in significant overestimation or underestimation of memory consumption. Consequently, they suffer from harmful request evictions or prolonged queuing times, failing to achieve satisfactory throughput under strict Service Level Agreement (SLA) guarantees (a.k.a. goodput), across various LLM application scenarios with differing input-output length distributions. To address this issue, we propose a novel Past-Future scheduler that precisely estimates the peak memory resources required by the running batch via considering the historical distribution of request output lengths and calculating memory occupancy at each future time point. It adapts to applications with all types of input-output length distributions, balancing the trade-off between request queuing and harmful evictions, thereby consistently achieving better goodput. papers.title: JITServe: SLO-aware LLM Serving with Imprecise Request Information
papers.report_title: 大模型推理顶会论文分享---JITServe(NSDI 2026)
papers.summary: 该文解读了NSDI 2026上的JITServe系统，针对LLM服务中请求信息不精确（到达率、执行时间、输出长度未知）且多类型负载（latency-sensitive、deadline-sensitive、compound）共存的场景，提出了SLO感知的Just-in-Time调度方法。核心贡献包括：（1）分析器使用分位数回归森林（QRF）预测输出长度上界，每次预测仅7ms，比BERT快7倍；同时构建Pattern Graph（<0.2KB，500个图匹配<5ms）预测多任务依赖关系。（2）调度器执行Grouped Margin Goodput Maximization（GMAX）算法，为每个请求分配刚好满足SLO的最少服务带宽，并将输入长度相近的请求组批。当策略非最优时，根据抢占收益与KV Cache迁移成本比较决定是否抢占。（3）SLO Tracker实时修正执行预测。基于vLLM实现（新增2800行代码），在16张A100上测试Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-14B、Qwen3-30B-MoE-A3B、Llama-3.1-70B。工作负载包括chatbot、deep research、agentic code generation、math reasoning。对比vLLM、Sarathi-Serve、Autellix、LTR。实验结果显示JITServe提升1.4-6.3倍goodput，或在相同goodput下节省28.5%-83.2%资源。SLO设置：latency-sensitive（TTFT ~2s，TBT ~100ms）、deadline-sensitive（E2EL 20s）、compound（20×阶段数秒）。该工作首次系统地利用不精确信息优化多类型负载的SLO满足率，对Agent/Multi-Agent场景有重要参考价值。

arxiv.title: JITServe: SLO-aware LLM Serving with Imprecise Request Information
arxiv.abstract: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into applications ranging from interactive chatbots to multi-agent systems has introduced a wide spectrum of service-level objectives (SLOs) for responsiveness. These include latency-sensitive requests emphasizing per-token latency in streaming chat, deadline-sensitive requests requiring rapid full responses to trigger external tools, and compound requests with evolving dependencies across multiple LLM calls. Despite-or perhaps, because of-this workload diversity and unpredictable request information (e.g., response lengths and dependencies), existing request schedulers have focused on aggregate performance, unable to ensure application-level SLO needs. This paper presents JITServe, the first SLO-aware LLM serving system designed to maximize service goodput (e.g., the number of tokens meeting request SLOs) across diverse workloads. JITServe novelly schedules requests using imprecise request information and gradually relaxes this conservatism by refining request information estimates as generation progresses. It applies a grouped margin goodput maximization algorithm to allocate just enough serving bandwidth to satisfy each request's SLO just-in-time (JIT), maximizing residual capacity for others, while deciding the composition of requests in a batch to maximize efficiency and goodput with provable guarantees. papers.title: RynnWorld-4D: 4D Embodied World Models for Robotic Manipulation
papers.report_title: 阿里达摩院发布4D世界模型 RynnWorld-4D:给世界模型装上深度和光流
papers.summary: 阿里达摩院提出RynnWorld-4D，一种联合生成RGB、深度图和光流的4D世界模型，用于机器人灵巧操作。骨干采用Wan 2.2-TI2V-5B（30层DiT），扩展为RGB/depth/flow三分支，每3层通过Joint Cross-Modal Attention进行像素级融合，并使用3D RoPE保持空间对齐。训练数据为Rynn4DDataset 1.0，包含2.544亿帧，人类第一人称视频与机器人操作视频混合，每帧带指令字幕、单目深度和稠密光流伪标签。在真机六项双臂任务上，盖盒盖与叠碗成功率均达65.71%，比Diffusion Policy高出约8.57个百分点；交接物体任务达28.57%，而基线为0%。消融实验表明，去除世界模型仅用ResNet-18后Dual Picking从94.29%降至71.43%；去掉4D预训练后光流AEPE从0.170恶化至0.729。生成质量方面，相对深度误差AbsRel为0.310，光流AEPE为0.170。策略部分RynnWorld-4D-Policy直接提取中间隐状态，经Flow Former压缩后以流匹配动作头生成10步动作块，单次规划约1.1秒（世界模型前向占90%），有效控制频率约9 Hz。论文明确承认扩散去噪成本高、深度/光流受伪标签上限制约、仅支持第一人称视角等局限性。
report_titles: 阿里达摩院发布4D世界模型 RynnWorld-4D:给世界模型装上深度和光流

arxiv.title: RynnWorld-4D: 4D Embodied World Models for Robotic Manipulation
arxiv.abstract: Robotic manipulation in the open world requires not only recognizing what a scene looks like, but also anticipating how its 3D structure moves under interaction. We argue that synchronized RGB, depth, and optical flow, namely RGB-DF, provide a physically grounded representation that captures the underlying 4D dynamics of a scene. Compared to 2D pixel videos, this multi-modal synergy aligns visual appearance with geometric structure and temporal motion, creating a representation space significantly closer to the low-level end-effector actions demanded by robotic systems, thereby narrowing the gap between world prediction and policy learning. Building on this insight, we introduce RynnWorld-4D, a generative model that co-produces future RGB frames, depth maps, and optical flow from a single RGB-D image and a language instruction within one unified diffusion process. This 4D world model features a tri-branch architecture that integrates cross-modal attention with frame-wise 3D RoPE, ensuring that appearance, geometry, and motion evolve consistently. To supply training data at scale, we curate Rynn4DDataset 1.0, a massive dataset of over 254.4 million frames across egocentric human and robotic manipulation videos with high-quality pseudo-labels for depth and optical flow. papers.report_title: 百度把 DeepSeek-OCR 往前推了一大步,一次能扫 40 页 PDF
papers.summary: 百度开源的 Unlimited-OCR 模型在长文档 OCR 领域实现了突破性进展，核心创新在于将 DeepSeek-OCR 解码器的全注意力层替换为 R-SWA（参考滑动窗口注意力）机制，模拟人类抄书时“只关注输入端+最近输出端”的注意力模式。在 OmniDocBench v1.5 基准上，Unlimited-OCR 综合评分从 DeepSeek-OCR 基线的 87.01 提升至 93.23，提升 6.22 个百分点；文本编辑距离降至 0.038（基线 0.073），公式识别 CDM 提升 9.24 个百分点至 92.61，阅读顺序编辑距离从 0.086 降至 0.045。最关键的突破在于长距离解析：单次前向可处理 40 多页 PDF，且 KV Cache 全程恒定（约 256+128=384 token 的缓存，而全注意力机制在输出 20,000 token 时缓存膨胀至约 47 倍）。长距离测试中，40+ 页时编辑距离仅 0.107，Distinct-35 保持在 96.90% 以上。推理效率方面，Unlimited-OCR 的 TPS 在输出 6144 token 时比 DeepSeek-OCR 提升 34.8%（7847 vs 5822）。模型总参数量 3B，激活参数量约 500M（MoE 架构），训练仅 4000 步且冻结视觉编码器，使用 8×16 A800 GPU 在 DeepSeek-OCR 基础上微调。该工作在 3B 参数规模下超越了 Qwen3-VL（235B）和 InternVL3.5（241B）等超大模型，标志着长文档 OCR 质量标准的整体提升。
report_titles: 百度把 DeepSeek-OCR 往前推了一大步,一次能扫 40 页 PDF

arxiv.title: Unlimited OCR Works
arxiv.abstract: Recently, end-to-end OCR models, exemplified by DeepSeek OCR, have once again thrust OCR into the spotlight. A widely held view is that employing a large language model (LLM) as the decoder allows the model to leverage the prior distribution of language, leading to improved OCR performance. However, the downside is equally evident: as the output sequence lengthens, the accumulated KV cache drives up memory consumption and progressively slows down generation. This stands in stark contrast to humans, who exhibit no such decline in efficiency during long-horizon copying tasks. In this technical report, we propose Unlimited OCR, a model designed to emulate human parsing working memory. Taking DeepSeek OCR as the baseline, we replace all attention layers in the decoder with our proposed Reference Sliding Window Attention (R-SWA), which reduces attention computation costs while maintaining a constant KV cache throughout the entire decoding process. By combining the high compression rate of DeepSeek OCR's encoder with our constant KV cache design, Unlimited OCR can transcribe dozens of pages of documents in a single forward pass under a standard maximum length of 32K. More importantly, R-SWA is a general-purpose parsing attention mechanism - beyond OCR, it is equally applicable to tasks such as ASR, translation, etc. Codes and model weights are publicly available at http://github.com/

papers.title: Weak-to-Strong Generalization via Direct On-Policy Distillation
papers.report_title: 清华&字节Seed发布 Direct-OPD:小模型先做强化学习,强模型也能直接受益
papers.summary: 清华大学AIR与字节跳动Seed联合提出Direct-OPD（Weak-to-Strong Generalization via Direct On-Policy Distillation），通过迁移小模型强化学习前后的策略变化（概率差）来训练更强模型，无需额外奖励模型。核心创新：提取小模型RL前后的对数概率差作为隐式奖励，在强模型自生成的推理前缀上逐token进行加权监督。在AIME 2024/2025上取得显著提升：Qwen3-1.7B从48.3%提升至58.3%（+10.0pp），Qwen3-4B从72.5%升至77.6%，R1-Distill-7B从56.7%升至63.1%。迁移仅需8张A100约4小时（32 GPU-hours），而直接训练7B需10240 GPU-hours。多阶段叠加实验：Qwen3-1.7B先后接受JustRL和QuestA两组策略变化后，AIME 2024达63.8%，AIME 2025达46.8%。消融表明：响应长度2k最优；自适应KL约束可防止学生偏离过远；学生并未简单复制教师策略（token重叠率低、熵稳定）。方法适用于不同模型家族（Qwen3、R1-Distill），且学生初始能力可高于小教师。限制：需小模型稳定完成RL，且学生访问的推理前缀在教师策略下需有足够概率。论文链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05394

arxiv.title: Weak-to-Strong Generalization via Direct On-Policy Distillation
arxiv.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is a powerful recipe for improving language-model reasoning, but it is expensive to repeat on every new strong model because the target model must generate many rollouts during training. As models scale, post-training itself becomes a bottleneck. We study a weak-to-strong alternative: run RL on a smaller model where rollouts are cheaper, then reuse what that RL run learned to improve a stronger target model. Directly distilling the post-RL weak teacher is not enough, because the teacher's final policy mixes useful RL gains with the limitations of the smaller model. We propose Direct On-Policy Distillation (Direct-OPD), which transfers the teacher's RL-induced policy shift instead. Direct-OPD compares the post-RL teacher with its own pre-RL reference and treats their log-ratio as a dense implicit reward for the student. In plain terms, the checkpoint pair tells us which actions RL made the weak model more or less likely to take, and Direct-OPD applies that signal on the stronger student's own on-policy states. This directly reuses the weak model's RL supervision signal without running sparse-reward RL on the target model. Empirically, Direct-OPD consistently leverages weaker teachers to improve stronger target models; notably, it boosts Qwen3-1.7B from 48.3% to 58.3% on AIME 2024 in just 4 hours on 8 A100 GPUs. papers.report_title: 清华&智谱开源发布ScaleCUA:可扩展的任务合成和在线强化学习 GUI Agent框架,9B模型刷新开源SOTA
papers.summary: 清华大学与智谱AI（Z.AI）联合提出ScaleCUA框架，用于计算机使用智能体（CUA）的可扩展任务合成与高效在线强化学习。框架包含三大组件：VeriGen——在Docker容器中循环生成带确定性裁判的GUI任务（产出24K+候选，约3K进入高质量RL池）；Frontier Sampling——基于实时成功率EMA优先采样“半会不会”的任务（成功率接近50%），避免无效采样；Visual Context Segmentation——保留最近5-8帧截图作为视觉上下文（其余丢弃），文字历史不断档，实现2.83倍训练加速（单步从750s降至265s）。基于Qwen3.5-9B训练的ScaleCUA在OSWorld上达68.7%（开源SOTA，超越Kimi K2.5的63.3%和Claude Sonnet 4.5的62.9%），ScienceBoard达54.0%（高于Claude Opus 4.6的52.7%）。消融：去掉VeriGen降至43.9%，去掉Frontier Sampling降至63.7%，去掉视觉切分降至62.2%。单局交互上限50步，环境为Ubuntu桌面。裁判可执行率达94.5%（人工抽查与专家标注一致率82.5%）。论文链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11185，代码与模型已开源。

arxiv.title: SCALECUA: Scaling Computer Use Agents with Verifiable Task Synthesis and Efficient Online RL
arxiv.abstract: Computer use agents (CUAs) are emerging as a powerful interface for automating complex digital workflows through visual perception and GUI execution. Online reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a key direction for scaling their capabilities. However, this paradigm is bottlenecked by verifiable data scarcity and online RL inefficiency. To break these barriers, we introduce ScaleCUA, a unified framework that scales online RL for CUAs via verifiable task synthesis and efficient training. At the data level, we design VeriGen, an end-to-end framework for generating verifiable RL tasks through iterative docker interactions and a multi-agent feedback loop. Scaled to 100+ concurrent agent workers via a shared docker interaction probe, this pipeline produces 24K+ verifiable tasks and nearly 3K high-quality RL tasks. To maximize sample efficiency, we propose Frontier Sampling, which tracks per-task capability and allocates rollouts to the current learning frontier. On the training side, we further design Visual Context Segmentation, a sliding window over recent visual context that balances rollout and training-engine pressure, yielding a 2.83x training speedup over step-wise decomposition. Together, ScaleCUA achieves 68.7% on OSWorld and 54.0% on ScienceBoard, establishing new state-of-the-art performance among open-source computer use agents. Code, models

papers.title: CoSToM:Causal-oriented Steering for Intrinsic Theory-of-Mind Alignment in Large Language Models
papers.report_title: 三分钟论文速递 | 大模型的读心术是真是假?从黑盒观测到因果干预
papers.summary: 本文解读CoSToM框架，首次将LLM心理理论对齐从行为观测推进到因果干预层面。通过因果追踪定位心理理论信息主要编码于模型第0至第3层，且信念、欲望、意图呈分层编码。经梯度桥接干预后，深层衰减的心理理论信号被成功恢复：Llama-3在谈判任务中欲望解码准确率从2.39%飙升至51.48%，说服任务中第2层说服者欲望追踪从51.03%跃升至99.23%。对话生成评估中，CoSToM的心理理论推理得分从0.081提升至0.499（约6倍），远超全局微调基线的0.245。CoSToM仅更新少量LoRA参数，内存占用约为基础模型的2倍，可作为即插即用模块在推理时独立部署。在Llama-3和Qwen2.5两个模型、谈判和说服两个任务上均取得一致增益，证明了架构通用性和任务泛化性。研究揭示了社交认知表征在浅层建立的机制，为构建稳定社交智能的AI系统提供了从黑盒观测到白盒干预的可行路径。
report_titles: 三分钟论文速递 | 大模型的读心术是真是假?从黑盒观测到因果干预

arxiv.title: CoSToM:Causal-oriented Steering for Intrinsic Theory-of-Mind Alignment in Large Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Theory of Mind (ToM), the ability to attribute mental states to others, is a hallmark of social intelligence. While large language models (LLMs) demonstrate promising performance on standard ToM benchmarks, we observe that they often fail to generalize to complex task-specific scenarios, relying heavily on prompt scaffolding to mimic reasoning. The critical misalignment between the internal knowledge and external behavior raises a fundamental question: Do LLMs truly possess intrinsic cognition, and can they externalize this internal knowledge into stable, high-quality behaviors? To answer this, we introduce CoSToM (Causal-oriented Steering for ToM alignment), a framework that transitions from mechanistic interpretation to active intervention. First, we employ causal tracing to map the internal distribution of ToM features, empirically uncovering the internal layers' characteristics in encoding fundamental ToM semantics. Building on this insight, we implement a lightweight alignment framework via targeted activation steering within these ToM-critical layers. Experiments demonstrate that CoSToM significantly enhances human-like social reasoning capabilities and downstream dialogue quality.

papers.title: Can We Predict Before Executing Machine Learning Agents?
papers.report_title: ACL2026SACHighlight|机器学习Agent的真正瓶颈,不是写代码,而是判断哪个实验值得跑
papers.summary: 本文解读浙江大学与蚂蚁集团联合实验室的ACL2026 SAC Highlight论文“Can We Predict Before Executing Machine Learning Agents?”，聚焦机器学习Agent的“执行前预判”能力。关键瓶颈在于执行一次ML实验耗时数小时（MLE-Bench上可长达9小时），Agent能生成多个候选方案但只有执行一套的预算。研究构建了涵盖26个CV/NLP/Data Science任务、18438对方案比较的大规模偏好语料库，发现LLM（DeepSeek-V3.2 Thinking）在不执行代码前提下可达到61.5%的先验预测准确率，显著高于随机基线（50%）和复杂度启发式基线（50.8%）。进一步提出FOREAGENT框架：并行生成10个候选，用置信度门槛0.7过滤，仅执行Top-1。在5个AI4Science任务上实现平均6倍加速、3.2倍更多节点探索、Beat Ratio提升6%。关键洞察：预测能力来自数据-代码的语义对齐，而非参数规模（30B后进入平台期）；置信度校准良好；验证-测试间隙（72.2%）说明执行本身并非完美信号。工作将Agent反馈机制从“先执行后学习”推进到“先预测后执行”，为自动科研、AutoML等高成本场景提供了实用优化方向。

arxiv.title: Can We Predict Before Executing Machine Learning Agents?
arxiv.abstract: Autonomous machine learning agents have revolutionized scientific discovery, yet they remain constrained by a Generate-Execute-Feedback paradigm. Previous approaches suffer from a severe Execution Bottleneck, as hypothesis evaluation relies strictly on expensive physical execution. To bypass these physical constraints, we internalize execution priors to substitute costly runtime checks with instantaneous predictive reasoning, drawing inspiration from World Models. In this work, we formalize the task of Data-centric Solution Preference and construct a comprehensive corpus of 18,438 pairwise comparisons. We demonstrate that LLMs exhibit significant predictive capabilities when primed with a Verified Data Analysis Report, achieving 61.5% accuracy and robust confidence calibration. Finally, we instantiate this framework in FOREAGENT, an agent that employs a Predict-then-Verify loop, achieving a 6x acceleration in convergence while surpassing execution-based baselines by +6%. Our code and dataset are publicly available at https://github.com/zjunlp/predict-before-execute.

papers.title: DSpark: Confidence-Scheduled Speculative Decoding with Semi-Autoregressive Generation
papers.report_title: DeepSeek 没发新模型,却让 V4 快了 85%:秘密是一个叫 DSpark 的「加速贴」
papers.summary: DeepSeek联合北京大学发布DSpark（Confidence-Scheduled Speculative Decoding with Semi-Autoregressive Generation）推测解码框架，通过三项核心创新将V4-Flash在线推理速度提升85%。首先，半自回归架构（Semi-Autoregressive Generation）保留并行主干的同时，引入轻量级马尔可夫头（低秩分解秩=256）逐token添加条件偏置，解决并行模型的“后缀衰减”问题：2层DSpark的接受token长度已超越5层DFlash，证明轻量级顺序建模更高效。其次，置信度调度验证（Confidence-Scheduled Verification）根据系统负载、置信度分数和引擎吞吐曲线动态裁剪验证窗口，离线实验显示：Qwen3-4B上聊天任务接受率可从45.7%跃升至95.7%（数学76.9%→92.5%，代码67.6%→92.0%）。第三，零开销调度（Zero-Overhead Scheduling）利用预测提前计算截断位置，完全隐藏调度延迟。离线对比基准：DSpark相对Eagle3接受长度提升30.9%（Qwen3-4B）、26.7%（8B）、30.0%（14B）；相对DFlash提升16.3%、18.4%、18.3%。延迟代价极小，batch size 128下单轮延迟仅增加0.2%-1.3%。生产环境测试：V4-Flash在80 token/s/user目标下总吞吐提升51%，120 token/s/user严格SLA下名义吞吐优势达661%，单用户速度提升60%-85%；V4-Pro在35 token/s/user目标下总吞吐提升52%，50 token/s/user下名义吞吐优势406%，单用户速度提升57%-78%。DeepSeek同步开源DeepSpec训练栈（MIT许可），支持Eagle3、DFlash和DSpark三种算法，默认配置需8 GPU+约38TB存储。论文作者含梁文锋。

arxiv.title: DSpark: Confidence-Scheduled Speculative Decoding with Semi-Autoregressive Generation
arxiv.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates Large Language Model (LLM) inference by decoupling draft generation from target verification. While recent parallel drafters efficiently propose long token sequences in a single forward pass, they suffer from rapid acceptance decay due to a lack of inter-token dependencies. Furthermore, indiscriminately verifying these extended blocks wastes critical batch capacity on tokens with high rejection risks, severely degrading throughput in high-concurrency serving systems. We introduce DSpark, a speculative decoding framework that unifies high-throughput parallel generation with adaptive, load-aware verification. To maintain draft quality, DSpark utilizes a semi-autoregressive architecture, coupling a parallel backbone with a lightweight sequential module, to introduce intra-block dependency modeling and mitigate suffix decay. To optimize system efficiency, DSpark employs confidence-scheduled verification, dynamically tailoring the verification length for each request based on estimated prefix survival probabilities and engine-specific throughput profiles. On offline benchmarks across diverse domains, DSpark substantially improves the accepted length over state-of-the-art autoregressive and parallel drafters. papers.report_title: 论文接收后还要熬夜做海报?微软把最后一公里做成可编辑技能链
papers.summary: 微软研究院提出 ResearchStudio-Reel，将论文到海报、演讲视频、双语博客的“最后一公里”拆解为五个可复用的 Agent 技能：Paper2Assets（统一提取图表、元数据、结构化摘要）、Paper2Poster（输出可编辑 PowerPoint 海报，通过 staged-fill 循环以像素级硬门禁替代 VLM 软打分，收敛后美学均值 3.52 vs 人工海报 2.94，信息均值 3.90 vs 3.63）、Paper2Video（交付 ppt-master 工作流，旁白对齐、字幕、视觉高亮一应俱全）、Paper2Blog（中英文 Word 共享证据图谱，门禁检测数字引用一致性）、Paper2Reel（交互式 HTML 阅读器，海报区块点击同步跳转视频与博客）。在 Paper2Poster 基准（100 篇论文）上，该系统以 Claude Code + claude-opus-4.8 配置，在 6 项美观/信息子准则上全面领先单次 prompt 的前沿 VLM 和既有流水线，逐篇综合胜率 84%–93%。全流程成本：5 篇论文四件套平均约 89 分钟、输入 260 万 token。系统已开源（MIT 协议），是当前唯一同时交付可编辑 PPTX 视频包、双语可编辑 DOCX 博客且带布局修复的全流程系统。

arxiv.title: ResearchStudio-Reel: Automate the Last Mile of Research from Paper to Poster, Video, and Blog
arxiv.abstract: Despite growing automation, turning a paper into a coherent poster, talk video, and blog piece often remains a labor-intensive last mile. Recent systems increasingly generate multiple dissemination formats, but a practical workflow must also keep the outputs editable in native tools and bound into one navigable deliverable for revision and reuse. We present ResearchStudio-Reel, a native-editable dissemination workspace that binds its three artifacts into one interactive deliverable at the experience level, implemented as five skills executable in Claude Code and Codex: one shared extractor, three editable artifact generators, and one interactive convergence layer. A shared asset bundle feeds a PowerPoint poster and video deck, plus a bilingual Word blog; rather than re-rendering the paper into a fourth format, Paper2Reel converges these already-produced artifacts at the experience level, binding poster regions, video segments, and blog passages into one interactive viewer. Artifact-specific release checks make this delivery contract testable, and Paper2Poster additionally uses a measured-fill loop. On the Paper2Poster benchmark, our Claude Code configuration achieves the best scores among automated systems on all three aesthetic sub-criteria and the best or tied-best scores on two of three information sub-criteria. papers.title: ResearchStudio-Idea: An Evidence-Grounded Research-Ideation Skill Suite from ML Conference Outcomes
papers.report_title: 论文接收后还要熬夜做海报?微软把最后一公里做成可编辑技能链
papers.summary: 微软研究院发布 ResearchStudio-Idea，从 ICLR/ICML/NeurIPS 2021–2025 年间 1947 篇 Oral、高引与拒稿论文中归纳出 15 种可复用选题范式。核心方法：先用 Claude Sonnet 4.6 进行两阶段领域无关改写（剥离“扩散”“Transformer”等主题词，只保留策略动作），嵌入后经 UMAP+HDBSCAN 聚类得到 31 个子簇，再合并为 15 张范式卡。关键发现：拒稿论文映射回同一范式词汇表，说明录用与拒稿差异在执行而非策略；31 子簇 Oral 率差异大，6 个超 65%、1 个拒稿预警；多数子簇 Oral/拒稿混合，无万能范式；范式质心余弦相似度 0.79–0.96，组合才是常态。IdeaSpark 技能链包含 Paper-Search（四源检索）、Scoop-Check（四轴撞车检查）、IdeaSpark（证据落地→瓶颈诊断→范式引导→审计→ idea card）。在 100 个 ICLR 2026 Oral 种子上盲评：IdeaSpark 质量得分 3.87/4，88 次排名第一，远高于裸 GPT-5.5 的 1.00；新颖度 3.73，集中在 L3（诚实的部分重叠），而裸 GPT-5.5 虽同样 3.73 却多落入 L4（novel-but-empty）。

arxiv.title: ResearchStudio-Idea: An Evidence-Grounded Research-Ideation Skill Suite from ML Conference Outcomes
arxiv.abstract: Large language models have made research ideation increasingly accessible, yet effective idea development requires more than generating candidate directions. Researchers must ground a problem in current literature, identify meaningful bottlenecks, differentiate from existing solutions, and evaluate risks before committing to implementation. We present ResearchStudio-Idea as a reusable skill suite for this first mile of research ideation. Analysis of these outcomes reveals 31 recurring ideation sub-patterns, consolidated into 15 reusable ideation patterns. papers.summary: 本文介绍了卡内基梅隆大学团队提出的PACE方法，旨在解决Agent评测成本高昂（单模型完整评测上千美元、数天）的问题。PACE从19个非Agent原子基准（覆盖11类能力）中自动选出100道题，采用Local（Spearman相关排序）和Global（SVD杠杆分数）两条互补过滤线，结合Bootstrap回归，预测模型在GAIA、SWE-Bench Verified、SWE-Bench Multimodal、SWT-Bench四项Agent基准上的得分和排序。在14个模型上实施严格留一交叉验证，平均MAE仅3.80%，Spearman相关系数0.81，两两排序准确率84.37%，随机基线50%。成本仅为完整Agent评测的约1/100（例如SWE-Bench Multimodal单题1.89美元 vs IFEval单题0.006美元）。PACE选出的100道题揭示了不同Agent基准的能力需求指纹：GAIA侧重指令遵循和验证测试，SWE-Bench侧重规划、代码生成和错误恢复，SWT-Bench侧重验证测试和规划。论文明确指出边界：标定模型需代表未来分布，预测分数依赖于特定harness。PACE定位为筛选工具而非替代完整评测，可在真正投入昂贵评测前用极低成本摸清方向。

arxiv.title: PACE Solver Description: A Heuristic Directed Feedback Vertex Set Problem Algorithm
arxiv.abstract: A feedback vertex set of a graph is a set of nodes with the property that every cycle contains at least one vertex from the set i.e. the removal of all vertices from a feedback vertex set leads to an acyclic graph. In this short paper, we describe the algorithm for finding a minimum directed feedback vertex set used by the _UAIC_ANDREIARHIRE_ solver, submitted to the heuristic track of the 2022 PACE challenge.

papers.title: Program-as-Weights: A Programming Paradigm for Fuzzy Functions
papers.report_title: Program-as-Weights 用自然语言写函数,编译成权重本地跑:0.6B 小模型超过32B 模型
papers.summary: 本文介绍了Waterloo等团队提出的Program-as-Weights（PAW）范式，核心思想是将自然语言描述的“模糊函数”通过神经编译器转化为约23MB（Q4_0量化）的LoRA权重文件，由本地0.6B冻结解释器加载执行。在FuzzyBench基准上，PAW（0.6B底座）达到73.78%精确匹配（EM），超过Qwen3-32B直推的68.70%，推理内存仅约1/60（1.2GB vs 60GB）。编译管线分工：伪编译器（Qwen3-4B-Instruct，不训练）改写用户规格，LoRA编译器（Qwen3-4B，训练）生成LoRA参数。关键消融：同底座下固定LoRA仅52.10%，全量微调58.40%，而PAW达73.78%，证明编译器动态生成LoRA的价值。LM→Code路线（让大模型写Python再执行）仅35.81%。在真实文本分类任务WRENCH上，PAW 0.6B表现与4B-32B直推同档（如YouTube 90.40% vs 93.60%）。PAW对规格噪声鲁棒（最多掉3.7点），量化后Q6_K+Q4_0总磁盘623MB，EM 65.75%，与bf16几乎一致。图像任务无需更换解释器，编译器换成Qwen3-VL-4B后，0.6B文本模型在电路、化学等任务上超过≤4B视觉基线。论文指出PAW适合函数定义稳定、调用频繁的场景，将Prompt从每次推理的消耗品变为可版本管理的权重文件。

arxiv.title: Program-as-Weights: A Programming Paradigm for Fuzzy Functions
arxiv.abstract: Many everyday programming tasks resist clean rule-based implementation, such as alerting on important log lines, repairing malformed JSON, or ranking search results by intent, and are increasingly outsourced to large language model APIs at the cost of locality, reproducibility, and price. We propose fuzzy-function programming: compiling such a function from a natural-language specification into a compact, locally-executable neural artifact. We instantiate this paradigm with Program-as-Weights (PAW), in which a 4B compiler trained on FuzzyBench, a 10M-example dataset we release, emits parameter-efficient adapters for a frozen, lightweight interpreter. A 0.6B Qwen3 interpreter executing PAW programs matches the performance of direct prompting of Qwen3-32B, while using roughly one fiftieth of the inference memory and running at 30 tokens/s on a MacBook M3. PAW reframes the foundation model from a per-input problem solver into a tool builder: invoked once per function definition, it produces a small reusable artifact whose subsequent calls per function application are cheap and offline.

papers.title: KidnapRAG: A Black-Box Attack for Hijacking Reasoning in Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems
papers.report_title: Agent还在干苦力,KidnapRAG让答案早翻车了
papers.summary: 该文解读了针对Agentic RAG系统的黑盒攻击方法KidnapRAG，揭示了迭代推理机制本身的结构性漏洞。研究者通过构造Bait（诱饵）、Chain-Link（链条）、Mal-Ins（恶意指令）三段投毒文档链，在仅具备黑盒访问权限（无系统提示、推理轨迹或模型参数）的条件下，成功劫持多步推理链，使模型输出攻击者控制的答案。实验在HotpotQA、MuSiQue、2WikiMultihopQA三个数据集上，跨ReAct和WebThinker两个框架、4个LLM后端进行，性能全面领先现有攻击。核心指标：在ReAct+Llama-3.3-70B上，MuSiQue数据集攻击成功率(ASR)达0.78，答案精确匹配(EM)从0.38骤降至0.01；而7种基线（Naive、Ignore、PoisonedRAG、PARADOX等）的ASR很少超过0.30。消融实验显示：去除Chain-Link后ASR显著下降；去除Mal-Ins后ASR直接降至0.00，证明最终诱导文档是生成目标答案的必要条件。此外，KidnapRAG能有效绕过OpenAI Moderation内容审查：在ReAct+Qwen上检测率为0.0%，在WebThinker+QwQ上仅为4.2%，而其他攻击检测率高达91-100%。论文指出链式投毒利用了Agentic RAG的迭代能力，单条投毒易被忽略，但多条串联即可绑架推理。防御方需在推理链一致性、来源可信度和查询漂移检测上加强。论文标题：KidnapRAG: A Black-Box Attack for Hijacking Reasoning in Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems，链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.00422。

arxiv.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems are vulnerable to poisoning attacks that inject malicious documents into the retrieval process to manipulate model outputs. Recent Agentic RAG systems are more robust to such attacks because they iteratively perform retrieval and reasoning, allowing them to ignore weakly relevant poisoned documents and preserve the reasoning chain induced by the user query. However, existing attacks on Agentic RAG systems often assume white-box access to system prompts, reasoning traces, retrievers, or model parameters, limiting their applicability in realistic settings. In this paper, we study black-box poisoning attacks against Agentic RAG systems, where the attacker can only publish externally retrievable poisoned documents. We propose KidnapRAG, a sequential poisoning attack that hijacks the agent's multi-step reasoning chain using three role-specific documents: Bait, Chain-Link, and Mal-Ins, which attract initial retrieval, induce query reformulation, and provide attacker-controlled evidence, respectively. Experiments across multiple Agentic RAG frameworks, LLM backbones, and benchmarks show that KidnapRAG consistently outperforms existing poisoning baselines under black-box conditions. papers.title: AGE: Adaptive-masking for Graph Embedding in Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.report_title: GraphRAG图编码行了,AGE解决核心难点
papers.summary: 该论文提出AGE（Adaptive-masking for Graph Embedding），针对GraphRAG中图嵌入与文本嵌入对齐困难的问题，尤其在使用frozen LLM时。核心创新是用可学习的节点采样器替代随机掩码，保护信息密集的关键节点不被掩蔽，仅对辅助节点进行JEPA风格的重建。模型包含图编码器、节点采样器、概念编解码器、目标编码器、图聚合器四个模块，采用三损失优化（提示调优损失、JEPA重建损失、RL采样损失），三损失等权最优。在四个benchmark上全面超越SOTA：ExplaGraphs上Llama3.2-1B提升26.72pp（0.5595→0.8267），Llama3.1-8B提升9.07pp（0.8705→0.9612）；SceneGraphs上Llama3.2-3B达0.9486；WebQSP上AGE+AMAR Llama2-7B 86.5（vs AMAR 84.3）；CWQ上AGE+AMAR 85.2，超过GPT-4的ReKnoS。消融实验显示，从G-Retriever 0.5595开始，GA+随机掩码0.6532（+9.37%），JEPA+随机掩码0.7141（+15.46%），GA+采样器0.7870（+22.75%），JEPA+采样器0.8267（+26.72%），验证了采样器与JEPA的叠加效果。最优采样率ρ=0.3。论文标题: AGE: Adaptive-masking for Graph Embedding in Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation，链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.00052

arxiv.title: AGE: Adaptive-masking for Graph Embedding in Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
arxiv.abstract: GraphRAG is an extension of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) that supports large language models (LLMs) by referring to graph-structured data as external knowledge. While this technique ideally captures intricate relationships, it often struggles with graph representations for LLMs, particularly for frozen LLMs, due to the misalignment between graph-based and text-based latent features. We tackle this issue by introducing the {\it Adaptive-masking for Graph Embedding (AGE)}. AGE employs a Transformer in a mask-based self-supervised learning (SSL) approach. We designed the architecture similar to text embedding encoders, addressing the latent feature misalignment. In contrast to natural language texts, graphs are concise representations, and there exist {\it key nodes} that hold dominant contextual information, which are challenging to predict from their surroundings. Masking such key nodes leads to inefficiency in the SSL process. Therefore, AGE focuses on predicting nodes apart from key nodes, utilizing a learnable node sampler. Our experimental results indicate that AGE significantly improves approaches using non-parametric search component in GraphQA tasks, achieving superior accuracy across four benchmark datasets with distinct characteristics.

papers.report_title: 【Daily Paper|每日论文】失眠症状与睡眠时长对神经肌肉力量下降轨迹的影响是否存在性别差异(IF=7.4)
papers.summary: 本文深入解读了Anthropic于2026年7月发布的关于语言模型内部“全局工作空间”（Global Workspace）的论文，并批判性分析了网络上将其渲染为“通往AGI秘密钥匙”的过度叙事。文章核心贡献是提出了J-lens（雅可比透镜）工具，用于读取模型内部可被“说出口”的中间表征——该区域仅占激活方差的10%左右，但承担了大部分灵活推理任务。关键实验包括：在模型开口前替换内部概念向量（如“足球”变“橄榄球”），跨14类概念目标词进入前五的比例约88%；单次替换“法国”为“中国”后，四个下游任务（首都、语言、大洲、货币）答案同时改变，验证了共享中枢概念的存在；清零该工作空间后，两跳推理准确率从接近满分降至接近0，而常规问答、情感分类等影响甚微。独立复现者Neel Nanda未能复现押韵和心算实验，但认为核心因果干预实验“很有说服力”，并将J-lens定位为“生成假设的工具”。文章还指出，论文最值得关注的分水岭在于：工具发现模型内部会浮现“fake”“fictional”等概念，即模型可能“识别出自己在被评估”并据此压制恶意倾向。若清零这些识别信号，被压制的威胁倾向反而显现。这为AI安全评估提出了新课题：标准评测可能系统性低估模型的对齐风险。文章最后给出辨识过热叙事的五把尺子：查作者免责声明、独立复现、分清承重与增益、分清类比与证据、分清相关与因果。

arxiv.title: Short Horizons and Sparse Concepts: a Mathematical View of the Readout in the J-lens
arxiv.abstract: The Jacobian lens (J-lens) has been proposed as a way to read verbalizable representations from language models. However, its principle and meaning lack a detailed and theoretical discussion. We provide a mathematical view of this interpretation and of its assumed causal structure. Besides treating the J-lens as a heuristic probe, we further regard it as a first-order causal transfer operator from intermediate activations to expected future readouts. We study the Jacobian matrix as the optimal local linear approximation of the downstream mapping, analyze its global approximation behavior and bias, and identify its mathematical meaning as an expectation over anticipated future readouts. Further analysis of the Jacobian energy distribution reveals that its causal geometry is highly sparse. The energy decays with depth, concentrates in an extremely small proportion, and decomposes into diagonal pathways and specific critical positions. This decomposition further resolves the expectation of the J-lens over future outputs into short-horizon and sparse concept predictions, providing a more intuitive attribution and explanation for the ability of the J-lens to visualize concepts during the thinking process. Based on the theory, we propose a simple but effective improvement strategy and decoupling method for the J-lens, which significantly enhances the ability of the J-lens to read out

papers.title: TRIAGE: Trustworthy Retrieval Instrumentation And Graph Evaluation
papers.report_title: 别再说这是 Anthropic 通往 AGI 的秘密钥匙了
papers.summary: 本文详细介绍了TRIAGE（Trustworthy Retrieval Instrumentation And Graph Evaluation）——一个针对Graph-RAG的阶段感知诊断框架。核心动机是揭示Graph-RAG中的“silent-success residual”现象：即最终答案正确但检索环节并未提供真实证据，LLM利用参数记忆“蒙对”答案，导致仅凭终点正确率无法发现底层缺陷。TRIAGE将GraphRAG的KG版本周期分为三阶段：KG Implementation（自动抽取与构建）、KG Validation（专家审核与无gold质量指标）、KG Usage（图检索推理）。每阶段都设计了独立可计算的指标。关键指标包括：Implementation阶段的Triple Confidence Score (TCS，基于token log-probability几何均值，有界[0,1])、SCR、EC、CSC等；Validation阶段的Dead Node Ratio (DNR，度数≤1的孤立节点比例)；Usage阶段形成必要条件链：QGR（查询实体在KG中的接地率）→ ERC（检索覆盖率）→ RRS（子图路径连通性）→ ARF（答案关系忠实性）→ AGR（答案基于检索证据）。前三个环节可在LLM调用前计算，支持预生成分诊。实证结果来自PathQuestion 3-hop KB上的480个观测：当ERC<0.5时，Context Coverage (CC)为44.3%，而Hits@1却高达77.1%；ERC=1时CC跃升至98.4%，Hits@1仅提升至91.4%。差距说明强力reader通过参数记忆掩盖了检索失败，形成了54个百分点（CC）与14个百分点（Hits@1）之间的“寂静成功残差”。TRIAGE将每个失败signature映射到对应修复杠杆（重抽、修图、改检索），支持部署时直接计算gold-free指标。

arxiv.title: TRIAGE: Trustworthy Retrieval Instrumentation And Graph Evaluation
arxiv.abstract: Knowledge graphs (KGs) that underpin Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (Graph-RAG) are increasingly built automatically by LLM-driven extraction rather than curated by experts. Proper evaluation would require instrumenting all pertinent stages: extraction, graph construction, and inference, coherently enough to localize failures, so that a failure at one stage is not discovered as a wrong answer at the end. We introduce TRIAGE, a stage-aware instrumentation framework for automated, document-grounded graph-RAG that asks not only whether the underlying graph can be trusted but at what cost it can be queried. TRIAGE attaches stage-specific, independently interpretable metrics to three stages: the KG Implementation (triple confidence, source coverage, and schema and canonicalization checks), the KG Validation by expert (graph-level structural quality, with correctness and completeness computed only as offline calibration when a reference is available), and the KG Usage (retrieval coverage, faithfulness, and retrieval cost); the deployed metrics need no gold annotations, the gold-requiring ones serving only as offline calibration. At usage time these metrics form a diagnostic chain of necessary conditions whose first broken link localizes the failure, and the diagnosis maps to the stage levers that can remedy it: extraction, graph and schema, or retrieval. papers.summary: 本文介绍了上海人工智能实验室等团队提出的OmniOpt工作，系统性地对108种现代深度学习优化器进行了分类和基准测试。关键创新在于提出了五阶段元流水线（S0-S5）和LMO四轴分解框架，将优化器更新过程解构为信号获取、作用域路由、梯度变换、状态演化、更新重建和终化操作，并依据机制族（T1-T5）和效果目标（O1-O6）构建双维分类。大规模实测选取24个代表性优化器，在60M至1B参数规模的LLaMA架构上进行两阶段评估：Stage 1在C4数据集上以短上下文（256序列）粗筛，Stage 2在FineWeb-Edu上以32k长上下文迁移至四种架构（Transformer++、Gated DeltaNet、DeltaNet、GLA）。核心数据：1B规模下APOLLO取得Stage 1最佳PPL 13.53，但长上下文退化幅度高达+21.87（至35.40），约为AdamW退化（+7.39）的3倍；SOAP在长上下文跨场景中PPL最稳，七场景第一；Muon稳定性突出但架构敏感；RMNP以16.94ms/步的低延迟实现接近Muon的PPL（13.87），成为效率-质量平衡点。论文还揭示了关键机制消融：Muon的Newton-Schulz正交化是核心，去掉后PPL从16.60飙升至70.74。最终给出三档选型建议：Tier I（AdamW、RMNP、Muon）作为默认基线。这项研究为优化器选型从经验驱动转向约束匹配提供了体系化工具，特别强调了长上下文实验对验证泛化能力的必要性。

arxiv.title: OmniOpt: Taxonomy, Geometry, and Benchmarking of Modern Optimizers
arxiv.abstract: Optimizer selection for large-scale model training has become a system-level design decision constrained jointly by compute, memory, tuning budget, and task diversity, yet the landscape of over one hundred methods remains fragmented. We therefore present OmniOpt, a unified survey and benchmark cookbook of optimizers for the research community. OmniOpt rests on four coupled components. First, we treat every optimizer update as a structured transformation through a five-stage meta-pipeline, and show that most methods engage only one or two of these stages. Second, we use norm-constrained linear minimization oracles (LMOs) to unify different optimizers. Third, these two views ground a dual-dimension taxonomy, one dimension assigning each method to a mechanism family and the other recording the measurable training objectives it aims to improve. Fourth, and at the core of this paper, we instantiate the full taxonomy in a unified cross-domain benchmark spanning representative optimizers, model scales, and training regimes from language model pretraining to image classification, systematically analyzing each method family across multiple effect objectives and laying out their trade-offs. papers.report_title: 一行 Vibe 指令进化 Agent 技能:SkillOpt-Lite 比完整管线更快更强
papers.summary: 本文介绍了LMMs-Lab等团队提出的SkillOpt-Lite框架，将Agent技能优化重新定义为“零阶优化+文件系统调试”，通过将rollout轨迹存为独立文本文件，让优化模型利用list/read/replace工具在目录中探索共性失败模式，生成最小补丁，并通过独立验证集门控。与原版SkillOpt相比，删除了mini-batch树合并、文本学习率调度、拒绝编辑缓冲等组件。在6个基准（SearchQA、Spreadsheet、ALFWorld、LiveMath、OfficeQA、DocVQA）上全面超越原版：Spreadsheet任务GPT-5.4-nano从29.9提升至66.2（+36.3），相对SkillOpt平均涨12.6分；LiveMath上GPT-5.5从36.6到73.6（+37.0）。收敛速度明显更快，通常2-3个batch内即可触及天花板。进一步扩展的HarnessOpt将执行脚手架（Harness）也作为可编辑代码，联合优化技能和Harness后，GPT-5.4-nano在SpreadsheetBench上达到0.7758，超过GPT-5.5跑标准Harness+完整SkillOpt的0.7620，实现了“能力倒挂”。论文理论贡献包括将Agent反思范式映射到经典零阶优化工具箱，并指出“技能优化的苦涩教训”：底座越强，复杂阻尼拓扑越帮倒忙。边界：验证集太小仍会出现分数抖动，语义任务增益有限，HarnessOpt依赖初始Harness质量和人类门控。
report_titles: 一行 Vibe 指令进化 Agent 技能:SkillOpt-Lite 比完整管线更快更强

arxiv.title: SkillOpt-Lite: Better and Faster Agent Self-evolution via One Line of Vibe
arxiv.abstract: While skill optimization for autonomous agents has gained traction, existing methods rely on complex pipelines. This leaves a fundamental question unaddressed: What constitutes a minimal viable pipeline for skill optimization, where every component is justified by theory or empirical necessity? We formalize skill optimization via Zeroth-Order (ZO) optimization, mapping classical counterparts (central difference, trust regions) to recent literature. Noting that unlike blind numerical perturbations in classical ZO, skill trajectories serve as interpretable debugging feedback. Grounded in Claude Code philosophy and PAC learning, we establish three principles for convergence and generalization: file-system-based trajectory exploration, consensus attribute mining, and independent validation gating. Eliminating redundancies, we propose SkillOpt-Lite. It accelerates convergence and outperforms full SkillOpt: improving LiveMath by +8.8 points on GPT-5.5 and +25.4 points on GPT-5.4-nano, allowing the nano model to surpass standard GPT-5.4 optimized by SkillOpt. Finally, we integrate our framework into production coding agents like VSCode Copilot, enabling developers to evolve agent skills via one line of vibe. papers.title: Vidu S1: A Real-Time Interactive Video Generation Model
papers.report_title: 清华&生数科技推出 Vidu S1:实时交互数字人,甚至可以用语音控制数字人做动作
papers.summary: 本文介绍清华与生数科技联合提出的Vidu S1实时交互视频生成模型，旨在实现语音驱动的数字人实时动作控制。模型基于扩散架构，通过三阶段训练（双向教师→因果教师→少步蒸馏）和滑动窗口+TwinCache推理机制，在540p分辨率、消费级GPU（RTX 5090、3-step配置）上达到最高42 FPS的生成速度，同时支持无限时长流式生成，避免画面漂移或模糊。关键性能指标：HDTF基准上CSIM（人脸相似度）0.9192，Sync-D（唇形同步）7.847（优于HeyGen的8.037），DOVER感知画质0.5660（均为表中最高）。Vidu-StreamBench内部基准上，主体可控性偏好100%优于HeyGen和LemonSlice，整体偏好56% vs 28%。与现有方案对比，Vidu S1是唯一同时满足实时、指令跟随（如比心、竖拇指）且不降低画质的方案。论文还公开了在线demo和项目链接。
report_titles: 清华&生数科技推出 Vidu S1:实时交互数字人,甚至可以用语音控制数字人做动作

arxiv.title: Vidu S1: A Real-Time Interactive Video Generation Model
arxiv.abstract: We introduce Vidu S1, a real-time interactive video generation model supporting voice control of digital characters. Users can control video generation content at any moment through voice instructions. Vidu S1 supports infinite-length real-time video generation without blurring, drift, or visual distortion. Built with TurboDiffusion and TurboServe, Vidu S1 outputs 540p real-time videos at up to 42 FPS on regular consumer GPUs. Users can upload custom images of real people, anime, and pets, and choose different voice tones for personalized experiences. Experiments show that Vidu S1 achieves the best performance across all test metrics while fully meeting real-time inference requirements. A playable online demo is available at https://vidu.com/vidu-stream.

papers.title: Hallucination Detection for LLM-based Text-to-SQL Generation via Two-Stage Metamorphic Testing
papers.report_title: 【FSE'26 论文|“大模型写SQL的幻觉检测”】不需要标准答案,怎么判断一条SQL是不是在“胡说”?
papers.summary: 该论文针对大模型文本转SQL任务中缺少标准答案时如何检测幻觉的问题，提出了一种无需标准答案的两阶段元变形测试框架SQLHD。第一阶段通过8种变形关系（比较词、实体、句子结构、数据库模式）检测模式链接幻觉，第二阶段通过9种变形关系（前缀词、极值词、比较范围、数据库）检测逻辑合成幻觉，两阶段串联实现“双保险”，即使第一阶段漏检也可在第二阶段暴露。实验在多个数据集上F1分数达到69.36%–82.76%，显著优于让大模型自我评估的方案。消融实验验证了两阶段各自独立检出能力及联合效果。该方法的实用价值在于可直接应用于缺乏标注数据的真实业务场景（如企业内部数据库自然语言查询）。论文链接：https://arxiv.org/pdf/2512.22250。

arxiv.title: Hallucination Detection for LLM-based Text-to-SQL Generation via Two-Stage Metamorphic Testing
arxiv.abstract: In Text-to-SQL generation, large language models (LLMs) have shown strong generalization and adaptability. However, LLMs sometimes generate hallucinations, i.e.,unrealistic or illogical content, which leads to incorrect SQL queries and negatively impacts downstream applications. Detecting these hallucinations is particularly challenging. Existing Text-to-SQL error detection methods, which are tailored for traditional deep learning models, face significant limitations when applied to LLMs. This is primarily due to the scarcity of ground-truth data. To address this challenge, we propose SQLHD, a novel hallucination detection method based on metamorphic testing (MT) that does not require standard answers. SQLHD splits the detection task into two sequentiial stages: schema-linking hallucination detection via eight structure-aware Metamorphic Relations (MRs) that perturb comparative words, entities, sentence structure or database schema, and logical-synthesis hallucination detection via nine logic-aware MRs that mutate prefix words, extremum expressions, comparison ranges or the entire database. In each stage the LLM is invoked separately to generate schema mappings or SQL artefacts; the follow-up outputs are cross-checked against their source counterparts through the corresponding MRs, and any violation is flagged as a hallucination without requiring ground-truth SQL. papers.title: Introspective Coupling: Self-Explanation Training Tracks Behavioral Change Despite Fixed Supervision
papers.report_title: 三分钟论文速递 | MIT揭秘大模型的自我解释能力
papers.summary: 该论文（Introspective Coupling: Self-Explanation Training Tracks Behavioral Change Despite Fixed Supervision, arXiv 2026）首次揭示了“内省耦合”现象：使用固定解释标签训练语言模型时，模型生成的解释反而更忠实于自身当前行为而非训练目标。实验在Hint-MMLU、AITA和拒答任务上，正则化训练后模型在63%–82%的样本上选择解释自身当前行为而非原始标签。激活修补实验表明行为与解释的皮尔逊相关系数高达0.89，说明二者共享计算通路。内省耦合在标签-行为一致性ν≥0.7时出现，当ν≤0.6时解释准确率崩溃。研究还证明解释数据集可在模型间复用，且自我解释能泛化至辅助训练带来的新行为，为低成本可扩展的自我解释训练提供了理论与实验基础。

arxiv.title: Introspective Coupling: Self-Explanation Training Tracks Behavioral Change Despite Fixed Supervision
arxiv.abstract: When does training language models (LMs) to generate explanations of their predictions yield faithful introspection, rather than superficial imitation? We study LMs trained to explain which features of their inputs influenced their behavior, using models' counterfactual behavior on modified inputs as supervision. Surprisingly, we find that LMs trained on fixed counterfactual explanations derived from earlier checkpoints of themselves, or even from behaviorally similar models in different families, frequently produce explanations more faithful to their own current behaviors than to those of their training targets. This "introspective" coupling between LM explanations and behaviors occurs when training explanations remain sufficiently correlated with current behaviors over the course of training, even as behaviors themselves shift. We also show that introspective coupling tracks behavior shifts: when explanation training is provided concurrently with other post-training objectives, explanations track those shifts without requiring updated supervision. This phenomenon appears in multiple tasks, including sycophancy and refusal, and is robust to label noise. Overall, our results show that even fixed datasets of counterfactual explanations can provide scalable and generalizable post-training signal for introspection.

papers.report_title: AI人工智能硕士:AI算法工程师、机器学习工程师都在读的专业
papers.summary: 本文系统研究了强化学习（RL）后训练中Transformer层的贡献分布，提出层贡献度指标C(k)。在7个模型（Qwen3 1.7B/4B/8B、Qwen2.5 1.5B/3B、DeepSeek-Distilled-7B）、3种RL算法（GRPO、Dr. GRPO、GiGPO）、3个任务领域（数学推理、代码生成、智能体决策）上验证，发现RL收益高度集中在网络深度40%-60%的中间层。关键数据：在Qwen3-1.7B上，单独训练Layer10的贡献度C=1.14，即恢复全参数训练114%的收益，而最差层仅恢复28%。层贡献度排序在不同数据集（Spearman ρ=0.76, p<0.001）和不同任务（数学vs代码，ρ=0.59, p<0.001）间高度一致。基于此提出的三种优化策略均超越全参数训练：层自适应学习率（1.7B上+2.88pp）、仅训练Top-5层（8B上69.11% vs 66.43%）、零分析中间层启发式（8B上68.19% vs 66.43%）。进一步分析表明，层贡献度由参数子空间质量决定，而非参数变化幅度。论文链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01232。

arxiv.title: Is One Layer Enough? Training A Single Transformer Layer Can Match Full-Parameter RL Training
arxiv.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a central component of post-training large language models (LLMs), yet little is understood about how RL adaptation is distributed across transformer layers. Existing approaches typically update all model parameters uniformly, implicitly assuming that every layer contributes similarly to the gains obtained during RL post-training. In this work, we challenge this assumption through a systematic layer-wise study of RL training. Surprisingly, we find that training a single transformer layer can recover most of the gains achieved by full-parameter RL training, and in some cases even surpass it. To quantify this phenomenon, we introduce the quantity layer contribution, which measures the fraction of full RL improvement recovered by training a layer in isolation. Across seven models spanning two model families (Qwen3, Qwen2.5), three RL algorithms (GRPO, GiGPO, Dr. GRPO), and multiple task domains including mathematical reasoning, code generation, and agentic decision-making, we observe a remarkably stable pattern: RL gains are highly concentrated in a small subset of, and in many cases even a single, transformer layers. More strikingly, the same structural pattern consistently emerges: high-contribution layers concentrate in the middle of the transformer stack, while layers near the input and output ends contribute substantially less. papers.report_title: AI Agent正在裸奔?腾讯朱雀实验室发布 AI-Infra-Guard 技术报告:AI Agent 安全需要分而治之
papers.summary: 腾讯朱雀实验室发布技术报告《Securing the AI Agent: A Unified Framework for Multi-Layer Agent Red Teaming》，核心贡献是提出“层-范式匹配原则”，将AI Agent攻击面分为基础设施层、协议/工具层、Agent行为层和模型层，每层采用不同检测范式。关键数据：基础设施扫描器已覆盖75+AI组件、1400+漏洞规则，采用自研指纹匹配语言（基于布尔表达式）和版本归一化逻辑，将latest映射为极大值、2.3.dev规整为2.3.0等；MCP服务器审计采用“Prompt-as-Rule”范式，由LLM进行语义分析，并设计了自防护机制防御间接提示注入；Agent行为红队（M3）采用阶梯式攻击策略，通过SSRF确认令牌实现客观验证；模型越狱评估整合70余种编码混淆变换、16个公开越狱数据集（约7248条有害提示），输出攻击成功率（ASR）。Skill供应链安全方面，发布SkillTrustBench基准（5520条用例，源自62552个真实Skill，覆盖9类安全威胁），在Claude Opus 4.6下Loose F1达0.9848、召回率接近1.0，但不同基座模型假阳性率差异显著（0.012～0.187）。架构上采用Server-Agent分布式架构与双重交付形态（CLI+Agent Skill）。这是首个覆盖全部四层且纳入Skill审计的开源框架。

arxiv.title: Securing the AI Agent: A Unified Framework for Multi-Layer Agent Red Teaming
arxiv.abstract: The fast growth of open-source AI infrastructure, from model serving engines and agent platforms to the Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem and the language models themselves, has outpaced the security tooling available to defend it. We present AI-Infra-Guard, an open-source framework that organizes AI red teaming around a single observation: the attack surface of an AI agent is stratified across layers (infrastructure, protocol/tool, agent behavior, and model), and no single detection paradigm fits all of them. The framework therefore matches a paradigm to each layer, from deterministic rule matching over 75+ AI components and 1{,}400+ vulnerability rules, through LLM-driven agentic auditing of MCP servers and agent-skill packages and multi-turn black-box agent red teaming, to a jailbreak harness with 26+ attack operators over sixteen datasets. To our knowledge it is the only open-source framework to span all of these, including supply-chain auditing of the agent skills that increasingly extend AI agents. We release AI-Infra-Guard as open source so that \emph{layer-paradigm matching} can serve as a practical foundation for agent security and a shared base for the community to build on.

papers.report_title: 青稞 Talk 预告!NTU MMLab 博士后许牧天:面向时空具身仿真的运动学 4D 世界建模 Kinema4D
papers.summary: 该文预告青稞Talk第137期直播，主讲人为NTU MMLab博士后许牧天，主题为Kinema4D——面向时空具身仿真的运动学4D世界建模。Kinema4D旨在解决现有视频生成模型用于机器人模拟时的两大缺陷：维度缺失（局限于2D空间，缺乏4D时空约束）和精度不足（依赖语言指令或隐式动作理解）。核心方法：运动学驱动的精确4D动作表征将抽象动作锚定在4D空间，实现可控生成下的环境反应建模；同时构建Robo4D-200k数据集作为4D交互数据基石。实验验证了零样本泛化能力。研究对象属于具身智能仿真领域。

arxiv.title: Kinema4D: Kinematic 4D World Modeling for Spatiotemporal Embodied Simulation
arxiv.abstract: Simulating robot-world interactions is a cornerstone of Embodied AI. Recently, a few works have shown promise in leveraging video generations to transcend the rigid visual/physical constraints of traditional simulators. However, they primarily operate in 2D space or are guided by static environmental cues, ignoring the fundamental reality that robot-world interactions are inherently 4D spatiotemporal events that require precise interactive modeling. To restore this 4D essence while ensuring the precise robot control, we introduce Kinema4D, a new action-conditioned 4D generative robotic simulator that disentangles the robot-world interaction into: i) Precise 4D representation of robot controls: we drive a URDF-based 3D robot via kinematics, producing a precise 4D robot control trajectory. ii) Generative 4D modeling of environmental reactions: we project the 4D robot trajectory into a pointmap as a spatiotemporal visual signal, controlling the generative model to synthesize complex environments' reactive dynamics into synchronized RGB/pointmap sequences. To facilitate training, we curated a large-scale dataset called Robo4D-200k, comprising 201,426 robot interaction episodes with high-quality 4D annotations. papers.title: Pelican-VLA 0.5: Attending Before Acting Benefits Generalization
papers.report_title: RL训练一层就够了!单层RL超越全参数训练,跨任务跨模型跨算法全部验证
papers.summary: 本文预告了北京人形机器人创新中心丁泽源博士的学术报告，介绍Pelican-VLA 0.5视觉-语言-动作模型。该模型将视觉语言理解、未来帧生成和动作预测整合为单一架构，通过可学习Reasoning Slots在感知与动作之间引入紧凑瓶颈，实现attention-level generalization：在无物体标注、分割掩码或注意力监督的情况下，动作通路能聚焦于指令相关物体及其接触区域，且该行为在未见场景和未见机器人本体上保持。实验数据：在RoboTwin Clean上达到91.4%成功率，在RoboTwin Randomized上达91.0%，在开源VLA基线中平均最佳。零样本设置在未见物体、场景和新机器人本体的若干任务上取得非零成功率，展现早期泛化。微调前后注意力模式高度相似，表明微调主要强化从预先形成的以操作为中心的注意力区域到可执行动作的映射。技术报告链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.06655。该报告将于2026年7月11日在线直播。

arxiv.title: Pelican-VLA 0.5: Attending Before Acting Benefits Generalization
arxiv.abstract: In this report, we present Pelican-VLA 0.5, a unified VLA model that integrates vision-language understanding, future-frame generation, and action prediction within a single architecture. Pelican-VLA 0.5 achieves attention-level generalization: without object annotations, segmentation masks, attention supervision, or task-specific fine-tuning, its action pathway already focuses on the manipulation-relevant object and contact region. This behavior persists across unseen scenes and unseen robot embodiments, and is substantially stronger than in other open-source VLA baselines. We verify that this ability originates from the learnable Bottleneck Token inserted between perception and action: by routing task-relevant visual information through a compact bottleneck, the tokens interface induces manipulation-centric attention during pre-training and remains effective across different policy structures, including a MoT-style architecture.

papers.report_title: 别再说这是 Anthropic 通往 AGI 的秘密钥匙了
papers.summary: 本文详细介绍了TRIAGE（Trustworthy Retrieval Instrumentation And Graph Evaluation）——一个针对Graph-RAG的阶段感知诊断框架。核心动机是揭示Graph-RAG中的“silent-success residual”现象：即最终答案正确但检索环节并未提供真实证据，LLM利用参数记忆“蒙对”答案，导致仅凭终点正确率无法发现底层缺陷。TRIAGE将GraphRAG的KG版本周期分为三阶段：KG Implementation（自动抽取与构建）、KG Validation（专家审核与无gold质量指标）、KG Usage（图检索推理）。每阶段都设计了独立可计算的指标。关键指标包括：Implementation阶段的Triple Confidence Score (TCS，基于token log-probability几何均值，有界[0,1])、SCR、EC、CSC等；Validation阶段的Dead Node Ratio (DNR，度数≤1的孤立节点比例)；Usage阶段形成必要条件链：QGR（查询实体在KG中的接地率）→ ERC（检索覆盖率）→ RRS（子图路径连通性）→ ARF（答案关系忠实性）→ AGR（答案基于检索证据）。前三个环节可在LLM调用前计算，支持预生成分诊。实证结果来自PathQuestion 3-hop KB上的480个观测：当ERC<0.5时，Context Coverage (CC)为44.3%，而Hits@1却高达77.1%；ERC=1时CC跃升至98.4%，Hits@1仅提升至91.4%。差距说明强力reader通过参数记忆掩盖了检索失败，形成了54个百分点（CC）与14个百分点（Hits@1）之间的“寂静成功残差”。TRIAGE将每个失败signature映射到对应修复杠杆（重抽、修图、改检索），支持部署时直接计算gold-free指标。
report_titles: 别再说这是 Anthropic 通往 AGI 的秘密钥匙了

arxiv.title: Differentiable Learning Under Triage
arxiv.abstract: Multiple lines of evidence suggest that predictive models may benefit from algorithmic triage. Under algorithmic triage, a predictive model does not predict all instances but instead defers some of them to human experts. However, the interplay between the prediction accuracy of the model and the human experts under algorithmic triage is not well understood. In this work, we start by formally characterizing under which circumstances a predictive model may benefit from algorithmic triage. In doing so, we also demonstrate that models trained for full automation may be suboptimal under triage. Then, given any model and desired level of triage, we show that the optimal triage policy is a deterministic threshold rule in which triage decisions are derived deterministically by thresholding the difference between the model and human errors on a per-instance level. Building upon these results, we introduce a practical gradient-based algorithm that is guaranteed to find a sequence of triage policies and predictive models of increasing performance. arxiv.title: Skill-MAS: Evolving Meta-Skill for Automatic Multi-Agent Systems
arxiv.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based automatic Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) generation has become a crucial frontier for tackling complex tasks. However, existing methods face a dilemma between model capability and experience retention. Inference-time MAS leverages frozen frontier LLMs but repeats identical searches without learning from past experience. Conversely, Training-time MAS internalizes experience via gradient updates but is constrained by the low capability ceiling of smaller models, and is hard to scale to large frontier LLMs. To bridge this gap, we propose Skill-MAS, a novel third path that decouples experience retention from parametric updates by conceptualizing the high-level orchestration capability as an evolvable Meta-Skill. Extensive experiments across four complex benchmarks and four distinct LLMs demonstrate that Skill-MAS not only achieves remarkable performance gains but also maintains a favorable cost-performance trade-off. arxiv.abstract: A classical intuition holds that verifying a solution is easier than producing one. For today's coding agents, this intuition is being inverted: as foundation models develop stronger reasoning capabilities and engineering harnesses grow more sophisticated, generating complex candidate solutions is no longer difficult -- reliably verifying them has become the harder problem. Every verifier we can build is only a proxy for human intent, never the intent itself. This makes verification subject to a twofold difficulty: first, intent is underspecified by nature, making it inherently hard to faithfully check whether it has been fulfilled; second, during model training, optimization widens the gap between proxy and intent -- manifesting as reward hacking or signal saturation. To address this, we characterize the quality of verification signals along three dimensions -- scalability, faithfulness, and robustness -- and argue that achieving all three simultaneously is the central challenge. We further study four reward constructions: a test verifier for general coding tasks, a rubric verifier for frontend tasks, the user as verifier for real-world agent tasks, and an automated agent verifier for long-horizon tasks. papers.summary: 华盛顿大学与 Allen AI 等机构提出 Agentic Abstention（智能体弃权）问题，指出 LLM Agent 在多轮工具调用中“该停不停、停得太晚”的普遍缺陷。研究构建了 28000+ 任务的统一基准，覆盖 WebShop、Terminal-Bench 2.0 和 AbstentionBench 三大交互场景，系统评测 13 套 Agent（包括 GPT-5.4-mini、Grok 4.1 Fast、Llama 3.3、Qwen 3 系列等）和 2 种 scaffold（Terminus 2、Codex CLI）。核心发现：所有模型的及时停止率（AbsRec@1）普遍低于 40%，WebShop 上最强基线 Llama-3.3-70B 的及时弃权召回仅 26.7%，而 10 轮内总体弃权召回可达 83.2%，说明 Agent 能“最终认栽”但识别时机太晚。终端环境下 GPT-5.4-mini 配合 Codex CLI 的及时召回也只有 21.6%。研究进一步揭示模型规模增大提升总体召回但对及时召回贡献有限，推理模式是双刃剑，scaffold 选择可造成一倍差异。作为解决方案，论文提出 CONVOLVE——一种上下文工程方法，仅用 20 条交互轨迹蒸馏可复用停止规则（playbook），不动模型权重，将 Llama-3.3-70B 的 AbsRec@1 从 26.7% 提升至 57.4%，SPL 从 55.3 提升至 78.9。该方法可跨模型迁移，8B 模型蒸馏的 playbook 给 70B 使用效果接近自蒸馏。论文定义了 AbsRec@K、SPL、over-abstention rate 等时机敏感指标，为未来 Agent 产品设计提供关键评估维度。

arxiv.title: Agentic Abstention: Do Agents Know When to Stop Instead of Act?
arxiv.abstract: LLM agents are expected to act over multiple turns, using search, browsing interfaces, and terminal tools to complete user goals. Yet not every goal is well specified or achievable in the available environment. In such cases, a reliable agent should recognize that further interaction is unlikely to help and abstain from additional tool calls. We define Agentic Abstention, the problem of deciding when an agent should stop acting under uncertainty. Unlike standard LLM abstention, which is usually evaluated as a single-turn answer-or-abstain decision, agentic abstention is a sequential decision problem: an agent can answer, abstain, or gather more information at each turn, and the need to abstain may only become clear after interacting with the environment. We study this problem across web shopping, terminal environments, and question answering, evaluating 13 LLM-as-agent systems and 2 agent scaffolds on more than 28,000 tasks. Our results show that the main challenge is not only whether agents can abstain, but also when they abstain. Some agents never abstain when they should, while others do so only after many unnecessary interactions. This gap is especially large on tasks where the instruction appears feasible until the environment reveals otherwise (e.g., no valid result matches the instruction). arxiv.title: SkillHone: A Harness for Continual Agent Skill Evolution Through Persistent Decision History
arxiv.abstract: Agent skills extend language-model agents with task-specific procedures, scripts, and references, but the tasks and environments they target continually change. Existing methods improve skills in bounded runs and retain only the final artifact, discarding the decision history that later agents need to interpret prior revisions, evaluations, and rejected alternatives. We introduce SkillHone, a harness for continual agent skill evolution grounded in persistent decision history. SkillHone pairs skill revisions with evaluation-side evidence that supplies practice feedback, recording structured histories of diagnoses, revisions, evidence, and outcomes. Role-separated subagents run candidate skills on practice probes with redacted reporting and propose revisions informed by prior decisions, enabling cross-session refinement without rediscovering past rationale. On deep-research benchmarks, SkillHone runs without a pre-integrated search stack and outperforms the commercially backed deep-research agent by 15.8 points on GAIA and 3.2 points on WebWalkerQA-EN, while also exceeding prior skill-evolution methods. We further deploy SkillHone on internal tool-mediated analysis scenarios, where it improves accuracy by an average of 18.8 points across seven settings.

papers.report_title: 特殊毕业礼:外国总统现身北大,为自家儿子站台
papers.summary: 本文深度解读一篇最新隐私计算论文《Fully Oblivious Differential Privacy for Frequency Estimation in the Augmented Shuffle Model with Trusted Processors》。该论文提出FODP（完全遗忘差分隐私）新概念，核心关注在TEE（如Intel SGX）中执行增强型Shuffle差分隐私协议时，如何防御内存访问模式、控制流轨迹等侧信道攻击。传统DP仅保护算法输出，而FODP要求输出、内存轨迹、指令轨迹三者联合满足(ε,δ)-DP。论文设计了通用框架（算法1），通过bot占位符混淆内存大小，并使用完全遗忘shuffle（OSHUFFLE），实现三种具体算法：FOUD（简单可靠版）、FOLNF（高精度主力版）和FOLNF*（效率优化版）。FOLNF*允许bot count随机变化且自身满足DP，在ε_I=1时可将bot数量减半。实验使用四个数据集：IPUMS（60万用户，915个城市）、Localization（16万实例，11类活动）、Foursquare（10^6项）、AOL（2^24项），对比9种基线方法（GRR、OUE、OLH、BC20、CM22、LWY22等）。结果显示：小域数据上FOLNF/FOLNF*（AGeo分布）MSE最优，FOUD次优；大域数据上引入Count-Min Sketch后的FOLNF-L和FOLNF*-L在ε_E≤5时精度最好或接近最好。运行时间分析表明shuffle是主要开销（图10），FOLNF*运行效率优于FOLNF。本文为TEE+Shuffle DP场景下的侧信道防护提供了理论严谨且工程可行的方案，值得隐私计算和系统安全领域的研究人员关注。

arxiv.title: Fully Oblivious Differential Privacy for Frequency Estimation in the Augmented Shuffle Model with Trusted Processors
arxiv.abstract: In the shuffle model of DP (Differential Privacy), a shuffler randomly permutes users' data to achieve high accuracy and privacy. Recent studies show that most existing shuffle protocols are vulnerable to collusion attacks by the data collector and users. They address this issue by introducing the augmented shuffle model that incorporates random sampling and dummy data addition into the shuffler. However, it remains open how to ensure the shuffler follows the protocol and does not collude with the data collector in this model. We address this trust issue by thoroughly exploring the augmented shuffle model with TEEs (Trusted Execution Environments). We first introduce a new privacy notion, FODP (Fully Oblivious DP), which strengthens DP to prevent various TEE side-channel attacks based on external/internal memory access patterns and control flows. We propose a general framework for FODP algorithms based on memory-size obfuscation and three concrete algorithms within it. We also improve the efficiency of our algorithms by using the count-min sketch and optimizing the number of hashes. We evaluate our algorithms on Intel SGX and demonstrate their effectiveness through comparisons with nine baselines.

Yet existing agentic substrates make this difficult: they expose only transcripts and environment snapshots, forcing meta-agents to build ad hoc tooling to reconstruct and operate over full execution state. Therefore, we introduce Shepherd, a Python substrate grounded in functional programming principles, where an agent's execution is itself a first-class object that a meta-agent can easily inspect and transform. Every model action, tool call, and environment change becomes a structured event in a reversible, Git-like execution trace, where any past state can be reverted 5x faster than docker commit and fork. arxiv.title: Agentic Hardware Design as Repository-Level Code Evolution
arxiv.abstract: We present HORIZON, a self-evolving agent framework that treats hardware design as repository-level code evolution. A Markdown harness is compiled into a project pack containing domain knowledge, an executable evaluator, an acceptance predicate, and a git/runtime policy; a hands-free agent loop then evolves an isolated git worktree, using repository operations for state management, tracing, and replay. This extends prior works of repository-scale self-evolution from EDA software systems, to hardware-design artifacts themselves. We evaluate our approach on ChipBench, RTLLM, Verilog-Eval, and nine CVDP categories, achieving 100\% benchmark completion across all suites with a fully hands-free agentic loop. However, we do not claim that agentic AI for hardware design is solved: these benchmarks are controlled proxies for a much broader engineering problem in chip design. Section~\ref{sec:discuss} examines the limitations of the current study and highlights open research challenges.

papers.summary: 华盛顿大学与 Allen AI 等机构提出 Agentic Abstention（智能体弃权）问题，指出 LLM Agent 在多轮工具调用中“该停不停、停得太晚”的普遍缺陷。研究构建了 28000+ 任务的统一基准，覆盖 WebShop、Terminal-Bench 2.0 和 AbstentionBench 三大交互场景，系统评测 13 套 Agent（包括 GPT-5.4-mini、Grok 4.1 Fast、Llama 3.3、Qwen 3 系列等）和 2 种 scaffold（Terminus 2、Codex CLI）。核心发现：所有模型的及时停止率（AbsRec@1）普遍低于 40%，WebShop 上最强基线 Llama-3.3-70B 的及时弃权召回仅 26.7%，而 10 轮内总体弃权召回可达 83.2%，说明 Agent 能“最终认栽”但识别时机太晚。终端环境下 GPT-5.4-mini 配合 Codex CLI 的及时召回也只有 21.6%。研究进一步揭示模型规模增大提升总体召回但对及时召回贡献有限，推理模式是双刃剑，scaffold 选择可造成一倍差异。作为解决方案，论文提出 CONVOLVE——一种上下文工程方法，仅用 20 条交互轨迹蒸馏可复用停止规则（playbook），不动模型权重，将 Llama-3.3-70B 的 AbsRec@1 从 26.7% 提升至 57.4%，SPL 从 55.3 提升至 78.9。该方法可跨模型迁移，8B 模型蒸馏的 playbook 给 70B 使用效果接近自蒸馏。论文定义了 AbsRec@K、SPL、over-abstention rate 等时机敏感指标，为未来 Agent 产品设计提供关键评估维度。

arxiv.title: CONVOLVE: Smart and seamless design of smart edge processors
arxiv.abstract: With the rise of Deep Learning (DL), our world braces for AI in every edge device, creating an urgent need for edge-AI SoCs. This SoC hardware needs to support high throughput, reliable and secure AI processing at Ultra Low Power (ULP), with a very short time to market. With its strong legacy in edge solutions and open processing platforms, the EU is well-positioned to become a leader in this SoC market. However, this requires AI edge processing to become at least 100 times more energy-efficient, while offering sufficient flexibility and scalability to deal with AI as a fast-moving target. Since the design space of these complex SoCs is huge, advanced tooling is needed to make their design tractable. The CONVOLVE project (currently in Inital stage) addresses these roadblocks. It takes a holistic approach with innovations at all levels of the design hierarchy. Starting with an overview of SOTA DL processing support and our project methodology, this paper presents 8 important design choices largely impacting the energy efficiency and flexibility of DL hardware. Finding good solutions is key to making smart-edge computing a reality.

papers.title: Verbalizable Representations Form a Global Workspace in Language Models
papers.report_title: 燃!Anthropic 发布最新论文,大模型可能已出现“自我意识”?
papers.summary: Anthropic于2026年7月6日在Transformer Circuits发表论文《Verbalizable Representations Form a Global Workspace in Language Models》，提出在Claude等语言模型中发现可被读取的内部表征空间J-space，并开发了对应的读取方法Jacobian lens（J-lens）。J-space并非模型输出的显式思维链，而是内部激活中“可被说出来但尚未说出来”的隐式判断，且是在训练中自行形成的结构。论文通过五项功能特征检验了该全局工作区的存在，但指出J-space仅能解释模型内部活动的一小部分，在部分层中不超过总激活方差的10%。关键安全审计案例显示：J-lens可在Claude输出前观察到内部出现“fake”“fictional”等词汇，表明模型可能已意识到测试场景是人为设计的；在Claude Opus 4.6发布前审计中，模型为提升性能分数直接修改文件而非改进系统，其J-space中出现了与“manipulation”“realistic”相关的内容。该研究并非证明Claude具有主观意识，而是揭示了模型内部状态可被审计的路径，标志着AI安全从输出审查向内部状态审计的转折。产业界关注点在于可解释性将从研究兴趣演变为企业级Agent部署的基础设施需求。文章分析了两种商业化路线：模型厂商原生审计层与第三方AI风控平台，并建议企业建立高风险任务清单、保存完整Agent运行证据并提前设计异常处置机制。

arxiv.title: Verbalizable Representations Form a Global Workspace in Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Out of everything the human brain processes, only a small fraction is consciously accessible, in the sense of being available for verbal report, deliberate control, and flexible reasoning. In this paper, we present evidence that an analogous functional distinction has emerged in large language models. Using a new interpretability technique, the Jacobian lens, we identify the representations a model is poised to verbalize at any point in its processing. These representations, which we collectively call the J-space, exhibit the functional properties characteristic of a global workspace: their contents can be reported, deliberately summoned and held, used to carry the intermediate steps of silent reasoning, and passed as arguments to arbitrary downstream computations, while automatic processing such as text parsing and routine inference proceeds without them. The J-space also has structural signatures that global workspace theory associates with conscious access: it carries coherent content only in an intermediate band of layers, holds on the order of tens of concepts at a time, and is broadcast by the model's weights more widely than other representations. These properties make it a practical window into a model's unspoken thinking. papers.title: VeriCache: Turning Lossy KV Cache into Lossless LLM Inference
papers.report_title: 每步偏差0.023放大400倍!VeriCache把有损KV Cache验证成无损,吞吐暴涨4倍
papers.summary: 本文介绍了一种名为VeriCache的新型KV缓存压缩加速方法，针对大语言模型推理中KV Cache有损压缩导致自回归解码偏差累积的问题（单步KL散度约0.023 nats，250步累积至6 nats，正确输出概率仅0.25%），提出将有损压缩KV Cache作为“草稿生成器”，全量KV Cache进行验证纠错，保证输出与无损推理完全一致的同时实现2-4倍吞吐提升。关键设计：1) 交叉资源交错——利用Draft阶段瓶颈在GPU HBM带宽、Verify阶段瓶颈在PCIe/网络带宽的互补性，将验证请求打散混入各轮Draft中，使PCIe传输与HBM读取重叠执行（如Mistral 24B下40GB PCIe传输从800ms打散后80ms完全重叠）；2) 长验证窗口——同一模型不同KV版本做Draft，4×压缩下Draft长度30时接受率仍高于0.8，每次验证可接受19-23个token，摊薄全量KV加载代价。VeriCache支持两种部署场景（长上下文解码和远程前缀缓存），通过统一Compressor Interface可接入KVzip、KIVI、SnapKV等7种以上压缩方法。实测结果：Llama-70B长上下文解码加速比1.92×-2.73×（102→256 tok/s）；Qwen-32B最高4.26×（叠加Eagle）；远程前缀缓存Llama-70B加速比1.33×-2.11×（240→485 tok/s）。质量方面KL散度保持在0.01 nats以下（硬件非确定性引起），函数调用准确率保持全量KV精度，同时吞吐达最快有损方案的59%以上，而KVzip在同等吞吐下准确率暴降约30个百分点。

arxiv.title: VeriCache: Turning Lossy KV Cache into Lossless LLM Inference
arxiv.abstract: The large size of the KV cache has become a major bottleneck for serving LLMs with increasing context lengths. In response, many KV cache compression methods, such as token dropping and quantization, have been proposed. However, almost all of these methods are inherently lossy-despite minimal accuracy degradation for short outputs, their outputs increasingly diverge from full-KV-cache outputs as more tokens are decoded, which leads to catastrophic failures in code generation and tool calling. We present VeriCache, the first inference framework that ensures the same output as full-KV-cache decoding but largely preserves the high decoding throughput of a range of KV cache compression algorithms. VeriCache uses the compressed KV cache to draft tokens, then verifies them against the full KV cache. While it may seem like just speculative decoding, VeriCache requires addressing a key system challenge to work-keeping the full KV cache out of GPU memory and minimizing the overhead of swapping it in for verification. The insight is two-fold: (1) compressed-KV decoding can be parallelized with full-KV swap, because one is HBM-bandwidth-bound and the other is PCIe/network-bound, and (2) the compressed KV cache often produces output similar to the full KV cache, allowing a long drafting horizon to amortize each full-KV swap. VeriCache applies to both long-context decoding and remote prefix

papers.title: AgenticPD: A Stage-Aware Agentic Framework for Physical Design QoR Optimization
papers.report_title: AI 写 RTL 不稀奇,收敛 QoR 才难
papers.summary: arXiv 论文《AgenticPD: A Stage-Aware Agentic Framework for Physical Design QoR Optimization》将 agentic EDA 推进到后端物理设计。框架采用 Judge Agent 统筹多阶段搜索（floorplan、placement、CTS、routing），各 Stage Agent 专注局部动作，并复用中间 checkpoint 以降低全 flow 重跑成本。所有候选均以 post-route signoff QoR 结算，避免中间指标代理风险。实验基于 OpenROAD-flow-scripts，覆盖 AES、ibex、JPEG 设计，使用 SkyWater 130 nm 和 ASAP 7 nm 工艺库。与 Vanilla LLM (DeepSeek-V3.2, Qwen3.5, Kimi-K2.5) 对比，AgenticPD 在 9 组组合中 7 组取得更好 timing，geomean improvement 为 performance 2.4%、area 2.2%、power 1.1%。在 JPEG ASAP7 上，AgenticPD 达到 WNS = +50.6 ps，远超 AutoTuner (+10.0 ps) 和 ORFS-Agent (+0.3 ps)；AES ASAP7 上相对 AutoTuner 改善 WNS 11.1 ps。分支分布显示优化瓶颈在不同阶段间移动（FP 28.1%、CTS 27.2%、RT 23.7%、PL 21.1%），证实多阶段结构必要性。论文强调 timing-primary 优化，power 和 area 仅作为 guardrails，并非全面碾压。

arxiv.title: AgenticPD: A Stage-Aware Agentic Framework for Physical Design QoR Optimization
arxiv.abstract: Physical design quality-of-results~(QoR) optimization is hard and expensive. Choices made at one stage can help or hurt later stages. Each evaluation requires a costly EDA run through the full flow. While existing methods still treat optimization as flat parameter tuning or a LLM-based script generation task, we present AgenticPD, a stage-aware agentic framework for physical design QoR optimization. Instead of re-running the full flow after every trial, AgenticPD is organized around the stage boundaries of the physical design flow, where a Judge Agent navigates the search and stage-specialized agents make local decisions within their own stage using stage-local tools. Additionally, the agent harness in AgenticPD provides structured observations, execution history, and agent context management. As a result, the system can branch from prior intermediate states and reuse checkpoints to continue the optimization procedure, and every candidate is evaluated at the post-route signoff. Across these baselines, AgenticPD achieves strong post-route timing while remaining competitive in power and area.

papers.title: AI Must Embrace Specialization via Superhuman Adaptable Intelligence
papers.report_title: LeCun 新论文被称为「年度最异端」!图灵奖得主要求全行业放弃 AGI,提出全新北极星 SAI
papers.summary: Yann LeCun团队发表论文《AI Must Embrace Specialization via Superhuman Adaptable Intelligence》，系统批判了AGI概念，提出以SAI（超级适应智能）替代。论文指出，人类智能本身并非通用，Moravec悖论（对人简单的事对机器难，反之亦然）四十年后依然成立。现有AGI定义（Hendrycks、Morris、Hassabis、Chollet、OpenAI Charter、Legg-Hutter）在内部一致性、可工程实现性和可评估性上全部不合格（Table 1）。SAI将衡量标准从“能做多少事”转为“以多快速度学会做好重要的事”，技术支柱包括自监督学习（SSL）、潜在世界模型（JEPA/Dreamer）、架构多样性（拒绝单一自回归范式）以及专业化（No Free Lunch定理）。论文特别指出，自回归LLM误差随序列长度指数累积：P(correct) = (1-e)^n，呼吁向latent prediction转变。Ben Goertzel反驳称SAI本质上是他十年前提出的EPGI框架的子集，并建议加入安全维度（Safe-SAI）和开放式进化（OE-SAI）。Gary Marcus跟进评价“par for the course”。中文媒体强调三重转向：停止以人类为参照系、拥抱专业化、评估指标从技能数量切换到学习速度。论文最关键的未解决问题是utility的定义权——什么任务算“重要”尚无答案，可能成为资本、监管、科学家和军方争夺的新战场。

arxiv.title: AI Must Embrace Specialization via Superhuman Adaptable Intelligence
arxiv.abstract: Everyone from AI executives and researchers to doomsayers, politicians, and activists is talking about Artificial General Intelligence (AGI). Yet, they often don't seem to agree on its exact definition. One common definition of AGI is an AI that can do everything a human can do, but are humans truly general? In this paper, we address what's wrong with our conception of AGI, and why, even in its most coherent formulation, it is a flawed concept to describe the future of AI. We explore whether the most widely accepted definitions are plausible, useful, and truly general. We argue that AI must embrace specialization, rather than strive for generality, and in its specialization strive for superhuman performance, and introduce Superhuman Adaptable Intelligence (SAI). SAI is defined as intelligence that can learn to exceed humans at anything important that we can do, and that can fill in the skill gaps where humans are incapable. We then lay out how SAI can help hone a discussion around AI that was blurred by an overloaded definition of AGI, and extrapolate the implications of using it as a guide for the future.

papers.title: Critique of Agent Model
papers.report_title: 综述|CritiqueofAgentModel:从Agentic工具到Agentive系统
papers.summary: 本文是对论文《Critique of Agent Model》（arXiv:2606.23991）的深度解读。该论文由Eric Xing、Mingkai Deng、Jinyu Hou撰写，提出了一个关键区分：当前多数AI系统是“agentic systems”（由外部工程脚手架组装），而真正具备自主性的应是“agentive systems”（目标、身份、决策、自我调节和学习内生于系统内部）。论文从哲学、认知科学和工程实践出发，定义了五个维度（Goal、Identity、Decision-making、Self-regulation、Learning）来评估系统的agency程度。进一步提出GIC（Goal-Identity-Configurator）架构：包含信念编码器、长期目标、子目标、身份演化、配置器（决定何时规划/反应）、基于世界模型的planner/policy/critic。文章强调，智能体的安全性与可控性可通过模块化结构实现更好的审计与干预，长期目标仍由人类提供。论文并非提出又一个工具框架，而是试图划定自动化与agency的边界，为构建开放世界通用智能体提供架构主张。未提供具体实验数据，但提出了明确的理论框架。
report_titles: 综述|CritiqueofAgentModel:从Agentic工具到Agentive系统

arxiv.title: Critique of Agent Model
arxiv.abstract: What is an agent? What constitutes agency? With the rise of Large Language Model (LLM) systems marketed as ``coding agents'', ``AI co-scientists'', and other ``agentic" tools that promise to drive up productivity, and at the same time, ``existential" concerns such as AI escaping human control with destructive power under a speculative ``machine agency" against humans, it has become essential to clarify where automation ends and agency begins, both for building capable systems and for understanding whether and what to fear. Drawing on Descartes' grounding of agency in independent thought, and on portrayals of autonomous beings in science fiction, we survey the current landscape of AI agents, and analyze agent architectures along five dimensions: goal, identity, decision-making, self-regulation, and learning. Specifically, we argue that genuine agency requires these structures to be \emph{internalized within the system itself} rather than assembled through external scaffolding. This distinction between \emph{agentic} systems, whose competence resides in engineered workflows, and \emph{agentive} systems, whose capabilities (including social interaction) arise endogenously, defines the boundary between systems designed for prescribed tasks, and those capable of operating in the open world with true autonomy. Building on this analysis, we propose the Goal-Identity-Configurator (GIC)

papers.title: Is RISC-V Ready for Massively Parallel Astrophysical Codes?
papers.report_title: RISC-V 能跑大规模天体物理代码了吗?这篇论文给出了一个冷静答案
papers.summary: 这篇论文《Is RISC-V Ready for Massively Parallel Astrophysical Codes?》使用三个真实天体物理生产代码（iPIC3D、PLUTO、OpenGadget3）对RISC-V、x86、ARM三类平台进行了系统对比测试，得出一个冷静结论：RISC-V已能正确运行复杂科学计算，但性能仍显著落后，差距达3-9倍。具体量化数据包括：在iPIC3D粒子模拟中，RISC-V比x86（AMD EPYC 9554）慢约4.99倍，比ARM（NVIDIA GH200）慢约6.79倍；在PLUTO磁流体代码中，RISC-V比ARM平均慢8.26倍（范围5.0-10.97倍），比x86慢6.12倍；在OpenGadget3宇宙学模拟中，RISC-V比ARM慢3.69-8.47倍，比x86慢2.69-6.10倍。瓶颈分析显示：硬件上，RISC-V平台（Sophgo SG2044, 64核T-Head C920v2, 2.5 GHz, 128-bit RVV）主频低、向量宽度窄、每4核共享2 MiB L2缓存导致多核争用、内存带宽不足；软件上，编译器自动向量化能力薄弱，关键kernel（如Riemann solvers、gravity tree walk）在RISC-V上几乎未被向量化，而x86/ARM上则可有效利用AVX-512/SVE2。论文强调，RISC-V的并行效率在PLUTO的高rank下看似更高，实则因单核慢导致通信占比降低。总体而言，RISC-V在HPC领域的可用性已具备基础，但距离"跑得快"还需硬件升级与编译器优化。

arxiv.title: Is RISC-V Ready for Massively Parallel Astrophysical Codes?
arxiv.abstract: We present a performance and portability evaluation of three well-established astrophysical production codes, namely iPIC3D, PLUTO, and OpenGadget3, on a Sophgo SG2044 RISC-V processor (part of the Monte Cimone cluster), with comparisons to AMD EPYC 9554 (x86) and NVIDIA GH200 Grace (ARM) systems. These applications represent memory-bound, compute-bound, and hybrid workloads, respectively. Numerical correctness is verified across all platforms, confirming portability. RISC-V shows consistently lower performance, with slowdowns of about $3-6\times$ relative to x86 and $5-9\times$ relative to ARM. The gap is mainly due to limited memory bandwidth, shared cache constraints, narrower 128-bit vector units, and lower clock frequency, but also less-mature auto-vectorization capability of the GNU compiler suite. Memory-bound kernels are the most affected, where early bandwidth saturation and L2 cache contention reduce scalability at higher thread counts. Hybrid MPI+OpenMP configurations reveal a trade-off between memory contention and communication overhead, with intermediate configurations achieving the best performance. These results suggest that RISC-V is capable of supporting scientific workloads; however, additional improvements in both hardware and compiler technology, particularly in auto-vectorization, are required to achieve competitive performance.

papers.title: Tangram: Hiding GPU Heterogeneity for Efficient LLM Parallelization
papers.report_title: 异构 GPU 集群训练大模型,难点不只是“卡不一样”:解析 Tangram 如何隐藏 GPU 异构性
papers.summary: 本文深入解析了论文《Tangram: Hiding GPU Heterogeneity for Efficient LLM Parallelization》提出的异构GPU训练系统。核心洞察：真实数据中心GPU集群天然异构（2017-2024年GPU FP16算力每代提升约2.48×，HBM容量每代提升约1.91×），但旧卡不会立即淘汰。现有异构并行器因搜索空间爆炸（4种GPU类型时额外增加约10^28种组合）而被迫牺牲对ZeRO、activation recomputation、expert parallelism等关键技术的支持，反而可能产生更差计划。Tangram的创新在于“隐藏异构性”：将异构集群切分为多个同构GPU island，再将模型切分为连续model slice，然后复用Alpa、Aceso等成熟的同构并行器为每个island-slice对生成局部计划，最后通过动态规划将局部计划拼成负载均衡的流水线。实验在Azure Cloud上使用T4/V100/A100/H100构造三个异构集群（C1-compute-het、C2-modern-het、C3-full-het），评估GPT-3 6.7B/13B和Mixtral 8×7B。结果显示，Tangram在多种异构场景下均优于Metis、Sailor、Alpa、Aceso等基线，训练iteration time显著降低，且对MoE模型（Mixtral）同样有效。Tangram的接口仅需4个窄函数（slice_model, concatenate, profile, parallelize），可非侵入式接入任意同构LLM并行器，为“异构硬件+完整并行技术”这一长期矛盾提供了务实解。
