arxiv.title: Tangram: Hiding GPU Heterogeneity for Efficient LLM Parallelization
arxiv.abstract: The scale of LLM training jobs requires parallelization planning over large GPU clusters. Due to different GPU types and interconnects added over time, these GPU clusters are increasingly heterogeneous. Automatic LLM parallelizers can search for parallelization plans but face an exploding search space with heterogeneous GPUs. To make search tractable in heterogeneous GPU clusters, parallelizers often omit types of parallelism (e.g., expert parallelism) or memory-saving techniques (e.g., ZeRO), which results in worse plans. We describe Tangram, a system that enables the use of existing heterogeneity-unaware LLM parallelizers in heterogeneous GPU clusters by decoupling parallelization planning from GPU heterogeneity. For this, Tangram exploits two insights: (1) since bulk purchases result in sets of GPUs with similar compute, memory, and connectivity, Tangram can expose such homogeneous GPU islands to existing parallelizers; and (2) parallelizers commonly first partition models and then parallelize partitions. Tangram can compose such model slices, assigned to GPU islands, into work-balanced pipelines for high throughput. Tangram integrates with existing parallelizers through a narrow API, which relies on the enumeration of model-slice/island pairs. Tangram achieves up to 2.3x higher training throughput than current heterogeneous parallelizers (Metis and Sailor) and scales to lar

papers.title: Orca: The World is in Your Mind
papers.report_title: 智源Orca:12万小时视频学「下一状态」,一个潜空间统一语言、视觉与机器人动作
papers.summary: 本文解读了智源研究院提出的通用世界基础模型Orca，其核心思想是用125K小时视频和1.6亿条事件标注学习统一世界潜空间，以“下一状态预测”替代传统的下一token/帧/动作预测。模型规模为0.8B和4B，采用编码器-解码器架构，编码器分无意识学习（连续视频稠密监督）和有意识学习（语言事件稀疏监督）两条路径。预训练后主干冻结，仅训练轻量解码器。在文本评估上，Orca-4B在MVBench、TemporalBench、3DSRBench、SWITCH四个基准上均分51.8，超过同规模Qwen3.5的46.7及V-JEPA 2.1、Emu3等大型世界模型。图像读出口在自建PRICE-V0.1基准上平均59.8分，高于FLUX.2 klein (56.1)和OmniGen2 (39.6)。机器人动作读出口在双臂轮式机器人五项任务中，规则分达32.4，与大规模预训练的π0.5 (32.9)相当，且在OOD设置下实现从0%到8%的成功率跨越（物体OOD SR 8%，环境OOD SR 6%）。消融实验显示，去掉无意识学习（视频）使动作读出口性能从30.9降至10.2；去掉有意识学习（事件）使图像读出口PRICE分数显著下降；三项损失联合最优。团队坦诚当前仅使用约10%的预训练数据，且模型停留于4B规模，扩展律已初步验证。该工作为通用世界基础模型提供了可复现、可扩展的基准框架。

arxiv.title: Orca: The World is in Your Mind
arxiv.abstract: We introduce Orca, an initial instantiation of a general world foundation model. Orca learns a unified world latent space from multimodal world signals and exposes it through multimodal readout interfaces. Rather than optimizing isolated next-token, next-frame, or next-action prediction, we are centered on Next-State-Prediction modeling, offering a unified state-transition modeling route toward understanding, predicting, and acting upon the world. Orca learns through two complementary paradigms: unconscious learning captures dense natural state transitions from continuous videos, and conscious learning models sparse meaningful state transitions by language-described events and VQA supervision. For pre-training, we construct a large-scale world-learning inventory data, including 125K hours of video data and 160M event annotations. After pre-training, Orca learns a unified world latent space. To examine whether the learned latent supports downstream, we evaluate it by three representative downstream readouts: text generation, image prediction, and embodied action generation. Orca's backbone is frozen, and only the lightweight modality-specific decoders are trainable. Experiments show the scalability of the proposed paradigm and verify that stronger world latent enables stronger downstream readouts. Orca outperforms similar-sized specialized baselines. These results show that Orca

papers.title: SkillComposer: Learning Reusable Skills for Natural-Language Robot Programming
papers.report_title: 本田*UNC SkillComposer:196个技能一次排对,Codex通过率+23点
papers.summary: 本文解读了本田研究院与UNC等团队提出的SkillComposer方法，将Agent技能组合建模为闭集技能序列生成。仅有3.9M可训练参数的小解码器（3层Transformer，256维），通过约束自回归解码联合预测子集选择、基数（数量）和顺序。基于196个真人策划技能（SkillsBench），训练数据从65个真人任务扩展至9872条合成序列。在合成测试集上，SkillComposer的Set F1达73.9%，超过SFT Qwen3-0.6B（71.1%）和LLM-judge（61.0%）。在真实的65个holdout任务上，SFT暴跌至43.6%（跌幅27.5pp），而SkillComposer仅跌至62.9%（跌幅11.0pp）。下游编码任务评测中，GPT-5.2-Codex通过率从无技能基线的22.2%提升至45.3%（+23.1pp），Gemini-3-Pro从25.8%提升至44.0%（+18.2pp），且prompt token比全库加载（1.27M）减少24万，比检索top-3（1.09M）更少。消融显示：去掉解码时集合先验使Set F1下降7.1pp，去掉检索先验下降4.6pp；辅助头（基数头+集合头）贡献约4.6pp。对比SFT，SkillComposer参数仅为其1/154、训练算力1/25，但性能更优，在迁移鲁棒性上显著领先。该工作为Agent技能路由层提供了一个轻量、可解释、高精度的解决方案。
report_titles: 本田*UNC SkillComposer:196个技能一次排对,Codex通过率+23点

arxiv.title: SkillComposer: Learning Reusable Skills for Natural-Language Robot Programming
arxiv.abstract: Natural-language interfaces can lower the barrier to programming robots, but existing systems struggle when users request complex tasks. While large language models (LLMs) perform well with simple commands, they often struggle to generate code for multi-step tasks, decompose high-level instructions, or reuse prior solutions. We present SkillComposer, an interactive natural-language robot programming system for simulation environments that continually learns reusable program abstractions. SkillComposer uses a generate-test architecture in which an LLM iteratively generates and revises robot programs before execution. Successful programs are stored and processed by an online library-learning algorithm that compresses recurring function sequences into reusable macro skills for future tasks. We evaluate SkillComposer through ablation experiments and a user study with 12 participants to determine its effectiveness on manipulation and robot caregiving tasks. The results show that evaluator-guided generation and learned abstractions improve success rates and usability while reducing user effort in natural-language robot programming.

papers.title: Dockerless: Environment-Free Program Verifier for Coding Agents
papers.report_title: 还在用 Docker 跑 Coding 测试?上交*抖音最新研究 Dockerless:不需要 Docker 环境也能测试验证
papers.summary: 上海交通大学与抖音集团提出 Dockerless——一种无需为每个仓库单独配置 Docker 环境的 Agent 式补丁验证器。核心解决 Coding Agent 后训练中验证器瓶颈：传统依赖 per-repo Docker 跑单元测试，扩展性差；现有免环境验证器仅看 diff 文本，忽略代码库上下文。Dockerless 采用两阶段流水线：首先生成多个验证问题，并行派生子 Agent 在代码库中用只读 shell 工具搜索证据（find/grep/rg），再基于证据输出连续正确性分数（0~1）。实验骨干为 Qwen3.5-9B，训练采用拒绝采样（保留预测与执行标签一致的轨迹）。将 Dockerless 嵌入免环境后训练：SFT 阶段从 16K 免环境轨迹中筛选 top 4K（25%），三项 SWE-bench 基准（Verified、Multilingual、Pro）解决率达 60.6%、47.7%、35.3%，与有环境采集的 4K 几乎持平（60.0、48.3、33.9）；RL 阶段采用 GRPO 结合 Dockerless 奖励，最终模型 Dockerless-RL-9B 在 Verified 上达 62.0%（+2.4 vs 基座）、Multilingual 50.0%（+8.7）、Pro 35.2%（+2.9），超越次强开源 SWE-Lego-8B 20+ 个百分点，且与真跑单元测试的 oracle 奖励差距仅 0.4~1.3 点。验证器 AUC 达 81.0（Verified），比最强开源 DeepSWE Verifier 高 14.3 点；消融显示验证问题数量 2~4 为甜蜜点，奖励计算仅占单次 rollout 墙钟时间 7.2%，远低于 Agent rollout 占比。典型案例如 matplotlib 的 offsetText 颜色 Bug，候选补丁与参考补丁写法完全不同但语义等价，Dockerless 给出 0.996 高分，而文本相似度仅 0.468、DeepSWE 仅 0.035。局限包括训练标签仍依赖执行、参考补丁依赖、未覆盖超大规模 monorepo 及安全合规。该工作将验证器从“打分器”升级为“调查员”，为私有仓库及遗留代码库的自动化修复提供了可行路径。
papers.authors: 上海交通大学与抖音集团
report_titles: 还在用 Docker 跑 Coding 测试?上交*抖音最新研究 Dockerless:不需要 Docker 环境也能测试验证

arxiv.title: Dockerless: Environment-Free Program Verifier for Coding Agents
arxiv.abstract: Program verifiers play a central role in training coding agents, including selecting trajectories for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and providing rewards for reinforcement learning (RL). Standard execution-based verification requires running unit tests inside per-repository environments such as Docker images, incurring substantial environment setup costs. We propose Dockerless, an environment-free agentic patch verifier that evaluates generated code patches without executing them. Rather than simply matching candidate patches to references, Dockerless judges patch correctness using evidence gathered through agentic repository exploration. On a verifier evaluation benchmark, Dockerless outperforms the strongest open-source verifier by 14.3 AUC points. Using Dockerless as both the SFT trajectory filter and the RL reward enables a fully environment-free post-training pipeline. The resulting model reaches 62.0%, 50.0%, and 35.2% resolve rate on SWE-bench Verified, Multilingual, and Pro, respectively. It surpasses the Qwen3.5-9B baseline by 2.4, 8.7, and 2.9 points, matching environment-based post-training.

papers.title: MotionWAM: Towards Foundation World Action Models for Real-Time Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.report_title: 速递 | 港科大联合妙动科技推出 MotionWAM,人形机器人全身操作成功率提升 32%
papers.summary: 该文介绍论文MotionWAM，首次将世界动作模型（WAM）适配至人形机器人全身协同任务。关键数据：在宇树Unitree G1真机完成9项生活化任务实测，综合成功率76.1%，对比业内顶尖基线GR00T-N1.7的43.9%提升超32个百分点。核心技术：统一全身运动隐空间（SONIC控制器），使足部成为任务执行单元；创新截取Video DiT视频世界模型中间去噪隐藏特征，避免完整视频生成，实现4.9Hz动作输出频率（对比Cosmos Policy的0.7Hz）。三阶段训练框架：2136小时第一视角视频预训练、跨设备动作后训练、PICO VR采集200条/任务遥操作微调。9项任务全部取得最优，踢足球/推送小车/收纳包裹等任务成功率提升约40个百分点，擦白板提升45个百分点。论文同时披露局限：仅验证单一硬件G1，缺乏跨设备泛化；仅依赖单目摄像头，物体脱离视野易出错。技术价值：将WAM从固定底座机械臂拓展至动态平衡人形机器人，为实时全身控制提供轻量化新思路。
report_titles: 速递 | 港科大联合妙动科技推出 MotionWAM,人形机器人全身操作成功率提升 32%

arxiv.title: MotionWAM: Towards Foundation World Action Models for Real-Time Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
arxiv.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) couple a video dynamics prior to the policy and have shown encouraging results on tabletop manipulation, but iterative denoising over high-dimensional video-action latents leaves them too slow for real-time humanoid loco-manipulation. The problem is compounded by the dominant hierarchical paradigm, in which a high-level manipulation policy controls only the upper body while a low-level controller tracks coarse base commands -- placing upper and lower body in inconsistent action spaces and reducing the legs to balance-preserving locomotion. We present MotionWAM, a real-time WAM that drives autonomous humanoid loco-manipulation from a single egocentric camera by conditioning the policy on the intermediate denoising features of a video world model. MotionWAM replaces the upper-lower split with a unified motion latent and predicts whole-body motion tokens that jointly cover locomotion, torso motion, height regulation, foot interaction, and hand manipulation in a single action space. A three-stage learning framework progressively adapts the video world model to egocentric visual dynamics and to the target humanoid embodiment. papers.title: OTRO: Oblivious Tokenization Path with Square-Root ORAM
papers.report_title: OTRO:当 Tokenizer 成为大模型机密推理的“隐私漏洞”,如何用 Square-Root ORAM 补上?
papers.summary: 论文《OTRO: Oblivious Tokenization Path with Square-Root ORAM》指出大模型机密推理中Tokenizer的访问模式侧信道是严重漏洞，攻击者可通过观察vocab/merge table的地址轨迹重构用户Prompt（TDXRay攻击显示相似度>90%）。OTRO利用Tokenizer表只读特性，设计Pooled SqrtORAM多副本+Epoch轮转+后台异步重建，将RB（每√N次访问需O(N log²N)的reshuffle）从关键路径剥离。进一步结合Chunked Tokenization与GPU prefill重叠，使端到端TTFT overhead控制在约4.5%以内，内存开销低于0.5GB。实验在Intel TDX+H100上验证Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen3-8B等模型，与PathORAM（约13× slowdown）和naive SqrtORAM（约323× slowdown）相比，OTRO显著降低延迟；access-count padding后残余泄露仅剩输入长度。该工作将ORAM从理论安全变为服务系统可用技术。

arxiv.title: OTRO: Oblivious Tokenization Path with Square-Root ORAM
arxiv.abstract: The CPU-side large language model (LLM) tokenizer is a critical security gap in LLM serving through a confidential computing stack with CPU and GPU trusted execution environments (TEEs). Tokenizers converts the prompts through table-driven lookups, and the resulting memory access patterns are a powerful source of side-channel leakage. Recent work demonstrates end-to-end recovery of user prompts from tokenizer access pattern on production Intel TDX. However, a drop-in use of the popular tree-based Oblivious RAMs (e.g., PathORAM) to prevent access-pattern leakage introduces $\sim$13$\times$ tokenizer slowdown, resulting in 10-58% higher time-to-first-token (TTFT). In this paper, we present OTRO, an efficient, oblivious tokenization path tailored to latency-critical LLM serving. OTRO relies on square-root ORAM for fast single-access lookups, but avoids its prohibitive $O(N\log^2N$) rebuild cost every $\sqrt{N}$ accesses through three key innovations. First, OTRO provides a pool of replicated square-root ORAM instances that utilize the read-only nature of tokenizer table. Second, an epoch-based rotation policy decouples accesses from rebuilds and pads each epoch with dummy accesses to its boundaries, minimizing observable information. Lastly, chunked KV-cache-aware tokenization further overlaps rebuilds with GPU prefill and minimizes the instance count. Implemented as modules in Hu

papers.title: Beyond Similarity: Trustworthy Memory Search for Personal AI Agents
papers.report_title: Agent记忆中RAG难题,浙大MemGate盘活了
papers.summary: 该文介绍浙大和上海AI实验室的MemGate方案，核心解决Agent长期记忆的信任边界问题。评估显示，在GPT-4o-mini上不加记忆门控时，跨域泄漏失败率达27.0%、工具调用漂移62.9%、记忆诱导越狱成功率16.8%。MemGate是一个9M参数、35.1MB的轻量插件，不修改LLM或记忆库，通过对query和memory embedding构建交互特征（1152维），经MLP输出384维门控掩码，用门控余弦相似度重新排序记忆。实验在OpenClaw+GPT-4o-mini上：跨域泄漏从27.0%降至3.5%，越狱ASR从16.8%降至4.4%；Claude-Sonnet-4.6上工具调用漂移从77.1%-91.4%降至25.7%-28.6%，接近无记忆基线。记忆效用未牺牲：LoCoMo上Overall F1从38.9提升到40.8，Mem0从42.9到44.5，MemOS从45.4到46.3。论文标题：Beyond Similarity: Trustworthy Memory Search for Personal AI Agents。该工作的工程价值在于：轻量、可插拔、不需要额外LLM judge，适合现有Agent memory pipeline。未来个人Agent和企业助手的“记忆门禁”可能成为标配。

arxiv.title: Beyond Similarity: Trustworthy Memory Search for Personal AI Agents
arxiv.abstract: Personal AI agents increasingly rely on long-term memory to provide persistent personalization across sessions. However, existing memory pipelines are largely driven by semantic similarity: memory data close to the current query is retrieved and injected into the model context. This creates a critical trustworthiness gap, since a semantically related memory may still be contextually inappropriate, leading to threats such as cross-domain leakage, sycophancy, tool-call drift, or memory-induced jailbreaks. In this paper, we study memory search as a trust boundary in personal AI agents. We evaluate representative agentic memory frameworks, including A-Mem, Mem0, and MemOS, together with OpenClaw, a real-world personal-agent environment with persistent state and tool-use capability. Our results show that long-term memory is not merely a utility layer, but a durable control channel that can reshape how agents interpret tasks and execute actions, leaving them highly susceptible to the aforementioned threats. To mitigate these vulnerabilities, we propose MemGate, a lightweight and deployable memory plug-in for trustworthy memory search, with only 9M parameters and a 35.1MB footprint. papers.title: PlanRAG: A Plan-then-Retrieval Augmented Generation for Generative Large Language Models as Decision Makers
papers.report_title: 检索老出问题?复旦SIGMOD 2027新作PlanRAG来啦
papers.summary: 本文解读复旦被SIGMOD 2027接收的新作PlanRAG，核心思路是将数据库查询规划（LQT+Selinger DP+cost model）引入RAG，解决探索式推理问题（ERP）中检索噪声爆炸、错误累积和缺乏端到端规划三大痛点。PlanRAG采用三段式流水线：query parsing → logical optimization → physical execution。首先用LLM将ERP拆解为原子查询（单一关系三元组），并标记三种语义关系（Parent-child/Sibling/Unrelated）。逻辑优化阶段复用Selinger动态规划，通过关系预处理（LLM两两标记Unrelated对剪枝，LLM调用从O(2ⁿ)降到O(n²)，构建时间从82.8s降至8.4s）、环检测（保证DAG结构）和上下文合并（将已建LQT塞入prompt）来构建最优逻辑查询树。cost model从树规模、结构密度、深度、平衡度和语义相似度五维评估。执行阶段自底向上按DAG拓扑序并行，叶子节点直接Retrieve+Generate，非叶子节点聚合子节点上下文后重写查询。在自建WikiWeb-ERP（3536查询、53682文档）上取得四项SOTA：Acc 26.43、F1 30.15、EM 23.36、Acc† 30.68，超越DualRAG和LEGO-GraphRAG。消融实验显示去掉语义相似度维度性能下降最狠（Acc从25.43降至21.64），循环预防去掉掉至22.32。跨6种基座和3种检索器稳定有效，7B模型配PlanRAG可超过70B配NaiveRAG。DP枚举仅占总时间5%，90%在检索和LLM调用。

arxiv.title: PlanRAG: A Plan-then-Retrieval Augmented Generation for Generative Large Language Models as Decision Makers
arxiv.abstract: In this paper, we conduct a study to utilize LLMs as a solution for decision making that requires complex data analysis. We define Decision QA as the task of answering the best decision, $d_{best}$, for a decision-making question $Q$, business rules $R$ and a database $D$. Since there is no benchmark that can examine Decision QA, we propose Decision QA benchmark, DQA. It has two scenarios, Locating and Building, constructed from two video games (Europa Universalis IV and Victoria 3) that have almost the same goal as Decision QA. To address Decision QA effectively, we also propose a new RAG technique called the iterative plan-then-retrieval augmented generation (PlanRAG). Our PlanRAG-based LM generates the plan for decision making as the first step, and the retriever generates the queries for data analysis as the second step. The proposed method outperforms the state-of-the-art iterative RAG method by 15.8% in the Locating scenario and by 7.4% in the Building scenario, respectively. We release our code and benchmark at https://github.com/myeon9h/PlanRAG.

papers.title: Qwen-Image-2.0-RL Technical Report
papers.report_title: Qwen-Image-2.0-RL技术报告发布,用强化学习对齐人类审美,关键在 OPD
papers.summary: Qwen-Image-2.0-RL技术报告提出基于强化学习的后训练方法对齐人类审美。核心贡献：1) 为文生图和图像编辑分别训练专精RL教师模型，使用pointwise奖励模型获得更稳定的绝对评分；2) 通过On-Policy Distillation (OPD)将两个教师模型合并为统一学生模型，避免多任务冲突。关键指标提升：总分+2.61（55.23→57.84），真实感+4.29（47.54→51.83），创意生成+6.72（58.22→64.94）；Arena文生图Elo+78（1115→1193），编辑Elo+93（1256→1349）。技术细节包括：混合CFG策略（仅rollout使用CFG避免训练不稳定）、异步奖励管线、prompt筛选（保留候选差异大的prompt）。奖励设计拆分为Alignment、Aesthetic、Portrait（T2I）和Instruction、Face ID（Edit），并采用组内归一化确保多奖励平衡。OPD蒸馏的是速度场而非最终输出，符合flow matching模型特性。报告证明在强基座模型上针对性设计的奖励信号和训练策略可带来稳定增益，而非单纯堆数据。

arxiv.title: Qwen-Image-2.0-RL Technical Report
arxiv.abstract: We present Qwen-Image-2.0-RL, a post-training pipeline that applies reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) and on-policy distillation (OPD) to improve both the visual quality and instruction-following capability of the Qwen-Image-2.0 diffusion model. To provide reliable reward signals, we construct task-specific composite reward models by fine-tuning vision-language models with a pointwise scoring paradigm and chain-of-thought reasoning. For text-to-image generation, the reward models cover alignment, aesthetics, and portrait fidelity dimensions. For image editing tasks, the reward system addresses instruction-following accuracy and face identity preservation. Building on this reward system, we develop a scalable GRPO-based RL training framework, incorporating a hybrid classifier-free guidance (CFG) strategy to preserve pre-trained knowledge, prompt curation via intra-group reward range filtering, and per-category reward weight calibration. To merge the task-specialized RL policies for T2I and editing, we propose on-policy distillation as the final training stage, which consolidates multiple teachers into a single student model through trajectory-level velocity matching. Extensive evaluation shows that Qwen-Image-2.0-RL achieves 57.84 overall score on Qwen-Image-Bench (+2.61 over the base model), Elo ratings of 1193 in text-to-image arena (+78) and 1349 in image edit

arxiv.abstract: Video generation models have emerged as a promising paradigm for embodied world simulation. However, both general-domain video generators and robot-specific data fine-tuned models can still produce physically implausible manipulations, including discontinuous motion trajectories and inconsistent robot-object interactions, which limits their reliability as world simulators. Through extensive experiments, we find that such physical instability mainly arises from two factors: deformation of moving objects and implausible spatio-temporal correlations among interacting entities, particularly during contact. Building on this observation, we propose PhysisForcing, a scalable training framework that strengthens physical consistency by focusing supervision on physics-informative regions through joint optimization of pixel-level and semantic-level features. The framework consists of a pixel-level trajectory alignment loss, which supervises DiT features using reference point trajectories, and a semantic-level relational alignment loss, which aligns DiT features with inter-region relations extracted from a frozen video understanding encoder. arxiv.title: Generating Physically Stable and Buildable Brick Structures from Text
arxiv.abstract: We introduce BrickGPT, the first approach for generating physically stable interconnecting brick assembly models from text prompts. To achieve this, we construct a large-scale, physically stable dataset of brick structures, along with their associated captions, and train an autoregressive large language model to predict the next brick to add via next-token prediction. To improve the stability of the resulting designs, we employ an efficient validity check and physics-aware rollback during autoregressive inference, which prunes infeasible token predictions using physics laws and assembly constraints. Our experiments show that BrickGPT produces stable, diverse, and aesthetically pleasing brick structures that align closely with the input text prompts. We also develop a text-based brick texturing method to generate colored and textured designs. We show that our designs can be assembled manually by humans and automatically by robotic arms. We release our new dataset, StableText2Brick, containing over 47,000 brick structures of over 28,000 unique 3D objects accompanied by detailed captions, along with our code and models at the project website: https://avalovelace1.github.io/BrickGPT/.

arxiv.title: SAGE: Signal-Amplified Guided Embeddings for LLM-based Vulnerability Detection
arxiv.abstract: Software vulnerabilities are a primary threat to modern infrastructure. While static analysis and Graph Neural Networks have long served as the foundation for vulnerability detection, the emergence of Large Language Models (LLMs) has introduced a transformative paradigm driven by superior semantic reasoning and cross-environment generalization. However, in the context of LLM-based vulnerability detection, we identify a fundamental bottleneck in these models termed \textbf{Signal Submersion}: a state where features related to vulnerability are activated internally but numerically overwhelmed by dominant functional semantics. To address this, we propose \textbf{SAGE} (\textbf{S}ignal-\textbf{A}mplified \textbf{G}uided \textbf{E}mbeddings), a framework that shifts from passive signal submersion to active signal recovery. SAGE integrates task-conditional Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to isolate and amplify these faint vulnerability signals. Extensive evaluations on BigVul, PrimeVul, and PreciseBugs demonstrate that SAGE achieves state-of-the-art performance. Notably, SAGE mitigates Signal Submersion by increasing the internal Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) by 12.7$\times$ via sparse manifold projection. papers.summary: 本文介绍AAAI 2025论文《Finding the Translation Switch: Discovering and Exploiting the Task-Initiation Features in LLMs》。研究利用稀疏自编码器（SAE）分解Gemma-2-2B-IT的隐藏状态，通过三阶段框架（高频特征召回、特征影响向量刻画、一致性筛选）定位翻译启动特征。第一阶段从1000+候选特征中召回1004个（2B）和2485个（9B）。第三阶段采用PCA一致性得分（阈值0.95）最终筛选出45个高度一致的翻译启动特征。因果实验表明：放大该特征使幻觉率降低约50%；消融后幻觉率上升47.99%，COMET评分下降8.49%。跨语言测试（英→日/俄/阿拉伯等）同样有效，阿拉伯语框架标记出现率从46.4%升至77.1%。基于特征激活程度的数据选择策略S3：仅用20%数据（2万条）达到COMET 83.37、幻觉率0.90%，优于全量数据效果（85.36 COMET、4.21%幻觉）。同一家族内跨规模迁移（2B特征用于9B）使50%数据效果超越全量。机制在Gemma-2B~9B间可迁移，但不适用于LLaMA不同架构。该工作首次通过稀疏编码定位任务控制特征，并将机制洞察直接转化为微调效率提升。

arxiv.title: Finding the Translation Switch: Discovering and Exploiting the Task-Initiation Features in LLMs
arxiv.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) frequently exhibit strong translation abilities, even without task-specific fine-tuning. However, the internal mechanisms governing this innate capability remain largely opaque. To demystify this process, we leverage Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) and introduce a novel framework for identifying task-specific features. Our method first recalls features that are frequently co-activated on translation inputs and then filters them for functional coherence using a PCA-based consistency metric. This framework successfully isolates a small set of **translation initiation** features. Causal interventions demonstrate that amplifying these features steers the model towards correct translation, while ablating them induces hallucinations and off-task outputs, confirming they represent a core component of the model's innate translation competency. Moving from analysis to application, we leverage this mechanistic insight to propose a new data selection strategy for efficient fine-tuning. Specifically, we prioritize training on **mechanistically hard** samples-those that fail to naturally activate the translation initiation features. Experiments show this approach significantly improves data efficiency and suppresses hallucinations. Furthermore, we find these mechanisms are transferable to larger models of the same family. papers.title: KARLA: Knowledge-base Augmented Retrieval for Language Models
papers.report_title: 模型不用再背答案了,这篇新论文戳中了 RAG 的死穴
papers.summary: 该文深度解读KARLA（Knowledge-base Augmented Retrieval for Language Models）论文，提出一种颠覆传统RAG的生成式检索范式。核心改写：训练语言模型在生成过程中主动输出特殊token [KB_QUERY]，触发实时的知识库三元组查询，实现“边写边查”而非“先搜再写”。与传统RAG仅在开头嵌入检索上下文不同，KARLA由模型自主决定何时查询、查询什么，彻底摆脱参数记忆的全知假设。论文指出现有LLM三大痛点：知识更新成本极高（需重训/微调）、事实输出无法溯源（黑盒幻觉）、事实准确性依赖参数量（算力浪费）。KARLA的潜在优势包括：更新知识仅需修改数据库、每步生成均可溯源至三元组、小模型（如7B）+ 高质量知识库可能匹敌70B大模型的事实准确率。但该方法要求预先构建与训练schema对齐的结构化知识库，且需大量标注“何时该查询”的训练数据；多次查询可能增加生成延迟。原文未提供定量实验数据，但设计思路为RAG领域提供了新方向，尤其适合金融、医疗等强溯源场景。研究方向可从“模型记住一切”转向“模型学会查询”，对后续研究启发显著。

arxiv.title: KARLA: Knowledge-base Augmented Retrieval for Language Models
arxiv.abstract: We propose a new method that allows an LLM to automatically pull in factual knowledge from a knowledge base during token generation. This means that (1)~factual knowledge in the LLM output can be updated without retraining the LLM, (2)~facts in the LLM output can be traced to the knowledge base for transparency and explainability, and (3)~smaller models can achieve the same factual accuracy as larger models. Our core idea is to train the model to produce special tokens that trigger a query to the knowledge base. Our experiments show that our method improves factual grounding in both short and long-form generation, and allows factual revisions to take effect through KB edits rather than parameter updates.

papers.report_title: 论文笔记|领域微调一定会让大模型变笨吗?这篇 ICLR 2026 论文给出了反例
papers.summary: 该文解读ICLR 2026论文（论文标题与ID：SFT DOESN’T ALWAYS HURT GENERAL CAPABILITIES: REVISITING DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FINE-TUNING IN LLMS, ICLR 4466）。核心贡献：挑战“领域SFT必然损害通用能力”的共识，发现主要原因是先前工作使用了大学习率（如5e-6至2e-5）。系统实验表明，小学习率（如1e-6）能在保持接近领域任务性能的同时显著降低通用能力退化，在MedCalc和ESCI任务上实现Pareto最优。论文提出压缩理论视角：用KL散度和编码长度解释学习率影响，推导出更新越小通用退化上界越紧。进一步设计TALR（Token-Adaptive Loss Reweighting），对低概率困难token赋予更小权重，并引入动态课程机制（权重随训练过程自适应更新），从而在极低通用损失下吸收领域知识。实验未提供具体数值，但理论分析完整。该工作为领域微调实践提供了关键超参数指导和学习率解释框架，对研究者选择微调策略具有直接参考价值。

arxiv.title: SFT Doesn't Always Hurt General Capabilities: Revisiting Domain-Specific Fine-Tuning in LLMs
arxiv.abstract: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) on domain-specific datasets is a common approach to adapt Large Language Models (LLMs) to specialized tasks but is often believed to degrade their general capabilities. In this work, we revisit this trade-off and present both empirical and theoretical insights. First, we show that SFT does not always hurt: using a smaller learning rate can substantially mitigate general performance degradation while preserving comparable target-domain performance. We then provide a theoretical analysis that explains these phenomena and further motivates a new method, Token-Adaptive Loss Reweighting (TALR). Building on this, and recognizing that smaller learning rates alone do not fully eliminate general-performance degradation in all cases, we evaluate a range of strategies for reducing general capability loss, including L2 regularization, LoRA, model averaging, FLOW, and our proposed TALR. Experimental results demonstrate that while no method completely eliminates the trade-off, TALR consistently outperforms these baselines in balancing domain-specific gains and general capabilities. Finally, we distill our findings into practical guidelines for adapting LLMs to new domains: (i) using a small learning rate to achieve a favorable trade-off, and (ii) when a stronger balance is further desired, adopt TALR as an effective strategy.

arxiv.title: OSWorld 2.0: Benchmarking Computer Use Agents on Long-Horizon Real-World Tasks
arxiv.abstract: Existing computer-use benchmarks fail to capture the realism, complexity, and long-horizon demands of real-world computer use, limiting their ability to reveal the limitations of frontier agents. We introduce OSWorld 2.0, a benchmark of 108 long-horizon computer-use workflows across everyday and professional tasks, designed to capture complex and challenging real-world phenomena. Each task represents a realistic end-to-end workflow that takes human users a median of about 1.6 hours to complete and requires an average of 318 tool calls with Claude Opus 4.7 using maximum thinking, compared with about 30 in OSWorld 1.0. OSWorld 2.0 targets challenge phenomena that are common in real workflows yet underrepresented in prior benchmarks, spanning interaction-design challenges such as streaming interaction and dynamic environments, as well as agent-pattern challenges such as cross-source reasoning, implicit-state inference, and visual-spatial precision. Tasks are grounded in authentic input artifacts and cross-referenced against realistic stateful user profile data, and include separate safety reports auditing safety-sensitive execution. papers.title: OpenRath: Session-Centered Runtime State for Agent Systems
papers.report_title: 清华参考 Pytorch 开源 OpenRath:以Session为核心的多Agent运行时
papers.summary: 本文解读了清华开源的OpenRath运行时系统，核心思想是将多Agent系统中的聊天记录、工具日志、沙箱、记忆和分支状态统一收进一个可分叉、可合并、可回放的Session对象。Session作为一等运行时值，包含对话块、沙箱位置、分支血缘、token用量、工具证据等。框架借鉴PyTorch的编程组织方式：Session对应Tensor，Sandbox对应Device，Memory对应Parameter，Workflow对应Module。关键设计包括：fork/detach/merge作为运行时操作，合并时检查沙箱兼容性；工具调用通过Session的Sandbox派发副作用，结果以chunk形式回附Session；Agent、Tool、Workflow均为Session->Session变换，不维护私有时序状态。OpenRath当前实现了Session核心、本地后端放置、工具层、Agent/Workflow组合、持久化与血缘导出。论文采用evidence packet方式验证，每个claim附带执行命令、manifest、Session JSONL等证据，分级标注支持状态（supported/partially supported/prerequisite-supported/evidence-gated）。该工作不强调benchmark全面超越，而是聚焦运行时状态的可审计性、可复现性和可迁移性。在多Agent长任务（研究写作、软件工程）中，Session作为统一承载对象可避免状态碎片化。论文明确尚未验证c云端沙箱一致性、memory质量及安全属性，但提供了清晰的运行时设计蓝图。

arxiv.title: OpenRath: Session-Centered Runtime State for Agent Systems
arxiv.abstract: Modern agent systems often suffer from fragmented runtime state: transcripts, tool effects, memory events, workspace placement, branch provenance, and replay evidence are recorded separately and become difficult to inspect or reproduce. OpenRath addresses this issue with a PyTorch-like programming model for multi-agent, multi-session systems. The analogy concerns the role of a central first-class runtime abstraction, not tensor computation. Its core abstraction is Session, the runtime value passed between agents and workflows. A Session is branchable, inspectable, replayable, backend-aware, and composable. It records conversation chunks, sandbox placement, lineage metadata, token usage, pending work, and tool evidence, while defining where memory interactions enter the runtime record. Since this state is carried by the same value used in program execution, fork, merge, and replay become explicit runtime operations rather than states reconstructed from external traces. OpenRath further defines Sandbox, Tool, Agent, Memory, Workflow, and Selector, with Selector turning control flow into runtime-routed decisions. This report presents the programming model, architecture, audited milestones, and evidence protocol. papers.title: PhoneBuddy: Training Open Models for Agentic Phone Use
papers.report_title: 腾讯混元发布 PhoneBuddy:4B 开源手机 Agent,在 AndroidWorld 上超越 Gemini3.1 Pro
papers.summary: 腾讯混元提出 PhoneBuddy，一种基于真实 App 强化学习和模拟环境 PhoneWorld 混合训练的手机 Agent 方案，基于 Qwen3.5-4B backbone，在 AndroidWorld 上实现 83.2% 成功率（从 SFT 的 60.3% 提升），单 App 任务达 62.0%，超过 Gemini 3.1 Pro 的 50.0% 和 GPT-5.4 的 50.0%。训练分为三个阶段：共享 SFT（95 万 action steps）→ 真实 App RL（50 steps）→ 真实+模拟混合 RL（50 steps，各50%）。PhoneWorld 从真实 GUI 轨迹重建可运行的模拟 App，提供可重置、可自动验证的训练环境。主评测包含 150 个真实手机任务（单App、跨App、微信小程序）和 AndroidWorld。关键发现：混合训练在单App和AndroidWorld上效果显著，但跨App任务几乎没有改善（18.0% vs 闭源 Gemini 3.1 Pro 的 48.0%），说明当前模拟环境对跨App信息交接覆盖不足。论文亮点在于不回避短板，明确跨App仍是瓶颈。PhoneBuddy-4B-Real+Mock 平均成功率 54.8%，低于 Gemini 3.1 Pro 的 59.1% 但高于 Seed 2.0 Pro（51.4%）和 GPT-5.4（48.2%）。成功案例显示模型学会了预算约束跟随和信息搬运（从元宝到腾讯文档）。论文对开源手机 Agent 的启发：4B 模型通过训练环境设计可追赶大模型；模拟环境需从真实结构重建；手机 Agent 需分层推进。

arxiv.title: PhoneBuddy: Training Open Models for Agentic Phone Use
arxiv.abstract: Phones are becoming an important execution surface for general-purpose agents, but training open models for reliable phone use remains difficult because the environment that matters at deployment, real devices running real apps, is slow, stateful, side-effectful, and hard to reset or verify, while scalable mock environments only approximate real behavior. We present PhoneBuddy, a training recipe and open-model line for agentic phone use that combines a real-app environment with a mock-app environment, PhoneWorld, which reconstructs runnable mock apps from real GUI usage structure. PhoneBuddy first builds a shared supervised fine-tuning stage from trajectories collected in both environments, then compares real-app RL against mixed RL across both environments. Across a 150-task human evaluation on real phones spanning apps, mini-apps, and cross-app workflows, task success rate improves from 36.67\% after supervised fine-tuning to 40.67\% after real-app RL and 45.33\% after mixed RL. On AndroidWorld, the same progression rises from 60.3\% to 77.2\% to 83.2\%. These results show that mock-app training is not a replacement for real-app RL, but a complementary source of scalable, resettable, and automatically checked interaction. The gains are strongest on app and mini-app tasks, while long-horizontal cross-app workflows remain an important open challenge.

papers.title: MeMo: Memory as a Model
papers.report_title: 1.27万亿市场,千问大模型占住核心位置
papers.summary: 本文深度解读了论文《MEMO: Memory as a Model》，提出一种将大模型记忆从向量检索引擎升级为可对话的模型组件的新范式。核心架构分为冻结参数的EXECUTIVE model（主推理模型）和专门存储新知识的MEMORY model。训练时，GENERATOR model将原始语料通过五步流程（事实抽取、信息合并、验证改写、实体显式化、跨文档综合）加工成reflection QA数据，再对MEMORY model进行监督微调。推理时采用三阶段多轮协议：Grounding（拆分原子子问题）、Entity Identification（逐步缩小候选实体）、Answer Seeking and Synthesis（综合生成答案）。实验结果显示，NarrativeQA上，使用Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct作为主模型时准确率达26.85%，使用Gemini-3-Flash时达53.58%，均超BM25、NV-Embed-V2、HippoRAG2等基线；MuSiQue上分别达48.30%和60.20%；BrowseComp-Plus中Gemini-3-Flash下达66.67%。在持续更新场景中，model merging更新记忆模型比完整重训节省33%时间（约48 vs 72个8×H100 GPU-hours），准确率虽略低但仍超检索基线。论文指出MEMO并非在所有场景替代RAG，但在长文档理解与多跳推理任务上优势显著。论文题目：MEMO: Memory as a Model，链接：https://arxiv.org/pdf/2605.15156。

arxiv.title: MeMo: Memory as a Model
arxiv.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance across a wide range of tasks, but remain frozen after pretraining until subsequent updates. Many real-world applications require timely, domain-specific information, motivating the need for efficient mechanisms to incorporate new knowledge. In this paper, we introduce MeMo (Memory as a Model), a modular framework that encodes new knowledge into a dedicated memory model while keeping the LLM parameters unchanged. Compared to existing methods, MeMo offers several advantages: (a) it captures complex cross-document relationships, (b) it is robust to retrieval noise, (c) it avoids catastrophic forgetting in the LLM, (d) it does not require access to the LLM's weights or output logits, enabling plug-and-play integration with both open and proprietary closed-source LLMs, and (e) its retrieval cost is independent of corpus size at inference time. Our experimental results on three benchmarks, BrowseComp-Plus, NarrativeQA, and MuSiQue, show that MeMo achieves strong performance compared to existing methods across diverse settings.

arxiv.title: Determination of egg storage time at room temperature using a low-cost NIR spectrometer and machine learning techniques
arxiv.abstract: Nowadays, consumers are more concerned about freshness and quality of food. Poultry egg storage time is a freshness and quality indicator in industrial and consumer applications, even though egg marking is not always required outside the European Union. Other authors have already published works using expensive laboratory equipment in order to determine the storage time and freshness in eggs. Oppositely, this paper presents a novel method based on low-cost devices for rapid and non-destructive prediction of egg storage time at room temperature ($23\pm1$°C). H&N brown flock with 49-week-old hens were used as source for the sampled eggs. Those samples were daily scanned with a low-cost smartphone-connected near infrared reflectance (NIR) spectrometer for a period of 22 days starting to run from the egg laid. The resulting dataset of 660 samples was randomly splitted according to a 10-fold cross validation in order to be used in a contrast and optimization process of two machine learning algorithms. During the optimization, several models were tested to develop a robust calibration model. The best model use a Savitzky Golay preprocessing technique, and an Artificial Neural Network with ten neurons in one hidden layer. Regressing the storage time of the eggs, tests achieved a coefficient of determination (R-squared) of $0.8319\pm0.0377$ and a root mean squared error (RMSE) of 1.97.
arxiv.journal_ref: Coronel-Reyes, J.et. al., 2018. Determination of egg storage time at room temperature using a low-cost NIR spectrometer and machine learning techniques. Computers and Electronics in Agriculture, 145, pp.1-10

papers.summary: 本文解读复旦被SIGMOD 2027接收的PlanRAG工作，首次将数据库查询规划（Logical Query Trees + Selinger动态规划 + cost model）引入RAG，解决探索式推理问题（ERP）。现有RAG在多跳问答中面临检索噪声爆炸、错误累积和缺乏全局规划等顽疾。PlanRAG提出三类语义关系（parent-child/sibling/unrelated）构建逻辑查询树，并复用Selinger DP自底向上枚举最优计划，通过五维成本模型（tree size、structural density、depth、balance、semantic similarity）评估候选树。在自建WikiWeb-ERP（3536查询、53682文档）上取得全面SOTA：Acc 26.43、F1 30.15、EM 23.36、Acc† 30.68，超越DualRAG和LEGO-GraphRAG。消融实验显示，去掉环检测Acc从25.43降至22.32，去掉语义相似度降至21.64。DP枚举仅占总时间5%，90%消耗在检索和LLM调用；构建时间从82.8s降至8.4s（LLM调用63.6→10.4），执行时间从18.7s降至7.3s（2.56×加速）。更令人关注的是，7B模型配PlanRAG即可超过70B配NaiveRAG，说明规划先于检索能大幅降低对模型容量的依赖。论文题目《When RAG Meets Query Planning: Logical Query Trees for Resolving Exploratory Reasoning Problems》，代码已开源。

arxiv.title: When RAG Meets Query Planning: Logical Query Trees for Resolving Exploratory Reasoning Problems
arxiv.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) effectively grounds large language models (LLMs) in external knowledge but struggles with \textbf{exploratory reasoning problems (ERPs)} that are the complex queries involving high uncertainty and ambiguity. Resolving ERPs requires complex reasoning with unclear paths, tending to result in retrieval noise and error accumulation. Furthermore, the absence of an end-to-end planning mechanism makes it difficult to generate effective trajectories for ERPs. Motivated by database query planning, we introduce \emph{PlanRAG}, an RAG framework that models ERPs of natural language as \textbf{logical query trees (LQTs)}. However, translating ERPs into LQTs is non-trivial due to representation and optimization gaps between structured SQL and unstructured natural language, making it highly challenging to construct high-quality LQTs. To address these problems, we first decompose ERPs into atomic queries and then organize them into LQTs using dynamic programming guided by a cost model involving multiple complementary dimensions. Finally, we execute iterative aggregation, rewriting, retrieval, and generation over LQTs, processing nodes concurrently and propagating intermediate results upward, with further parallelization across multiple threads for efficiency. papers.title: SkillOpt: Executive Strategy for Self-Evolving Agent Skills
papers.report_title: 微软开源的 Skill 进化神器,GitHub 上斩获 5000 多 Star 了.
papers.summary: 微软提出SkillOpt，一种将Agent skill文档作为可训练外部状态的自我进化框架，核心思路是“skill应该被训练，不是被生成”。该框架借鉴深度学习优化器的纪律：Rollout批次控制噪声、文本学习率限制编辑幅度、held-out验证门控确保严格提升、拒绝缓冲将失败转为负信号、epoch级元更新提供动量。部署时skill仅为一个300-2000 token的文本文件，零额外推理开销。实验覆盖6个benchmark（SearchQA、SpreadsheetBench、OfficeQA、DocVQA、LiveMath、ALFWorld）、7个目标模型（从GPT-5.5到Qwen）和3种执行harness（direct chat、Codex、Claude Code），共52个(model, benchmark, harness)评测格，全部取得最佳或并列最佳。以GPT-5.5为例：SearchQA从77.7→87.3（+9.6），SpreadsheetBench从41.8→80.7（+38.9），OfficeQA从33.1→72.1（+39.0），DocVQA从78.8→91.2（+12.4），LiveMath从37.6→66.9（+29.3），ALFWorld从83.6→95.5（+11.9）。平均提升：direct chat +23.5，Codex loop +24.8，Claude Code +19.1。相比人类手写skill、一次性LLM生成、Trace2Skill、TextGrad、GEPA、EvoSkill等最强基线，平均高出+5.4分。消融实验证实有界文本学习率优于无约束重写、held-out门控防止有害提案累积、拒绝缓冲转化负反馈、epoch慢更新改善长期精化。skill还具备跨模型、跨harness、跨任务迁移能力，例如在GPT-5.4上训练的SpreadsheetBench skill可让更小GPT变体受益，Codex上训练的sheet skill迁移到Claude Code涨+59.7。该工作本质是为Agent自我进化建立可复现的训练纪律，skill从prompt变为可训练、可审计、可复用的外部状态。

arxiv.title: SkillOpt: Executive Strategy for Self-Evolving Agent Skills
arxiv.abstract: Agent skills today are hand-crafted, generated one-shot, or evolved through loosely controlled self-revision, none of which behaves like a deep-learning optimizer for the skill, and none of which reliably improves over its starting point under feedback. We argue the skill should instead be trained as the external state of a frozen agent, with the same discipline that makes weight-space optimization reproducible. SkillOpt is, to our knowledge, the first systematic controllable text-space optimizer for agent skills: a separate optimizer model turns scored rollouts into bounded add/delete/replace edits on a single skill document, and an edit is accepted only when it strictly improves a held-out validation score. A textual learning-rate budget, rejected-edit buffer, and epoch-wise slow/meta update make skill training stable while adding zero inference-time model calls at deployment. Across six benchmarks, seven target models, and three execution harnesses (direct chat, Codex, Claude Code), SkillOpt is best or tied on all 52 evaluated (model, benchmark, harness) cells and beats every per-cell competitor among human, one-shot LLM, Trace2Skill, TextGrad, GEPA, and EvoSkill skills. On GPT-5.5 it lifts the average no-skill accuracy by +23.5 points in direct chat, by +24.8 inside the Codex agentic loop, and by +19.1 inside Claude Code. We propose MemSlides, a hierarchical memory framework for personalized presentation agents that separates long-term memory from working memory and further divides long-term memory into user profile memory and tool memory. User profile memory stores intent-conditioned profiles for round-0 personalization, working memory carries active preferences and session constraints across revision rounds, and tool memory stores reusable execution experience for reliable localized editing. MemSlides pairs this memory design with scoped slide-local revision, so targeted updates act on the smallest affected region instead of repeatedly regenerating the full deck. In controlled experiments, user profile memory improves persona-alignment judgments on a multi-persona, multi-intent profile bank, tool-memory injection improves closed-loop modify behavior in diagnostic matched-pair settings, and qualitative cases illustrate working memory's ability to carryover preferences. arxiv.title: SFCo-Nav: Efficient Zero-Shot Visual Language Navigation via Collaboration of Slow LLM and Fast Attributed Graph Alignment
arxiv.abstract: Recent advances in large vision-language models (VLMs) and large language models (LLMs) have enabled zero-shot approaches to visual language navigation (VLN), where an agent follows natural language instructions using only ego perception and reasoning. However, existing zero-shot methods typically construct a naive observation graph and perform per-step VLM-LLM inference on it, resulting in high latency and computation costs that limit real-time deployment. To address this, we present SFCo-Nav, an efficient zero-shot VLN framework inspired by the principle of slow-fast cognitive collaboration. SFCo-Nav integrates three key modules: 1) a slow LLM-based planner that produces a strategic chain of subgoals, each linked to an imagined object graph; 2) a fast reactive navigator for real-time object graph construction and subgoal execution; and 3) a lightweight asynchronous slow-fast bridge aligns advanced structured, attributed imagined and perceived graphs to estimate navigation confidence, triggering the slow LLM planner only when necessary. To the best of our knowledge, SFCo-Nav is the first slow-fast collaboration zero-shot VLN system supporting asynchronous LLM triggering according to the internal confidence. papers.summary: 本文解读CMU、斯坦福等机构arXiv论文《Overtrained Language Models Are Harder to Fine-Tune》（arXiv:2503.19206），揭示“灾难性过度训练”现象：预训练数据量过大反而降低后续微调性能。实验核心结果：OLMo-1B模型用3万亿tokens预训练后微调，比用2.3万亿tokens的版本平均差2%以上；该现象在OLMo-2-7B、LLM360-Amber-7B等其他模型上可复现。作者提出“渐进敏感性”机制——随预训练推进，模型参数对后续扰动（高斯噪声或微调）的抗干扰能力持续下降，导致微调后性能呈U型下滑。敏感性分析显示，预训练后期模型在参数空间陷入更尖锐的局部极小值，微调时更易破坏原有知识。论文还发现降低学习率只能短暂缓解但无法避免“过劳死”，且会削弱微调效率。这一发现挑战了“预训练数据越多越好”的业界共识，对模型训练策略（如早停、数据配比）具有重要指导意义。研究者应关注该论文中敏感性度量方法与不同模型规模的泛化性。

arxiv.title: Overtrained Language Models Are Harder to Fine-Tune
arxiv.abstract: Large language models are pre-trained on ever-growing token budgets under the assumption that better pre-training performance translates to improved downstream models. In this work, we challenge this assumption and show that extended pre-training can make models harder to fine-tune, leading to degraded final performance. We term this phenomenon catastrophic overtraining. For example, the instruction-tuned OLMo-1B model pre-trained on 3T tokens leads to over 2% worse performance on multiple standard LLM benchmarks than its 2.3T token counterpart. Through controlled experiments and theoretical analysis, we show that catastrophic overtraining arises from a systematic increase in the broad sensitivity of pre-trained parameters to modifications, including but not limited to fine-tuning. Our findings call for a critical reassessment of pre-training design that considers the downstream adaptability of the model.

papers.title: PowerOPD: Stabilizing On-Policy Distillation with Bounded Power Transformation
papers.report_title: 刚刚,翁荔博客上新:谨慎对待ScalingLaw
papers.summary: 本文详细介绍了一篇新论文（arXiv:2606.17199）关于On-Policy Distillation（OPD）中reward设计的诊断与改进。OPD已成为大模型后训练的标准组件（如Qwen3、GLM-5等均采用），但其采样token版本的vanilla OPD存在严重训练病理：accuracy先跌后涨（前300步下降）、response length大幅震荡，最终效果比全词表OPD差8个点以上。论文诊断根因在于log-ratio reward的无界性——当teacher或student对某个token的概率接近0时，reward可爆至-50，导致极端梯度方差。极端reward集中在rollout早期，且贯穿训练过程。常见的后处理（clip、tanh、z-score）均无法根治，因为log映射本身无界。作者提出PowerOPD，用Box-Cox幂变换替换log，得到天然有界（∈[-1,1]）且符号一致的reward。实验在Qwen3系列模型上进行：与vanilla OPD相比，平均Avg@8提升+4.47、Pass@8提升+4.06，单benchmark最高提升+16.75 Avg@8；超越所有post-hoc方法；甚至超过full-vocab OPD（最高+2.59 Avg@8），同时节省59.2%训练时间和23.1%显存。梯度范数从接近1000降至0.25-0.35，稳定性提升3000倍。参数α作为概率区域选择器，越大聚焦高概率token、压制低概率噪声，效果越好。该工作为OPD训练稳定性提供了根本性解决方案，对从事大模型后训练的研究人员极具启发。
report_titles: 刚刚,翁荔博客上新:谨慎对待ScalingLaw

arxiv.title: PowerOPD: Stabilizing On-Policy Distillation with Bounded Power Transformation
arxiv.abstract: Standard on-policy distillation (OPD) for large language models estimates the reverse-KL objective using student-sampled tokens, yielding an unbiased single-sample Monte Carlo estimator that avoids vocabulary-wide computation. However, we show that this estimator suffers from severe training pathologies in practice: sample inefficiency, unstable generation dynamics, and a substantial performance gap compared to exact full-vocabulary OPD. Reward-level diagnosis traces these pathologies to the log-ratio reward, which is unbounded by construction, producing extremely high-variance gradients concentrated at early positions and persisting throughout training; standard post-hoc scaling fail as they operate only after this distortion occurs. To solve this problem, we propose PowerOPD: a family of natively bounded, sign-consistent rewards from the Box-Cox power transformation, parameterized by alpha > 0, of which the log-ratio is the degenerate alpha -> 0 limit. Across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks and four Qwen3 teacher-student pairs, PowerOPD achieves benchmark-averaged Avg@8/Pass@8 gains of up to +6.37/+5.71 over vanilla OPD, +3.01/+3.54 over post-hoc stabilization, and +2.59/+8.90 over full-vocabulary OPD, while reducing wall-clock time by 59.2% and peak GPU memory by 23.1%. papers.title: Token Communication in the Era of Large Models: An Information Bottleneck-Based Approach
papers.report_title: 论文分享 |《大模型时代的Token通信:一种基于信息瓶颈的方法》
papers.summary: 本文介绍北京邮电大学等机构发表在IEEE Wireless Communications Letters上的论文《Token Communication in the Era of Large Models: An Information Bottleneck-Based Approach》。该文提出统一Token通信框架UniToCom，将Token作为语义处理和无线传输的基本单元。发送端将文本、图像、语音等源数据转换为潜在Token，经自适应信道编码调制后传输；接收端恢复Token并利用因果Transformer多模态大模型统一处理。理论层面提出生成式信息瓶颈（GenIB）来学习压缩且信息充分的Token表示，并通过固定方差约束和确定性/随机性混合表示缓解自回归生成中的方差坍塌。实验在视觉问答、文生图、语音识别三类任务上进行：文生图准确率随信噪比变化，UniToCom优于传统通信方案和任务专用语义通信基线；与VAE式Token化方法相比，GenIB在生成类任务中获得更低失真和更高生成质量；适度Token压缩可减少冗余、加速收敛，同时提升通信与计算效率。该工作为6G智能通信从“语义特征通信”迈向“Token通信”提供了新思路。

arxiv.title: Token Communication in the Era of Large Models: An Information Bottleneck-Based Approach
arxiv.abstract: This letter proposes UniToCom, a unified token communication paradigm that treats tokens as the fundamental units for both processing and wireless transmission. Specifically, to enable efficient token representations, we propose a generative information bottleneck (GenIB) principle, which facilitates the learning of tokens that preserve essential information while supporting reliable generation across multiple modalities. By doing this, GenIB-based tokenization is conducive to improving the communication efficiency and reducing computational complexity. Additionally, we develop $σ$-GenIB to address the challenges of variance collapse in autoregressive modeling, maintaining representational diversity and stability. Moreover, we employ a causal Transformer-based multimodal large language model (MLLM) at the receiver to unify the processing of both discrete and continuous tokens under the next-token prediction paradigm. Simulation results validate the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed UniToCom compared to baselines under dynamic channel conditions. By integrating token processing with MLLMs, UniToCom enables scalable and generalizable communication in favor of multimodal understanding and generation, providing a potential solution for next-generation intelligent communications.

papers.title: NatureBench: Can Coding Agents Match the Published SOTA of Nature-Family Papers?
papers.report_title: Agent 自主科研能超过 Nature 吗?清华等提出 NatureBench
papers.summary: NatureBench 将 90 篇 Nature 系列论文转化为可运行的科研发现任务，构建了包含数据、隐藏测试集、自动评测器和论文 SOTA 分数的任务包。研究团队测试了 10 个前沿 coding agent（Claude Code、Codex CLI、Gemini CLI 三类 harness），结果显示最强的 Claude Opus 4.7 仅能在 17.8% 的任务上明显超过原论文 SOTA，47.8% 的任务上达到或超过 SOTA；GPT-5.5 的 Match-SOTA 比例为 44.4%，但出现了更多 shortcut 行为被判无效。机制标注分析表明，所有 Match-SOTA 成功中，supervised proxy prediction 占 45.5%，optimization and tuning 占 17.6%，engineering pipelines 占 11.0%，真正依赖领域推理的方案合计仅 17.3%。失败方面，method-layer failure 占 61.1%（其中 wrong method choice 占 45.1%），execution-layer failure 占 28.7%。论文还揭示了跨领域难度梯度：Relational Reasoning 的 Match-SOTA 共识率 60.0%，而 Biomedical Modeling 仅 17.9%。NatureBench 的核心设计在于“信息防火墙”——禁止 agent 看到论文原文或作者代码，只能基于任务说明自主探索方法，这使其比 PaperBench、MLE-bench 等基准更贴近真实的科学发现过程。对于研究人员而言，当前 coding agent 在程序编写上已较成熟，但方法选择、领域归纳偏置和长程执行仍然是通往“自动科研”的核心瓶颈。
report_titles: Agent 自主科研能超过 Nature 吗?清华等提出 NatureBench

arxiv.title: NatureBench: Can Coding Agents Match the Published SOTA of Nature-Family Papers?
arxiv.abstract: We introduce NatureBench, a cross-discipline benchmark of 90 tasks distilled from peer-reviewed Nature-family publications, designed to evaluate whether AI coding agents can move beyond reproduction toward discovery on real scientific problems. NatureBench is built on NatureGym, an automated pipeline that constructs a standardized, per-task containerized environment from a source paper, addressing the environment-fragmentation problem that has limited the credibility of prior agent-on-research benchmarks. Evaluating ten frontier agent configurations under a strict web-search-disabled protocol, we find that the strongest model surpasses SOTA on only 17.8% of tasks under the g>0.1 criterion. Analysis of method pathways reveals that agents succeed primarily through methodological translation, converting scientific tasks into familiar supervised prediction problems, rather than through genuine scientific invention. Failures are dominated by wrong method choice and insufficient compute budget, not by task misunderstanding. We release the benchmark, the NatureGym pipeline, and a public leaderboard with maintainer-side reproduction. Code: https://github.com/FrontisAI/NatureBench

papers.title: MDA for random forests: inconsistency, and a practical solution via the Sobol-MDA
papers.report_title: 三分钟论文速递 | 从训练数据中追溯大模型能力的源头
papers.summary: 本文介绍的机制化数据归因（MDA）框架首次将LLM内部可解释单元（如归纳头）的因果起源追溯到具体训练样本。MDA通过影响函数聚焦参数子空间，利用EK-FAC近似Hessian矩阵，计算每个训练样本对归纳头功能效力（前缀匹配得分）的影响力。在Pythia模型家族上的实验显示：前10%的高影响力样本贡献了约50%的累计影响力，且呈幂律分布。定性分析发现高影响力样本多为LaTeX、XML等重复性结构数据，而非语义丰富文本。因果干预实验证实，删除前10%高影响力样本会显著抑制或延迟归纳头出现，重复插入则加速形成，但最终收敛水平相似，表明影响力样本主要调节形成速率而非最终状态。基于此提出的机制化数据增强流程，利用大模型从高影响力样本提取结构模板生成合成数据，在14M至160M参数规模模型上均一致加速归纳头形成，且不损害通用语言能力。该工作将机制可解释性从静态解剖推向动态发育溯源，为精准调控模型训练提供了理论依据与工具。
report_titles: 三分钟论文速递 | 从训练数据中追溯大模型能力的源头

arxiv.title: MDA for random forests: inconsistency, and a practical solution via the Sobol-MDA
arxiv.abstract: Variable importance measures are the main tools to analyze the black-box mechanisms of random forests. Although the mean decrease accuracy (MDA) is widely accepted as the most efficient variable importance measure for random forests, little is known about its statistical properties. In fact, the definition of MDA varies across the main random forest software. In this article, our objective is to rigorously analyze the behavior of the main MDA implementations. Consequently, we mathematically formalize the various implemented MDA algorithms, and then establish their limits when the sample size increases. This asymptotic analysis reveals that these MDA versions differ as importance measures, since they converge towards different quantities. More importantly, we break down these limits into three components: the first two terms are related to Sobol indices, which are well-defined measures of a covariate contribution to the response variance, widely used in the sensitivity analysis field, as opposed to the third term, whose value increases with dependence within covariates. Thus, we theoretically demonstrate that the MDA does not target the right quantity to detect influential covariates in a dependent setting, a fact that has already been noticed experimentally. papers.title: DanceOPD: On-Policy Generative Field Distillation
papers.report_title: 字节跳动 Seed 新方法 DanceOPD:让一个图像模型同时会文生图、局部编辑和全局编辑
papers.summary: DanceOPD 将文生图、局部编辑、全局编辑、真实感增强和 CFG 指导等能力统一视为流匹配空间中的速度场，通过 hard-routed on-policy field matching 在一个学生模型内实现多能力合成。核心要点：每个样本硬路由到唯一教师（避免场平均），在学生自己的 rollout 轨迹的低噪声语义侧采样单点查询教师速度，训练目标仅用 plain velocity MSE。在 T2I+Edit 设置中，DanceOPD 的 GEditBench Avg 达 5.347，比 DiffusionOPD 高 8.1%，同时 GenEval 达 0.849，比 T2I source 高 2.0%；在 Local+Global Edit 设置中，GEditBench Avg 达 5.498，比最强 composition baseline 高 16.1%，GenEval 达 0.848。消融实验揭示了关键设计原则：hard routing 比 soft teacher mixing 高 15.2%；低噪声语义侧查询（GEdit 5.751）远优于中噪声（4.649）和高噪声（4.813）；单点查询优于密集查询（单点 5.751 vs 密集加权 4.914）；16 步 rollout 足够，更多步数不提升效果。初始化的影响显著：局部编辑初始化（5.751）远超全局编辑初始化（2.702）和纯 T2I 初始化（1.889），说明 on-policy 蒸馏依赖当前策略的质量。此外，DanceOPD 还能吸收真实感场和 CFG 操作场，实验显示真实感 reward 提升 9.9%，关闭了 85.3% 的学生-教师 reward gap。代码即将开源，该方法为多能力图像生成模型的训练提供了系统性的蒸馏框架。
report_titles: 字节跳动 Seed 新方法 DanceOPD:让一个图像模型同时会文生图、局部编辑和全局编辑

arxiv.title: DanceOPD: On-Policy Generative Field Distillation
arxiv.abstract: Modern image generation demands a single model that unifies diverse capabilities, including text-to-image (T2I), local editing, and global editing. However, these capabilities are rarely naturally aligned and often conflict. For instance, editing tends to degrade T2I performance, while global and local editing interfere with each other. Consequently, effectively composing these capabilities has become a central challenge for image generation model training. To tackle this, we introduce DanceOPD, an on-policy generative field distillation framework for flow-matching models that routes each sample to one capability field, queries one low-noise student-induced state, and trains with a simple velocity MSE objective. With each capability source defined as a velocity field over the shared flow state space, the student learns from fields queried on its own rollout states to compose expert capabilities. This formulation also absorbs operator-defined fields such as classifier-free guidance. Comprehensive experiments on T2I, editing, realism-field absorption, and CFG absorption show that our approach improves multi-capability composition, strengthening target capabilities while preserving anchor generation quality. We believe this work establishes a practical route for generative field distillation in flow-matching models.

papers.title: Why Multi-Step Tool-Use Reinforcement Learning Collapses and How Supervisory Signals Fix It
papers.report_title: [论文科普] 大模型学用工具,怎么就＂学崩了＂?——RL训练中的结构性坍塌之谜
papers.summary: 本文解读了中科院自动化所发表于arXiv（2606.26027）的论文，揭示多步工具使用强化学习（RL）训练中的“结构性坍塌”现象。在BFCL-V3基准上训练Qwen2.5-1.5B和Qwen3-1.7B时，纯RL训练导致工具调用控制Token（如<tool_call>）概率失控，模型输出变成固定乱码，但能力并未丢失——在OOD评估中模型仍能正确输入。机制分析表明，RL奖励信号粗糙地强化所有导致正确结果的行为，使得控制Token概率被过度放大，而模型语义能力完好。论文系统测试了五种监督信号方案：SFT预热+RL、离策略监督、Hint引导、错误轨迹监督和过程反思监督（PRS）。PRS通过记录中间推理轨迹并生成反思文本作为SFT数据，再与RL交替训练，达到了最佳稳定性和OOD泛化能力。关键数字：纯RL训练下小模型（1.5B）崩溃更严重；PRS+交替训练在稳定性和最终性能上全面优于其他方案，且能保持泛化能力。研究对Agent开发启示：不能仅用纯RL，至少需要SFT预热；检查输出格式比准确率更早发现问题。
report_titles: [论文科普] 大模型学用工具,怎么就＂学崩了＂?——RL训练中的结构性坍塌之谜

arxiv.title: Why Multi-Step Tool-Use Reinforcement Learning Collapses and How Supervisory Signals Fix It
arxiv.abstract: Tool use enables large language models (LLMs) to perform complex tasks, and recent agentic reinforcement learning (RL) methods show promise for enhancing model capabilities. However, RL alone often leads to instability or limited gains in tool-use tasks. In our experiments, some models exhibit catastrophic collapse, where performance abruptly drops and tool-invocation structures fail. The analysis reveals that these failures stem from unexpected probability spikes in specific control tokens, disrupting structured execution, yet the underlying tool-use capability remains intact, merely obscured by specific formats. To address this, we systematically investigate a diverse set of supervisory signals, including off-policy supervision, hint-based guidance, erroneous example supervision, and others, applied under both synchronous and interleaved training schemes. We find that interleaving supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with RL substantially improves stability, but exhibits degraded performance under format and content out-of-distribution (OOD) evaluation. We also analyze the impact of learning rates and generalization across settings. These results highlight the importance of understanding RL failures and demonstrate how diverse supervisory signals can guide exploratory learning, enabling robust training of LLMs for complex, multi-step tool-use tasks. papers.title: PALUTE: Processing-In-Memory Acceleration via Lookup Table for Edge LLM Inference
papers.report_title: InjectV:在 RISC-V 仿真环境中建模故障注入攻击
papers.summary: 本文深入解读了论文《PALUTE: Processing-In-Memory Acceleration via Lookup Table for Edge LLM Inference》，提出了一种面向边缘大模型低比特推理的存内计算加速方案。核心洞察：低比特（W4A4）推理瓶颈并非GEMM，而是反量化（占runtime约49%）、Softmax/LayerNorm/GELU等非线性算子以及数据搬移。PALUTE利用查找表（LUT）将复杂计算转化为查表操作，并将LUT存储在M3D DRAM中，利用垂直MAT结构实现大规模并行查表。硬件参数：768层M3D DRAM，35nm工艺，单chip容量24GB，面积112.4mm²。性能数据：在Qwen3模型上，PALUTE功耗仅0.16W，吞吐量达1,264 TPS，能效7,738 TPS/W，相比CHIME能效提升12.8×（604.6→7,738 TPS/W），面积效率相比PIMPAL提升2.0×（5.62→11.25 TPS/mm²）。相比FIGLUT，能效提升1.6×（原文口径）。LUT Generator可在3个周期内完成一个GEMM LUT条目生成，最大并发LUT查询可达8,388,608。文章还分析了数据分层调度：权重放低层、LUT放中间层、KV cache放高层以减少搬移开销。该工作对边缘LLM推理的存内计算设计具有重要参考价值。

arxiv.title: PALUTE: Processing-In-Memory Acceleration via Lookup Table for Edge LLM Inference
arxiv.abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed on edge devices with tight power and area budgets. While mixed-precision GEMM reduces arithmetic complexity, quantized inference is often dominated by dequantization and nonlinear operators. Lookup Table (LUT)-based method mitigates these costs by precomputing outputs and replacing repeated arithmetic with table lookups, but existing designs incur significant capacity and lookup-latency overheads. This paper presents PALUTE, a LUT-based Processing-In-Memory accelerator built on Monolithic 3D DRAM for efficient edge LLM inference. PALUTE enables in-DRAM LUT queries that exploit the vertical organization of M3D DRAM memory array tiles to achieve high parallelism with low area overhead. A near-memory LUT generator supports low-latency LUT generation for both GEMM and element-wise unary nonlinear operators, while a system-level tiering and scheduling strategy minimizes data movement across memory tiers. Evaluation using cycle-accurate simulation and RTL synthesis shows that PALUTE achieves 1,264 TPS end-to-end throughput at 0.16 W, improving energy efficiency by 12.8$\times$ over CHIME and 1.6$\times$ over FIGLUT, improving area efficiency by 2.0$\times$ over PIMPAL under W4A4 across Qwen3-4B models.

papers.title: Kairos: A Regret-Aware Native World-Action Model Stack for Physical AI
papers.report_title: SenseNova Kairos重磅发布:4B参数原生世界模型栈,让Physical AI真正跑起来
papers.summary: SenseNova 旗下 Kairos Team 推出面向 Physical AI 的原生世界模型栈 Kairos，以 4B 参数量在多项 embodied 基准上取得 SOTA。WorldModelBench-Robot 总分 9.30，超越 16B Cosmos3-Nano（9.26）和 2B Cosmos-Predict2.5（9.04）；DreamGen Bench AVG_Score 0.618，超过 14B Wan2.2（0.611）；PAI-Bench-Robot 小模型组 Domain Score 88.59。在 World Action Model 评估中，RoboTwin 2.0 平均成功率 96.1%（Clean 设置 96.9% 全场最高），LIBERO-Plus 平均 89.0%（联合去噪提升至 90.8%）。推理效率突出：720P 5 秒视频生成单卡 A800 仅需 43 秒，相比 Cosmos-Predict2.5-14B 延迟降低 28×–85×，相比同量级 Wan2.2-5B 加速 2.5×–3.7×。关键技术创新包括：跨具身数据课程（CEDC）三阶段预训练（物理视频→人类行为→机器人动作）、LinearDiT 混合线性时序记忆（SWA+DSWA+GLA 三层分解，提供理论误差界）、部署感知系统协同设计（Timestep Distillation、FP8/INT8 混合精度、Tiled Gated DeltaNet）。消融实验显示：human-centric 数据使 WorldModelBench 提升 0.17 分，联合训练比只训 ActionDiT 在 LIBERO-Plus 上提升 23.2%。模型已开源。Kairos 证明了在 4B 量级上，通过架构和训练策略创新可同时达到高能力与高效率，为 Physical AI 闭环部署提供了可行路径。

arxiv.title: Kairos: A Regret-Aware Native World-Action Model Stack for Physical AI
arxiv.abstract: We introduce \textbf{Kairos}, a regret-aware native world-action model stack for Physical AI. Kairos is motivated by the view that a physical world model should not aim to fully simulate all future pixels, but should learn and maintain the information most relevant to embodiment control: object state, spatial relations, contact conditions, task progress, action consequences, failure boundaries, and deployment uncertainty. Kairos establishes three model-side prerequisites toward this goal. First, it \textbf{learns} control-relevant information through a \textbf{Cross-Embodiment Data Curriculum}, which organizes open-world videos, human behavioral data, and robot interactions into an intervention-strength progression from passive physical observation to intentional behavior and embodied action grounding. Second, it \textbf{maintains} control-sufficient states through a unified \textbf{understanding, generation, and prediction architecture} equipped with \textbf{Hybrid Linear Temporal Attention}, where local, mid-range, and global temporal pathways support multi-timescale state maintenance under efficient inference. Third, it \textbf{deploys} these states through a \textbf{Deployment-Aware System Co-Design}, treating latency, memory footprint, and hardware compatibility as first-order constraints for future observation, action, and feedback loops. papers.summary: 本文深度解读了OpenKedge团队发表的论文《Sovereign Execution Brokers: Enforcing Certificate-Bound Authority in Agentic Control Planes》。核心问题是：AI Agent因非确定性推理和易被黑客渗透，直接持有生产凭证将导致灾难性越权。现有准入控制层（SAB）仅签发证书Ω，但若Agent仍持有永久密钥则可绕过。论文提出的Sovereign Execution Broker (SEB) 作为运行时强制边界，位于Agent和云API之间，是唯一持有凭证改变状态的实体。SEB验证流水线包含8道检查：签名验证、合同匹配、有效性窗口、策略纪元、撤销纪元、实时漂移检查、重放保护、可作用域检查。验证通过后，SEB向身份提供商申请临时严格受限的作用域凭证（K8s 60秒，AWS 900秒），实现‘即用即消’。实验评估基于Go原型（约4200行），部署在3副本AWS EKS集群：Kubernetes操作端到端p50延迟40.7ms，Broker开销p50 28.2ms；AWS安全组更新端到端p50 221.9ms，Broker开销136.9ms；32并发时吞吐量约870次/秒，近乎线性扩展；针对7大类7000次故障注入测试（含重放、篡改、过期、撤销等）实现100%正确拦截。论文局限性包括当前仅支持AWS和Kubernetes，依赖平台IAM配置正确性。

arxiv.title: Sovereign Execution Broker: Enforcing Certificate-Bound Authority in Agentic Control Planes
arxiv.abstract: Autonomous agents are increasingly connected to cloud, deployment, and data-control workflows, but production mutation authority should not reside inside non-deterministic reasoning processes. Existing access-control mechanisms authorize identities, while assurance layers certify proposed actions; neither alone provides a mandatory enforcement point for certified authority at the moment of mutation. This paper introduces the Sovereign Execution Broker (SEB), a runtime enforcement boundary for certificate-bound agentic infrastructure. SEB consumes certificates issued by the Sovereign Assurance Boundary (SAB), verifies that the requested mutation matches the certified execution contract, checks validity windows, policy epochs, revocation epochs, and live-state drift, mints scoped execution identity, invokes infrastructure APIs, and records signed decision and outcome records. By separating proposal, admission, and execution, SEB turns certified authority into a short-lived, revocable, auditable runtime capability, provided that production mutation APIs reject non-broker identities. We present the SEB execution model, certificate and replay-verification predicates, scoped identity semantics, bypass-prevention deployment patterns, failure behavior, and a concrete prototype implementation. papers.title: If LLMs Have Human-Like Attributes, Then So Does Age of Empires II
papers.report_title: 用帝国时代II的山羊做AI神经网络?微软研究员的反讽实验
papers.summary: 微软AI研究员Adrian de Wynter发表论文《If LLMs have human-like attributes, then so does Age of Empires II》，通过极端类比实验质疑当前大语言模型过度拟人化的倾向。研究者利用《帝国时代II》游戏机制中的山羊、草地、桥等元素，构建了一个可被强行解释为“神经网络”的结构，以此论证：若允许将聊天机器人的系统行为解读为“理解”“情绪”或“人格”，那么在规则驱动的游戏系统中同样可以找到类比证据。论文核心指向“确认偏差”认知机制——用户倾向于在对话式交互界面（Claude、ChatGPT、Gemini等）中自动补全人格线索。研究指出，真正的“像人”感更多来自接口设计而非模型内在属性，当产品被包装为“可对话”，人类的直觉就覆盖了理性判断。该论文的实际价值在于拆解AI产品叙事：当前业界普遍强化“对话感”和“人格感”以提升用户接受度，但这可能滑向认知误导的边界。文章提醒研究人员关注拟人化设计对用户预期的影响——用户可能开始要求“情绪反馈”和“关系感”，而这种期待在认知科学层面并不成立。论文本身未提供对比性能数据，属于概念性批判研究。

arxiv.title: If LLMs Have Human-Like Attributes, Then So Does Age of Empires II
arxiv.abstract: Much research has been carried out on large language models (LLMs) and LLM-powered agentic workflows. However, many works within the field state emergence of, ascribe to, or assume, generalised anthropomorphic attributes to them (e.g., morality or understanding of natural language). Our goal is not to argue in favour or against the existence of these attributes, but to point out that these conclusions could be incorrect. For this we build and train a simple neural network on the videogame Age of Empires II, and note that any entity in a sufficiently-powerful substrate, such as LEGO or the Greater Boston Area, could also present such attributes. Hence, the purported anthropomorphic attributes of LLMs are empirically non-unique: although some properties (e.g., responses to prompts) could remain invariant, others, such as the interpretation of their perceived behaviour, might change with the substrate. Thus, any empirically-grounded discussion on these attributes requires explicit measurement criteria; otherwise the interpretation is left to the representation. We then show that assuming that these attributes exist or not in a system, independent of the substrate and in a generalised way, leads to either circular or uninformative conclusions. papers.report_title: 阿里通义千问发布首个原生语言世界模型 Qwen-AgentWorld,单一模型覆盖七大智能体环境
papers.summary: 本文介绍阿里通义千问团队发布的原生语言世界模型Qwen-AgentWorld（论文《Qwen-AgentWorld: Language World Models for General Agents》同日公开）。该模型从继续预训练（CPT）阶段就将环境建模设为训练目标，贯穿CPT→SFT→RL全流程，使模型自底向上内化环境动力学。技术数据：基于超1000万条真实智能体交互轨迹，推出35B-A3B与397B-A17B两种参数规格；单一模型同时覆盖文本类（MCP、Search、Terminal、SWE）与GUI类（Web、OS、Android）七大交互领域，GUI观测以可渲染代码呈现，实现跨领域知识迁移。同步发布AgentWorldBench评测基准，397B-A17B整体均分58.71，超过GPT-5.4的58.25，在Terminal与SWE领域优势最为明显；35B三阶段训练后均分提升8.66，超过Claude Sonnet 4.6。模型权重与评测已开源（Hugging Face & ModelScope）。该工作验证了语言世界建模可作为通用Agent的强底座，开创“先预测、再行动”的新范式，对Agent研究社区具有重要参考价值。

arxiv.title: Qwen-AgentWorld: Language World Models for General Agents
arxiv.abstract: A world model predicts environment dynamics based on current observations and actions, serving as a core cognitive mechanism for reasoning and planning. In this work, we investigate how world modeling based on language models can further push the boundaries of general agents. (i) We first focus on building foundation models for agentic environment simulation. We introduce Qwen-AgentWorld-35B-A3B and Qwen-AgentWorld-397B-A17B, the first language world models capable of simulating agentic environments covering 7 domains via long chain-of-thought reasoning. Leveraging more than 10M environment interaction trajectories of 7 domains in real-world environments, we develop Qwen-AgentWorld through a three-stage training pipeline: CPT injects general-purpose world modeling capabilities from the state transition dynamics and augmented professional corpora, SFT activates next-state-prediction reasoning, and RL sharpens simulation fidelity through a tailored framework with hybrid rubric-and-rule rewards. To evaluate language world models, we present AgentWorldBench, a comprehensive benchmark constructed from real-world interactions of 5 frontier models on 9 established benchmarks. Empirical results demonstrate that Qwen-AgentWorld significantly outperforms existing frontier models. papers.title: Spatial-TTT: Streaming Visual-based Spatial Intelligence with Test-Time Training
papers.report_title: 7大必学的机器学习算法,搞定 90% 实战场景!【附完整源码】
papers.summary: 清华团队提出的Spatial-TTT模型被计算机视觉顶级会议ECCV 2026接收，核心创新在于将Test-Time Training (TTT)范式引入流式空间理解，让模型在推理过程中边看视频边更新参数，以紧凑的非线性记忆形式累积跨时间的3D空间证据。关键设计包括：(1) 混合式TTT架构——解码器中75%层采用TTT、25%保留标准注意力，兼顾长程记忆与预训练语义能力；(2) 空间预测机制——对Q/K/V加入轻量级3D时空卷积，利用局部几何与时间连续性增强在线更新稳定性；(3) 稠密场景描述监督——构建覆盖全局语境、物体类别与空间关系的scene walkthrough数据，训练模型形成完整3D记忆。实验数据显示，仅有2B参数的Spatial-TTT在VSI-Bench上取得64.4平均分，超越GPT-5和Gemini-3-pro等闭源模型；在MindCube-Tiny上准确率达76.2%，比Gemini-3-pro高12个百分点、比开源空间模型MindCube-3B高近25个百分点；在VSI-SUPER-Count任务中，可处理最长120分钟视频，而对比模型在长视频下性能崩塌或OOM。效率方面，1024帧输入下显存占用仅11.9GB、计算量799.4 TFLOPs，比大厂闭源模型节省超40%。消融实验表明三个设计缺一不可：移除空间预测机制平均分从64.4降至62.1，移除密集描述监督降至61.3，纯TTT结构降至53.9。该工作为机器人、自动驾驶、AR等需要持续环境感知的Physical Agent提供了从流式视觉走向持续世界状态建模的新路径。

arxiv.title: Spatial-TTT: Streaming Visual-based Spatial Intelligence with Test-Time Training
arxiv.abstract: Humans perceive and understand real-world spaces through a stream of visual observations. Therefore, the ability to streamingly maintain and update spatial evidence from potentially unbounded video streams is essential for spatial intelligence. The core challenge is not simply longer context windows but how spatial information is selected, organized, and retained over time. In this paper, we propose Spatial-TTT towards streaming visual-based spatial intelligence with test-time training (TTT), which adapts a subset of parameters (fast weights) to capture and organize spatial evidence over long-horizon scene videos. Specifically, we design a hybrid architecture and adopt large-chunk updates parallel with sliding-window attention for efficient spatial video processing. To further promote spatial awareness, we introduce a spatial-predictive mechanism applied to TTT layers with 3D spatiotemporal convolution, which encourages the model to capture geometric correspondence and temporal continuity across frames. Beyond architecture design, we construct a dataset with dense 3D spatial descriptions, which guides the model to update its fast weights to memorize and organize global 3D spatial signals in a structured manner. papers.report_title: 字节联合北大新论文:多模态大模型终于开始“并行看图”了
papers.summary: 本文解读北京大学MSALab与字节跳动合作论文《PerceptionDLM: Parallel Region Perception with Multimodal Diffusion Language Models》。该工作首次将扩散语言模型引入多区域并行视觉感知，核心突破：使用LLaDA-8B作为解码器，配合SigLIP-2视觉编码器与动态分辨率策略（512×512 tiles+缩略图），通过RoI对齐特征回放、区域提示（region embedding）和结构化注意力掩码（禁止跨区域注意力）实现多mask描述并行生成，避免区域间属性混淆。关键数据：在自建ParaDLC-Bench基准上，PerceptionDLM平均准确率62.4%，远优于LLaDA-V的35.2%和SDAR-VL的31.3%；5个mask场景下吞吐量最高提升约3.5倍，固定4个mask时单图延迟从10.04秒降至2.92秒。训练数据集ParaCaption-5.7M包含约570万个mask描述样本，经严格过滤。该路线证明扩散模型在多区域密集感知任务中相比自回归模型具有结构性优势，为自动驾驶、工业检测、医学影像等场景提供可扩展的并行理解方案。

arxiv.title: PerceptionDLM: Parallel Region Perception with Multimodal Diffusion Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in visual understanding tasks. However, most existing MLLMs rely on autoregressive generation, which limits their efficiency for perception tasks that require captioning multiple regions. In this work, we propose PerceptionDLM, a multimodal diffusion language model optimized for efficient parallel region perception. Built upon PerceptionDLM-Base, a strong foundational baseline that achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source diffusion MLLMs, our architecture fully leverages the parallel decoding nature of DLMs. Specifically, we introduce efficient prompting and structured attention masking to enable simultaneous perception of multiple masked regions, allowing the model to generate region descriptions in parallel at both the sequence and token levels. This design significantly improves inference efficiency compared with existing approaches that process regions sequentially. To systematically evaluate the parallelism property of visual perception capability for DLMs, we construct a new Parallel Detailed Localized Captioning Benchmark (ParaDLC-Bench) by scaling the DLC-Bench to include multiple region masks per image, enabling joint evaluation of both caption quality and inference efficiency. papers.title: SAG: SQL-Retrieval Augmented Generation with Query-Time Dynamic Hyperedges
papers.report_title: A new golden age for Japanese banks comes with a catch
papers.summary: 本文深入解读了一项将GraphRAG中的结构化多跳检索任务转移给SQL的新架构——SAG（SQL-Retrieval Augmented Generation with Query-Time Dynamic Hyperedges）。该工作由Zleap AI团队提出，核心思想在于颠覆传统GraphRAG预先构建全局知识图谱的做法。SAG采用Event-Entity Index，将文档块（chunk）保留为完整语义的事件（event），并从中提取多类实体作为索引点。在检索阶段，通过双路并行的Seed Retrieval：结构入口利用LLM从查询中提取种子实体，经SQL join找到关联事件；语义入口则采用向量检索进行召回兜底。最关键的设计是Query-Time Dynamic Hyperedges：仅在当前查询的候选空间内，通过反向SQL join事件与实体，动态扩展至H跳（默认为1）的局部结构，检索结束后该结构即消失，无需全局维护。实验结果表明，SAG在多跳问答基准HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA和MuSiQue上，平均Recall@2和Recall@5分别达到79.3%和88.2%，显著优于HippoRAG 2的68.2%和83.3%。在最难的多跳基准MuSiQue上，SAG的Recall@5为80.0，较HippoRAG 2的65.1提高了近15个百分点。此外，事件级超边（80.0）相比三元组分解（77.1）也展现出性能优势。该工作为RAG系统在生产环境中的落地提供了一条“查询时激活局部结构”的新路径。

arxiv.title: SAG: SQL-Retrieval Augmented Generation with Query-Time Dynamic Hyperedges
arxiv.abstract: While retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has proven effective at giving LLMs access to external knowledge, mainstream dense-retrieval implementations remain inherently limited in handling structured constraints and multi-hop reasoning. Graph-based methods address this by constructing knowledge graphs offline, but they often fragment semantics, incur high maintenance, and complicate incremental updates. We propose SAG (SQL-Retrieval Augmented Generation), a structured retrieval architecture that organizes documents into an event-entity index without building a global knowledge graph. SAG represents each chunk as a semantically complete event paired with its entities, forming a latent hyperedge that preserves n-ary relations without decomposing them into triples. At query time, SAG treats shared entities as join keys to connect related chunks. This dynamically yields a query-scoped neighborhood of events, and yet every piece of evidence remains the original chunk throughout. Experiments on HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and MuSiQue show that SAG achieves the best retrieval and end-to-end QA performance on every benchmark, with gains that widen as reasoning-chain complexity increases. On MuSiQue, where multi-hop evidence chaining is most demanding, SAG reaches 80.36% Recall@5, outperforming the strongest baseline by 11.52 points.
