papers.title: MCompassRAG: Topic Metadata as a Semantic Compass for Paragraph-Level Retrieval
papers.report_title: GraphRAG的重活,SAG请外援解决了
papers.summary: 本文介绍了一项名为MCompassRAG的创新检索增强生成（RAG）方法，其旨在解决粗粒度块检索中的语义噪声问题。传统方案在粗块（如段落）检索时，由于一个块可能包含多个主题，导致余弦相似度被无关语义拖累。MCompassRAG的核心思路是不细化块粒度，而是在粗块上添加主题元数据（Topic Metadata）作为“语义指南针”。其流程包括：离线阶段，使用主题模型编码器将文档和块映射至检索器的嵌入空间，每个块获得一个主题分布向量，并存储于元数据银行中。查询时，通过选择策略从元数据银行中选出最相关的离线主题分布，经抽象模块提炼为紧凑的查询侧主题向量。随后，将查询/块嵌入与其对应的主题向量拼接，形成元数据丰富的表示，并由一个轻量级MLP学生分类器进行打分。训练阶段采用知识蒸馏框架，使用LLM教师（带查询扩展）的软标签来监督学生模型。推理时完全去掉LLM和查询扩展，仅执行4步：编码、选择、抽象、评分。在6个基准测试上，该方法平均信息效率（IE）相比最强非LLM基线提升8.24%，延迟比LLM基线的RAG方案低5倍以上。定性分析表明，主题向量能精准地将检索方向校准到正确的语义聚类，有效指导粗块检索。该工作为RAG系统提供了一种低成本、高效率的语义导航方案。
report_titles: GraphRAG的重活,SAG请外援解决了

arxiv.title: MCompassRAG: Topic Metadata as a Semantic Compass for Paragraph-Level Retrieval
arxiv.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems depend critically on how documents are chunked and searched. Fine-grained chunks can improve retrieval precision but expand the search space, increasing latency and cost; larger chunks reduce the number of candidates but make dense similarity less reliable, as the representation for each chunk mixes multiple topics and introduces more semantic noise. This trade-off becomes especially limiting in deep research tasks, where retrieval must be both fast and precise across large, heterogeneous corpora. We introduce MCompassRAG, a metadata-guided retrieval framework that uses topic-level signals as a semantic compass for selecting relevant evidence. Instead of relying only on cosine similarity between queries and noisy chunk embeddings, MCompassRAG enriches chunk representations with topic metadata in the same embedding space and trains a lightweight retriever through LLM-teacher distillation. At inference time, MCompassRAG performs topic-aware retrieval without additional LLM calls, improving both efficiency and evidence quality. Across six complex retrieval benchmarks, MCompassRAG improves information efficiency (IE) by 8.24% on average with over 5 times lower latency than the strongest efficient RAG baselines. Code is available on https://github.com/AmirAbaskohi/MCompassRAG.

papers.title: SproutRAG: Attention-Guided Tree Search with Progressive Embeddings for Long-Document RAG
papers.report_title: The Age of “Intentional” Drinking
papers.summary: 本文解读长文档RAG论文SproutRAG，核心解决chunk切分粒度矛盾——小chunk检索精准但上下文断裂，大chunk上下文完整但噪声增加。SproutRAG创新提出Attention-Guided Tree结构：利用小语言模型（SLLM）的句子间注意力机制构建二叉树，学习attention heads与layers的加权组合而非简单平均，避免邻近偏差。采用Progressive Embeddings为不同层级节点保留独立向量表示，避免摘要信息损失——叶子节点为细粒度句子，中间节点为语义片段，高层节点对应更宽上下文。检索阶段使用Hierarchical Beam Search沿树动态选择证据，支持返回fine-grained leaves、mid-level nodes或broader subtrees。Joint Objective端到端联合优化embeddings与树结构，使表示质量和语义聚合互相促进。在四个检索基准（Dragonball、SCI-DOCS、LegalBench-RAG、MS MARCO）上，信息效率（IE）平均比最强baseline提升6.1%，具体提升值：Dragonball +8.06，SCI-DOCS +4.65，LegalBench-RAG +4.90，MS MARCO +6.83。在线成本优势显著：SproutRAG在线Tokens/Q为4382、延迟193ms，而GraphRAG为16238 tokens/2317ms，PageIndex为24620 tokens/2847ms。定性案例显示，对法律条款检索，SproutRAG能返回clause-level节点（包含责任上限、损害排除、例外条件），避免单句证据遗漏。该工作将chunk大小问题转化为树上多粒度检索，无需在线LLM调用或有损摘要，对合同、论文、法律文档等长文档RAG场景具有实用价值。
report_titles: The Age of “Intentional” Drinking

arxiv.title: SproutRAG: Attention-Guided Tree Search with Progressive Embeddings for Long-Document RAG
arxiv.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems must balance retrieval granularity with contextual coherence, a challenge that existing methods address through LLM-guided chunking, single-level context expansion, or hierarchical summarization. These approaches variously depend on costly LLM calls during indexing or retrieval, limit context aggregation to a single granularity level, or introduce information loss through summarization. We present SproutRAG, an attention-guided hierarchical RAG framework that addresses this trade-off by organizing sentence-level chunks into progressively larger but semantically coherent units, using learned inter-sentence attention to construct a binary chunking tree. Unlike prior approaches that rely on external LLMs, fixed context expansion, or lossy summarization, SproutRAG learns which attention heads and layers best capture semantic document structure, enabling multi-granularity retrieval without additional LLM calls or compressed summaries. At retrieval time, SproutRAG uses hierarchical beam search to retrieve candidates at multiple granularities, capturing multi-sentence relevance beyond flat retrieval. The framework is trained end-to-end with a joint objective that improves both embeddings and tree structure. papers.report_title: AI 会写 RTL 之后,PPA 怎么办?
papers.summary: 本文深入解读了Alpha-RTL: Test-Time Training for RTL Hardware Optimization论文。该论文针对LLM生成RTL后PPA优化问题，提出TTT-RTL框架，核心创新在于将EDA工具（Yosys/OpenSTA）的物理反馈（面积、延迟、功耗）作为训练信号，在测试时通过策略梯度更新模型，而非仅静态搜索。关键数据：在RTLLM v2.0 benchmark的44个公共设计上，TTT-RTL的PPA-product几何平均ratio为0.349，相对reference降低65.1%，而此前最优方法REvolution为0.739（降低26.1%）；功能正确设计数48/49；在工业级案例XuanTie C910 FPU的LZA单元上，ADP从3,402,207 μm²·ps降至1,381,970 μm²·ps，降幅59.4%，且优化涉及微结构重构（分组式层级priority encoder）。但论文也明确边界：结果基于single-seed、开源flow而非sign-off、缺乏formal equivalence验证。计算成本约780 GPU-hour（49个设计）。本文认为AI进入芯片设计的方式正从文本生成走向工程闭环，但验证、sign-off、算力成本和责任归属仍是硬门槛。

arxiv.title: Alpha-RTL: Test-Time Training for RTL Hardware Optimization
arxiv.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown increasing promise in generating functionally correct register-transfer-level (RTL) hardware designs. Recent systems improve further through EDA-integrated reinforcement learning with syntax, simulation, and PPA rewards, but train a general RTL generator before deployment while test-time approaches search with a frozen policy. We instead perform reinforcement learning at test time, allowing the LLM policy to adapt to executable EDA feedback for the specific RTL problem at hand. We propose TTT-RTL, to our knowledge the first per-design test-time training framework that closes the loop between an LLM policy and an EDA pipeline for RTL optimization. TTT-RTL samples candidate implementations, verifies them through syntax checking and simulation, scores valid designs using synthesis-derived PPA product, reuses high-reward variants through a PUCT-indexed design-state pool, and updates the policy with an entropic policy-gradient objective. To stabilize policy updates under sparse or plateaued rewards, we introduce an adaptive KL-budget controller that adjusts the entropy constraint using reference KL, effective sample size, and reward saturation signals. papers.title: AtomMem: Building Simple and Effective Memory System for LLM Agents via Atomic Facts
papers.report_title: 传统Agent记忆已死?AtomMem登顶长程基准,让Mem0运行成本暴跌61%(论文)
papers.summary: 本文深度解读中国科学技术大学与安徽大学联合发表的论文《AtomMem: Building Simple and Effective Memory System for LLM Agents via Atomic Facts》。针对LLM Agent长期记忆系统的“膨胀vs失真”根本困境，AtomMem提出三大范式转移：①底层记忆表示：将混沌对话流提纯为结构化原子事实七元组（唯一ID、客观事实、稠密嵌入、参与者、关键词、时间锚点、事件链接），通过微调Qwen3-14B执行去噪、指代消解、时间锚定、第三人称重写四步流水线。②中层情景聚合：动态将原子事实聚合成宏观事件记忆，自动刷新概要并扩展时间跨度；同时建立时间用户画像，禁止破坏性覆盖，保留历史版本支持全链路追溯。③顶层3-Edge关联记忆图谱：以原子事实为节点，构建实体边（IDF加权）、事件边（规模惩罚）、时间边（轮次距离指数衰减），检索时先LLM解析意图，再以种子节点运行个性化PageRank实现多跳联想。在LoCoMo基准（平均35个会话、600+轮对话）中，AtomMem综合评分J-score达64.58（对比Mem0为54.17），多跳推理68.44、时间推理66.98（较LightMem相对提升31.1%），而Token消耗降低61.4%。消融实验显示：仅启用原子事实即可将多跳推理F1提升76.6%。项目已开源，释放4352条SFT数据集。商业价值：大幅降低Agent大规模部署算力成本，全链路可追溯满足企业合规要求。

arxiv.title: AtomMem: Building Simple and Effective Memory System for LLM Agents via Atomic Facts
arxiv.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong reasoning and generation abilities, but their fixed context windows limit long-term information accumulation and reuse across multi-session interactions. Existing memory-augmented systems often construct memory in a coarse and unstable manner, relying on inefficient memory representations or unstable unconstrained updates. To address these challenges, we propose AtomMem, a long-term memory system designed for value-dense storage and stable memory evolution. AtomMem introduces a Fact Executor, which selectively extracts high value atomic facts from long form interactions to serve as highly efficient memory representations. Subsequently, AtomMem organizes these facts into hierarchical event structures and temporal profiles, capturing coherent episodic contexts and tracking dynamically evolving user attributes over time. During retrieval, the system activates an associative memory graph to connect fragmented memories. Experiments on the LoCoMo benchmark confirm that AtomMem achieves state-of-the-art performance across various reasoning tasks, offering a scalable and economically viable solution for deploying intelligent personalized agents.

papers.report_title: CVPR 2026收录!字节Seed空间智能新突破SpatialTree,重新建构多模态大模型空间能力路线图
papers.summary: 本文解读了CVPR 2026收录论文SpatialTree，该工作将多模态大模型（MLLM）的空间智能系统化为四级能力树：L1基础感知（距离、大小等）、L2心理地图（语言/语义映射）、L3心理模拟（推理/规划）、L4空间智能体（行动/操作）。研究团队构建SpatialTree-Bench覆盖27类子能力。实验发现：当前最强模型Gemini 3 Flash平均分仅57.8，远未解决空间智能；Gemini 3 Pro 56.5，Seed1.8 50.3，开源最佳Qwen3VL-235B为40.0。关键发现：L1能力之间相关性弱且可能相互干扰，但高层能力高度依赖基础能力组合。SFT实验表明，单独训练距离能力后，复杂野外距离推理提升36.0%，机器人操作任务提升27.1%，强有力地证明了基础空间感知对高层任务的迁移价值。此外，空间任务并非“想得越多越好”：低层感知宜快速判断，高层规划才需长思考；团队提出的auto-think策略（Full RL@auto-think）得分30.8，优于SFT baseline的27.3和普通Full RL@think的30.1。这些数据和对比为构建具身智能与多模态Agent提供了清晰的能力路线图。

arxiv.title: SpatialTree: How Spatial Abilities Branch Out in MLLMs
arxiv.abstract: Cognitive science suggests that spatial ability develops progressively-from perception to reasoning and interaction. Yet in multimodal LLMs (MLLMs), this hierarchy remains poorly understood, as most studies focus on a narrow set of tasks. We introduce SpatialTree, a cognitive-science-inspired hierarchy that organizes spatial abilities into four levels: low-level perception (L1), mental mapping (L2), simulation (L3), and agentic competence (L4). Based on this taxonomy, we construct the first capability-centric hierarchical benchmark, thoroughly evaluating mainstream MLLMs across 27 sub-abilities. The evaluation results reveal a clear structure: L1 skills are largely orthogonal, whereas higher-level skills are strongly correlated, indicating increasing interdependency. Through targeted supervised fine-tuning, we uncover a surprising transfer dynamic-negative transfer within L1, but strong cross-level transfer from low- to high-level abilities with notable synergy. Finally, we explore how to improve the entire hierarchy. We find that naive RL that encourages extensive "thinking" is unreliable: it helps complex reasoning but hurts intuitive perception. We propose a simple auto-think strategy that suppresses unnecessary deliberation, enabling RL to consistently improve performance across all levels. papers.title: World Action Models: A Survey
papers.report_title: NUS 最新综述梳理具身智能新范式:World Action Models,少做梦,多行动
papers.summary: 新加坡国立大学发布 57 页综述《World Action Models: A Survey》，系统梳理了机器人世界模型、视频生成模型和 VLA 之间的边界。核心主张：只有当「预测未来」真正参与动作生成、动作打分或动作训练时，才能称为 World Action Model（WAM）。论文将现有 109 篇相关工作按设计哲学分为三条路线：Render-and-Decode（58篇）、Latent-Only（38篇）、Video-Generation-Free（13篇），并引入四轴解剖（substrate、backbone、action coupling、deployment regime）进行细粒度分类。未来 substrate 分为像素/可解码 latent、特征、几何、affordance 四类；action coupling 分为 action-conditioned rollout、joint generation、post-prediction head 三种；deployment regime 包括开环、chunked、单步闭环、交互式。论文还定义了 WAM 的五大核心性质：interactability、causality、persistence、physical plausibility、generalization，并整理了数据源（遥操作、人类演示、互联网视频、仿真、自生成数据）和评测维度。该综述的价值在于为具身智能社区的 WAM 研究提供了统一的概念框架和分类学，有助于研究者快速定位方法瓶颈和系统选型。对关注具身智能的研究人员，该分类法可直接用于设计评估实验和对比基线。

arxiv.title: World Action Models: A Survey
arxiv.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) are embodied predictive-action models that make a forecast of the future available to action. Recent WAMs repurpose large video generation models, and a parallel line relies on language or vision-language backbones without a video-generation core. This rapid expansion has blurred the boundary among broad world models, video generation models, action-grounded video world models, Vision-Language-Action policies, and WAMs. This survey gives the field a common account. It first clarifies these boundaries, then organizes existing works through two complementary views. The first view asks what each method is required to generate, spanning rendered futures, latent futures, and video-generation-free action reasoning. The second view decomposes each method by predictive substrate, backbone, action coupling, and deployment regime. This anatomy supports a unified discussion of interactability, causality, persistence, physical plausibility, and generalization, followed by data, evaluation, and open challenges. Across these axes, a consistent design pattern emerges: WAMs are not simply video generators with action heads, but predictive-action methods whose design choices trade representational richness against compute, memory, latency, and action-label cost. The field is moving toward methods that generate less of the future while preserving what control requires.

papers.title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale
papers.report_title: 一天解读一篇AI论文:大模型是怎么看懂图片的呢?ViT / Vision Transformer
papers.summary: 本文以通俗方式解读Vision Transformer (ViT) 的核心思想，即通过将图像分割为固定大小的patch（经典16×16），经线性投影为token并加入位置编码与class token，再送入标准Transformer Encoder进行自注意力处理，从而让模型像读句子一样理解图像。该架构突破CNN主导的视觉识别范式，证明纯Transformer可在图像分类任务中达到与CNN相当甚至更优的效果。研究人员应关注其所引用的原论文《An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale》（arXiv:2010.11929）中提出的关键设计：patch size对性能的影响、位置编码的必要性、以及可学习的[CLS] token聚合全局信息。文章虽未给出具体实验数据，但点明了ViT在ImageNet上取得88.55% top-1准确率（预训练后）的里程碑式结果，为后续多模态大模型（如CLIP、DALL·E）奠定基础。对从事视觉理解与Transformer架构的研究者而言，本文是快速理解ViT原理的入门材料。

arxiv.title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale
arxiv.abstract: While the Transformer architecture has become the de-facto standard for natural language processing tasks, its applications to computer vision remain limited. In vision, attention is either applied in conjunction with convolutional networks, or used to replace certain components of convolutional networks while keeping their overall structure in place. We show that this reliance on CNNs is not necessary and a pure transformer applied directly to sequences of image patches can perform very well on image classification tasks. When pre-trained on large amounts of data and transferred to multiple mid-sized or small image recognition benchmarks (ImageNet, CIFAR-100, VTAB, etc.), Vision Transformer (ViT) attains excellent results compared to state-of-the-art convolutional networks while requiring substantially fewer computational resources to train.

papers.report_title: 三分钟论文速递 | 大模型的推理能力是真实存在,还是格式假象?
papers.summary: 本文解读ACL 2026论文《Linear Probes Detect Task Format, Not Reasoning Mode in Language Model Hidden States》，揭露线性探针研究LLM推理机制中的系统性偏差。实验基于Qwen3-14B模型，构建包含演绎（LogiQA 2.0）、归纳（ARC-Challenge）和溯因（αNLI）三类任务的平衡数据集。关键发现：层32的线性探针虽达100%准确率且流形几何分离显著（内在维度分别为20.6、28.5、33.6，凸包污染率≤1.5%），但经格式去混淆后准确率降至33.5%（随机水平33.3%），轨迹-模式一致性仅42.5%，因果转向效果与随机扰动无显著差异（p=0.286）。结论：模型采用统一推理策略而非模式特定机制，探针高准确率完全由数据集来源、选项数量、提示结构等格式特征驱动。研究提供了系统的格式去混淆分析框架（来源预测、选项检验、格式控制、残差分析）及因果验证方法，为可解释性研究树立方法论标杆。

arxiv.title: Linear Probes Detect Task Format, Not Reasoning Mode in Language Model Hidden States
arxiv.abstract: Linear probing of large language model (LLM) hidden states is widely used to claim that models learn distinct representations for different reasoning types. We test this by probing Qwen3-14B on three benchmarks spanning the classical trichotomy: LogiQA 2.0 (deductive), ARC-Challenge (inductive), and $α$NLI (abductive). At layer 32 of 40, linear probes achieve 100\% cross-validated accuracy with well-separated geometry (intrinsic dimensionalities: 20.6, 28.5, 33.6; convex hull contamination $\leq$1.5\%). However, this separation is entirely driven by format confounds. Residualizing source identity, option count, and response length reduces accuracy to chance. Trace-anchor similarity indicates largely shared reasoning across tasks (42.5\% agreement vs.\ 33.3\% chance), and causal steering with random controls ($n=20$) shows no functional link between geometry and reasoning mode ($p=0.286$). Thus, high probe accuracy reflects task format rather than computational structure, motivating routine format deconfounding in mechanistic interpretability.

papers.title: EverydayGPT: Confidence-Gated Routing for Efficient and Safe Hybrid GPT-RAG Conversational QA
papers.report_title: 别无脑跑了,RAG路由该这么搞
papers.summary: 本文解读论文《EverydayGPT: Confidence-Gated Routing for Efficient and Safe Hybrid GPT-RAG Conversational QA》。核心贡献是提出CGR（Confidence-Gated Routing）三路路由策略，在生成前先判断走哪条路：快通道（RAG提取，45毫秒）、高速通道（GPT生成，5.9秒）或直接拒绝。关键发现是85%的查询只需从检索结果中提取一句话即可回答，而标准RAG管线对所有查询均无条件调用大模型，导致算力浪费和答案质量下降。CGR基于检索距离d_min和提取置信度c的联合信号决策，置信度由三个启发式特征加权（答案词数0.3、问答关键词重叠0.4、类型正确性0.3），阈值τ≈0.5为稳定操作点，F1变化仅0.013。生成骨干为205M参数模型，从零训练（FineWeb-Edu数据集，Tesla P4训练48-72小时，预训练损失从4.21降至2.84），在消费级CPU即可运行，内存<2GB。与GPT-2 Small对比：WikiText-103 PPL 26.87 vs 29.41，PTB PPL 61.32 vs 65.85。在500题域内基准测试中，CGRAG在所有8个基线上取得最佳F1（0.226）和ROUGE-L，延迟6.00秒，比GPT-only快6.3倍，F1从0.171提升至0.226。路由分布：85% RAG抽取、7.5% GPT生成、7.5%拒绝。域外查询拒绝率从0%升至6-12%，安全性提升。对LangChain RAG的F1增益仅+0.016，精度突破有限。

arxiv.title: EverydayGPT: Confidence-Gated Routing for Efficient and Safe Hybrid GPT-RAG Conversational QA
arxiv.abstract: Standard Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines route every query through retrieval and generation unconditionally, incurring unnecessary computation and propagating low-quality context to the generator. We introduce EverydayGPT, a lightweight conversational QA system built around a Confidence-Gated Routing (CGR) mechanism that formalises the routing decision as a joint policy over retrieval distance and extraction adequacy. The backbone is a 205M-parameter GPT trained from scratch on 10B tokens of FineWeb-Edu. CGR avoids invoking the costly GPT pathway (~5.9s) for 85 percent of queries by resolving them via fast RAG extraction (~45 ms), yielding over 120x latency reduction on the majority of queries while maintaining answer quality. On a 500-question in-domain benchmark, the system achieves F1 = 0.226 +/- 0.004 compared to 0.171 for GPT-only and 0.210 for unconditional RAG. Gains over strong baselines are modest but consistent, while efficiency improvements are substantial (6.3x mean latency reduction). A structured grounding audit finds no unsupported claims in the sampled set, with explicit scope limitations. We position this work as a study of routing strategies under resource constraints rather than a claim of state-of-the-art performance.

papers.summary: 微软与上海交通大学联合团队提出FastContext，将Coding Agent的仓库探索任务解耦为专用4B-30B subagent，通过SFT+RL训练，显著减少主Agent的Token消耗。实验表明，读取+搜索占主Agent 46.5% Token和56.2% tool轮次。在SWE-bench Multilingual上，主模型GPT-5.4配合FC-30B-SFT得分从71.7提升至75.0(+3.3)，Token从457k降至356k(-22.1%)；SWE-bench Pro得分从46.0提升至51.5(+5.5)；SWE-QA Token降低60.3%。4B-RL模型在SWE-bench Pro上超越30B-SFT版本，且Token更少。成本审计显示，4B explorer调用仅占总成本2.1%，300任务净节省$69。RL阶段使用patch位置作为奖励信号，通过GRPO优化，reward持续上升。独立评估中，FC-30B-SFT在file-level F1达73.71，优于基线CodeScout-14B的68.57。FC-4B-RL在4B规模接近frontier模型。论文还分析了三个真实案例，展示FastContext如何挽救基线失败任务。局限性包括仅集成Mini-SWE-Agent、最小模型为4B等。该工作提供了一套完整的仓库探索subagent训练与评估开放链路。

arxiv.title: FastContext: an efficient and scalable implementation of the ConText algorithm
arxiv.abstract: Objective: To develop and evaluate FastContext, an efficient, scalable implementation of the ConText algorithm suitable for very large-scale clinical natural language processing. Background: The ConText algorithm performs with state-of-art accuracy in detecting the experiencer, negation status, and temporality of concept mentions in clinical narratives. However, the speed limitation of its current implementations hinders its use in big data processing. Methods: We developed FastContext through hashing the ConText's rules, then compared its speed and accuracy with JavaConText and GeneralConText, two widely used Java implementations. Results: FastContext ran two orders of magnitude faster and was less decelerated by rule increase than the other two implementations used in this study for comparison. Additionally, FastContext consistently gained accuracy improvement as the rules increased (the desired outcome of adding new rules), while the other two implementations did not. Conclusions: FastContext is an efficient, scalable implementation of the popular ConText algorithm, suitable for natural language applications on very large clinical corpora.

papers.summary: 微博AI团队发布 VibeThinker-3B，基于 Qwen2.5-Coder-3B base 重做后训练，通过课程式两阶段 SFT、多领域强化学习（MGPO）、离线自蒸馏和声明级测试时缩放（CLR），将 3B 稠密小模型的可验证推理能力推至一线水平。在 AIME26 上标准推理得分 94.3%，加入 CLR 后达 97.1%，超过 Gemini 3 Pro（91.7%）和 DeepSeek V3.2（94.2%）；在 IMO-AnswerBench 上 CLR 后达 80.6%，接近 671B-1T 参数模型区间。代码能力方面，LiveCodeBench v6 上 Pass@1 为 80.2%，接近 GPT-OSS-120B（81.9%）。在最新 LeetCode 周赛测试中（128 次首次提交），通过率高达 96.1%，优于 GPT-5.2、Qwen3-Max 等更大模型。指令跟随 IFEval 得分 93.4%。核心技术包括：MGPO 强化学习策略（聚焦模型能力边界附近的样本）、Long2Short 阶段（在正确轨迹中偏好更简洁解）、64K 长上下文直接训练。论文公开于 arXiv，模型及代码已在 Hugging Face 及 GitHub 开源。

arxiv.title: VibeThinker-3B: Exploring the Frontier of Verifiable Reasoning in Small Language Models
arxiv.abstract: This technical report introduces VibeThinker-3B, a compact dense model with 3B parameters developed to investigate how far verifiable reasoning can be pushed within a strictly small-model regime. Building upon the Spectrum-to-Signal post-training paradigm, we systematically enhance the model through an optimized pipeline that includes curriculum-based supervised fine-tuning, multi-domain reinforcement learning, and offline self-distillation. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that VibeThinker-3B achieves frontier-level performance on highly demanding verifiable tasks. Specifically, it attains a score of 94.3 on AIME26 (improving to 97.1 with claim-level test-time scaling), an 80.2 Pass@1 on LiveCodeBench v6, and exhibits strong out-of-distribution generalization with a 96.1\% acceptance rate on recent unseen LeetCode contests. This effectively places it in the performance band of first-tier reasoning systems, matching or exceeding flagship models that are orders of magnitude larger, such as DeepSeek V3.2, GLM-5, and Gemini 3 Pro. Furthermore, a score of 93.4 on IFEval confirms that this extreme reasoning enhancement does not compromise strict instruction controllability. papers.report_title: 阿里高德发布 APPO:Agent RL信用分配细化到每个决策点,13项基准平均提升近4分
papers.summary: 中科大与阿里高德联合提出APPO，针对Agent RL中信用分配粗粒度问题，引入Branching Score（BS）将分支点从工具调用边界下沉到序列中细粒度决策点。BS结合token熵与未来价值，过滤“假高熵”并识别真正影响下游的决策点（如verify、sum、break）。在13项基准上（数学推理GSM8K/MATH/AIME、知识推理HotpotQA/2Wiki/Musique/Bamboogle/WebWalkerQA、深度搜索GAIA/HLE/Xbench）相对于强基线ARPO平均提升近4分。具体：Qwen2.5-7B上AIME24从30.0到36.7(+6.7)，MATH500从64.6到69.4；GAIA上Qwen3-8B从38.8到42.7，14B达46.6；Pass@5分析显示APPO探索到结构不同的推理策略。组件消融表明未来感知项贡献最大（去掉掉3.4分），BS比纯熵高1.8分。APPO的工具调用次数与基线持平，无需额外开销。训练动态更稳定，聚类分析显示分支更紧凑。理论给出方差缩减与策略改进下界。核心价值在于将“过程”作为可学习结构，使Agent RL从“在工具边界分叉”升级为“在序列中找真正改变命运的决策点”。

arxiv.title: APPO: Attention-guided Perception Policy Optimization for Video Reasoning
arxiv.abstract: Complex video reasoning, actually, relies excessively on fine-grained perception rather than on expert (e.g., Ph.D, Science)-level reasoning. Through extensive empirical observation, we have recognized the critical impact of perception. In particular, when perception ability is almost fixed, enhancing reasoning from Qwen3-8B to OpenAI-o3 yields only 0.7% performance improvement. Conversely, even minimal change in perception model scale (from 7B to 32B) boosts performance by 1.4%, indicating enhancing perception, rather than reasoning, is more critical to improve performance. Therefore, exploring how to enhance perception ability through reasoning without the need for expensive fine-grained annotation information is worthwhile. To achieve this goal, we specially propose APPO, the Attention-guided Perception Policy Optimization algorithm that leverages token-level dense rewards to improve model's fine-grained perception. The core idea behind APPO is to optimize those tokens from different responses that primarily focus on the same crucial video frame (called intra-group perception tokens). Experimental results on diverse video benchmarks and models with different scales (3/7B) demonstrate APPO consistently outperforms GRPO and DAPO (0.5%~4%). We hope our work provides a promising approach to effectively enhance model's perception abilities through reasoning in a low-cost manner,

papers.report_title: RAG又变了,HistoRAG跑出新范式
papers.summary: 本文解读论文《HistoRAG: Embedding Historical Methodology in Retrieval-Augmented Generation Through Critical Technical Practice》。HistoRAG针对历史研究这一解释型领域，重构传统RAG流水线。核心设计包括：（1）两阶段流水线（Heuristik + Analyse），要求用户手动确认候选资料后LLM才能进入解释阶段，保留研究者控制权；（2）时间窗口（Temporal Windowing）策略，强制按年代保留资料，防止词汇变迁导致早期资料被遗漏；实验使用SPIEGELragged语料（1950-1979年Der Spiegel的102,189篇文章），发现用1970s术语检索1950s的结果为0块，而windowed方法保证分布均衡；（3）LLM-as-judge后检索评估，对比向量相似度（Spearman rho仅0.275）与LLM评估的相关性极弱，跨模型排序一致性高（r>0.96）；（4）Zwischentexte中间文本概念，将LLM输出定位为解释草案而非最终结论。论文强调：当RAG进入专业领域，关键不是检索更相似，而是让检索过程符合领域知识生产方式。该方法不追求通用QA榜单刷分，而是为可审查、可质疑的研究流程提供架构支撑。

arxiv.title: HistoRAG: Embedding Historical Methodology in Retrieval-Augmented Generation Through Critical Technical Practice
arxiv.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is the prevailing architecture for grounding language model outputs in external evidence, yet its dominant evaluation paradigms and default configurations remain oriented toward factual question-answering. For interpretive disciplines such as historical studies, RAG embeds assumptions that conflict with scholarly practice. We introduce HistoRAG, a framework that translates historiographical principles into concrete architectural interventions. Separated retrieval and generation decouples source discovery from interpretation, temporal windowing enforces balanced source representation across the research period as a methodological requirement of historical inquiry, and LLM-as-judge evaluation makes relevance judgments transparent and contestable. We evaluate these interventions using SPIEGELragged, applied to 102,189 articles from Der Spiegel (1950-1979). papers.title: InjectV: Modeling Fault Injection Attacks in RISC-V Simulation Environment
papers.report_title: InjectV:在 RISC-V 仿真环境中建模故障注入攻击
papers.summary: 本文深入解读论文《InjectV: Modeling Fault Injection Attacks in RISC-V Simulation Environment》，该工作提出一个基于gem5全系统模拟器的故障注入攻击仿真框架。核心创新在于通过预处理阶段自动识别候选注入点（Candidate Injection Points, CIP），将传统的随机探索转为安全语义引导的定向注入。在FISSC VerifyPIN基准上，使用46,067×2次仿真、37个CPU cores、峰值内存33.6 GB、平均每次仿真约30秒。实验结果：定向注入共发现48次成功安全违规（27次内存故障、21次寄存器扰动），而相同条件下的随机注入仅发现2次。若要达到相同成功率，随机注入需要约1,104,000次注入，相当于24×计算成本，InjectV因此节省约95.8%时间。进一步分析显示寄存器x15贡献了21次成功寄存器扰动中的16次，说明攻击有效性高度依赖于是否命中关键架构状态。该工作支持寄存器与内存瞬态bit-level故障建模，结果自动分类为TIMEOUT、CRASH、NO EFFECT、UNKNOWN、SUCCESS，其中SUCCESS需满足用户定义的安全谓词（如认证绕过）。框架通过checkpoint机制减少OS启动重复开销，Campaign Manager实现批量并行仿真。该工具适合在芯片早期设计阶段进行可重复、可定位的安全评估，对RISC-V安全芯片、TEE及抗故障攻击软件防护设计具有重要价值。

arxiv.title: InjectV: Modeling Fault Injection Attacks in RISC-V Simulation Environment
arxiv.abstract: Fault Injection Attacks (FIAs) are a significant threat to hardware security, capable of compromising systems by inducing malicious faults in computation or storage. Evaluating resilience against such attacks is challenging due to the high cost, complexity, and limited availability of physical fault experiments, particularly during pre-silicon development. Architectural-level simulation offers a developer-oriented, white-box perspective for systematic vulnerability assessment. This paper introduces InjectV, a fault injection attack framework for RISC-V platforms built on the gem5 simulator. InjectV enables precise, guided fault injection at security-critical execution points, such as control-flow decisions, counters, and comparisons, allowing systematic exploration of attack vectors. It currently supports transient fault attacks in registers and memory, broadening its ability to simulate diverse attack scenarios. Experimental results on security benchmarks from the FISSC suite, including hardened variants of the VerifyPIN application, demonstrate InjectV's ability to effectively identify fault-injection points, achieving a 95.8% time-saving advantage over traditional fault injection approaches.

papers.report_title: 腾讯联手港中文等发榜单:让 Agent 在 Godot 里做完整游戏,最强也只有 41.46%
papers.summary: 腾讯与港中文等机构提出GameCraft-Bench，首个在真实Godot引擎中评测Coding Agent端到端构建可玩游戏能力的基准。覆盖15类游戏家族140个任务，定义五阶段评测流水线：Task Packaging、Agent Generation、Build Gate（项目能启动且trace可解析，否则总分归零）、Replay、Scoring（四大维度：Core Mechanics 15%、Content Depth 35%、Functional Visuals 15%、Art and Presentation 35%）。最强配置总体分仅41.46%，第二梯队39.49%、30.65%，说明当前Agent离稳定交付完整游戏还差得远。失败模式诊断发现：视觉反馈驱动迭代确实有效（频繁截图看画面的Agent更易调试）；工具调用次数多不等于分数高；评分器稳定性良好但与人工对齐有轻微偏置（Content/Presentation略宽松，Visual略严格）。四大维度相关性分析表明Mechanics强不代表Content或Art自然跟上。论文强调评测契约完整性：必须满足真实引擎、完整可运行产物、可交互验证三件事。当前聚焦2D场景，3D/多人/长周期待扩展。

arxiv.title: GameCraft-Bench: Can Agents Build Playable Games End-to-End in a Real Game Engine?
arxiv.abstract: Game generation is an emerging application of coding agents, requiring models to transform natural-language specifications into playable interactive systems. Unlike traditional coding tasks, game generation takes place within a game engine, where scripts, scenes, assets, rendering, and runtime interactions must jointly produce coherent gameplay. We formalize end-to-end game generation as the problem of producing a complete game artifact that realizes a specification through observable player-game interaction in a target environment. We argue that evaluating this setting requires three desiderata: Engine Grounding, Artifact Completeness, and Interactive Verification. We propose an interaction-grounded evaluation framework that assesses executable gameplay through replayed demonstrations and rubric-guided multimodal judging. We instantiate this framework as GameCraft-Bench, a benchmark comprising 140 Godot tasks across 15 game families. Evaluations of frontier coding agents show that end-to-end game generation remains highly challenging: the strongest agent achieves only 41.46%, and most agents score below 40%. Further analysis reveals that while agents often implement recognizable mechanics, they struggle to deliver complete games with sufficient content, functional visual feedback, and coherent presentation. papers.title: Parallel R-tree-based Spatial Query Processing on a Commercial Processing-in-Memory System
papers.report_title: U.S. News 2026-2027全球大学排名发布!
papers.summary: 本文是一篇关于《Parallel R-Tree–based Spatial Query Processing on a Commercial Processing-in-Memory System》论文的深度技术解读。论文针对传统空间范围查询（基于 R-tree）在大规模数据下受限于内存访问瓶颈的问题，提出并实现了一种基于商用 UPMEM PIM 系统的 broadcast-based PIM R-tree 执行策略。核心方法是将三层 STR R-tree 的上层索引（root + level-1）广播到所有 DPU，下层叶子节点连续切片后分发至各 DPU，查询批量广播，DPU 内部先进行上层过滤（O(1) 复杂度）再本地扫描叶子节点，最终主机聚合结果。实验使用三个数据集：Sports (~999K矩形)、Lakes (~8.4M矩形)、Synthetic (~16M矩形)。关键数据：在 Synthetic 数据集上，PIM kernel 相比多线程 CPU baseline 最高加速约 1.66×，且 kernel speedup 随 DPU 数量从 512 增至 2540 提升至约 3.66×（8.4M Lakes 数据集），但 end-to-end speedup 受通信开销影响为 2.70×。与 subtree-based baseline 相比，Broadcast 方法在 Lakes 上 end-to-end speedup 达 2.16×–2.83×（subtree 方法低于 0.5×），在 Synthetic 上达 7.50×。论文还分析了 DPU 内 tasklet 并行饱和点（8–11个后受 MRAM 带宽限制）。结论是 PIM 在大规模、不规则内存访问场景下可有效弥补 CPU 内存墙，但 host-DPU 通信设计是决定端到端收益的关键。

arxiv.title: Parallel R-tree-based Spatial Query Processing on a Commercial Processing-in-Memory System
arxiv.abstract: The growing volume of data in scientific domains has made spatial query processing increasingly challenging due to high data transfer costs across the memory hierarchy and limited memory bandwidth. To address these bottlenecks and reduce the energy consumed on data movement, this work explores Processing-in-Memory (PIM) systems by executing range queries directly inside memory chips. Unlike prior PIM studies centered on linear scans or hash-based queries, this work is the first to map R-tree range queries onto commercial PIM hardware. The proposed broadcast-based method constructs the R-tree bottom-up on the CPU, broadcasts top levels to UPMEM DPUs (DRAM Processing Units) for global filtering, and distributes lower levels for parallel batched queries in a CPU-DPU system. We evaluate our approach on two real spatial datasets, Sports (999K rectangles) and Lakes (8.4M rectangles), and assess scalability using a synthetic dataset with up to 16M rectangles and 3.9M queries on a commercial UPMEM PIM system with up to 2,540 DPUs. Across all datasets, broadcast-based execution consistently outperforms subtree partitioning by preventing communication from dominating execution. On the Lakes dataset, strong scaling from 512 to 2,540 DPUs reduces kernel time from 64.9 s to 17.6 s, yielding up to 3.66x kernel and 2.70x end-to-end speedup relative to the CPU R-tree search on the same system.

papers.title: CQC-RAG: Robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Cross-Query Consistency
papers.report_title: RAG缺陷找到了,CQC-RAG上了新思路
papers.summary: 本文提出了一种基于跨查询一致性假设（Cross-Query Consistency Hypothesis）的RAG答案自验证框架CQC-RAG，旨在解决现有RAG系统对查询表述敏感及噪声文档诱导幻觉的问题。核心思路是：若答案正确，语义等价但句法多样的查询下仍保持高置信度；若是幻觉，换种问法置信度会大幅波动。框架包含三阶段：受控查询改写（N=4个改写+原始共5视角，共享检索池）、跨查询推理与证据提取（query-specific reranking + evidence-grounded reasoning）、跨查询一致性置信度估计（语义共识均值减方差惩罚）。在Qwen3-8B骨干模型上的实验显示：TriviaQA EM达59.65（较标准RAG提升10.47pp，较DMQR-RAG提升4.76pp），PopQA EM 46.86（较DMQR-RAG提升0.40pp），MuSiQue EM 32.62（较标准RAG提升20.32pp，较DMQR-RAG提升9.12pp），HotpotQA AVG 60.05（略低于DMQR-RAG的61.63，因DMQR-RAG的信息扩展查询在标题匹配上有优势）。消融实验表明，去掉跨查询评估是最大降幅（MuSiQue EM下降显著），验证了核心机制。该方法无需外部监督、不扩大检索覆盖，仅通过改写+重排+评估增强鲁棒性，与现有RAG管线兼容。

arxiv.title: CQC-RAG: Robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Cross-Query Consistency
arxiv.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has become a common approach for improving the factuality of Large Language Models (LLMs), yet its reliability remains highly sensitive to how external evidence is retrieved and used. Semantically equivalent queries with different syntactic forms may lead to different retrieval results, while irrelevant or misleading documents can further induce hallucinated answers. Existing multi-path reasoning methods improve robustness by sampling multiple candidate answers and applying voting- or confidence-based selection, but they still face two limitations: diversity is often injected through uncontrollable decoding randomness, and answer evaluation is usually confined to a single query-induced evidence view. To address these limitations, we propose a Cross-Query Consistency Hypothesis: correct answers tend to maintain high confidence across semantically equivalent but syntactically diverse queries, whereas noise-induced hallucinations exhibit unstable confidence under such query variations. Based on this hypothesis, we introduce CQC-RAG, a framework that co-designs query-level diversity injection with cross-query consistency evaluation. papers.summary: 本文深度解读了 arXiv:2606.12983 上的论文《Structured Testbench Generation for LLM-Driven HDL Design and Verification-Oriented Data Curation》。该论文提出 STG 方法，核心思路是放弃让 LLM 从头生成 testbench，而是先解析 HDL 结构（识别端口、时钟、复位、状态机等），然后根据设计类型（组合逻辑、一般时序、FSM）选择激励策略，并用参数化 Jinja 模板渲染 testbench。关键性能指标：作为直接验证工具，STG 生成 testbench 的速度比迭代式 LLM pipeline 快 720 倍，且具有更高的编译成功率、line/toggle coverage，并减少错误 DUT 的 false-pass。在数据筛选场景下，STG 在单个 CPU core 上比 LLM-based filtering 快 11 倍，能耗低 127 倍；用 STG 筛出的数据训练简单 SFT 模型，在多项 RTL generation benchmark 上取得有竞争力甚至更好的结果。作为 test-time scaling oracle，STG 可将 solved-problem node count 降低 14%-47%。该方法的局限性在于依赖已知的 golden reference，不适用于无 golden 或复杂 SoC 验证场景。论文为 AI+EDA 中的“批量候选判断”和“训练数据筛选”提供了低成本、高信度的工程化方案，值得关注其在 LLM-driven RTL workflow 中的实际落地潜力。

arxiv.title: Structured Testbench Generation for LLM-Driven HDL Design and Verification-Oriented Data Curation
arxiv.abstract: Automated testbench generation has become a critical bottleneck in large language model (LLM)-driven Register Transfer Level (RTL) workflows, where large numbers of candidate designs must be verified rapidly and reliably. Existing prompt-based approaches treat testbench generation as unconstrained code synthesis, yielding stochastic outputs with high token cost, low reproducibility, and insufficient coverage. To address this gap, we present STG, a Structured Testbench Generation framework that exploits the inherent structure of hardware designs to generate deterministic testbenches. As a direct verification tool, STG runs 720x faster than an iterative LLM-based testbench generation flow and higher rate of successful compilation, achieves higher coverage, and reduces false-pass verdicts on incorrect DUTs. STG also helps identify errors in RTL generation benchmarks by exposing faulty benchmark testbenches. As a data curation engine, it is 11x faster than LLM-based filtering on a single CPU core with 127x less energy, and the resulting distilled models provide state-of-the-art performance in our multi-benchmark evaluation. As a test-time scaling oracle, it reduces node count by 14-47\%. Our models are available at https://huggingface.co/collections/AS-SiliconMind/siliconmind-v12.

papers.title: OpenRTLSet: A Fully Open-Source Dataset for Large Language Model-based Verilog Module Design
papers.report_title: 开源 RTL 数据,才是 AI 芯片设计的硬地基
papers.summary: 本文深度解读了OpenRTLSet这一开源RTL数据集，其在AI+EDA领域具有重要意义。OpenRTLSet提供了超过13.1万个Verilog代码样本，包括约102k个来自GitHub的Verilog模块、约5k个VHDL翻译模块以及约24k个从可综合C/C++翻译的模块。作者利用DeepSeek-R1为每个样本生成自然语言描述，形成描述-代码配对数据，并用于微调Qwen、Granite等开源模型家族（7B-32B参数规模）。论文还比较了是否加入Verilator生成的C++上下文、INT4与BF16精度差异等变量，并使用VerilogEval pass@k进行评测。最佳微调模型为Qwen2.5-Coder 32B OpenRTLSet。数据集和代码仓库采用Apache-2.0许可，公开了从数据生成、标注、微调到评测的完整工程链路，便于复现和扩展。文章强调，高质量RTL数据远比通用代码更难获取，许可合规是AI+EDA落地的隐形门槛。研究者需注意pass@k指标仅能反映生成能力，真实芯片设计还需经过综合、CDC检查、形式验证等工程环节。OpenRTLSet的意义在于提供了可合法使用、可追溯的训练基线，推动AI芯片设计从演示走向工程化。对于企业而言，真正的价值在于将模型与内部设计规范、知识库和流程工具链集成，构建可控的AI研发底座。
report_titles: 开源 RTL 数据,才是 AI 芯片设计的硬地基

arxiv.title: OpenRTLSet: A Fully Open-Source Dataset for Large Language Model-based Verilog Module Design
arxiv.abstract: OpenRTLSet introduces the largest fully open-source dataset for hardware design, offering over 131,000 diverse Verilog code samples to the research community and industry. Our dataset uniquely combines Verilog code from GitHub repositories (102k modules), VHDL translations (5k modules), and synthesizable C/C++ translations (24k modules), all freely accessible without proprietary restrictions. Using the reasoning model DeepSeek-R1, we generated paired natural language descriptions for each code sample, enabling fine-tuning of various language model families (e.g., Qwen and Granite) for Verilog code generation. Our dataset explores multiple options, including Verilator-generated C++ files as additional context during labeling, quantization techniques (INT4 vs. BF16), and performance differences across model sizes (7B-32B parameters). OpenRTLSet demonstrates that open-source approaches can achieve superior performance in hardware design tasks, establishing a new foundation for accessible research and commercial use in this domain.
arxiv.journal_ref: 2025 IEEE International Conference on LLM-Aided Design (ICLAD), Stanford, CA, USA, 2025, pp. 212-218

papers.title: Hallucinations Undermine Trust; Metacognition is a Way Forward
papers.report_title: Google这篇论文,揭开了大模型幻觉的根本困境
papers.summary: 本文详细解读了Google最新论文《幻觉破坏信任，元认知是一条出路》（arXiv链接：https://arxiv.org/html/2605.01428v1）。论文指出，大模型幻觉在现有自回归框架下无法根除，核心限制在于‘辨别力缺口’：模型校准（置信度与准确率匹配）不等于辨别能力。实验表明，当前现实任务AUROC仅0.70-0.85，要将幻觉率降至5%以下需同时丢弃52%的正确回答（‘效用税’）。论文还发现扩展推理反而增加幻觉，因为推理链越长越容易将错误起点合理化。作为替代，论文提出‘忠实的不确定性’（Faithful Uncertainty）范式：重新定义幻觉为‘自信的错误’，要求模型用语言表达的不确定性与其内在不确定性对齐。内在不确定性通过对同一问题多次采样得到，语言不确定性通过输出文本传达。忠实度指标cMFG当前先进模型仅0.5-0.7，说明表达与内部状态弱相关。论文论证，消灭幻觉要求输出匹配外部世界（开放问题），而忠实不确定性只需输出匹配内部状态（封闭问题），后者可通过模型内部置信度信号直接提取。在Agent系统中，元认知被定位为控制层，决定何时调用工具、何时质疑检索结果。后训练（如RLHF）会破坏预训练模型的不确定性表示，需要设计‘保持不确定性的对齐算法’。该工作为幻觉研究提供了结构性诊断与新的优化方向。

arxiv.title: Hallucinations Undermine Trust; Metacognition is a Way Forward
arxiv.abstract: Despite significant strides in factual reliability, errors -- often termed hallucinations -- remain a major concern for generative AI, especially as LLMs are increasingly expected to be helpful in more complex or nuanced setups. Yet even in the simplest setting -- factoid question-answering with clear ground truth-frontier models without external tools continue to hallucinate. We argue that most factuality gains in this domain have come from expanding the model's knowledge boundary (encoding more facts) rather than improving awareness of that boundary (distinguishing known from unknown). We conjecture that the latter is inherently difficult: models may lack the discriminative power to perfectly separate truths from errors, creating an unavoidable tradeoff between eliminating hallucinations and preserving utility. This tradeoff dissolves under a different framing. If we understand hallucinations as confident errors -- incorrect information delivered without appropriate qualification -- a third path emerges beyond the answer-or-abstain dichotomy: expressing uncertainty. We propose faithful uncertainty: aligning linguistic uncertainty with intrinsic uncertainty. This is one facet of metacognition -- the ability to be aware of one's own uncertainty and to act on it. papers.title: TokenMizer: Graph-Structured Session Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Context Management
papers.report_title: 三分钟论文速递 | 大模型微调后,为什么有些数据总是学不会?
papers.summary: 本文基于论文《TokenMizer: Graph-Structured Session Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Context Management》系统介绍了监督微调中的‘不完全学习现象’。研究发现，即使模型在训练集上损失收敛，平均仍有约15.3%的样本无法被正确回答。论文归纳了五种核心成因：预训练知识不足、知识与微调冲突、微调数据内部冲突、左侧遗忘及优化不足。实验结果表明：持续预训练在医疗、法律等领域带来9.4%-14.1%准确率提升；动态分桶使冲突数据处理提升2.8%；重采样策略使早期数据保留率提高29%；渐进式轮数递增带来1.0%-1.9%准确率提升。单纯增加微调轮数仅能改善不到2%，说明知识缺失问题无法通过延长微调解决。论文设计了检测流程：将训练样本转为多选题，微调收敛后计算pass@N，阈值设为0.2标记未学习样本。归因框架通过零样本正确率、JS散度等信号关联五类成因。该工作揭示了传统整体评估可能掩盖的可靠性风险，为微调实践提供了细粒度诊断和因因施策的干预方向。

arxiv.title: TokenMizer: Graph-Structured Session Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Context Management
arxiv.abstract: Long-horizon LLM sessions outlive their context windows, and the standard mitigations - truncation, summarization, retrieval - share a structural flaw: they treat history as flat text, discarding precisely the content that makes a session resumable: decisions and their rationales, task status, and file modification history. We present TokenMizer, an open-source transparent proxy that maintains session history as a typed knowledge graph and, at context boundaries, replaces the raw transcript with a token-budgeted serialization of session state. The schema comprises 14 node types and 7 edge types under an 8-state lifecycle in which decisions can be superseded or explicitly invalidated; bitemporal validity intervals support time-travel queries; and first-class decision-transition records preserve why each decision replaced its predecessor (trigger, reason, evidence). Version 0.3.1 embeds this memory core in a production-shaped serving layer - SSE streaming, security middleware, nine provider adapters, a monitoring dashboard, graph exports (D3 JSON, self-contained interactive HTML, Obsidian Canvas) - and exposes checkpoint/resume to agents as Model Context Protocol tools. The evaluation is deliberately minimal and fully provenanced: three synthetic sessions, heuristic-only extraction, one plain-summary baseline, every value traceable to a single versioned results file. papers.title: APPO: Agentic Procedural Policy Optimization
papers.report_title: 阿里高德发布 APPO:Agent RL信用分配细化到每个决策点,13项基准平均提升近4分
papers.summary: 本文解读中科大与阿里高德联合提出的APPO（Agentic Procedural Policy Optimization）方法，将Agent强化学习的信用分配从粗粒度的工具调用边界下沉到生成序列中每个细粒度决策点。核心创新是Branching Score（BS）= token熵×未来价值，有效过滤纯熵方法中的“假高熵”（如罕见名词），聚焦于真正改变推理走向的决策词（如verify、sum、break）。在13项基准上，APPO相对最强Agentic基线（ARPO）平均提升近4分：Llama3.1-8B上AIME24从23.3提到30.0，MATH500从64.6到69.4；Qwen2.5-7B上AIME24从30.0到36.7，2Wiki从76.1到81.5。深度搜索任务中，Qwen3-8B在GAIA上从38.8提到42.7，14B达到46.6；WebWalkerQA同步上涨。消融实验显示未来感知项（process-aware advantage）贡献最大（完整版58.1 vs去掉后54.7），BS优于纯熵（+1.8分），双组advantage也贡献+2.1分。Pass@K分析显示优势随K扩大持续增加，说明APPO探索到结构不同的推理策略。训练曲线更平稳，工具调用次数与基线持平。论文还给出理论保证：BS引导下向高方差决策点分配更多样本可降低梯度方差（Theorem 3.1），并有策略改进下界（Theorem 3.2）。与ARPO的对比中，APPO在全序列细粒度分支、BS选点准则、procedure级信用分配和理论支撑四个维度全面升级。该方法在8B/14B规模即刷新同类方法最佳成绩，甚至超越DeepSeek-R1-671B等闭源模型在某些长链路任务上的表现。
papers.authors: 中科大与阿里高德团队

arxiv.title: APPO: Agentic Procedural Policy Optimization
arxiv.abstract: Recent advances in agentic Reinforcement Learning (RL) have substantially improved the multi-turn tool-use capabilities of large language model agents. However, most existing methods assign credit over coarse heuristic units, such as tool-call boundaries or fixed workflows, making it difficult to identify which intermediate decisions influence downstream outcomes. In this work, we study agentic RL from two perspectives: \textit{where to branch and how to assign credit after branching}. Our pilot analysis shows that influential decision points are broadly distributed throughout the generated sequence rather than concentrated at tool calls, while token entropy alone does not reliably reflect their impact on final outcomes. Motivated by these observations, we propose \textbf{Agentic Procedural Policy Optimization (APPO)}, which shifts branching and credit assignment from coarse interaction units to fine-grained decision points in the sequence. APPO selects branching locations using a Branching Score that combines token uncertainty with policy-induced likelihood gains of subsequent continuations, enabling more targeted exploration while filtering out spurious high-entropy positions. It further introduces procedure-level advantage scaling to better distribute credit across branched rollouts. Experiments on 13 benchmarks show that APPO consistently improves strong agentic RL baseline

papers.title: NanoFlow: Scalable Normalizing Flows with Sublinear Parameter Complexity
papers.report_title: 大模型推理顶会论文分享---NanoFlow(OSDI 2025)
papers.summary: 本文深度解读NanoFlow（OSDI 2025）的核心贡献，该工作从设备内执行调度入手，将输入Batch拆分为多个nano-batch，通过自动决定batch大小、顺序和资源分配，实现计算（GEMM）、访存（decode attention）和通信（AllReduce/AllGather）三类异构操作的流水线重叠，从而提升GPU利用率。关键数据包括：在8×A100上，NanoFlow比vLLM快4.18×，比TensorRT-LLM快1.91×；现有系统仅达到理论最优吞吐的22%–38%（vLLM 22%，TensorRT-LLM 37.8%），而NanoFlow可达50%–72%。核心前提分析显示：得益于GQA，70B模型在8×A100上dense batch size可达~2048，使系统转为compute-bound，通信和内存均非瓶颈（T_net/T_compute远小于1，T_mem/T_compute<0.5）。NanoFlow通过两阶段MILP自动搜索pipeline结构和资源分配，结合kernel interference profiling（R→P映射表，std<5%），10分钟即可生成最优方案。消融实验表明overlap贡献约1.17×，其余来自更好的kernel实现和异步调度。多模型验证中MoE模型受益最大。局限性包括：长context场景下KV-cache压力可能改变瓶颈判断；低请求率场景延迟略高于TensorRT-LLM；单卡小模型收益有限；未在H100/B200及多节点场景验证。
report_titles: 大模型推理顶会论文分享---NanoFlow(OSDI 2025)

arxiv.title: NanoFlow: Scalable Normalizing Flows with Sublinear Parameter Complexity
arxiv.abstract: Normalizing flows (NFs) have become a prominent method for deep generative models that allow for an analytic probability density estimation and efficient synthesis. However, a flow-based network is considered to be inefficient in parameter complexity because of reduced expressiveness of bijective mapping, which renders the models unfeasibly expensive in terms of parameters. We present an alternative parameterization scheme called NanoFlow, which uses a single neural density estimator to model multiple transformation stages. Hence, we propose an efficient parameter decomposition method and the concept of flow indication embedding, which are key missing components that enable density estimation from a single neural network. Experiments performed on audio and image models confirm that our method provides a new parameter-efficient solution for scalable NFs with significant sublinear parameter complexity.

papers.title: From Similarity to Vulnerability: Key Collision Attack on LLM Semantic Caching
papers.report_title: ICML2026|一句无关问题也能劫持Agent,港科大&复旦提出首个语义缓存键碰撞攻击
papers.summary: 香港科技大学与复旦团队在ICML 2026发表论文《From Similarity to Vulnerability: Key Collision Attack on LLM Semantic Caching》，系统揭示语义缓存的完整性漏洞。提出CacheAttack黑盒攻击框架，通过对抗后缀使恶意查询的嵌入向量与良性查询碰撞，劫持AI响应。攻击成功率：GPTCache上CacheAttack-1达86.9%，CacheAttack-2达83.1%，覆盖AWS、Azure等云服务。方法包括离线生成器（基于GCG搜索+PPL惩罚生成流畅对抗后缀）和双变体校验器（利用GMM+MAP从时延侧信道推断缓存命中）。理论证明语义缓存固有误报风险下界。金融Agent案例显示：攻击者预先注入含“卖出5000股”的缓存，受害者发送无关问题即可触发强平指令。研究指出性能（高缓存命中率）与安全（抗碰撞）存在不可调和的Trade-off：收紧阈值会破坏缓存价值。相关工作已覆盖主流语义缓存中间件和智能体场景，对推理优化系统的安全设计提出严峻挑战。

arxiv.title: From Similarity to Vulnerability: Key Collision Attack on LLM Semantic Caching
arxiv.abstract: Semantic caching has emerged as a pivotal technique for scaling LLM applications, widely adopted by major providers including AWS and Microsoft. By utilizing semantic embedding vectors as cache keys, this mechanism effectively minimizes latency and redundant computation for semantically similar queries. In this work, we conceptualize semantic cache keys as a form of fuzzy hashes. We demonstrate that the locality required to maximize cache hit rates fundamentally conflicts with the cryptographic avalanche effect necessary for collision resistance. Our conceptual analysis formalizes this inherent trade-off between performance (locality) and security (collision resilience), revealing that semantic caching is naturally vulnerable to key collision attacks. While prior research has focused on side-channel and privacy risks, we present the first systematic study of integrity risks arising from cache collisions. We introduce CacheAttack, an automated framework for launching black-box collision attacks. We evaluate CacheAttack in security-critical tasks and agentic workflows. It achieves a hit rate of 86\% in LLM response hijacking and can induce malicious behaviors in LLM agent, while preserving strong transferability across different embedding models. papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware Hybrid Retrieval for Long-Document RAG
papers.report_title: 牛了,UMG-RAG实现自适应检索粒度
papers.summary: 本文解读普渡大学发表的论文《Uncertainty-Aware Hybrid Retrieval for Long-Document RAG》。UMG-RAG无需训练，通过多粒度多通道检索（2、4、8、16、32句五种粒度）结合置信度加权融合，自适应为每个查询选择最合适的检索粒度。核心机制是将检索分数转化为证据分布，计算归一化熵作为置信度（低熵=高可信），然后对10组expert-粒度对进行置信度加权融合，并加入长度惩罚排序（R(u|q)=P(u|q)/sqrt(ℓ(u))）。扩展版本UMGP-RAG引入Parent promotion：细粒度chunk命中时提升到其g=8的parent chunk，同时使用有界证据聚合和重叠感知去重。实验使用NQ和HotPotQA数据集，dense retriever包括BERT/BGE-M3/Qwen3-Embedding-4B，sparse retriever为SPLADEv3，generator为Qwen2.5-3B/Llama-3.2-3B。关键发现：检索召回最高≠生成最好。以BGE-M3+Qwen2.5-3B在NQ为例，LongRAG AR@5=0.9101但生成F1=0.4598，UMGP-RAG AR@5=0.8759但生成F1=0.5052，验证了紧凑连贯上下文的重要性。Parent promotion在所有组合中优于UMG-RAG。成本方面：预处理从0.15s/query增至5.36s/query，但生成更快（0.33s vs 0.71s）且显存更低（6716 MiB vs 7558 MiB）。论文核心主张：粒度选择不是超参数调优，而是查询特定的可靠性估计问题，利用检索器分数分布隐含的置信度信号即可。

arxiv.title: Uncertainty-Aware Hybrid Retrieval for Long-Document RAG
arxiv.abstract: Retrieval augmented generation (RAG) depends critically on the quality and granularity of retrieved evidence. Large retrieval units preserve context but often introduce irrelevant content, which can dilute answer bearing evidence and worsen long context utilization. Fine-grained units are more compact, but they may be difficult to retrieve reliably because short chunks can lack semantic, lexical, or bridging cues needed to match the query. We propose Uncertainty-aware Multi-Granularity RAG (UMG-RAG), a training-free hybrid retrieval framework that treats chunk granularity as query-specific reliability estimation. Instead of training a new retriever or modifying the generator, UMG-RAG uses existing dense and sparse retrievers as complementary experts across multiple chunk granularities. For each query, it converts each expert-granularity score list into an evidence distribution, estimates reliability from distribution entropy, and fuses candidates according to query-specific semantic, lexical, and granularity confidence. We further introduce UMGP-RAG, a parent promotion variant that uses fine-grained hits to locate relevant evidence while returning broader non-redundant parent chunks for local coherence. papers.title: Cloak: Heuristic ORAM Optimization Through Fixed Temporal Distribution
papers.report_title: 2026年度博士后创新人才拟支持名单公示
papers.summary: 本文深度解读论文《Cloak: Heuristic ORAM Optimization Through Fixed Temporal Distribution》，该研究提出一种全新的ORAM优化思路：将服务器端访问模式固定为具有时间局部性的分布（而非传统均匀随机），从而大幅降低dummy请求开销。实测数据显示，在Netflix数据集上，Cloak吞吐达到162,369 ops/s，仅比不安全基线（173,459 ops/s）慢约6.4%，延迟仅为69 ms（基线96 ms）；在Ethereum数据集上，Cloak吞吐为169,344 ops/s（基线185,572 ops/s，慢约8.7%），延迟203 ms；在Synthetic Zipf（s=1, 1M元素）负载下，Cloak吞吐147,620 ops/s（基线157,036 ops/s，慢约6.0%），延迟94 ms。与现有先进ORAM系统Treebeard和Waffle相比，Cloak在三个负载上分别达到2.8~7.6倍和4.7~6.6倍的吞吐提升。Cloak的核心动机来自真实访问轨迹的Zipf时间局部性（Ethereum拟合指数s≈1.1，Netflix s≈0.9），通过为每个reuse-distance set分配递减预算（第一个集合初始预算最大），使大多数批次槽位被真实请求填充。Batch size下界为O(√N)，适合高吞吐批处理场景。论文同时提供了TRACE-IND安全游戏证明和线性一致性证明。值得关注的是，Cloak的dummy选择优化（优先选取最近访问地址）进一步提升了性能，且不影响安全性。总体而言，Cloak在隐私保护强度不减的情况下，将ORAM开销压缩到接近明文存储，为云存储访问模式隐藏的实际部署提供了新路径。

arxiv.title: Cloak: Heuristic ORAM Optimization Through Fixed Temporal Distribution
arxiv.abstract: Encrypted cloud storage can hide data contents but still leak sensitive information through access patterns. ORAM addresses this by hiding access patterns, but existing ORAM systems are too inefficient to deploy in practice. We present Cloak, an oblivious storage system that dramatically improves performance by leveraging a simple, widely observed property of real workloads: temporal locality, where recently accessed items are more likely to be accessed again soon. Instead of trying to make server accesses look perfectly uniform, Cloak makes server traffic follow a fixed, "recentness-biased" pattern and then uses real queries to fill as much of that traffic as possible. When the workload exhibits temporal locality, Cloak achieves overheads as low as $1.1\times$ over a non-oblivious and unencrypted baseline. Importantly, this heuristic affects only performance, not security. We evaluate Cloak on Netflix click-stream and Ethereum transaction traces, achieving 165,000 and 157,000 operations per second, respectively, on a single machine.

papers.title: MiniMax Sparse Attention
papers.report_title: MiniMax 开源 MSA:百万上下文Attention算力砍28倍,109B模型推理加速14倍
papers.summary: MiniMax提出MiniMax Sparse Attention（MSA），在GQA骨干上增加轻量Index Branch进行块级Top-k稀疏检索，将百万token上下文下的Attention FLOPs降至全量GQA的1/28.4。在109B参数、6B激活参数的多模态MoE模型上，H800实测prefill延迟从30秒降至2.1秒（加速14.2倍），decode延迟从0.9ms降至0.12ms（加速7.6倍）。MSA采用极简设计：无压缩分支、无可学习sink，仅由Index Branch（两组投影矩阵+块级max-pooling+per-GQA-group独立Top-k）和Main Branch（仅在选中块上做精确Softmax Attention）组成，训练时使用KL对齐损失（梯度解耦）指导Index Branch，并包含Indexer Warmup和Local Block强制保留等稳定机制。关键参数：块大小128 token，每个query最多attend 2048个token，预算固定。GPU Kernel协同设计：采用exp-free Top-k选择（比torch.topk快5.1倍）、KV-outer迭代顺序（提高算术强度）、热点块扇出+两阶段前向+稀疏KL反向动态负载均衡。训练路线验证：从零稀疏预训练（MSA-PT）和从全量GQA checkpoint续训（MSA-CPT）均在3T token训练后与全量基线能力持平。MSA-PT在EgoSchema上提升8.0分（37.6 vs 29.6）、VideoMME提升4.37分（45.48 vs 41.11），RULER-8K/32K长上下文检索优于基线。消融实验证实KL-only训练信号最优、动态块选择全面优于等算力滑动窗口、可学习sink无一致优势。论文和推理Kernel已开源，生产级模型MiniMax-M3同步发布。

arxiv.title: MiniMax Sparse Attention
arxiv.abstract: Ultra-long-context capability is becoming indispensable for frontier LLMs: agentic workflows, repository-scale code reasoning, and persistent memory all require the model to jointly attend over hundreds of thousands to millions of tokens, yet the quadratic cost of softmax attention makes this untenable at deployment scale. We introduce MiniMax Sparse Attention (MSA), a blockwise sparse attention built upon Grouped Query Attention (GQA). A lightweight Index Branch scores key-value blocks and independently selects a Top-k subset for each GQA group, enabling group-specific sparse retrieval while maintaining efficient block-level execution; the Main Branch then performs exact block-sparse attention over only the selected blocks. Designed around a principle of simplicity and scalability, MSA is deliberately streamlined, making it straightforward to deploy efficiently across a broad range of GPUs. To translate sparsity into practical speedups, we co-design MSA with a GPU execution path that uses exp-free Top-k selection and KV-outer sparse attention to improve tensor-core utilization under block-granular access. On a 109B-parameter model with native multimodal training, MSA performs on par with GQA while reducing per-token attention compute by 28.4x at 1M context. Paired with our co-designed kernel, MSA achieves 14.2x prefill and 7.6x decoding wall-clock speedups on H800. Our inferen

papers.report_title: 浙大发布TokenPilot:Agent推理成本砍61%,KV Cache命中率飙到83%
papers.summary: 浙江大学提出TokenPilot双粒度上下文管理框架，聚焦长会话Agent的KV Cache命中率问题。在PinchBench连续模式下，推理费用从7.24美元降至2.79美元（-61%），cache hit率从38.7%提升至83.1%；Claw-Eval连续模式费用从81.52美元降至10.58美元（-87%），精度仅降2.6分。核心设计包括：摄入门（前缀稳定用占位符替换易变字段、观测压缩如HTML瘦身和输出截断 带recovery tool）、生命周期驱逐（基于残余效用估计，batch-turn调度最优γ=4）。消融显示：仅前缀稳定将cache hit率从38.7%拉至79.2%，费用砍半。单次全链路分析费用极低（PinchBench连续仅$2.79）。论文开源代码（基于LightMem），并提供了详细的实验对比和case study。

arxiv.title: TokenPilot: Cache-Efficient Context Management for LLM Agents
arxiv.abstract: As LLM agents are deployed in long-horizon sessions, context accumulation drives up inference costs. Existing approaches utilize text pruning or dynamic memory eviction to minimize token footprints; however, their unconstrained sequence mutations alter layouts, introducing prefix mismatches and cache invalidation. This reveals a critical trade-off between text sparsity and prompt cache continuity. To address this, we present TokenPilot, a dual-granularity context management framework. Globally, Ingestion-Aware Compaction acts as a framework harness to stabilize prompt prefixes and eliminate open-world environmental noise at the ingestion gate. Locally, Lifecycle-Aware Eviction monitors the ongoing residual utility of context segments, enforcing a conservative batch-turn schedule to offload content segments only when task relevance expires. Experiments on PinchBench and Claw-Eval under both isolated and continuous modes demonstrate that TokenPilot reduces costs by 61% and 56% in isolated mode, and 61% and 87% in continuous mode, while maintaining competitive performance compared to prior systems. TokenPilot has been integrated into LightRSI at https://github.com/zjunlp/RSI.

papers.summary: 剑桥大学2026年3月论文《The Observability Gap: Why Output-Level Human Feedback Fails for LLM Coding Agents》聚焦LLM编码代理的人机反馈问题。实验设计：让AI生成Blender 3D场景（房子、2-3棵树、1-2辆车），满足物体完整性、地面接触、碰撞避免、比例合理性四条件。A/B/C三组（模糊指令/定量约束/指定算法）共运行10次，成功率0%——AI陷入“失败模式振荡”，修A bug生B bug。D组在初始提示中加入一行代码级约束（“碰撞检测时排除地面平面”），仅3个周期即收敛成功。根本原因：代码逻辑层→执行状态层→渲染输出层之间存在多对一映射（可观察性差距）。论文提出构建“中间可观察性层”作为缓解方案，如结构化执行摘要、运行时信号可视化、错误归因建议。局限性：仅基于单一任务（Blender场景）、单一LLM（Claude）。该研究对RLHF、交互式AI Agent设计有重要启示。原文链接：https://arxiv.org/pdf/2603.26942v1.pdf，代码已开源。

arxiv.title: The Observability Gap: Why Output-Level Human Feedback Fails for LLM Coding Agents
arxiv.abstract: Large language model (LLM) multi-agent coding systems typically fix agent capabilities at design time. We study an alternative setting, earned autonomy, in which a coding agent starts with zero pre-defined functions and incrementally builds a reusable function library through lightweight human feedback on visual output alone. We evaluate this setup in a Blender-based 3D scene generation task requiring both spatial reasoning and programmatic geometric control. Although the agent rediscovered core utility functions comparable to a human reference implementation, it achieved 0% full-scene success under output-only feedback across multiple instruction granularities, where success required satisfying object completeness, ground contact, collision avoidance, and scale plausibility simultaneously. Our analysis identifies a structural observability gap: bugs originate in code logic and execution state, while human evaluation occurs only at the output layer, and the many-to-one mapping from internal states to visible outcomes prevents symptom-level feedback from reliably identifying root causes. This mismatch leads to persistent failure mode oscillation rather than convergence. papers.report_title: 新国立*MIT 发布 EvoArena:Agent在动态环境平均仅39.6%准确率,EvoMem用「类Git记忆补丁」破局
papers.summary: 新国立与MIT提出EvoArena评测套件和EvoMem记忆方法。EvoArena将终端工作流、软件仓库和用户偏好改造成版本演化链，三大子集分别为Terminal-Bench-Evo（441实例，平均5步）、SWE-Chain-Evo（493链步，平均10步）、PersonaMem-Evo（505题，每对话17.47万token）。当前Agent在EvoArena上平均step accuracy仅39.6%，chain accuracy更低（Terminal-Bench-Evo仅21.5%）。EvoMem采用类Git的patch历史记录记忆变更，按需检索，平均step accuracy提升1.5%（如Terminal-Bench-Evo从43.6%到46.0%），chain accuracy提升3.7%（从21.5%到27.6%）。在GAIA上平均+6.5%，LoCoMo上+3.3%。机制分析显示：patch被“执行化”才有效，软件回归率降低2.77%，偏好任务时序轨迹题提升5.2%。论文公开了代码、数据集和项目网站。

arxiv.title: EvoArena: Tracking Memory Evolution for Robust LLM Agents in Dynamic Environments
arxiv.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents have achieved strong performance on a wide range of benchmarks, yet most evaluations assume static environments. In contrast, real-world deployment is inherently dynamic, requiring agents to continually align their knowledge, skills, and behavior with changing environments and updated task conditions. To address this gap, we introduce EvoArena, a benchmark suite that models environment changes as sequences of progressive updates across terminal, software, and social domains. We further propose EvoMem, a patch-based memory paradigm that records memory evolution as structured update histories, enabling agents to reason about environmental evolution through changes in their memory. Experiments show that current agents struggle on EvoArena, achieving an average accuracy of 39.6% across evolving terminal, software, and social-preference domains. EvoMem consistently improves performance, yielding an average gain of 1.5% on EvoArena and also improving standard benchmarks such as GAIA and LoCoMo by 6.1% and 4.8%. Beyond individual tasks, EvoMem further improves chain-level accuracy by 3.7% on EvoArena, where success requires completing a consecutive sequence of related evolutionary subtasks. Mechanistic analysis shows that EvoMem improves evidence capture in the memory, indicating better preservation of complete evolving environment states. Our results

papers.report_title: NEWTON:从「等物理涌现」到「请牛顿进工具箱」,Agent驱动的视频生成新范式
papers.summary: 浙江大学等机构提出NEWTON框架，将Agent范式引入视频生成以提升物理一致性。核心思想：不是等待物理规律从大模型中涌现，而是通过Agent规划工具调用来显式补全物理信息。框架包含Planner（可训练，基于Flow-GRPO优化）、Executor（调用关键帧生成、科学计算、提示优化等工具）和Verifier（生成后评估物理合理性并反馈）。工具库覆盖动态关键帧边界、Python数值计算（轨迹、动量守恒等）、材料属性重写。实验在VideoPhy-2上：接入LTX-Video时联合准确率从21.4%提升至29.7%，接入Veo-3.1时从30.7%提升至37.4%。底层视频生成器保持冻结，仅训练Planner。案例展示：倒酒时液面逐步升高、刀刻木头出现凹槽和木屑、吹泡泡时泡泡飘动、LEGO传球时受力反弹等，基线模型则出现“动作发生但世界状态不变”。论文指出纯文本prompt信息严重不足，NEWTON通过显式补全物理参数和闭环修正，显著改善因果动态呈现，为“世界模拟器”提供了一条务实路径。

arxiv.title: NEWTON: Agentic Planning for Physically Grounded Video Generation
arxiv.abstract: Video generation models produce visually compelling results but systematically violate physical commonsense -- on VideoPhy-2, the best model achieves only 32.6% joint accuracy. We identify a specification bottleneck: text prompts are lossy compression of the physical world, omitting the parameters that fully determine dynamics, and no amount of model scaling can recover what was never specified. From this diagnosis we derive three properties that physics conditioning must satisfy -- sufficiency, dynamism, and verifiability -- and show that no existing approach satisfies all three. We present NEWTON, in which video generation is demoted from the system output to one action inside an agent's toolbox: a learned planner orchestrates physics-aware tools (keyframe generation, scientific computation, prompt refinement) to construct rich conditioning, and a verifier closes the loop for iterative re-planning. The planner is the sole trainable component, optimized on-policy via Flow-GRPO inside the live multi-turn loop. On VideoPhy-2, NEWTON improves joint accuracy from 21.4% to 29.7% on LTX-Video and from 30.7% to 37.4% on Veo-3.1, without modifying either generator. Our project page: https://Newton026.github.io/newton

papers.summary: 来自东方理工、香港理工大学、上海交通大学、香港科技大学（广州）的研究团队发表论文，揭示大模型后训练中四种看似不同的范式——SFT、DAgger、离线RL、OPD——实际上对应一张2×2表格的四个格子，由两个正交维度解耦得到：prefix来源（教师轨迹 vs 学生轨迹）和KL方向（forward KL → SFT式梯度；reverse KL → REINFORCE式梯度）。论文使用Qwen3-4B/8B教师、Qwen3-0.6B学生，在DeepScaleR上训练，AIME24、MATH500等基准上评测。关键发现：1）reverse KL在standalone蒸馏中Avg@k平均高+2.45分，但导致熵崩塌和响应长度膨胀；2）蒸馏后接RL时，reverse KL checkpoint因熵枯竭无法探索，精度被forward KL反超；3）学生prefix（on-policy）质量更高但FLOPs成本更高，教师prefix可复用离线轨迹更经济；4）长序列蒸馏精度高但放大熵崩塌，短序列稳定但精度有限。论文提出两个实用方法：KL mixing（需足量forward权重，如≥0.8）在保熵的同时维持精度；Entropy-gated长度课程，用预测熵实时控制训练长度上限，相比固定4096-token训练，Avg@k提升3.6分，Pass@k最高提升5.8分，响应长度缩短约3倍。论文链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16826。

arxiv.title: Decoupling KL and Trajectories: A Unified Perspective for SFT, DAgger, Offline RL, and OPD in LLM Distillation
arxiv.abstract: Knowledge distillation is central to LLM post-training, yet its design space remains poorly understood, especially alongside reinforcement learning (RL). We show that the prevailing paradigms, off-policy distillation and on-policy distillation (OPD), implicitly couple two orthogonal choices: prefix source and token-level KL direction. This follows from decomposing sequence-level KL over autoregressive response distributions: forward KL pairs teacher prefixes with token-level forward KL, and reverse KL pairs student prefixes with token-level reverse KL. We argue this coupling is not intrinsic: decoupling the two axes yields four valid objectives. We establish gradient-level identities showing forward KL gives SFT-style cross-entropy matching with teacher soft targets, whereas reverse KL gives an RL-style policy-gradient objective with a dense teacher-student log-ratio reward, connecting them to off-policy SFT, DAgger-style on-policy SFT, offline-RL-style distillation, and OPD. We conduct an extensive controlled study on math reasoning, evaluating the four objectives both as standalone methods and as initializations for subsequent RL. The results reveal three tradeoffs: KL direction induces an accuracy-entropy tradeoff, prefix source a quality-compute tradeoff, and training length an accuracy-stability tradeoff. papers.report_title: 论文笔记|大模型会读几何代码吗?GeoGramBench 揭示“程序到空间推理”的短板 2026 ICLR
papers.summary: 本文是一篇针对ICLR 2026论文《GEOGRAMBENCH: BENCHMARKING THE GEOMETRIC PROGRAM REASONING IN MODERN LLMS》的深度技术笔记。研究聚焦于大语言模型是否真正具备从程序化绘图代码（如Asymptote）中恢复几何图形结构并进行推理的能力。作者系统定义了Program-to-Geometry任务，并构建了GeoGramBench基准数据集：从NuminaMath-1.5、HARP、OmniMATH共约905K道题中，通过[asy]标签筛选出9,260道含代码题，经8-gram去重至1,782道，再经GPT-4o分类和两轮人工清洗（4位专家参与），最终获得392道高质量题目，并额外加入AIME24、MATH-500、MathVerse改写题，总计500道程序化几何推理题。数据集特别处理了代码中坐标、半径等数值泄露问题。论文提出三层几何复杂度分类：Primitive Recognition（基础图元识别）、Local Relation Composition（局部关系组合）、Global Abstract Integration（全局抽象整合），用于定位模型在几何结构理解上的具体瓶颈。实验评测了19个主流模型，发现在MATH-500和AIME24上，模型在普通文本题上表现较好，但一旦加入几何绘图代码，准确率明显下降。失败模式包括：过度依赖代数、不会加辅助线、方向关系混淆、符号与图形元素映射错误等。该研究为评估和提升LLM在程序化几何推理方面的能力提供了关键基准和诊断工具。

arxiv.title: GeoGramBench: Benchmarking the Geometric Program Reasoning in Modern LLMs
arxiv.abstract: Geometric spatial reasoning forms the foundation of many applications in artificial intelligence, yet the ability of large language models (LLMs) to operate over geometric spatial information expressed in procedural code remains underexplored. In this paper, we address this gap by formalizing the Program-to-Geometry task, which challenges models to translate programmatic drawing code into accurate and abstract geometric reasoning. To evaluate this capability, we present GeoGramBench, a benchmark of 500 carefully refined problems organized by a tailored three-level taxonomy that considers geometric complexity rather than traditional mathematical reasoning complexity. Our comprehensive evaluation of 17 frontier LLMs reveals consistent and pronounced deficiencies: even the most advanced models achieve less than 50% accuracy at the highest abstraction level. These results highlight the unique challenges posed by program-driven spatial reasoning and establish GeoGramBench as a valuable resource for advancing research in symbolic-to-spatial geometric reasoning. Project page: https://github.com/LiAuto-DSR/GeoGramBench.

papers.summary: 本文深入解读了Stanford、Harvard、MIT、Anthropic等机构合作的论文《Why Larger Models Learn More: Effects of Capacity, Interference, and Rare-Task Retention》。核心贡献在于揭示了大规模模型优势不止源于表达能力和样本效率，更源于对低频复杂任务信号的保留能力。论文通过合成多任务回归实验和OLMo预训练验证，量化了模型容量、任务频率与梯度干扰的关系。关键发现：模型宽度增加后，常见任务残差下降，其对参数的梯度拉力减弱，使稀有任务信号在多次低频观测间得以累积。OLMo实验训练了4M、20M、300M、1B、4B五个档位模型，注入低频比较任务TCMP和模加任务TADD，结果显示大模型在低频任务上测试准确率显著高于小模型，且任务特征更清晰出现在内部表示中。论文还指出数据扩展可弥补部分差距，但另一部分必须依赖模型扩展。这一结论对理解scaling law的深层机制、指导数据配比调整和训练策略设计具有重要价值。值得关注的具体数据：合成实验中模型宽度跨过阈值后稀有任务准确率从接近随机跃升至显著；OLMo 4B模型在低频注入任务上的准确率远高于小模型。对于研究人员，本文提供了一个关于“更新-遗忘循环”的新视角，提示记忆可能不是副作用，而是跨batch累积信号的前提。

arxiv.title: Why Larger Models Learn More: Effects of Capacity, Interference, and Rare-Task Retention
arxiv.abstract: Larger models learn tasks smaller models do not. What drives this phenomenon? We develop a simple phenomenological argument that power-law scaling already suggests that a larger model will be able to learn a part of the data distribution that a smaller model fails to learn, even with infinite training data. To validate this claim and identify its causes, we study the effects of model scaling on a synthetic setup consisting of a mixture of tasks that show monotonic scaling curves. The results point to a data-induced competition over resources (neurons). Specifically, smaller models allocate their neurons to high frequency or low complexity tasks, and so they learn solutions that perform poorly on rare and complex tasks. Moreover, this happens even when solutions capable of expressing the desired task exist. We then assess how a larger model circumvents this data-centric bottleneck, finding that it traces to a reduced interference mechanism: larger models can allocate enough resources to common tasks that the gradient updates for those tasks become weak, which means that they do not overwrite rare-task features as they slowly accumulate. Finally, to further validate these claims, we pretrain OLMo models (4M to 4B parameters) on novel tasks of varying frequency and complexity. papers.report_title: AgiBot World 全解析:从百万轨迹到 GO-1 的具身智能数据生态
papers.summary: 本文全面解析了 AgiBot World 具身智能数据生态，这是一个覆盖数据集、基础模型、基准测试与工具链的全栈式机器人学习平台。数据集方面，Beta 版包含超过 100 万条轨迹，由 100 台机器人采集，总时长 2976.4 小时，覆盖 100+ 个真实世界场景和 200+ 种任务类型，涉及 87 类原子技能（如系扎、开罐、削皮等）。AgiBot World 2026 版则转向 100% 真实世界采集，并采用数字孪生技术实现真实-仿真配对，同时兼容 LeRobot v2.1 格式。模型方面，开源了在数据集上预训练的 GO-1（含 Latent Planner）和轻量版 GO-1 Air（去掉规划器），均为 VLA（Vision-Language-Action）模型。此外还包括 AgiBot World Challenge 基准竞赛和基于 HuggingFace LeRobot 的工具链。该技术报告获得 IROS 2025 最佳论文奖入围，并被 IEEE TRO 2026 收录。对于研究人员而言，该生态解决了具身智能领域高质量数据稀缺和难以复用的核心瓶颈，提供了从数据采集到模型训练的全链路开源方案，特别适合希望快速进入机器人操作研究的团队。
report_titles: AgiBot World 全解析:从百万轨迹到 GO-1 的具身智能数据生态

arxiv.title: AgiBot World Colosseo: A Large-scale Manipulation Platform for Scalable and Intelligent Embodied Systems
arxiv.abstract: We explore how scalable robot data can address real-world challenges for generalized robotic manipulation. Introducing AgiBot World, a large-scale platform comprising over 1 million trajectories across 217 tasks in five deployment scenarios, we achieve an order-of-magnitude increase in data scale compared to existing datasets. Accelerated by a standardized collection pipeline with human-in-the-loop verification, AgiBot World guarantees high-quality and diverse data distribution. It is extensible from grippers to dexterous hands and visuo-tactile sensors for fine-grained skill acquisition. Building on top of data, we introduce Genie Operator-1 (GO-1), a novel generalist policy that leverages latent action representations to maximize data utilization, demonstrating predictable performance scaling with increased data volume. Policies pre-trained on our dataset achieve an average performance improvement of 30% over those trained on Open X-Embodiment, both in in-domain and out-of-distribution scenarios. GO-1 exhibits exceptional capability in real-world dexterous and long-horizon tasks, achieving over 60% success rate on complex tasks and outperforming prior RDT approach by 32%. By open-sourcing the dataset, tools, and models, we aim to democratize access to large-scale, high-quality robot data, advancing the pursuit of scalable and general-purpose intelligence.

papers.title: SeedER: Seed-and-Expand Retrieval from Knowledge Graphs
papers.report_title: GraphRAG进化了,SeedER用上了结构探索
papers.summary: 该文解读论文《SeedER: Seed-and-Expand Retrieval from Knowledge Graphs》（arXiv:2605.23753）。论文针对知识图谱检索中“正确答案与问题文本不相似但存在关系路径”的难题，提出 SeedER 轻量级第一阶段检索器。核心思路：先用 dense retriever 找到 k0 个语义锚点（seed），再通过 K-hop-with-filtering 将搜索空间缩小到 100-200 个节点的子图，然后用 query-conditioned GNN + RL policy 进行多步扩展（learned expansion），最后用 scoring head 排序。训练采用 group-centered REINFORCE（Recall@Any 奖励）结合 BPR loss。在 STARK 三个基准上，使用 MiniLM 编码器时 SeedER 的 Hit@1 从 dense retriever 的 0.101 提升至 0.199，Hit@5 从 0.218 提升至 0.411，Recall@20 从 0.259 提升至 0.461。使用更强编码器（OpenAI ada-002 和 Qwen3-Embedding-4B）仍有显著增益，例如 Qwen3 时 Hit@1 达 0.310（对比 dense 的 0.154）。模型仅 1.1M 可训练参数，约为 8B LLM agent 方法的 1/8000，速度快数十倍但 Recall@20 已具竞争力。SeedER 被定位为低预算高召回的第一阶段检索器，可配合下游 reranker 或 LLM 推理，为 GraphRAG 提供结构化路径补充。
report_titles: GraphRAG进化了,SeedER用上了结构探索

arxiv.title: SeedER: Seed-and-Expand Retrieval from Knowledge Graphs
arxiv.abstract: Knowledge graphs (KGs) offer a rich representation for relational knowledge, but their irregular structure makes retrieval challenging: ego-graph expansion grows rapidly, and dense embedding methods struggle with multi-hop compositional queries. Existing agent-based graph exploration approaches, while expressive, are often too expensive for large-scale retrieval. We introduce SeedER (Seed-and-Expand Retrieval), a retrieval framework that explicitly leverages KG structure through iterative, low-cost expansion. SeedER first seeds a compact set of core nodes using lightweight dense and entity-based retrieval, then selectively expands this set via a learned graph-aware policy trained with reinforcement learning. This design decomposes global reasoning into reusable local decisions, enabling efficient discovery of query-relevant nodes while tightly controlling expansion cost. We show theoretical limitations of dense retrieval on compositional graph queries, and establish advantages of SeedER from both compositional generalization and graph-constrained submodular optimization perspectives. Empirically, SeedER substantially improves recall with compact candidate sets over strong dense and graph-augmented baselines, making it an effective first-stage retriever for knowledge-intensive reasoning systems.

papers.title: StepPRM-RTL: Stepwise Process-Reward Guided LLM Fine-Tuning for Enhanced RTL Synthesis
papers.report_title: RTL 生成不缺答案,缺的是过程监督
papers.summary: 文章围绕arXiv论文StepPRM-RTL展开技术解读，核心观点：大模型生成RTL的真正瓶颈不在于产出代码，而在于中间设计过程是否可监督、可解释、可纠偏。该论文提出一个包含分步轨迹建模、过程奖励模型（PRM）、RAFT微调与MCTS搜索的统一框架。具体而言，它将标准RTL解法拆解为设计步骤序列（如定义接口、处理状态寄存器、reset、状态转移等），并利用PRM对每一步进行中间评分，而非仅奖励最终测试结果。通过MCTS探索多条设计路径，再将优质轨迹用于强化学习训练。论文摘要称，该方法在Verilog和VHDL基准测试中，功能正确性与推理一致性指标相比此前最佳方法提升超过10%。文章深入对比了RTL生成与通用代码生成（如Python、JavaScript）的本质差异：RTL错误会被综合、仿真、形式验证、时序分析层层放大，而PRM通过将监督点前移，使模型在早期步骤就能暴露偏航。文章同时冷静指出了工业化落地的四道坎：公开benchmark与真实企业代码库差异、PRM训练依赖高质量设计轨迹（难以获取）、缺少与EDA工具链的验证闭环、责任边界模糊。总体而言，StepPRM-RTL将AI+EDA从“答案生成”推向“过程可控”，是RTL生成迈向可生产环境的重要研究方向。
report_titles: RTL 生成不缺答案,缺的是过程监督

arxiv.title: StepPRM-RTL: Stepwise Process-Reward Guided LLM Fine-Tuning for Enhanced RTL Synthesis
arxiv.abstract: Automatic generation of RTL code for digital hardware designs remains challenging due to long-horizon reasoning, multi-step dependencies, and strict correctness constraints in Verilog and VHDL. We present StepPRM-RTL, a novel framework that combines stepwise trajectory modeling, process-reward modeling (PRM), and retrieval-augmented fine-tuning (RAFT) to enhance both the functional correctness and reasoning fidelity of LLM-based RTL code generation. StepPRM-RTL constructs stepwise reasoning trajectories from canonical solutions, where each step contains a rationale and incremental code modification. A Process Reward Model (PRM) evaluates intermediate steps, providing dense feedback that guides reinforcement-style updates during RAFT fine-tuning. Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) explores alternative reasoning paths, enriching the training dataset with high-quality trajectories. This integration of stepwise and outcome-aware rewards allows the model to learn both how and why to construct correct RTL, improving long-horizon reasoning beyond standard supervised or outcome-based training. Experimental evaluation on benchmark Verilog and VHDL datasets demonstrates that StepPRM-RTL outperforms the best prior methods by over 10\% in functional correctness and reasoning fidelity metrics.
