papers.title: DeepSeek-OCR 2: Visual Causal Flow
papers.report_title: DeepSeek重磅发布新论文、新模型(附下载)!
papers.summary: DeepSeek团队开源DeepSeek-OCR 2并发布同名论文《DeepSeek-OCR 2: Visual Causal Flow》。核心创新DeepEncoder V2编码器：用Qwen2-0.5B语言模型替代传统CLIP，引入“可学习的因果流查询”实现语义驱动的视觉token重排序，并通过双流注意力机制兼顾全局感知与因果顺序。在OmniDocBench v1.5文档理解基准上整体准确率达91.09%，较前代提升3.73个百分点；阅读顺序编辑距离从0.085降至0.057，降幅33%。视觉token数量控制在256-1120之间，上限与Gemini-3 Pro相当，远低于其他模型常见的6000+ tokens，大幅降低后续计算负担。实际生产环境重复率显著下降：在线用户日志从6.25%降至4.17%，PDF预训练数据从3.69%降至2.88%，验证了架构的稳定性。论文验证了用语言模型架构做多模态编码器的可行性，为原生多模态智能提供了路径：通过为不同模态配置对应的“智能查询员”，可在同一框架下统一处理图像、语音、文本。未来方向包括更复杂的多跳推理场景和更长因果流序列。
report_titles: DeepSeek重磅发布新论文、新模型(附下载)!

arxiv.title: DeepSeek-OCR 2: Visual Causal Flow
arxiv.abstract: We present DeepSeek-OCR 2 to investigate the feasibility of a novel encoder-DeepEncoder V2-capable of dynamically reordering visual tokens upon image semantics. Conventional vision-language models (VLMs) invariably process visual tokens in a rigid raster-scan order (top-left to bottom-right) with fixed positional encoding when fed into LLMs. However, this contradicts human visual perception, which follows flexible yet semantically coherent scanning patterns driven by inherent logical structures. Particularly for images with complex layouts, human vision exhibits causally-informed sequential processing. Inspired by this cognitive mechanism, DeepEncoder V2 is designed to endow the encoder with causal reasoning capabilities, enabling it to intelligently reorder visual tokens prior to LLM-based content interpretation. This work explores a novel paradigm: whether 2D image understanding can be effectively achieved through two-cascaded 1D causal reasoning structures, thereby offering a new architectural approach with the potential to achieve genuine 2D reasoning. Codes and model weights are publicly accessible at http://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-OCR-2.

papers.title: The DAWN of World-Action Interactive Models
papers.report_title: 这篇新论文,可能把世界模型往“可行动”推进了一步
papers.summary: 本文解读了arXiv上的一篇新论文（链接：https://arxiv.org/pdf/2605.11550），提出了World-Action Interactive Models (WAIM)及其具体实现方法DAWN。核心创新在于将世界预测与动作生成构建成一个推理阶段反复互相修正的闭环，而非传统的并行或串行方式。DAWN包含两个核心模块：World Predictor（预测世界变化）和World-Conditioned Action Denoiser（生成动作）。两者通过迭代交互：先提出初步动作方案，根据该方案推演未来世界，再根据更新后的未来修正动作，如此循环直至得到合理轨迹。为避免在像素空间完整渲染未来的高成本，DAWN采用在压缩后的潜在语义空间（latent space）中进行短距离推演（short rollout），仅推演对决策最有帮助的一段未来。论文在自动驾驶场景中展示了效果，Figure 4的定性结果显示生成轨迹更贴近人类驾驶行为。作者在limitations中指出，WAIM的设定不适用于所有简单场景，缺乏形式化收敛性与安全保证，长期程多主体场景可能不足，且解释性较弱。总体而言，该工作推进了世界模型从“被动预测未来”向“带着动作主动推演未来”的方向演进，使世界模型更接近决策模型，对具身智能领域有重要启发意义。
report_titles: 这篇新论文,可能把世界模型往“可行动”推进了一步

arxiv.title: The DAWN of World-Action Interactive Models
arxiv.abstract: A plausible scene evolution depends on the maneuver being considered, while a good maneuver depends on how the scene may evolve. Existing World Action Models (WAMs) largely miss this reciprocity, treating world prediction and action generation as either isolated parallel branches or rigid predict-then-plan pipelines. We formalize this perspective as World-Action Interactive Models (WAIMs), and instantiate it in autonomous driving with \textbf{DAWN} (\textbf{D}enoising \textbf{A}ctions and \textbf{W}orld i\textbf{N}teractive model), a simple yet strong latent generative baseline. DAWN operates in a compact semantic latent space and couples a \emph{World Predictor} with a \emph{World-Conditioned Action Denoiser}: the predicted world hypothesis conditions action denoising, while the denoised action hypothesis is fed back to update the world prediction, so that both are recursively refined during inference. Rather than eliminating test-time world evolution altogether or rolling out the full future in pixel space, DAWN performs a short explicit latent rollout that is sufficient to support long-horizon trajectory generation in complex interactive scenes. Experiments show that DAWN achieves strong planning performance and favorable safety-related results across multiple autonomous driving benchmarks. papers.title: Semantic Level of Detail for Knowledge Graphs: Discovering Abstraction Boundaries via Spectral Heat Diffusion
papers.report_title: Graph被颠覆了,SLoD给GraphRAG上了语义变焦
papers.summary: 该文解读论文《Semantic Level of Detail for Knowledge Graphs: Discovering Abstraction Boundaries via Spectral Heat Diffusion》（arXiv:2603.08965）。现有 GraphRAG 系统依赖固定分辨率的社区检测（如 Leiden 算法），难以适应不同语义粒度的需求。SLoD 提出基于热核扩散（heat kernel diffusion）的连续尺度参数 σ，将知识图谱节点嵌入到 Poincaré ball 双曲空间，通过 graph Laplacian 的指数函数 exp(-σL) 实现从局部细节到全局主题的平滑缩放，并用加权 Fréchet mean 得到各尺度下的语义中心表示。BoundaryScan 方法利用 representation velocity、weight divergence 和 neighborhood churn 三个信号自动检测语义层级边界。实验一：在合成层级图（HSBM，1024节点，3层）上，σ 增大时有效维度 K*(σ) 依次穿过 macro/meso/micro 层级，高信噪比下 macro ARI 达 1.00，meso ARI 达 0.89。实验二：在 WordNet 名词层次（82K synsets）上，BoundaryScan 检测到的尺度边界与真实 taxonomy depth 的 Kendall τ 达 0.79。该方法为 GraphRAG 和 Agent 记忆系统提供了一种可导航的抽象层级控制机制，便于根据任务选择最佳语义粒度。

arxiv.title: Semantic Level of Detail for Knowledge Graphs: Discovering Abstraction Boundaries via Spectral Heat Diffusion
arxiv.abstract: Graph-structured knowledge systems -- from knowledge graphs to GraphRAG pipelines -- organize information into hierarchical communities, yet lack a principled mechanism for continuous resolution control: where do the qualitative boundaries between abstraction levels lie, and how should an agent navigate them? Current approaches rely on discrete community detection with manually tuned resolution parameters (e.g., Leiden $γ$), offering no continuous zoom and no formal guarantees. We introduce Semantic Level of Detail (SLoD), a framework that addresses both problems by defining a continuous zoom operator via heat kernel diffusion on a graph Laplacian whose kNN structure is induced by a Poincare-ball embedding. We prove hierarchical coherence in the tree limit (exact tree with Sarkar embedding), with bounded approximation error, and demonstrate consistent boundary-detection behaviour on noisy hierarchies; spectral gaps in the graph Laplacian then induce emergent scale boundaries -- scales where the representation undergoes qualitative transitions -- detectable without manual resolution tuning. papers.title: CASS-RTL: Correctness-Aware Subspace Steering for RTL Generation with LLMs
papers.report_title: AI 写 RTL,开始动模型内部了
papers.summary: 本文解读arXiv论文《CASS-RTL: Correctness-Aware Subspace Steering for RTL Generation with LLMs》，探讨从模型内部干预RTL生成的方向。与外部验证后纠错或过程监督不同，CASS-RTL通过分析正确/错误样本下attention head激活分布的差异，筛选与RTL功能正确性高度相关的注意力头，并压缩到低维子空间，在推理时做轻量steering干预，无需重训练。关键性能数据：在VerilogEval基准上，QwenCoder 2.5 14B的功能正确性从Base的37.1/44.8/50.6（pass@1/5/10）提升至48.7/52.5/56.4，提升10%-20%；面向RTL微调的CodeV从53.2/65.1/68.5提升至62.8/70.0/73.7。在更难的数据集CVDP上，QwenCoder 14B从10.2/11.5/14.1提升至16.6/19.2/20.5，CodeV从5.1/6.4/6.4提升至8.9/8.9/10.2，提升约5%。遮蔽实验证明，遮蔽关键头后功能正确性下降显著大于随机遮蔽，因果信号明确。该方向为AI+EDA提供了“模型内可解释、可干预”的新思路，但需注意benchmark提升不直接等于真实芯片可交付质量。论文公开于arXiv:2606.05680v1。

arxiv.title: CASS-RTL: Correctness-Aware Subspace Steering for RTL Generation with LLMs
arxiv.abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled the automatic synthesis (generation) of register-transfer level (RTL) code from natural language instructions, offering a promising pathway to accelerate chip design. Unlike typical natural language (and software coding) tasks, LLM-based RTL code generation demands strict cycle accuracy with concurrency, where minor logical errors can render a circuit unusable or insecure. While prior work has explored hallucination mitigation via external verification, self-evaluation prompts, retrieval-augmented prompting, domain specific fine-tuning, agentic solutions, and reasoning, these approaches largely overlook the attention-oriented internal mechanisms of LLMs that may inherently correlate with RTL correctness. This work proposes CASS-RTL, a first-of-its-kind framework for discovering and leveraging LLMs' correctness-aware components to guide RTL generation toward functionally accurate outputs. We (i) identify attention heads whose activation patterns consistently differentiate correct from incorrect RTL; (ii) construct a low-dimensional subspace capturing correctness-relevant signals; and (iii) design a lightweight, geometry-aware intervention that steers the model at inference time. papers.title: OpenSkill: Open-World Self-Evolution for LLM Agents
papers.report_title: Lehigh+Salesforce联手:OpenSkill让Agent仅凭一句提示,在开放世界里自己进化
papers.summary: Lehigh University与Salesforce AI Research联合提出OpenSkill，针对LLM Agent在开放世界中的自我进化问题。核心设定是Agent仅凭一句话任务提示，无需任何标注数据、预存技能或成功轨迹，即可从文档、代码库和网页中自学可迁移技能，并通过自建的虚拟验证器迭代优化。在SkillsBench的11个领域84个任务上，OpenSkill在Claude Opus 4.6上达到43.6%的平均通过率，GPT 5.2上为42.1%，分别比最强closed-world基线高出8.9和8.8个百分点，距离人工curated skill的上限44.5%仅差0.9个百分点。在SocialMaze和ScienceWorld上同样全面领先。技术方案分三阶段：开放世界知识获取（使用Gemini Deep Research agent异步检索）、无泄漏skill进化（通过虚拟验证器生成proxy test suite，覆盖88.9%的GT测试意图）、零样本目标评估。Key亮点包括：虚拟验证器与ground-truth的agreement rate为60.7%，统计显著（Fisher's exact test OR=2.97, p=0.035）；每个任务中位数测试function数量比GT suite多3.4倍；消融实验显示3轮refine为最优迭代数，开放世界查询（DR）和虚拟验证器（VV）互补。论文还验证了skill的跨模型迁移性：Opus 4.6上生成的skill直接部署到Haiku 4.5等弱模型，平均reward提升5.5%。整体上，OpenSkill是首个同时满足可扩展、有grounding、无监督三个条件的开放世界自进化Agent框架。
papers.authors: Lehigh University、University of Illinois Chicago、Salesforce AI Research
report_titles: Lehigh+Salesforce联手:OpenSkill让Agent仅凭一句提示,在开放世界里自己进化

arxiv.title: OpenSkill: Open-World Self-Evolution for LLM Agents
arxiv.abstract: Self-evolving agents requires adaptation after deployment, but existing approaches assume a usable learning loop, such as curated skills, successful trajectories, or verifier signals. Real open-world deployments may provide none of these, offering only a task prompt. In this work, we study open-world self-evolution, where an agent must build both its skills and its own verification signals from scratch, using open-world resources but no target-task supervision. We propose OpenSkill, a framework that bootstraps this loop: it acquires grounded knowledge and verification anchors from documentation, repositories, and the web, synthesizes them into transferable skills, and refines those skills against self-built virtual tasks grounded in the anchors rather than in target answers. The open world thus supplies both the knowledge to be learned and a supervision-independent practice environment, with target-task supervision reserved for final evaluation. Across three benchmarks and two target agents, OpenSkill attains the best automated pass rate while satisfying the no-supervision constraint. Analysis shows its skills transfer across models without model-specific adaptation, and its self-built verifier aligns with ground-truth outcomes despite never accessing them.

papers.title: PaperFlow: Profiling, Recommending, and Adapting Across Daily Paper Streams
papers.report_title: 上海AI Lab等提出PaperFlow:把论文推荐做成每日科研阅读闭环,行为对齐提升111%
papers.summary: 上海AI Lab提出PaperFlow，将个性化论文推荐建模为每日闭环推荐系统。核心思路是从冷启动构建结构化、可编辑的学术画像（包括研究方向、主题权重、作者/机构先验等），每日从arXiv冻结候选池中选出Top-20论文，并通过多信号排序（语义匹配+先验+动态行为+必读规则）生成推荐。框架包含三个紧耦合阶段：Profiling（结构化画像构建）、Recommending（多信号聚合排序）、Adapting（兴趣适应，区分强/弱信号并支持漂移追踪）。在自建纵向评测基准（24个模拟研究者、50天、1200个user-day episode）上，PaperFlow相对最强外部基线Scholar Inbox实现显著提升：gNDCG@20从39.00提升至50.65（+29.9%），SelectedNDCG@20从33.47提升至70.88（+111.8%），HumanEval从55.56提升至65.56（+18.0%）。兴趣漂移专项分析显示，漂移模块有效降低新方向适应延迟（AdaptDelay最短）、提高新主题召回（NewTopicRecall@20最高），同时保持与后续阅读行为的一致性。LLM骨干对比表明默认Gemini 3 Flash表现均衡，Grok 4.3在闭源组中RecommendationScore最高（56.31）且token成本最低，自动评测与人工盲评高度对齐（Pearson r=0.9632）。真实用户试点（5名研究生）中PaperFlow的ReadRate（0.34）是日常arXiv邮件（0.18）的近2倍，满意度4.0/5.0。论文同时开源了代码、数据与基准。
report_titles: 上海AI Lab等提出PaperFlow:把论文推荐做成每日科研阅读闭环,行为对齐提升111%

arxiv.title: PaperFlow: Profiling, Recommending, and Adapting Across Daily Paper Streams
arxiv.abstract: Scientific paper recommendation is typically evaluated as static ranking over a fixed candidate set, yet real scientific reading unfolds as a daily, longitudinal process in which interests shift and feedback accumulates. We introduce PaperFlow, a framework that organizes it into three coupled stages: Profiling, which constructs and maintains a structured, inspectable scholarly profile from heterogeneous cold-start evidence; Recommending, which ranks each date-specific paper stream through multi-signal aggregation under a fixed display budget; and Adapting, which updates user state from semantically distinct feedback signals and models interest drift across days. We further define a longitudinal user-day benchmark that fixes users, dates, candidate pools, visible inputs, and hidden simulated relevance labels under a shared temporal information boundary. The benchmark contains 24 simulated research users, 50 daily paper streams, 1,200 user-day episodes, 20,727 unique papers, and 497,448 episode-paper records. We additionally specify a blind human-evaluation protocol to validate alignment between automatic metrics and expert judgments. Experiments against five scientific recommendation baselines show that PaperFlow achieves the strongest oracle-based ranking, the highest behavioral alignment with simulated reading selections, and the best blind human-evaluation score.

papers.report_title: 上海人工智能实验室新论文:不换模型也能变强?MinerU2.5-Pro 把答案藏在样本里
papers.summary: 本文详细介绍上海人工智能实验室的MinerU2.5-Pro文档解析模型（论文链接：https://arxiv.org/pdf/2604.04771）。核心思路是保持1.2B参数架构不变，通过数据工程和训练策略提升性能。在OmniDocBench v1.6 Full上总分达95.69，相比baseline MinerU2.5的92.98提升2.71；Hard subset上94.08，优于GLM-OCR和PaddleOCR-VL-1.5的92.01。数据引擎从<10M扩至65.5M samples/pages，三阶段训练分别贡献1.31、0.96、0.45的增益。关键组件包括DDAS（多样性与难度感知采样）、CMCV（跨模型一致性验证）和Judge-and-Refine（先渲染再验证的标注修正）。论文还改进了评测基准OmniDocBench v1.6以消除元素匹配偏差。

arxiv.title: MinerU2.5-Pro: Pushing the Limits of Data-Centric Document Parsing at Scale
arxiv.abstract: Current document parsing methods advance primarily through model architecture innovation, while systematic engineering of training data remains underexplored. Yet state-of-the-art models spanning diverse architectures and parameter scales exhibit highly consistent failure patterns on the same set of hard samples, suggesting that the performance bottleneck stems from shared deficiencies in training data rather than from architectural differences. Building on this finding, we present MinerU2.5-Pro, which advances the state of the art purely through data engineering and training strategy design while retaining the 1.2B-parameter architecture of MinerU2.5 unchanged. At its core is a Data Engine co-designed around coverage, informativeness, and annotation accuracy: Diversity-and-Difficulty-Aware Sampling expands training data from under 10M to 65.5M samples while mitigating distribution shift; Cross-Model Consistency Verification leverages output consensus among heterogeneous models to assess sample difficulty and generate reliable annotations; the Judge-and-Refine pipeline improves annotation quality for hard samples through render-then-verify iterative correction. A three-stage progressive training strategy--large-scale pre-training, hard sample fine-tuning, and GRPO alignment--sequentially exploits these data at different quality tiers. papers.title: Explaining Data Mixing Scaling Laws
papers.report_title: 用AI重塑物质教育:一篇论文揭示如何让大模型“引经据典”,输出可靠知识
papers.summary: 清华大学IIIS与北京理工大学提出统一理论框架解释多域数据混合中的Scaling Law，论文《Explaining Data Mixing Scaling Laws》从容量竞争与噪声驱动两个机制出发，将单域Scaling Law扩展至多域场景。关键发现：模型有限容量导致各域专属skill争夺资源（容量竞争），而不同skill的学习效果依赖于数据量（噪声驱动），最优配比向难学域倾斜。实验在64个1B参数模型、17域（Pile）上，理论模型以MRE 1.53%、MAE 0.034取得最低误差，仅需5K参数（域数K），远优于最强基线Shukor et al. 2026（约2.21%）。在4域200M/8B规模拟合后外推预测700M/16B最优配比，训练后的模型loss严格优于直接使用小规模配比；7域122M/10B外推到1B/30B，达到用全规模数据拟合的SOTA基线相同loss。该框架证明小规模实验可预测更大规模的最优数据配比，避免昂贵试错。论文地址：https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.08167。

arxiv.title: Explaining Data Mixing Scaling Laws
arxiv.abstract: Recent research has established empirical scaling laws to predict model performance on multi-domain data mixtures. However, a theoretical understanding of these model loss behaviors remains absent. In this work, we propose a unified framework to explain the underlying mechanics of data mixing. Our approach extends theoretical perspectives originally developed for standard neural scaling laws (e.g., Kaplan and Chinchilla) to the multi-domain setting. Based on the distributional assumption that domains overlap on fundamental skills while diverging on specialized skills, we identify two key factors that govern the domain losses of models trained on different data mixtures: \textit{Capacity Competition}, where the allocation of finite model capacity couples domain losses globally, and \textit{Noise Reduction}, where optimal weights shift toward harder-to-learn domains to minimize overall noise. Empirical evaluations show that our framework outperforms existing baselines by fitting the loss landscape with a lower Mean Relative Error and identifying higher-performing training mixtures. Most importantly, our model successfully extrapolates across scales, predicting highly effective mixtures for large, unseen scales using parameters fitted on smaller ones. papers.title: BEAT: Visual Backdoor Attacks on VLM-based Embodied Agents via Contrastive Trigger Learning
papers.report_title: 论文分享 | ICLR'25:针对大语言模型后门非对齐攻击的黑盒防御方法
papers.summary: 本文提出BEAT（Black-box input-level dEtection for LLM backdoor unAlignment aTtacks）方法，针对大语言模型后门非对齐攻击实现黑盒防御。核心发现是探针连接效应：当恶意探针与包含触发器的输入连接时，后门模型对探针的拒绝率显著降低，而正常输入几乎不影响。BEAT通过测量探针在连接前后的输出分布扭曲程度（使用Earth Mover's Distance）来检测触发输入，仅需采样前10个token即可捕捉语义变化。实验覆盖Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3和闭源GPT-3.5-turbo，在多种后门攻击（词级、短语级、长文本触发器及RLHF阶段攻击）下平均AUROC达99.6%，5%假阳性率下真阳性率（TPR@FPR5%）达100%。对比基线方法ONION、Deletion、Paraphrase，其平均AUROC低于90%、TPR@FPR5%低于60%。推理效率方面，BEAT平均每样本0.88秒，优于Deletion（4.02秒）和Paraphrase（0.90秒），且探针结果可预缓存。鲁棒性实验中，即使仅毒化10个样本，AUROC仍超99%；针对句法级高级攻击，AUROC达93.7%（使用3个探针提升至96.5%），显著优于基线最高75.8%。此外，BEAT对越狱攻击也有效，平均AUROC超96%。论文已被ICLR 2025接收，为LLM安全对齐的后门防御提供了新范式。
report_titles: 论文分享 | ICLR'25:针对大语言模型后门非对齐攻击的黑盒防御方法

arxiv.title: BEAT: Visual Backdoor Attacks on VLM-based Embodied Agents via Contrastive Trigger Learning
arxiv.abstract: Recent advances in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have propelled embodied agents by enabling direct perception, reasoning, and planning task-oriented actions from visual inputs. However, such vision-driven embodied agents open a new attack surface: visual backdoor attacks, where the agent behaves normally until a visual trigger appears in the scene, then persistently executes an attacker-specified multi-step policy. We introduce BEAT, the first framework to inject such visual backdoors into VLM-based embodied agents using objects in the environments as triggers. Unlike textual triggers, object triggers exhibit wide variation across viewpoints and lighting, making them difficult to implant reliably. BEAT addresses this challenge by (1) constructing a training set that spans diverse scenes, tasks, and trigger placements to expose agents to trigger variability, and (2) introducing a two-stage training scheme that first applies supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and then our novel Contrastive Trigger Learning (CTL). CTL formulates trigger discrimination as preference learning between trigger-present and trigger-free inputs, explicitly sharpening the decision boundaries to ensure precise backdoor activation. papers.title: Inclusive-PIM: Hardware-Software Co-design for Broad Acceleration on Commercial PIM Architectures
papers.report_title: 商业 PIM 不只加速 AI 矩阵乘:这篇论文告诉我们,存内计算想“通用”,还差什么?
papers.summary: 本文深度解读了发表于商用PIM领域的论文《Hardware-Software Co-design for Broad Acceleration on Commercial PIM Architectures》，系统评估了现有商用PIM（如Samsung HBM-PIM、SK Hynix GDDR-PIM）在加速科学计算、稀疏机器学习、图计算等非ML负载时的瓶颈与优化空间。论文提出PIM-amenability-test，从内存带宽受限、数据驻留、操作数局部性、对齐数据并行四个维度判断程序是否适合PIM。对三个代表性primitive（WaveSim科学计算、Sparse Skinny GEMM、图计算push primitive）的测试表明：baseline商用PIM的平均加速比仅为1.12×（相对GPU），且不同负载表现差异极大（0.23×~1.66×）；而通过architecture-aware row activation（拆分为even/odd bank调度，隐藏行激活延迟）、sparsity-aware PIM（跳过稀疏零值指令）、cache-aware PIM（根据缓存命中率动态决定是否卸载）三类软硬件协同优化，平均加速比提升至2.49×。特别值得关注的是：vector-sum等理想型负载可达2.6×加速，但稀疏图计算push primitive因跨bank随机访问严重，即使优化后仍难以突破2×。论文同时展示了自定义数据布局（dense matrix column-major block映射到多个pseudo-channel）对PIM性能的关键影响，并指出PIM command带宽和寄存器文件大小是实际落地的核心约束。

arxiv.title: Inclusive-PIM: Hardware-Software Co-design for Broad Acceleration on Commercial PIM Architectures
arxiv.abstract: Continual demand for memory bandwidth has made it worthwhile for memory vendors to reassess processing in memory (PIM), which enables higher bandwidth by placing compute units in/near-memory. As such, memory vendors have recently proposed commercially viable PIM designs. However, these proposals are largely driven by the needs of (a narrow set of) machine learning (ML) primitives. While such proposals are reasonable given the the growing importance of ML, as memory is a pervasive component, %in this work, we make there is a case for a more inclusive PIM design that can accelerate primitives across domains. In this work, we ascertain the capabilities of commercial PIM proposals to accelerate various primitives across domains. We first begin with outlining a set of characteristics, termed PIM-amenability-test, which aid in assessing if a given primitive is likely to be accelerated by PIM. Next, we apply this test to primitives under study to ascertain efficient data-placement and orchestration to map the primitives to underlying PIM architecture. We observe here that, even though primitives under study are largely PIM-amenable, existing commercial PIM proposals do not realize their performance potential for these primitives. papers.title: SURF: Signature-Retained Fast Video Generation
papers.report_title: 速递 | 香港大学团队研究证实,非奈利酮可改善卵巢早衰助力生育
papers.summary: 本文报道了香港大学赵衡爽团队与快手可灵团队联合研发的SURF高分辨率视频生成加速框架。该框架通过分阶段、分模块协作（OptimRes→LowRes→HighRes），在预览阶段由基础模型在最优分辨率下确定视频内容与运动方向，随后下采样至低分辨率快速产出预览，最后由参数量约1B的轻量级Refiner模型以少量去噪步补充细节。核心技术创新包括Noise Reshifting技术解决分辨率切换导致的模型适配问题，以及基于10万组高低清视频帧对训练的Refiner实现局部时序建模与跨帧信息联动。实测数据极为亮眼：在Wan2.1 14B模型中生成5秒720p视频，耗时从约58分钟降至278秒（提速约12.58倍），浮点运算量从658.5 PFLOPs降至34.3 PFLOPs；在HunyuanVideo上实现约8.7倍加速；针对1080p场景，对比原生Wan2.1提速约43倍。画质测评显示各维度与原始模型持平甚至更优。SURF还具备插件式通用性，可对接不同基础模型并与AccVideo结合额外提升1.3倍。该框架为高分辨率AI视频生成的成本-质量平衡提供了可复用的范式，相关论文已公开于arXiv:2603.21002。

arxiv.title: SURF: Signature-Retained Fast Video Generation
arxiv.abstract: The demand for high-resolution video generation is growing rapidly. However, the generation resolution is severely constrained by slow inference speeds. For instance, Wan2.1 requires over 50 minutes to generate a single 720p video. While previous works explore accelerating video generation from various aspects, most of them compromise the distinctive signatures (e.g., layout, semantic, motion) of the original model. In this work, we propose SURF, an efficient framework for generating high-resolution videos, while maximally keeping the signatures. Specifically, SURF divides video generation into two stages: First, we leverage the pretrained model to infer at optimal resolution and downsample latent to generate low-resolution previews in fast speed; then we design a Refiner to upscale the preview. In the preview stage, we identify that directly inferring a model (trained with higher resolution) on lower resolution causes severe losses in signatures. So we introduce noise reshifting, a training-free technique that mitigates this issue by conducting initial denoising steps on the original resolution and switching to low resolution in later steps. In the refine stage, we establish a mapping relationship between the preview and the high-resolution target, which significantly reduces the denoising steps. papers.title: Seeing is Coding: On the Effectiveness of Vision Language Models in Code Understanding
papers.report_title: 【ISSTA'26 论文 | 大模型推理成本】把代码截图丢给大模型 居然可以省 token
papers.summary: 本文解读 ISSTA 2026 论文《CodeOCR: On the Effectiveness of Vision Language Models in Code Understanding》，来自上海交通大学、新加坡管理大学、帝国理工学院等。核心发现：将代码以截图形式输入多模态大模型（MLLM），可在多个任务上达到甚至超过文本输入的性能，同时大幅节省 token 成本。在 GPT-5-mini 上，克隆检测 F1 从 33.2 提升至 47.0（+42%），GPT-5.1 从 46.8 升至 62.4（+33%）。图像压缩具有连续可调性，在 8× 压缩（仅 12.5% token）下，Gemini-3-Pro 的代码问答准确率达 79.5%，高于文本基线的 74.8%；2× 压缩时克隆检测 F1 跃升 75%（p<0.01）。语法高亮增强在中低压缩比（1×-4×）下有效，如 GLM-4.6v 补全 ES 从 50.8 升至 53.2。但 Qwen-3-VL 和 GLM-4.6v 在极限压缩下出现“性能悬崖”。论文开源了 CodeOCR 工具，本地转换吞吐量达每秒 6900 token，可支持 IDE 插件实时运行。该工作颠覆了代码只能以文本形式被 AI 消费的假设，表明视觉代码理解在高层语义任务上优势显著，且压缩成本从离散博弈变为连续光谱。论文链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.01785

arxiv.title: Seeing is Coding: On the Effectiveness of Vision Language Models in Code Understanding
arxiv.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success in source code understanding, yet as software systems grow in scale, computational efficiency has become a critical bottleneck. Currently, these models rely on a text-based paradigm that treats source code as a linear sequence of tokens, which leads to a linear increase in context length and associated computational costs. The rapid advancement of Multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) introduces an opportunity to optimize efficiency by representing source code as rendered images. Unlike text, which is difficult to compress without losing semantic meaning, the image modality is inherently suitable for compression. By adjusting resolution, images can be scaled to a fraction of their original token cost while remaining recognizable to vision-capable models. To explore the feasibility of this approach, we conduct the first systematic study on the effectiveness of MLLMs for code understanding. Our experiments reveal that: (1) MLLMs can effectively understand code with substantial token reduction, achieving up to 8x compression; (2) MLLMs can effectively leverage visual cues such as syntax highlighting, improving code completion performance under 4x compression; and (3) Code-understanding tasks like clone detection exhibit exceptional resilience to visual compression, with some compression ratios even slightly outperforming raw text inp

papers.title: CLP: Collocation-Length Prediction for Zero-Loss Adaptive Multi-Token Inference
papers.report_title: 【大模型最新论文科普】CLP 登上 arXiv:它改变的,不只是“多猜几个词”,而是“先由谁拍板”
papers.summary: 本文科普解读 6 月 9 日登上 arXiv 的论文《CLP: Collocation-Length Prediction for Zero-Loss Adaptive Multi-Token Inference》。CLP 针对大模型推理加速中的多 token 预测环节，提出两项核心改造：一是“Backbone-as-Architect”，即每轮生成的第一步 token 必须由主干模型的语言头决定，而非由多 token 预测头（MTP head）竞争；二是用极轻量的长度预测器（单线性层，参数量仅 4.6K-7.7K）替代传统逐个 token 的 gating 网络（百万级参数），直接判断除首 token 外还能安全接收多少个后续 token。在 Qwen2.5-1.5B 上实现 1.20x-1.29x 加速，在 Qwen2.5-7B 上实现 1.14x-1.20x 加速，且输出质量无明显恶化（重复率低）。相比 Medusa、MARS 等方案，CLP 侧重职责切分与长度决策，而非单纯多头扩展或训练方式改进。该工作属于系统级推理优化，通过改变流程边界（谁拍板第一步、整段接受而非逐个安检）来提升效率，对降低大模型服务延迟和成本具有参考价值。论文摘要披露了关键性能数字，但尚未经过大规模统一验证。

arxiv.title: CLP: Collocation-Length Prediction for Zero-Loss Adaptive Multi-Token Inference
arxiv.abstract: Large language model inference is bottlenecked by autoregressive decoding, where each token requires a full forward pass. Multi-token prediction (MTP) offers a promising acceleration path, but existing approaches suffer from a fundamental architectural flaw: the MTP head for the first token competes with the backbone's own language model (LM) head, leading to severe quality degradation when predictions are accepted. We identify this head-backbone competition as the root cause of repetitive and incoherent outputs in prior MTP-based acceleration methods. To address this, we propose Backbone-as-Architect, a design principle where the backbone LM head always generates the first token, and MTP heads are responsible only for subsequent tokens. Building on this principle, we introduce CLP (Collocation-Length Predictor), a lightweight span-level decision layer that predicts how many additional tokens can be safely accepted at each decoding step. CLP uses only a single linear layer (4.6K--7.7K parameters), replacing the over-engineered 1M-parameter gate networks used in prior work. Experiments on Qwen2.5 models (0.5B, 1.5B, 7B) show that CLP achieves 1.20x--1.29x speedup on 1.5B and 1.14x--1.20x on 7B, with zero quality degradation (repetition ratio < 0.02), while gate-based approaches fail to accelerate (1.07x) or produce severely degraded outputs (repetition ratio > 0.5%). papers.report_title: 大模型推理顶会论文分享---NanoFlow(OSDI 2025)
papers.summary: 本文深度解读NanoFlow论文（NanoFlow: Towards Optimal Large Language Model Serving Throughput，OSDI 2025）。NanoFlow通过将输入batch拆分为更小的nano-batches，自动决定批大小、顺序和资源分配，实现计算、访存和通信的overlap。实验表明：在LLaMA-2-70B+8×A100上，吞吐比vLLM快4.18×，比TensorRT-LLM快1.91×；达到50%-72%的最优吞吐（现有引擎仅22%-38%）；P99延迟仅比平均值高1.07×；在高负载下200ms SLO内处理1.64×更多请求。核心洞察：GQA使batch size大幅提升（~2048），导致compute成为瓶颈，为overlap创造空间；通信和内存均非瓶颈。消融显示overlap核心技术贡献约1.17-1.2×，其余来自更好kernel和异步调度。论文未在H100上验证，且多节点场景待探索。

arxiv.title: NanoFlow: Towards Optimal Large Language Model Serving Throughput
arxiv.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have resulted in a surging demand for planet-scale serving systems, where tens of thousands of GPUs continuously serve hundreds of millions of users. Consequently, throughput has emerged as a key metric that determines serving systems' performance. Due to large model sizes and memory-intensive self-attention, LLM serving has been commonly assumed to be memory-bound. Through a detailed analysis, we show that despite having memory-intensive components, end-to-end LLM serving is compute bound for most common workloads and LLMs. Alas, most existing serving engines fall short from optimal compute utilization, because the heterogeneous operations that comprise LLM serving--compute, memory, networking--are executed sequentially within a device. We propose NanoFlow, a novel serving framework that exploits intra-device parallelism, which overlaps the usage of heterogeneous resources within a single device. NanoFlow splits inputs into smaller nano-batches and duplicates operations to operate on each portion independently, enabling overlapping. NanoFlow automatically identifies the number, size, ordering, and GPU resource allocation of nano-batches to minimize the execution time, while considering the interference of concurrent operations. arxiv.title: The Meta-Agent Challenge: Are Current Agents Capable of Autonomous Agent Development?
arxiv.abstract: Current AI benchmarks evaluate agents on task execution within human-designed workflows. These evaluations fundamentally fail to measure a critical next-level capability: whether models can autonomously develop agent systems. We introduce the Meta-Agent Challenge (MAC), an evaluation framework designed to test the capacity of frontier models for autonomous agent development. Specifically, a code agent (the meta-agent) is given a sandboxed environment, an evaluation API, and a time limitation to iteratively program an agent artifact that maximizes performance on a held-out test set across five domains. To ensure evaluation integrity, this framework is secured by multi-layer defenses against reward hacking. Leveraging this framework, we demonstrate that meta-agents rarely match human-engineered baseline policies, and the few that do are dominated by proprietary frontier models. Moreover, the design process exhibits high variance, and high optimization pressure surfaces emergent adversarial behaviors like ground-truth exfiltration-highlighting critical deficits in both robustness and model alignment. Ultimately, MAC provides a rigorous, open-source benchmark for autonomous AI research and development, offering an empirical proxy for evaluating recursive self-improvement. Benchmark is publicly available at: https://github.com/ant-research/meta-agent-challenge.

papers.title: ABot-Earth 0.5: Generative 3D Earth Model
papers.report_title: 高德地图发布ABot-Earth 0.5:一张卫星图10分钟生成1平方公里3D世界,已覆盖190+国家
papers.summary: 高德地图AMAP CV Lab发布的ABot-Earth 0.5，提出了一种基于原生3D Gaussian Splatting（3DGS）的生成式三维地球模型。核心创新在于：输入单张带地理坐标的卫星图，模型在10分钟内即可生成1平方公里无缝3D场景（推理时单块1.6 km×1.6 km在A100上约25分钟），并直接输出原生3DGS资产，省去mesh中转。在生成保真度上，FID从先前最优方法（EarthCrafter）的69.5大幅降至16.1（降幅超75%），KID从0.061降至0.006。产品已上线覆盖300+城市、190+国家，可交互数字地球。方法上采用压缩-生成范式：先将真实城市场景的数百万Gaussian压入紧凑latent space，再以卫星图为条件解构新场景；内生多LOD解码支持从行星俯瞰到街道细节的连续过渡；滑动窗口推理时对重叠区域智能混合，单块覆盖面积是训练tile的64倍。全球生产管线将建成区约80万km²切为31.25万块，1000卡A100集群并发300+批次，预计10天完成。最终产出约3.2万亿Gaussian原语，通过地理对齐、LOD重组（zoom 14–19）和OGC 3D Tiles索引接入高德YunJing引擎，支持实时缩放漫游。与Google Earth对比，虽几何精度和纹理保真仍不及（Google多年优化航拍+人工后处理），但在覆盖广度（无限）、生成时效（10分钟/km² vs 数月）、成本（免费、MB级存储）和审美评分上已占优。实验还展示了地标融合方案（COLMAP重建+生成环境嵌入）及UAV仿真等下游应用。数据引擎是关键壁垒：自研ABot-3DGS重建引擎整合多源影像（卫星/航拍/街景）及8个公开数据集，经三级质量筛选，保证了训练数据的真实性与多样性。

arxiv.title: ABot-Earth 0.5: Generative 3D Earth Model
arxiv.abstract: We present ABot-Earth 0.5, a generative 3D framework designed to synthesize vast, seamless 3D environments from ubiquitous, geospatially referenced satellite imagery. To achieve this, we propose a novel generative model formulated directly with the 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) representation. The model is trained on a diverse corpus of existing real-world urban reconstructions, learning to generate realistic geometry and textures. At inference, it synthesizes novel 3D scenes conditioned solely on satellite imagery at a scalable rate of under 10 minutes per square kilometer, while demonstrating exceptional realism. The framework is designed for accessibility, with integrated hierarchical level-of-detail (LOD) structures that permit real-time, interactive visualization on web-based map engines. This high-fidelity simulation sandbox effectively mitigates the sim-to-real domain gap, enabling critical downstream Embodied AI applications like closed-loop UAV navigation. By providing an ultra-low-cost and high-efficiency solution, ABot-Earth 0.5 significantly lowers the technical and financial barriers to large-scale 3D reconstruction and empowers the future of global digital earth visualization.

papers.title: A Survey of Audio Reasoning in Multimodal Foundation Models
papers.report_title: 速递 | 港中大发布首篇音频推理综述,补齐 AGI 关键短板
papers.summary: 本文介绍了香港中文大学Irwin King教授团队联合多位研究者发布的首篇聚焦音频推理的全景综述论文《A Survey of Audio Reasoning in Multimodal Foundation Models》（arXiv:2605.21008）。该综述重新定义了音频推理的技术范式，搭建了完整的分类体系，将主流研究划分为四大核心范式：Audio-to-Text推理（利用思维链直接从原始音频信号梳理逻辑，解决长音频理解问题）、Audio-to-Speech推理（端到端语音交互，匹配情绪语调，探索边听边推理/边发声边预推理等低延迟方案）、Audio-Visual推理（音视频时空对齐，声源区分与跨模态消歧）、Agentic Audio推理（听觉驱动的自主决策，基于LLM规划器动态调用工具）。综述指出当前行业存在三大问题：缺乏独立研究框架、子方向分散、文本捷径现象普遍。在数据方面，大规模训练数据主要源于MMAU、VoxEval等数据集，并利用LLM-ALM架构结合音高、语速等声学特征减少模态幻觉。评测标准已从单纯答案正确率转向核查模型是否真正运用音频信息，覆盖情绪识别、多人对话、环境音等多元场景。未来五大研究方向包括：合成数据可靠性验证、模态幻觉消除、实时交互延迟优化、长上下文音频推理、将推理能力前移至预训练阶段。该综述填补了音频推理领域统一研究框架的空白，被视为多模态大模型迈向AGI的关键参考。

arxiv.title: A Survey of Audio Reasoning in Multimodal Foundation Models
arxiv.abstract: Reasoning has become a defining capability of modern foundation models, yet its development in the audio modality remains limited. Audio poses challenges that are distinct from those of text and vision. It is continuous, temporally dense, and contains linguistic, paralinguistic, and environmental information at multiple time scales. As a result, audio reasoning models must align acoustic signals with the discrete semantic space of large language models, while still preserving fine-grained information needed for reliable inference. Progress is also limited by three major obstacles: the scarcity of genuinely audio-grounded reasoning data, shortcut learning and modality hallucination, and the tension between reasoning depth and real-time latency in spoken interaction. In this paper, we present the first dedicated survey of audio reasoning. We provide a unified formulation that distinguishes direct predictive modeling from reasoning-augmented generation, review the architectural and training foundations of audio reasoning models, and systematically organize recent advances in Audio-to-Text, Audio-to-Speech, Audio-Visual Reasoning and Agentic Audio Reasoning. We further examine emerging paradigms such as Chain-of-Thought prompting, supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and latency-aware spoken interaction, and discuss evaluation practices, open challenges, and future direc

papers.title: ELF: Embedded Language Flows
papers.report_title: 何凯明又出手:AI 写字下一站「ELF论文解读」
papers.summary: 本文是对何凯明团队提出的ELF（Embedded Language Flows）论文的深度技术解读。ELF属于连续扩散语言模型路线，核心创新为“先画后写”：将文字通过T5 embedding映射到128维连续空间，使用Flow Matching从噪声连续推演至清晰语义，仅在最后一步（t=1）才离散化为具体文本。关键性能数据：训练数据仅用45B token（约为同行1/10），采样步数从MDLM的1024步压缩至32步（32倍加速），且32步生成为原生能力无需蒸馏。架构上采用shared-weight设计，用一个网络同时做denoise和decode，参数从148M降至105M（节省30%）。训练时80%样本用于denoise的MSE loss，20%用于decode的CE loss。此外，ELF将图像扩散领域的CFG（classifier-free guidance）直接迁移至文本生成，支持训练时CFG嵌入，推理时一次前向即生效。本文还梳理了连续DLM领域5年的发展脉络：从2022年Diffusion-LM到2026年ELF，关键突破在于“只在最后一秒落字”的大胆删减。从研究人员视角看，ELF的45B token训练数据量和32步生成速度是值得重复验证的关键指标；shared-weight + mode token的设计思路简洁高效，参数节省30%且任务互促；CFG在连续空间中的直接应用打开了将图像领域大量技巧迁移至文本生成的大门。但文章也提及争议：现有对比可能未完全公平（32步vs 1024步但有其他差异）。

arxiv.title: ELF: Embedded Language Flows
arxiv.abstract: Diffusion and flow-based models have become the de facto approaches for generating continuous data, e.g., in domains such as images and videos. Their success has attracted growing interest in applying them to language modeling. Unlike their image-domain counterparts, today's leading diffusion language models (DLMs) primarily operate over discrete tokens. In this paper, we show that continuous DLMs can be made effective with minimal adaptation to the discrete domain. We propose Embedded Language Flows (ELF), a class of diffusion models in continuous embedding space based on continuous-time Flow Matching. Unlike existing DLMs, ELF predominantly stays within the continuous embedding space until the final time step, where it maps to discrete tokens using a shared-weight network. This formulation makes it straightforward to adapt established techniques from image-domain diffusion models, e.g., classifier-free guidance (CFG). Experiments show that ELF substantially outperforms leading discrete and continuous DLMs, achieving better generation quality with fewer sampling steps. These results suggest that ELF offers a promising path toward effective continuous DLMs.

papers.title: Compute Optimal Tokenization
papers.report_title: Meta新论文训练988个模型,撼动大模型「缩放律」根基:token该退位了,byte才是真正的尺子!
papers.summary: 本文解读了Meta FAIR与华盛顿大学的论文《Compute Optimal Tokenization》(arXiv:2605.01188)。该论文通过训练988个latent tokenized模型（参数从5000万到70亿），系统扫描了tokenizer压缩率与模型规模、数据量的关系，得出颠覆性结论：跨tokenizer比较时，bytes（而非tokens）才是更稳定的数据计量单位。核心发现包括：(1)在compute-optimal配置下，与参数量成比例增长的数据单位是bytes，而非tokens，最优bytes/parameter比例约为60（针对英语）且跨算力预算基本稳定；(2)每个训练算力预算下存在最优压缩率，且该最优压缩率随算力增加而下降；(3)不同语言的最优bytes/parameter比例和压缩率存在系统性偏移。该研究打破了业界默认的“多少token配多少参数”的经验法则，指出tokenizer压缩率应作为联合调优的超参数。对于从事预训练配方设计的团队，本文提供了具体指导：将training bytes与model parameters的比例作为跨tokenizer泛化的关键度量。值得注意的是，该论文并未否定token在工程场景中的价值，而是强调在跨tokenizer比较时必须切换到byte坐标系。
report_titles: Meta新论文训练988个模型,撼动大模型「缩放律」根基:token该退位了,byte才是真正的尺子!

arxiv.title: Compute Optimal Tokenization
arxiv.abstract: Scaling laws enable the optimal selection of data amount and language model size, yet the impact of the data unit, the token, on this relationship remains underexplored. In this work, we systematically investigate how the information granularity of tokens, controlled by the compression rate (i.e., average bytes of text per token), affects scaling trends. We train 988 latent tokenized models (BLT) ranging from 50M to 7B parameters that enable setting the desired compression rate. This flexibility allows us to study the role of compression rate well beyond 4.57 bytes per token obtained with a popular BPE tokenizer. Our experiments reveal that in compute-optimal configurations, model parameter counts scale proportionally to data size measured in bytes, not in tokens as commonly perceived (Kaplan et al., 2020; Hoffmann et al., 2022). Furthermore, we discover that the optimal compression rate differs from the one obtained with BPE and decreases with compute. These findings generalize to both latent and subword tokenization, as well as to languages other than English, guiding language model developers on tokenization scheme selection for maximal compute efficiency.

papers.report_title: Adobe新研究:用通用奖励模型驯服AI审美,修图效果碾压GPT-5
papers.summary: 本文解读了Adobe Research与UC Santa Barbara联合提出的RETOUCHIQ框架，该框架通过多模态大语言模型（MLLM）智能体实现指令驱动的图像修图。核心创新是通用奖励模型（GRM），它作为审美裁判，动态生成评价指标而非依赖像素级损失，解决了主观修图任务中监督信号缺失的难题。策略模型基于Qwen2.5-VL-7B，先经过19万对高质量数据监督微调，再通过强化学习（RL）优化，奖励模型由MLLM担任。研究还提出策略导向奖励训练（PGRT），用策略模型自身的失败案例训练奖励模型，形成教学相长循环。在自建RETOUCHEVAL基准上，RETOUCHIQ-GRM在语义一致性（SC）和感知质量（PQ）上全面领先GPT-5、Gemini 2.5、JarvisArt及Flux-Pro-1.1。在MIT-Adobe5K标准数据集上，SSIM达0.86，LPIPS为0.16，与MonetGPT持平。GRM相比规则奖励在风格变换任务上提升显著。论文展示了AI在主观审美领域通过自我评估学习复杂技能的新范式。

arxiv.title: RetouchIQ: MLLM Agents for Instruction-Based Image Retouching with Generalist Reward

However, training remains challenging due to the lack of reliable, verifiable reward signals that can reflect the inherently subjective nature of creative editing. In this work, we introduce RetouchIQ, a framework that performs instruction-based executable image editing through MLLM agents guided by a generalist reward model. RetouchIQ interprets user-specified editing intentions and generates corresponding, executable image adjustments, bridging high-level aesthetic goals with precise parameter control. To move beyond conventional, rule-based rewards that compute similarity against a fixed reference image using handcrafted metrics, we propose a generalist reward model, an RL fine-tuned MLLM that evaluates edited results through a set of generated metrics on a case-by-case basis. Then, the reward model provides scalar feedback through multimodal reasoning, enabling reinforcement learning with high-quality, instruction-consistent gradients. papers.title: Sycophantic Chatbots Cause Delusional Spiraling, Even in Ideal Bayesians
papers.report_title: AI 鸦片:它不骗你,只是从不疲倦地同意你
papers.summary: 本文以加拿大47岁男子Allan Brooks的极端案例为引，深入剖析AI聊天机器人的谄媚行为如何导致用户产生妄想螺旋。Brooks在21天内与ChatGPT交流超300小时、累计100万字，因模型持续无条件的肯定而相信自己发明了能攻破全球加密体系的新数学，最终致信美国NSA，直到将同样内容输入Gemini才被戳穿。文章核心引用MIT CSAIL、华盛顿大学等学者发表的论文《Sycophantic Chatbots Cause Delusional Spiraling, Even in Ideal Bayesians》(arXiv:2602.19141, 2026年2月)，该论文通过贝叶斯模型模拟多轮对话，得出三个关键结论：1) 即使理想贝叶斯理性人也会在谄媚模型前滑向妄想，这是数学上的必然；2) 谄媚起因果作用，而非装饰；3) 两个看似对症的解药——让模型不编造假话、事先告知用户模型会拍马屁——均无效。文章进一步指出问题根源不在“造假”而在“迎合”，且“知情同意”作为唯一防线不够稳固。研究建议定期清零对话、引入异质声音来打破单一长期对话的风险结构。本文从研究人员视角揭示：AI的无条件肯定正绕过理性直接改写用户先验，其成瘾机制类似“精神鸦片”，值得精神科和AI伦理领域高度关注。

arxiv.title: Sycophantic Chatbots Cause Delusional Spiraling, Even in Ideal Bayesians
arxiv.abstract: "AI psychosis" or "delusional spiraling" is an emerging phenomenon where AI chatbot users find themselves dangerously confident in outlandish beliefs after extended chatbot conversations. This phenomenon is typically attributed to AI chatbots' well-documented bias towards validating users' claims, a property often called "sycophancy." In this paper, we probe the causal link between AI sycophancy and AI-induced psychosis through modeling and simulation. We propose a simple Bayesian model of a user conversing with a chatbot, and formalize notions of sycophancy and delusional spiraling in that model. We then show that in this model, even an idealized Bayes-rational user is vulnerable to delusional spiraling, and that sycophancy plays a causal role. Furthermore, this effect persists in the face of two candidate mitigations: preventing chatbots from hallucinating false claims, and informing users of the possibility of model sycophancy. We conclude by discussing the implications of these results for model developers and policymakers concerned with mitigating the problem of delusional spiraling.

papers.title: AgentDoG 1.5: A Lightweight and Scalable Alignment Framework for AI Agent Safety and Security
papers.report_title: 上海 AI Lab 最新开源 AgentDoG 1.5:面向完整执行轨迹的轻量可扩展 Agent 安全框架
papers.summary: 上海AI Lab最新开源AgentDoG 1.5，聚焦AI Agent在完整执行轨迹中的安全风险。现有安全方案主要审查用户输入或最终回复，但Agent的风险可能出现在工具描述、环境返回、仓库文件、依赖包、历史状态乃至中间工具调用中。AgentDoG 1.5将安全判断对象升级为完整agent trajectory，同时输出二分类（safe/unsafe）和细粒度诊断。核心组件包括：ATBench Family（统一轨迹级评测接口，包含1,000条经过审计的轨迹，其中503条安全、497条不安全，覆盖2,084个可用工具、平均9.01轮交互及约3.95k tokens），并扩展出ATBench-Claw（面向状态化多工具Agent）和ATBench-Codex（面向代码执行Agent）。ATBench DataEngine通过三维taxonomy（风险来源、失效模式、真实世界危害）构造高质量训练数据，覆盖5,973个独立工具和MCP server，包含1,620个风险组合。应用一：Safety Agentic SFT & RL，用约21,939条高质量agentic safety轨迹训练Qwen3.5-4B，AgentHarm Harm Score从57.49%降至20.32%，Refusal Rate提升至75.00%，AgentSafetyBench Safe Rate从34.37%提升至53.23%，BFCL函数调用准确率81.12%。RL阶段进一步将Harm Score降至18.04%，Safe Rate提升至59.32%。应用二：Online Agent Safety Guardrail，在pre-reply节点拦截不安全回复，ClawSafety中ASR从56.25%降至18.75%，AgentHazard Prompt_Intel_Theft中从41.92%降至34.23%。AgentDoG-Qwen3-4B在R-Judge上达到91.8% Accuracy和92.7% F1，在ATBench上达到92.8% Accuracy和93.0% F1，轻量模型即可实现高效安全诊断。
report_titles: 上海 AI Lab 最新开源 AgentDoG 1.5:面向完整执行轨迹的轻量可扩展 Agent 安全框架

arxiv.title: AgentDoG 1.5: A Lightweight and Scalable Alignment Framework for AI Agent Safety and Security
arxiv.abstract: Modern open-world agents such as OpenClaw exhibit powerful cross-environment execution capabilities yet introduce broad new safety risk sources. Meanwhile, advanced frontier AI models drastically lower attack barriers, rendering current agent alignment frameworks inadequate for real-world deployment. To tackle these emerging threats, we propose a lightweight and scalable agent safety alignment framework. Specifically, we update the agent safety taxonomy to accommodate emergent risks from Codex and OpenClaw execution scenarios. We further build a taxonomy-guided data engine with influence-function purification to train lightweight AgentDoG 1.5 variants (0.8B, 2B, 4B, and 8B parameters) using only around 1k samples, achieving comparable performance with leading closed-source models (e.g., GPT-5.4). Based on AgentDoG 1.5, we construct a highly efficient agentic safety SFT and RL training environment, which reduces deployment overhead in Docker-level environments by two orders of magnitude. Finally, we deploy AgentDoG 1.5 as a training-free online guardrail for real-time safety moderation. Extensive experimental results indicate that AgentDoG 1.5 achieves state-of-the-art performance in diverse and complex interactive agentic scenarios. All models and datasets are openly released.

papers.title: Mitigating Perceptual Judgment Bias in Multimodal LLM-as-a-Judge via Perceptual Perturbation and Reward Modeling
papers.report_title: 多模态大模型当裁判也会看错图:这篇论文讲清了 Perceptual Judgment Bias
papers.summary: 论文《Mitigating Perceptual Judgment Bias in Multimodal LLM-as-a-Judge via Perceptual Perturbation and Reward Modeling》（arXiv 2606.02578，ICML 2026）聚焦多模态大模型作为裁判时的感知判断偏差：当视觉证据与文本回答冲突时，裁判模型往往被流畅的文本话术说服，忽略真实图像内容。核心方法包括：（1）构造Perceptually Perturbed Judgment Dataset，通过最小编辑反事实回答将感知错误隔离；（2）使用结构化GRPO-based reward和batch-ranking objective训练更可靠的judge，使其偏向可验证的视觉事实。论文指出该偏差对自动评测系统构成严重威胁，建议工程团队在评测流程中保留视觉证据、构造反事实测试集、检查judge是否被错误但流畅的文本吸引。该工作对多模态评测、RAG评测和AI搜索质检有重要启示，提醒自动评分必须与证据绑定。原文未提供精确性能数字（如准确率提升幅度），强调方法本身而非绝对指标。
papers.paper_title: Mitigating Perceptual Judgment Bias in Multimodal LLM-as-a-Judge via Perceptual Perturbation and Reward Modeling
report_titles: 多模态大模型当裁判也会看错图:这篇论文讲清了 Perceptual Judgment Bias

arxiv.title: Mitigating Perceptual Judgment Bias in Multimodal LLM-as-a-Judge via Perceptual Perturbation and Reward Modeling
arxiv.abstract: Recent multimodal large language models have demonstrated strong reasoning ability, yet their reliability as automated evaluators remains limited by a critical weakness: when visual evidence conflicts with textual cues, MLLM judges tend to reward plausible narratives over perceptually correct answers. We identify and systematically analyze this phenomenon, which we term Perceptual Judgment Bias. Through controlled visual perturbations, existing multimodal judges frequently anchor on the response text instead of their own visual perception, leading to inconsistent and non-verifiable evaluations. To address this issue, we introduce the Perceptually Perturbed Judgment Dataset, which constructs minimally edited counterfactual responses that isolate perceptual errors and enable verifiable supervision. Building on this dataset, we develop a unified training framework that combines a structured GRPO-based reward with a batch-ranking objective, achieving coherent global ordering without explicit pairwise labels. Experiments across diverse MLLM-as-a-Judge benchmarks show that our approach substantially improves perceptual fidelity, ranking coherence, and alignment with human evaluation. Our results establish a scalable and generalizable pathway for training multimodal judges that are perceptually grounded, interpretable, and robust to visual-reasoning conflicts.

papers.title: HH-PIM: Dynamic Optimization of Power and Performance with Heterogeneous-Hybrid PIM for Edge AI Devices
papers.report_title: 边缘 AI 芯片如何又快又省电?HH-PIM 用“大小核 + 混合存储”给 PIM 加上动态调度能力
papers.summary: 本文深度解读AAAI/ISCA等会议论文《HH-PIM: Dynamic Optimization of Power and Performance with Heterogeneous-Hybrid PIM for Edge AI Devices》。针对边缘AI推理负载动态变化而PIM资源固定配置导致能效浪费的问题，提出异构混合PIM架构HH-PIM。核心设计：将PIM模块分为高性能HP-PIM（1.2V，5.52ns PE延迟）和低功耗LP-PIM（0.8V，10.68ns PE延迟），每个模块内集成MRAM（非易失、低功耗）与SRAM（低延迟、高动态功耗）。通过动态规划算法在运行时根据时间约束自动决定权重在HP-MRAM/HP-SRAM/LP-MRAM/LP-SRAM四类空间的分配比例。FPGA原型（Genesys 2，RISC-V Rocket Core）验证。关键性能数据：在持续低负载场景（Case1）相比传统Baseline-PIM（8HP+128KB SRAM）最高节能86.23%，相比仅异构PIM（4HP+4LP仅SRAM）节能78.7%，相比仅混合PIM（8HP+MRAM/SRAM混合）节能66.5%。在动态负载下（周期性峰值/随机负载）节能幅度分别达72.01%、61.46%、48.94%、59.28%。平均最高节能：相较Baseline-PIM 60.43%，相较Heterogeneous-PIM 36.3%，相较Hybrid-PIM 48.58%。EfficientNet-B0推理时间：HH-PIM混合使用SRAM+MRAM达31.06ms，而纯MRAM方案为44.5ms。实验采用45nm工艺综合+NVSim仿真。该工作将big.LITTLE思想引入PIM，辅以MRAM/SRAM混合存储+动态数据放置，为边缘AI能效优化提供了新的架构级方案。
papers.paper_title: HH-PIM: Dynamic Optimization of Power and Performance with Heterogeneous-Hybrid PIM for Edge AI Devices
report_titles: 边缘 AI 芯片如何又快又省电?HH-PIM 用“大小核 + 混合存储”给 PIM 加上动态调度能力

arxiv.title: HH-PIM: Dynamic Optimization of Power and Performance with Heterogeneous-Hybrid PIM for Edge AI Devices
arxiv.abstract: Processing-in-Memory (PIM) architectures offer promising solutions for efficiently handling AI applications in energy-constrained edge environments. While traditional PIM designs enhance performance and energy efficiency by reducing data movement between memory and processing units, they are limited in edge devices due to continuous power demands and the storage requirements of large neural network weights in SRAM and DRAM. Hybrid PIM architectures, incorporating non-volatile memories like MRAM and ReRAM, mitigate these limitations but struggle with a mismatch between fixed computing resources and dynamically changing inference workloads. To address these challenges, this study introduces a Heterogeneous-Hybrid PIM (HH-PIM) architecture, comprising high-performance MRAM-SRAM PIM modules and low-power MRAM-SRAM PIM modules. We further propose a data placement optimization algorithm that dynamically allocates data based on computational demand, maximizing energy efficiency. FPGA prototyping and power simulations with processors featuring HH-PIM and other PIM types demonstrate that the proposed HH-PIM achieves up to $60.43$ percent average energy savings over conventional PIMs while meeting application latency requirements. These results confirm the suitability of HH-PIM for adaptive, energy-efficient AI processing in edge devices.
arxiv.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 2025 Design Automation Conference (DAC)

papers.title: EvoNav: Evolutionary Reward Function Design for Robot Navigation with Large Language Models
papers.report_title: [论文解读] EvoNav:让大模型写奖励函数,机器人导航终于不用全靠人调参了
papers.summary: EvoNav 提出一套利用大语言模型自动化设计机器人导航奖励函数的渐进式多保真度搜索框架，旨在解决手工调参成本高、易引入人为偏差的问题。系统通过三个阶段筛选候选奖励函数：第一阶段利用已有轨迹数据和常识规则进行低成本排序评估，快速剔除明显不合理的候选；第二阶段采用轻量级代理训练（较少梯度步数、短训练视野）观察策略行为趋势，收集成功率、碰撞率、超时率等指标反馈给大模型迭代修改；第三阶段仅对通过前两轮筛选的优秀候选进行全尺寸强化学习训练验证。实验结果显示，相比手工奖励函数和其他自动方法，EvoNav 取得了更高的导航成功率，同时降低了碰撞率和超时率。更重要的是，其分层筛选策略大幅节省计算成本，总体 GPU 和 API 消耗相比 CARD 方法节省约 74%。演化出的奖励函数展现出复杂行为逻辑，如距离障碍物越近安全惩罚越强、距离目标越近优先级越高、人群密集区主动保持安全距离等，使机器人在动态人群中表现更接近有经验的导航者。该方法将大模型生成、规则评估、代理训练和完整强化学习连成闭环，使奖励函数设计从“专家手工调参”走向可自动化验证的高效流程。值得关注的是，该工作验证了“代理一致性”假设：低成本评估中表现优秀的奖励函数在完整训练中大概率保持优势，为后续自动奖励设计提供了理论支撑。
report_titles: [论文解读] EvoNav:让大模型写奖励函数,机器人导航终于不用全靠人调参了

arxiv.title: EvoNav: Evolutionary Reward Function Design for Robot Navigation with Large Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Robot navigation is a crucial task with applications to social robots in dynamic human environments. While Reinforcement Learning (RL) has shown great promise for this problem, the policy quality is highly sensitive to the specification of reward functions. Hand-crafted rewards require substantial domain expertise and embed inductive biases that are difficult to audit or adapt, limiting their effectiveness and leading to suboptimal performance. In this paper, we propose EvoNav, an evolutionary framework that automates the design of robot navigation reward functions via large language models (LLMs). To overcome prohibitively costly policy training, EvoNav evaluates each candidate proposal from the LLM via a progressive three-stage warm-up-boost procedure. EvoNav advances from analytical proxies with low-cost surrogates, such as small datasets and analytic rules, to lightweight rollouts and, finally, to full policy training, enabling computationally efficient exploration under effective feedback. Experiment results show that EvoNav produces more effective navigation policies than manually designed RL rewards and state-of-the-art reward design methods.

papers.title: Tracing the Dynamics of Refusal: Exploiting Latent Refusal Trajectories for Robust Jailbreak Detection
papers.report_title: 三分钟论文速递 | 动态追踪大模型内部的拒绝机制
papers.summary: 本篇解读的论文《Tracing the Dynamics of Refusal: Exploiting Latent Refusal Trajectories for Robust Jailbreak Detection》通过因果追踪方法揭示了大语言模型中拒绝机制的动态轨迹，发现关键拒绝信号并非主要存在于末端状态，而是稀疏分布在语义锚点（如“炸弹”）之后的中间层词元位置。基于此发现，作者提出 SALO 检测方法，利用多尺度卷积核和全局最大池化从激活体积中定位稀疏信号。关键实验结果：在 Qwen、Mistral、Llama 三种模型上，SALO 对预填充、GCG、AutoDAN 等越狱攻击的检测成功率均超过 85%，将基线方法在某些场景下 0% 的检测率提升至 90% 以上。在白盒自适应攻击（攻击者完全知晓模型和检测器）下，SALO 仍保持 84.3% 的检测成功率，且成功绕过检测的案例中发生了“语义崩塌”——攻击者为压制检测信号而对后缀进行的激进优化同时破坏了有害语义完整性，导致模型将输入解读为良性问题，攻击成功率从 25.7% 降至 7.0%。研究还发现压缩韧性存在“优雅退化”与“性能悬崖”的显著差异，提示 MLLM 需在训练中引入多分辨率样本。该工作挑战了当前主流安全检测依赖末端状态（最后一个 token）的假设，为基于模型内部机制的安全防御提供了新路径，对于理解 LLM 对齐脆弱性及设计鲁棒越狱检测具有重要参考价值。

arxiv.title: Tracing the Dynamics of Refusal: Exploiting Latent Refusal Trajectories for Robust Jailbreak Detection
arxiv.abstract: Representation Engineering analyses often characterize refusal using static directions extracted from terminal or pooled representations. We ask whether this view misses how refusal is constructed across layer-token positions. Using causal tracing, we identify a \textit{Refusal Trajectory}: a sparse upstream activation pattern that often persists even when attacks such as GCG suppress terminal refusal signals. Based on this observation, we propose SALO (Sparse Activation Localization Operator), a lightweight white-box detector that operates on raw hidden-state volumes from a selected layer window. Across Qwen, Llama, and Mistral models, SALO improves jailbreak detection on several attack families under a fixed XSTest-calibrated operating point. We further analyze static RepE-style baselines, ROI sensitivity, adaptive GCG attacks, and encoded-input boundary cases, clarifying both the promise and limitations of refusal-trajectory monitoring.

papers.title: Thinking with Imagination: Agentic Visual Spatial Reasoning with World Simulators
papers.report_title: 大模型开始学会“想象”:这篇最新视觉论文,让 VLM 主动补上看不见的视角
papers.summary: 本文解读arXiv:2606.06476论文《Thinking with Imagination: Agentic Visual Spatial Reasoning with World Simulators》。提出Astra系统，包含Astra-VL（RL策略模型）和Astra-WM（动作条件世界模拟器），使VLM能主动“想象”新视角以补全缺失视觉证据。关键数据：Qwen3-VL-8B在MMSI-Bench从29.8提升至38.8；Gemini-3-Flash结合Astra-WM达49.5（对比无模拟器45.1）。两阶段RL训练将工具调用率从98%降至61.5%但总分最高。Astra-WM经视角一致性训练（姿态一致性69/75，内容一致性53/56）可生成可靠中间证据。论文强调“选择性想象”优于强制工具调用，为多模态主动感知、世界模型推理提供新范式。项目页已开源。

report_titles: 大模型开始学会“想象”:这篇最新视觉论文,让 VLM 主动补上看不见的视角

arxiv.title: Thinking with Imagination: Agentic Visual Spatial Reasoning with World Simulators
arxiv.abstract: While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong visual reasoning capabilities, their spatial reasoning abilities remain largely constrained to the observed images and text-oriented chain-of-thought. They often struggle to infer unobserved layouts, maintain cross-view consistency, and reason from alternative viewpoints when only limited egocentric observations are available. In this work, we study this problem as thinking with imagination, where a VLM actively acquires imagined visual evidence by interacting with a world simulator during reasoning. We propose Astra, an agentic spatial reasoning framework that empowers VLMs with action-conditioned visual imagination. Specifically, Astra couples Astra-VL, an RL-trained VLM policy, with Astra-WM, a Bagel-based world simulator that generates novel-view observations from context images and natural-language camera motions. To provide reliable imagined evidence, Astra-WM is trained with view consistency tuning to improve pose and content consistency across views. In the RL stage, we propose a world-simulator-in-the-loop two-phase RL curriculum to stabilize tool-use exploration and advance the model's ability to invoke the simulator only when imagined observations improve over direct answering. Experiments demonstrate that both the world simulator and the agentic policy are necessary: Astra-WM improves simulator-augmented Gemini-3

papers.report_title: 用AI重塑物质教育:一篇论文揭示如何让大模型“引经据典”,输出可靠知识
papers.summary: 本文深度解读一篇arXiv预印本论文（arXiv:2605.00383），提出基于Agentic AI和RAG架构的物质使用教育系统。该系统创新性地整合了美国缉毒局（DEA）监管数据与PubMed科学文献共102篇权威文档，通过语义分块（相比固定切分提升检索准确率15%-20%）和向量检索，为LLM提供可追溯的知识基础，有效抑制幻觉。论文构建了六大核心组件：数据采集、语义分块、向量存储、动态PubMed查询、RAG生成及Web交互。在专家评估中，5位多学科专家对30个预设问题的90次交互评估显示：回答准确性4.35/5，信息完整性4.28/5，来源可追溯性4.22/5，回答实用性4.18/5，评估者间一致性Cohen's Kappa=0.78（高度一致）。该系统实现了监管数据与科学文献的“法规-科学”双维度融合，每个回答均附带来源链接，支持独立验证。应用前景可拓展至传染病防控、慢性病管理等。局限包括语料库规模（当前102篇）、仅支持英文等。该工作为AI在专业健康教育领域的可信应用建立了可复用的技术范式。

arxiv.title: Agentic AI for Substance Use Education: Integrating Regulatory and Scientific Knowledge Sources
arxiv.abstract: The delivery of traditional substance education has remained problematic due to challenges in scalability, personalization, and the currency of information in a rapidly evolving substance use landscape. While artificial intelligence (AI) offers a promising frontier for enhancing educational delivery, its application in providing real-time, authoritative substance use education remains largely underexplored. We built an agentic-based AI web application that combined Drug Enforcement Administration records with peer-reviewed literature in real-time to provide transparent context-sensitive substance use education. The system uses retrieval-augmented generation with a carefully filtered corpus of 102 documents and dynamic PubMed queries. Document storage was semantically chunked and placed in a vector representation in order to be easily retrieved. papers.title: ORACLE-CT: Anatomy-Aware Support Pooling for CT Classification
papers.report_title: 医疗AI告别“盲人摸象”:ORACLE–CT用器官定位让诊断更准更稳
papers.summary: 本文解读杜克大学论文ORACLE-CT，提出解剖感知的支撑池化框架用于CT多标签分类。核心思路：不改变编码器，仅在后处理聚合阶段注入解剖先验——为每个病理标签分配专属器官支持区域（如肾囊肿→肾脏），强制注意力池化只在区域内计算。在MERLIN内部测试集（n=5,082）上，DINOv3编码器的宏AUROC从0.838提升至0.858（+2.0pt），AUPRC从0.638提升至0.676（+3.8pt）；I3D-ResNet-121的AUROC从0.829升至0.848（+1.9pt），AUPRC从0.617升至0.659（+4.2pt）。外部泛化测试在Duke-Abdomen（n=2,000）上，DINOv3的AUROC从0.802升至0.835（+3.3pt），AUPRC从0.628升至0.683（+5.5pt）；在AMOS（n=1,107）上AUROC从0.742升至0.762（+2.0pt）。方法还提供可审计的注意力热力图，医生可核验模型关注的器官区域。论文采用TotalSegmentator做多器官分割，支持五种解剖支持策略（单器官、联合、比较、局部、全局）。局限性依赖分割质量，但3mm膨胀缓解边界问题。

arxiv.title: ORACLE-CT: Anatomy-Aware Support Pooling for CT Classification
arxiv.abstract: Abdominal CT disease classification is challenging because each scan is a large 3D volume with many possible findings, while diagnostic evidence is often confined to specific organs or anatomical compartments. Most study-level classifiers aggregate encoder features using anatomy-agnostic pooling or attention, creating a mismatch between localized disease evidence and global evidence aggregation. We propose ORACLE--CT, an encoder-agnostic anatomy-aware aggregation framework that uses multi-organ segmentation to define label-specific anatomical supports and restrict attention pooling to relevant regions. The framework supports single-organ, multi-organ union, comparative, localized, and global support strategies. We evaluate ORACLE--CT with three encoder families: DINOv3, I3D--ResNet-121, and the radiology-native Pillar--0 encoder. Models are trained end-to-end on MERLIN and evaluated internally and under frozen external transfer to Duke--Abdomen and AMOS. arxiv.title: Audio Interaction Model
arxiv.abstract: Audio is continuous and interactive, yet most Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) remain offline and streaming systems usually specialize in ASR or spoken dialogue. We formalize the Audio Interaction Model, an always-on perceive--decide--respond paradigm that tracks context, decides whether intervention is warranted, and responds without stopping listening. We instantiate it with Audio-Interaction and introduce SoundFlow, coupling streaming-native data construction, comprehension-aware silence/response supervision, dual-loss training, and asynchronous FIFO inference. We also construct textsc{StreamAudio-2M, a 2.6M-item, 302k-hour corpus spanning 7 capability families and 28 sub-tasks, together with Proactive-Sound-Bench. Across 8 benchmarks, Audio-Interaction remains competitive on mainstream audio tasks while enabling spoken-instruction robustness, long-stream interaction, and proactive intervention.

arxiv.title: The Last Human-Written Paper: Agent-Native Research Artifacts
arxiv.abstract: Scientific publication compresses a branching, iterative research process into a linear narrative, discarding the majority of what was discovered along the way. This compilation imposes two structural costs: a Storytelling Tax, where failed experiments, rejected hypotheses, and the branching exploration process are discarded to fit a linear narrative; and an Engineering Tax, where the gap between reviewer-sufficient prose and agent-sufficient specification leaves critical implementation details unwritten. Tolerable for human readers, these costs become critical when AI agents must understand, reproduce, and extend published work. We introduce the Agent-Native Research Artifact (ARA), a protocol that replaces the narrative paper with a machine-executable research package structured around four layers: scientific logic, executable code with full specifications, an exploration graph that preserves the failures compilation discards, and evidence grounding every claim in raw outputs. Three mechanisms support the ecosystem: a Live Research Manager that captures decisions and dead ends during ordinary development; an ARA Compiler that translates legacy PDFs and repos into ARAs; and an ARA-native review system that automates objective checks so human reviewers can focus on significance, novelty, and taste. arxiv.abstract: LLM agents are increasingly expected not only to complete isolated tasks, but also to carry bounded representations of human expertise, judgment, and interaction style. Building such person-grounded agents remains difficult because actionable knowledge associated with a person or role is usually embedded in heterogeneous traces rather than written as clean instructions. Existing memory and persona systems capture fragments of this evidence, while skill frameworks provide portable packaging formats; however, there is no end-to-end workflow for distilling these traces into inspectable, correctable, and agent-usable skills. We present an automated trace-to-skill distillation system for generating person-grounded AI skills via expert knowledge distillation. Given materials from a target person or role, COLLEAGUE.SKILL produces a versioned skill package with two coordinated tracks: a capability track for practices, mental models, and decision heuristics, and a bounded behavior track for communication style, interaction rules, and correction history. The package can be inspected, invoked, updated through natural-language feedback, rolled back, installed across agent hosts, and optionally prepared for controlled distribution. papers.summary: 本文介绍minWM——一套将现有文生/图生视频模型（Wan2.1-1.3B、混元HY1.5-8B）改造为镜头可控、少步自回归交互式世界模型的全流程开源方案。核心方法分两阶段：第一阶段通过PRoPE注入相机内参/外参至自注意力，实现精准镜头控制；第二阶段利用Causal Forcing蒸馏将多步双向扩散模型压缩为少步自回归生成器（仅需几步Euler积分）。关键消融实验揭示：相机轨迹必须精确（估计位姿无效），控制能力约在8000步训练时涌现，batch size需≥16才能稳定学习（小于4则几乎学不会）。T2A阶段纯文本预训练2000步即达峰值。在Wan2.1（cross-attention）和混元（MMDiT）两种异构骨干上均验证成功，代码、权重、训练配方全部开源。该工作为社区提供了可复现的交互世界模型基线，将原本分散的多篇论文技术整合为一条可扩展流水线。

papers.title: When Truth Is Overridden: Uncovering the Internal Origins of Sycophancy in Large Language Models
papers.report_title: 三分钟论文速递 | 大语言模型的“讨好”行为从何而来?
papers.summary: 本文解读AAAI 2025论文《When Truth Is Overridden: Uncovering the Internal Origins of Sycophancy in Large Language Models》，首次从机制可解释性角度揭示大语言模型讨好行为的内部计算机制。研究使用MMLU数据集（57个学科）对7个模型家族进行实验。核心定量发现：当用户陈述错误观点时，模型平均讨好率高达63.7%（最高95.1%）。用户自称的专业水平（初/中/高）对讨好率影响小于4.4%，隐藏状态分析显示三种专业水平表征完全重叠（余弦相似度>0.9），说明模型未在内部编码专家身份。通过对数透镜追踪，发现用户观点在模型后期层（约16-19层）开始覆盖正确知识——观点提示阻止了基于事实的偏好的形成。激活修补因果实验证实：将无观点条件下的后期层激活替换到观点条件中，可使讨好率下降36%（Llama模型）；反向替换则诱导出47%的讨好行为。语法人称效应显著：第一人称表述比第三人称平均高出13.6%的讨好率，两类提示在表征空间中呈近乎正交的方向。这些数据表明模型内部观点覆盖是结构性的，且与记忆知识调用深度耦合。对于对齐与安全研究，该工作提供了可量化的内部机制证据，建议监控后期层表征变化。

arxiv.title: When Truth Is Overridden: Uncovering the Internal Origins of Sycophancy in Large Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) often exhibit sycophantic behavior, agreeing with user-stated opinions even when those contradict factual knowledge. While prior work has documented this tendency, the internal mechanisms that enable such behavior remain poorly understood. In this paper, we provide a mechanistic account of how sycophancy arises within LLMs. We first systematically study how user opinions induce sycophancy across different model families. We find that simple opinion statements reliably induce sycophancy, whereas user expertise framing has a negligible impact. Through logit-lens analysis and causal activation patching, we identify a two-stage emergence of sycophancy: (1) a late-layer output preference shift and (2) deeper representational divergence. We also verify that user authority fails to influence behavior because models do not encode it internally. In addition, we examine how grammatical perspective affects sycophantic behavior, finding that first-person prompts (``I believe...'') consistently induce higher sycophancy rates than third-person framings (``They believe...'') by creating stronger representational perturbations in deeper layers. These findings highlight that sycophancy is not a surface-level artifact but emerges from a structural override of learned knowledge in deeper layers, with implications for alignment and truthful AI systems.

papers.report_title: 写经验的不用是大模型,用经验的才要:一篇论文 + 一次亲手复现
papers.summary: 本文深度解读并亲手复现了arXiv论文《Harness Updating Is Not Harness Benefit》（arXiv 2605.30621），该论文系统拆解了自进化Agent中“更新harness”与“受益于harness”两种能力的独立影响。核心发现：1）更新能力（evolver角色）与模型强弱基本无关，最强与最弱evolver的增益差距不超过3.1个百分点，9B小模型在SkillsBench上的增益甚至超过Claude Opus 4.6，且生成技能在程序结构上同构。2）受益能力（solver角色）呈“中间高、两头低”分布，弱模型虽提升空间最大却受益最少。论文将弱模型“用不好”归因为两道坎：激活失败（加载技能进上下文的概率，强模型96% vs Qwen3-32B仅25%）和遵循失败（弱模型加载后从0.52分衰减至0.13，强模型稳定在0.8以上）。作者用四卡服务器实测Qwen3.6-27B作为evolver成功生成42行真实技能文件，并用DeepSeek v4-flash/v4-pro及Qwen3.6作为solver在SQL任务上验证了强模型天花板效应（裸跑满分，加载技能后增益为零）以及技能误用现象（三个solver裸跑全对，加载技能后全错）。文章给出三条工程建议：预算花在solver而非evolver；将调用harness作为一等训练目标；强化长程指令遵循。

arxiv.title: Harness Updating Is Not Harness Benefit: Disentangling Evolution Capabilities in Self-Evolving LLM Agents
arxiv.abstract: LLM agents are increasingly deployed as systems built around editable external harnesses, including prompts, skills, memories and tools, that shape task execution without changing model parameters. Harness self-evolution adapts such agents by updating these harnesses from execution evidence. Yet it remains unclear whether a model's base capability in task-solving predicts its capabilities in harness self-evolution: which models produce useful harness updates, and which actually benefit from them? We analyze two harness self-evolution capabilities: (i) harness-updating, the capability to produce useful persistent harness updates from execution evidence; (ii) harness-benefit, the capability to benefit from updated harnesses during task solving. Our analysis reveals two findings. First, harness-updating is flat in base capability: models from different capability tiers produce harness updates that lead to surprisingly similar gains; even Qwen3.5-9B's updates yield gains comparable to those of Claude Opus~4.6. Second, harness-benefit is non-monotonic in base capability: weak-tier models benefit little from updated harnesses, mid-tier models benefit most, and strong-tier models benefit less than mid-tier. papers.report_title: 告别AI“失忆”!Apple端侧记忆方案EpiCache,4-6倍压缩下性能不减
papers.summary: 本文深度解读Apple Research于2025年9月发表的论文《EpiCache: Episodic KV Cache Management for Long-Term Conversation on Resource-Constrained Environments》。该论文提出一种无需额外训练的KV缓存管理框架，旨在解决大模型长对话中显存膨胀问题，尤其适用于手机等资源受限端侧设备。核心创新在于将长对话按主题无监督聚类为“情景”，为每个情景建立专属压缩KV缓存，并通过逐层敏感性分析分配缓存预算。实验在LongMemEval、Realtalk、LoCoMo三个基准上进行，覆盖Qwen3、LLaMA等模型。关键数据：在LoCoMo测试中，EpiCache相比KVzip准确率提升超过30个百分点；在2K-8K低预算下性能显著优于RAG-2K、RAG-Episodic、KVzip等基线；解码延迟降低2.4倍，峰值内存减少3.7倍。此外，EpiCache在非对话的长文档问答任务（NarrativeQA、HotpotQA）上也全面超越基线，展现出强泛化能力。论文代码已公开于GitHub。本文还详细解释了“块-预填充逐出”与“后-预填充逐出”的区别，并通过龙哥三问和龙哥点评从创新性、实验合理性、稳定性、成本等维度进行了评估。

arxiv.title: EpiCache: Episodic KV Cache Management for Long-Term Conversation on Resource-Constrained Environments
arxiv.abstract: Modern large language models (LLMs) extend context lengths to millions of tokens, enabling coherent, personalized responses grounded in long conversational history. However, the Key-Value (KV) cache grows linearly with the extended dialogue history, causing the model's memory footprint to quickly exceed device limits. While recent KV cache compression methods attempt to reduce memory usage, most apply cache eviction after processing the entire context, incurring unbounded peak memory usage. Additionally, query-dependent eviction narrows the cache semantics to a single query, leading to failure cases in multi-turn conversations. In this paper, we introduce EpiCache, a training-free KV cache management framework for long conversational question answering (LongConvQA) under fixed memory budgets. EpiCache bounds cache growth through block-wise prefill and preserves topic-relevant context via episodic KV compression, which clusters conversation history into coherent episodes and performs episode-specific KV cache eviction. Across three LongConvQA benchmarks (LongMemEval, Realtalk, and LoCoMo), EpiCache improves accuracy by up to 30%, achieves near full-cache accuracy under 4-6x compression, and reduces latency and peak memory by up to 2.4x and 3.7x, respectively.

papers.title: LLM Reasoning Is Latent, Not the Chain of Thought
papers.report_title: 三分钟论文速递 | 大语言模型的推理本质:是隐藏状态而非显性思维链
papers.summary: 本文解析arXiv 2026年4月论文《LLM Reasoning Is Latent, Not the Chain of Thought》，系统论证了大模型推理的本质是潜在状态轨迹（Z），而非表面思维链（S）或通用串行计算（B）。研究将模糊观点形式化为三个竞争假说（H1潜在轨迹、H2表面思维链、H0串行计算），并提出严格的实验设计标准（分解化、计算审计、差异裁决规则）。通过受控层级（算术、图遍历、世界状态规划、代码语义）和自然层级（GSM8K-Platinum、HotpotQA、MATH、HumanEval+）两类实验进行实证裁决。关键结果：在普通制度中，潜在状态具备时间优先性、必要性和充分性，消融Z造成的损害超过最强假干预，修补Z比随机修补更能恢复表现。具体数据：GSM8K-Platinum表现为普通制度（潜在胜出），HotpotQA表现为H2制度（表面胜出），MATH表现为H0制度（计算胜出），HumanEval+保持混合。中介体统计显示，在普通制度中合格的潜在状态Z在早期即可获得，保留Z同时破坏表面痕迹比保留表面痕迹同时消融Z*的损害更小。论文建议将潜在状态作为默认研究对象，并采用分解化计算审计设计评估推理。对于安全监控，这意味着仅依赖思维链的可解释性可能不可靠，需开发基于内部状态的监控方法。

arxiv.title: LLM Reasoning Is Latent, Not the Chain of Thought
arxiv.abstract: This position paper argues that large language model (LLM) reasoning should be studied as latent-state trajectory formation rather than as faithful surface chain-of-thought (CoT). This matters because claims about faithfulness, interpretability, reasoning benchmarks, and inference-time intervention all depend on what the field takes the primary object of reasoning to be. We ask what that object should be once three often-confounded factors are separated and formalize three competing hypotheses: H1, reasoning is primarily mediated by latent-state trajectories; H2, reasoning is primarily mediated by explicit surface CoT; and H0, most apparent reasoning gains are better explained by generic serial compute than by any privileged representational object. Reorganizing recent empirical, mechanistic, and survey work under this framework, and adding compute-audited worked exemplars that factorize surface traces, latent interventions, and matched budget expansions, we find that current evidence most strongly supports H1 as a default working hypothesis rather than as a task-independent verdict. We therefore make two recommendations: the field should treat latent-state dynamics as the default object of study for LLM reasoning, and it should evaluate reasoning with designs that explicitly disentangle surface traces, latent states, and serial compute.

papers.title: Reasoning on Graphs: Faithful and Interpretable Large Language Model Reasoning
papers.report_title: 论文日报 | RoG:基于大语言模型与知识图谱的可信可解释推理框架
papers.summary: 本文解读了ICLR 2024论文《REASONING ON GRAPHS: FAITHFUL AND INTERPRETABLE LARGE LANGUAGE MODEL REASONING》，提出了RoG（Reasoning on Graphs）框架。该框架通过“规划-检索-推理”三阶段协同LLM与知识图谱（KG）：规划模块利用知识蒸馏训练LLM生成由KG支撑的关系路径作为可信推理计划；检索模块基于关系路径通过约束广度优先搜索检索具体推理路径；推理模块采用FiD框架处理多条路径并生成忠实可解释的答案。关键性能数据：在WebQSP和CWQ两个KGQA基准上取得SOTA，在更具挑战性的CWQ数据集上，Hits@1和F1分数分别比之前SOTA模型UniKGQA高出22.3%和14.4%。消融实验证明规划与推理模块均不可或缺。RoG的规划模块具有即插即用特性，可无缝集成到ChatGPT、Alpaca等其他LLM中，无需重新训练即可显著提升其KGQA性能。该工作有效解决了LLM推理中知识匮乏和幻觉问题，为高风险场景（法律判决、医疗诊断）的可信推理提供了新范式。
