arxiv.title: Reasoning on Graphs: Faithful and Interpretable Large Language Model Reasoning
arxiv.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive reasoning abilities in complex tasks. However, they lack up-to-date knowledge and experience hallucinations during reasoning, which can lead to incorrect reasoning processes and diminish their performance and trustworthiness. Knowledge graphs (KGs), which capture vast amounts of facts in a structured format, offer a reliable source of knowledge for reasoning. Nevertheless, existing KG-based LLM reasoning methods only treat KGs as factual knowledge bases and overlook the importance of their structural information for reasoning. In this paper, we propose a novel method called reasoning on graphs (RoG) that synergizes LLMs with KGs to enable faithful and interpretable reasoning. Specifically, we present a planning-retrieval-reasoning framework, where RoG first generates relation paths grounded by KGs as faithful plans. These plans are then used to retrieve valid reasoning paths from the KGs for LLMs to conduct faithful reasoning. Furthermore, RoG not only distills knowledge from KGs to improve the reasoning ability of LLMs through training but also allows seamless integration with any arbitrary LLMs during inference. Extensive experiments on two benchmark KGQA datasets demonstrate that RoG achieves state-of-the-art performance on KG reasoning tasks and generates faithful and interpretable reasoning results.

papers.title: GR00T N1: An Open Foundation Model for Generalist Humanoid Robots
papers.report_title: Karpathy大神的llm-wiki创意变成可复制的recipe了?SiliconFlow + opencode + OMO,拥有自己的自进化的知识库
papers.summary: 本文深度拆解NVIDIA的GR00T N1论文（arXiv:2503.14734）。GR00T N1是一个面向通用人形机器人的开放基础模型，核心创新是双系统VLA架构：System 2采用Eagle-2 VLM（1.34B参数）负责视觉语言语义理解，System 1采用DiT + flow-matching action head生成高频连续动作。总参数量2.2B。架构关键点：VLM使用middle-layer embeddings（论文称速度更快、成功率更高）；DiT block通过cross-attention连接VLM tokens；action chunk horizon设为16，在L40 GPU bf16下推理时间约63.9ms。数据策略是Data Pyramid：底层为大量human videos/web data（提供广泛先验），中层为synthetic trajectories和neural-generated videos（可扩展，生成约827小时），顶层为少量real robot data（最贵但提供grounding）。通过latent action codebook将无动作视频转化为训练信号，实现跨embodiment数据利用。关键结果：在GR-1人形机器人真机tabletop manipulation任务上，Full Data平均成功率达76.8%，显著优于Diffusion Policy的46.4%。论文同时展示了跨embodiment能力（SO100、Libero等benchmark）。文章还对比了与π系列VLA的定位差异，认为GR00T N1更偏向humanoid foundation model全栈系统的首次大规模公开化。官方代码、模型、数据集已开源。
report_titles: Karpathy大神的llm-wiki创意变成可复制的recipe了?SiliconFlow + opencode + OMO,拥有自己的自进化的知识库

arxiv.title: GR00T N1: An Open Foundation Model for Generalist Humanoid Robots
arxiv.abstract: General-purpose robots need a versatile body and an intelligent mind. Recent advancements in humanoid robots have shown great promise as a hardware platform for building generalist autonomy in the human world. A robot foundation model, trained on massive and diverse data sources, is essential for enabling the robots to reason about novel situations, robustly handle real-world variability, and rapidly learn new tasks. To this end, we introduce GR00T N1, an open foundation model for humanoid robots. GR00T N1 is a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model with a dual-system architecture. The vision-language module (System 2) interprets the environment through vision and language instructions. The subsequent diffusion transformer module (System 1) generates fluid motor actions in real time. Both modules are tightly coupled and jointly trained end-to-end. We train GR00T N1 with a heterogeneous mixture of real-robot trajectories, human videos, and synthetically generated datasets. We show that our generalist robot model GR00T N1 outperforms the state-of-the-art imitation learning baselines on standard simulation benchmarks across multiple robot embodiments. Furthermore, we deploy our model on the Fourier GR-1 humanoid robot for language-conditioned bimanual manipulation tasks, achieving strong performance with high data efficiency.

papers.title: ConRAG: Consensus-Driven Multi-View Retrieval for Multi-Hop Question Answering
papers.report_title: 如何掌控你的⾃由时间(English paper)
papers.summary: 武汉大学团队提出ConRAG框架，通过三个独立检索视角（关系、实体锚点、文本证据）的共识投票机制，显著提升多跳问答（Multi-Hop QA）中证据检索的准确性。核心贡献在于：1) 图谱仅作为检索接口，将结构信号桥接到可验证的文本证据，避免额外上下文负担；2) 三视角独立检索后通过src()函数映射至统一证据单元空间进行排序，引入共识加成（公式b(c)=1+λ·max(0,m(c)-1)/2）和度感知惩罚（压制高连接度枢纽实体噪声）；3) 槽位绑定执行机制，使子问题仅传递依赖相关的中间答案，减少token消耗。在HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA、MuSiQue三个基准上，ConRAG在GPT-4o-mini和Gemma-4-31B上全面超越所有基线。MuSiQue（最难基准）上，GPT-4o-mini版Str-Acc达56.2（+10.2）、LLM-Acc达58.7（+4.3），Gemma-4-31B版达到新SOTA（Str-Acc +4.6, LLM-Acc +4.0）。与vanilla RAG相比，平均提升26.9%（LLM-Acc）。效率方面，每查询平均5.64秒，比LogicRAG快42%、比GraphRAG快64%，平均token消耗2,517。消融实验表明三视角均不可缺，单一文本视角最稳（Str-Acc 54.8），但加上关系和实体视角后进一步提升至56.2。该方法实现成本低（三个稠密索引+排序融合），收益高，为多跳RAG场景提供实用的共识驱动范式。论文链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28093
report_titles: 如何掌控你的⾃由时间(English paper)

arxiv.title: ConRAG: Consensus-Driven Multi-View Retrieval for Multi-Hop Question Answering
arxiv.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has emerged as a promising paradigm for enhancing large language models (LLMs) on multi-hop question answering (QA), which requires reasoning over evidence from multiple documents. Current multi-hop RAG methods generally focus on either query-side task decomposition or corpus-side knowledge graph construction. Despite their progress, these methods still struggle to achieve satisfactory performance on complex multi-hop QA tasks. To this end, we propose ConRAG, a consensus-driven multi-view RAG framework that effectively boosts LLMs on complex multi-hop QA. The core of ConRAG is to systematically optimize both the query and corpus sides and to leverage multi-view evidence (relation, entity, and text signals) for more accurate retrieval. Extensive experiments on three multi-hop QA benchmarks show that ConRAG consistently outperforms all baselines by a clear margin, e.g., up to +26.9% average performance gains over vanilla RAG, and enables Gemma-4-31B to achieve a new state-of-the-art record on the challenging MuSiQue benchmark.

papers.title: Evolving-RL: End-to-End Optimization of Experience-Driven Self-Evolving Capability within Agents
papers.report_title: 超越GRPO与SkillRL!小红书提出自进化智能体技能RL新范式,单模型协同无需分模块训练
papers.summary: 小红书团队提出Evolving-RL框架，首次实现经验提取与使用在同一模型参数内协同进化，解决了现有经验自进化智能体中劣质经验导致自失效的根本问题。核心创新在于：将提取器与求解器共享同一主干模型参数，通过源任务交互、文本技能抽取、下游多任务评测、双向联合优化四步闭环，让模型在训练中同时学会提炼高质量技能和高效运用技能。在ALFWorld文本居家交互基准上，Evolving-RL在未知任务中相对GRPO基线最高提升98.7%（无技能成功率45.5%→81.1%，带技能88.6%），整体成功率带技能达96.0%；Mind2Web网页操控基准上，整体动作准确率从GRPO的22.83%提升至30.87%，跨任务场景准确率从28.79%飙升至41.99%。消融实验证实联合优化是性能拉满的必要条件：单独训练提取器导致技能过拟合无法泛化，单独训练求解器则模型养成无视技能的决策习惯。技能跨模型迁移实验显示，Evolving-RL提炼的技能可显著提升原基座模型（45.5%→60.4%）和GRPO模型（79.9%→88.8%）的表现，证明技能具有通用性。该方法以Qwen2.5-7B为基座，所有实验重复5轮取平均，数据可靠。该框架不仅满足智能体上线后持续自主学习进化的需求，还可作为通用增强型RL算法优化基座模型泛化能力，适用于网页交互、具身智能、工具调用等多种场景。
report_titles: 超越GRPO与SkillRL!小红书提出自进化智能体技能RL新范式,单模型协同无需分模块训练

arxiv.title: Evolving-RL: End-to-End Optimization of Experience-Driven Self-Evolving Capability within Agents
arxiv.abstract: Experience-driven self-evolving agents aim to overcome the static nature of large language models by distilling reusable experience from past interactions, thus enabling adaptation to novel tasks at deployment time. This process places substantial demands on the foundation model's capacities for abstraction, generalization, and in-context learning. However, most existing studies focus primarily on system-level design choices, such as how experience is represented and managed, neglecting the inherent capabilities of the underlying model. While some recent works have started to optimize the experience utilization stage via reinforcement learning, they still fail to treat self-evolution as a unified process to be jointly optimized. To this end, we propose Evolving-RL, an efficient algorithmic framework that jointly improves the experience extraction and utilization capabilities required for self-evolution. Specifically, we center the learning process on experience extraction and evaluation, using the two supervisory signals derived from evaluation to optimize the extractor and solver separately and thus enable their coordinated co-evolution. Experiments on ALFWorld and Mind2Web show that Evolving-RL effectively enhances LLMs' ability to extract and reuse experience, leading to strong performance gains on out-of-distribution tasks (up to 98.7% relative improvement over the GRPO bas

papers.title: GrepSeek: Training Search Agents for Direct Corpus Interaction
papers.report_title: UMass等提出GrepSeek:不用切chunk,不用向量索引,让Search Agent直接grep 2100万篇语料
papers.summary: GrepSeek提出Direct Corpus Interaction (DCI)范式，让Search Agent直接对原始语料（2018年Wikipedia dump，2100万passages，14GB）执行rg、grep等shell命令，无需切chunk和向量索引。采用两阶段训练：cold-start SFT（1万条自动构造轨迹，覆盖Natural Questions和HotpotQA各半）和GRPO（200 steps，采样5条轨迹，token-level F1+格式约束）。在7个数据集上的平均F1为0.5691，超越RAG(0.4905)、Search-O1(0.5021)、Rejection Sampling(0.5133)、Search-R1(0.5441)等基线。多跳任务表现突出：HotpotQA F1 0.6231，2Wiki 0.5178，MuSiQue 0.3006。但PopQA上F1仅0.4861（低于Search-R1的0.5101），因长尾实体精确匹配受限。成本方面：内存占用仅14GB（E5需70GB，Qwen3-Embedding-4B需221GB），离线索引约1分钟（E5需3.2 A100小时，Qwen3需62.4 A100小时）。端到端延迟8.67秒（LLM解码占7.86秒，搜索工具仅0.81秒）。并行引擎将延迟从5.39秒(1 shard)降至0.71秒(32 shards)。消融实验：去掉SFT导致F1降至0.3314，去掉GRPO降至0.4249，验证两阶段缺一不可。GRPO训练中Agent命令数从3.06降至2.56，但取回行数从5增至10，响应tokens从4251增至6409。论文指出DCI更适合作为精确检索能力，与语义检索互补。
report_titles: UMass等提出GrepSeek:不用切chunk,不用向量索引,让Search Agent直接grep 2100万篇语料

arxiv.title: GrepSeek: Training Search Agents for Direct Corpus Interaction
arxiv.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) search agents have shown strong promise for knowledge-intensive language tasks through multiple rounds of reasoning and information retrieval. Most existing systems access information using a retriever that takes a keyword or natural language query and returns a ranked list of documents using an index of pre-computed document representations. In this work, we explore a complementary perspective in which the search agent treats the corpus itself as the search environment and finds evidence by issuing executable shell commands. We introduce GrepSeek, an optimized direct corpus interaction (DCI) search agent that trains a compact search agent to find, filter, and compose evidence from large text corpora. To address the instability of learning behavior directly with reinforcement learning on large corpora, we propose a two-stage training pipeline. First, we construct a cold-start dataset using an answer-aware Tutor and answer-blind Planner to generate verified, causally grounded search trajectories. Second, we refine the initialized policy with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), allowing the agent to improve its task-oriented search behavior through direct interaction with the corpus. To make DCI practical at scale, we further use a semantics-preserving sharded-parallel execution engine that accelerates shell-based retrieval by up to $7.6\times$ w

papers.title: Reweighted Wake-Sleep
papers.report_title: 谷歌最新记忆研究:LLM 也需要睡觉,短期记忆怎么变成长期知识?
papers.summary: 本文解读Google Research与Cornell大学关于LLM持续学习的论文，提出Wake/Sleep范式。核心贡献：Memory Consolidation通过参数扩展（sparse MoE新增low-rank expert）和Knowledge Seeding（smaller self蒸馏给larger self）将短期经验沉淀为长期参数；Dreaming阶段用RL-based data selection生成并筛选synthetic data。关键实验数据：在CLINC/Banking/DBpedia class-incremental分类上Sleep显著优于ICL、EWC等方法；在MK-NIAH、LongHealth、QASPER长上下文任务中随consolidation stages增加性能提升；BABILong上扩展到10M tokens接近perfect score；Qwen3-8B在AIME-24上从73.8提升至79.2（Sleep），AIME-25达69.0；SQuAD知识融入中Sleep-4L达48.9（单段落），持续预训练下46.2。消融实验表明去掉imitation learning或expansion均导致数学性能下降。该研究为LLM终身学习提供了架构无关的工程框架。

arxiv.title: Reweighted Wake-Sleep
arxiv.abstract: Training deep directed graphical models with many hidden variables and performing inference remains a major challenge. Helmholtz machines and deep belief networks are such models, and the wake-sleep algorithm has been proposed to train them. The wake-sleep algorithm relies on training not just the directed generative model but also a conditional generative model (the inference network) that runs backward from visible to latent, estimating the posterior distribution of latent given visible. We propose a novel interpretation of the wake-sleep algorithm which suggests that better estimators of the gradient can be obtained by sampling latent variables multiple times from the inference network. This view is based on importance sampling as an estimator of the likelihood, with the approximate inference network as a proposal distribution. This interpretation is confirmed experimentally, showing that better likelihood can be achieved with this reweighted wake-sleep procedure. Based on this interpretation, we propose that a sigmoidal belief network is not sufficiently powerful for the layers of the inference network in order to recover a good estimator of the posterior distribution of latent variables. Our experiments show that using a more powerful layer model, such as NADE, yields substantially better generative models.

papers.title: Crafter: A Multi-Agent Harness for Editable Scientific Figure Generation from Diverse Inputs
papers.report_title: AI科研绘图终于开窍了:出图就是可编辑SVG
papers.summary: 该文章解读了UIUC、清华、北大团队推出的多智能体科研绘图系统CRAFTER及配套SVG转换工具CRAFTEDITOR。CRAFTER采用Multi-Agent Harness架构，通过生成-检查-修订闭环生成科研插图，支持文本、草图、掩码、关键元素组合等多种条件输入。关键数据：在PaperBanana-Bench和CRAFTBENCH上综合得分最高，消融实验显示去掉任一核心机制分数下降5.04-8.90分。CRAFTEDITOR可将栅格图转为可编辑SVG，经三个VLM评审，综合得分8.04，显著高于AutoFigure-Edit的6.91和Edit-Banana的3.69，在位置、颜色、文本等各维度均领先。系统运行在单块NVIDIA Titan 24GB显卡上。论文已在arXiv公开（2605.30611），代码已开源。对需要批量生成或迭代论文插图的AI研究者而言，该系统能显著减少从文本到可编辑矢量图的工程开销，值得验证其在不同领域图（方法图、Poster、信息图）上的实际效果。

arxiv.title: Crafter: A Multi-Agent Harness for Editable Scientific Figure Generation from Diverse Inputs
arxiv.abstract: Scientific figures are among the most effective means of communicating complex research ideas, yet producing publication-quality illustrations remains one of the most labor-intensive parts of paper preparation. Existing automated systems each target a single figure type under text-only input, leaving the diversity of types and conditions researchers actually use unaddressed; their raster outputs further cannot be locally revised. Because scientific figures are structured compositions of discrete semantic components, the localized errors generators produce on such layouts demand not a stronger backbone but a harness. We instantiate this harness in two complementary systems: Crafter, a multi-agent harness for figure generation that generalizes across figure types and input conditions without architectural changes, and CraftEditor, which applies the same pattern to convert raster outputs into editable SVGs. Moreover, we introduce CraftBench, a benchmark spanning three figure types and four input conditions with human quality annotation. Experiments show that Crafter substantially outperforms both standalone generators and the agentic baseline on PaperBanana-Bench and CraftBench, with ablations confirming each component's independent contribution; CraftEditor faithfully converts outputs into editable SVGs that surpass all baselines. papers.title: Benchmarks are Not Enough: RAMP for Runtime Assessing of Agentic Models in Production Systems
papers.report_title: 中山大学RAMP实测:15款Agent进生产级编译流水线,无一零干预跑通全程
papers.summary: 中山大学团队基于YatCC平台构建RAMP评测框架，将15款主流LLM Agent放入六段串行编译流水线（T0环境搭建→T5后端生成），在持久仓库、串行依赖环境下量化工程韧性。核心发现：无复活模式（Mode 2）下，无模型完成全程，任务完成率从T0 100%跌至T4 0%、T5 20%，平均MR 42.7（仅比无Agent基线23.38高17.6分）。主榜单（Mode 1含Resurrection）前五名：Claude Opus 4.7 (MR 93.39, 花费126.24 USD)、DeepSeek V4 Pro (85.34, 8.68 USD)、DeepSeek V4 Flash (66.48, 3.43 USD)、GPT-5.5 (65.91, 8.77 USD)、Qwen 3.6 Max (56.72, 67.28 USD)。API花费极差2525倍，Opus 4.7 MR仅比DeepSeek V4 Pro高9.4%但费用高14.5倍。60%模型因Context Failure终止（集中在T2-T3），53.3%出现Planning Failure。AEI指标显示GPT-5.5 (81.57)优于Opus 4.7 (约40)。三种退化模式：渐进衰减、错误放大（如DeepSeek V4 Pro T3 83.6→T4 38.6）、断崖式断裂（如GPT-5.5前四段满分→T5 0分）。Resurrection协议使用golden artifact修复中间产物，避免连锁崩盘。论文强调静态benchmark与生产级串行依赖的差距，过程指标（Token、时间、成本）与主指标同等重要。链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27492。

arxiv.title: Benchmarks are Not Enough: RAMP for Runtime Assessing of Agentic Models in Production Systems
arxiv.abstract: LLM agents are rapidly evolving from coding assistants into autonomous software engineering systems. However, existing evaluation methodologies remain largely centered on static, isolated, and short-horizon benchmarks that fail to capture the dynamic complexity of real-world production workflows. As a result, benchmark performance may poorly reflect practical capability under realistic runtime environments involving long execution chains, tool interactions, dependency management, and iterative feedback loops. We thus present RAMP, a production-grounded infrastructure for assessing long-horizon software engineering agents. Built upon the YatCC integrated platform, RAMP provides a unified runtime assessment architecture through standardized orchestration and execution interfaces. RAMP introduces realistic compiler-construction workloads with serial dependencies and complex toolchain interactions, together with a staged recovery mechanism for analyzing execution behavior under partial workflow failure. The framework further incorporates utility-oriented multi-dimensional metrics that jointly evaluate outcome quality and process efficiency. We conduct runtime assessments across 15 mainstream models and observe substantial capability degradation that remains largely invisible to conventional isolated benchmarks. papers.report_title: 三分钟论文速递 | 大模型是真的会推理,还是在背答案?
papers.summary: 本文深度解读ICML 2026论文《SYNTHWORLDS: Controlled Parallel Worlds for Disentangling Reasoning and Knowledge in Language Models》，该研究提出SYNTHWORLDS框架，通过构建结构相同但实体名称不同的平行语料库（真实世界 vs 合成世界），首次实现了推理能力与事实知识的彻底解耦。研究人员从Wikidata自动生成6,290篇平行文档（约150万token），设计多跳问答与页面导航两个可控任务。关键数据：闭卷设置下，模型在真实世界的F1平均约20（不同模型17-22），而合成世界接近0（0.2-1.8），知识优势差距（KA）显著。单步RAG反而扩大差距（GPT-5-mini的KA从21.4升至25.4）；而迭代检索+思维链推理（IRCoT）可有效缩小差距（GPT-5-mini KA降至16.2，Gemini-2.0-Flash KA从18.8降至8.5）。页面导航任务中，仅链接条件下真实世界成功率40-51%，合成世界16-20%；即便提供完整页面内容，真实世界中参数化知识仍提供“捷径”（GPT-5-mini约48%的推理步骤提及外部实体）。论文系统评估了GPT-5-mini、Gemini-2.0-Flash、Kimi-K2等6个主流模型，证实知识优势差距普遍存在且难以完全消除。对于评估大模型推理能力的研究者，SYNTHWORLDS提供了可扩展的量化基准和严格的解耦方法论，其代码已开源。

arxiv.title: SynthWorlds: Controlled Parallel Worlds for Disentangling Reasoning and Knowledge in Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Evaluating the reasoning ability of language models (LMs) is complicated by their extensive parametric world knowledge, where benchmark performance often reflects factual recall rather than genuine reasoning. Existing datasets and approaches (e.g., temporal filtering, paraphrasing, adversarial substitution) cannot cleanly separate the two. We present SynthWorlds, a framework that disentangles task reasoning complexity from factual knowledge. In SynthWorlds, we construct parallel corpora representing two worlds with identical interconnected structure: a real-mapped world, where models may exploit parametric knowledge, and a synthetic-mapped world, where such knowledge is meaningless. On top of these corpora, we design two mirrored tasks as case studies: multi-hop question answering and page navigation, which maintain equal reasoning difficulty across worlds. Experiments in parametric-only (e.g., closed-book QA) and knowledge-augmented (e.g., retrieval-augmented) LM settings reveal a persistent knowledge advantage gap, defined as the performance boost models gain from memorized parametric world knowledge. Knowledge acquisition and integration mechanisms reduce but do not eliminate this gap, highlighting opportunities for system improvements. papers.title: PIM-AI: A Novel Architecture for High-Efficiency LLM Inference
papers.report_title: GPU 跑大模型太耗电?PIM-AI 把 LLM 推理搬进 DDR5/LPDDR5 内存芯片大模型推理为什么贵?
papers.summary: 本文解读论文《PIM-AI: A Novel Architecture for High-Efficiency LLM Inference》，提出一种将大语言模型推理计算搬进DDR5/LPDDR5内存芯片的存内计算架构。PIM-AI采用stacked die设计，上层DRAM提供容量，下层logic die集成4个RISC-V处理器、tensor/vector units，支持INT4/FP16/BF16。兼容现有DDR/LPDDR生态，双模式工作（标准内存模式与PIM加速模式）。一个PIM-AI DIMM提供32GB容量、1.6TB/s聚合带宽、128 TFLOPs（FP16/BF16）。云端实验（模拟器）显示：在Llama2-70B和Mixtral-8x22B上，decoding阶段tokens/s是DGX-H100的2.23×-2.75×，energy/token低15%-40%；整体QPS高55%，3年TCO per QPS优势达6.2×-6.94×。移动端对比A17 Pro：tokens/s提升49.6%，energy/token低约20×，energy/query低13.4×。首token延迟在encoding阶段PIM-AI偏高（约3×），但能效优势明显。文章指出PIM-AI特别适合memory-bound的decoding阶段，但基于模拟器结果，实际芯片待验证。

arxiv.title: PIM-AI: A Novel Architecture for High-Efficiency LLM Inference
arxiv.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have become essential in a variety of applications due to their advanced language understanding and generation capabilities. However, their computational and memory requirements pose significant challenges to traditional hardware architectures. Processing-in-Memory (PIM), which integrates computational units directly into memory chips, offers several advantages for LLM inference, including reduced data transfer bottlenecks and improved power efficiency. This paper introduces PIM-AI, a novel DDR5/LPDDR5 PIM architecture designed for LLM inference without modifying the memory controller or DDR/LPDDR memory PHY. We have developed a simulator to evaluate the performance of PIM-AI in various scenarios and demonstrate its significant advantages over conventional architectures. In cloud-based scenarios, PIM-AI reduces the 3-year TCO per queries-per-second by up to 6.94x compared to state-of-the-art GPUs, depending on the LLM model used. In mobile scenarios, PIM-AI achieves a 10- to 20-fold reduction in energy per token compared to state-of-the-art mobile SoCs, resulting in 25 to 45~\% more queries per second and 6.9x to 13.4x less energy per query, extending battery life and enabling more inferences per charge. These results highlight PIM-AI's potential to revolutionize LLM deployments, making them more efficient, scalable, and sustainable.

papers.title: Do Language Models Need Sleep? Offline Recurrence for Improved Online Inference
papers.report_title: 大模型也需要睡眠:先“休息一下”把记忆整理好再回答
papers.summary: 本文解读了卡内基梅隆大学和马里兰大学的论文《Do Language Models Need Sleep? Offline Recurrence for Improved Online Inference》（arXiv 2605.26099）。核心思想：SSM-Attention混合大模型在长上下文推理中，瓶颈并非记忆容量而是计算深度。作者提出“睡眠巩固”机制：在KV cache被清空前，对同一窗口执行多轮前向传播（sleep pass），让SSM fast weights被反复改写，从而在不增加推理延迟的前提下提升深度推理能力。关键实验结果：1）在二进制演化合成任务（t=32步）中，无sleep模型训练5B token后准确率仅约10%，而4-loop sleep模型超过30%；2）在Depo多跳图遍历任务（16-hop）中，4-loop模型仍能改善，而2-loop和0-loop停滞；3）在GSM-Infinite数学推理任务（2000-3300 token长上下文）中，滑动窗口设置下，N=4 sleep将2-operation问题准确率从59.6%提升至90.5%，且各操作数上N越大提升越明显。训练吞吐随N增大而下降（约反比），但预测延迟不变。该工作将记忆巩固需要计算深度的问题从容量问题中分离出来，提出“存储（fast weights）、读取（attention）、巩固（sleep recurrence）”三段分工。局限性：当前结果集中于合成任务和中规模模型，扩展到更大模型及真实任务需验证。

arxiv.title: Do Language Models Need Sleep? Offline Recurrence for Improved Online Inference
arxiv.abstract: Transformer-based large language models are increasingly used for long-horizon tasks; however, their attention mechanism scales poorly with context length. To handle this, we study a sleep-like consolidation mechanism in which a model periodically converts recent context into persistent fast weights before clearing its key-value cache. During sleep, the model performs $N$ offline recurrent passes over the accumulated context and updates the fast weights in its state-space model (SSM) blocks through a learned local rule. During inference, this shifts extra computation to sleep while preserving the latency of wake-time prediction. We test our method on controlled synthetic tasks, including cellular automata and multi-hop graph retrieval, as well as a realistic math reasoning task, on which a regular transformer as well as SSM-attention hybrid models fail. We then show that increasing sleep duration $N$ for our models improves performance, with the largest gains on examples that require deeper reasoning.

papers.report_title: 推理强度到底应该怎么设置?腾讯提出 HRBench 首次统一评测混合推理模型
papers.summary: 港科大广州与腾讯联合提出的HRBench，首次建立统一框架评测混合推理模型的思考切换策略。论文在3类切换策略（Prompt-Tuning、Routing、Speculative）、4种训练范式（TF/SFT/DPO/GRPO）、6个模型（2B~1.1T参数）、5个基准（MATH500、AIME2025、GPQA-Diamond、LiveCodeBench、Codeforces）上进行了527次实验。核心发现：Prompt-Tuning在Qwen3.5-9B上平均准确率47.6%，比Full-Think节省24% token；Routing节省13% token但准确率44.1%；Speculative准确率45.8%但token升至21.2k（高于Full-Think）。策略效果随模型尺度变化：9B和1.1T上Prompt-Tuning最优，20B和671B上Speculative反超，2B上三者无差异。任务类型也影响最优解：数学/科学任务Prompt-Tuning更优，代码任务Speculative准确率提升13.9点但token增加6.4%。训练主要带来效率提升而非准确率暴涨：准确率仅提升1-2点，token节省达12%-65%，其中Routing在GRPO下token降幅最大（65%）。论文还将10余种已有方法统一重测，发现无人能跨任务全面统治。这些结论为混合推理的工程部署提供了可量化的策略选择依据。

arxiv.title: HRBench: Benchmarking and Understanding Thinking-Mode Switch Strategies in Hybrid-Reasoning LLMs
arxiv.abstract: Hybrid-reasoning large language models (LLMs) expose explicit controls over reasoning effort, allowing users or systems to trade off answer quality against inference cost. However, existing methods for adaptive thinking-mode selection are typically evaluated under different models, datasets, and implementation assumptions, making it difficult to compare their practical behavior. We introduce HRBench, a unified evaluation framework for studying thinking-mode switching in hybrid-reasoning LLMs. HRBench organizes the design space along two axes: three switching strategy families, prompt-based selection, external routing, and speculative execution, and four training regimes, training-free, SFT, offline and online RL, yielding 12 controlled evaluation settings. We evaluate these settings across 6 LLMs, from Qwen3.5-2B to Kimi-K2.5-1.1T, and 5 reasoning benchmarks covering mathematics, science, and code, while reimplementing 12+ representative prior methods within the same pipeline. Our analysis characterizes how different switching strategies occupy distinct effectiveness-efficiency trade-off regions: prompt-based methods often provide favorable token-accuracy trade-offs, routing methods offer more stable cost reduction, and speculative methods tend to improve accuracy at higher token cost. papers.title: MUSE-Autoskill: Self-Evolving Agents via Skill Creation, Memory, Management, and Evaluation
papers.report_title: 任务完成率超越Hermes!字节提出自进化智能体技能框架,复用生成技能Token直降20%
papers.summary: 本文介绍字节跳动与RIT联合提出的MUSE-Autoskill框架，将Agent技能管理系统化为五段生命周期（创建、记忆、管理、评估、精炼）。技能定义为结构化目录（含SKILL.md、scripts/、resources/、tests/），支持技能级记忆（.memory.md）记录专属经验。核心贡献：在SkillsBench 51个真实任务上，MUSE带人类技能达到68.40%总体准确率（Codex 67.28%、Hermes 61.21%）；自生成技能在35个可覆盖任务上二阶段准确率87.94%（高于人类技能参考线）。技能可跨Agent迁移：Hermes使用MUSE生成技能后准确率从47.89%提升至58.40%，追回79%差距。成本分析：生成一个技能中位成本383K tokens/164秒，复用约3次即可回本；自生成技能使MUSE中位每任务token从615K降至493K、耗时从656秒降至411秒、turn从19降至15。技能解剖显示MUSE生成SKILL.md中位326行（人类技能146行），是唯一自带tests/的包。论文确认技能主要收益在“成功经验固化”，当前瓶颈在覆盖率（51个任务中68.6%可生成），不支持冷启动。

arxiv.title: MUSE-Autoskill: Self-Evolving Agents via Skill Creation, Memory, Management, and Evaluation
arxiv.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents rely on reusable skills to solve complex tasks, but existing skill creation approaches often treat skills as isolated, static artifacts, limiting reusability, reliability, and long-term improvement. We propose MUSE-Autoskill Agent (Memory-Utilizing Skill Evolution), a skill-centric agent framework that creates, reuses, and refines skills under a unified lifecycle: creation, memory, management, evaluation, and refinement. MUSE creates skills on demand, stores them across tasks, retrieves them through a skill catalog, and accumulates per-skill experience for later reuse and adaptation. Across the main reported settings on SkillsBench and SkillLearnBench, MUSE-Autoskill outperforms Hermes, Codex, and Claude Code. On SkillsBench, its self-created skills surpass human-authored skills on the successfully covered subset (85.24% vs. 81.17%), showing that lifecycle-managed skills can distill agent experience into highly effective reusable assets; MUSE-created skills also transfer to Hermes more effectively than Codex- or Claude-created skills, reaching 51.90% accuracy under transfer. These results highlight the importance of treating skills as long-lived, experience-aware, and testable assets.

papers.title: EFC++: Elastic Feature Consolidation with Prototype Re-balancing for Cold Start Exemplar-free Incremental Learning
papers.report_title: 花了那么多token,Agent Harness到底有效果吗?哈工大给 Harness 找到了Scaling Law:真正关键的指标是＂有效反馈＂
papers.summary: 哈尔滨工业大学提出有效反馈算力（EFC）指标，量化Agent轨迹中真正改变后续行为的有用反馈。在受控合成任务中，原始算力指标（raw tokens、tool calls等）预测失败率的R²最高仅0.42，而Oracle-EFC/D_task达到0.99。关键干预实验：控制原始预算完全一致（差异0.000%），仅改变反馈质量，成功率从0.27跃升至0.90。EFC由信息量（I）、有效性（V）、非冗余相关性（R）、记忆更新（M）四个因子的连乘积累加构成。论文设计了三个版本：Oracle-EFC（需隐藏状态）、Estimated-EFC（仅用轨迹可观测特征）、NRS-EFC（针对真实场景的噪声重复环境）。在HumanEval等代码任务上，Estimated-EFC/D_task的R²达0.97，远超raw tokens的0.78。进一步拆解发现，harness效率η（EFC/原始成本）解释成功率变化的R²=0.97，而原始成本仅0.01。模块消融定位了路由质量、验证器强度、记忆保真度是提升η的关键。前瞻留出测试中，NRS-EFC/D_task在未知任务、harness、模型组合上R²仍达0.85。该工作为Agent系统从“堆算力”转向“优化反馈效率”提供了量化坐标。
report_titles: 花了那么多token,Agent Harness到底有效果吗?哈工大给 Harness 找到了Scaling Law:真正关键的指标是＂有效反馈＂

arxiv.title: EFC++: Elastic Feature Consolidation with Prototype Re-balancing for Cold Start Exemplar-free Incremental Learning
arxiv.abstract: Exemplar-free Class Incremental Learning (EFCIL) aims to learn from a sequence of tasks without having access to previous task data. In this paper, we consider the challenging Cold Start scenario in which insufficient data is available in the first task to learn a high-quality backbone. This is especially challenging for EFCIL since it requires high plasticity, resulting in feature drift which is difficult to compensate for in the exemplar-free setting. To address this problem, we propose an effective approach to consolidate feature representations by regularizing drift in directions highly relevant to previous tasks while employing prototypes to reduce task-recency bias. Our approach, which we call Elastic Feature Consolidation++ (EFC++) exploits a tractable second-order approximation of feature drift based on a proposed Empirical Feature Matrix (EFM). The EFM induces a pseudo-metric in feature space which we use to regularize feature drift in important directions and to update Gaussian prototypes. In addition, we introduce a post-training prototype re-balancing phase that updates classifiers to compensate for feature drift. Experimental results on CIFAR-100, Tiny-ImageNet, ImageNet-Subset, ImageNet-1K and DomainNet demonstrate that EFC++ is better able to learn new tasks by maintaining model plasticity and significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art.

papers.title: Enhancing Instruction Prefetching via Cache and TLB Management
papers.report_title: CPU 前端越来越“吃力”,指令预取还能怎么救?读懂 IP-CaT:用 Cache + TLB 联动增强指令预取
papers.summary: 本文详细解读论文《Enhancing Instruction Prefetching via Cache and TLB Management》，提出IP-CaT（Instruction Prefetch Centric Cache and TLB Management），通过协同管理TLB和L2 Cache来增强L1指令预取效果。现代服务器程序指令工作集年增近30%，前端瓶颈突出：跨页预取受地址翻译延迟拖累，预取进入L2的代码行复用价值差异大（EPI预取器下36.1%的代码行dead-on-arrival）。IP-CaT包含两个模块：tPB（translation Prefetch Buffer）——缓存L1I跨页预取触发的页表项（64-entry），减少demand sTLB miss造成的page walk；TIPRP（Trimodal Instruction Prefetch Replacement Policy）——动态选择保护（PIP）、降优先级（NPIP）或绕过（BIP）预取代码行，基于两级饱和计数器决策。在ChampSim模拟（类似Intel Cascade Lake，32KB L1I，1MB L2）105个单核服务器负载下，与EPI预取器结合获得6.1%几何平均加速，超过CHiRP、Morrigan、CLIP等方案；sTLB MPKI降低31.6%。多核（160个4核混合）和SMT场景下也分别获得7.2%和7.1%加速（vs CHiRP）。硬件存储开销仅约0.79KB（L2容量的0.08%），无需修改L1I预取器自身。

arxiv.title: Enhancing Instruction Prefetching via Cache and TLB Management
arxiv.abstract: Modern server workloads exhibit massive instruction footprints that heavily pressure the processor front-end, making L1 instruction (L1I) prefetching critical for sustaining performance. However, this paper shows that current L1I prefetchers fail to reach their full potential due to two key limitations. First, L1I prefetches crossing page boundaries require address translation before issuance, and translation latency reduces prefetch timeliness. Second, the reuse behavior of code lines fetched by L1I prefetches is highly heterogeneous: while some lines are reused many times, others are dead-on-arrival. This paper introduces Instruction Prefetch-Centric Cache and TLB Management (IP-CaT), the first microarchitectural framework jointly optimizing TLB and cache management for L1I prefetching. IP-CaT consists of two components: (i) the translation Prefetch Buffer (tPB), a small structure colocated with the second-level TLB (sTLB) that stores page table entries fetched by page-crossing L1I prefetches, reducing translation overheads; and (ii) the Trimodal Instruction Prefetch Replacement Policy (TIPRP), a decision-tree-based L2 cache replacement policy specialized for lines fetched by L1I prefetches. papers.summary: Qwen团队发布Qwen-VLA，统一视觉-语言-动作模型，同一套参数驱动32种以上机器人（单/双臂、人形、轮式导航等）。架构拆分为Qwen3.5-4B认知大脑+1.15B DiT动作小脑，通过本体感知提示区分不同平台。四阶段训练：T2A纯文本预训练建立语言-动作先验（2000步后过拟合），CPT视觉 grounding，SFT多任务微调，RL稀疏奖励优化（仅单一环境SimplerEnv）。在8个benchmark上追平或超越专家模型：LIBERO 97.9%（最佳98.6%）、Simpler-WidowX 73.7%（超专家9.1%）、RoboTwin-Hard 87.2%（超此前最佳2.2%）。真机ALOHA域内83.6%，OOD泛化（颜色/实例/背景/指令）平均76.9%，超过π0.5达35.4%，超过从零训练版40.7%。具备零样本动态操作能力（DOMINO SR 26.6%，超过部分专门微调方法9.4%）。消融关键：T2A混合20%合成+80%真机最优（71.09%）；显式状态条件几乎无用；混入视觉语言数据无干扰只有增益；RL训练环境增益可迁移至未见环境。

arxiv.title: Qwen-VLA: Unifying Vision-Language-Action Modeling across Tasks, Environments, and Robot Embodiments
arxiv.abstract: Embodied intelligence is often studied through specialized models for individual tasks such as manipulation or navigation, resulting in fragmented capabilities and limited generalization across tasks, environments, and robot embodiments. In this work, we study whether heterogeneous embodied decision-making problems can be unified within a single vision-language-action model. We present Qwen-VLA, a unified embodied foundation model that extends Qwen's vision-language modeling stack from perception, understanding, and reasoning to continuous action and trajectory generation through a DiT-based action decoder. Qwen-VLA is trained with a large-scale joint pretraining recipe over diverse data sources, including robotics manipulation trajectories, human egocentric demonstrations, synthetic simulation data, vision-and-language navigation data, trajectory-centric supervision, and auxiliary vision-language data. To support multiple robot platforms, we introduce embodiment-aware prompt conditioning, where robot-specific textual descriptions specify the current embodiment and control convention. We further cast manipulation, navigation, and trajectory prediction into a unified action-and-trajectory prediction framework, enabling transferable visual grounding, spatial reasoning, and continuous action generation across robot morphologies, task families, and environments. papers.title: OmniRetrieval: Unified Retrieval across Heterogeneous Knowledge Sources
papers.report_title: KAIST 把文本、SQL、知识图谱、属性图全打通:一句话提问,跨四种知识源一起检索
papers.summary: 本文介绍KAIST与DeepAuto.ai提出的OmniRetrieval框架，首次实现从单一自然语言问题自动检索文本、SQL数据库、RDF知识图谱和属性图四种异构知识源。核心创新在于“统一访问层”而非“统一表示”：保留各源原生查询语言（自由文本、SQL、SPARQL、Cypher），通过三步流程（选源→母语查询生成→跨源证据筛选）完成检索。基准覆盖309个知识库、13个数据集（包括BEIR 7域、Spider 206库、BIRD 80库、Wikidata、Text2Cypher 15图等），在5个骨干模型（GPT-5.4、Gemini-3.1、Sonnet-4.6、Qwen-3.5 27B、Gemma-4 31B）上平均结果为：选源准确率65.71%，检索准确率44.34%，LLM Judge评分65.88%，全面超越单源基线（选源24.84%、检索17.83%、Judge 27.99%）和KB Routing（61.65%、39.98%、57.99%）。关键发现：选源是最大瓶颈，与Oracle上界差距在证据筛选阶段可收窄至8.67分（Judge指标）；多候选数k并非越大越好，k=3时选源准确率67.5%，k=10时降至62.8%。框架设计证明了“保持各源母语”路线在真实大规模部署中的可行性（如Wikidata 150亿三元组无法统一索引）。
report_titles: KAIST 把文本、SQL、知识图谱、属性图全打通:一句话提问,跨四种知识源一起检索

arxiv.title: OmniRetrieval: Unified Retrieval across Heterogeneous Knowledge Sources
arxiv.abstract: Real-world information needs require access to structurally diverse knowledge sources, from unstructured text and relational tables to knowledge graphs and property graphs. Existing retrievers, however, operate over one source at a time under a fixed query language, leaving the broader landscape of available knowledge fragmented behind incompatible interfaces. A natural attempt at unification would collapse these sources into a shared space, but this erases the structural affordances (such as schemas, ontologies, compositional operators) that give each source its expressive power. Effective retrieval over diverse knowledge, therefore, requires not homogenization but an overarching layer that meets each source on its own terms. To achieve this, we present OmniRetrieval, a framework that takes any natural-language query, identifies appropriate knowledge sources, and dispatches source-native queries to their native execution engines. Across an extensive benchmark spanning 13 datasets and 309 distinct knowledge bases over text, relational, and graph-structured sources, OmniRetrieval exceeds single-source baselines, demonstrating that it can serve as a general-purpose interface to the heterogeneous sources while preserving the structural distinctions that make each source valuable.

papers.report_title: NVIDIA把世界模型扩展到4个玩家:24 FPS实时多Agent模拟,训练只看2人也能泛化
papers.summary: 本文介绍NVIDIA等机构提出的Gamma-World，首个支持多Agent实时交互的视频世界模型。核心技术创新包括：Simplex Rotary Agent Encoding（将Agent身份映射到正单纯形顶点，实现param-free、可交换的身份编码，支持从2-player训练泛化到4-player推理）和Sparse Hub Attention（通过可学习hub tokens实现Agent间通信，避免dense attention的平方复杂度）。模型基于Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B，采用三阶段训练（bidirectional teacher→causal student→conditional Self-Forcing distillation），最终在320×480分辨率下实现24 FPS实时生成。实验在多人虚拟环境（movement、mining、combat、building）中进行，核心指标：Memory FVD 184.1（Solaris 333.8）、Grounding FVD 199.3（Solaris 301.9）、Consistency FVD 280.0（Solaris 443.1），全面领先。效率方面，8-player时Sparse Hub Attention的self-attention FLOPs仅981.0G（dense attention为7.6T），latency 4.5ms（dense 17.6ms），整体DiT latency 246ms（dense 611ms）。消融实验证实Simplex编码比learned ID embedding在permutation symmetry和扩展性上更优，Sparse Hub Attention在K=8时取得最佳FVD 223.4。

arxiv.title: Gamma-World: Generative Multi-Agent World Modeling Beyond Two Players
arxiv.abstract: World models for interactive video generation have largely focused on single-agent settings, where future observations are generated from a single control signal. However, many generated environments require multi-agent interaction: multiple players, robots, or embodied agents act simultaneously within a shared space. Scaling world models to such settings requires a principled multi-agent design: agents should remain independently controllable, permutation-symmetric, and support efficient inference while maintaining consistency across time and perspectives. In this paper, we present our generative multi-agent world model for interactive simulation. It introduces Simplex Rotary Agent Encoding, a parameter-free extension of 3D RoPE that represents agents as vertices of a regular simplex in rotary angle space. This gives each agent a distinct phase while making all agents permutation-equivalent, enabling scalable agent identity without learned per-slot identities or a fixed agent ordering. To avoid dense all-to-all attention across agents, we further propose Sparse Hub Attention, where learnable hub tokens mediate token interaction across agents, reducing cross-agent attention cost from quadratic to linear in the number of agents. papers.title: TierCheck: Tiered Checkpointing for Fault Tolerance in Large Language Model Training
papers.report_title: TierCheck:面向大规模语言模型训练容错的分层检查点机制
papers.summary: 本文深度解读TierCheck——一种面向LLM训练异构故障的分层检查点系统。针对LLM训练常见故障（GPU崩溃、节点故障、机架故障），TierCheck采用三层设计：Tier-1本地易失性内存保留轻量级差分检查点实现快速恢复；Tier-2对等节点内存异步复制以容忍单节点故障；Tier-3远程持久存储作为机架级灾难回退。关键数据：在4000亿参数模型评估中，TierCheck将端到端检查点时间压缩到10秒以内；与CheckFreq和Gemini相比，检查点开销降低62.8-82.7%；软件故障下恢复加速3.6-6.9倍，节点故障下1.8-3.5倍，最坏机架故障下仍比基线快1.3-2.5倍。系统基于DeepSpeed实现，兼容3D并行（张量并行、流水线并行、ZeRO数据并行）。核心创新包括：自适应梯度压缩（针对小张量用INT8量化，大张量用基于阈值的Top-K稀疏化）、内存中检查点拦截（避免写后读惩罚）、非对称传输调度（差分检查点高频批处理，基础检查点异步分块迁移）。对训练框架研发人员而言，这是值得关注的高质量系统论文。

arxiv.title: TierCheck: Tiered Checkpointing for Fault Tolerance in Large Language Model Training
arxiv.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) training is frequently interrupted by a heterogeneous spectrum of failures, from common GPU crashes to catastrophic cluster-wide outages. Existing checkpointing systems rely on monolithic, single-tier storage backend, forcing a trade-off between state-saving overhead and recovery speed. We propose TierCheck, a cluster-aware tiered checkpointing system that aligns storage placement with failure heterogeneity. TierCheck adopts a three-tier design that maintains lightweight differential checkpoints in local and peer memory for fast localized recovery, while asynchronously migrating heavyweight base checkpoints to remote persistent storage. It also ensures strict global consistency across tiers without stalling training, and achieves fast cluster-aware checkpoint restoration during recovery. Evaluations on models up to 40 billion parameters show that TierCheck achieves low training overhead, reduces end-to-end checkpointing time to under 10s, and supports high-frequency checkpointing, ultimately striking an optimal balance between low-overhead persistence and fast recovery.

papers.title: HiKEY: Hierarchical Multimodal Retrieval for Open-Domain Document Question Answering
papers.report_title: RAG两个死穴,ACL 2026新方案来挑战
papers.summary: 本文解读韩国高丽大学团队被ACL 2026主会接收的论文HiKEY，聚焦工业RAG的两大瓶颈：路由失败和证据碎片化。关键发现：在文档级定位任务中，页面级多模态嵌入方法（如ColPali、M3DocRAG）全面劣于传统文本分块——M3DocVQA Recall上文本分块83.0 vs M3DocRAG 75.6；FRAMES数据集上文本分块66.2 vs VDocRAG 58.5。HiKEY通过三个创新点取得领先：1）重建文档层级树（DHP模块），将每个block的祖先路径作为检索信号；2）两阶段检索：全局路由（Doc_card + BM25+稠密混合）后细粒度排序（文本/表格/图表类型特异评分）；3）祖先感知子图组装，在固定token预算内最大化信息密度。消融实验显示层级路径作为独立字段使Avg R@10提升+4.0；分步路由比直接搜索好12.5个百分点。在FRAMES多跳查询3-hop+上HiKEY保持约4%领先，ANLS达14.6 vs 基线10.8。在0.5K token极小预算下召回率仍达78.8。图表和表格查询提升分别+2.8和+2.9。代码基于M3DocDep的DHP模块，工程可复现。

arxiv.title: HiKEY: Hierarchical Multimodal Retrieval for Open-Domain Document Question Answering
arxiv.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for document-based Open-domain Question Answering (ODQA) on large-scale industrial corpora faces two critical bottlenecks: routing failure in locating the correct document and evidence fragmentation in integrating scattered information. Existing approaches relying on flat text chunks or page-level images inherently struggle to (i) precisely pinpoint the target document among thousands of candidates and (ii) organically connect multimodal evidence, such as tables and figures, within a limited token budget. To address these challenges, we propose HiKEY, a hierarchical tree-based multimodal retrieval framework that elevates document hierarchy to a first-class retrieval signal. Instead of simple chunking, HiKEY reconstructs a logical heterogeneous graph via Document Hierarchical Parsing (DHP), explicitly encoding parent-child relationships. Adopting a hierarchical coarse-to-fine strategy, the framework (1) performs global routing to rapidly prune the search space using hierarchical indexing, and (2) conducts fine-grained retrieval to rank sections by employing a multimodal fusion strategy that captures the most discriminative evidence. Finally, HiKEY assembles a token-efficient evidence subgraph via a hybrid structural-semantic packing strategy. papers.title: Trade-offs in Large Reasoning Models: An Empirical Analysis of Deliberative and Adaptive Reasoning over Foundational Capabilities
papers.report_title: 三分钟论文速递 | 大推理模型的权衡:深思熟虑会削弱基础能力?
papers.summary: 本文解读了论文《Trade-offs in Large Reasoning Models: An Empirical Analysis of Deliberative and Adaptive Reasoning over Foundational Capabilities》，系统评估了DeepSeek、Qwen、LLaMA三个模型家族（7B-70B）的大推理模型（LRM）在获得深思熟虑推理能力后对基础能力的影响。关键发现：蒸馏模型s1.1-32B在指令遵循基准IFEval上表现下降47.38%，推理成本增加250%；安全性方面，模型思考过程的不安全率远高于输出；过长的思考过程反而损害通用任务表现。研究提出了四种自适应推理模式：零思考（将越狱抵抗从28.25提升至89.10）、少思考（最优比例因任务而异）、摘要思考（IFEval提升59.74%）和摘要思考增强。分析表明，摘要模式有效的关键在于大幅减少模型的自省模式（自我反思）。结论：固定推理策略不可行，需动态适配；未来LRM应具备按难度自适应分配推理计算的能力，例如在蒸馏数据中混合短链/长链轨迹，或在强化学习中将推理长度作为奖励因子。

arxiv.title: Trade-offs in Large Reasoning Models: An Empirical Analysis of Deliberative and Adaptive Reasoning over Foundational Capabilities
arxiv.abstract: Recent advancements in Large Reasoning Models (LRMs), such as OpenAI's o1/o3 and DeepSeek-R1, have demonstrated remarkable performance in specialized reasoning tasks through human-like deliberative thinking and long chain-of-thought reasoning. However, our systematic evaluation across various model families (DeepSeek, Qwen, and LLaMA) and scales (7B to 32B) reveals that acquiring these deliberative reasoning capabilities significantly reduces the foundational capabilities of LRMs, including notable declines in helpfulness and harmlessness, alongside substantially increased inference costs. Importantly, we demonstrate that adaptive reasoning -- employing modes like Zero-Thinking, Less-Thinking, and Summary-Thinking -- can effectively alleviate these drawbacks. Our empirical insights underline the critical need for developing more versatile LRMs capable of dynamically allocating inference-time compute according to specific task characteristics.

arxiv.title: A satellite foundation model for improved wealth monitoring
arxiv.abstract: Poverty statistics guide social policy, but in many low- and middle-income countries, censuses and household surveys that collect these data are costly, infrequent, quickly outdated, and sometimes error-prone. Satellite imagery offers global coverage and the possibility of predicting economic livelihoods at scale, yet existing approaches to predicting livelihoods with imagery or other non-traditional data often fail to reliably identify local-level variation and, as we show, degrade under temporal shift. Here we introduce Tempov, a satellite foundation model pretrained by self-supervision on three million bi-temporal Landsat pairs and adapted with parameter-efficient fine-tuning to sparse survey labels. The model enables large-scale, high-resolution wealth mapping and dynamic measurement, including zero-shot nowcasting up to a decade after observed labels, retrospective hindcasting, and decadal change tracking, while outperforming existing neural network and geospatial foundation-model baselines. In low-label regimes, Tempov achieves competitive accuracy with only 10% of survey samples, indicating substantially reduced dependence on expensive label collection. arxiv.title: Clinical Data Goes MEDS? Let's OWL make sense of it
arxiv.abstract: The application of machine learning on healthcare data is often hindered by the lack of standardized and semantically explicit representation, leading to limited interoperability and reproducibility across datasets and experiments. The Medical Event Data Standard (MEDS) addresses these issues by introducing a minimal, event-centric data model designed for reproducible machine-learning workflows from health data. However, MEDS is defined as a data-format specification and does not natively provide integration with the Semantic Web ecosystem. In this article, we introduce MEDS-OWL, a lightweight OWL ontology that provides formal concepts and relations to represent MEDS datasets as RDF graphs. Additionally, we implemented meds2rdf, a Python conversion library that transforms MEDS events into RDF graphs, ensuring conformance with the ontology. We evaluate the proposed approach on two datasets: a synthetic clinical cohort describing care pathways for ruptured intracranial aneurysms, and a real-world subset of MIMIC-IV. To assess semantic consistency, we performed a SHACL validation against the resulting knowledge graphs. The first release of MEDS-OWL comprises 13 classes, 10 object properties, 20 data properties, and 24 OWL axioms. papers.summary: 本文提出探针轨迹框架（Probe Trajectories），通过多实例学习元探测器捕捉大推理模型隐藏表征的时序变化，以监控思维链不忠实行为。关键发现：最大池化策略AUROC可达95%，远优于平均池化和末位令牌法（~50%，接近随机）。模板化训练数据效果媲美真实模型生成数据，大幅降低标注成本。在安全有害性检测任务中，轨迹特征在分布偏移的域外数据集上仍保持稳定判别能力，而静态探针性能严重衰减。在数学推理错误预测任务（GSM8K）上，轨迹特征最高提升AUROC 17个百分点。此外，轨迹特征具备跨类别、跨领域泛化能力。该框架首次揭示了安全与数学推理任务专属的时序规律，为AI安全监控提供了不依赖表面文本的内在动态分析新路径。

However, CoT is not always faithful to the model's final output, undermining its reliability as a monitoring tool. To address this, we investigate the hidden representations of LRMs to determine whether future behavior can be predicted from prompt and CoT representations. By evaluating a probe at each generated token, we construct a probe trajectory, the continuous evolution of a concept's probability across the reasoning process. We find that future model behavior is more distinguishable when examined over the full trajectory than from a single static prediction. To characterize these temporal dynamics, we extract signal-processing features that capture volatility, trend, and steady-state behavior, significantly improving the separation of future model states. We also present two methodological insights. First, template-based training data achieves near-parity with dynamically generated model responses, eliminating the need for a costly initial inference and labeling. Second, the choice of pooling operation is critical: average-pooling and last-token methods collapse to near-random performance, while max-pooling achieves up to 95% AUROC and yields stable probe trajectories. papers.report_title: 打破Agent训练瓶颈!人大&至知研究院开源ClawAgent数据+训练+评测全链条
papers.summary: 针对Claw-style Personal Agent在真实工作区中完成任务面临的数据难构造、轨迹难采集、训练难稳定、奖励难定义等挑战，中国人民大学与至知研究院联合提出ClawGym一体化框架，系统覆盖数据合成、模型训练与可靠评测。该框架包含三个核心：ClawGym-SynData（13.5K可执行合成任务，采用persona-driven top-down与skill-grounded bottom-up双路线生成，自动构建mock workspace并混合code-based+rubric-based验证）、ClawGym-Agents（基于OpenClaw黑盒执行轨迹训练，轨迹平均13轮交互/18.67K tokens/15.82次工具调用/3.25种工具类型；对Qwen3系列进行multi-turn SFT并探索sandbox-parallel RL）、ClawGym-Bench（200个严格筛选任务，覆盖六类工作区场景）。关键性能数据：ClawGym-30B-A3B在Bench上达56.82分，超越参数规模更大的Qwen3-235B-A23B；在外部PinchBench上达86.00，表明合成数据训练出可迁移的工作区执行能力。ClawGym-4B/8B/30B-A3B分别达到47.73/50.24/56.82，均优于对应基座模型。实验揭示了Agent能力的本质并非简单工具调用，而是工作流组织、长程错误恢复与产物验证的能力。团队已开源全部数据、代码、模型检查点。

arxiv.title: ClawGym: A Scalable Framework for Building Effective Claw Agents
arxiv.abstract: Claw-style environments support multi-step workflows over local files, tools, and persistent workspace states. However, scalable development around these environments remains constrained by the absence of a systematic framework, especially one for synthesizing verifiable training data and integrating it with agent training and diagnostic evaluation. To address this challenge, we present ClawGym, a scalable framework that supports the full lifecycle of Claw-style personal agent development. Concretely, we construct ClawGym-SynData, a diverse dataset of 13.5K filtered tasks synthesized from persona-driven intents and skill-grounded operations, paired with realistic mock workspaces and hybrid verification mechanisms. We then train a family of capable Claw-style models, termed ClawGym-Agents, through supervised fine-tuning on black-box rollout trajectories, and further explore reinforcement learning via a lightweight pipeline that parallelizes rollouts across per-task sandboxes. To support reliable evaluation, we further construct ClawGym-Bench, a benchmark of 200 instances calibrated through automated filtering and human-LLM review. Relevant resources have been released at https://github.com/ClawGym.

papers.title: LASA: Language-Agnostic Semantic Alignment at the Semantic Bottleneck for LLM Safety
papers.report_title: ACL 2026 | 7000种语言怎么教?清华阿里找准语义瓶颈,通关多语言安全
papers.summary: 清华CoAI团队与阿里巴巴安全部联合提出LASA（Language-Agnostic Semantic Alignment）方法，通过发现大语言模型中间层的“语义瓶颈层”实现语言无关的安全对齐，相关论文已被ACL 2026接收。研究通过逐层Silhouette分数分析，发现在模型相对深度43%-68%的中间层，不同语言相同语义的表征会自然聚拢，语言外壳被剥离，形成纯语义簇。基于此，LASA采用三步框架：首先定位语义瓶颈层，然后在该层接入参数量不足模型0.2%的轻量安全语义解释器（SSI）提取安全信号，最后将安全信号作为条件变量通过KTO损失进行偏好对齐训练。实验在Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen2.5系列（7B/14B/32B）和Qwen3系列（8B/14B/32B）上进行，使用MultiJail和HarmBench_translated基准评估。核心指标：Llama-3.1-8B平均攻击成功率（ASR）从24.7%降至2.8%，Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct斯瓦希里语ASR从约50%降至13.0%，通用能力（MMLU、MT-Bench）无损失。消融实验证实SSI仅在语义瓶颈层训练最优，替换KTO为SFT或ORPO影响极小，验证了瓶颈层定位和条件控制的核心收益。该方法无需针对每种语言单独收集安全数据，实现了向低资源语言的泛化。论文标题：LASA: Language-Agnostic Semantic Alignment at the Semantic Bottleneck for LLM Safety，arXiv链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.12710。

arxiv.title: LASA: Language-Agnostic Semantic Alignment at the Semantic Bottleneck for LLM Safety
arxiv.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often demonstrate strong safety performance in high-resource languages, yet exhibit severe vulnerabilities when queried in low-resource languages. We attribute this gap to a mismatch between language-agnostic semantic understanding ability and language-dominant safety alignment biased toward high-resource languages. Consistent with this hypothesis, we empirically identify the semantic bottleneck in LLMs, an intermediate layer in which the geometry of model representations is governed primarily by shared semantic content rather than language identity. Building on this observation, we propose Language-Agnostic Semantic Alignment (LASA), which anchors safety alignment directly in semantic bottlenecks. Experiments show that LASA substantially improves safety across all languages: average attack success rate (ASR) drops from 24.7% to 2.8% on LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct and remains around 3-4% across Qwen2.5 and Qwen3 Instruct models (7B-32B). Together, our analysis and method offer a representation-level perspective on LLM safety, suggesting that safety alignment requires anchoring safety understanding not in surface text, but in the model's language-agnostic semantic space.

papers.summary: 本文介绍了由MIT CSAIL、英伟达研究院和浙江大学联合提出的TriAttention技术（arXiv 2604.04921），核心创新是在pre-RoPE空间中利用三角集中度（Triangular Concentration）动态筛选关键KV token，在注意力计算前丢弃非关键token，从而大幅压缩KV Cache。在AIME25数学推理任务（Qwen3-8B，32K生成长度）上，TriAttention实现了KV Cache内存缩减10.7倍、吞吐量提升2.5倍，且准确率与Full Attention持平（40.8%）。AIME24和MATH500上同样零精度损失。实际部署验证中，单张RTX 4090（24GB）配合AWQ INT4量化的Qwen3-32B，在OpenClaw agent工作流中读取6份Markdown文档生成完整周报，未加压缩时显存溢出，加入TriAttention后稳定运行。该方法无需修改模型架构或重新训练，提供开箱即用的vLLM插件，支持OpenAI兼容API和Python接口。与量化路线（如Google TurboQuant）不同，TriAttention属于选择性丢弃token的路线，理论上可与量化叠加以进一步压缩。这一工作指明，对于长上下文推理，KV Cache膨胀已成为主要显存瓶颈，通过智能丢弃而非简单压缩，可显著降低推理资源门槛，使消费级硬件运行生产级大模型成为可能。Apple Silicon（MLX框架）有实验性支持，但尚未达到生产级。论文: TriAttention（arXiv 2604.04921），代码: github.com/WeianMao/triattention。

arxiv.title: TriAttention: Efficient Long Reasoning with Trigonometric KV Compression
arxiv.abstract: Extended reasoning in large language models (LLMs) creates severe KV cache memory bottlenecks. Leading KV cache compression methods estimate KV importance using attention scores from recent post-RoPE queries. However, queries rotate with position during RoPE, making representative queries very few, leading to poor top-key selection and unstable reasoning. To avoid this issue, we turn to the pre-RoPE space, where we observe that Q and K vectors are highly concentrated around fixed non-zero centers and remain stable across positions -- Q/K concentration. We show that this concentration causes queries to preferentially attend to keys at specific distances (e.g., nearest keys), with the centers determining which distances are preferred via a trigonometric series. Based on this, we propose TriAttention to estimate key importance by leveraging these centers. Via the trigonometric series, we use the distance preference characterized by these centers to score keys according to their positions, and also leverage Q/K norms as an additional signal for importance estimation. On AIME25 with 32K-token generation, TriAttention matches Full Attention reasoning accuracy while achieving 2.5x higher throughput or 10.7x KV memory reduction, whereas leading baselines achieve only about half the accuracy at the same efficiency. papers.report_title: Daily Papers | 当 AGI 不再只是概念:Google DeepMind 如何用“人类认知框架”衡量通用智能?
papers.summary: 本文解读了Google DeepMind团队在arXiv上发表的论文《Measuring Progress Towards Artificial General Intelligence: A Cognitive Framework》（链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28405）。该论文提出了一套基于人类认知科学的AGI评估框架，核心贡献包括：①将通用智能拆解为10个认知维度——感知、生成、注意、学习、记忆、推理、元认知、执行功能、问题解决（复合）和社会认知（复合），避免单一benchmark分数的主观性；②设计针对性的held-out认知任务，要求任务私有化、经第三方验证、难度覆盖人类能力范围；③引入人类基线，在相同任务、相同格式下比较AI与人类表现，生成“认知能力剖面”(cognitive profile)，展示系统在各维度的强弱分布。论文通过假想示例（Figure 2）展示了三种剖面形态：部分能力低于人类基线、全部超过人类中位数、全部达到极高人类水平。作者指出，现有benchmark在元认知、注意、学习和社会认知维度存在明显空缺，且高质量公开基准易被训练数据污染。该框架将AGI评估从主观争论推向可量化、可比较、可治理的新阶段。

arxiv.title: Measuring Progress Toward AGI: A Cognitive Framework
arxiv.abstract: Despite widespread discussion of AGI, there is no clear framework for measuring progress toward it. This ambiguity fuels subjective claims, makes it difficult to track progress, and risks hindering responsible governance. As a starting point to address this gap, we present a framework for understanding system capabilities in relation to human cognitive abilities. Drawing from decades of research in psychology, neuroscience, and cognitive science, we introduce a Cognitive Taxonomy that deconstructs general intelligence into 10 key cognitive faculties. We then propose a rigorous evaluation protocol in which a system's performance is measured across a suite of targeted, held-out cognitive tasks, generating a 'cognitive profile' that can be used to understand a system's strengths and weaknesses. We hope this framework will provide a practical roadmap and an initial step toward more rigorous, empirical evaluation of AGI.

papers.report_title: 当大模型遇上全同态加密:这篇论文让“私有微调模型”也能安全推理
papers.summary: 本文解读论文《Sieve: Dynamic Expert-Aware PIM Acceleration for Evolving Mixture-of-Experts Models》，该工作针对现代MoE大模型中专家负载严重不均衡（二峰分布）的问题，提出在GPU+PIM异构系统中运行时动态决定每个专家是放在GPU还是HBM-PIM上执行。关键性能数据：在B200 GPU + HBM-PIM模拟环境下，Sieve在Qwen3.5-397B-A17B上实现约1.3× throughput与interactivity改善，在GPT-OSS-120B上约1.3×，在Qwen3-30B-A3B上约1.6×；在Qwen3.5上batch size=256时相比静态阈值方法PIMoE最高提升26% throughput。调度算法采用轻量贪心启发式（从最热门专家开始尝试移动到GPU），单层调度开销约20µs。核心观察：现代MoE（如GPT-OSS act-ratio仅2.4%@B=1）中大量长尾专家只收到1~4个token（Qwen3-Next中89.3%专家最多收4个），适合在PIM上以GEMV执行；而少数热门专家形成compute-bound GEMM，适合GPU。Sieve通过运行时实时评估token-to-expert分布，动态划分专家集，并重叠GPU计算、PIM计算、HBM传输和跨GPU通信。在prefill-decode混合场景下，Sieve在B=16时相比NoExp（仅attention上PIM）达到2.4×加速。该工作为MoE推理加速提供了动态PIM协同的实用方案，但依赖模拟器且需灵活的PIM command接口。对于从事LLM推理系统优化的研究人员，其动态调度思路值得关注。

arxiv.title: Sieve: Dynamic Expert-Aware PIM Acceleration for Evolving Mixture-of-Experts Models
arxiv.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) has become a dominant architecture for scaling large language models (LLMs). However, the execution characteristics of MoE inference are changing rapidly and increasingly mismatch the assumptions underlying existing Processing-in-Memory (PIM) systems. Prior PIM systems for LLMs rely on static rules to offload memory-bound operations to PIM, without accounting for the combined effects of load imbalance and inter-GPU communication. Meanwhile, modern MoE models activate fewer experts out of increasingly many, creating a bimodal expert distribution: a small set of experts receives many tokens, while a long tail of experts receives only one or a few. We identify a trend in modern MoE models toward increasingly bimodal token-to-expert distributions, quantify the resulting disparity in arithmetic intensity across experts, and show that this disparity dramatically reduces the efficiency of state-of-the-art PIM systems for LLMs. To address this problem, we propose a scheduler for serving MoE models on multi-GPU systems with attached HBM-PIM stacks. Our scheduler partitions expert execution between GPU and PIM based on runtime token-to-expert distributions, while jointly considering interconnect overhead, memory bandwidth, GPU throughput, and PIM throughput. arxiv.title: Memory-R2: Fair Credit Assignment for Long-Horizon Memory-Augmented LLM Agents
arxiv.abstract: Memory-augmented LLM agents enable interactions that extend beyond finite context windows by storing, updating, and reusing information across sessions. However, training such agents with reinforcement learning in multi-session environments is challenging because memory turns the agent's past actions into part of its future environment. Once different rollouts write, update, or delete different memories, they no longer share the same intermediate memory state, making trajectory-level comparisons fundamentally unfair. This violates a key assumption behind group-relative methods such as GRPO, where rollouts are compared as if they were sampled from the same effective environment. Consequently, trajectory-level rewards provide noisy or biased credit signals for long-horizon memory operations. To address this challenge, we introduce Memory-R2, a training framework for long-horizon memory-augmented LLM agents. Its core algorithm, LoGo-GRPO, combines local and global group-relative optimization. The global objective preserves end-to-end learning from long-horizon trajectory-level rewards, while local rerollouts compare different memory-operation outcomes from the same intermediate memory state, yielding fairer group comparisons and more precise supervision for memory construction. papers.report_title: 大模型论文经典解读:HiPLAN的“经验图书馆”与“双层导航”
papers.summary: 本文深度解读了论文《HiPlan: Hierarchical Planning for LLM-Based Agents with Adaptive Global-Local Guidance》。HiPLAN框架为LLM智能体解决长时程任务（如ALFWorld家庭模拟任务超50步、WebShop在线购物超118万商品）中的方向迷失和局部最优问题。核心设计：离线阶段，从500条（ALFWorld）和77条（WebShop）成功轨迹中提取约3300个“里程碑”并构建向量化经验库；在线时采用双层few-shot指导：宏观层面检索相似任务的里程碑序列生成全局指南，微观层面检索相似里程碑的轨迹片段生成逐步提示。在LLaMA 3.3-70B上，ALFWorld任务成功率：HiPLAN 94% vs 基线TRAD 79%、ReAct 50%、Reflexion 56%；其中“Pick Two & Place”子任务达82%（TRAD仅59%）。WebShop成功率：HiPLAN 40% vs TRAD 14%、ReAct 8%、Reflexion 12%。效率方面，完成步数比ReAct减少51%（ALFWorld）和55%（WebShop）。消融实验证明宏观与微观协同不可或缺。论文同时指出局限性：依赖经验库，对语义空间完全陌生的任务效果下降，但可退化至zero-shot模式。该框架适用于家庭服务、电商客服等具有结构重复性的长时程决策场景。

arxiv.title: HiPlan: Hierarchical Planning for LLM-Based Agents with Adaptive Global-Local Guidance
arxiv.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based agents have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in decision-making tasks, but struggle significantly with complex, long-horizon planning scenarios. This arises from their lack of macroscopic guidance, causing disorientation and failures in complex tasks, as well as insufficient continuous oversight during execution, rendering them unresponsive to environmental changes and prone to deviations. To tackle these challenges, we introduce HiPlan, a hierarchical planning framework that provides adaptive global-local guidance to boost LLM-based agents'decision-making. HiPlan decomposes complex tasks into milestone action guides for general direction and step-wise hints for detailed actions. During the offline phase, we construct a milestone library from expert demonstrations, enabling structured experience reuse by retrieving semantically similar tasks and milestones. In the execution phase, trajectory segments from past milestones are dynamically adapted to generate step-wise hints that align current observations with the milestone objectives, bridging gaps and correcting deviations. Extensive experiments across two challenging benchmarks demonstrate that HiPlan substantially outperforms strong baselines, and ablation studies validate the complementary benefits of its hierarchical components.

arxiv.title: FASTER: Rethinking Real-Time Flow VLAs
arxiv.abstract: Real-time execution is crucial for deploying Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models in the physical world. Existing asynchronous inference methods primarily optimize trajectory smoothness, but neglect the critical latency in reacting to environmental changes. By rethinking the notion of reaction in action chunking policies, this paper presents a systematic analysis of the factors governing reaction time. We show that reaction time follows a uniform distribution determined jointly by the Time to First Action (TTFA) and the execution horizon. Moreover, we reveal that the standard practice of applying a constant schedule in flow-based VLAs can be inefficient and forces the system to complete all sampling steps before any movement can start, forming the bottleneck in reaction latency. To overcome this issue, we propose Fast Action Sampling for ImmediaTE Reaction (FASTER). By introducing a Horizon-Aware Schedule, FASTER adaptively prioritizes near-term actions during flow sampling, compressing the denoising of the immediate reaction by tenfold (e.g., in $π_{0.5}$ and X-VLA) into a single step, while preserving the quality of long-horizon trajectory. Coupled with a streaming client-server pipeline, FASTER substantially reduces the effective reaction latency on real robots, especially when deployed on consumer-grade GPUs. papers.summary: 本文深度解读论文《Rule2DRC》，聚焦AI Agent将自然语言工艺设计规则翻译为KLayout DRC脚本的硬核任务。与通用代码生成不同，Rule2DRC构建了包含1,000个rule-to-script任务、13,921个evaluation layouts的benchmark，评估标准不是代码文本相似度，而是实际执行后的violation output与ground-truth一致性。关键设计SplitTester通过主动构造差分测试样例来选出最优候选脚本，实验表明在GPT-OSS-20B的BoN-20设置下，SplitTester相比CodeMonkey将成功率从41.1%提升至44.4%，错误率从14.1%降至12.6%。文章强调DRC是“可验证工件”的典型场景，AI必须能调用工具、读懂日志、修正脚本、生成测试，才能进入真实EDA流程。论文公开的GitHub仓库(code and benchmark data will be updated soon)值得跟踪。这一方向为AI for EDA从“生成内容”向“生成可验证工件”推进提供了工程化思路，对芯片设计中的LVS、STA等环节有示范意义。

arxiv.title: Rule2DRC: Benchmarking LLM Agents for DRC Script Synthesis with Execution-Guided Test Generation
arxiv.abstract: Manufacturable chip layouts must satisfy thousands of geometry-based design rules, and design rule checking (DRC) enforces them by running executable DRC scripts on layouts. Translating natural language rules into correct DRC scripts is labor-intensive and requires specialized expertise, motivating LLM agents for DRC script synthesis and debugging. However, existing benchmarks have small evaluation sets and often evaluate scripts by code similarity rather than execution correctness, and prior machine learning-based methods either ignore execution feedback or require labeled test layouts as agent's input. To this end, we introduce Rule2DRC, a large-scale benchmark for DRC script coding agents with 1,000 rule-to-script tasks and 13,921 evaluation chip layouts for execution-based scoring. Rule2DRC provides an evaluation pipeline that measures functional correctness via DRC execution outcomes without requiring evaluation layouts as input to the agent. We also propose SplitTester, a tester agent for program selection that uses execution feedback to generate discriminative test cases and separate previously indistinguishable candidate scripts, substantially improving Best-of-N selection performance in this domain. We release the code at https://github.com/snu-mllab/Rule2DRC.

papers.summary: 本文系统解读了KAIST团队论文（arXiv:2605.23315），通过16个不同家族LLM（1.5B-72B参数）在800道推理题上的实验，揭示表征趋同不等于推理趋同。三个关键发现：1）难度反转：模型在集体答错的难题上表征更相似（CKA=0.897）反而高于简单题（CKA=0.830），原因在于难题导致注意力均匀分布（高熵）使所有模型陷入类似“迷茫模式”；2）生成断层：决策前编码层表征高度相似（CKA=0.875），但决策后生成层几乎无关（CKA=0.274），差距高达0.601；3）附随正确性：跨模型探针可从另一模型表征预测答案（准确率66%），但因果消融该子空间后仅1.5%-5.5%的答案发生变化，说明正确性信息虽编码但未被实际用于决策。此外，随机初始化模型的表征相似度竟比训练过的模型更高，提示部分趋同源于Transformer架构共性。该研究警示CKA指标可能被误读，模型集成仍有价值，知识迁移需谨慎。

arxiv.title: Convergence Without Understanding: When Language Models Agree on Representations but Disagree on Reasoning
arxiv.abstract: Large language models trained under diverse objectives and architectures have been shown to develop increasingly similar internal representations, an observation formalized as the Platonic Representation Hypothesis. Whether this representational convergence extends to the reasoning processes that operate over shared representations remains untested. We evaluate representational similarity across 16 language models from 8 families (1.5B to 72B parameters) on 800 reasoning problems spanning mathematics, science, commonsense, and truthfulness, stratifying by problem difficulty, computational stage, and causal relevance. Our analysis reveals three dissociations: a difficulty inversion, where models converge more on problems they collectively fail (Centered Kernel Alignment [CKA] = 0.897) than on those they solve (CKA = 0.830); a generation gap, where pre-decision representations align (CKA = 0.875) while post-decision representations diverge (CKA = 0.274); and epiphenomenal correctness, where shared information is decodable across models (66% transfer accuracy) but exerts minimal causal influence on predictions (1.5% to 5.5% flip rate across ablation protocols). papers.title: OpenSearch-VL: An Open Recipe for Frontier Multimodal Search Agents
papers.report_title: 95后庞天宇腾讯首篇署名论文:多模态搜索智能体开源新方案
papers.summary: 本文报道了腾讯混元首席研究科学家庞天宇加入后的首篇学术成果——OpenSearch-VL，一套基于强化学习从头训练多模态深度搜索智能体的完整开源方案。该方案针对当前多模态搜索智能体数据不公开、流程不透明、训练黑箱等问题，从三个维度系统解决：一是数据构建，通过维基百科知识链路自动生成多跳逻辑链，并模糊改写实体名称、筛选低难度样本、引入图像退化，最终产出SearchVL-SFT-36k和SearchVL-RL-8k两个专用数据集；二是工具环境，统一集成检索、视觉增强和视觉解析三类工具，支持锐化、超分辨率、透视校正等修复功能，形成“修图→检索→核验”闭环；三是训练算法，采用两阶段递进框架，SFT阶段学习推理格式与工具调用，RL阶段使用失效感知GRPO算法，通过复合奖励、失效感知掩码和单侧优势截断应对多轮工具调用的级联失败。实验基于Qwen3-VL-8B/30B-A3B/32B构建，在SimpleVQA、VDR、MMSearch等7项基准上，30B-A3B版本平均得分从47.8提升至61.6（+13.8），VDR提升13.3、MMSearch提升24.5；32B版本平均得分63.7，在多项任务上达到或超越GPT-5和Claude Opus 4.6。消融实验显示，移除source-anchor grounding导致平均分下降11.5，失效感知GRPO比标准GRPO高4.2分。项目已全面开源数据、代码与模型。该工作为多模态深度搜索智能体提供了可复现的基础方案，具有重要的工程与学术价值。

arxiv.title: OpenSearch-VL: An Open Recipe for Frontier Multimodal Search Agents
arxiv.abstract: Deep search has become a crucial capability for frontier multimodal agents, enabling models to solve complex questions through active search, evidence verification, and multi-step reasoning. Despite rapid progress, top-tier multimodal search agents remain difficult to reproduce, largely due to the absence of open high-quality training data, transparent trajectory synthesis pipelines, or detailed training recipes. To this end, we introduce OpenSearch-VL, a fully open-source recipe for training frontier multimodal deep search agents with agentic reinforcement learning. First, we curated a dedicated pipeline to construct high-quality training data through Wikipedia path sampling, fuzzy entity rewriting, and source-anchor visual grounding, which jointly reduce shortcuts and one-step retrieval collapse. Based on this pipeline, we curate two training datasets, SearchVL-SFT-36k for SFT and SearchVL-RL-8k for RL. Besides, we design a diverse tool environment that unifies text search, image search, OCR, cropping, sharpening, super-resolution, and perspective correction, enabling agents to combine active perception with external knowledge acquisition. Finally, we propose a multi-turn fatal-aware GRPO training algorithm that handles cascading tool failures by masking post-failure tokens while preserving useful pre-failure reasoning through one-sided advantage clamping. papers.title: HAGE: Harnessing Agentic Memory via RL-Driven Weighted Graph Evolution
papers.report_title: UTD等提出HAGE:用强化学习让 Agent 记忆从“检索”变成“找路”
papers.summary: 得克萨斯大学达拉斯分校、佛罗里达大学和加州大学戴维斯分校提出HAGE（Harnessing Agentic Memory via RL-Driven Weighted Graph Evolution），将Agent记忆组织为带权多关系图（时间、语义、因果、实体四类边），并用强化学习联合训练边特征和查询路由策略。记忆图节点为细粒度事件节点（含内容、时间戳、语义向量和元数据），边为可训练多维向量而非静态标签。检索分四步：查询分析（用LLM分类器识别关系意图）、锚点识别（密集/稀疏/时间检索找到起点）、查询条件加权遍历（QueryRouter结合语义相似度和结构权重选择路径，最大跳数5）、上下文合成（按问题类型重排序）。训练采用策略梯度，命中奖励10.0，步数惩罚0.05，超时惩罚1.0，边特征和路由器共进化，使用非对称学习率（路由器1e-3，边特征1e-4）和锚点正则化。在LoCoMo长期对话记忆基准上，HAGE总体得分0.739（语义评分0-1），超越最强基线MAGMA的0.700，尤其对抗查询从0.742提升至0.839（+13.1%）；在HotpotQA多跳问答上，GPT-4o-mini下F1达0.678，Qwen2.5-3B下F1从0.337提升至0.429。消融实验表明边特征和路由器联合优化最优（完整HAGE 0.739 vs 仅边特征0.724、仅路由器0.713）。效率上HAGE每次查询约3.82K tokens，延迟2.17秒，比MAGMA增加13.7% token但带来显著准确率提升。论文指出需要补充记忆生命周期管理、隐私控制、在线适应性和可解释性等工程能力。
papers.authors: 德克萨斯大学达拉斯分校、佛罗里达大学、加州大学戴维斯分校
report_titles: UTD等提出HAGE:用强化学习让 Agent 记忆从“检索”变成“找路”

arxiv.title: HAGE: Harnessing Agentic Memory via RL-Driven Weighted Graph Evolution
arxiv.abstract: Memory retrieval in agentic large language model (LLM) systems is often treated as a static lookup problem, relying on flat vector search or fixed binary relational graphs. However, fixed graph structures cannot capture the varying strength, confidence, and query-dependent relevance of relationships between events. In this paper, we propose HAGE, a weighted multi-relational memory framework that reconceptualizes retrieval as sequential, query-conditioned traversal over a unified relational memory graph. Memory is organized as relation-specific graph views over shared memory nodes, where each edge is associated with a trainable relation feature vector encoding multiple relational signals. Given a query, an LLM-based classifier identifies the relational intent, and a routing network dynamically modulates the corresponding dimensions of the edge embedding. Traversal scores are computed via a learned combination of semantic similarity and these query-conditioned edge representations. This allows memory traversal to prioritize high-utility relational paths while softly suppressing noisy or weakly relevant connections. Beyond adaptive traversal, HAGE further introduces a reinforcement learning-based training framework that jointly optimizes routing behavior and edge representations using downstream tasks. Finally, empirical results demonstrate improved long-horizon reasoning accuracy

papers.title: Token Economics for LLM Agents: A Dual-View Study from Computing and Economics
papers.report_title: 浙大*阿里云综述 Token 经济学:LLM Agent 的成本、协作与安全账本
papers.summary: 浙江大学和阿里云发布46页综述《Token Economics for LLM Agents: A Dual-View Study from Computing and Economics》，将LLM Agent中的Token重新定义为生产要素、交换媒介和记账单位。引用OpenRouter数据：平台周Token处理量从2024年12月的0.4万亿增长至2026年3月的27万亿（15个月增长68倍）。提出Token五分类：输入、推理、通信、外部和输出Token。单Agent层面核心问题是在内部推理Token和外部工具Token之间找到最优分配，优化手段包括prompt压缩、early exit、KV cache、更准的工具选择与记忆策略。多Agent层面，总成本=节点生产成本+内部交易成本，通信成本随Agent数量超线性增长，例如软件工程场景中ChatDev的迭代代码Review消耗59.4% Token，SWE-bench相关研究显示agentic coding的Token消耗可能超过单轮推理1000倍，输入输出比超150:1，同一任务Token用量方差达30倍。优化方向包括裁剪通信图（AgentPrune/AgentDropout）、压缩通信内容（结构化表示替代自然语言）、跨Agent KV cache复用（KVComm/TokenDance）以及管理集体记忆（避免公共草地悲剧）。生态级成本包括生产、等待、交易和合规四类，缓存形成平台粘性（Anthropic缓存输入按10%收费，OpenAI自动50%折扣），拥挤定价变得重要。安全三条路径降低Token预期效用、提高影子价格。论文核心结论：不要只看Token数或模型能力，要看每个Token对目标质量的边际贡献是否超过真实成本。

arxiv.title: Token Economics for LLM Agents: A Dual-View Study from Computing and Economics
arxiv.abstract: As LLM agents evolve, tokens have emerged as the core economic primitives of Agentic AI. However, their exponential consumption introduces severe computational, collaborative, and security bottlenecks. Current surveys remain fragmented across system optimization, architecture design, and trust, lacking a unified framework to evaluate the fundamental trade-off between output quality and economic cost. To bridge this gap, this survey presents the first comprehensive survey of Token Economics. By unifying computer science and economics, we conceptualize tokens as production factors, exchange mediums, and units of account. We synthesize existing literature across a four-dimensional taxonomy: (1) Micro-level (Single Agent): Optimizing budget-constrained factor substitution via neoclassical firm theory. (2) Meso-level (Multi-Agent Systems): Minimizing collaboration friction using transaction cost and principal-agent theories. (3) Macro-level (Agent Ecosystems): Addressing congestion externalities and pricing via mechanism design. (4) Security: Internalizing adversarial threats as endogenous economic constraints. Finally, we outline frontier directions, including differentiable token budgets and dynamic markets, to lay the theoretical foundation for scalable next-generation agent systems.

papers.title: World Action Models are Zero-shot Policies
papers.report_title: WAM paper daily——《World Action Models are Zero-shot Policies》速读:DreamZero 如何把视频世界模型变成零样本机器人策略
papers.summary: 本文对 NVIDIA 团队在 arXiv 2026 发布的论文《World Action Models are Zero-shot Policies》（模型名 DreamZero）进行深度速读。DreamZero 提出 World Action Model (WAM) 范式，核心思想是让预训练的 14B 视频扩散模型（Wan2.1-I2V-14B-480P backbone）同时预测未来视频和连续动作，将未来视频作为隐式视觉规划，动作作为逆动力学输出，从而突破传统 VLA 在新物理动作泛化上的瓶颈。架构采用 autoregressive DiT 进行 video-action joint flow matching，输入包括历史视觉、语言指令、本体感受，输出 future video latent 和 action chunk。推理时通过 closed-loop 部署：每执行一次 action chunk 后，将真实相机观察写回 KV cache 覆盖预测帧，避免误差累积。作者报告在 AgiBot G1 seen-task 零样本新环境评测上达到 62.2% average task progress，远超最强 VLA baseline 的 27.4%；unseen-task 达 39.5%。为满足实时性，通过 CFG parallelism、DiT caching、torch.compile、NVFP4 quantization 等累计实现 38× 推理加速，使 14B 模型达到约 7Hz 闭环控制。跨 embodiment 迁移方面，仅用 12 分钟人类视频或 20 分钟 YAM 机器人视频即可将 AgiBot unseen-task progress 从 38.3% 提升至 54.3%/55.4%。论文代码较为完整，已公开 checkpoints、推理 server、数据处理入口等。文章还给出了 DreamZero-Flash 变体，解耦 video 和 action 的 noise schedule，使动作能从高噪声视频 latent 中快速降噪。该工作被视为 2026 年机器人基础模型的重要方向。

arxiv.title: World Action Models are Zero-shot Policies
arxiv.abstract: State-of-the-art Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models excel at semantic generalization but struggle to generalize to unseen physical motions in novel environments. We introduce DreamZero, a World Action Model (WAM) built upon a pretrained video diffusion backbone. Unlike VLAs, WAMs learn physical dynamics by predicting future world states and actions, using video as a dense representation of how the world evolves. By jointly modeling video and action, DreamZero learns diverse skills effectively from heterogeneous robot data without relying on repetitive demonstrations. This results in over 2x improvement in generalization to new tasks and environments compared to state-of-the-art VLAs in real robot experiments. Crucially, through model and system optimizations, we enable a 14B autoregressive video diffusion model to perform real-time closed-loop control at 7Hz. Finally, we demonstrate two forms of cross-embodiment transfer: video-only demonstrations from other robots or humans yield a relative improvement of over 42% on unseen task performance with just 10-20 minutes of data. More surprisingly, DreamZero enables few-shot embodiment adaptation, transferring to a new embodiment with only 30 minutes of play data while retaining zero-shot generalization.

papers.title: Verbal-R3: Verbal Reranker as the Missing Bridge between Retrieval and Reasoning
papers.report_title: RAG瓶颈找到了,ACL 2026新作
papers.summary: 本文解读 ACL 2026 论文《Verbal Reranker as the Missing Bridge between Retrieval and Reasoning》。针对 RAG 系统中检索结果已正确但 LLM 答错的核心问题（由 exposure bias 引起），首尔国立大学与 DGIST 团队提出 Verbal-R3 框架。核心创新是 Verbal Annotation（口头注解）——一段分析性叙述，显式解释检索文档与查询之间的逻辑关系，包括定位相关信息、过滤噪声、建立逻辑桥梁。框架为双角色 agentic RAG：Generator 迭代推理，Verbal Reranker 对每篇文档打 1-5 分并生成注解，每次检索从 15 篇中选出最相关的 3 篇。为降低开销，使用蒸馏策略：用 GPT-OSS-120B 生成 50 万组三元组（人工审批通过率 98.5%），最终 38 万组高质量数据蒸馏到 Qwen2.5-3B。在 7 个 QA benchmark 上，Verbal-R3 3B 对比 Search-R1 3B：EM +17.1%，F1 +18.0%；3B 版本甚至超越 Search-R1 7B；7B 版本对比 Search-R1 7B：EM +15.3%，F1 +14.3%。多跳任务 F1 提升 20-27%（单跳仅 8-10%）。计算效率方面，添加 3B Reranker 仅增加 13.8% FLOPs 即可获得 3.1% F1 提升，而将 Generator 从 3B 扩至 7B 花费 133% FLOPs 才提升 8.2% F1。测试时采用相关性引导的 test-time scaling，减少 45-54% 的 reranker 调用。该工作揭示了 RAG 瓶颈不在检索而在结果理解，Verbal Annotation 作为轻量级“解释器”是最优解。
