arxiv.title: Verbal-R3: Verbal Reranker as the Missing Bridge between Retrieval and Reasoning
arxiv.abstract: The conventional Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) paradigm of injecting raw retrieved texts into the Large Language Model (LLM)'s context often results in suboptimal integration of retrieved information. This paper proposes to bridge retrieval results and the LLM's reasoning ability through Verbal Annotations, analytic narratives that explicitly articulate the logical connection between a search query and retrieved contexts. Our empirical investigation reveals the potential of Verbal Annotations to substantially enhance the LLM's ability to generate accurate, contextually-grounded responses. Motivated by this finding, we introduce Verbal-R3, a novel agentic RAG framework that consists of a Generator and a Verbal Reranker. The Generator performs iterative retrieval and reasoning, while the Verbal Reranker returns relevance scores and Verbal Annotations to guide the reasoning and answering process of the Generator. The inference process of Verbal-R3 is further refined through relevance-guided test-time scaling, which efficiently allocates test-time compute for effective trajectory expansion. Verbal-R3 achieves state-of-the-art performance on complex Question Answering benchmarks, validating the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

papers.title: SkillOS: Learning Skill Curation for Self-Evolving Agents
papers.report_title: 谷歌SkillOS,让Agent自己管Skill
papers.summary: Google新近发表的论文《SkillOS: Learning Skill Curation for Self-Evolving Agents》（arXiv: 2605.06614）将Agent的技能管理问题转化为强化学习任务。核心思想是训练一个“Skill Curator”来自动管理Skill库（insert/update/delete），使Agent能自我进化。系统由冻结的Agent Executor（根据SkillRepo中技能执行任务）和可训练的Skill Curator（基于RL策略生成技能库编辑操作）组成。关键设计包括：任务流分组+两阶段评估（上游轨迹用于更新，下游任务评估更新有效性）以提供延迟奖励；复合奖励机制将下游执行反馈精确归因到Curator的特定编辑操作；技能以Markdown文件存储（与Anthropic/OpenAI Skills格式一致）。实验结果表明：SkillOS在多轮Agent任务和单轮推理任务上稳定优于memory-free和强memory-based基线；训练好的Curator可以跨Executor主干迁移（换底层模型仍可用）以及跨任务域迁移；更引人注目的是，随着训练推进，SkillRepo内部会自发涌现出更高层级的“meta-skill”——技能开始呈现层次化和抽象化。论文的局限性：RL训练成本未充分展开；跨域迁移的跨度需更多对照实验；技能间的依赖、版本、冲突处理尚存空白。对于Agent系统研究者，该工作给出了“技能管理可被训练”的具体可行性证明，并推动了Skill格式标准的收敛，为self-evolving agent提供了可落地的锚点。

report_titles: 谷歌SkillOS,让Agent自己管Skill

arxiv.title: SkillOS: Learning Skill Curation for Self-Evolving Agents
arxiv.abstract: LLM-based agents are increasingly deployed to handle streaming tasks, yet they often remain one-off problem solvers that fail to learn from past interactions. Reusable skills distilled from experience provide a natural substrate for self-evolution, where high-quality skill curation serves as the key bottleneck. Existing approaches either rely on manual skill curation, prescribe heuristic skill operations, or train for short-horizon skill operations. However, they still struggle to learn complex long-term curation policies from indirect and delayed feedback. To tackle this challenge, we propose SkillOS, an experience-driven RL training recipe for learning skill curation in self-evolving agents. SkillOS pairs a frozen agent executor that retrieves and applies skills with a trainable skill curator that updates an external SkillRepo from accumulated experience. To provide learning signals for curation, we design composite rewards and train on grouped task streams based on skill-relevant task dependencies, where earlier trajectories update the SkillRepo, and later related tasks evaluate these updates. Across multi-turn agentic tasks and single-turn reasoning tasks, SkillOS consistently outperforms memory-free and strong memory-based baselines in both effectiveness and efficiency, with the learned skill curator generalizing across different executor backbones and task domains. papers.title: VGGT-$Ω$
papers.report_title: CVPR26 Oral!VGGT-Ω让AI生成符合物理定律
papers.summary: CVPR 2026 Oral论文VGGT-Ω针对生成式AI物理幻觉问题提出系统评估框架。当前模型（如Sora）虽像素逼真但缺乏底层逻辑，常出现物质不守恒、几何畸变、动力学缺失。VGGT-Ω引入几何与动作接地量化标准：3D空间一致性通过OmniVGGT检测物体多视角3D结构稳定性；时间动力学校验轨迹与交互瞬间的运动学规律；物体持久性评估复杂遮挡下长程记忆。解决方案强调从隐式模拟转向显式约束：几何注入在latent space嵌入位姿与深度控制信号；VLA闭环学习关联视觉生成与机器人动作，使模型在试错中习得直觉物理（如推力与加速度关系）。该框架对自动驾驶长尾碰撞训练、具身智能Sim-to-Real迁移具有基石意义。论文地址：https://arxiv.org/pdf/2605.15195，代码已开源。该方法为评估AI生成内容的物理合理性提供了首个量化基准。
report_titles: CVPR26 Oral!VGGT-Ω让AI生成符合物理定律

arxiv.title: VGGT-$Ω$
arxiv.abstract: Recent feed-forward reconstruction models, such as VGGT, have proven competitive with traditional optimization-based reconstructors while also providing geometry-aware features useful for other tasks. Here, we show that the quality of these models scales predictably with model and data size. We do so by introducing VGGT-$Ω$, which substantially improves reconstruction accuracy, efficiency, and capabilities for both static and dynamic scenes. To enable training this model at an unprecedented scale, we introduce architectural changes that improve training efficiency, a high-quality data annotation pipeline that supports dynamic scenes, and a self-supervised learning protocol. We simplify VGGT's architecture by using a single dense prediction head with multi-task supervision and removing the expensive high-resolution convolutional layers. We also use registers to aggregate scene information into a compact representation and introduce register attention, which restricts inter-frame information exchange to these registers, in part replacing global attention. In this way, during training, VGGT-$Ω$ uses only about 30% of the GPU memory of its predecessor, allowing us to train with 15x more supervised data than prior work and to leverage vast amounts of unlabeled video data. papers.title: Understanding Transformers via N-gram Statistics
papers.report_title: 10M参数也能跑ARC与数独,Bengio团队押注「多轨迹推理」
papers.summary: Yoshua Bengio团队与KAIST、Mila、NYU提出的GRAM模型仅有10M参数，却在Sudoku-Extreme上达到97.0%准确率，在ARC-AGI-1和ARC-AGI-2上分别取得52.0%和11.1%。作为参考，DeepSeek-R1、Claude 3.7 16k、o3-mini-high在Sudoku-Extreme上均为0.0%（作者强调非同等条件对比）。核心创新是将确定性递归改为概率多轨迹计算（生成式递归推理），隐状态分为高层h和低层l，低层连续K步更新，高层每次更新时注入高斯扰动，并行采样多条推理轨迹。消融实验表明，移除引导信号（均值归零）导致N-Queens准确率降至50.27%，完全移除随机性（方差归零）降至0.0%。推理时扩展方面，GRAM仅需16次迭代、并行采样N=20条轨迹即达97.0%，而TRM需320次迭代才达90.5%。无条件数独生成中，10.9M参数的GRAM有效率达99.05%，远好于55.1M参数的D3PM的91.33%。二值化MNIST生成中，递归步数从8增至256时FID由84.08降至73.34。论文证实多轨迹采样对结构化推理任务的显著提升，但指出深度监督顺序训练限制扩展性。
report_titles: 10M参数也能跑ARC与数独,Bengio团队押注「多轨迹推理」

arxiv.title: Understanding Transformers via N-gram Statistics
arxiv.abstract: Transformer based large-language models (LLMs) display extreme proficiency with language yet a precise understanding of how they work remains elusive. One way of demystifying transformer predictions would be to describe how they depend on their context in terms of simple template functions. This paper takes a first step in this direction by considering families of functions (i.e. rules) formed out of simple N-gram based statistics of the training data. By studying how well these rulesets approximate transformer predictions, we obtain a variety of novel discoveries: a simple method to detect overfitting during training without using a holdout set, a quantitative measure of how transformers progress from learning simple to more complex statistical rules over the course of training, a model-variance criterion governing when transformer predictions tend to be described by N-gram rules, and insights into how well transformers can be approximated by N-gram rulesets in the limit where these rulesets become increasingly complex. In this latter direction, we find that for 79% and 68% of LLM next-token distributions on TinyStories and Wikipedia, respectively, their top-1 predictions agree with those provided by our N-gram rulesets.

papers.title: MemLens: A Value-Aware Memory Management System with Interactive Analytics for LLM-based Agents
papers.report_title: 港科大等提出 MemLens:34 个模型一测,AI 的多模态长期记忆还远没过关
papers.summary: 来自港科大、CUHK、OmniMemory和NVIDIA AI Technology Center等机构的研究团队提出了MemLens基准，专门用于评估多模态长期记忆能力。该基准包含789道需要图文证据的多会话记忆题，覆盖32K到256K四种上下文长度，对27个长上下文视觉语言模型（LVLM）和7个记忆增强Agent进行了系统评测。关键发现：在32K上下文下，最强LVLM总体准确率仅58.68%；当证据图片被移除后，GPT-5.4准确率从93.13%骤降至1.74%，Gemini-3.1-Pro从89.42%降至1.89%，证明任务真正依赖视觉证据。五类能力中，信息提取最高74.39%，知识更新约50.86%，多会话推理（MSR）最难（Kimi-K2.5达44.06%），拒绝回答能力在32K下可达97.78%但随上下文变长大幅下降。记忆Agent在长度稳定性上优于LVLM（6/7个Agent波动±7%以内），但写入时损失视觉细节，导致信息提取和知识更新类错误接近90%源于视觉证据定位失败。模型规模扩大（Qwen3-VL 2B→8B→30B MoE）对长期记忆改善有限，主要瓶颈在于长历史中的图文证据检索而非单图理解。论文揭示两类失忆模式：长上下文模型“照片在但翻不到”，记忆Agent“翻得快却丢失细节”。错误分析显示69.44%是near-miss（定位到相关证据但读错/算错），30.57%是total-miss（完全未找到证据）。此基准为产品化多模态助手提供了可量化的记忆能力评估维度。
papers.authors: 港科大、中大、OmniMemory、NVIDIA AI Technology Center

arxiv.title: MemLens: A Value-Aware Memory Management System with Interactive Analytics for LLM-based Agents
arxiv.abstract: Recently, memory management has become a key infrastructure for LLM-based agents, as it directly affects long-horizon reasoning, personalized responses, and knowledge reuse. However, existing LLM memory systems typically adopt a coarse-grained (utility-agnostic) manner that treats heterogeneous user-LLM interaction records uniformly, leading to redundant and low-impact records persisting in the memory repository. To address this challenge, we present MemLens, a value-aware memory management system that takes memory records as first-class data objects. MemLens provides an end-to-end interactive analytics dashboard that exposes the complete memory lifecycle, including Shapley-style memory evaluation, value-aware storage, and memory-assisted response. Through a study-copilot application, the system enables users to inspect memory values, visualize hierarchical memory structures, and compare various memory management strategies in terms of response quality, retrieval latency, and token consumption. Therefore, our MemLens can serve as an efficient, interpretable, and personalized long-term memory management system for LLM-based agents.

papers.title: UDA: Unsupervised Debiasing Alignment for Pair-wise LLM-as-a-Judge
papers.report_title: 论文分享:UDA让大模型裁判不再偏心自己
papers.summary: 本文介绍AAAI-26论文《UDA: Unsupervised Debiasing Alignment for Pair-wise LLM-as-a-Judge》，针对大模型充当裁判时存在的偏好偏差（尤其是self-preference bias）问题，提出无监督去偏对齐框架。核心方案：不依赖人工标注，直接修改Elo评分过程——通过轻量神经网络动态输出adaptive K-factor和refined win probability，利用候选答案间及候选答案与裁判自身答案的相似度特征进行校准。实验效果显著：inter-judge score standard deviation最高降低63.4%，与人类判断的平均相关性提升24.7%。该方法将LLM-as-a-Judge从“直接信任裁判”推进到“校准裁判偏见”，使评测结果更稳定、可复现，对当前依赖LLM评判的模型排行榜（如Chatbot Arena）具有重要参考价值。论文地址：https://arxiv.org/pdf/2508.09724。

arxiv.title: UDA: Unsupervised Debiasing Alignment for Pair-wise LLM-as-a-Judge
arxiv.abstract: Pairwise evaluation of Large Language Models (LLMs) is a common paradigm, but it is prone to preference bias, where judges systematically favor certain outputs, such as their own. This bias leads to inconsistent and skewed rankings across different judges. To address this, we first empirically demonstrate significant and heterogeneous biases in cross-model evaluations. We then propose UDA (Unsupervised Debiasing Alignment), a framework that reduces inter-judge disagreement by dynamically adjusting the Elo rating system. For each pairwise comparison, a compact neural network learns to adaptively set the K-factor and refine win probabilities. Crucially, UDA operates in a fully unsupervised manner, guided solely by the objective of minimizing the dispersion among the Elo trajectories of all judges. This forces an alignment towards a collective consensus, which serves as an unsupervised proxy for a more stable and reproducible evaluation. In addition, we provide theoretical motivation demonstrating how alignment towards a consensus can reduce aggregate system bias. Experiments show that UDA significantly reduces the inter-judge rating standard deviation by up to 63.4% and improves the average correlation with human judgments by 24.7%. papers.title: Code as Agent Harness
papers.report_title: UIUC、Meta、斯坦福等最新综述!Code as Agent Harness
papers.summary: 这篇来自UIUC、Meta、斯坦福等机构的102页综述，提出了'Code as Agent Harness'框架，将代码定义为智能体（Agent）运行时外骨骼：包含接口、机制与扩展三层结构。接口层将代码用于推理（如Program-of-Thoughts）、行动（如Code as Policies）和环境建模（如SWE-bench）；机制层涵盖规划（计划作为可审查变更契约）、记忆（五类记忆：工作、语义、经验、长期、多智能体）、工具使用（四类工具及生命周期治理）以及PEV（计划-执行-验证）闭环；扩展层聚焦多智能体围绕共享代码状态的协作，如协同生成、批评修复、对抗验证与推理辩论。综述还覆盖了五个落地场景：代码助手（如LingmaAgent实现16.9%全自动解决issue）、GUI/OS Agent、科学发现、个性化与具身智能。核心洞察是：Agent的自动化瓶颈不仅在于模型能力，更在于底层Harness的可靠性——代码因其可执行、可检查、有状态的特性，成为连接模型与世界的理想介质。论文强调AHE（Agentic Harness Engineering）作为系统优化新范式，需通过深层遥测（deep telemetry）诊断失败来源并受治理地修改Harness。
report_titles: UIUC、Meta、斯坦福等最新综述!Code as Agent Harness

arxiv.title: Code as Agent Harness
arxiv.abstract: Recent large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in understanding and generating code, from competitive programming to repository-level software engineering. In emerging agentic systems, code is no longer only a target output. It increasingly serves as an operational substrate for agent reasoning, acting, environment modeling, and execution-based verification. We frame this shift through the lens of agent harnesses and introduce code as agent harness: a unified view that centers code as the basis for agent infrastructure. To systematically study this perspective, we organize the survey around three connected layers. First, we study the harness interface, where code connects agents to reasoning, action, and environment modeling. Second, we examine harness mechanisms: planning, memory, and tool use for long-horizon execution, together with feedback-driven control and optimization that make harness reliable and adaptive. Third, we discuss scaling the harness from single-agent systems to multi-agent settings, where shared code artifacts support multi-agent coordination, review, and verification. Across these layers, we summarize representative methods and practical applications of code as agent harness, spanning coding assistants, GUI/OS automation, embodied agents, scientific discovery, personalization and recommendation, DevOps, and enterprise workflows.

papers.title: MMSkills: Towards Multimodal Skills for General Visual Agents
papers.report_title: 小红书东南等推出 MMSkills:让视觉 Agent 学会看图调用技能,OSWorld 最高提升 17.83 个点
papers.summary: 上海交通大学、小红书和东南大学提出MMSkills，定义多模态过程性知识包，将视觉Agent的技能从纯文本升级为包含紧凑描述、可复用文本流程、运行时状态卡和多视角关键帧的结构化包。技能生成采用从公开非测试轨迹自动抽取的5阶段流水线（任务聚类→簇级规划→合并泛化→文本起草→图像落地审计），生成515个多模态技能（OSWorld 247个技能/879张状态卡/1898个视图）。运行时采用分支加载机制：主Agent不直接吞技能包，而是通过临时分支进行门控视图选择（优先加载focus crop）和分支规划，输出当前技能是否适用、局部目标、计划、避免动作和验证条件，实现证据隔离。在OSWorld上，Qwen3-VL-235B从21.34%提升至39.17%（+17.83），Qwen3-VL-8B从10.78%提升至25.40%（+14.62），Gemini 3 Flash从36.65%提升至47.97%（+11.32）；在macOSWorld上Qwen3-VL-235B从47.55%提升至51.75%，GLM-5V从34.97%提升至51.75%。消融实验表明状态卡、视觉关键帧和分支加载缺一不可，直接加载完整多模态内容反而有害。行为分析显示，MMSkills减少低层动作负担：Qwen3-VL-235B的精确重复动作从21.8%降至6.2%，平均步数从15.22降至9.87；DONE行为比例上升。纯文本技能在强模型上可能下降（Gemini 3.1 Pro从44.08%降至40.76%），说明缺少视觉证据的流程描述会让Agent更自信地走错路。
papers.authors: 上海交通大学、小红书、东南大学

arxiv.title: MMSkills: Towards Multimodal Skills for General Visual Agents
arxiv.abstract: Reusable skills have become a core substrate for improving agent capabilities, yet most existing skill packages encode reusable behavior primarily as textual prompts, executable code, or learned routines. For visual agents, however, procedural knowledge is inherently multimodal: reuse depends not only on what operation to perform, but also on recognizing the relevant state, interpreting visual evidence of progress or failure, and deciding what to do next. We formalize this requirement as multimodal procedural knowledge and address three practical challenges: (I) what a multimodal skill package should contain; (II) where such packages can be derived from public interaction experience; and (III) how agents can consult multimodal evidence at inference time without excessive image context or over-anchoring to reference screenshots. We introduce MMSkills, a framework for representing, generating, and using reusable multimodal procedures for runtime visual decision making. Each MMSkill is a compact, state-conditioned package that couples a textual procedure with runtime state cards and multi-view keyframes. To construct these packages, we develop an agentic trajectory-to-skill Generator that transforms public non-evaluation trajectories into reusable multimodal skills through workflow grouping, procedure induction, visual grounding, and meta-skill-guided auditing. papers.title: Adapt Data to Model: Adaptive Transformation Optimization for Domain-shared Time Series Foundation Models
papers.report_title: 论文笔记|TATO:不微调大模型,只调数据变换,让冻结时间序列大模型跨领域预测更稳 ICLR 2026
papers.summary: 本文解读了被ICLR 2026接收的论文《Adapt Data to Model: Adaptive Transformation Optimization for Domain-shared Time Series Foundation Models》。该工作提出TATO框架，核心思路是保持预训练时间序列大模型完全冻结，通过自动搜索数据预处理流水线来适配不同领域的输入数据，从而提升跨领域零样本预测的鲁棒性。作者指出，现有LTM（如Moirai、Timer、Chronos）在跨领域时因数据统计结构差异（采样频率、非平稳性、异常值等）导致预测失败；传统的微调成本高且破坏泛化性，test-time adaptation效率不稳定。TATO将数据变换建模为超参数优化问题，使用TPE（Tree-structured Parzen Estimator）搜索三类九个算子：上下文变换（Trimmer、Sampler、Aligner）、归一化变换（Scaler、Differencer、Warper）和异常值变换（Denoiser、Imputator、Clipper），并采用启发式规则约束搜索顺序。为缓解过拟合，引入8种时间序列增强（如幅值翻转、时间扭曲、EWMA平滑等）并设计两阶段Pareto排序机制：第一阶段在多指标和增强样本上筛除高风险流水线，第二阶段在原始样本上按加权指标选最优。消融实验表明，Denoiser虽不总是最大化平均提升但能降低方差、增强跨场景鲁棒性。论文未在正文中给出具体数值实验对比，但从定性描述看TATO旨在解决已有方法的分类边界模糊、统计指标差异等根本问题，为冻结LTM部署提供一种轻量级无训练方案。

arxiv.title: Adapt Data to Model: Adaptive Transformation Optimization for Domain-shared Time Series Foundation Models
arxiv.abstract: Large time series models (LTMs) have emerged as powerful tools for universal forecasting, yet they often struggle with the inherent diversity and nonstationarity of real-world time series data, leading to an unsatisfactory trade-off between forecasting accuracy and generalization. Rather than continually finetuning new LTM instances for each domain, we propose a data-centric framework, time-series adaptive transformation optimization (TATO), that enables a single frozen pre-trained LTM to adapt to diverse downstream domains through an optimally configured transformation pipeline. Specifically, TATO constructs three representative types of transformations, including context slicing, scale normalization, and outlier correction, to help LTMs better align with target domain characteristics. To ensure robustness, we incorporate carefully selected time series augmentations and a two-stage ranking mechanism that filters out pipelines underperforming on specific metrics. Extensive experiments on state-of-the-art LTMs and widely used datasets demonstrate that TATO consistently and significantly improves domain-adaptive forecasting performance, achieving a maximum reduction in MSE of 65.4\% and an average reduction of 13.6\%. papers.summary: 香港中文大学（深圳）发布综述论文《A Comprehensive Survey on Agent Skills: Taxonomy, Techniques, and Applications》，系统梳理Agent技能从表示、获取、检索到演化的完整生命周期。论文定义技能为“有有限作用域的可复用程序化工件”，形式化为S=(M,R,C)（根指令、辅助资源、适用条件）。技能表示分为文本、代码和混合三类，混合形态最有潜力但维护成本高。技能获取包括人类衍生、经验衍生、任务衍生和语料衍生四类，其中从执行轨迹中提炼是研究最活跃的方向。技能检索面临规模挑战，论文总结密集检索、关键词检索、生成式检索和结构检索四类方法，并强调检索需结合执行状态。技能演化包括修订、验证、仓库演化和运行时治理，需要类似软件包的版本管理。代表性技能平台规模已超数十万：SkillNet 300k+，ClawHub 40k+，SkillsMP 700k+。应用场景覆盖软件工程、数据科学、网页交互、机器人、医疗和金融等。论文指出核心挑战转向维护“技能社会”的质量控制、互操作和安全治理。对Agent产品设计的启发包括：技能应携带验证、更新可审计、检索结合执行状态等。

arxiv.title: A Comprehensive Survey on Agent Skills: Taxonomy, Techniques, and Applications
arxiv.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based agents that reason, plan, and act through tools, memory, and structured interaction are emerging as a promising paradigm for automating complex workflows. Recent systems such as OpenClaw and Claude Code exemplify a broader shift from passive response generation to action-oriented task execution. Yet as agents move toward open-ended, real-world deployment, relying on from-scratch reasoning and low-level tool calls for every task become increasingly inefficient, error-prone, and hard to maintain. This survey examines this challenge through the lens of \emph{agent skills}, which we define as reusable procedural artifacts that coordinate tools, memory, and runtime context under task-specific constraints. Under this view, agents and skills play complementary roles: agents handle high-level reasoning and planning, while skills form the operational layer that enables reliable, reusable, and composable execution. Skills are therefore central to the scalability, robustness, and maintainability of modern agent systems. We organize the literature around four stages of the agent skill lifecycle -- representation, acquisition, retrieval, and evolution -- and review representative methods, ecosystem resources, and application settings across each stage. papers.title: $δ$-mem: Efficient Online Memory for Large Language Models
papers.report_title: NTU、复旦等提出 δ-mem:只用 8*8 在线记忆矩阵,让大模型长期记忆涨到 1.31*
papers.summary: δ-mem为冻结大语言模型外挂极小的在线联想记忆状态（默认8×8矩阵），通过delta-rule边读边写历史信息，将记忆信号转为注意力低秩修正。在Qwen3-4B上，TSW版本平均分51.66，比冻结backbone（46.79）高4.87分，比最强非δ-mem基线Context2LoRA（44.90）高6.76分。MemoryAgentBench上，MSW版本从29.54提升至38.85；LoCoMo上从40.79提升至49.12；HotpotQA的EM/F1从42.35/56.00提升至49.41/63.66。在SmolLM3-3B上提升最大（+10.88分）。参数开销仅0.12%（SSW/TSW）或0.48%（MSW），显存几乎无增加，解码吞吐略低于Vanilla但远优于MemGen。写入粒度支持token级（TSW）、段级（SSW）和多状态（MSW），适合不同场景。该方法将记忆从文本层推进到attention steering层，为小模型长期记忆增强提供了轻量级方案。
report_titles: NTU、复旦等提出 δ-mem:只用 8*8 在线记忆矩阵,让大模型长期记忆涨到 1.31*

arxiv.title: $δ$-mem: Efficient Online Memory for Large Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Large language models increasingly need to accumulate and reuse historical information in long-term assistants and agent systems. Simply expanding the context window is costly and often fails to ensure effective context utilization. We propose $δ$-mem, a lightweight memory mechanism that augments a frozen full-attention backbone with a compact online state of associative memory. $δ$-mem compresses past information into a fixed-size state matrix updated by delta-rule learning, and uses its readout to generate low-rank corrections to the backbone's attention computation during generation. With only an $8\times8$ online memory state, $δ$-mem improves the average score to $1.10\times$ that of the frozen backbone and $1.15\times$ that of the strongest non-$δ$-mem memory baseline. It achieves larger gains on memory-heavy benchmarks, reaching $1.31\times$ on MemoryAgentBench and $1.20\times$ on LoCoMo, while largely preserving general capabilities. These results show that effective memory can be realized through a compact online state directly coupled with attention computation, without full fine-tuning, backbone replacement, or explicit context extension.

papers.title: SDAR: A Synergistic Diffusion-AutoRegression Paradigm for Scalable Sequence Generation
papers.report_title: OPSD火到 Agent 训练,美团&清华发布SDAR给蒸馏装了一道token级门控
papers.summary: 针对多轮LLM智能体训练中OPSD蒸馏的误差累积与特权指导信任不对称问题，浙江大学团队提出SDAR框架（Self-Distilled Agentic Reinforcement Learning），以GRPO强化学习为核心优化骨干，引入token级自适应sigmoid门控机制选择性蒸馏教师信号，实现无偏全局优化与精细token指导的稳定融合。实验在ALFWorld、Search-QA、WebShop三大基准上全面验证：Qwen2.5-3B模型上，ALFWorld平均成功率从75.0%提升至84.4%（+9.4%），Search-QA平均准确率从36.4%提升至43.4%（+7.0%），WebShop准确率从63.3%提升至68.0%（+4.7%）；Qwen2.5-7B在WebShop上准确率从72.6%跃升至82.8%（+10.2%）。小模型Qwen3-1.7B上优势更显著，ALFWorld成功率达53.9%，远超纯GRPO（46.1%）和混合方法（GRPO+OPSD仅32.0%）。门控消融显示：Gap门控最优（成功率约84%），门控锐度β=5.0、蒸馏系数λ=0.01时效果最佳。SDAR无需外部技能输入即可内化特权知识，且对技能检索质量不敏感（随机检索下仍超GRPO）。论文代码已开源，为多轮Agent训练提供了稳定可复用的统一范式。

arxiv.title: SDAR: A Synergistic Diffusion-AutoRegression Paradigm for Scalable Sequence Generation
arxiv.abstract: We propose SDAR, a Synergistic Diffusion-Autoregression paradigm that unifies the training efficiency of autoregressive models with the parallel inference capability of diffusion. Instead of costly end-to-end diffusion training, SDAR performs a lightweight paradigm conversion that transforms a well-trained autoregressive (AR) model into a blockwise diffusion model through brief, data-efficient adaptation. During inference, SDAR generates sequences autoregressively across blocks for global coherence while decoding all tokens within each block in parallel via a discrete diffusion process. Extensive experiments show that AR models remain substantially more compute-efficient than masked diffusion models, providing a strong foundation for adaptation. Building on this insight, SDAR achieves efficient AR-to-diffusion conversion with minimal cost, preserving AR-level performance while enabling parallel generation. Scaling studies across dense and Mixture-of-Experts architectures confirm that SDAR scales without compromise: larger models exhibit stronger robustness to block size and decoding thresholds, yielding greater speedups without accuracy loss. Beyond efficiency, SDAR demonstrates enhanced reasoning and domain adaptability. papers.title: DAQ: Delta-Aware Quantization for Post-Training LLM Weight Compression
papers.report_title: 腾讯重新定义后训练量化,DAQ让FP8小参数更新不失真
papers.summary: 腾讯元宝/混元AI Infra团队提出Delta-Aware Quantization（DAQ），针对后训练模型（SFT/RLHF等）量化过程中微调知识丢失的问题，将优化目标从传统的重建误差（MSE）转向保护参数增量方向（ΔW）。标准FP8量化在DeepSeek-V3上导致风格指标（Style）从BF16基线的1.709骤降至1.081（block级）或1.323（channel级），而通用指标（General）相对稳定，证实小幅度参数增量承载了对话风格等行为差异，且极易被量化噪声抹除。DAQ引入两个增量感知指标：符号保留率（SignRate）和余弦相似度（CosSim），并设计粗到细的两阶段scale搜索策略。实验表明，采用SignRate或CosSim作为搜索目标后，Style指标分别恢复至1.718和1.647（block级），接近BF16基线；同时General指标保持稳定（1.380~1.471）。值得注意的是，若继续使用MSE作为搜索目标，Style指标反而恶化至0.260（block级），证明MSE优化主动将权重拉向base模型，放大微调信号丢失。DAQ与GPTQ/AWQ/SmoothQuant等技术正交，可通过结合进一步提升效果。论文已公开于arXiv（2603.22324），代码集成在Tencent/AngelSlim仓库。未来工作将探索非对称量化、混合精度、查表量化网格与增量感知目标的联合优化。该工作为后训练量化提供了全新视角：从‘重建完整模型’转向‘保护增量知识’，对推理部署中保持模型微调后特有行为具有重要价值。
papers.authors: 腾讯元宝/混元AI Infra团队
report_titles: 腾讯重新定义后训练量化,DAQ让FP8小参数更新不失真

arxiv.title: DAQ: Delta-Aware Quantization for Post-Training LLM Weight Compression
arxiv.abstract: We introduce Delta-Aware Quantization (DAQ), a data-free post-training quantization framework that preserves the knowledge acquired during post-training. Standard quantization objectives minimize reconstruction error but are agnostic to the base model, allowing quantization noise to disproportionately corrupt the small-magnitude parameter deltas ($ΔW$) that encode post-training behavior -- an effect we analyze through the lens of quantization as implicit regularization. DAQ replaces reconstruction-based objectives with two delta-aware metrics -- Sign Preservation Rate and Cosine Similarity -- that directly optimize for directional fidelity of $ΔW$, requiring only the base and post-trained weight matrices. In a pilot FP8 study, DAQ recovers style-specific capabilities lost under standard quantization while maintaining general performance.

papers.title: FLARE: Agentic Coverage-Guided Fuzzing for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
papers.report_title: 【论文速读】| FLARE—面向大语言模型多智能体系统的智能覆盖引导模糊测试
papers.summary: 本文介绍FLARE框架，专为LLM多智能体系统（MAS）设计的覆盖引导模糊测试工具。在16个开源MAS应用上的评估中，FLARE实现了96.9%的智能体间覆盖率（RAC）和91.1%的智能体内覆盖率（AAC），分别超越最强基线LLM-Fuzzer约9.5%和1.0%。传统指标语句覆盖率达94.2%，分支覆盖率达81.7%。FLARE共发现56个此前未知的MAS特有故障，涵盖智能体任务执行（25个，包含提示偏离15个、响应缺失4个等）、工具调用（16个）、智能体关系（4个）和系统终止（11个），而基线方法仅发现少量运行时崩溃。故障检测机制采用双智能体验证（故障+裁判），有效过滤LLM幻觉误报。规范生成准确性人工审核Cohen's Kappa达0.8512。FLARE对底层LLM不敏感，替换Gemini-3-Pro后覆盖率稳定。该工作填补了MAS自动化测试空白，为LLM智能体系统的可靠性验证提供了系统化方案。论文链接https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.05289。
report_titles: 【论文速读】| FLARE—面向大语言模型多智能体系统的智能覆盖引导模糊测试

arxiv.title: FLARE: Agentic Coverage-Guided Fuzzing for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
arxiv.abstract: Multi-Agent LLM Systems (MAS) have been adopted to automate complex human workflows by breaking down tasks into subtasks. However, due to the non-deterministic behavior of LLM agents and the intricate interactions between agents, MAS applications frequently encounter failures, including infinite loops and failed tool invocations. Traditional software testing techniques are ineffective in detecting such failures due to the lack of LLM agent specification, the large behavioral space of MAS, and semantic-based correctness judgment. This paper presents FLARE, a novel testing framework tailored for MAS. FLARE takes the source code of MAS as input and extracts specifications and behavioral spaces from agent definitions. Based on these specifications, FLARE builds test oracles and conducts coverage-guided fuzzing to expose failures. It then analyzes execution logs to judge whether each test has passed and generates failure reports. Our evaluation on 16 diverse open-source applications demonstrates that FLARE achieves 96.9% inter-agent coverage and 91.1% intra-agent coverage, outperforming baselines by 9.5% and 1.0%. FLARE also uncovers 56 previously unknown failures unique to MAS.

papers.title: Mage-VL: An Efficient Codec-Native Streaming Multimodal Foundation Model
papers.report_title: 冻结大模型也能自我进化?这篇论文让大模型靠“图记忆”自我进化
papers.summary: MAGE框架通过外部共进化知识图谱（EVOKG）让冻结的8B模型（Qwen3-8B/Llama-3.1-8B）持续自我进化，不更新模型参数。在五个推理基准上全部超过最强提示基线：RealMath提升31.6点（最佳MAGE Opus），STBench提升20.8点，GSM8K、HotpotQA、WebQA亦有稳定提升。FinQA达到69.0±1.5（基线58.0），MedQA达到79.8±1.9（基线64.5），超过Medprompt参考74。在Crafter环境中，独立Llama-3.1-8B peak unlock率为25.5±3.2，MAGE Opus教师达到37.9±3.5。WebShop任务分数90.2±2.3，严格成功率84.0±1.8。成功记忆消融实验表明，去掉成功记忆后平均性能下降7.0点（GSM8K -7.8, RealMath -11.5等），证明成功记忆是关键燃料。EVOKG包含能力、任务、经验、环境四子图，经验子图保存原则、失败、成功记忆等。MAGE通过追加式记忆（append-only）保证信息单调性，轮转式课程选择避免任务覆盖不均，非对称mastery更新减少灾难性遗忘。该框架为冻结模型的自我进化提供了结构化外部记忆的新路线。
report_titles: 冻结大模型也能自我进化?这篇论文让大模型靠“图记忆”自我进化

arxiv.title: Mage-VL: An Efficient Codec-Native Streaming Multimodal Foundation Model
arxiv.abstract: Standard vision-language models (VLMs) suffer from Moravec's paradox: they excel at complex offline visual reasoning but struggle with simple streaming perception tasks and process them inefficiently. We present Mage-VL, an efficient codec-native streaming foundation model for real-time multimodal understanding and interaction. At its core, our custom tokenizer, Mage-ViT, replaces uniform frame sampling by selectively encoding dynamic, entropy-rich regions using motion vectors and residual energy across sparse anchor (I) and predicted (P) frames. Operating at a 16 x 16 patch level, this reduces visual token consumption by over 75% while preserving spatiotemporal context. Trained from scratch on approximately 560M unlabeled images and 100M unlabeled video frames, Mage-ViT matches or outperforms flagship encoders trained on billions of image-text pairs. We establish AI4AI data pipelines encompassing prompt-code joint optimization for multimodal captioning and AI-driven performance diagnosis to guide training recipes. Furthermore, through a bio-inspired dual-system architecture - a lightweight System 1 event gate and a causal System 2 decoder - Mage-VL enables proactive streaming perception. papers.title: HeavySkill: Heavy Thinking as the Inner Skill in Agentic Harness
papers.report_title: 最新【AI论文】解读|把重思考装进模型参数,效果反超复杂编排
papers.summary: 本文解读了arXiv论文HeavySkill（arXiv:2605.02396），该研究提出将智能体框架中反复出现的“先并行生成多条推理路径再汇总”模式视为模型内在技能，而非编排层技巧。方法：定义两阶段流程——第一阶段并行推理（广度N条独立推理链），第二阶段由模型自行汇总综合答案（深度由汇总token数衡量）。通过强化学习训练，使模型学会自动生成多样化路径并精准挑选正确结果。实验在数学推理、代码生成、常识推理等任务上进行，结果显示HeavySkill训练模型一致超越传统Best-of-N策略，在相同采样预算下答对率更高；且在更强基础模型上表现逼近Pass@N理论上限。强化学习可同时放大广度和深度，未见过早饱和。文章认为，HeavySkill揭示了许多性能提升本质上来源于模型内化的可学习技能，而非编排层精巧设计，为自进化大模型开辟新方向。本文属于对单篇论文的深度技术拆解与评估。
report_titles: 最新【AI论文】解读|把重思考装进模型参数,效果反超复杂编排

arxiv.title: HeavySkill: Heavy Thinking as the Inner Skill in Agentic Harness
arxiv.abstract: Recent advances in agentic harness with orchestration frameworks that coordinate multiple agents with memory, skills, and tool use have achieved remarkable success in complex reasoning tasks. However, the underlying mechanism that truly drives performance remains obscured behind intricate system designs. In this paper, we propose HeavySkill, a perspective that views heavy thinking not only as a minimal execution unit in orchestration harness but also as an inner skill internalized within the model's parameters that drives the orchestrator to solve complex tasks. We identify this skill as a two-stage pipeline, i.e., parallel reasoning then summarization, which can operate beneath any agentic harness. We present a systematic empirical study of HeavySkill across diverse domains. Our results show that this inner skill consistently outperforms traditional Best-of-N (BoN) strategies; notably, stronger LLMs can even approach Pass@N performance. Crucially, we demonstrate that the depth and width of heavy thinking, as a learnable skill, can be further scaled via reinforcement learning, offering a promising path toward self-evolving LLMs that internalize complex reasoning without relying on brittle orchestration layers.

papers.title: Warp-as-History: Generalizable Camera-Controlled Video Generation from One Training Video
papers.report_title: 上海AI实验室最新:仅靠1个视频,就能让视频生成器精准听话按轨迹运镜!
papers.summary: 本文深度解读上海AI实验室联合上海交通大学等提出的Warp-as-History方法，实现极低资源下的相机控制视频生成。核心创新在于：将相机轨迹导致的画面扭曲（Warp）伪装成视频生成模型（Helios）原生历史帧接口的输入，无需训练新模块，仅通过目标帧位置对齐与可见性选择即可激活模型预训练中沉睡的相机控制能力。关键数据：在WorldScore基准上，单视频LoRA微调（仅1000步，单卡A800约1小时）使相机控制分数从26.42（纯文本基线）飙升134.7%至62.00，超越CogVideoX-I2V，接近使用数万视频训练的方法（如Voyager）。在DAVIS和RE10K上，旋转误差和平移误差均低于ViewCrafter（训练数据8.5万视频）。零样本模式下（冻结权重不训练）即可实现初步轨迹跟随，消融实验证实每一步设计的必要性。该方法无需海量标注数据，推理开销可忽略（<1秒），但依赖首帧场景重建质量，对动态前景复杂场景稳定性仍有提升空间。论文揭示了‘能力暴露’而非‘能力赋予’的新范式，具有极高学术与实用价值。
papers.authors: 上海AI实验室、上海交通大学等

arxiv.title: Warp-as-History: Generalizable Camera-Controlled Video Generation from One Training Video
arxiv.abstract: Camera-controlled video generation has made substantial progress, enabling generated videos to follow prescribed viewpoint trajectories. However, existing methods usually learn camera-specific conditioning through camera encoders, control branches, or attention and positional-encoding modifications, which often require post-training on large-scale camera-annotated videos. Training-free alternatives avoid such post-training, but often shift the cost to test-time optimization or extra denoising-time guidance. We propose Warp-as-History, a simple interface that turns camera-induced warps into camera-warped pseudo-history with target-frame positional alignment and visible-token selection. Given a target camera trajectory, we construct camera-warped pseudo-history from past observations and feed it through the model's visual-history pathway. Crucially, we align its positional encoding with the target frames being denoised and remove warped-history tokens without valid source observations. Without any training, architectural modification, or test-time optimization, this interface reveals a non-trivial zero-shot capability of a frozen video generation model to follow camera trajectories. papers.title: LaST-R1: Reinforcing Robotic Manipulation via Adaptive Physical Latent Reasoning
papers.report_title: 机器人模型R1时刻!不只学动作更学会物理推理,LIBERO99.9%
papers.summary: 该文解读了LaST-R1框架，由至简动力、香港中文大学、北京大学等提出，被ICML2026接收为Spotlight论文。核心创新是LAPO（Latent-to-Action Policy Optimization），将隐空间物理推理纳入强化学习优化闭环，并引入Adaptive Latent CoT动态调整推理步长。实验结果非常亮眼：在LIBERO基准上仅用1条轨迹warm-up后，通过在线RL后训练达到99.9%平均成功率（四个套件分别99.8%/100%/100%/99.8%）；在真实机器人任务中，仅用30条轨迹warm-up，成功率从52.5%提升至93.75%，显著超过使用100条专家轨迹训练的π0.5（71.25%）。泛化测试中，在未见物体、背景变化和光照变化下性能下降更小，说明学到了可迁移的空间语义。该方法让机器人先进行隐空间推理再生成动作，而非直接映射，是具身大模型后训练的新范式。值得关注的是，该框架对模型架构无要求，可适配现有基座模型。
papers.authors: 至简动力、香港中文大学、北京大学等
report_titles: 机器人模型R1时刻!不只学动作更学会物理推理,LIBERO99.9%

arxiv.title: LaST-R1: Reinforcing Robotic Manipulation via Adaptive Physical Latent Reasoning
arxiv.abstract: Robotic foundation models require reasoning over complex visual scenes to execute adaptive actions in dynamic environments. While recent studies on latent-reasoning Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated the capability to capture fine-grained physical dynamics, they remain predominantly confined to static imitation learning, severely limiting their adaptability and generalization. In this paper, we present LaST-R1, a novel reinforcement learning (RL) post-training framework designed to effectively harness "latent reasoning-before-acting" policies. Specifically, we propose Latent-to-Action Policy Optimization (LAPO), a core RL algorithm that jointly optimizes the latent reasoning process and the action generation. By explicitly embedding latent Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning directly within the RL optimization loop, LAPO stimulates profound physical world modeling, which in turn drives robust execution in interactive environments. Furthermore, an adaptive latent CoT mechanism is introduced, allowing the policy to dynamically modulate its reasoning horizon based on diverse environment states. Experiments show that LaST-R1 achieves a near-perfect 99.9% average success rate on the LIBERO benchmark with only one-shot supervised warm-up, significantly improving convergence speed and performance over prior state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods. papers.title: REPTILES: Repeated Tiles of Sargantana, a RISC-V multicore based on OpenPiton
papers.report_title: 做 HPC 芯片有多难?这篇论文给出了一条开源路线
papers.summary: 本文解读了巴塞罗那超级计算中心（BSC）在RISC-V Summit Europe上发表的论文REPTILES（arXiv:2605.08229）。REPTILES整合了普林斯顿OpenPiton多核框架与BSC自研的Sargantana 64位RISC-V处理器核心（7级流水线、支持乱序写回和寄存器重命名，22nm FD-SOI下1.26 GHz）。关键改进包括：NoC总线宽度从64位到704位可配置、缓存块大小和MSHR可参数化、Sargantana从RVV 0.7升级至RVV 1.0（支持大部分向量指令并实现寄存器重命名，向量加法加速9.3倍）。在Alveo U55 FPGA上运行4核原型，执行NAS并行基准测试，4线程相比1线程平均加速3.1倍（理想4倍，并行效率约77.5%），其中CG和EP基准达3.6倍。论文由29位作者共同完成，合作机构包括UC Santa Barbara、法国Inria和CEA。文章指出REPTILES证明了开源RISC-V多核架构在HPC方向的可行性，但也面临生态成熟度、性能天花板（单发射顺序执行、不支持LMUL>1和向量浮点）、仅FPGA验证等挑战。

arxiv.title: REPTILES: Repeated Tiles of Sargantana, a RISC-V multicore based on OpenPiton
arxiv.abstract: Chip industry continues advancing and expanding modern computing systems, resulting in more complex multi-core processors. Conversely, academic projects face scalability challenges due to limited resources, highlighting the need for open-source frameworks that enable innovation and knowledge sharing. Recently, several open-source proposals have emerged, offering flexible and scalable designs, but fail to meet the performance demands of modern High-Performance Computing (HPC) applications. In this project, we present REPTILES, an open-source RISC-V multicore framework based on OpenPiton\thanks. REPTILES interconnects multiple Sargantana cores with the memory hierarchy of OpenPiton. Moreover, we present the new features incorporated in Sargantana and OpenPiton designs to improve the performance of HPC applications. We demonstrate that REPTILES presents suitable scalability, achieving a speedup of 3.1x on average with 4 cores. Additionally, we show that Sargantana's new features increase the performance of vector addition benchmark in a 9.3x.

papers.title: The Illusion of Thinking: Understanding the Strengths and Limitations of Reasoning Models via the Lens of Problem Complexity
papers.report_title: 大模型真的会思考吗?Apple 论文为什么会引发这么大争议
papers.summary: 本文深度解读Apple研究团队在NeurIPS 2025发表的论文《The Illusion of Thinking: Understanding the Strengths and Limitations of Reasoning Models via the Lens of Problem Complexity》。该论文通过设计可控逻辑谜题（如汉诺塔、过河问题），系统评估推理模型（rethinking model）的鲁棒性。关键发现：当问题复杂度提升到某个阈值后，推理模型的准确率会出现断崖式崩塌（complete accuracy collapse），而非平滑下降；且在高复杂度阶段，模型的思考token数反而减少，表明推理行为断裂。论文质疑“长思维链”是否等同于稳健推理能力。后续评论指出，实验可能存在输出长度限制和无解问题等设计缺陷，但核心结论仍极具价值：不能仅因模型输出长思维链就认为其具备泛化推理能力。文章还介绍了三类阶段的对比（低复杂度标准模型更优，中等复杂度推理模型胜出，高复杂度两者均崩塌）。本文属于对论文的深度技术拆解与批判性评估。

arxiv.title: The Illusion of Thinking: Understanding the Strengths and Limitations of Reasoning Models via the Lens of Problem Complexity
arxiv.abstract: Recent generations of language models have introduced Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) that generate detailed thinking processes before providing answers. While these models demonstrate improved performance on reasoning benchmarks, their fundamental capabilities, scaling properties, and limitations remain insufficiently understood. Current evaluations primarily focus on established math and coding benchmarks, emphasizing final answer accuracy. However, this evaluation paradigm often suffers from contamination and does not provide insights into the reasoning traces. In this work, we systematically investigate these gaps with the help of controllable puzzle environments that allow precise manipulation of complexity while maintaining consistent logical structures. This setup enables the analysis of not only final answers but also the internal reasoning traces, offering insights into how LRMs think. Through extensive experiments, we show that LRMs face a complete accuracy collapse beyond certain complexities. Moreover, they exhibit a counterintuitive scaling limit: their reasoning effort increases with problem complexity up to a point, then declines despite having remaining token budget. papers.summary: 本文解读了ICLR 2026论文《Pretrain Where? Investigating How Pretraining Data Diversity Impacts Geospatial Foundation Model Performance》（arXiv:2604.21104）。研究首次系统控制预训练数据的地理分布对遥感基础模型的影响。他们自建7个数据集（6个单大洲+1个全球均衡），每个约700k样本，采用SatMAE（ViT-Base）统一预训练50个epoch。下游评测使用FMoW-Sentinel、MOSAIKS Population、ForTy、GEO-Bench等，主要采用线性探测。反直觉发现：仅使用欧洲数据预训练的模型在全球和各洲下游任务中均表现最优，甚至优于在对应区域数据上预训练的模型，打破了“地理匹配即最优”的假设。进一步分析表明，样本级光谱熵（衡量像素光谱复杂度）与下游性能呈强相关性，而大陆、生物群系、土地覆盖等传统地理多样性指标相关性弱。研究认为光谱熵是更关键的数据质量指标。代码和数据集已开源。本文属于论文推荐。

arxiv.title: Pretrain Where? Investigating How Pretraining Data Diversity Impacts Geospatial Foundation Model Performance
arxiv.abstract: New geospatial foundation models introduce a new model architecture and pretraining dataset, often sampled using different notions of data diversity. Performance differences are largely attributed to the model architecture or input modalities, while the role of the pretraining dataset is rarely studied. To address this research gap, we conducted a systematic study on how the geographic composition of pretraining data affects a model's downstream performance. We created global and per-continent pretraining datasets and evaluated them on global and per-continent downstream datasets. We found that the pretraining dataset from Europe outperformed global and continent-specific pretraining datasets on both global and local downstream evaluations. To investigate the factors influencing a pretraining dataset's downstream performance, we analysed 10 pretraining datasets using diversity across continents, biomes, landcover and spectral values. We found that only spectral diversity was strongly correlated with performance, while others were weakly correlated. This finding establishes a new dimension of diversity to be accounted for when creating a high-performing pretraining dataset. We open-sourced 7 new pretraining datasets, pretrained models, and our experimental framework at https://github.com/kerner-lab/pretrain-where.

papers.title: AME-PIM: Can Memory be Your Next Tensor Accelerator?
papers.report_title: AME-PIM:内存,能不能成为下一个张量加速器?
papers.summary: 本文解读了论文《AME-PIM: Can Memory be Your Next Tensor Accelerator?》，探讨将商业HBM-PIM（三星Aquabolt-XL）封装成RISC-V AME矩阵扩展后端的可行性。核心贡献在于通过PIM Execution Primitive (PEP) 微内核、Even/Odd Bank映射及reduction-free外积数据流，在单个HBM pseudo-channel上实现了14.9 GFLOP/s的矩阵tile乘法（59.4 FLOP/cycle），接近理论峰值128 FLOP/cycle的一半。实验表明，mfmacc指令在最大tile尺寸下效率饱和，且setup成本低于1%。与MPC-Wrapper相比，AME-PIM在GEMM/GEMV上达到59.4 vs 58.1 FLOP/cycle，并支持in-memory accumulation。论文同时揭示了当前HBM-PIM的局限：无cross-lane reduction、缺乏比较指令、operand routing不灵活（需用'加零'实现广播）以及数据类型支持有限（仅FP16）。结论强调，尽管性能尚未接近理论峰值，但通过ISA级抽象将PIM纳入编译器可管理的矩阵计算体系，是突破冯·诺依曼瓶颈的重要方向，尤其适合大块矩阵运算而非零碎小算子。

arxiv.title: AME-PIM: Can Memory be Your Next Tensor Accelerator?
arxiv.abstract: High Bandwidth Memory with Processing-in-Memory (HBM-PIM) offers an opportunity to reduce data movement by executing computation directly inside memory, but current commercial platforms expose limited instruction sets and require specialized software stacks. In this work, we investigate whether HBM-PIM can serve as a backend for ISA-level matrix acceleration, using the RISC-V Attached Matrix Extension (AME) as a semantic reference. We propose a PEP-based execution model that maps AME element-wise and matrix instructions to HBM-PIM micro-kernels and data instructions in memory operations. Differently from SoA HBM-PIM, we introduce a reduction-free outer-product dataflow that enables accumulation entirely within memory despite the lack of native reduction support. Our approach supports end-to-end execution of element-wise operations, GEMV, and GEMM in PIM mode, minimizing host involvement and off-chip transfers. An experimental evaluation on Samsung Aquabolt-XL shows that AME matrix tile multiplication achieves up to 14.9 GFLOP/s (59.4 FLOP/cycle) on a single HBM pseudo-channel.

papers.summary: 本文系统介绍了ChipLingo的训练框架（arXiv:2604.27415），针对EDA领域大模型面临的“知识理解”与“外部知识利用”双重挑战。研究团队观察到，领域训练后模型的检索增益率（RAG Gain Rate）下降，即对检索外部文档的依赖减弱。为解决此问题，他们提出三步走训练流程：多源语料QA增强、领域预训练（对比LoRA/Full FT/Partial FT，发现Partial FT在知识密集型任务中优于LoRA）、显式RAG场景训练。在自建内部基准EDA-Bench上，ChipLingo-8B达到59.7%准确率，超越同规模模型及部分更大通用模型（如DeepSeek V4）；ChipLingo-32B达70.02%，接近领先闭源商业模型。关键指标RAG增益率在RAG场景训练后得到有效缓解。文章强调，仅让模型“懂知识”不够，必须确保其在真实工程场景中能稳定利用外部文档、工具反馈和上下文状态，这是EDA Agent系统的基础能力。贡献包括：系统化训练方法、发现并缓解检索利用率退化、构建面向工程实践的EDA-Bench评估基准。

arxiv.title: ChipLingo: A Systematic Training Framework for Large Language Models in EDA
arxiv.abstract: With the rapid advancement of semiconductor technology, Electronic Design Automation (EDA) has become an increasingly knowledge-intensive and document-driven engineering domain. Although large language models (LLMs) have shown strong general capabilities, applying them directly to EDA remains challenging due to limited domain expertise, cross-tool knowledge confusion, and degraded retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) performance after domain training. To address these issues, this paper presents ChipLingo, a systematic training pipeline for domain-adapted LLMs tailored to EDA scenarios. ChipLingo consists of three stages: domain corpus construction with multi-source data curation and QA augmentation, domain-adaptive pretraining with comparisons of different parameter training strategies, and instruction alignment with RAG scenario training under diverse retrieval conditions. We also curate an internal benchmark, EDA-Bench, covering representative EDA tool scenarios, with plans for public release. Experiments show that ChipLingo-8B achieves 59.7% accuracy on EDA-Bench, outperforming the same-scale base model and some larger general-purpose models. ChipLingo-32B reaches 70.02%, approaching leading closed-source commercial models. papers.report_title: 把隐私 ANN 搜索做到 12ms:Onyx 如何用“倒过来的协同设计”打破 ORAM + SSD 的性能墙?
papers.summary: 本文深度解读UC Berkeley、NVIDIA、UT Austin联合发表的论文《Onyx: Cost-Efficient Disk-Oblivious ANN Search》，该工作针对TEE+SSD环境下向量检索的磁盘访问模式泄露问题，提出一种新型协同设计方案。核心洞察在于“倒过来”设计ANN层与ORAM层的优化目标：传统方案让ANN省访问次数、ORAM省带宽，Onyx则让ANN省带宽（通过三阶段搜索：Traversal只读256–512B的hint+邻接表，Prune用Hprn重排序，最后Refinement只对少量候选读全精度向量），让ORAM省访问次数（通过浅d-ary树、本地化metadata、eviction整桶顺序读）。实验在AMD EPYC 9554 + Micron 7450 MAX SSD上，1 vCPU + 4GB RAM + 1 SSD unit配置下，对64GB索引（20M向量，每向量3KB）达到约70 QPS、12ms延迟、90% top-10 recall，相比Compass-in-TEE延迟降低2.3–12.3×、吞吐提升2.3–12.2×；Onyx-ORAM在512B小块访问下吞吐超10K logical accesses/s，相比RingORAM高5.1×、相比PathORAM高3.4×。论文还披露了关键资源消耗数据：1-SSD unit包含85K IOPS、330MB/s读带宽、175MB/s写带宽、187.5GB存储。Onyx将ORAM的访问次数从RingORAM的约2.5logN降至约1/3logN，带宽从约3logN略增至约4logN，实现了SSD场景下的最优平衡。该工作为RAG隐私检索、企业知识库、个人记忆库等场景提供了低成本可落地的解决方案。

arxiv.title: Onyx: Cost-Efficient Disk-Oblivious ANN Search
arxiv.abstract: Approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search in AI systems increasingly handles sensitive data on third-party infrastructure. Trusted execution environments (TEEs) offer protection, but cost-efficient deployments must rely on external SSDs, which leaks user queries through disk access patterns to the host. Oblivious RAM (ORAM) can hide these access patterns but at a high cost; when paired with existing disk-based ANN search techniques, it makes poor use of SSD resources, yielding high latency and poor cost-efficiency. The core challenge for efficient oblivious ANN search over SSDs is balancing both bandwidth and access count. The state-of-the-art ORAM-ANN design minimizes access count at the ANN level and bandwidth at the ORAM level, each trading-off the other, leaving the combined system with both resources overutilized. We propose inverting this design, minimizing bandwidth consumption in the ANN layer and access count in the ORAM layer, since each component is better suited for its new role: ANN's inherent approximation allows for more bandwidth efficiency, while ORAM has no fundamental lower bounds on access count (as opposed to bandwidth). papers.report_title: 别再只加电容了:AIM 如何从架构层缓解高性能 PIM 芯片的 IR-drop?
papers.summary: 本文深度解读了ISCA 2025论文《AIM: Software and Hardware Co-design for Architecture-level IR-drop Mitigation in High-performance PIM》，该论文针对高性能SRAM PIM芯片中严重的IR-drop问题，提出了从架构层、软件层和编译器层协同缓解的框架。论文在商用7nm 256-TOPS SRAM PIM设计上进行post-layout验证，实现了最高69.2%的IR-drop缓解、2.29倍的能效提升和1.152倍的性能提升。文章详细分析了PIM芯片IR-drop问题的特殊性：大量存内计算单元同时工作导致瞬时电流峰值放大，传统后端加去耦电容、调整floorplan等电路级方法代价高且易牺牲PPA。论文核心洞察在于将IR-drop与比特翻转活动关联，提出两个关键指标：Rtog（PIM bank内bitstream瞬时翻转率）和HR（权重中比特1的汉明率）。HSPICE实验表明，在7nm DPIM macro上Rtog与IR-drop相关系数达0.977，在28nm APIM macro上达0.998。AIM框架包含三个组件：离线软件优化LHR（在量化感知训练中引入低汉明率正则项）和WDS（将权重分布整体向正数方向平移以降低HR）；运行时硬件调节IR-Booster（根据HR信息动态选择更激进的电压-频率对）；以及HR-aware任务映射编译器策略。论文证实真实工作负载（如YOLOv5、ResNet18、Llama3、ViT）的IR-drop峰值显著低于signoff最坏情况，存在可被利用的margin。LHR通过可导近似引导权重落在“电路翻转友好”的编码位置，WDS采用2的幂次偏移并通过移位补偿器低成本修正计算结果。

arxiv.title: AIM: Software and Hardware Co-design for Architecture-level IR-drop Mitigation in High-performance PIM
arxiv.abstract: SRAM Processing-in-Memory (PIM) has emerged as the most promising implementation for high-performance PIM, delivering superior computing density, energy efficiency, and computational precision. However, the pursuit of higher performance necessitates more complex circuit designs and increased operating frequencies, which exacerbate IR-drop issues. Severe IR-drop can significantly degrade chip performance and even threaten reliability. Conventional circuit-level IR-drop mitigation methods, such as back-end optimizations, are resource-intensive and often compromise power, performance, and area (PPA). To address these challenges, we propose AIM, comprehensive software and hardware co-design for architecture-level IR-drop mitigation in high-performance PIM. Initially, leveraging the bit-serial and in-situ dataflow processing properties of PIM, we introduce Rtog and HR, which establish a direct correlation between PIM workloads and IR-drop. Building on this foundation, we propose LHR and WDS, enabling extensive exploration of architecture-level IR-drop mitigation while maintaining computational accuracy through software optimization. Subsequently, we develop IR-Booster, a dynamic adjustment mechanism that integrates software-level HR information with hardware-based IR-drop monitoring to adapt the V-f pairs of the PIM macro, achieving enhanced energy efficiency and performance. papers.report_title: 医学影像AI的＂万能插件＂? 多数据集蒸馏,一个模型搞定分割、分类、检测
papers.summary: 本文对一篇发表于2026年5月的学术论文进行深度解读，论文题目为《多数据集跨域知识蒸馏用于统一的医学图像分割、分类和检测》，来自布加勒斯特大学，arXiv链接：https://arxiv.org/pdf/2605.01563v1.pdf。论文提出MCD-KD框架，通过三阶段流水线（训练专科教师、构建联合教师、课程式知识蒸馏）将多个来源、不同任务的知识集成到轻量级学生模型中。核心技术包括域对抗训练（迫使编码器学习域不变特征）、交叉注意力多级特征融合以及课程式蒸馏（按训练轮次动态调整蒸馏权重）。实验覆盖分割（6个公开数据集，MRI/CT）、分类（肺部疾病和脑部退行性疾病）和检测（肺部CT病灶）三大任务。分割任务中，使用TResUNet架构的学生模型平均Dice得分比单数据集基线高出近4个百分点，且跨架构（TResUNet→UNet）蒸馏同样有效。分类和检测任务上也全面超越基线。定性结果展示学生模型分割边界更清晰、注意力更聚焦。论文同时指出局限性：训练成本高、需目标域标注数据、融合机制尚可优化。本文以“龙哥读论文”风格撰写，适合医学影像AI研究人员关注。

arxiv.title: Multi-Dataset Cross-Domain Knowledge Distillation for Unified Medical Image Segmentation, Classification, and Detection
arxiv.abstract: We propose a unified cross-domain transfer learning framework that leverages knowledge from multiple heterogeneous medical imaging datasets to improve performance across segmentation, classification, and object detection tasks. Our approach employs a teacher-student paradigm in which a joint teacher model aggregates domain-invariant representations learned from diverse source datasets, while a task-specific student model is trained via multi-level knowledge distillation. Originally developed for medical image segmentation, the framework is extended to support image-level classification and object-level detection, enabling a general multi-task formulation for medical image analysis. We evaluate our method on a broad suite of datasets, including six segmentation benchmarks, BrainMetShare, ISLES, BraTS (MRI) and Lung MSD, LiTS, KiTS (CT), as well as multiple classification datasets for pulmonary disease and dementia, and detection datasets with native bounding-box annotations. Across all tasks and modalities, the proposed approach yields consistent improvements over strong dataset-specific and multi-head baselines, demonstrating enhanced robustness to distributional shifts and superior generalization. papers.summary: 本文解读ASPLOS 2026论文REPA，提出一种GPU+可重构ReRAM PIM混合架构，旨在解决大模型推理中KV Cache占显存和解码阶段GPU利用率低两个核心痛点。REPA将解码阶段中难以批处理的scoring和context计算（与KV Cache强绑定）卸载到PIM，同时利用ReRAM的非易失性实现KV Cache的持久化卸载。关键数据：相比A100，REPA实现1.5–6.5×速度提升和8–10×能效提升；在Llama2-7B上，单请求KV Cache平均达670MiB；解码scoring/context即使batch size=16，GPU利用率仅提升5.8%/5.6%，而projection提升33%；REPA在2048和4096长序列上token生成能力分别比GPU高1.8–4.8×和2.1–6.5×；接入FlexGen后端到端延迟提升2.4–5.2×，吞吐提升1.0–2.4×；locality-aware映射使92%计算在单个tile内完成，相比传统映射长距离传输降低1.6–3.2×；能效方面每焦耳token数比GPU高2.1–4.3×；动态碎片率平均1.2%–1.5%。PIM die面积73.26mm²，功耗68.92W，容量32GiB。论文通过BLK_SET指令和4 controllers/PU的甜点设计，在面积-功耗-性能间做了扎实折中。REPA的核心贡献不是简单加速，而是将“算、传、存”三件事重叠执行，为长上下文推理提供了可行方向。
report_titles: 把 KV Cache “搬进内存里算”:REPA 如何同时解决大模型“存不下”和“跑不快”?

arxiv.title: U-REPA: Aligning Diffusion U-Nets to ViTs
arxiv.abstract: Representation Alignment (REPA) that aligns Diffusion Transformer (DiT) hidden-states with ViT visual encoders has proven highly effective in DiT training, demonstrating superior convergence properties, but it has not been validated on the canonical diffusion U-Net architecture that shows faster convergence compared to DiTs. However, adapting REPA to U-Net architectures presents unique challenges: (1) different block functionalities necessitate revised alignment strategies; (2) spatial-dimension inconsistencies emerge from U-Net's spatial downsampling operations; (3) space gaps between U-Net and ViT hinder the effectiveness of tokenwise alignment. To encounter these challenges, we propose \textbf{U-REPA}, a representation alignment paradigm that bridges U-Net hidden states and ViT features as follows: Firstly, we propose via observation that due to skip connection, the middle stage of U-Net is the best alignment option. Secondly, we propose upsampling of U-Net features after passing them through MLPs. Thirdly, we observe difficulty when performing tokenwise similarity alignment, and further introduces a manifold loss that regularizes the relative similarity between samples. Experiments indicate that the resulting U-REPA could achieve excellent generation quality and greatly accelerates the convergence speed. With CFG guidance interval, U-REPA could reach $FID<1.5$ in 200 epochs

papers.title: AMMA: A Multi-Chiplet Memory-Centric Architecture for Low-Latency 1M Context Attention Serving
papers.report_title: 存储器行业加大对下一代技术“HBM-PNM”的研究力度
papers.summary: 本文聚焦HBM-PNM（近内存处理）技术的最新研究进展，重点介绍了由三星电子、英伟达、加州大学圣地亚哥分校、哥伦比亚大学和延世大学联合团队在arXiv上发表的AMMA（多芯片内存中心架构）方案。该方案针对LLM解码阶段注意力机制中GPU计算核心利用率仅4%-5%、内存带宽成为瓶颈的问题，提出移除传统GPU计算芯片，改用16个HBM-PNM立方体构成4×4网格结构，将封装内内存带宽提升至44TB/s（约为现有架构两倍）。实测数据显示，与NVIDIA H100相比，AMMA架构将注意力延迟降低15.5倍，能耗降低6.9倍；与下一代Rubin GPU相比，速度提升1.8-2.5倍，能效提高2.6-3.1倍，特别是在百万级超长上下文推理和智能体工作负载中表现优异。文章还回顾了“存储墙”问题：处理器算力每两年增长3.1倍，而DRAM带宽每两年仅增长1.4倍，差距达1.7倍，DRAM在10nm节点已面临发展天花板。HBM4采用5nm及以下逻辑工艺降低了PNM实施门槛，使该技术有望突破以GPU为中心的传统架构。整体来看，本文为近存加速领域提供了极具价值的实测数据和架构对比，值得关注其后续产业化进展。
papers.authors: 三星电子、英伟达、加州大学圣地亚哥分校、哥伦比亚大学、延世大学联合团队
report_titles: 存储器行业加大对下一代技术“HBM-PNM”的研究力度

arxiv.title: AMMA: A Multi-Chiplet Memory-Centric Architecture for Low-Latency 1M Context Attention Serving
arxiv.abstract: All current LLM serving systems place the GPU at the center, from production-level attention-FFN disaggregation to NVIDIA's Rubin GPU-LPU heterogeneous platform. Even academic PIM/PNM proposals still treat the GPU as the central hub for cross-device communication. Yet the GPU's compute-rich architecture is fundamentally mismatched with the memory-bound nature of decode-phase attention, inflating serving latency while wasting power and die area on idle compute units. The problem is compounded as reasoning and agentic workloads push context lengths toward one million tokens, making attention latency the primary user-facing bottleneck. To address these inefficiencies, we present AMMA, a multi-chiplet, memory-centric architecture for low-latency long-context attention. AMMA replaces GPU compute dies with HBM-PNM cubes, roughly doubling the available memory bandwidth to better serve memory-bound attention workloads. To translate this bandwidth into proportional performance gains, we introduce (i) a logic-die microarchitecture that fully exploits per-cube internal bandwidth for decode attention under a minimal power and area budget, (ii) a two-level hybrid parallelism scheme, and (iii) a reordered collective flow that reduces intra-chip die-to-die communication overhead. papers.title: Faster LLM Inference via Sequential Monte Carlo
papers.report_title: SMC-SD:蒙特卡洛颠覆推测解码,5.2倍加速告别无效拒绝
papers.summary: 本文提出一种全新的推测解码范式SMC-SD（Sequential Monte Carlo Speculative Decoding），用序贯蒙特卡洛重采样替代传统的token级拒绝采样，从根本上解决了标准推测解码（SD）中“遇到第一个错误即截断”导致的算力浪费问题。SMC-SD维护多个草稿序列（粒子），按目标模型打分进行重要性加权重采样，使错误草稿不再是废料，而是可被重新加权利用的粒子群，同时消除回滚开销。作者指出，LLM推理本质是内存带宽受限，因此并行生成多个草稿粒子的额外计算几乎是“免费”的。实验在推理、指令遵循和代码编写三类主流基准上进行：相比自回归解码平均加速5.2倍，相比标准推测解码平均加速2.36倍，且精度损失控制在3%以内。关键优势包括：无回滚设计（验证操作固定大小向量化）、理论近似误差有保证、无需特殊硬件即可在常规GPU上部署。性能对比清晰量化：自回归解码1×、标准SD约2.2×（有回滚开销）、SMC-SD 5.2×（无回滚，精度偏差<3%）。该方法为生产场景提供了高度实用的工程权衡——3%的精度损失换取近翻倍的加速，使同等算力可服务更多用户。论文来自arXiv:2604.15672，2026年4月。

arxiv.title: Faster LLM Inference via Sequential Monte Carlo
arxiv.abstract: Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates language model inference by drafting tokens from a cheap proposal model and verifying them against an expensive target model via rejection sampling. Because rejection truncates the draft block at the first error, throughput degrades when draft and target diverge. Rather than rejecting draft tokens outright, we propose to reweight them. To this end, we introduce sequential Monte Carlo speculative decoding (SMC-SD), which replaces token-level rejection with importance-weighted resampling over a population of draft particles. SMC-SD is a principled approximate inference scheme that trades exactness for additional speed, while preserving theoretical bounds on its per-step approximation error. Because LLM inference is memory bandwidth-bound, the arithmetic needed to draft particles and to score them in parallel comes nearly for free -- SMC-SD uses idle compute to turn verification into a vectorized, fixed-size operation with no rollback. Empirically, SMC-SD achieves 2.36x speed-up over speculative decoding and a 5.2x speed-up over autoregressive decoding, while remaining within 3% of the target model's accuracy on reasoning, instruction-following, and coding benchmarks.

papers.title: ARM: Adaptive Reasoning Model
papers.report_title: 论文笔记|ARM:让大模型学会“该少想就少想”(NeurIPS 2025 Workshop ER)
papers.summary: 本文是对ARM（Adaptive Reasoning Model）论文的技术笔记，聚焦于解决大型推理模型（LRMs）的overthinking问题。直接动机：当前LRMs依赖Long CoT获得强推理能力，但不区分任务难度，简单题也消耗大量推理token，造成浪费甚至引入误导。现有方法不足：通用模型能力不足；LRMs默认长推理成本高；token budget方法难以提前估计任务所需长度；SFT只能教格式不能教何时使用；GRPO会导致format collapse（格式坍缩），模型最终只选择准确率最高的Long CoT。核心直觉：不同任务需要不同粒度推理，模型应学会选择推理格式（Direct Answer、Short CoT、Code、Long CoT），而非控制思考长度。方法名为Ada-GRPO，在GRPO框架基础上修改奖励计算，鼓励模型根据任务难度自适应选择格式。实验部分仅展示初步结果，提到在基本不损失准确率的情况下显著减少token。文章未提供具体数字指标（如token减少百分比、准确率对比），也未给出完整消融实验。这是一篇典型的早期工作笔记，适合关注推理效率优化的研究人员快速了解方向。

arxiv.title: ARM: Adaptive Reasoning Model
arxiv.abstract: While large reasoning models demonstrate strong performance on complex tasks, they lack the ability to adjust reasoning token usage based on task difficulty. This often leads to the "overthinking" problem -- excessive and unnecessary reasoning -- which, although potentially mitigated by human intervention to control the token budget, still fundamentally contradicts the goal of achieving fully autonomous AI. In this work, we propose Adaptive Reasoning Model (ARM), a reasoning model capable of adaptively selecting appropriate reasoning formats based on the task at hand. These formats include three efficient ones -- Direct Answer, Short CoT, and Code -- as well as a more elaborate format, Long CoT. To train ARM, we introduce Ada-GRPO, an adaptation of Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), which addresses the format collapse issue in traditional GRPO. Ada-GRPO enables ARM to achieve high token efficiency, reducing tokens by an average of 30%, and up to 70%, while maintaining performance comparable to the model that relies solely on Long CoT. Furthermore, not only does it improve inference efficiency through reduced token generation, but it also brings a 2x speedup in training. papers.title: Knowledge Is Not Static: Order-Aware Hypergraph RAG for Language Models
papers.report_title: GraphRAG的盲区,被OKH-RAG攻克了,让AI读懂因果链条
papers.summary: 本文解读的OKH-RAG（Order-aware Knowledge Hypergraph RAG）论文由Texas A&M等高校提出，核心发现是传统RAG（包括GraphRAG、HyperGraphRAG）将检索证据视为无序集合，但严格数学证明（Proposition 1）表明证据顺序直接影响推理结果：P(y|a,b,q) ≠ P(y|b,a,q)。针对该盲区，OKH-RAG用超图（Hypergraph）保留多因素交互语义，并引入顺序感知——为每个超边分配序列索引，构建有序状态序列H(l)表示推理轨迹。自监督顺序学习模块通过文档顺序、实体重叠和检索反馈三种信号，自动学习超边间的转移优先级（非对称双线性模型P_θ(e_j|e_i)）。检索任务从“找top-k相关片段”升级为“寻找最优有序轨迹”，由相关性、顺序连贯性、优先级一致性、实体连续性和阶段覆盖率五维评分，结合束搜索高效求解。在CyPortQA数据集（90场飓风、145港口、11.7万道跨时间窗口问题）上，OKH-RAG与HyperGraphRAG使用完全相同的底层超图，仅因顺序建模带来显著提升，控制实验严格证明性能增益来自顺序而非其他因素。案例显示，对动态演化场景（如飓风ARLENE）效果尤显，而规则阶段场景（ALEX）则受益较小。模型还能自适应不同查询类型：跨时间推理问题自动构建演化链，单事实查询则压缩于本地窗口。论文标题《Knowledge Is Not Static: Order-Aware Hypergraph RAG for Language Models》，arxiv链接https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.12185。该工作为RAG从“找碎片”升级到“拼轨迹”提供了关键范式转变。

arxiv.title: Knowledge Is Not Static: Order-Aware Hypergraph RAG for Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) enhances large language models by grounding outputs in retrieved knowledge. However, existing RAG methods including graph- and hypergraph-based approaches treat retrieved evidence as an unordered set, implicitly assuming permutation invariance. This assumption is misaligned with many real-world reasoning tasks, where outcomes depend not only on which interactions occur, but also on the order in which they unfold. We propose Order-Aware Knowledge Hypergraph RAG (OKH-RAG), which treats order as a first-class structural property. OKH-RAG represents knowledge as higher-order interactions within a hypergraph augmented with precedence structure, and reformulates retrieval as sequence inference over hyperedges. Instead of selecting independent facts, it recovers coherent interaction trajectories that reflect underlying reasoning processes. A learned transition model infers precedence directly from data without requiring explicit temporal supervision. We evaluate OKH-RAG on order-sensitive question answering and explanation tasks, including tropical cyclone and port operation scenarios. OKH-RAG consistently outperforms permutation-invariant baselines, and ablations show that these gains arise specifically from modeling interaction order. papers.title: RecoWorld: Building Simulated Environments for Agentic Recommender Systems
papers.report_title: 曾经我们以为 AGI 将至:AI 七十年热潮、寒冬与重启
papers.summary: 本文深入解读Meta的RecoWorld论文（Building Simulated Environments for Agentic Recommender Systems），核心主张是推荐系统正从传统CTR预测范式向Agentic RecSys演进。文章重点分析了RecoWorld如何构建基于LLM用户模拟器的沙盒环境，使推荐Agent能在多轮交互中学习理解用户意图。关键技术突破包括：dual-view架构（User Simulator + Agentic RecSys），通过LLM模拟用户生成行为与自然语言反馈（如“给我看点更有意思的内容”），使推荐从“猜你喜欢”转向“理解你并响应你”。文章强调，在约8万技能库场景下，语义ID建模（Semantic ID）为推荐与大模型融合的关键接口，可压缩多模态内容为离散语义单元。同时指出推荐目标正从item-level点击率转向session-level长期体验，用户模拟器可输出reasoning trace（如为什么跳过），但存在LLM过于理性的风险。文中还提到multi-agent simulator可将创作者内容预投放至模拟用户群测试，形成内容创作决策系统。最后总结，未来推荐系统将在底层模块之上新增Agentic Interaction Layer，负责理解自然语言、维护动态记忆、融合显式指令与隐式行为。

arxiv.title: RecoWorld: Building Simulated Environments for Agentic Recommender Systems
arxiv.abstract: We present RecoWorld, a blueprint for building simulated environments tailored to agentic recommender systems. Such environments give agents a proper training space where they can learn from errors without impacting real users. RecoWorld distinguishes itself with a dual-view architecture: a simulated user and an agentic recommender engage in multi-turn interactions aimed at maximizing user retention. The user simulator reviews recommended items, updates its mindset, and when sensing potential user disengagement, generates reflective instructions. The agentic recommender adapts its recommendations by incorporating these user instructions and reasoning traces, creating a dynamic feedback loop that actively engages users. This process leverages the exceptional reasoning capabilities of modern LLMs. We explore diverse content representations within the simulator, including text-based, multimodal, and semantic ID modeling, and discuss how multi-turn RL enables the recommender to refine its strategies through iterative interactions. RecoWorld also supports multi-agent simulations, allowing creators to simulate the responses of targeted user populations. It marks an important first step toward recommender systems where users and agents collaboratively shape personalized information streams. papers.report_title: 科研进入AGI时代!PaperGuru在Auto Research评测中领先人类博士25分
papers.summary: 本文解读阿里达摩院最新论文《SkillRouter: Skill Routing for LLM Agents at Scale》。核心问题是LLM Agent在技能库规模达约8万时，如何快速准确进行技能路由。SkillRouter采用两阶段流水线：双编码器（0.6B）从8万技能库中粗筛出前20个候选，再通过交叉编码器（0.6B）精细排序，总参数量仅1.2B，Hit@1达74%，比16B基线系统高6个百分点（74% vs 68%），速度快5.8倍且内存更少。关键创新包括：假阴性过滤（剔除约10%等效技能，带来+4.0%准确率提升）和列表式重排序损失（让模型直接比较20个候选优劣，带来+30.7%准确率提升）。在4个真实编程Agent（Claude Sonnet、Kimi等）上端到端测试，任务成功率提升1.78%-2.33%，且更强模型（Claude Opus）获益更大。论文揭示核心规律：完整技能文本（Body）而非仅元数据是精准路由的生命线。文章提供了论文链接（arxiv/pdf/2603.22455）和GitHub仓库。

arxiv.title: SkillRouter: Skill Routing for LLM Agents at Scale
arxiv.abstract: Reusable skills let LLM agents package task-specific procedures, tool affordances, and execution guidance into modular building blocks. As skill ecosystems grow to tens of thousands of entries, exposing every skill at inference time becomes infeasible. This creates a skill-routing problem: given a user task, the system must identify relevant skills before downstream planning or execution. Existing agent stacks often rely on progressive disclosure, exposing only skill names and descriptions while hiding the full implementation body. We examine this design choice on a SkillsBench-derived benchmark with approximately 80K candidate skills, targeting the practically important setting of large skill registries with heavy overlap. Across representative dense and reranking baselines on this setting, hiding the skill body causes a 37-44 percentage point drop in routing accuracy. Stronger controls show that the missing signal is body-resident rather than a simple length artifact: body-distilled descriptions recover part of the gap, but remain 7-21 points below direct all-field routing, while a metadata-only encoder trained with the same data remains 14.0 points below its all-field counterpart. papers.title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
papers.report_title: ReAct 论文深度解读:让大模型学会“边想边做“
papers.summary: 本文深度解读Google Research与Princeton发表于2022年的经典论文《ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models》。ReAct通过Thought（思考）、Action（行动）、Observation（观察）闭环，让大模型在推理时能调用外部工具获取真实反馈，解决了Chain-of-Thought（CoT）闭门造车、容易产生幻觉的问题。关键数据：在HotPotQA、Fever等多跳推理任务上，ReAct+CoT协同相比单独CoT精度提升约10-15%。论文提出ReAct的三个核心组件：Thought负责推理策略，Action调用搜索引擎等工具，Observation获取真实反馈纠正错误。文章还对比了ReAct与AutoGPT、Reflexion、Plan-and-Execute等技术的关系，指出ReAct已成为AI Agent的标配架构。局限性包括API调用成本、Token消耗增加、循环依赖风险等。实践建议：适合需要实时信息、多跳推理、避免幻觉的场景。该论文在Semantic Scholar上引用量达7,293，为后续Agent系统奠定了基础。

arxiv.title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
arxiv.abstract: While large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities across tasks in language understanding and interactive decision making, their abilities for reasoning (e.g. chain-of-thought prompting) and acting (e.g. action plan generation) have primarily been studied as separate topics. In this paper, we explore the use of LLMs to generate both reasoning traces and task-specific actions in an interleaved manner, allowing for greater synergy between the two: reasoning traces help the model induce, track, and update action plans as well as handle exceptions, while actions allow it to interface with external sources, such as knowledge bases or environments, to gather additional information. We apply our approach, named ReAct, to a diverse set of language and decision making tasks and demonstrate its effectiveness over state-of-the-art baselines, as well as improved human interpretability and trustworthiness over methods without reasoning or acting components. Concretely, on question answering (HotpotQA) and fact verification (Fever), ReAct overcomes issues of hallucination and error propagation prevalent in chain-of-thought reasoning by interacting with a simple Wikipedia API, and generates human-like task-solving trajectories that are more interpretable than baselines without reasoning traces. papers.report_title: [论文科普] EMO:把大模型拆成＂乐高积木＂——用更少专家,做更多事情
papers.summary: UC Berkeley与Allen AI联合发布论文《EMO: Pretraining Mixture of Experts for Emergent Modularity》，提出通过一个简单约束——同一文档内所有token共享专家池——让MoE专家在预训练中自然形成语义领域分组（数学、代码、生物医学等）。关键数据：EMO使用1B活跃参数、14B总参数（128路由专家+16共享专家），在1万亿tokens上预训练。保留12.5%专家时性能仅下降约3%，而标准MoE下降约15%；保留25%专家时EMO下降约1%，标准MoE下降约10%。分析显示标准MoE专家偏向低级别语法模式（介词、标点），而EMO专家偏向高级语义领域，实现了知识按领域分组。这种模块化能力使推理时可仅加载所需领域专家，为手机等内存受限设备部署大模型提供了可能。论文已在arXiv公开（2605.06663），模型和代码开源在HuggingFace和GitHub。研究预示着MoE从大规模稀疏计算走向可组合模块化架构，支持按需付费、模块更新和更好的可解释性。

arxiv.title: EMO: Pretraining Mixture of Experts for Emergent Modularity
arxiv.abstract: Large language models are typically deployed as monolithic systems, requiring the full model even when applications need only a narrow subset of capabilities, e.g., code, math, or domain-specific knowledge. Mixture-of-Experts (MoEs) seemingly offer a potential alternative by activating only a subset of experts per input, but in practice, restricting inference to a subset of experts for a given domain leads to severe performance degradation. This limits their practicality in memory-constrained settings, especially as models grow larger and sparser. We introduce EMO, an MoE designed for modularity-the independent use and composition of expert subsets-without requiring human-defined priors. Our key idea is to encourage tokens from similar domains to rely on similar experts. Since tokens within a document often share a domain, EMO restricts them to select experts from a shared pool, while allowing different documents to use different pools. This simple constraint enables coherent expert groupings to emerge during pretraining using document boundaries alone. We pretrain a 1B-active, 14B-total EMO on 1T tokens. As a full model, it matches standard MoE performance. Crucially, it enables selective expert use: retaining only 25% (12.5%) of experts incurs just a 1% (3%) absolute drop, whereas standard MoEs break under the same setting. papers.title: KnowledgeSmith: Uncovering Knowledge Updating in LLMs with Model Editing and Unlearning
papers.report_title: 三分钟论文速递 | 大模型如何编辑与遗忘知识?
papers.summary: 本文系统介绍了KnowledgeSmith框架，将知识编辑与机器遗忘统一为约束优化问题的两种形式，并基于知识图谱层级（根、中间、叶节点）自动生成超百万探针样本，覆盖直接、反向、多跳、上下文、冲突、比较六类探针，支持系统化知识干预评估。核心发现：编辑倾向于过度传播（附带变化比率高），遗忘则传播不足（残留保留率高）；存在一致性—容量权衡，数据过大会导致逻辑矛盾；编辑提升领域内准确性但损害鲁棒性，遗忘保持全局稳定性但局部增益弱；内部表征分析显示编辑表现为旋转加缩放，遗忘表现为各向异性缩放。在Qwen、Llama等多模型上实验表明，编辑在低数据效率下表现优异，LoRA微调存在知识漂移，遗忘策略保守但稳定。此外，编辑在10,000条样本上运行约6小时，遗忘仅需约0.2小时。论文发表于ICLR 2026，代码已开源。
report_titles: 三分钟论文速递 | 大模型如何编辑与遗忘知识?

arxiv.title: KnowledgeSmith: Uncovering Knowledge Updating in LLMs with Model Editing and Unlearning
arxiv.abstract: Knowledge editing and machine unlearning are two popular approaches for large language models (LLMs) to stay up-to-date. However, the knowledge updating mechanism of LLMs remains largely unexplored due to insufficient, isolated, and small-scale evaluation. For instance, are LLMs similar to humans in modifying certain knowledge? What differs editing and unlearning as training data increases? This paper proposes KnowledgeSmith, a unified framework to systematically understand the updating mechanism of LLMs. We first cast editing and unlearning as instances of one constrained optimization problem. Then, we propose an automatic dataset generator that provides structured interventions across multiple graph levels and data scales, enabling controlled studies of how different modification strategies propagate through model knowledge. Extensive experiments demonstrate nuanced insights over knowledge propagation, plasticity scaling, consistency, and robustness. For instance, our results show that LLMs do not exhibit similar updating as humans for different levels of knowledge, and there exists consistency-capacity trade-off. We hope our findings can offer suggestions to the design of more reliable and scalable strategies. Code: https://github.com/AIFrontierLab/KnowledgeSmith.git

papers.title: End-to-end autonomous scientific discovery on a real optical platform
papers.report_title: AI科学家自己“悟”了:首次在真实光学平台上完成端到端自主科学发现

arxiv.title: End-to-end autonomous scientific discovery on a real optical platform
arxiv.abstract: Scientific research has long been human-led, driving new knowledge and transformative technologies through the continual revision of questions, methods and claims as evidence accumulates. Although large language model (LLM)-based agents are beginning to move beyond assisting predefined research workflows, none has yet demonstrated end-to-end autonomous discovery in a real physical system that produces a nontrivial result supported by experimental evidence. Here we introduce Qiushi Discovery Engine, an LLM-based agentic system for end-to-end autonomous scientific discovery on a real optical platform. Qiushi Engine combines nonlinear research phases, Meta-Trace memory and a dual-layer architecture to maintain adaptive and stable research trajectories across long-horizon investigations involving thousands of LLM-mediated reasoning, measurement and revision actions. It autonomously reproduces a published transmission-matrix experiment on a non-original platform and converts an abstract coherence-order theory into experimental observables, providing, to our knowledge, the first observation of this class of coherence-order structure. papers.title: LLMs Get Lost In Multi-Turn Conversation
papers.report_title: 解析ICLR 2026杰出论文:为什么LLM总在多轮对话中“断片”?
papers.summary: 本文来自Microsoft，被ICLR 2026接收，首次系统揭示了大语言模型在多轮模糊指令场景下的性能退化问题。研究团队设计了“指令分片”流程，将完整指令拆解为多个信息碎片，并构建了包含用户模拟器、被评测助手和系统评估组件的多轮对话模拟环境。覆盖15款不同规模的开源与闭源LLM，开展超20万次模拟对话，横跨代码生成、SQL、API调用、数学解题、Data-to-text、多文档摘要6项任务。核心发现：所有模型在多轮模糊场景中的性能平均下降39%，最高达50%以上；性能下降的主因并非能力不足，而是不可靠性飙升112%（翻倍），表现为不同模拟间输出波动巨大，尤其是模型一旦“走偏”便难以纠正。触发阈值极低：仅需两轮及以上对话即可引发退化。现有补救策略（如对话末尾总结、每轮复述、降低温度）效果有限，复述策略仅缓解15%-20%性能损失，温度调零后不可靠性仍维持在30%左右。进一步分析表明，任务的可分解性是关键变量：可分解任务（如逐句翻译）不受多轮分片影响，而需要整合多轮信息的任务才会“Lost”。该研究刷新了对LLM对话能力的评估视角，并开源了代码与数据。论文：https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.06120；项目：https://github.com/Microsoft/lost_in_conversation。

arxiv.title: LLMs Get Lost In Multi-Turn Conversation
arxiv.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are conversational interfaces. As such, LLMs have the potential to assist their users not only when they can fully specify the task at hand, but also to help them define, explore, and refine what they need through multi-turn conversational exchange. Although analysis of LLM conversation logs has confirmed that underspecification occurs frequently in user instructions, LLM evaluation has predominantly focused on the single-turn, fully-specified instruction setting. In this work, we perform large-scale simulation experiments to compare LLM performance in single- and multi-turn settings. Our experiments confirm that all the top open- and closed-weight LLMs we test exhibit significantly lower performance in multi-turn conversations than single-turn, with an average drop of 39% across six generation tasks. Analysis of 200,000+ simulated conversations decomposes the performance degradation into two components: a minor loss in aptitude and a significant increase in unreliability. We find that LLMs often make assumptions in early turns and prematurely attempt to generate final solutions, on which they overly rely. In simpler terms, we discover that *when LLMs take a wrong turn in a conversation, they get lost and do not recover*.

papers.title: RAGEN-2: Reasoning Collapse in Agentic RL
papers.report_title: ICLR 2026 Oral | Agent RL训练的隐形杀手:RAGEN-2揭示模板坍缩,互信息+SNR过滤拯救推理能力
papers.summary: 西北大学、斯坦福、微软等机构在ICLR 2026 Oral论文中揭示Agent RL训练中的“模板坍缩”现象：模型熵稳定但互信息骤降，推理退化为输入无关的固定模板。提出互信息代理指标（Retrieval-Acc和MI-ZScore-EMA），与最终任务性能正相关（Spearman +0.39），而传统熵指标为负相关（-0.11至-0.14）。从信噪比视角解释机制：低奖励方差（RV）的prompt导致任务梯度弱，正则化噪声主导更新，驱动输入依赖下降。四分位消融实验提供因果证据：Q1（最高RV）训练的模型性能远优于Q4。提出SNR-Aware Filtering（Top-p按RV过滤prompt），在PPO、DAPO、GRPO、Dr.GRPO四种算法和0.5B-7B多种模型上验证，平均提升+6.9%（PPO+Qwen2.5-3B），视觉Agent场景提升最显著达+35.8%（FrozenLake从16.0%到69.5%）。过滤实现简单，额外计算开销<0.1%迭代时间。MI可作为早期预警信号，在任务性能退化前已显著下降。边界条件分析显示，环境随机性高或RV分布均匀时过滤效果减弱。

arxiv.title: RAGEN-2: Reasoning Collapse in Agentic RL
arxiv.abstract: RL training of multi-turn LLM agents is inherently unstable, and reasoning quality directly determines task performance. Entropy is widely used to track reasoning stability. However, entropy only measures diversity within the same input, and cannot tell whether reasoning actually responds to different inputs. In RAGEN-2, we find that even with stable entropy, models can rely on fixed templates that look diverse but are input-agnostic. We call this template collapse, a failure mode invisible to entropy and all existing metrics. To diagnose this failure, we decompose reasoning quality into within-input diversity (Entropy) and cross-input distinguishability (Mutual Information, MI), and introduce a family of mutual information proxies for online diagnosis. Across diverse tasks, mutual information correlates with final performance much more strongly than entropy, making it a more reliable proxy for reasoning quality. We further explain template collapse with a signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) mechanism. Low reward variance weakens task gradients, letting regularization terms dominate and erase cross-input reasoning differences. To address this, we propose SNR-Aware Filtering to select high-signal prompts per iteration using reward variance as a lightweight proxy. papers.report_title: MBZUAI出品!这个开源多智能体系统,让文献综述效率提升10倍
papers.summary: MBZUAI研究团队提出Paper Circle开源多智能体框架，由发现和分析两条流水线组成。发现流水线并行检索arXiv、Semantic Scholar、OpenAlex、DBLP四个数据源，平均覆盖8.7个来源，去重率43.5%，遗漏率仅9.0%（对比arXiv单独70.9%）。中位运行时间2.3分钟，用户负荷NASA-TLX评分1.2/7。采用四维评分框架（相似度、时效性、新颖性、BM25）和MMR多样性重排，三种搜索模式自适应权重。分析流水线构建类型化知识图谱（7类节点、6类边），支持图感知问答和覆盖度验证。在500条学术查询上HR达0.9818。消融实验显示“论文提及”和结构化检索链对准确性至关重要。与PaperQA2、STORM等竞品对比，Paper Circle在多智能体编排、多源发现、类型化知识图谱、节点/边溯源、覆盖度验证等方面具备独特优势。但审稿功能与人类评分相关性弱（|r|<0.25），不适合论文排名。系统在所有步骤同步输出JSON、CSV、BibTeX、Markdown、HTML五种格式，确保可重复性和可审计性。
