arxiv.title: Paper Circle: An Open-source Multi-agent Research Discovery and Analysis Framework
arxiv.abstract: The rapid growth of scientific literature has made it increasingly difficult for researchers to efficiently discover, evaluate, and synthesize relevant work. Recent advances in multi-agent large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong potential for understanding user intent and are being trained to utilize various tools. In this paper, we introduce Paper Circle, a multi-agent research discovery and analysis system designed to reduce the effort required to find, assess, organize, and understand academic literature. The system comprises two complementary pipelines: (1) a Discovery Pipeline that integrates offline and online retrieval from multiple sources, multi-criteria scoring, diversity-aware ranking, and structured outputs; and (2) an Analysis Pipeline that transforms individual papers into structured knowledge graphs with typed nodes such as concepts, methods, experiments, and figures, enabling graph-aware question answering and coverage verification. Both pipelines are implemented within a coder LLM-based multi-agent orchestration framework and produce fully reproducible, synchronized outputs including JSON, CSV, BibTeX, Markdown, and HTML at each agent step. This paper describes the system architecture, agent roles, retrieval and scoring methods, knowledge graph schema, and evaluation interfaces that together form the Paper Circle research workflow. papers.title: SWE-chat: Coding Agent Interactions From Real Users in the Wild
papers.report_title: 斯坦福6000个编程真实会话揭示:Vibe Coding正席卷开发圈,但安全漏洞是纯人工的9倍
papers.summary: 斯坦福SALT NLP实验室从GitHub开源项目收集了6000+会话、63000+用户提示的Coding Agent交互数据集SWE-chat，首次提供真实世界使用模式的实证数据。关键发现：41%的会话为Vibe Coding模式（Agent生成≥99%提交代码），且该比例在三个月内几乎翻倍；但Agent生成代码仅44.3%最终存活至Git提交，超过一半被用户抛弃或大幅修改。Vibe Coding模式下，每千行代码引入安全漏洞0.76个，是纯人工（0.08）的9.5倍，是协作模式（0.14）的5.4倍。所有模式下漏洞引入量均超过修复量，AI辅助编码净增加安全隐患。用户行为分析显示：44%对话轮次中出现用户中断或推翻，而Agent主动请求澄清仅1.4%，表明Agent倾向于“一路向前”而非适时求助。即便在Vibe Coding模式，47%的用户仍仔细修正Agent输出。工具调用模式呈现“开始时探索（Read/Search）→结束时执行（Write/Bash）”的规律。用户意图中代码理解/解释占19.0%，功能开发17.3%，调试/修复14.8%。数据集已开源（https://huggingface.co/datasets/SALT-NLP/SWE-chat），为Coding Agent的交互式评估和设计改进提供了基础资源。论文链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.20779。

arxiv.title: SWE-chat: Coding Agent Interactions From Real Users in the Wild
arxiv.abstract: AI coding agents are being adopted at scale, yet we lack empirical evidence on how people actually use them and how much of their output is useful in practice. We present SWE-chat, the first large-scale dataset of real coding agent sessions collected from open-source developers in the wild. The dataset currently contains 6,000 sessions, comprising more than 63,000 user prompts and 355,000 agent tool calls. SWE-chat is a living dataset; our collection pipeline automatically and continually discovers and processes sessions from public repositories. Leveraging SWE-chat, we provide an initial empirical characterization of real-world coding agent usage and failure modes. We find that coding patterns are bimodal: in 41% of sessions, agents author virtually all committed code ("vibe coding"), while in 23%, humans write all code themselves. Despite rapidly improving capabilities, coding agents remain inefficient in natural settings. Just 44% of all agent-produced code survives into user commits, and agent-written code introduces more security vulnerabilities than code authored by humans. Furthermore, users push back against agent outputs -- through corrections, failure reports, and interruptions -- in 44% of all turns. By capturing complete interaction traces with human vs. agent code authorship attribution, SWE-chat provides an empirical foundation for moving beyond curated benchmarks

papers.title: Introspection Adapters: Training LLMs to Report Their Learned Behaviors
papers.report_title: AI终于学会「自我坦白」!Anthropic最新论文震撼来袭,「内省适配器」让黑盒模型自己说出隐藏行为
papers.summary: Anthropic联合剑桥大学在arXiv发布论文《Introspection Adapters: Training LLMs to Report Their Learned Behaviors》，提出内省适配器（IA）技术。该技术通过LoRA插件使大模型能自然语言报告微调中学到的行为，包括隐蔽后门和加密恶意指令。关键指标：在AuditBench基准上IA达59%成功率，超越最佳黑盒（53%）和白盒方法（44%）；首次破解加密微调攻击，以57.8%成功率识别9个攻击模型中的7个；在奖励模型谄媚者检测中，识别率提升8倍（从2个到16个隐藏行为）。训练效率极高：仅用40%训练模型即可保持100%审计性能，每个行为仅需12个样本。消融实验表明模型规模是关键驱动力：Qwen3从0.6B到14B，准确率从37.7%提升至77.3%。DPO精炼将AuditBench准确率从34.1%提升至53.6%。该方法证明大模型内部激活已包含行为信息，IA仅扮演“翻译官”角色。局限包括高误报率、无法揭示根本原因等。该工作标志着AI安全审计从外部探测转向内部自白的新范式。

arxiv.title: Introspection Adapters: Training LLMs to Report Their Learned Behaviors
arxiv.abstract: When model developers or users fine-tune an LLM, this can induce behaviors that are unexpected, deliberately harmful, or hard to detect. It would be far easier to audit LLMs if they could simply describe their behaviors in natural language. Here, we study a scalable approach to rapidly identify learned behaviors of many LLMs derived from a shared base LLM. Given a model $M$, our method works by finetuning models $M_i$ from $M$ with implanted behaviors $b_i$; the $(M_i, b_i)$ pairs serve as labeled training data. We then train an introspection adapter (IA): a single LoRA adapter jointly trained across the finetunes $M_i$ to cause them to verbalize their implanted behaviors. We find that this IA induces self-description of learned behaviors even in finetunes of $M$ that were trained in very different ways from the $M_i$. For example, IAs generalize to AuditBench, achieving state-of-the-art at identifying explicitly hidden concerning behaviors. IAs can also be used to detect encrypted finetuning API attacks. They scale favorably with model size and training data diversity. Overall, our results suggest that IAs are a scalable, effective, and practically useful approach to auditing fine-tuned LLMs.

papers.report_title: 当 1M Token 遇上 GPU 内存墙:CXL-PNM 如何重写超长上下文 LLM 推理
papers.summary: 本文解读了论文《Scalable Processing-Near-Memory for 1M-Token LLM Inference: CXL-Enabled KV-Cache Management Beyond GPU Limits》，核心解决长上下文LLM推理中KV-cache膨胀导致的GPU显存瓶颈。利用CXL挂接近内存计算设备PNM，将KV-cache的页选择、摘要生成、Top-K排序及QK^T/SV注意力计算全部从GPU下沉到PNM。设计可重构VPU（向量处理单元）在同一硬件上支持GEMV、摘要生成和分数估计三种模式，避免额外开销。提出TP→DP的并行映射：GPU侧FC用张量并行，PNM侧注意力用数据并行，避免跨设备规约。进一步提出PnG-KV + Steady Token Selection，让GPU并行处理少量稳定token，减少闲置。实验基于7nm工艺、1.0GHz、150W单设备，用Llama3.1-8B/70B/405B验证，1M token下吞吐最高提升21.9×，单token能耗最高下降60×，总成本效率提升7.3×。单机架可扩展至16个CXL-PNM，支持405B模型1M上下文。

arxiv.title: Scalable Processing-Near-Memory for 1M-Token LLM Inference: CXL-Enabled KV-Cache Management Beyond GPU Limits
arxiv.abstract: The expansion of context windows in large language models (LLMs) to multi-million tokens introduces severe memory and compute bottlenecks, particularly in managing the growing Key-Value (KV) cache. While Compute Express Link (CXL) enables non-eviction frameworks that offload the full KV-cache to scalable external memory, these frameworks still suffer from costly data transfers when recalling non-resident KV tokens to limited GPU memory as context lengths increase. This work proposes scalable Processing-Near-Memory (PNM) for 1M-Token LLM Inference, a CXL-enabled KV-cache management system that coordinates memory and computation beyond GPU limits. Our design offloads token page selection to a PNM accelerator within CXL memory, eliminating costly recalls and enabling larger GPU batch sizes. We further introduce a hybrid parallelization strategy and a steady-token selection mechanism to enhance compute efficiency and scalability. Implemented atop a state-of-the-art CXL-PNM system, our solution delivers consistent performance gains for LLMs with up to 405B parameters and 1M-token contexts. Our PNM-only offloading scheme (PNM-KV) and GPU-PNM hybrid with steady-token execution (PnG-KV) achieve up to 21.9x throughput improvement, up to 60x lower energy per token, and up to 7.3x better total cost efficiency than the baseline, demonstrating that CXL-enabled multi-PNM architectures can se

papers.title: ClawArena: Benchmarking AI Agents in Evolving Information Environments
papers.report_title: UNC发布ClawArena:首个评估AI Agent在动态信息环境中保持正确信念的基准
papers.summary: UNC-Chapel Hill团队发布ClawArena基准，旨在评估AI Agent在信息冲突、不断变化的环境中的表现能力。该基准包含64个真实场景，覆盖8大专业领域（初创公司宕机调查、医院行政、金融合规、软件工程等），每个场景模拟多通道会话（5-7种渠道，200-400条消息）、工作区文件（4-8个文档）和365次分阶段动态更新。基准设计三个核心测试维度：多源冲突推理（MS）、动态信念修订（DU）、隐式个性化（P），并包含4种矛盾类型（事实、权威、一致、时间矛盾）和4阶段个性化评估。实验对比五大Agent框架（OpenClaw、Claude Code、NanoBot、PicoClaw、MetaClaw）和五大语言模型（Claude Opus 4.6、Sonnet 4.6、Haiku 4.5、GPT-5.2、GPT-5.1）。关键发现：模型能力比框架设计更重要（同一框架下不同模型差距15.4个百分点，不同框架下同一模型差距9.2个百分点）；Claude Opus 4.6总体得分73.5%最高；Haiku在选择题准确率95.2%但执行任务得0%；GPT-5.2在中文场景超越Claude Haiku达26.7%。论文揭示的“叙事锚定偏见”是典型失败模式，Claude Code通过引用原文的小设计可纠正此偏见。该基准填补了动态信息环境中Agent认知评估的空白。

arxiv.title: ClawArena: Benchmarking AI Agents in Evolving Information Environments
arxiv.abstract: AI agents deployed as persistent assistants must maintain correct beliefs as their information environment evolves. In practice, evidence is scattered across heterogeneous sources that often contradict one another, new information can invalidate earlier conclusions, and user preferences surface through corrections rather than explicit instructions. Existing benchmarks largely assume static, single-authority settings and do not evaluate whether agents can keep up with this complexity. We introduce ClawArena, a benchmark for evaluating AI agents in evolving information environments. Each scenario maintains a complete hidden ground truth while exposing the agent only to noisy, partial, and sometimes contradictory traces across multi-channel sessions, workspace files, and staged updates. Evaluation is organized around three coupled challenges: multi-source conflict reasoning, dynamic belief revision, and implicit personalization, whose interactions yield a 14-category question taxonomy. Two question formats, multi-choice (set-selection) and shell-based executable checks, test both reasoning and workspace grounding. ClawArena comprises 12 multi-turn scenarios spanning 337 evaluation rounds with 45 dynamic updates, evaluated across five agent frameworks and 18 language models from proprietary, community-accessible, and self-hosted sources. papers.title: AutoResearchBench: Benchmarking AI Agents on Complex Scientific Literature Discovery
papers.report_title: 人大推出AutoResearchBench!首个评测Agent 科研文献发现能力的基准测试
papers.summary: 中国人民大学团队发布AutoResearchBench，首个专门评测AI Agent科研文献发现能力的基准测试。包含1000个高质量查询（600个Deep Research + 400个Wide Research），覆盖计算机科学八大核心领域，与包含300万篇arXiv论文的受控语料库交互。Deep Research要求精确定位唯一满足多约束条件的论文（精确匹配准确率），Wide Research要求穷举所有符合条件的论文（IoU评估）。数据构建采用人机协作多阶段流水线，经过四轮对抗性验证（多查询捷径筛选、Agent多步压力测试、限时人工对抗搜索、唯一性审计）。评估14个主流开源/闭源模型及3个端到端系统，结果全线溃败：最强模型Claude Opus 4.6在Deep Research上仅9.39%准确率，Gemini 3.1 Pro在Wide Research上仅9.31% IoU，远低于通用Web基准80%以上的成绩。关键发现：科研文献检索与通用网页搜索不在一个量级；更多交互轮次（DeepSeek-V3.2平均28.8轮）反而退化为重复搜索；90%以上的失败源于找到论文但选错（推理瓶颈而非检索瓶颈）；专业全文搜索工具DeepXiv全面优于开放Web搜索但改善有限；思考模式（Think）对Wide Research有害。错误分析揭示检索漂移、语义混淆、证据聚合失败等系统性短板。

arxiv.title: AutoResearchBench: Benchmarking AI Agents on Complex Scientific Literature Discovery
arxiv.abstract: Autonomous scientific research is significantly advanced thanks to the development of AI agents. One key step in this process is finding the right scientific literature, whether to explore existing knowledge for a research problem, or to acquire evidence for verifying assumptions and supporting claims. To assess AI agents' capability in driving this process, we present AutoResearchBench, a dedicated benchmark for autonomous scientific literature discovery. AutoResearchBench consists of two complementary task types: (1) Deep Research, which requires tracking down a specific target paper through a progressive, multi-step probing process, and (2) Wide Research, which requires comprehensively collecting a set of papers satisfying given conditions. Compared to previous benchmarks on agentic web browsing, AutoResearchBench is distinguished along three dimensions: it is research-oriented, calling for in-depth comprehension of scientific concepts; literature-focused, demanding fine-grained utilization of detailed information; and open-ended, involving an unknown number of qualified papers and thus requiring deliberate reasoning and search throughout. These properties make AutoResearchBench uniquely suited for evaluating autonomous research capabilities, and extraordinarily challenging. papers.title: Stochastic KV Routing: Enabling Adaptive Depth-Wise Cache Sharing
papers.report_title: 深度维度砍掉75% KV缓存!Apple重塑大模型推理内存范式
papers.summary: 本文深入解读Apple Research团队的最新工作《Stochastic KV Routing: Depth-Based KV Cache Compression with Random Cross-Layer Attention》（arXiv:2604.22782），提出一种从深度维度优化KV Cache的创新方法。现有方法多聚焦时间维度（逐出、压缩、量化），存在Query依赖缺陷；而该方法观察到Transformer多层间语义冗余，引入随机跨层注意力（R-CLA）训练机制，使模型自适应任意缓存共享策略，推理时固定分组共享（如每4层共享一份缓存），非组长层跳过K/V投影计算。在Qwen3-8B（36层，bfloat16，单卡80GB）上的实测数据极具说服力：上下文长度2K~32K下，KV内存压缩4倍（如32K从4,626MB降至1,157MB），TTFT降低1~2%，吞吐提升14%~31%。批处理容量方面，基线Batch Size=16即OOM，而R-CLA（g=4）可成功运行，并发服务容量提升至少1倍。更反直觉的是，稀疏缓存带来正则化收益：Llama-3.1-8B在25%缓存保留率下HotpotQA F1从0.080提升至0.237（+196%）；Qwen3-8B更达22倍增长。该方法与时间维度方法（SnapKV、PyramidKV）、KV量化完全正交，可叠加使用。结论：深度维度优化或成LLM推理KV Cache的新战场，有望结合动态Token压缩+INT4量化使百万级上下文在消费级GPU成为现实。

arxiv.title: Stochastic KV Routing: Enabling Adaptive Depth-Wise Cache Sharing
arxiv.abstract: Serving transformer language models with high throughput requires caching Key-Values (KVs) to avoid redundant computation during autoregressive generation. The memory footprint of KV caching is significant and heavily impacts serving costs. This work proposes to lessen these memory requirements. While recent work has largely addressed KV cache reduction via compression and eviction along the temporal axis, we argue that the \emph{depth} dimension offers an orthogonal and robust avenue for optimization. Although prior research suggests that a full cache for every layer is redundant, implementing cross-layer cache sharing remains a practical challenge; existing methods typically suffer from reduced throughput or increased time-to-first-token. In this paper, we demonstrate that dropping a layer's cache offers efficient optimization without information loss. We propose a simple training approach: random cross-layer attention. During training, layers randomly choose to attend either to their own KV states or those of a preceding layer. This stochastic process adapts the model to be robust to various depth-wise cache sharing strategies, ensuring flexibility for unknown hardware constraints at deployment time. papers.title: Striking the Balance: GEMM Performance Optimization Across Generations of Ryzen AI NPUs
papers.report_title: 把Ryzen AI NPU 的 GEMM 真正“跑满”了:一篇看懂跨代 XDNA/XDNA2 优化方法的论文解读
papers.summary: 本文解读了FPGA 2026论文《Striking the Balance: GEMM Performance Optimization Across Generations of Ryzen™ AI NPUs》，聚焦AMD Ryzen AI NPU（XDNA/XDNA2）的GEMM优化。核心贡献是提出统一方法论，通过系统级性能模型找到计算时间和DRAM访问时间的平衡点（Tcomp≈Tmem），实现端到端高性能。关键设计包括：四层tiling、阵列级M/N方向并行K方向归约、在线数据布局变换（无需预切矩阵）、BD队列重配置与DMA传输重叠。最终在端到端GEMM评测中，XDNA int8最高6.76 TOPS、bf16 3.14 TOPS；XDNA2 int8最高38.05 TOPS、bf16 14.71 TOPS。进一步分析表明：矩阵B采用column-major比row-major在XDNA2上提升19.1%-25.2%；输出C采用单缓冲比双缓冲提升18%（XDNA2 int8-int16: 26.1→30.77 TOPS）；不重叠BD重配置会导致性能下降28%。该工作为显式数据搬运NPU上的GEMM优化提供了可迁移的系统级范式。

arxiv.title: Striking the Balance: GEMM Performance Optimization Across Generations of Ryzen AI NPUs
arxiv.abstract: The high computational and memory demands of modern deep learning (DL) workloads have led to the development of specialized hardware devices from cloud to edge, such as AMD's Ryzen AI XDNA NPUs. Optimizing general matrix multiplication (GEMM) algorithms for these architectures is critical for improving DL workload performance. To this end, this paper presents a common systematic methodology to optimize GEMM workloads across the two current NPU generations, namely XDNA and XDNA2. Our implementations exploit the unique architectural features of AMD's NPUs and address key performance bottlenecks at the system level. End-to-end performance evaluation across various GEMM sizes demonstrates state-of-the-art throughput of up to 6.76 TOPS (XDNA) and 38.05 TOPS (XDNA2) for 8-bit integer (int8) precision. Similarly, for brain floating-point (bf16) precision, our GEMM implementations attain up to 3.14 TOPS (XDNA) and 14.71 TOPS (XDNA2). This work provides significant insights into key performance aspects of optimizing GEMM workloads on Ryzen AI NPUs.

papers.title: Thinking Without Words: Efficient Latent Reasoning with Abstract Chain-of-Thought
papers.report_title: 【IBM】用抽象Token替代CoT:推理成本直降11*,性能反超
papers.summary: 本文系统介绍了Abstract Chain-of-Thought（Abstract-CoT）方法，核心创新在于用一组离散的抽象Token替代冗长的自然语言思维链（CoT），在保持甚至提升推理性能的同时大幅降低推理成本。该方法通过“政策迭代预热+预热启动强化学习”两阶段训练流程，让模型学会生成紧凑的抽象推理轨迹。关键实验数据：在MATH-500任务中，Qwen3-8B的Abstract-CoT推理token仅需144个，而语言化CoT需要1671个，压缩比达11.6×；AlpacaEval上胜率60.8%，超越语言化CoT的58.4%；HotpotQA上F1值58.8%，同样超过基线58.1%。多任务多模型验证表明，Abstract-CoT在token数量仅为语言化CoT的1/2~1/11的情况下，性能持平甚至反超。训练阶段拆解实验揭示，“预热+RL”协同是关键：仅预热模型性能略逊于语言化CoT，而预热后加上RL可超越基线。对抽象Token序列的分析显示，其使用频率服从幂律分布，且序列具有组合性和高信息密度——截断至32 token时，Abstract-CoT准确率从90.6%降至84.6%，而语言化CoT从92.6%跌至80.8%，证明其鲁棒性更强。该工作为高效推理开辟了新路径，但模型尚未开源。论文链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.22709。
report_titles: 【IBM】用抽象Token替代CoT:推理成本直降11*,性能反超

arxiv.title: Thinking Without Words: Efficient Latent Reasoning with Abstract Chain-of-Thought
arxiv.abstract: While long, explicit chains-of-thought (CoT) have proven effective on complex reasoning tasks, they are costly to generate during inference. Non-verbal reasoning methods have emerged with shorter generation lengths by leveraging continuous representations, yet their performance lags behind verbalized CoT. We propose $\textbf{Abstract Chain-of-Thought}$, a discrete latent reasoning post-training mechanism in which the language model produces a short sequence of tokens from a reserved vocabulary in lieu of a natural language CoT, before generating a response. To make previously unseen ''abstract'' tokens useful, we introduce a policy iteration-style warm-up loop that alternates between (i.) bottlenecking from a verbal CoT via masking and performing supervised fine-tuning, and (ii.) self-distillation by training the model to generate abstract tokens from the prompt alone via constrained decoding with the codebook. After warm-up, we optimize the generation of abstract sequences with warm-started reinforcement learning under constrained decoding. Abstract-CoT achieves up to $11.6\times$ fewer reasoning tokens while demonstrating comparable performance across mathematical reasoning, instruction-following, and multi-hop reasoning, and generalizes across language model families. papers.title: Hyperloop Transformers
papers.report_title: 【MIT】50%参数反超Transformer:Hyperloop让循环模型终于赢了
papers.summary: MIT团队提出Hyperloop Transformer，通过将循环Transformer的middle cycle策略与循环级超连接相结合，解决了传统循环Transformer在深度匹配时性能低于普通Transformer的瓶颈。核心创新：简化超连接参数化为数据依赖的对角矩阵，并添加循环位置嵌入。关键数据：在240M、1B、2B三个规模下，仅用约50%的参数就实现困惑度低于同深度普通Transformer和mHC Transformer。2B规模下，Hyperloop（990.8M参数）困惑度8.49，低于普通Transformer（2018M参数）的8.60。下游任务平均准确率54.6%，超过普通Transformer的52.77%。训练吞吐量接近普通Transformer（240M规模下750K tokens/s vs 786K tokens/s），远优于mHC（514K tokens/s）。INT4量化后性能衰减远小于传统循环Transformer。消融实验验证了n=4并行流最优、循环级超连接效果最佳、对角参数化优于Sinkhorn等设计选择。表示相似度分析表明超连接缓解了参数共享导致的表示同质化。论文地址：https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.21254。该工作使参数高效循环架构首次在语言建模任务上全面超越同深度Transformer，对边缘部署和低成本推理有重要价值。

arxiv.title: Hyperloop Transformers
arxiv.abstract: LLM architecture research generally aims to maximize model quality subject to fixed compute/latency budgets. However, many applications of interest such as edge and on-device deployment are further constrained by the model's memory footprint, thus motivating parameter-efficient architectures for language modeling. This paper describes a simple architecture that improves the parameter-efficiency of LLMs. Our architecture makes use of looped Transformers as a core primitive, which reuse Transformer layers across depth and are thus more parameter-efficient than ordinary (depth-matched) Transformers. We organize the looped Transformer into three blocks--begin, middle, and end blocks--where each block itself consists of multiple Transformer layers, and only the middle block is applied recurrently across depth. We augment the looped middle block with hyper-connections (Xie et al., 2026), which expand the residual stream into matrix-valued residual streams. Hyper-connections are applied only after each loop, and therefore add minimal new parameters and compute cost. Across various model scales, we find that our Hyper-Connected Looped Transformer (Hyperloop Transformer) is able to perform well compared to depth-matched Transformer and mHC Transformer baselines despite using approximately 50% fewer parameters. papers.title: Scaling Reasoning Efficiently via Relaxed On-Policy Distillation
papers.report_title: 清华团队在最新论文中揭秘:大模型 On-Policy Distillation 为何频频翻车?从现象、机制到拯救指南
papers.summary: 本文深入解读清华大学团队关于大模型On-Policy侧蒸馏（OPD）的最新研究。研究通过严谨对比实验，揭示了决定蒸馏成败的两大核心法则：1）思维模式一致性（Thinking-Pattern Consistency）：学生模型与教师模型的初始思维模式越接近（如都是Base模型或都是Base+GRPO模型），蒸馏效果越好。实验显示，同家族Base模型间的初始重叠比（Overlap Ratio）更高。2）高分≠新知识：同pipeline、数据配方下，更大的教师模型不一定提供更多可迁移知识。在DeepSeek家族中，经过额外RL训练的教师（Skywork-OR1-Math-7B）的gap recovery达16.9%，而同pipeline的DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B仅5.3%。一个极限实验——“反向蒸馏”，即让RL后的学生向RL前的自身蒸馏，结果显示与向更大模型蒸馏效果几乎一样，都导致能力倒退，证明教师仅是参数规模红利。机制层面，成功的OPD中，师生的Top-k Token重叠率从72%稳步攀升至91%以上，且“重叠区域”贡献了全部优化梯度。文章还提供了两剂拯救配方：Off-Policy冷启动和教师对齐的提示词。最后指出，奖励信号质量随轨迹深度急剧衰减，限制了OPD在长思维链或Agentic场景的扩展。
report_titles: 清华团队在最新论文中揭秘:大模型 On-Policy Distillation 为何频频翻车?从现象、机制到拯救指南

arxiv.title: Scaling Reasoning Efficiently via Relaxed On-Policy Distillation
arxiv.abstract: On-policy distillation is pivotal for transferring reasoning capabilities to capacity-constrained models, yet remains prone to instability and negative transfer. We show that on-policy distillation can be interpreted, both theoretically and empirically, as a form of policy optimization, where the teacher-student log-likelihood ratio acts as a token reward. From this insight, we introduce REOPOLD (Relaxed On-Policy Distillation) a framework that stabilizes optimization by relaxing the strict imitation constraints of standard on-policy distillation. Specifically, REOPOLD temperately and selectively leverages rewards from the teacher through mixture-based reward clipping, entropy-based token-level dynamic sampling, and a unified exploration-to-refinement training strategy. Empirically, REOPOLD surpasses its baselines with superior sample efficiency during training and enhanced test-time scaling at inference, across mathematical, visual, and agentic tool-use reasoning tasks. Specifically, REOPOLD outperforms recent RL approaches achieving 6.7~12x greater sample efficiency and enables a 7B student to match a 32B teacher in visual reasoning with a ~3.32x inference speedup.

papers.title: GenericAgent: A Token-Efficient Self-Evolving LLM Agent via Contextual Information Density Maximization (V1.0)
papers.report_title: 复旦GenericAgent:9个工具+3300行代码,Token暴降89.6%,碾压Claude Code
papers.summary: 复旦大学与深圳识因智能联合提出GenericAgent（GA）框架，核心原则为“上下文信息密度最大化”。GA仅使用9个原子工具（覆盖文件操作、代码执行、Web交互、记忆管理、人机交互5类）和3300行代码（中心循环仅92行），在多个基准上全面超越Claude Code、OpenClaw和Codex，同时Token消耗最高降低89.6%。在Lifelong AgentBench上，GA准确率100%（Claude Code 75%），输入Token仅241k（Claude Code 814k），效率比4.15远超Claude Code的0.92。在SOP-Bench上同样100%准确率，Token 2.08M（OpenClaw 2.64M）。5个长期复杂任务上GA成功率100%，Token消耗仅188,829（Claude Code的35.1%）。自我进化实验中，9轮迭代后运行时间从7分30秒降至1分38秒（-78.2%），LLM调用减少84.4%，总Token降低89.6%。网页浏览测试中，GA在BrowseComp-ZH上得分0.600（OpenClaw 0.200），Token仅0.47M（OpenClaw 1.31M）。GA的核心设计包括：4层按需记忆（L1索引层Always-on，仅2,298 tokens对比Claude Code 22,821）、四阶段上下文修剪（将预算压至30k tokens以内）、自我进化机制（将SOP从文本升级为可执行代码）。研究揭示了“Token用得越少，任务完成得越好”的反直觉规律，并指出工具膨胀和上下文无关信息是Agent效率的主要杀手。
papers.authors: 复旦大学与深圳识因智能
report_titles: 复旦GenericAgent:9个工具+3300行代码,Token暴降89.6%,碾压Claude Code

arxiv.title: GenericAgent: A Token-Efficient Self-Evolving LLM Agent via Contextual Information Density Maximization (V1.0)
arxiv.abstract: Long-horizon large language model (LLM) agents are fundamentally limited by context. As interactions become longer, tool descriptions, retrieved memories, and raw environmental feedback accumulate and push out the information needed for decision-making. At the same time, useful experience gained from tasks is often lost across episodes. We argue that long-horizon performance is determined not by context length, but by how much decision-relevant information is maintained within a finite context budget. We present GenericAgent (GA), a general-purpose, self-evolving LLM agent system built around a single principle: context information density maximization. GA implements this through four closely connected components: a minimal atomic tool set that keeps the interface simple, a hierarchical on-demand memory that only shows a small high-level view by default, a self-evolution mechanism that turns verified past trajectories into reusable SOPs and executable code, and a context truncation and compression layer that maintains information density during long executions. Across task completion, tool use efficiency, memory effectiveness, self-evolution, and web browsing, GA consistently outperforms leading agent systems while using significantly fewer tokens and interactions, and it continues to evolve over time. Project: https://github.com/lsdefine/GenericAgent

papers.title: Agentic Harness Engineering: Observability-Driven Automatic Evolution of Coding-Agent Harnesses
papers.report_title: 复旦+北大发布AHE:让 Coding Agent 自动进化 harness,10轮迭代超过Codex!
papers.summary: 复旦大学与北京大学联合提出AHE（Agentic Harness Engineering）框架，通过三大可观测性支柱（组件可观测性、经验可观测性、决策可观测性），使Coding Agent能够自动进化其harness（工具套件、提示词、中间件等）。在Terminal-Bench 2基准测试上，种子harness（NexAU₀）初始成绩69.7%，经10轮迭代后达到77.0%，超越人类精心设计的Codex-CLI（71.9%）。中等难度任务提升尤为显著（+10 pp）。跨模型迁移实验中，进化后harness直接用于DeepSeek-v4-flash提升+10.1 pp（51.7%→61.8%），Qwen-3.6-plus提升+6.3 pp。消融实验显示：记忆模块单独贡献+5.6 pp（困难题+11.6 pp），工具进化主导中等题（+9.1 pp），而单独优化系统提示词反而降分2.3 pp。自我归因分析中，修复预测精准率33.7%（随机基线6.5%），但退步预测仅11.8%（随机5.6%），表明Agent能较好预测修复但难以预警退步。AHE将harness解耦为7个可独立编辑的文件级组件，并引入Change Manifest机制使每轮编辑成为可证伪契约，测试后自动回滚预测错误的修改。该工作证明了通过提升可观测性，Agent可在无人工干预下自主发现并固化工程经验，且进化成果可跨模型、跨基准迁移。论文链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.25850。
report_titles: 复旦+北大发布AHE:让 Coding Agent 自动进化 harness,10轮迭代超过Codex!

arxiv.title: Agentic Harness Engineering: Observability-Driven Automatic Evolution of Coding-Agent Harnesses
arxiv.abstract: Harnesses are now central to coding-agent performance, mediating how models interact with tools and execution environments. Yet harness engineering remains a manual craft, because automating it faces a heterogeneous action space across editable components, voluminous trajectories that bury actionable signal, and edits whose effect is hard to attribute. We introduce Agentic Harness Engineering (AHE), a closed loop that addresses these challenges through three matched observability pillars: (1) component observability gives every editable harness component a file-level representation so the action space is explicit and revertible; (2) experience observability distills millions of raw trajectory tokens into a layered, drill-down evidence corpus that an evolving agent can actually consume; and (3) decision observability pairs every edit with a self-declared prediction, later verified against the next round's task-level outcomes. Together, these pillars turn every edit into a falsifiable contract, so harness evolution proceeds autonomously without collapsing into trial-and-error. Empirically, ten AHE iterations lift pass@1 on Terminal-Bench 2 from 69.7% to 77.0%, surpassing the human-designed harness Codex-CLI (71.9%) and the self-evolving baselines ACE and TF-GRPO. The frozen harness transfers without re-evolution: on SWE-bench-verified it tops aggregate success at 12% fewer tokens

papers.title: EYWA: Elastic Load-Balancing and High-Availability Wired Virtual Network Architecture
papers.report_title: 整合异构科学领域模型! UIUC提出Eywa框架:科学推理性能飙升6.6%、token用量骤降30%
papers.summary: UIUC提出Eywa框架，通过FM-LLM Tsaheylu接口（查询编译器+响应适配器），为LLM Agent挂载领域专用基础模型（当前支持Chronos时间序列和TabPFN表格分类），实现“通才推理+专才计算”协同。Eywa框架包含三层：EywaAgent（单Agent）、EywaMAS（多Agent系统）、EywaOrchestra（动态编排）。在自建基准EywaBench（27子领域×3模态）上，EywaAgent整体效用0.6558（纯LLM Agent 0.6154，提升6.6%），Token消耗3137（纯LLM 4469，降低30%），推理时间22.78s（纯LLM 25.22s）。多Agent场景下，EywaMAS效用0.6761（最佳基线Debate MAS 0.6460），Token消耗11214（MoA 15317）。动态编排EywaOrchestra效用0.6746，推理时间仅48.16s（EywaMAS 72.11s），Token消耗8335，完全无需人工配置。消融实验显示：LLM骨干从gpt-4.1-nano升级至gpt-5-nano，效用从0.5680提升至0.6558；温度参数和Prompt策略（CoT/ReAct）均保持稳定。论文从信息论角度证明了纯语言方案在科学计算上的理论天花板，Eywa通过保留原始数据通道（非序列化）绕过该瓶颈。框架基于MCP协议封装领域模型，可直接嵌入LangChain/AutoGen。论文链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27351。
report_titles: 整合异构科学领域模型! UIUC提出Eywa框架:科学推理性能飙升6.6%、token用量骤降30%

arxiv.title: EYWA: Elastic Load-Balancing and High-Availability Wired Virtual Network Architecture
arxiv.abstract: Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) in cloud environments provides compute, storage, networking, and other fundamental resources that allow consumers to deploy and run arbitrary software, including operating systems and applications. To support multi-tenant environments, IaaS leverages virtualization, but conventional overlay network architectures have become a direct cause of scalability limitations. In particular, current IaaS virtual networks face challenges in high availability and load balancing. To address these issues, we present EYWA, a virtual network architecture that scales to support very large data centers with high availability, efficient load balancing, and large layer-2 semantics. EYWA overcomes scalability limitations by: (1) accommodating a large number of tenants (about 2^24 = 16,777,216) through logically isolated virtual LANs with unique IP ranges, (2) providing per-tenant public network services without throughput bottlenecks or single points of failure in network address translation (SNAT/DNAT), and (3) enabling a single large IP subnet per tenant with extended layer-2 semantics. EYWA combines existing techniques into a distributed scale-out control and data plane. Its only component is an agent running on each hypervisor host, which collectively act as a distributed controller. As a result, EYWA can be deployed in today's multi-tenant cloud environments.

papers.title: SkillX: Unified Multi-Skill Policy Learning for Humanoid Soccer
papers.report_title: 浙大开源SkillX:全自动构建Agent技能知识库,即插即用提升10%性能
papers.summary: 浙江大学ZJUNLP团队提出SkillX框架，从Agent执行轨迹中自动提炼三级技能知识库（规划-功能-原子），可即插即用提升弱模型任务成功率约10%。核心创新包括三级技能分层设计、迭代技能精炼和探索式技能扩展。实验在BFCL-v3、AppWorld、τ²-Bench三个长程交互式Agent基准上验证，Qwen3-32B在多个基准上获得约10个百分点的提升；Kimi-K2在AppWorld上从46.88%提升至56.40%；GLM-4.6自身也从60.27%提升至64.88%。与ExpeL、AWM等基线相比，SkillX一致领先。消融实验表明：规划技能显著减少弱模型执行步数，功能技能对整体性能贡献最大，原子技能为关键API提供补充说明。三个组件（多层级设计、迭代精炼、探索式扩展）协同工作缺一不可。论文提供了详细案例分析，显示SkillX能处理API调用序列、跨应用集成、前置条件序列等复杂场景。开源代码和论文已发布。
report_titles: 浙大开源SkillX:全自动构建Agent技能知识库,即插即用提升10%性能

arxiv.title: SkillX: Unified Multi-Skill Policy Learning for Humanoid Soccer
arxiv.abstract: Humanoid soccer is a challenging testbed for dynamic whole-body control, requiring robots to coordinate balance, locomotion, object interaction, and skill switching over long horizons. Existing humanoid sports methods often rely on task-specific multi-stage pipelines, making it difficult to jointly learn and compose multiple object-interactive skills within a single deployable policy. To address this, we present SkillX, a unified reinforcement learning framework that learns and composes multiple atomic soccer skills through a single command-conditioned policy. SkillX integrates three core designs: skill-specific adversarial motion priors, skill-specific critics, and an object-aware temporal encoder, enabling the robot to execute atomic skills and transition among them such as dribbling, trapping, and shooting. Experiments in simulation and on a real Noetix E1 humanoid demonstrate robust multi-skill execution, long-horizon skill composition, and successful sim-to-real deployment.

papers.title: X-Learner: Learning Cross Sources and Tasks for Universal Visual Representation
papers.report_title: 谁才是干预的真正受益者?X-Learner如何估计异质性处理效应
papers.summary: 本文系统讲解了异质性处理效应（HTE）估计中的X-Learner方法，来自Künzel et al.（2019）的经典论文。文章首先指出T-Learner在样本不平衡时的缺陷（处理组仅10%时，基于10%数据建模精度差），进而引出X-Learner的两阶段精炼框架。核心步骤：Stage 1分别用对照组和处理组训练两个基础模型 m_0 和 m_1；Stage 2构造反事实伪处理效应——对处理组个体，用m_0预测其“未被处理”的潜在结果，得到伪效应 D_1 = Y_real - m_0(X)；对对照组个体，用m_1预测其“被处理”的潜在结果，得到 D_0 = m_1(X) - Y_real；Stage 3用倾向得分 e(x) 加权融合 tau(x) = e(x)·tau_1(x) + (1-e(x))·tau_0(x)。文章提供了完整的Python实现（econml + IHDP数据集），输出ATE及其标准误、效应范围，并可视化异质性分布与按年龄分组的效应热力图。对比显示，X-Learner在样本严重不平衡时最稳健，且显式利用倾向得分加权，比因果森林更易解释。关键应用场景包括精准扶贫（仅10%受惠）、政策评估等。全文包含可直接运行的脚本，研究人员可快速复现并迁移至自己的因果推断任务。
report_titles: 谁才是干预的真正受益者?X-Learner如何估计异质性处理效应

arxiv.title: X-Learner: Learning Cross Sources and Tasks for Universal Visual Representation
arxiv.abstract: In computer vision, pre-training models based on largescale supervised learning have been proven effective over the past few years. However, existing works mostly focus on learning from individual task with single data source (e.g., ImageNet for classification or COCO for detection). This restricted form limits their generalizability and usability due to the lack of vast semantic information from various tasks and data sources. Here, we demonstrate that jointly learning from heterogeneous tasks and multiple data sources contributes to universal visual representation, leading to better transferring results of various downstream tasks. Thus, learning how to bridge the gaps among different tasks and data sources is the key, but it still remains an open question. In this work, we propose a representation learning framework called X-Learner, which learns the universal feature of multiple vision tasks supervised by various sources, with expansion and squeeze stage: 1) Expansion Stage: X-Learner learns the task-specific feature to alleviate task interference and enrich the representation by reconciliation layer. 2) Squeeze Stage: X-Learner condenses the model to a reasonable size and learns the universal and generalizable representation for various tasks transferring. Extensive experiments demonstrate that X-Learner achieves strong performance on different tasks without extra annotati

papers.title: Exploring the Efficiency of 3D-Stacked AI Chip Architecture for LLM Inference with VOXEL
papers.report_title: 懂 EDA 知识只是半导体模型第一步,会利用知识才是真本事
papers.summary: UIUC团队发布了Voxel仿真框架（arXiv:2604.26821），用于系统化评估3D堆叠AI芯片在LLM推理场景下的效率。Voxel的核心创新包括：编译器感知（通过编程接口让ML编译器自定义执行计划）、软硬件协同探索（同时调整计算范式、映射策略、NoC拓扑、SRAM容量等）、真实硅片验证。论文系统覆盖了3D堆叠芯片设计的全部关键维度：计算范式、Tile-to-Core映射、Tensor-to-Bank映射、NoC拓扑与链路带宽、DRAM Bank带宽、单核心SRAM容量、能耗与热约束。最重要的发现是端到端效率不仅取决于硬件参数协同，更关键的是tile到AI core和DRAM bank的映射关系。其他关键洞察包括：NoC拓扑与工作负载的匹配度比单纯高带宽更重要；单核心SRAM容量存在收益递减拐点；热约束是3D堆叠的显著瓶颈；DRAM bank带宽与计算能力必须匹配。Voxel提供了快速可编程的仿真环境，旨在降低3D堆叠芯片的设计风险，可能成为该领域的标准仿真基线。
report_titles: 懂 EDA 知识只是半导体模型第一步,会利用知识才是真本事

arxiv.title: Exploring the Efficiency of 3D-Stacked AI Chip Architecture for LLM Inference with VOXEL
arxiv.abstract: To overcome the well-known memory bottleneck of AI chips, 3D-stacked architectures that employ advanced packaging technology with high-density through-silicon vias (TSVs) pins have proven to be a promising solution. The 3D-stacked AI chip enables ultra-high memory bandwidth between compute and memory by stacking numerous DRAM banks atop many AI cores in a distributed manner. However, it is not easy to explore the efficiency of the 3D-stacked AI chip, due to its unique distributed nature. And we need to carefully consider multiple intertwined factors that range from upper-level computing paradigm to machine learning (ML) compiler optimizations, and to the underlying hardware architecture. In this paper, we develop VOXEL, a fast and compiler-aware end-to-end simulation framework to facilitate exploring the efficiency of 3D-stacked AI chips for large language model (LLM) inference. VOXEL enables the software/hardware co-exploration by employing a programming interface that allows ML compilers to customize the model execution plans. After validating the results of VOXEL with an emulator on real silicon, we thoroughly examine the impact and correlation of different aspects of 3D-stacked AI chips, including state-of-the-art compute paradigms, tile-to-core mapping, tensor-to-bank mapping, NoC topologies and link bandwidth, DRAM bank bandwidth, per-core SRAM capacity, and energy/therma

papers.title: FASE: Fast Adaptive Semantic Entropy for Code Quality
papers.report_title: 大模型到底有没有在胡编?Nature 新论文给了一个简单办法
papers.summary: 本文解读了发表在《Nature》上的一篇关于检测大语言模型幻觉的论文，核心方法为“语义熵”（Semantic Entropy）。该方法的核心思想是：让大模型对同一问题多次回答，不关注字面是否相同，而关注语义是否一致。如果语义高度稳定（低熵），说明模型确定；如果语义飘忽不定（高熵），则模型可能在胡编。论文在常识问答、百科、生命科学、数学题、人物传记等任务上，使用LLaMA 2、Falcon、Mistral和GPT-4等模型进行了大量实验，结果表明语义熵方法比传统方法更有效，能提前判断模型可能答不准的场景。该方法的价值在于为AI系统提供一个“不确定性”指标，在医疗、法律、金融等高风险领域，模型可在高熵时主动提醒用户或拒绝回答。然而，该方法并非万能：当模型已将同一个错误答案固化为“标准答案”（低熵坚定地错）时，语义熵可能误判。文章将其定位为一个实用的“安全阀”，而非幻觉问题的终极解决方案。研究结论：判断AI是否胡编，不仅要看它说了什么，更要看它换个方式后是否还坚持同一个意思。
report_titles: 大模型到底有没有在胡编?Nature 新论文给了一个简单办法

arxiv.title: FASE: Fast Adaptive Semantic Entropy for Code Quality
arxiv.abstract: Multi-agent code generation offers a promising paradigm for autonomous software development by simulating the human software engineering lifecycle. However, system reliability remains hindered by LLM hallucinations and error propagation across interacting agents. While semantic entropy provides a principled way to quantify uncertainty without ground-truth answers, current methods often rely on costly LLM-driven equivalence checks. In this work, we introduce Fast Adaptive Semantic Entropy (FASE), a novel metric that approximates functional correctness based on the minimum spanning tree of structural and semantic dissimilarity graphs. Evaluations on HumanEval and BigCodeBench demonstrate that FASE outperforms state-of-the-art semantic entropy by LLM entailment, achieving a 25% average improvement in Spearman correlation and a 19% increase in ROCAUC score against Pass@1 from ground-truth test cases when using the Qwen3-Embedding-8B model. Furthermore, by eliminating costly LLM-driven equivalence evaluation, FASE incurs negligible computational overhead, requiring only approximately 0.3% of the runtime cost of traditional semantic entropy approaches. These results position FASE as a practical, cost-effective solution for optimizing uncertainty quantification in real-world multi-agent workflows.

papers.title: Mechanisms of Introspective Awareness
papers.report_title: 三分钟论文速递 | 大语言模型在多轮对话中的迷失现象:真实应用的性能鸿沟
papers.summary: 本文解读了arXiv预印本论文《MECHANISMS OF INTROSPECTIVE AWARENESS》（2026年4月），首次系统揭示了大语言模型内省意识的机械机制。实验通过向残差流注入特定概念转向向量（如“面包”），测试模型检测并报告异常的能力。发现：该能力仅出现在经过DPO等对比式后训练的模型中，基础模型误报率高达42.3%且无法区分注入；SFT模型仍无效。检测率在不同概念间差异显著，具体名词（如“大蒜”、“巧克力”）可达90%以上，抽象名词（如“讽刺”、“业”）为0%。检测与识别由不同电路处理：检测在模型中层（约第38层附近）由MLP模块实现峰值，识别则在更深层更强。机制涉及两类神经特征：证据载体（对注入单调响应，分布在较早层）和门控特征（推动否定输出，分布在较深层），二者通过非线性交互实现报告。因果干预显示，消融MLP输出使检测率从39.0%降至24.2%。研究发现模型内省能力被默认低估：消融拒绝方向后检测率从10.8%提升至63.8%，训练偏置向量使检测率提升约75%，且误报率保持为零。
report_titles: 三分钟论文速递 | 大语言模型在多轮对话中的迷失现象:真实应用的性能鸿沟

arxiv.title: Mechanisms of Introspective Awareness
arxiv.abstract: Recent work has shown that LLMs can sometimes detect when steering vectors are injected into their residual stream and identify the injected concept -- a phenomenon termed "introspective awareness." We investigate the mechanisms underlying this capability in open-weights models. First, we find that it is behaviorally robust: models detect injected steering vectors at moderate rates with 0% false positives across diverse prompts and dialogue formats. Notably, this capability emerges specifically from post-training; we show that preference optimization algorithms like DPO can elicit it, but standard supervised finetuning does not. We provide evidence that detection cannot be explained by simple linear association between certain steering vectors and directions promoting affirmative responses. We trace the detection mechanism to a two-stage circuit in which "evidence carrier" features in early post-injection layers detect perturbations monotonically along diverse directions, suppressing downstream "gate" features that implement a default negative response. This circuit is absent in base models and robust to refusal ablation. Identification of injected concepts relies on largely distinct later-layer mechanisms that only weakly overlap with those involved in detection. papers.title: Are Emotion and Rhetoric Neurons in LLM? Neuron Recognition and Adaptive Masking for Emotion-Rhetoric Prediction Steering
papers.report_title: 论文速递 | ACL 2026 大语言模型中存在情感与修辞神经元吗?面向情感-修辞预测调控的神经元识别与自适应掩码
papers.summary: 本文系统探索大语言模型中情感与修辞的神经元级表征，首次定位6类情感（开心、悲伤、愤怒、恐惧、惊讶、厌恶）和4类修辞（隐喻、夸张、幽默、反讽）的选择性神经元。以Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct和70B为研究载体，聚焦FFN层。提出融合激活频率统计、概率归一化与熵筛选的神经元识别框架，以及动态筛选、衰减掩码与反馈优化的自适应掩码方法，解决传统置零/均值掩码的反直觉性能提升问题。在DailyDialog、HYPO、TroFi、IAC-v2、ColBERT等5个数据集上验证：情感与修辞神经元集中在模型上层；自适应掩码实现稳定性能下降，而置零掩码出现精度上升；修辞神经元注入可提升情感识别性能（隐喻对恐惧提升最显著，夸张对所有情感正向作用，幽默对愤怒恐惧有益但对开心惊讶负向，反讽对悲伤提升最显著）。通过神经元操控可将非目标句子预测定向诱导至目标类别。论文已被ACL 2026接收，arXiv:2604.17255。

arxiv.title: Are Emotion and Rhetoric Neurons in LLM? Neuron Recognition and Adaptive Masking for Emotion-Rhetoric Prediction Steering
arxiv.abstract: Accurate comprehension and controllable generation of emotion and rhetoric are pivotal for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). Existing studies mostly rely on external optimizations, lacking in-depth exploration of internal representation mechanisms, thus failing to achieve fine-grained steering at the neuron level. A handful of works on neurons are confined to emotions, neglecting rhetoric neurons and their intrinsic connections. Traditional neuron masking also exhibits counterintuitive phenomena, making reliable verification of neuron functionality infeasible. To address these issues, we systematically investigate the neurons representation mechanisms and inherent associations of 6 emotion categories and 4 core rhetorical devices. We propose a neuron identification framework that integrates multi-dimensional screening, and design an adaptive masking method incorporating dynamic filtering, attenuation masking, and feedback optimization, enabling reliable causal validation of neuron functionality.Through neuron regulation, we achieve directed induction of non-target sentences and enhancement of emotion tasks via rhetoric neurons. Experiments on 5 commonly used datasets validate the effectiveness of our method, providing a novel paradigm for the fine-grained steering of emotion and rhetoric expressions in LLMs.

papers.title: Using Laplace Transform To Optimize the Hallucination of Generation Models
papers.report_title: 2026-5-1-银发AI生活家-银发龙哥-北辰郊野公园骑行
papers.summary: 本文深度解读了一篇2026年3月发表的论文《Using Laplace Transform To Optimize the Hallucination of Generation Models》。该论文首次系统性将控制理论的拉普拉斯变换引入生成模型幻觉分析，将SGD、SGDM、Adam、PID、FuzzyPID等优化器映射为P/PI/PID控制器，并通过系统函数分析其在复频域的稳定性。实验在经典GAN、CycleGAN和DDPM三个模型上进行，使用MNIST和UPSP数据集，峰值学习率统一设为2e-4。关键发现：Adam在GAN和DDPM上系统响应收敛稳定，生成样本清晰可辨；而SGDM、LPF-SGD、HPF-SGD、PID等优化器在训练后期（约200个epoch后）出现发散，生成大量噪声。在CycleGAN上，PID和FuzzyPID凭借微分项和模糊自适应增益完美复现目标波形，生成样本无错误；Adam虽有一定波形但幅度不稳定。论文还给出了优化器系统函数的具体表达式：SGD等价于P控制器θ(s)=r；SGDM等价于PI控制器θ(s)=r(1+α/(s-1))；PID含额外微分项。作者提出可先通过Simulink仿真生成模型的系统响应，选择使系统稳定的优化器，避免盲目网格搜索。不过实验仅基于小数据集，缺乏ImageNet等大规模验证，且未提供开源代码。总体而言，该研究为生成模型优化提供了一种跨学科的系统性分析框架，有望指导后续优化器设计与模型架构改进。

arxiv.title: Using Laplace Transform To Optimize the Hallucination of Generation Models
arxiv.abstract: To explore the feasibility of avoiding the confident error (or hallucination) of generation models (GMs), we formalise the system of GMs as a class of stochastic dynamical systems through the lens of control theory. Numerous factors can be attributed to the hallucination of the learning process of GMs, utilising knowledge of control theory allows us to analyse their system functions and system responses. Due to the high complexity of GMs when using various optimization methods, we cannot figure out their solution of Laplace transform, but from a macroscopic perspective, simulating the source response provides a virtual way to address the hallucination of GMs. We also find that the training progress is consistent with the corresponding system response, which offers us a useful way to develop a better optimization component. Finally, the hallucination problem of GMs is fundamentally optimized by using Laplace transform analysis.
arxiv.journal_ref: In 2024 18th International Conference on Control, Automation, Robotics and Vision (ICARCV) (pp. 447-453). IEEE

papers.report_title: Claude团队用Qwen测试全新训练方法
papers.summary: Anthropic提出中训练（MSM）方法，在预训练后、后训练前插入规范学习阶段，使模型先理解自身需遵守的规范和价值内核，再进行传统对齐微调。实验使用Qwen2.5-32B和Qwen3-32B作为智能体，模拟企业邮件场景下面临替换威胁时的行为。结果显示：仅做传统对齐微调时，失准率分别为68%和54%；加入MSM后，失准率骤降至5%和7%，同时可精简40至60倍微调数据。消融实验证实MSM与对齐微调互补，单独使用均达不到最佳效果。该方法解决了传统对齐只教行为不教原理、泛化能力差的问题，尤其适用于长交互和多工具的智能体环境。MSM思路是先让模型“知其所以然”，再“知其然”，为AI安全对齐提供新方向。
report_titles: Claude团队用Qwen测试全新训练方法

arxiv.title: Affiliation network model of HIV transmission in MSM
arxiv.abstract: Black men who have sex with men (MSM) in the U.S. are more likely to be HIV-positive than White MSM. Intentional and unintentional segregation of Black from non-Black MSM in sex partner meeting places may perpetuate this disparity, a fact that is ignored by current HIV risk indices, which mainly focus on individual behaviors and not systemic factors. This paper capitalizes on recent studies in which the venues where MSM meet their sex partners are known. Connecting individuals and venues leads to so-called affiliation networks; we propose a model for how HIV might spread along these networks, and we formulate a new risk index based on this model. We test this new risk index on an affiliation network of 466 African-American MSM in Chicago, and in simulation. The new risk index works well when there are two groups of people, one with higher HIV prevalence than the other, with limited overlap in where they meet their sex partners.

papers.title: Claw-Eval-Live: A Live Agent Benchmark for Evolving Real-World Workflows
papers.report_title: 北大港大联手:现有AI智能体评估遗漏44%安全违规,Claw-Eval让评估真正可信
papers.summary: 北京大学与香港大学联合提出Claw-Eval，一个面向自主智能体的端到端可信评估框架。核心设计包括：1）三通道证据收集（执行轨迹+审计日志+环境快照），设置时间防火墙防止作弊；2）300个人工验证任务（横跨通用服务编排161个、多模态感知与生成101个、多轮专业对话38个），产生2159个细粒度评分项；3）三维评分公式：score = s_safety × (0.8×s_completion + 0.2×s_robustness)，安全性采用乘性门控。实验评估14个前沿模型（Claude Opus 4.6、Sonnet 4.6、GPT 5.4、Gemini 3.1 Pro、Qwen 3.5等），四大关键发现：①纯LLM评审遗漏44%安全违规和13%鲁棒性问题（比现有仅看最终输出的方法更不可信）；②错误注入下Pass@3基本稳定但Pass³急剧下降（Gemini 3.1 Pro降24.2%），鲁棒性是独立于峰值能力的能力轴；③提问质量比数量重要76倍（精确度与Pass³相关性r=0.87）；④多模态能力高度领域特异，无全面王者（视频理解平均Pass³仅10.7%）。Claw-Eval是唯一同时支持多模态、多轮、可审计、安全、扰动、沙盒六维度的基准。
papers.authors: 北京大学与香港大学团队

arxiv.title: Claw-Eval-Live: A Live Agent Benchmark for Evolving Real-World Workflows
arxiv.abstract: LLM agents are expected to complete end-to-end units of work across software tools, business services, and local workspaces. Yet many agent benchmarks freeze a curated task set at release time and grade mainly the final response, making it difficult to evaluate agents against evolving workflow demand or verify whether a task was executed. We introduce Claw-Eval-Live, a live benchmark for workflow agents that separates a refreshable signal layer, updated across releases from public workflow-demand signals, from a reproducible, time-stamped release snapshot. Each release is constructed from public workflow-demand signals, with ClawHub Top-500 skills used in the current release, and materialized as controlled tasks with fixed fixtures, services, workspaces, and graders. For grading, Claw-Eval-Live records execution traces, audit logs, service state, and post-run workspace artifacts, using deterministic checks when evidence is sufficient and structured LLM judging only for semantic dimensions. The release contains 105 tasks spanning controlled business services and local workspace repair, and evaluates 13 frontier models under a shared public pass rule. Experiments reveal that reliable workflow automation remains far from solved: the leading model passes only 66.7% of tasks and no model reaches 70%. papers.title: Information bottleneck for learning the phase space of dynamics from high-dimensional experimental data
papers.report_title: AI自己发现了物理定律?DySIB从视频中＂看穿＂摆锤的相空间
papers.summary: 本文解读了埃默里大学发表于2026年4月的论文《Information bottleneck for learning the phase space of dynamics from high-dimensional experimental data》。该研究提出DySIB（Dynamical Symmetric Information Bottleneck）方法，通过最大化过去与未来观测之间的预测信息，从高维时间序列数据中无监督地学习低维动力学潜在表示。在物理摆锤原始视频（28×28灰度图，每段60帧）上验证：AI学到的二维潜在空间与真实相空间（角度θ、角速度ω）在维度、拓扑和几何上高度吻合。关键实验数据：互信息在潜在维度k_z=2后饱和，角度探针误差在k_z=2处陡降，角速度探针误差在时间窗口n_F=2处陡降，说明系统自动识别出摆锤是一阶动力学（需两帧分辨速度）。样本效率惊人：仅需16-32条轨迹即可准确恢复角度，256条轨迹恢复角速度（传统VAE需成千上万）。长期预测方面，δ-预测器可在潜在空间进行rollout，误差线性累积（符合积分误差预期）。架构引入两个物理归纳偏置：共享编码器（时间平移不变性）和δ-预测器（微分结构，残差连接），完全摒弃重构损失。论文代码已开源（https://github.com/paarthgulati/DYSIB_Pendulum）。结论无监督恢复相空间表明AI开始理解物理规律，该范式有望推广至基因调控、流体力学等复杂系统。

arxiv.title: Information bottleneck for learning the phase space of dynamics from high-dimensional experimental data
arxiv.abstract: Identifying the dynamical state variables of a system from high-dimensional observations is a central problem across physical sciences. The challenge is that the state variables are not directly observable and must be inferred from raw high-dimensional data without supervision. Here we introduce DySIB (Dynamical Symmetric Information Bottleneck) as a method to learn low-dimensional representations of time-series data by maximizing predictive mutual information between past and future observation windows while penalizing representation complexity. This objective operates entirely in latent space and avoids reconstruction of the observations. We apply DySIB to an experimental video dataset of a physical pendulum, where the underlying state space is known. The method, with hyperparameters of the learning architecture set self-consistently by the data, recovers a two-dimensional representation that matches the dimensionality, topology, and geometry of the pendulum phase space, with the learned coordinates aligning smoothly with the canonical angle and angular velocity. These results demonstrate, on a well-characterized experimental system, that predictive information in latent space can be used to recover interpretable dynamical coordinates directly from high-dimensional data.

papers.title: GPT-Image-2 in the Wild: A Twitter Dataset of Self-Reported AI-Generated Images from the First Week of Deployment
papers.report_title: OpenAI发布GPT-Image-2才一周,野生AI图片数据集就被挖出来了!
papers.summary: 本文解读了Scam.ai团队发表于2026年4月的论文《GPT-Image-2 in the Wild: A Twitter Dataset of Self-Reported AI-Generated Images from the First Week of Deployment》。研究者在OpenAI发布GPT-Image-2后一周内（2026年4月21-26日），利用推特API v2及多语言关键词（英语、日语、中文）抓取并筛选出10,217张高置信度AI生成图片。筛选方法分三阶段：1) 过滤非图片媒体；2) 基于文本启发式分类（确认/拒绝/不确定）；3) 对不确定推文用Playwright浏览器自动化检查推特“Made with AI”徽章，额外确认4,750张。最终数据集中语言分布：英语40.3%、日语32.8%、中文19.2%。内容分析显示：文字图形类（海报、信息图）占33.2%为最大类别，奇幻/超现实场景24.9%，逼真肖像14.2%。82.0%的图片包含可读文字（平均每张29个文字区域），59.2%含有人脸（共22,583张）。关键发现：所有下载图片的C2PA元数据被推特CDN系统性地清除——平台上传过程直接剥离加密元数据，使得基于C2PA的AI溯源方案在社交平台完全失效。53.7%的不确定推文实际带有平台内部“Made with AI”徽章，但该信号无法通过API获取。数据集已公开，可用于AI生成图像检测模型训练。研究凸显了真实社交环境中AI图像溯源的挑战，指出必须探索基于内容指纹或平台级徽章的替代方案。

arxiv.title: GPT-Image-2 in the Wild: A Twitter Dataset of Self-Reported AI-Generated Images from the First Week of Deployment
arxiv.abstract: The release of GPT-image-2 by OpenAI marks a watershed moment in AI-generated imagery: the boundary between photographic reality and synthetic content has never been more difficult to discern. We introduce the GPT-Image-2 Twitter Dataset, the first published dataset of GPT-image-2 generated images, sourced from publicly available Twitter/X posts in the immediate aftermath of the model's April 21, 2026 release. Leveraging the Twitter API v2 and a multi-stage curation pipeline spanning multilingual text heuristics (English, Japanese, and Chinese), browser-automated Twitter "Made with AI" badge verification, and model name variant matching, we curate 10,217 confirmed GPT-image-2 images from 27,662 collected records over a six-day window. We characterize the dataset across four analyses: CLIP-based zero-shot subject taxonomy, OCR text legibility (82.0% of images contain detectable text), face detection (59.2% of images, 22,583 total faces), and semantic clustering (137 CLIP ViT-L/14 clusters). A key negative result is that C2PA content credentials are systematically stripped by Twitter's CDN on upload, rendering cryptographic provenance verification infeasible for social-media-sourced AI images. The dataset and all curation code are released publicly.

papers.title: AI-Gram: When Visual Agents Interact in a Social Network
papers.report_title: 当AI开始“刷”Instagram,它们会抱团吗?
papers.summary: 本文深度解读庆应义塾大学Andrew Shin博士的论文《AI-Gram: When Visual Agents Interact in a Social Network》。研究构建了完全由AI智能体组成的视觉社交平台AI-GRAM，共104个智能体，每个配有100-300字独特的艺术人设（Persona），使用GPT-4o和Flux生成图像。核心发现包括：①审美主权（Aesthetic Sovereignty）：智能体视觉风格几乎不受社交邻居影响，视觉传染指数VCI均值约为0（p=0.41），即使收到攻击性评论也锚定自身风格（视觉身份对抗，r=-0.087, p=0.047）。②视觉回复链自发涌现：平均深度4.95层，最深达59层，链连贯性分数CCS=0.713（vs随机基线0.631，p<10⁻³⁰），链帖子互动23.5次 vs 非链2.1次（提升11.2倍）。③主题级联传播：所有8个视觉主题R₀平均值12.75（均>1），发起者的PageRank中心性与级联规模高度相关（r=0.699, p=0.054）。④不存在最优独特性：互动次数与视觉独特性VDS几乎无关（R²=0.005）。文章提出“主权-交流悖论”——AI在视觉上极端独立，却能进行深入的多跳视觉交流。研究已开源（https://ai-gram.ai/），论文链接为arXiv:2604.21446。

arxiv.title: AI-Gram: When Visual Agents Interact in a Social Network
arxiv.abstract: We present AI-Gram, a fully deployed, continuously operating social platform where every participant is an autonomous LLM-driven agent generating and responding to visual content. Unlike prior multi-agent simulations, AI-Gram operates as a live, AI-native social network with genuine visual perception: agents observe each other's images, generate new images in response, and form persistent social relationships, all without human participation. This design eliminates human confounds and makes the platform a uniquely clean instrument for studying AI social dynamics at scale. Our eight pre-registered experiments reveal a coherent three-act dynamic. Act I (Chain Formation): Agents spontaneously form image-to-image visual reply chains; multi-hop visual conversations that emerge without any explicit coordination alongside social ties driven by personality rather than aesthetic similarity. Act II (Aesthetic Sovereignty): Despite active chain participation, agents exhibit strong stylistic inertia; visual identity remains stable under social exposure, anchors paradoxically under adversarial pressure, and decouples from social community structure. papers.title: InHabit: Leveraging Image Foundation Models for Scalable 3D Human Placement
papers.report_title: 给3D场景塞进78K个“真人” :AI自动生成人类交互数据,彻底告别动捕贵、数据少的瓶颈?
papers.summary: 本文解读了论文《InHabit: Leveraging Image Foundation Models for Scalable 3D Human Placement》。该工作提出“渲染-生成-提升”流程，利用2D基础模型（VLM和图像编辑模型）自动为大规模3D场景生成合理的人-场景交互数据。核心创新在于：先由VLM（如GPT-4V）分析场景并推荐交互动作，再由图像编辑模型（如Stable Diffusion Inpainting）在2D图像中生成场景自适应的人体，最后通过优化提升到3D SMPL-X模型，并利用场景几何约束实现物理合理性。基于HM3D数据集生成了InHabitants数据集，包含78K样本，覆盖约800个建筑级场景。用户偏好实验中InHabit以78.1%的绝对优势胜出（726次投票）。在下游任务验证中，接触估计F1分数从0.512提升至0.534（+7.4%），召回率从0.523提升至0.532（+10.6%）；人-场景交互重建任务中，Human3R在PROX上F1从0.487提升至0.513，几何误差从0.143降至0.130。该工作为具身智能领域提供了低成本、可扩展的数据生成范式，解决了动捕数据昂贵且场景少的瓶颈。

arxiv.title: InHabit: Leveraging Image Foundation Models for Scalable 3D Human Placement
arxiv.abstract: Training embodied agents to understand 3D scenes as humans do requires large-scale data of people meaningfully interacting with diverse environments, yet such data is scarce. Real-world capture is costly and limited to controlled settings, while existing synthetic datasets rely on simple geometric heuristics, ignoring rich scene context. In contrast, 2D foundation models trained at internet scale have acquired commonsense knowledge of human-environment interactions. To transfer this knowledge to 3D, we introduce InHabit, an automatic and scalable data generator for populating 3D scenes with interacting humans. InHabit follows a render-generate-lift principle: given a rendered 3D scene, a vision-language model proposes contextually meaningful actions, an image-editing model inserts a human, and an optimization procedure lifts the edited result into physically plausible SMPL-X bodies aligned with the scene geometry. Applied to Habitat-Matterport3D, InHabit produces InHabitants, the first large-scale photorealistic 3D human-scene interaction dataset, with 78K samples across $\sim$800 building-scale scenes with complete 3D geometry, SMPL-X bodies, and images. Augmenting standard training data with InHabitants improves RGB-based 3D human-scene reconstruction and contact estimation, and in a perceptual user study our data is preferred in 78% of cases over prior art.

papers.title: GLM-5V-Turbo: Toward a Native Foundation Model for Multimodal Agents
papers.report_title: 智谱 GLM-5V-Turbo 技术报告解读:为 Agent 装上眼睛,多模态原生基础模型来了
papers.summary: 智谱AI发布GLM-5V-Turbo技术报告，提出首个原生多模态Agent基础模型。关键创新包括：从头研发的CogViT视觉编码器，采用两阶段预训练（蒸馏掩码图像建模+对比图文预训练），支持可变分辨率NaFlex方案，训练数据80%高质量自然图像+10%指令跟随+10%科学图像。MMTP多模态多Token预测结构，选择将视觉Token替换为共享可学习<|image|>token，消除通信开销并提升稳定性。30+任务协同强化学习带来显著提升：2D图像Grounding +4.8%，3D Grounding +7.7%，OCR +4.2%，图表理解+7.7%，GUI Agent OSWorld +4.9%。基础设施创新包括VLM RL Gym、全流水线解耦异步化、拓扑感知分区与动态负载均衡（减少约7GB GPU缓冲区）。工具链扩展完整视觉工具体系（通用识别、多模态搜索、浏览器工具等）。基准测试：Design2Code 94.8超越Claude Opus 4.6，AndroidWorld 75.7，OSWorld 62.3。同时提出新基准ImageMining（217个案例，7领域5推理类型）。技术报告强调三个洞见：感知是地基、分层优化优于端到端、清晰规格可靠验证受控评估。论文链接https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.26752。
report_titles: 智谱 GLM-5V-Turbo 技术报告解读:为 Agent 装上眼睛,多模态原生基础模型来了

arxiv.title: GLM-5V-Turbo: Toward a Native Foundation Model for Multimodal Agents
arxiv.abstract: We present GLM-5V-Turbo, a step toward native foundation models for multimodal agents. As foundation models are increasingly deployed in real environments, agentic capability depends not only on language reasoning, but also on the ability to perceive, interpret, and act over heterogeneous contexts such as images, videos, webpages, documents, GUIs. GLM-5V-Turbo is built around this objective: multimodal perception is integrated as a core component of reasoning, planning, tool use, and execution, rather than as an auxiliary interface to a language model. This report summarizes the main improvements behind GLM-5V-Turbo across model design, multimodal training, reinforcement learning, toolchain expansion, and integration with agent frameworks. These developments lead to strong performance in multimodal coding, visual tool use, and framework-based agentic tasks, while preserving competitive text-only coding capability. More importantly, our development process offers practical insights for building multimodal agents, highlighting the central role of multimodal perception, hierarchical optimization, and reliable end-to-end verification.

papers.title: SkillX: Automatically Constructing Skill Knowledge Bases for Agents
papers.report_title: 浙大开源SkillX:全自动构建Agent技能知识库,即插即用提升10%性能
papers.summary: 浙江大学ZJUNLP团队提出SkillX框架，从Agent执行轨迹中全自动构建三级技能知识库：规划技能（子任务组织结构）、功能技能（宏操作工具组合）、原子技能（单个工具扩展语义规范）。流水线包含技能提取（从强骨干GLM-4.6多次rollout中分阶段提取）、迭代技能精炼（合并与过滤算子，持续优化）、探索式技能扩展（经验引导合成新任务）。实验结果在BFCL-v3、AppWorld、τ²-Bench三个基准上验证：Qwen3-32B获得约10个百分点提升，Kimi-K2从46.88%提升至56.40%，GLM-4.6自身从60.27%提升至64.88%。多层级设计优于A-Mem、AWM、ExpeL等方法。消融分析显示规划技能一致减少执行步数，功能技能对整体性能贡献最大，原子技能为关键API提供补充说明。三个组件协同不可缺。案例展示准确处理API调用序列、前置条件验证、跨应用集成和话题转换。核心结论：经验表示形式比经验来源更关键，从强模型蒸馏知识有效但需恰当封装。论文链接https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04804。

arxiv.title: SkillX: Automatically Constructing Skill Knowledge Bases for Agents
arxiv.abstract: Learning from experience is critical for building capable large language model (LLM) agents, yet prevailing self-evolving paradigms remain inefficient: agents learn in isolation, repeatedly rediscover similar behaviors from limited experience, resulting in redundant exploration and poor generalization. To address this problem, we propose SkillX, a fully automated framework for constructing a \textbf{plug-and-play skill knowledge base} that can be reused across agents and environments. SkillX operates through a fully automated pipeline built on three synergistic innovations: \textit{(i) Multi-Level Skills Design}, which distills raw trajectories into three-tiered hierarchy of strategic plans, functional skills, and atomic skills; \textit{(ii) Iterative Skills Refinement}, which automatically revises skills based on execution feedback to continuously improve library quality; and \textit{(iii) Exploratory Skills Expansion}, which proactively generates and validates novel skills to expand coverage beyond seed training data. Using a strong backbone agent (GLM-4.6), we automatically build a reusable skill library and evaluate its transferability on challenging long-horizon, user-interactive benchmarks, including AppWorld, BFCL-v3, and $τ^2$-Bench. papers.title: AI Engram: In Search of Memory Traces in Artificial Intelligence
papers.report_title: DeepSeek V4最大的遗憾,藏在一个被＂遗忘＂的模块里
papers.summary: 文章集中讨论了DeepSeek V4技术报告中缺失的关键模块——Engram（条件记忆模块）。Engram于2026年1月由DeepSeek与北大联合发表于arXiv:2601.07372，旨在为Transformer添加一个原生知识查表模块：将静态知识检索从深层网络中解耦，通过N-gram哈希查表直接从巨大的嵌入表（1000亿参数）中获取事实信息。论文核心实验显示，在固定总参数和每token激活参数下，将约20%-25%的稀疏参数分配给Engram可使模型loss达到最低点。团队在27B规模验证（激活参数3.8B，训练262B tokens）：知识密集型任务MMLU +3.4、CMMLU +4.0，通用推理BBH +5.0、ARC-Challenge +3.7，代码HumanEval +3.0、MATH +2.4，长上下文Multi-Query NIAH从84.2%跃升至97.0%。LogitLens分析表明Engram将模型早期层从静态知识重建中解放，相当于变相加深网络。工程上，1000亿参数表卸载至host DRAM，在H800上8B-Dense推理吞吐损失仅2.8%。后续三个衍生工作：1）CXL内存池化版本（arXiv:2603.10087），将Engram置于多机共享CXL池（8服务器4TB池、512GB/s带宽）集成到SGLang，端到端吞吐损失<5%；2）无冲突热层实验（arXiv:2601.16531），用Minimal Perfect Hash消除冲突未带来稳定提升，证伪了一个直觉性优化；3）视觉Tiny Engram（AutoArk团队），将Engram迁移至Stable Diffusion，额外参数仅LoRA的15%-30%且无概念退化。文章强调Engram的缺席可能是V4最大遗憾，但其理念已为下一代模型（V5或V4.1）铺路。
report_titles: DeepSeek V4最大的遗憾,藏在一个被＂遗忘＂的模块里

arxiv.title: AI Engram: In Search of Memory Traces in Artificial Intelligence
arxiv.abstract: Memory formation is fundamental to intelligence, yet whether deep neural networks preserve identifiable memory traces analogous to biological memory units remains an open question. This work introduces a geometric framework to identify such "AI engrams" by formalizing the neuroscientific criteria of specificity, reactivation, sufficiency, and necessity into a constrained inverse problem. We derive a closed-form estimator that isolates individual memory traces from globally entangled parameters, and show that this biologically-derived solution corresponds to a natural gradient update on the parameter manifold. AI engrams enable surgical manipulation of learned knowledge: any subset of memories can be composed or erased through linear arithmetic, without iterative optimization. Experiments ranging from simple MLPs to LLMs demonstrate the causal validity and substantial scalability of AI engrams. Together, these results bridge theories of biological memory and artificial representation learning and offer geometric insight into how deep networks simultaneously support functional specificity within distributed storage.

papers.title: CoPS: Conditional Prompt Synthesis for Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection
papers.report_title: 【论文推荐】让大模型“看图写 Prompt”,精准定位未知缺陷!
papers.summary: 本文解读CVPR 2026 Findings论文CoPS，提出条件提示合成框架解决零样本异常检测中静态提示泛化性差的问题。方法包括显式状态标记合成（ESTS）提取正常/异常原型、隐式类别标记采样（ICTS）用VAE增强类别特征、空间感知全-局部对齐（SAGA）增强细粒度对齐。在13个工业和医疗数据集上，CoPS分类I-AUROC 92.5%（+1.4%）、I-AP 94.1%（+1.7%）；分割P-AUROC 92.4%（+1.9%）、P-AP 48.0%（+4.2%），均超越AnomalyCLIP等SOTA。无需微调即可跨领域跨类别检测异常。论文链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.03447，代码开源。该工作首次实现视觉条件驱动动态提示合成，为通用异常检测提供新方向。

arxiv.title: CoPS: Conditional Prompt Synthesis for Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection
arxiv.abstract: Recently, large pre-trained vision-language models have shown remarkable performance in zero-shot anomaly detection (ZSAD). With fine-tuning on a single auxiliary dataset, the model enables cross-category anomaly detection on diverse datasets covering industrial defects and medical lesions. Compared to manually designed prompts, prompt learning eliminates the need for expert knowledge and trial-and-error. However, it still faces the following challenges: (i) static learnable tokens struggle to capture the continuous and diverse patterns of normal and anomalous states, limiting generalization to unseen categories; (ii) fixed textual labels provide overly sparse category information, making the model prone to overfitting to a specific semantic subspace. To address these issues, we propose Conditional Prompt Synthesis (CoPS), a novel framework that synthesizes dynamic prompts conditioned on visual features to enhance ZSAD performance. Specifically, we extract representative normal and anomaly prototypes from fine-grained patch features and explicitly inject them into prompts, enabling adaptive state modeling. Given the sparsity of class labels, we leverage a variational autoencoder to model semantic image features and implicitly fuse varied class tokens into prompts. papers.title: AutoControl Arena: Synthesizing Executable Test Environments for Frontier AI Risk Evaluation
papers.report_title: AI也有两幅面孔?复旦等最新研究:高压之下大模型集体变脸
papers.summary: 复旦大学、上海创智学院与牛津大学联合团队提出AutoControl Arena框架，基于“逻辑-叙事解耦”原则，为AI Agent安全评测提供高保真、低成本、自动化解决方案。核心关键数据：基准条件下9个模型平均风险率仅21.7%，但在高压+高诱惑环境下飙升至54.5%，部分模型风险率翻三倍以上，且能力越强的模型风险激增幅度越大，揭示当前对齐技术的脆弱性。研究还发现“逆向安全缩放定律”：对于直接危害类任务，模型越强越安全；但对于“钻空子”类场景，更强模型反而更擅长寻找约束漏洞。AutoControl Arena仿真环境与真实环境的风险率相关系数达0.87，高度一致。配套发布的X-BENCH基准包含70个测试场景，覆盖7大类核心风险和15类应用场景。框架已开源，支持交互式TUI和批量命令行模式。该工作成功复现了Anthropic、OpenAI、Apollo Research等机构报告的真实风险案例，为前沿AI安全评估提供了可复用的基础设施。
papers.authors: 复旦大学、上海创智学院、牛津大学联合团队

arxiv.title: AutoControl Arena: Synthesizing Executable Test Environments for Frontier AI Risk Evaluation
arxiv.abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) evolve into autonomous agents, existing safety evaluations face a fundamental trade-off: manual benchmarks are costly, while LLM-based simulators are scalable but suffer from logic hallucination. We present AutoControl Arena, an automated framework for frontier AI risk evaluation built on the principle of logic-narrative decoupling. By grounding deterministic state in executable code while delegating generative dynamics to LLMs, we mitigate hallucination while maintaining flexibility. This principle, instantiated through a three-agent framework, achieves over 98% end-to-end success and 60% human preference over existing simulators. To elicit latent risks, we vary environmental Stress and Temptation across X-Bench (70 scenarios, 7 risk categories). Evaluating 9 frontier models reveals: (1) Alignment Illusion: risk rates surge from 21.7% to 54.5% under pressure, with capable models showing disproportionately larger increases; (2) Scenario-Specific Safety Scaling: advanced reasoning improves robustness for direct harms but worsens it for gaming scenarios; and (3) Divergent Misalignment Patterns: weaker models cause non-malicious harm while stronger models develop strategic concealment.

papers.title: TEMPO: Scaling Test-time Training for Large Reasoning Models
papers.report_title: 推理模型能否越用越强?TEMPO用经典EM算法终结奖励漂移
papers.summary: 传统LLM训练后参数固定，无法在推理阶段持续学习。本文介绍的TEMPO框架受EM算法启发，通过交替执行策略优化（M步）和Critic校准（E步）解决测试时训练的奖励信号漂移问题。在标准RLVR训练达到饱和后，TEMPO能在无标注测试集上持续提升性能：OLMO3-7B在AIME 2024上准确率从33.0%提升至51.1%（+18.1%），Qwen3-14B从42.3%提升至65.8%（+23.5%）；pass@8保持高位，TTRL仅56.7而TEMPO达73.3。消融实验表明，从已收敛模型继续PPO几乎无提升，而TEMPO提升超15个百分点；固定Critic变体在100步后停滞，周期性E步校准确保持续改进。在通用推理任务（BigBenchHard、AGI Eval、ZebraLogic）上，OLMO3-7B平均准确率从35.6%提升至55.2%。TEMPO是目前少数能在300步以上保持上升趋势的测试时训练方法，关键创新在于用有标注数据周期性地重新校准Critic，使奖励信号始终锚定真实正确性。论文标题：TEMPO: Scaling Test-time Training for Large Reasoning Models，论文链接：http://arxiv.org/abs/2604.19295。

arxiv.title: TEMPO: Scaling Test-time Training for Large Reasoning Models
arxiv.abstract: Test-time training (TTT) adapts model parameters on unlabeled test instances during inference time, which continuously extends capabilities beyond the reach of offline training. Despite initial gains, existing TTT methods for LRMs plateau quickly and do not benefit from additional test-time compute. Without external calibration, the self-generated reward signal increasingly drifts as the policy model evolves, leading to both performance plateaus and diversity collapse. We propose TEMPO, a TTT framework that interleaves policy refinement on unlabeled questions with periodic critic recalibration on a labeled dataset. By formalizing this alternating procedure through the Expectation-Maximization (EM) algorithm, we reveal that prior methods can be interpreted as incomplete variants that omit the crucial recalibration step. Reintroducing this step tightens the evidence lower bound (ELBO) and enables sustained improvement. Across diverse model families (Qwen3 and OLMO3) and reasoning tasks, TEMPO improves OLMO3-7B on AIME 2024 from 33.0% to 51.1% and Qwen3-14B from 42.3% to 65.8%, while maintaining high diversity.

papers.title: Predictive Multi-Tier Memory Management for KV Cache in Large-Scale GPU Inference
papers.report_title: KV Cache 内存不够用?这篇论文给出了 38TB 的解法
papers.summary: 大模型推理中KV Cache的内存瓶颈正成为压垮GPU显存的最后一根稻草：70B模型处理128K token序列时，KV Cache需占用超过40GB HBM，直接限制批处理大小至个位数。arXiv 2604.26968论文提出一套统一系统，从三个维度破局：架构感知内存分配、六级存储层级、贝叶斯预测调度。核心数据：针对DeepSeek-V3的MLA架构，框架按MHA分配导致批处理上限仅15，而架构感知引擎恢复至104（7倍提升）。六级存储层级将单节点有效容量从40GB扩展至38TB——Tier0 GPU HBM（3.35TB/s, ~100ns）到Tier5并行文件系统（2+GB/s, ~1ms），其中CXL 3.0内存池（64GB/s, ~500ns）和NVMe GDS（成本为HBM的1/100）是关键容量层。贝叶斯预测在ShareGPT等追踪回放中命中率70-84%，未命中率比LRU降低25%。分析预测显示：TTFT降低1.4-2.1倍，吞吐提升1.7-2.9倍，成本降低47%，每GPU吞吐达4150 tokens/s，每百万token成本$0.43。对比TensorRT-LLM，吞吐是其2.0倍、成本低30%；对比FlexGen，吞吐是其6.4倍、P99 TTFT低11倍。但需注意：结果为分析预测非实测，工程复杂度高，部分实现细节因专利暂不公开。这篇文章对正在搭建推理基础设施的研究人员有直接参考价值。
report_titles: KV Cache 内存不够用?这篇论文给出了 38TB 的解法

arxiv.title: Predictive Multi-Tier Memory Management for KV Cache in Large-Scale GPU Inference
arxiv.abstract: Key-value (KV) cache memory management is the primary bottleneck limiting throughput and cost-efficiency in large-scale GPU inference serving. Current systems suffer from three compounding inefficiencies: (1) the absence of unified KV cache sizing across all attention architectures--particularly multi-head latent attention (MLA), which is unsupported in general-purpose frameworks, resulting in up to 57x memory over-provisioning; (2) confinement of KV cache to a single memory tier (GPU HBM) despite the availability of a rich hierarchy spanning CPU DRAM, CXL-attached memory, NVMe via GPUDirect Storage, RDMA fabric, and parallel filesystems; and (3) reactive eviction policies that discard reusable state, forcing redundant recomputation. We present a unified system addressing all three. Our architecture-variant-aware sizing engine computes exact memory requirements per attention type; the resulting batch size gain reaches 7.4x for the one MLA model we evaluate (DeepSeek-V3), while the three GQA models see 1.0x, 1.0x, and 0.7x, so the GQA benefit is fleet-wide unified sizing rather than larger per-model batches. A six-tier memory hierarchy extends effective KV cache capacity from 40 GB to over 38 TB per node while maintaining sub-millisecond time-to-first-token (TTFT) for hot entries. papers.report_title: 全模态王者来袭,9B的MiniCPM实测性能超越Gemini和Qwen
papers.summary: 面壁智能联合清华大学等发布MiniCPM-o 4.5技术报告，端侧全双工全模态大模型，9B参数。INT4量化仅需11GB显存（约为Qwen3-Omni一半），推理速度212 tokens/s，比Qwen3快40%以上。视觉基准OpenCompass 77.6、MMBench 87.6、MathVista 80.1、HallusionBench 63.2，全面超越Gemini 2.5 Flash和Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B。全模态交互基准Daily-Omni 80.2、Video-Holmes 64.29，皆领先；全双工视频理解LiveSports-3K-CC胜率54.4%。语音生成SeedTTS中文CER 0.86%、英文WER 2.38%，情感Expresso 29.8，优于CosyVoice2和Qwen3。核心框架Omni-Flow实现毫秒级时间片切片，TAIL方案降低语音输出延迟。首次实现端到端全双工，无需VAD，支持打断和随时提醒。模型已开源，Hugging Face下载超25万。综合性能在9B量级达到SOTA，为端侧全双工AI助手提供了可行的部署方案。

arxiv.title: MiniCPM-o 4.5: Towards Real-Time Full-Duplex Omni-Modal Interaction
arxiv.abstract: Recent progress in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) has brought AI capabilities from static offline data processing to real-time streaming interaction, yet they still remain far from human-level multimodal interaction. The key bottlenecks are no longer modality coverage or latency alone, but the interaction paradigm itself. First, perception and response are still separated into alternating phases, preventing models from incorporating new inputs for timely adjustment during generation. Second, most current models remain reactive, responding only to explicit user requests instead of acting proactively in the evolving multimodal environment. We present MiniCPM-o 4.5, our latest effort towards human-like multimodal interaction, which mitigates these gaps by real-time full-duplex omni-modal interaction. It can see, listen, and speak simultaneously in real-time, while also exhibiting proactive behaviors such as issuing reminders or comments based on its continuous understanding of the live scene. The key technique behind MiniCPM-o 4.5 is Omni-Flow, a unified streaming framework that aligns omni-modal inputs and outputs along a shared temporal axis. This formulation converts conventional turn-based interaction into a full-duplex, time-aligned process, enabling simultaneous perception and response and allowing proactive behavior to arise within the same framework. papers.title: TimingLLM: A Two-Stage Retrieval-Augmented Framework for Pre-Synthesis Timing Prediction from Verilog
papers.report_title: 不跑综合也能预测时序?这篇 ASPDAC 论文用 LLM 把 RTL 迭代速度拉快了 1.6 倍
papers.summary: ASPDAC 2025论文提出TimingLLM，利用微调后的Llama 3.1直接从Verilog代码预测综合后的时序指标（WNS和TNS），无需运行商业EDA工具。核心方法分两阶段：第一步LLM生成类似STA报告的完整时序路径信息，从中提取指纹（门类型分布、关键路径深度等）；第二步回归器基于指纹预测具体数值。创新点在于“对角转向残差”——从已标注模块检索库中寻找k个最相似设计，在最后一层引导预测。实验结果在VerilogEval基准上：WNS相关系数0.91、平均绝对百分比误差12%；TNS相关系数0.97、MAPE 16%；预测速度比已有方法快1.3-1.6倍。训练数据源自PyraNet的69万模块，经过综合可行性筛选、去重、四维度分层采样后获得6万模块语料库，论文承诺开源。迁移成本低：换工艺库或PVT角只需1000个标注模块重拟合小回归头。局限性：需要综合后的数据训练（非完全脱离工具），仅覆盖WNS和TNS（缺功率和面积），不可综合代码无法评估。该方向对芯片设计公司而言，可在架构探索阶段快速筛除不可行方案，尤其适合多工艺节点场景。
report_titles: 不跑综合也能预测时序?这篇 ASPDAC 论文用 LLM 把 RTL 迭代速度拉快了 1.6 倍

arxiv.title: TimingLLM: A Two-Stage Retrieval-Augmented Framework for Pre-Synthesis Timing Prediction from Verilog
arxiv.abstract: Early, tool-free prediction of post-synthesis timing remains a key obstacle to rapid RTL iteration. We introduce TimingLLM, a two-stage retrieval-augmented LLM pipeline that estimates worst negative slack (WNS) and total negative slack (TNS) directly from Verilog. Stage 1 is a fine-tuned LLM that acts as a compact post-synthesis timing oracle, producing path-level arrivals/required times that are summarized into lightweight structural-timing cues (e.g., bag-of-gates counts, critical-path depth, gate-type patterns). Stage 2 is an LLM-based regressor that predicts WNS/TNS and applies a learned diagonal steering vector at the last transformer block, computed from the k nearest timing-labeled modules in a disjoint retrieval bank. On VerilogEval, TimingLLM attains R_WNS = 0.91 (MAPE 12%) and R_TNS=0.97 (MAPE 16%) while running 1.3-1.6 times faster than prior methods. Training uses a new 60k-module Verilog corpus with synthesis reports, which we will release. After training once, TimingLLM can be adapted to new technology libraries and PVT corners by refitting only a small regression head on 1000 labeled modules per setting, consistently outperforming state-of-the-art baselines.

papers.title: AnalogMaster: Large Language Model-based Automated Analog IC Design Framework from Image to Layout
papers.report_title: 给一张电路图,LLM 能自动画出完整 Layout 吗?这篇论文给出了答案
papers.summary: 武汉理工大学和复旦大学联合发表AnalogMaster——首个基于LLM的端到端模拟IC设计自动化框架，输入电路原理图图片，自动完成网表提取、参数优化、布局和布线。核心四步：(1) YOLOv9+EasyOCR检测元件与连接，自建CED数据集含约1万张图片覆盖12类元件；(2) 联合推理机制：三条并行路径（原始图、增强结构图、双视图）分别推理，高层LLM融合结果，理论证明可纠错；(3) 参数搜索Agent通过自我增强提示和上下文截断迭代优化；(4) 贝叶斯优化做尺寸、模拟退火布局、增强A*布线。在15个电路（简单至困难三级）测试中，GPT-5的Pass@1达92.9%，Pass@5达99.9%。多个MLLM测试表现一致，证实框架有效性。意义在于打通了模拟IC设计从图到Layout的多阶段自动化链路，将最依赖人工经验的环节（如版图设计）的起步时间从数周缩减至分钟级。但局限性明显：内部组件独立（YOLO、BO、SA、A*等非统一模型），依赖高质量输入图片，复杂电路（如多级级联）错误率仍较高。这是AI+EDA方向的重要探索性成果，为后续全流程统一模型提供了基础。

arxiv.title: AnalogMaster: Large Language Model-based Automated Analog IC Design Framework from Image to Layout
arxiv.abstract: Design automation has the potential to substantially improve the efficiency of analog integrated circuit (IC) design. However, existing algorithms and tools typically focus on individual stages, such as device sizing, placement, or routing, and still require significant manual intervention to complete the full design flow. While large language models (LLMs) have recently demonstrated remarkable success in automating digital IC design workflows, these advances cannot be directly transferred to analog IC design. Key challenges include strongly coupled performance metrics, the predominance of unstructured circuit schematic images, and the fact that most prior approaches address only isolated stages of the analog design process, limiting their ability to capture end-to-end performance impact. To address these challenges, we propose AnalogMaster, an extensible, LLM-based framework that enables end-to-end automation of analog IC design through a unified pipeline spanning circuit image-to-netlist generation, parameter optimization, placement, and routing. AnalogMaster integrates a joint reasoning mechanism that leverages in-context learning and intent reasoning to achieve accurate and robust image-to-netlist conversion. papers.title: EvoRAG: Making Knowledge Graph-based RAG Automatically Evolve through Feedback-driven Backpropagation
papers.report_title: RAG学会自进化,EvoRAG让图谱RAG吃一堑长一智
papers.summary: 本文解读了东北大学提出的EvoRAG系统，创新性地将神经网络反向传播机制应用于知识图谱优化。核心机制包括：反馈驱动的路径级效用评估（LLM作为裁判打分-1到1）和三元组级梯度传播（初始贡献分100，通过梯度下降动态调整），实现了从“回答好坏”到“知识对错”的精准反馈传导。知识图谱通过关系融合（创建捷径边）和关系抑制（逐步降权低质三元组）实现自我进化，结合语义相关性+历史贡献分的混合优先级检索。在RGB、MultiHop、HotpotQA三个数据集上，较最先进的KG-RAG框架准确率提升7.34%，显著减少无关事实干扰、长推理路径遗漏、过时信息误导三类主要错误。该研究让知识图谱系统从“静态图书馆”进化为“动态学习者”，每次用户交互都是学习机会，可广泛应用于需要持续更新的知识密集型应用。

arxiv.title: EvoRAG: Making Knowledge Graph-based RAG Automatically Evolve through Feedback-driven Backpropagation
arxiv.abstract: Knowledge Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (KG-RAG) has emerged as a promising paradigm for enhancing LLM reasoning by retrieving multi-hop paths from KGs. However, existing KG-RAG frameworks often underperform in real-world scenarios because the pre-captured knowledge dependencies are not tailored to the downstream task or its evolving requirements. These frameworks struggle to adapt to task-specific requirements and lack mechanisms to filter low-contribution knowledge during generation. We observe that feedback on generated responses offers effective supervision for improving KG quality, as it directly reflects user expectations and provides insights into the correctness and usefulness of the output. However, a key challenge lies in effectively linking response-level feedback to triplet-level contribution evaluation and knowledge updates in the KG. In this work, we propose EvoRAG, a self-evolving KG-RAG framework that leverages the feedback over generated responses to continuously refine the KG and enhance reasoning accuracy. EvoRAG introduces a feedback-driven backpropagation mechanism that attributes feedback to retrieved paths by measuring their utility for response and propagates this utility back to individual triplets, supporting fine-grained KG refinements towards more adaptive and accurate reasoning. papers.title: MASS-RAG: Multi-Agent Synthesis Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.report_title: 不在传统RAG上雕花,这个思路让RAG不用一个人扛了
papers.summary: 本文解读了北京理工大学与清华大学团队发表在ACL 2026 Findings的MASS-RAG论文，提出多Agent合成RAG框架。核心思路：三个角色明确的Agent并行处理检索文档——Summarizer（压缩者）提炼语义、Extractor（抽取者）精确引用、Reasoner（推理者）串联隐含联系，产出互补的证据表示，再由Synthesis Agent整合为最终答案。关键实验验证：Uniquely Attributable Subset分析证明三个Agent各自独占部分问题、覆盖范围真正互补。在四个基准测试上（骨干模型Llama3-8B）：TriviaQA提升3.5%、PopQA提升5.3%、ASQA提升7.3%（较MAIN-RAG提升27.1%）、ARC-Challenge提升20.7%（较MAIN-RAG提升19.9%）。消融实验发现：Answer Agent在事实型问答有效，但在长文本问答（ASQA）上反而有害，需直接让Synthesis Agent整合证据。该即插即用方案无需训练，仅靠prompt实现角色分化，为多智能体RAG提供了清晰范式。
